units.note: MG restores the bean image as turn yourself into a bean, though it omits small. UP retains tiny speck.
units.japanese: 「…少しでも隙があると、連中はすぐに“叶える願いの数を百に増やせ”とか“小さな豆粒に変身してみろ”とか言い出す」

description: 被った means having suffered or been subjected to fraud; get it from somewhere does not specify victimization.
sourceReading: People learn fraud because they suffered it somewhere, Beatrice tells Battler to infer.

units.text: "............Imagine it.  When people are born, they don't know of fraud.  ...They get it from somewhere.  And so they learn it."
units.note: MG retains They get it from somewhere. UP says They suffer it somewhere.
units.japanese: 「…………察しろ。人は生まれながらに詐欺を知りはせぬ。…どこかで被った。だから覚えた。」

units.text: "......Imagine it. When people are born, they know nothing of fraud. ...They get it from somewhere. And so they learn it."
units.note: MG retains They get it from somewhere. UP says They suffer it somewhere.
units.japanese: 「…………察しろ。人は生まれながらに詐欺を知りはせぬ。…どこかで被った。だから覚えた」

description: 我慢強さ is patience or endurance under strain; strength of determination emphasizes resolve instead.
sourceReading: A witch’s strength may depend on endurance rather than magical power, especially across a thousand years.

units.text: ......Maybe.  One thousand years is a long time......  Maybe a witch's true strength is decided not by their magical power, but by the strength of their determination.  ...I see, I can accept how terrifying Lady Bern is."
units.note: Both editions use endurance rather than determination.
units.japanese: ……かも知れぬな。千年は長い……。魔女の強さは魔力より、我慢強さで決まるのかもしれんな。…なるほど、ベルン卿の恐ろしさも頷ける。」

description: 乱入 in the competitive-game example means joining or challenging an ongoing game. Opponent’s territory adds a territorial premise.
sourceReading: A challenger joins, finds the opponent disappointingly weak, deliberately drops rounds, then overwhelms them in the final round.

units.text: "Come now, don't you often see it in competitive games?  Sometimes one player intrudes on their opponent's territory, but the opponent is so weak that it's a bit of an anticlimax, so the first player loses on purpose to extend the game until the last round, when they get serious and shower their opponent with blows, right?"
units.note: MG retains intrudes on their opponent's territory. UP says enter as a new challenger.
units.japanese: 乱入したけど相手があまりに弱くて拍子抜けで、わざと負けて最終ラウンドまで延長させて、最後に本気でフルボッコにすることとかってあるだろォ？」

units.text: "Come now, don't you often see it in competitive games? Sometimes one player intrudes on their opponent's territory, but the opponent is so weak that it's a bit of an anticlimax, so the first player loses on purpose to extend the game until the last round, during which they get serious and shower their opponent with blows, right?"
units.note: MG retains intrudes on their opponent's territory. UP says enter as a new challenger.
units.japanese: 「ほら、対戦ゲームでもよくあるだろォ？　乱入したけど相手があまりに弱くて拍子抜けで、わざと負けて最終ラウンドまで延長させて、最後に本気でフルボッコにすることとかってあるだろォ？」

description: それに耐えられる explicitly says Battler can withstand the aging; you are the same as that wine omits that capacity.
sourceReading: He is wine that can endure the aging, and Beatrice will mature him into a superb wine for her enjoyment.

units.text: ......You are the same as that wine.  I'll carefully make you age.  ......I'll raise you to be the best alcohol to color my elegant time..."
units.note: MG retains You're the same as that wine. UP says You are a wine that can withstand that process.
units.japanese: ……お前はそれに耐えられるワインだ。妾がじっくり熟成させてやる。……そなたを、妾の優雅な時間を彩る最高の美酒に育て上げてやるぞ…。」
candidates: are the same as that wine

units.text: ...You're the same as that wine. I'll carefully make you age. ...I'll raise you to be the best alcohol to adorn my elegant time..."
units.note: MG retains You're the same as that wine. UP says You are a wine that can withstand that process.
units.japanese: 「……お前はそれに耐えられるワインだ。妾がじっくり熟成させてやる。……そなたを、妾の優雅な時間を彩る最高の美酒に育て上げてやるぞ…」
candidates: You're the same as that wine

description: 幻想的な describes the dreamlike or fantastical impression of the butterflies; some kind of illusion makes them a potentially illusory thing.
sourceReading: On first seeing the butterflies George may have found them fantastical.

units.text: They were, ...countless gold butterflies. Because it was the first time George had seen them, it might have looked like some kind of illusion. ......But Gohda already knew. ...He knew that those gold butterflies were a long way from being beautiful, and that they caused some kind of misfortune.
units.note: MG retains some kind of illusion. UP says they might have looked fantastical.
units.japanese: 譲治にとっては初めて見るものだから、それは幻想的なものに見えたかもしれない。

units.text: They were...countless gold butterflies. It was the first time George had seen them, so it might've looked like some kind of illusion. ...But Gohda already knew. ...He knew that those gold butterflies were far from beautiful, and that they would bring about some kind of misfortune.
units.note: MG retains some kind of illusion. UP says they might have looked fantastical.
units.japanese:
それは、無数の黄金の蝶たち。譲治にとっては初めて見るものだから、それは幻想的なものに見えたかもしれない。……しかし郷田はすでに知っていた。
…あの黄金の蝶が、美しい存在などとは程遠い、何らかの不吉を司るものだと知っていた。

description: 舞い降りる specifies fluttering down upon Shannon; danced around omits the downward convergence.
sourceReading: The butterflies descend all at once upon Shannon, swarm and try to swallow her.

units.text: Shannon also realized that gold butterflies were trying to swallow her up. She ran unsteadily, her expression still shocked. As she did, the gold butterflies danced around Shannon at once. They grouped together.  They tried to swallow her up!
units.note: Both editions retain danced around Shannon rather than descending upon her.
units.japanese: その紗音に黄金の蝶たちは一斉に舞い降りる。

units.text: Shannon also realized that gold butterflies were trying to swallow her up. She ran unsteadily, her expression still shocked. As she did, the gold butterflies danced around her all at once. They grouped together. They tried to swallow her up!
units.note: Both editions retain danced around Shannon rather than descending upon her.
units.japanese:
紗音も自分が黄金の蝶たちに飲み込まれようとしていることを理解した。驚愕の表情のまま、よろよろと走る。
その紗音に黄金の蝶たちは一斉に舞い降りる。
群がる。飲み込もうとする！

units.text:
Shannon also realized that she was about to be swallowed up by gold butterflies. She ran unsteadily, her expression still shocked.
As she did, the gold butterflies danced around Shannon in unison.
They grouped together. They tried to swallow her up!
units.note: Both editions retain danced around Shannon rather than descending upon her.
units.japanese:
紗音も自分が黄金の蝶たちに飲み込まれようとしていることを理解した。驚愕の表情のまま、よろよろと走る。
その紗音に黄金の蝶たちは一斉に舞い降りる。
群がる。飲み込もうとする！

description: 壊れかかった means beginning to fail or nearly broken; broken states completed breakage.
sourceReading: George struggles with an aging, failing knob that will not turn properly.

units.text: George struggled with the broken handle. Its age showed, and it didn't turn well. I can't leave it to strength, it needs the right angle or some trick......
units.note: MG retains broken handle. UP says virtually broken, restoring that it is near failure rather than fully broken.
units.japanese: 譲治は壊れかかった摘みと奮闘する。

units.text: George struggled with the broken handle. Its age showed, and it didn't turn well. I can't leave it to strength, it needs the right angle, or there's some trick to it...
units.note: MG retains broken handle. UP says virtually broken, restoring that it is near failure rather than fully broken.
units.japanese:
譲治は壊れかかった摘みと奮闘する。
ガタが来てうまく回らなくなっているのだ。力任せじゃ駄目だ、ちょっとした角度とかコツの問題なんだ……。

description: ステンドグラスを背負うように places the stained glass behind the floating figure as a backdrop. Holding up suggests supporting the glass.
sourceReading: The laughing witch floats with the stained glass behind her, above the party table.

units.text: ......At that time, Gohda saw it. ......He was seen by it. In other words, their eyes met. On top of the party table, ......no, as if it was holding up the stained glass, floating, laughing, the figure of the witch. As the number of gold butterflies decreased, he saw the figure of the laughing witch in the center of the golden whirlwind.
units.note: MG places the stained glass behind the witch; UP says she is backed by it.
units.japanese: パーティーテーブルの上に、……いや、ステンドグラスを背負うように、浮いて、笑っている、魔女の姿を。

description: 黄金の蝶たちをはべらせ means having the butterflies attend her. As the number of gold butterflies decreased invents a decline in their number.
sourceReading: Gohda sees the witch laughing within the golden whirlwind, surrounded by butterflies attending her.

units.text: ......At that time, Gohda saw it. ......He was seen by it. In other words, their eyes met. On top of the party table, ......no, as if it was holding up the stained glass, floating, laughing, the figure of the witch. As the number of gold butterflies decreased, he saw the figure of the laughing witch in the center of the golden whirlwind.
units.note: MG has the butterflies fluttering about at the ready; UP has them attend to her whims. Neither invents a decreasing count.
units.japanese: 黄金の蝶たちをはべらせ、黄金の旋風の中で笑う魔女の姿を見た。

description: 引き出しを抜き出し means pulling the drawers out, not emptying their contents.
sourceReading: George removes each drawer and examines what is inside.

units.text: He emptied the drawers one by one and examined their contents. ......Every small box for makeup looked like a treasure box, and the amount of effort it would take to inspect all of them made him feel a little dizzy.
units.note: MG retains emptied the drawers. UP says pulled out the drawers and examined their contents.
units.japanese: 引き出しを次々に抜き出し中身を改める。

units.text: He emptied the drawers one by one and examined their contents. ...Every small box for makeup looked like a treasure box, and the amount of effort it would take to inspect all of them made him feel a little dizzy.
units.note: MG retains emptied the drawers. UP says pulled out the drawers and examined their contents.
units.japanese: 引き出しを次々に抜き出し中身を改める。……化粧道具の小箱はどれも宝物箱に見え、全てを改める手間の多さに軽い眩暈を覚えずにはいられなかった。

description: A slightly larger music-box-like box becomes something slightly larger than a music box, retaining size while omitting resemblance.
sourceReading: At a glance it looks like a somewhat oversized music box.

units.text: At a glance, it looked slightly larger than a music box. When shaken, it rustled, as though various small objects were inside. But it was locked and didn't open!
units.note: Both editions retain looked slightly larger than a music box, treating the music box as a size comparator rather than the box's apparent type.
units.japanese: それは一見、一回り大き目のオルゴールボックスに見えた。
candidates: looked slightly larger than a music box

units.text: At a glance, it looked slightly larger than a music box. When shaken, it rustled, as though various small objects were inside. But it was locked and didn't open!
units.note: Both editions retain looked slightly larger than a music box, treating the music box as a size comparator rather than the box's apparent type.
units.japanese:
それは一見、一回り大き目のオルゴールボックスに見えた。
振るとガサガサと中に色々な小物が入っている気配がする。
しかし鍵が掛かっていて開かない！
candidates: looked slightly larger than a music box

units.text:
At a glance, it looked slightly larger than a music box.
When shaken, it rustled, as though various small objects were inside.
But it was locked and wouldn't open!
units.note: Both editions retain looked slightly larger than a music box, treating the music box as a size comparator rather than the box's apparent type.
units.japanese:
それは一見、一回り大き目のオルゴールボックスに見えた。
振るとガサガサと中に色々な小物が入っている気配がする。
しかし鍵が掛かっていて開かない！
candidates: looked slightly larger than a music box

description: The source describes an illusion or impression as though someone beyond the door reopens it each time. English makes a prankster the agent creating the illusion of opening.
sourceReading: Gohda has the impression that a prankster on the other side undoes each closure.

units.text: Gohda hurriedly closed the door and locked it! However, just as he locked it, it returned to normal, just as though a spring or something had knocked it back! Just as though some prankster on the other side of the door was creating the illusion that it was opening every time he closed it. ......They shouldn't have reached the other side of the door yet!! Then who, how...?!
units.note: MG retains It gave the illusion that some prankster was unlocking it. UP says It almost gave the illusion that a prankster was opening it, restoring the impression as the apparent phenomenon rather than the prankster's act.
units.japanese: まるで、扉の向こうにいるイタズラ者が、閉める度に開けてしまっているような、錯覚。

units.text: Gohda hurriedly closed the door and locked it! However, just as he locked it, it returned to normal, just as though a spring or something had knocked it back! It gave the illusion that some prankster beyond the door was unlocking it every time he locked it. ...They couldn't have reached the other side of the door yet!! So who was doing it, and how...?!
units.note: MG retains It gave the illusion that some prankster was unlocking it. UP says It almost gave the illusion that a prankster was opening it, restoring the impression as the apparent phenomenon rather than the prankster's act.
units.japanese: 郷田は慌てて扉を閉め、そして施錠する！ところが施錠した途端、まるでバネか何かで弾き返されるように元に戻ってしまう！まるで、扉の向こうにいるイタズラ者が、閉める度に開けてしまっているような、錯覚。……距離的に、彼らはまだ扉の向こうに至っていないはず！！じゃあ、誰が、どうやって…？！
candidates: gave the illusion that some prankster

description: 声になってなかった means the scream no longer forms a voiced sound or utterance; didn’t sound like his voice describes changed vocal identity.
sourceReading: By now his scream no longer even comes out as a voice.

units.text: By now, Gohda's scream didn't sound like his voice. He could hear a sweet whispering voice from across the door. ......It wasn't coming from the witch, but judging by the sound of the voice, it was a young woman. ...But that didn't change the fact that it was a voice from one not of this world.
units.note: MG says the scream wasn't audible anymore; UP says it was not even vocalized. Neither changes its identity to a voice unlike Gohda's.
units.japanese: もう郷田の悲鳴は、声になってなかった。

description: 声だけを聞くならば若い女に聞こえた qualifies the impression by sound alone; it was a young woman asserts identity after judging by sound.
sourceReading: It is not the witch’s voice, but from the voice alone it sounds like a young woman.

units.text: By now, Gohda's scream didn't sound like his voice. He could hear a sweet whispering voice from across the door. ......It wasn't coming from the witch, but judging by the sound of the voice, it was a young woman. ...But that didn't change the fact that it was a voice from one not of this world.
units.note: MG says the voice sounded like a young woman. UP qualifies the judgment by sound but still states it was a young woman rather than limiting the claim to how the voice sounded.
units.japanese: ……魔女のものではなかったが、声だけを聞くならば若い女に聞こえた。

units.text:
By now, Gohda's scream was not even vocalized.
He could hear a sweet whispering voice from across the door. ......It wasn't coming from the witch, but judging by the sound of the voice, it was a young woman. ...But there was no difference in the fact that it was a voice from one not of this world.
units.note: MG says the voice sounded like a young woman. UP qualifies the judgment by sound but still states it was a young woman rather than limiting the claim to how the voice sounded.
units.japanese:
もう郷田の悲鳴は、声になってなかった。
扉の向こうから、甘い囁き声が聞こえる。……魔女のものではなかったが、声だけを聞くならば若い女に聞こえた。…しかしこの世ならざる者の声であることに何の変わりもなかった。

description: 少女だった頃から大切にしていそうな marks objects that appear cherished since girlhood; had treasured when she was a girl asserts the childhood history and drops continuity from then.
sourceReading: Objects spill out that look as though Natsuhi has treasured them ever since she was a girl.

units.text: *crack*. It was the sound of the lid to the treasure box breaking and opening. When George turned it over, accessories, charms, ......various small objects that Natsuhi had treasured when she was a girl fell out.
units.note: Both editions assert that Natsuhi treasured the objects when she was a girl, dropping the source's appearance qualifier and continuity from girlhood.
units.japanese: ……少女だった頃から大切にしていそうな様々な小物が出てきた。
candidates: treasured when she was a girl

units.text: *crack* It was the sound of the lid to the treasure box breaking open. When George turned it over, accessories, charms, ...various small objects that Natsuhi had treasured when she was a girl fell out.
units.note: Both editions assert that Natsuhi treasured the objects when she was a girl, dropping the source's appearance qualifier and continuity from girlhood.
units.japanese: ばきり。それは宝物箱の蓋が壊れて開いた音だった。譲治が中身を引っ繰り返すと、アクセサリーやお守りや、……少女だった頃から大切にしていそうな様々な小物が出てきた。
candidates: treasured when she was a girl

units.text: Crack. It was the sound of the lid to the treasure box breaking and opening. When George turned it over, out fell accessories, charms, ......various small objects that Natsuhi had treasured when she was a girl.
units.note: Both editions assert that Natsuhi treasured the objects when she was a girl, dropping the source's appearance qualifier and continuity from girlhood.
units.japanese: ばきり。それは宝物箱の蓋が壊れて開いた音だった。譲治が中身を引っ繰り返すと、アクセサリーやお守りや、……少女だった頃から大切にしていそうな様々な小物が出てきた。
candidates: treasured when she was a girl

description: 確信する means becoming certain; checked it immediately narrates an inspection instead.
sourceReading: George picks up the distinctive pouch and immediately knows this is it.

units.text: ...Mixed in with that, was a pouch that stood out from the rest. He picked it up, and checked it immediately. .........This was it.
units.note: MG says George was immediately sure; UP retains checked it immediately.
units.japanese: それを拾い、すぐに確信する。

units.text: ...Mixed in with those was a pouch that stood out from the rest. He picked it up, and checked it immediately. .........This was it.
units.note: MG says George was immediately sure; UP retains checked it immediately.
units.japanese: …それに混じり、一際目立つ巾着袋があった。それを拾い、すぐに確信する。………これだった。

description: 一手及ばなかった says George fell short by one move or step; you can’t do anything replaces near success with general helplessness.
sourceReading: Beatrice taunts him that he was one move too late before ordering the attack.

units.text: "You can't do anything.  *cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*!!
units.note: MG's so close, and yet so far restores the near miss without the one-move metaphor; UP gives One move short.
units.japanese: 「一手及ばなかったのぅ。くっくくくくくくくくく！！

description: それ resumes the apparent invisible wall, which repels the impostor while leaving red ripples. The loci left a bright red ripple on the wall attributes the ripple to the trajectories instead, though it then repelled him.
sourceReading: The wall leaves a ripple of bright-red traces as it repels, then actually shatters, the impostor.

units.text: As the impostor Kanon drew several purple loci, he should have attacked Shannon... But when he flew at Shannon, ......it felt like some kind of invisible wall had been set up in front of her. The loci left a bright red ripple on the wall, ......and it repelled the impostor. ......No, it didn't repel him, it smashed him. ......It knocked him back, turning him into golden dust, into pieces, scattering him...!
units.note: MG makes the wall repel the impostor while leaving the ripple. UP removes the old loci attribution but grammatically lets a ripple trail become the subject of it repelled, leaving the defensive agent unstable.
units.japanese: それは真っ赤な軌跡の波紋を残しながら、……偽者を弾く。
candidates: loci left a bright red ripple on the wall

units.text: As the impostor Kanon drew several purple trails, he definitely had attacked Shannon... But when he flew at Shannon, ......it felt like some kind of invisible wall had been set up in front of her. A bright red ripple trail was left on the wall, ......and it repelled the impostor. ......No, it didn't repel him, it smashed him. ......It knocked him back, turning him into golden dust, into pieces, scattering him...!
units.note: MG makes the wall repel the impostor while leaving the ripple. UP removes the old loci attribution but grammatically lets a ripple trail become the subject of it repelled, leaving the defensive agent unstable.
units.japanese: 偽者の嘉音が紫の軌跡を何条も描きながら、確かに紗音に襲い掛かったはずだった…。しかし、紗音に飛び掛った時、……紗音の前に、何か見えない壁が出来たように感じた。それは真っ赤な軌跡の波紋を残しながら、……偽者を弾く。……違う、弾いたんじゃない、砕いた。……黄金の粉にして、欠片にして、ばらばらにして弾き返した…！

description: 初めての夜を添い遂げる concerns sharing or consummating the first night together. Succeed in love adds an evaluative success condition.
sourceReading: Shannon asks how much sexual union and sharing their first night mean to two people in love.

units.text: Especially now, I think you are pitiful.  ......How much does it mean to a loving couple when they sleep together and succeed in love on their first night?"
units.note: MG's bring their love to fruition retains the evaluative-success framing in revised wording. UP's consummate their love expresses sexual union without separately making love a success. Both editions also preserve sexual detail from the fuller original-PC line; that edition material is recorded below in yellow and excluded from the paired error count.
units.japanese: 私は、今こそあなたを哀れに思う。……愛し合う二人にとって体を重ねることや、初めての夜を添い遂げることにどれほどの意味が？」

units.text: Especially now, I pity you. ...How precious is it for a loving couple when they bring their love to fruition by sleeping together on their first night?"
units.note: MG's bring their love to fruition retains the evaluative-success framing in revised wording. UP's consummate their love expresses sexual union without separately making love a success. Both editions also preserve sexual detail from the fuller original-PC line; that edition material is recorded below in yellow and excluded from the paired error count.
units.japanese: 「私は、今こそあなたを哀れに思う。……愛し合う二人にとって、添い遂げることにどれほどの意味が？」

description: あなた如き邪悪が口にする資格もない describes an evil being such as Beatrice as unqualified to speak of the sacred meaning at all. Speak of it wickedly makes wickedly qualify the manner of speaking.
sourceReading: The meaning is so sacred that an evil being such as Beatrice has no standing even to speak of it.

units.text: "......It does mean something, it definitely does.  ...But it's completely different from what you're saying.  It means something so sacred that one such as you has no right to speak of it wickedly."
units.note: Both editions retain no right to speak of it wickedly, making wickedly modify the manner of speech rather than treating Beatrice's wickedness as what disqualifies her.
units.japanese: 「……意味はある、きっとある。…でも、それはあなたの言うこととは全然違う。もっと神聖にしてあなた如き邪悪が口にする資格もないほどの神聖な意味がある。」
candidates: right to speak of it wickedly

units.text: "...It does have meaning, it definitely does. ...But it's completely different from what you're saying. It means something so sacred that one such as you has no right to speak of it wickedly."
units.note: Both editions retain no right to speak of it wickedly, making wickedly modify the manner of speech rather than treating Beatrice's wickedness as what disqualifies her.
units.japanese: 「……意味はある、きっとある。…でも、それはあなたの言うこととは全然違う。もっと神聖にしてあなた如き邪悪が口にする資格もないほどの神聖な意味がある」
candidates: right to speak of it wickedly

units.text: "......It does mean something, it definitely does. ...But it's completely different from what you're saying. It means something more sacred, so sacred that one such as you has no right to speak of it wickedly."
units.note: Both editions retain no right to speak of it wickedly, making wickedly modify the manner of speech rather than treating Beatrice's wickedness as what disqualifies her.
units.japanese: 「……意味はある、きっとある。…でも、それはあなたの言うこととは全然違う。もっと神聖にしてあなた如き邪悪が口にする資格もないほどの神聖な意味がある」
candidates: right to speak of it wickedly

description: 眼鏡男の欲望を覗いちまったら makes Shannon the observer of George’s dark desires. English makes George gaze at her with lust.
sourceReading: Beatrice claims Shannon would be devastated if she glimpsed the dark desires of the bespectacled man behind her.

units.text: "You'll despair, after that glasses man behind you gazes at you even once with dark lust, you'll lose heart, be shocked, be dumbfounded, be stupefied, and it's all useless, isn't it, Shannoooooooonnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn??  Hiiiihaaaaaaahahahahahaaaha--!!"
units.note: Both editions make Shannon the observer who glimpses or witnesses George's dark lust.
units.japanese: 「お前は失望するぜ、その後ろの眼鏡男のどす黒い欲望を一度でも覗いちまったら、がっかり愕然唖然呆然全然駄目だぜェエ紗音ォオオオンンンンンゥウゥウウゥ？？

description: 見えない円柱の壁 is an invisible cylindrical wall. Column of light substitutes light for the defensive wall.
sourceReading: Red ripples begin appearing simultaneously across the invisible cylindrical wall centered on Shannon.

units.text: I'll show you that this guy's only had his eyes on your fleeeeeeeeeeeeeeesh, die you piece of craaaaaaaaaaaaap, don't you tell me about looooooooooooooooooove!!" The invisible column of light with Shannon at the center, started to have bright red ripples drawn all over it at once.
units.note: Both editions retain an invisible column of light and later plural walls of the column instead of the source's single invisible cylindrical wall.
units.japanese: 紗音を中心とした見えない円柱の壁が、一斉に真っ赤な波紋を描き始める。

units.text: The invisible column of light with Shannon at the center, started to have bright red ripples drawn all over it at once. ...The wall did its best to withstand the malice that eyes couldn't see as it tried to corrode in on them from all directions.
units.note: Both editions retain an invisible column of light and later plural walls of the column instead of the source's single invisible cylindrical wall.
units.japanese: 紗音を中心とした見えない円柱の壁が、一斉に真っ赤な波紋を描き始める。

units.text: The invisible column of light with Shannon at the center...started to have bright red ripples drawn all over it at once. ...The wall did its best to withstand the unseeable malice that tried to corrode in on them from all directions.
units.note: Both editions retain an invisible column of light and later plural walls of the column instead of the source's single invisible cylindrical wall.
units.japanese: 紗音を中心とした見えない円柱の壁が、一斉に真っ赤な波紋を描き始める。…目に見えない悪意が全方向から侵食しようとしているのを、壁が懸命に堪えているのだ。

units.text: The invisible column of light with Shannon at the center started to have bright red ripples drawn all over it at once. ...The wall did its best to withstand the invisible malice that was trying to corrode it from all directions.
units.note: Both editions retain an invisible column of light and later plural walls of the column instead of the source's single invisible cylindrical wall.
units.japanese: 紗音を中心とした見えない円柱の壁が、一斉に真っ赤な波紋を描き始める。…目に見えない悪意が全方向から侵食しようとしているのを、壁が懸命に堪えているのだ。

units.text: I'll show you that this guy's only had his eyes on your fleeeeeeeeeeeeeeesh, die you piece of craaaaaaaaaaaaap, don't you tell me about looooooooooooooooooove!!" The invisible column of light with Shannon at the center, started to have bright red ripples drawn all over it at once.
units.note: At the barrier's collapse, MG calls the cylindrical wall a round wall and UP calls it a column. Both continue the earlier structural substitution rather than restoring an invisible cylindrical wall.
units.japanese: 紗音を中心とした見えない円柱の壁が、一斉に真っ赤な波紋を描き始める。

units.text: The invisible column of light with Shannon at the center, started to have bright red ripples drawn all over it at once. ...The wall did its best to withstand the malice that eyes couldn't see as it tried to corrode in on them from all directions.
units.note: At the barrier's collapse, MG calls the cylindrical wall a round wall and UP calls it a column. Both continue the earlier structural substitution rather than restoring an invisible cylindrical wall.
units.japanese: 紗音を中心とした見えない円柱の壁が、一斉に真っ赤な波紋を描き始める。

units.text: ...The round wall that had once protected them was assaulted and covered with a curve of bright red ripples as it seemed to scream, ...and it began to suck the two of them up instead.
units.note: At the barrier's collapse, MG calls the cylindrical wall a round wall and UP calls it a column. Both continue the earlier structural substitution rather than restoring an invisible cylindrical wall.
units.japanese: …かつて二人を守ってくれた円柱の壁は、悲鳴のような真っ赤な波紋の軌跡でいっぱいにしながら迫り、…むしろ逆に二人を飲み込もうとしている。

units.text: ...As the column that had once protected them was assaulted and covered with a trail of bloodcurdling red ripples, it contracted, ...and began to suck the two of them up instead.
units.note: At the barrier's collapse, MG calls the cylindrical wall a round wall and UP calls it a column. Both continue the earlier structural substitution rather than restoring an invisible cylindrical wall.
units.japanese: …かつて二人を守ってくれた円柱の壁は、悲鳴のような真っ赤な波紋の軌跡でいっぱいにしながら迫り、…むしろ逆に二人を飲み込もうとしている。

description: 悲鳴のような modifies the red ripple traces filling the wall. English says the wall made something like a scream, relocating the simile to an apparent sound or action.
sourceReading: The cylindrical wall closes in, filled with red ripple traces like screams, threatening to swallow the pair.

units.text: ...As the round wall that had once protected them was assaulted and covered with a locus of bright red ripples as it made something like a scream, ...it began to suck the two of them up instead.
units.note: MG makes the wall seem to scream, retaining the misplaced simile. UP's bloodcurdling modifies the red ripples themselves, restoring the visual attachment through revised imagery rather than an audible scream.
units.japanese: …かつて二人を守ってくれた円柱の壁は、悲鳴のような真っ赤な波紋の軌跡でいっぱいにしながら迫り、…むしろ逆に二人を飲み込もうとしている。

units.text: ...The round wall that had once protected them was assaulted and covered with a curve of bright red ripples as it seemed to scream, ...and it began to suck the two of them up instead.
units.note: MG makes the wall seem to scream, retaining the misplaced simile. UP's bloodcurdling modifies the red ripples themselves, restoring the visual attachment through revised imagery rather than an audible scream.
units.japanese: …かつて二人を守ってくれた円柱の壁は、悲鳴のような真っ赤な波紋の軌跡でいっぱいにしながら迫り、…むしろ逆に二人を飲み込もうとしている。

description: 作りかけていた identifies soup Gohda had started making; had made loses its unfinished preparation.
sourceReading: Genji reheats soup Gohda had been partway through preparing and eats refrigerator leftovers.

units.text: After Genji finished taking his late meal, he went out to do the nighttime rounds inside the mansion. He ate some reheated soup that Gohda had made, along with some random leftovers from the refrigerator. They were all things Gohda had made himself, and were, of course, delicious.
units.note: MG says Gohda had made the soup, losing its unfinished state. UP says he had started making it.
units.japanese: 食事は、郷田が作りかけていたスープを温めなおし、冷蔵庫の中にあった残り物を適当に食べた。

units.text: After Genji finished his late meal, he went out to do the nighttime rounds inside the mansion. He'd eaten some reheated soup that Gohda had made, along with some random leftovers from the refrigerator. Those were all things Gohda had made himself, and were, of course, delicious.
units.note: MG says Gohda had made the soup, losing its unfinished state. UP says he had started making it.
units.japanese: 源次は遅めの食事を取り終えた後、屋敷内の夜の見回りに出ていた。食事は、郷田が作りかけていたスープを温めなおし、冷蔵庫の中にあった残り物を適当に食べた。それらはいずれも郷田の手によるものだったので、やはり美味しかった。

description: 一応聞きには行った means he did go to ask, as a precaution or formality; half-heartedly attributes weak personal commitment.
sourceReading: Genji had at least gone to ask what Rosa’s group wanted for dinner, but was shouted away without the door opening.

units.text: He had half-heartedly gone to ask Rosa and the others what they would do for dinner, but he had been yelled at by a voice telling him that they had canned food so they were fine, and the door wasn't even opened for him. ......So ironically, the servant Genji was able to eat a more delicious meal...
units.note: Both editions retain half-heartedly for Genji's formal or precautionary inquiry.
units.japanese: 楼座たちに、夕食をどうするか一応聞きには行ったが、缶詰を食べるからいいと怒鳴られ、扉も開けてもらえなかった。

units.text: He had half-heartedly gone to ask Rosa and the others what they would do for dinner, but he'd been yelled at by a voice telling him that the canned food they had would be enough, and the door wasn't even opened for him. ...So, ironically, the servant Genji was able to eat a more delicious meal...
units.note: Both editions retain half-heartedly for Genji's formal or precautionary inquiry.
units.japanese: 楼座たちに、夕食をどうするか一応聞きには行ったが、缶詰を食べるからいいと怒鳴られ、扉も開けてもらえなかった。……なので皮肉にも、使用人である源次の方が美味しい食事を口に出来たのだった…。

units.text: He had half‐heartedly gone to ask Rosa and the others what they would do for dinner, but he had been yelled at by a voice telling him that they had canned food so they were fine, and the door wasn't even opened for him. ......So, ironically, it was the servant Genji who was able to eat the more delicious meal...
units.note: Both editions retain half-heartedly for Genji's formal or precautionary inquiry.
units.japanese: 楼座たちに、夕食をどうするか一応聞きには行ったが、缶詰を食べるからいいと怒鳴られ、扉も開けてもらえなかった。……なので皮肉にも、使用人である源次の方が美味しい食事を口に出来たのだった…。

description: 不可避であるならば is conditional. Since the fate that awaited him was unavoidable states unavoidability as a premise.
sourceReading: If the fate awaiting him is unavoidable, Genji would presumably regard orderly service until then as a virtue.

units.text: Was he taking a philosophic view, or was it simply resignation? Genji must have considered it a virtue to systematically carry out his duty until the last moment, since the fate that awaited him was unavoidable. It would probably be impossible to perceive the depths of his heart for all eternity, unless he told of it himself......
units.note: MG changes since to when, restoring a conditional circumstance though not the source's explicit if. UP retains since and therefore treats the fate's unavoidability as established.
units.japanese: 源次にとって、自分を待ち受ける運命が不可避であるならば、その瞬間まで勤めを整然と果たすことがきっと美徳であったに違いない。
candidates: since the fate that awaited him was unavoidable

units.text: Was he taking a philosophic view, or was it simply resignation? Genji must have considered it a virtue to systematically carry out his duty until the last moment, since the fate that awaited him was unavoidable. It would probably be eternally impossible to perceive the depths of his heart, unless he told of it himself......
units.note: MG changes since to when, restoring a conditional circumstance though not the source's explicit if. UP retains since and therefore treats the fate's unavoidability as established.
units.japanese: それは、ある種の達観なのか、それとも諦観なのか。源次にとって、自分を待ち受ける運命が不可避であるならば、その瞬間まで勤めを整然と果たすことがきっと美徳であったに違いない。彼の心の奥底をうかがい知ることは、彼が自ら語らぬ限り、永遠に不可能だろう……。
candidates: since the fate that awaited him was unavoidable

description: 戸締り includes securing or locking windows; windows were closed reports closure alone.
sourceReading: Without his master key, Genji can chiefly patrol the corridors and check that the windows are secured.

units.text: Because he had given the master key back to Rosa, the places he could go to were extremely limited. All he could do was walk around the hallways, checking to make sure that the windows were closed. So he was probably able to go around that route far more quickly than usual.
units.note: Both editions say Genji checks that windows are closed rather than that their security or locking is confirmed.
units.japanese: せいぜい廊下を回り、窓の戸締りを確認するくらいだ。

units.text: He had returned his master key to Rosa, so the places he could reach were extremely limited. All he could do was walk around the hallways, checking to make sure all the windows were closed. That probably made his rounds go a lot faster than usual.
units.note: Both editions say Genji checks that windows are closed rather than that their security or locking is confirmed.
units.japanese:
楼座にマスターキーを返した為、彼が見回れる場所はかなり限定されていた。せいぜい廊下を回り、窓の戸締りを確認するくらいだ。
だから、普段よりもだいぶ早く順路を回れるのだった。

units.text:
Because he had given the master key back to Rosa, the places he could go to were extremely limited. All he could do was walk around the hallways, checking to make sure that the windows were closed.
So he was able to go around that route far more quickly than usual.
units.note: Both editions say Genji checks that windows are closed rather than that their security or locking is confirmed.
units.japanese:
楼座にマスターキーを返した為、彼が見回れる場所はかなり限定されていた。せいぜい廊下を回り、窓の戸締りを確認するくらいだ。
だから、普段よりもだいぶ早く順路を回れるのだった。

description: By looking that one omits at.
sourceReading: Seeing the fallen object lets Battler recognize its stake-like construction.

units.text: So, by looking that one that had fallen over, for the first time, I realized that it wasn't a knife, but something like a stake. Its full length was probably about 30 centimeters. It was probably made out of bronze or iron or something of the sort. Even without touching it, I noticed that it had some weight to it. It was composed of a grip and a cone-shaped part, and it was obviously made to be a piercing weapon.
units.note: MG supplies looking at the fallen object; UP recasts the clause as when I saw it. Both repair the missing preposition.
units.japanese: だから、その倒れたものを見て初めて俺は、これがナイフではなく、杭のようなものであることを理解する。

description: 自分の胸が痛んだ describes Battler’s actual sympathetic pain; would cause anyone’s chest to hurt generalizes it into a hypothetical reaction.
sourceReading: Merely imagining the penetration makes his own chest hurt.

units.text: But the thing that caught the eye before that, .........was Gohda-san's corpse lying facedown right in front of the door... Right in the center of his chest, almost as though it had been stuck there to finish off a vampire, one of those demon stakes from before had been rammed in. ......Exactly how far could it have reached after being stuck that deeply into his chest? ...Just imagining it would cause anyone's chest to hurt.
units.note: MG generalizes the pain to anyone's chest. UP says My own chest hurt, preserving Battler's actual response.
units.japanese: …想像しただけで自分の胸が痛んだ。

units.text: But the very first thing that caught our eyes... ...was Gohda-san's corpse lying facedown right in front of the door... Right in the center of his chest, almost as though it had been stuck there to finish off a vampire, was one of those demon stakes from before. ...Exactly how far could it have reached after being stuck that deeply into his chest? ...Just imagining it would make anyone's chest hurt.
units.note: MG generalizes the pain to anyone's chest. UP says My own chest hurt, preserving Battler's actual response.
units.japanese: しかし、それより最初に目に入るのは、………部屋を入ってすぐのところにうつ伏せに倒れている郷田さんの遺体だった…。胸のど真ん中に、まるで吸血鬼に止めでも刺すみたいに、例の悪魔の杭がぶち込まれていた。……あれだけ深々と胸に刺されたら、一体どこまで至ってしまうのか。…想像しただけで自分の胸が痛んだ。

description: 額 specifies the forehead; head removes that anatomical precision.
sourceReading: Shannon has a gaping hole in her forehead, with its contents oozing out.

units.text: There was a gaping hole in Shannon-chan's head, and her insides were dripping out. Not only that, ...you could even see, ...inside her. After seeing that, I finally noticed that what I was doing was wrong. I immediately averted my eyes, but by now, it was probably pointless.
units.note: MG retains a hole in Shannon's head. UP correctly specifies her forehead.
units.japanese: 紗音ちゃんの額にはぽっかりと穴が空き、そこから中身がどろりと溢れてくる。

units.text: There was a gaping hole in Shannon-chan's head, and the insides were dripping out. Not only that, ...but you could even see...inside her. After seeing that, I finally realized I was doing something wrong. I immediately averted my eyes, but by now, it was probably pointless.
units.note: MG retains a hole in Shannon's head. UP correctly specifies her forehead.
units.japanese: 紗音ちゃんの額にはぽっかりと穴が空き、そこから中身がどろりと溢れてくる。それどころか、…その中身まで、…見えてしまう。それを見て、俺はようやくしてはいけないことをしたことに気付いた。慌てて目を背けたところで、今さら何の意味もなかっただろうが。

description: 絶対に大丈夫 becomes it’s alright without definitely or equivalent emphasis.
sourceReading: With Maria he will definitely be safe, she insists, so he should not fear.

units.text: "...However, if you're together with Maria, it's alright.  So, don't be afraid."
units.note: MG says only you'll be okay, omitting Maria's absolute certainty. UP retains definitely.
units.japanese: 「…でも、真里亞と一緒に居れば絶対に大丈夫。だから、怯えないで。」

units.text: "...However, if you're with me, you'll be okay. So don't be afraid."
units.note: MG says only you'll be okay, omitting Maria's absolute certainty. UP retains definitely.
units.japanese: 「…でも、真里亞と一緒に居れば絶対に大丈夫。だから、怯えないで」

description: 気休めでも is concessive: even if only empty comfort or reassurance, he appreciates it. It’s soothing asserts its comforting effect without the reservation.
sourceReading: Battler thanks Maria and says he is glad even if it is merely consolation.

units.text: ".........Thank you.  ......It's soothing, and I'm happy."
units.note: Both editions restore the concessive even if the reassurance is only consolation and preserve Battler's gratitude.
units.japanese: 「………ありがとな。……気休めでも、…嬉しいぜ。」

description: 死んでいる者だけが正しくて contrasts the dead as blameless or in the right with living wolves. Only the dead were safe shifts to safety.
sourceReading: If only the dead count as in the right and every living person is a wolf, the remaining suspects are the six survivors or presumed survivors.

units.text: Now that we had been released from our suspicion of those three, we once again returned to the parlor. I don't have a clue what's going on anymore. ......If only the dead were safe, and everyone alive was a wolf, ......all that was left was me, Rosa oba-san, Maria, and Genji-san. ......Only those, Grandfather, and that 19th person, the guest who we hadn't even sensed, Beatrice.
units.note: MG says only the dead are innocent, preserving the contrast with living wolves. UP retains only the dead are safe.
units.japanese: ……死んでいる者だけが正しくて、生きている者が全て狼だと言うなら、……あとに残るは、俺に楼座叔母さんに真里亞、それに源次さん。

units.text: Now that we had been released from our suspicion of those three, ......we once again returned to the parlor. I don't have a clue what's going on anymore. ......If only the dead are safe, and everyone alive is a wolf, ......then all that's left is me, Auntie Rosa, Maria, and Genji‐san. ......Only those, Grandfather, and that 19th person—the guest who I hadn't even sensed— Beatrice.
units.note: MG says only the dead are innocent, preserving the contrast with living wolves. UP retains only the dead are safe.
units.japanese: 俺たちは、あの３人に対する疑いから解放され、……再び客間へ戻る。もう、何が何だかわからない。……死んでいる者だけが正しくて、生きている者が全て狼だと言うなら、……あとに残るは、俺に楼座叔母さんに真里亞、それに源次さん。……そして、祖父さまと、気配すら見せない１９人目の来客、ベアトリーチェだけ。

description: Two pieces of stationary uses the adjective for the noun stationery.
sourceReading: Two sheets of writing paper emerge from the envelope.

units.text: I opened the letter. Two pieces of stationary came out. The first page, ...had a magic circle drawn on it, with something like blood. If I asked Maria, she'd probably know what it meant. And there was writing on the other page.
units.note: MG retains stationary. UP correctly spells stationery.
units.japanese:
封筒を開ける。
中からは便箋が２枚出てきた。
１枚目には、……血のような赤いもので、魔法陣が書いてある。
真里亞に聞けば意味はわかるだろう。
そしてもう１枚には文字が。

units.text: I opened the letter. Two pieces of stationary came out. The first page...had a magic circle drawn on it with something like blood. If I asked Maria, she'd probably know what it meant. And there was writing on the other page.
units.note: MG retains stationary. UP correctly spells stationery.
units.japanese:
封筒を開ける。
中からは便箋が２枚出てきた。１枚目には、……血のような赤いもので、魔法陣が書いてある。真里亞に聞けば意味はわかるだろう。そしてもう１枚には文字が。

description: The source says only Battler approached the table and claims to have found the letter. English puts both approaching and finding under claims to have.
sourceReading: Rosa distinguishes her observations about table access from Battler’s asserted discovery.

units.text: "When I came into the room just now, I saw that there was nothing at all on the table.  ...And I know that Maria did not approach that table.  ...It was for a short time.  But the only one who claims to have approached the table and found the letter, is you."
units.note: MG puts both approaching the table and finding the letter under claims to have. UP presents the approach as Rosa's observation and only the finding as Battler's claim.
units.japanese: 「私はこの部屋にたった今帰ってきて、そのテーブルの上に何もないことを見ているわ。…そして真里亞がそのテーブルに近付いていないことも知っている。…わずかな時間よ。でもこのテーブルに近付き、そして手紙を見つけたと主張するのはあなただけ、なのよ。」

units.text: "When I came into the room just now, I saw that there was nothing at all on the table. ...And I know that Maria did not approach that table. ...We're talking about a short stretch of time. But the only one who claims to have approached the table and found the letter...is you."
units.note: MG puts both approaching the table and finding the letter under claims to have. UP presents the approach as Rosa's observation and only the finding as Battler's claim.
units.japanese: 「私はこの部屋にたった今帰ってきて、そのテーブルの上に何もないことを見ているわ。…そして真里亞がそのテーブルに近付いていないことも知っている。…わずかな時間よ。でもこのテーブルに近付き、そして手紙を見つけたと主張するのはあなただけ、なのよ」

description: そこだけは聞き捨てならねぇ expresses that Battler cannot let that remark pass. You can’t ignore at least that much addresses Rosa’s disregard instead.
sourceReading: He insists Rudolf is his father and Kyrie like an older sister, then says he cannot let that insinuation go unchallenged.

units.text: Dad is Dad, right?!  Of course, I'm not related to Kyrie-san by blood, but she's like a big sister to me!!  You can't ignore at least that much, you bastard!!"
units.note: MG says Battler will not let the comment slide, restoring his own refusal. UP says Don't you dare say otherwise, still turning the line into a command directed at Rosa.
units.japanese: 親父は親父だろうが！！　確かに霧江さんと血縁はねぇが、俺の姉貴も同然のお人だ！！　そこだけは聞き捨てならねぇぞこの野郎ッ！！」

units.text: "Dad is Dad!! Sure I'm not related to Kyrie‐san by blood, but she's like a big sister to me!! Don't you dare say otherwise, you bastard!!"
units.note: MG says Battler will not let the comment slide, restoring his own refusal. UP says Don't you dare say otherwise, still turning the line into a command directed at Rosa.
units.japanese: 「親父は親父だろうが！！　確かに霧江さんと血縁はねぇが、俺の姉貴も同然のお人だ！！　そこだけは聞き捨てならねぇぞこの野郎ッ！！」

description: 施錠できた means could have locked; could have unlocked reverses the required act.
sourceReading: The room was locked, George had its room key, and Rosa alone held master keys: was she not the only one who could have locked it?

units.text: George-aniki was dead, and Natsuhi oba-san's room was locked!  George-aniki was holding the key to that room, right?!  And by now, the only one holding a master key is you, Rosa oba-san, right?!  Weren't you the only one who could have unlocked that room?!?!"
units.note: MG retains could've unlocked, reversing Battler's locking accusation. UP correctly says could have locked.
units.japanese: 譲治の兄貴たちが死んでいた、夏妃伯母さんの部屋には鍵が掛かってた！　部屋の鍵は譲治の兄貴が持っていたんだろ？！　そしてマスターキーを持ってるのは今や楼座叔母さんだけだぜッ？！　あの部屋に施錠できたのはあんただけじゃねぇかよッ？！？！」

units.text: George-aniki and the others were found dead, and Aunt Natsuhi's room was locked! George-aniki had the key to that room, right?! And by now, the only one with a master key is you, Aunt Rosa, right?! Aren't you the only one who could've unlocked that room?!?!"
units.note: MG retains could've unlocked, reversing Battler's locking accusation. UP correctly says could have locked.
units.japanese: 「譲治の兄貴たちが死んでいた、夏妃伯母さんの部屋には鍵が掛かってた！　部屋の鍵は譲治の兄貴が持っていたんだろ？！　そしてマスターキーを持ってるのは今や楼座叔母さんだけだぜッ？！　あの部屋に施錠できたのはあんただけじゃねぇかよッ？！？！」

description: 俺たちの目を盗み means evading our notice; while I wasn’t looking narrows the group to Battler.
sourceReading: He hypothesizes that Rosa secretly lent one master key to the culprit without the group noticing.

units.text: "My reasoning goes like this.  You're in contact with the real culprit, and while I wasn't looking, you lent them one of the five master keys!!"
units.note: Both editions retain while I wasn't looking, narrowing the proposed concealment from the group to Battler alone.
units.japanese: あんたは真犯人と通じ合っていて、俺たちの目を盗み、５つのマスターキーの内の１つをこっそり貸し出したんだ！！」

units.text: "My theory goes like this. You're in contact with the real culprit, and while I wasn't looking, you lent them one of the five master keys!!"
units.note: Both editions retain while I wasn't looking, narrowing the proposed concealment from the group to Battler alone.
units.japanese: 「俺の推理じゃこうだ。あんたは真犯人と通じ合っていて、俺たちの目を盗み、５つのマスターキーの内の１つをこっそり貸し出したんだ！！」

units.text: "My reasoning goes like this. You're in contact with the real culprit, and while I wasn't looking, you lent them one of the five master keys!!"
units.note: Both editions retain while I wasn't looking, narrowing the proposed concealment from the group to Battler alone.
units.japanese: 「俺の推理じゃこうだ。あんたは真犯人と通じ合っていて、俺たちの目を盗み、５つのマスターキーの内の１つをこっそり貸し出したんだ！！」

description: 室内に閉じ込められていた continues the key as subject. English changes the subject to the inside of the room was closed off.
sourceReading: Natsuhi’s own key was in George’s pocket, trapped inside the room.

units.text: There is no fraud or trick, there is no means of secret passage and no hidden place!  Natsuhi's own key was in George's pocket, and the inside of the room was closed off.  Only the five master keys were left, and 'Rosa' was holding all of them!
units.note: Both editions correctly keep Natsuhi's key as the subject locked inside the room.
units.japanese: 夏妃自身の鍵は譲治のポケットに入って、室内に閉じ込められていた。
candidates: Natsuhi's own key was in George's pocket
inside of the room was closed off

description: 黙るのはあなたの方でしょ is you are the one who should shut up, responding to his shouted demand. You’re the one who’s staying silent states his behavior instead.
sourceReading: Rosa retorts that Battler should be the one to stop talking, then demands an explanation.

units.text: "You're the one who's staying silent, how do you say the letter was set here by someone other than yourself?!  As long as you can't prove that, you're a wolf!!"
units.note: Both editions correctly render Rosa's response as You're the one who should shut up or keep silent, rather than saying Battler is staying silent.
units.japanese: 「黙るのはあなたの方でしょッ、あなた以外にどうやってその手紙を置けたというの？！　それが証明できない限りあなたは狼なのよッ！！」
candidates: You're the one who's staying silent

description: もうごめんだ and こんな疑り合いはごめん mean he has had enough and wants no more of this. I’m sorry already and I’m sorry for doubting substitute apologies.
sourceReading: Battler begs Beatrice to confess because he cannot bear any more mutual suspicion.

units.text: "Beatriiiiiiiice, please, show yourself here, and confess to us that you did everything, I'm sorry already, I'm sorry for doubting each other like this!!"
units.note: MG retains I'm sorry already and I'm sorry we've been suspecting. UP correctly says I've had enough of this mutual suspicion.
units.japanese: もうごめんだ、こんな疑り合いはごめんなんだッ！！」

units.text: "Beatriiiiiiiice, please, show yourself here, and confess to us that you did everything, I'm sorry already, I'm sorry we've been suspecting each other like this!!"
units.note: MG retains I'm sorry already and I'm sorry we've been suspecting. UP correctly says I've had enough of this mutual suspicion.
units.japanese: 「ベアトリーチェぇええぇえぇ、頼むからここに現れてくれよ、そして自分が全てやったと俺たちに告白してくれよッッ、もうごめんだ、こんな疑り合いはごめんなんだッ！！」

description: 捧げた is past, referring to having devoted all his remaining life in atonement. I offer makes it a present pledge.
sourceReading: Kinzo says he devoted the whole remainder of his life to atoning for the wrong he had done.

units.text: "In atonement, I offer all that remains of my life...!!  In order to apologize to you, in order to atone for my crimes, .........I offered, ......everything......... ......Please, even if it is as I die... ............At least, ............Let me, apologize, ... ......just once...e......  Beatriiiiiiiiice......  Whaaaa, hic, aaaaaaaah, whaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!"
units.note: Both editions use have offered, restoring the completed devotion of Kinzo's remaining life.
units.japanese: 「その償いに残りの全ての人生を捧げた…！！　お前に詫びるために、私の罪を償うために、

description: 小さな背中に and 舞い降りる place the butterfly onto his back. Behind his small back and fell down omit that contact.
sourceReading: A gold-leaf-like butterfly appears and flutters down onto his small, trembling back.

units.text: ......As Kinzo shook and cried, behind his small back, a butterfly appeared out of nowhere, like flake of gold leaf, and softly fell down...
units.note: Both editions place the butterfly behind Kinzo's back and make it descend or fall, rather than landing on his back.
units.japanese: ……震えながら泣く金蔵の小さな背中に、一枚の金箔のような蝶が、どこからともなく現れ、ひらりと舞い降りる…。

units.text: ...As Kinzo shook and cried, a butterfly appeared out of nowhere behind his small back like a flake of gold leaf...and softly descended...
units.note: Both editions place the butterfly behind Kinzo's back and make it descend or fall, rather than landing on his back.
units.japanese: ……震えながら泣く金蔵の小さな背中に、一枚の金箔のような蝶が、どこからともなく現れ、ひらりと舞い降りる…。

units.text: ......As Kinzo shook and cried, behind his small back, a butterfly appeared out of nowhere, like a flake of gold leaf, and softly fell down...
units.note: Both editions place the butterfly behind Kinzo's back and make it descend or fall, rather than landing on his back.
units.japanese: ……震えながら泣く金蔵の小さな背中に、一枚の金箔のような蝶が、どこからともなく現れ、ひらりと舞い降りる…。

description: チェスの譜面 refers here to the recorded moves or position of an unfinished chess game, not a musical composition.
sourceReading: Beatrice asks whether he remembers their unfinished chess game’s moves or position.

units.text: Kinzo.  Do you remember......? That musical piece of chess you played with me, which was still ongoing......?
units.note: MG calls it an ongoing chess game; UP calls it the board position of their unfinished game. Neither treats 譜面 as music.
units.japanese: 私としていた、まだ途中だったチェスの譜面……。

description: 駒をチェス盤から退ける removes pieces from the board. Removing the chessboard changes the moved object and adds purpose to mow off pieces.
sourceReading: Kinzo sweeps the existing pieces off the board, then sets up the remembered position.

units.text: Kinzo, as though he had suddenly remembered something, approached the chess set. It was as it had been during the game he had played with Nanjo until yesterday. ...After removing the chessboard to mow off all the pieces, he began to line the pieces up one by one. ...It was the setup for an ongoing game.
units.note: Both editions correctly make Kinzo sweep the pieces from the board rather than remove the chessboard itself.
units.japanese: …その駒を、ざぁっとなぎ払うようにチェス盤から退けると、駒を次々と並べ出す。

description: お前は駒を見捨てるか悩み identifies Beatrice as the one deliberating whether to abandon a piece. I worried about whether you would throw away your piece transfers the uncertainty to Kinzo.
sourceReading: He advanced his queen; Beatrice then deliberated at length over whether to sacrifice a piece.

units.text: ".........That's right.  Like this.  ............I advanced my queen.  ...That was a very spectacular move.  That move might have been a little too intense for you.  .........I worried about whether you would throw away your piece or not, ......I kept worrying............"
units.note: Both editions retain Kinzo as the one worrying or deliberating over whether Beatrice will abandon her piece.
units.japanese: 「………そうだ。こうだ。…………私はクイーンを進めた。…とても良い妙手だった。お前には少々きつすぎるかも知れん一手だった。………お前は、駒を見捨てるか、見捨てないかに悩み、
candidates: worried about whether you would throw away your piece

units.text: "......That's right. Like this. ......I advanced my queen. ...That was quite a spectacular move. Perhaps it was a little too intense for you. ......I worried whether you'd abandon your piece or not, ...worried for so long......"
units.note: Both editions retain Kinzo as the one worrying or deliberating over whether Beatrice will abandon her piece.
units.japanese: 「………そうだ。こうだ。…………私はクイーンを進めた。…とても良い妙手だった。お前には少々きつすぎるかも知れん一手だった。………お前は、駒を見捨てるか、見捨てないかに悩み、……ずっと悩み……………」

units.text: ".........That's right. Like this. ............I advanced my queen. ...That was a very spectacular move. It might have been a little too intense for you. .........I deliberated whether you would throw away your piece or not, ......deliberated and deliberated............"
units.note: Both editions retain Kinzo as the one worrying or deliberating over whether Beatrice will abandon her piece.
units.japanese: 「………そうだ。こうだ。…………私はクイーンを進めた。…とても良い妙手だった。お前には少々きつすぎるかも知れん一手だった。………お前は、駒を見捨てるか、見捨てないかに悩み、……ずっと悩み……………」
candidates: whether you would throw away your piece

description: I am well know requires known.
sourceReading: Battler drunkenly boasts of his reputation as a breast connoisseur.

units.text: "Even though I look like this, I am well know as a breast-sommelier, you see?  ... Hic."
units.note: Both editions correctly use well known or well-known.
units.japanese: 「俺ァこう見えても、ちょいと知られたおっぱいソムリエなんだじぇえ？

description: お邪魔なようでしたら失礼いたします means if he is unwelcome he will leave; I apologize if I am disturbing you substitutes an apology. Battler’s following response likewise treats it as saying sorry rather than departing.
sourceReading: Genji offers to withdraw if he is disturbing Battler, who objects to his leaving without saying what he came for.

units.text: ".........Nothing of the sort.  ......I apologize if I am disturbing you."
units.note: MG retains I apologize if I am disturbing you and Battler responds to an apology. UP says I shall excuse myself and Battler responds to Genji leaving without stating his business.
units.japanese: ……お邪魔なようでしたら失礼いたします。」

units.text: "......Nothing of the sort. ...I apologize if I am disturbing you."
units.note: MG retains I apologize if I am disturbing you and Battler responds to an apology. UP says I shall excuse myself and Battler responds to Genji leaving without stating his business.
units.japanese: 「………そのようなことはございません。……お邪魔なようでしたら失礼いたします」

description: 飲まなきゃやってられねぇ is unable to bear or cope with things without drinking. Nobody will invents a reason based on other people not consuming the liquor.
sourceReading: He drinks because he cannot stand the situation otherwise, not because he enjoys alcohol.

units.text: "............................... It's just that, if I don't drink it, nobody will.  ......I don't know the flavor of alcohol at all..."
units.note: MG corrects the original-PC line to I can't cope if I don't drink. UP follows the rewritten PS3-derived exchange about what Battler can do now and his readiness to die; the original-PC line does not occur in that witness.
units.japanese: 飲まなきゃやってられねぇだけさ。

description: 第八の晩までを全て終えました says all stages up to the eighth twilight have ended. Completely finished by the eighth twilight makes the entire ceremony completed.
sourceReading: The ceremony has completed everything through the eighth twilight, so Genji can now disclose matters.

units.text: "............Beatrice's ceremony was completely finished by the eighth twilight.  ...I believe that I can now tell you everything."
units.note: MG says the ceremony was completed when the eighth twilight ended, implying total completion. UP says it has been completed up to the eighth twilight.
units.japanese: 「…………ベアトリーチェさまの儀式も、第八の晩までを全て終えました。
candidates: completely finished by the eighth twilight

units.text: "......Beatrice's ceremony was completed when the eighth twilight ended. ...I believe I can tell you everything now."
units.note: MG says the ceremony was completed when the eighth twilight ended, implying total completion. UP says it has been completed up to the eighth twilight.
units.japanese: 「…………ベアトリーチェさまの儀式も、第八の晩までを全て終えました。…もう、全てをお話ししてもよいかと思います」
candidates: ceremony was completed when the eighth twilight ended

description: 見えるものを見えるがままに begins an instruction completed by accept what is heard as heard. What you see is as it appears instead states a correspondence between appearance and reality.
sourceReading: Genji asks Battler to accept what he sees and hears just as presented.

units.text: ".........What you see is as it appears.  What you hear is as it sounds, so please accept it."
units.note: Both editions make this an instruction to accept what is seen and heard as presented, rather than asserting appearance equals reality.
units.japanese: 「………見えるものを、見えるがままに。

description: 蘇っている in this already-result context states Beatrice is revived; already being revived makes the revival ongoing.
sourceReading: Battler concludes that Beatrice has already revived at the ninth twilight.

units.text: Genji-san checked one last time to see whether I was prepared to know the truth. The eighth twilight had already ended. And at the ninth twilight, the witch would be revived,  ......and nobody would be left alive. It meant that Beatrice was already being revived. ...And probably, none of us would be allowed to live and return.
units.note: Both editions say Beatrice had already been revived, preserving the completed result.
units.japanese: もうベアトリーチェは、蘇っているというわけだ。

description: Going lose omits to.
sourceReading: If he will lose his life anyway, Battler wants the truth before death.

units.text: If I was going lose my life anyway, ......I wanted to know the truth in the end. ...It didn't matter how hard it might be to accept.
units.note: Both editions retain If I was going lose my life, omitting to.
units.japanese: どうせ失う命なら、……その最期に、真実を知りたい。

units.text: If I was going lose my life anyway, ...I wanted to know the truth in the end. ...It didn't matter how hard it might be to accept.
units.note: Both editions retain If I was going lose my life, omitting to.
units.japanese:
どうせ失う命なら、……その最期に、真実を知りたい。
…それが、どんなに受け容れがたいものであってもだ。

units.text:
If I was going lose my life anyway, ......I wanted to know the truth in the end.
...It didn't matter how hard it might be to accept.
units.note: Both editions retain If I was going lose my life, omitting to.
units.japanese:
どうせ失う命なら、……その最期に、真実を知りたい。
…それが、どんなに受け容れがたいものであってもだ。

description: 敵わぬ repeats that Kinzo cannot match or beat his opponent. Unbearable changes the object of his amused admiration into intolerability.
sourceReading: Kinzo laughs with enjoyment and admits that he is outmatched.

units.text: "......Heheheheheheheh.  Indeed, this is a deeply matured move.  ......So fun, so fun..., *cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*, hahahahahahaha...!!  Unbearable, unbearable."
units.note: MG says I see I'm no match for you. UP calls the opponent unbeatable; both restore being outmatched rather than unbearable.
units.japanese: 敵わぬ敵わぬ。」

description: しばらく待て orders Battler to wait a while. I have been waiting for a while reverses the temporal and participant relationship.
sourceReading: Beatrice tells the arriving Battler to wait and remain silent while Kinzo thinks.

units.text: "So you came, Battler.  I've been waiting for a while.  Be silent for Kinzo's sake.  ...Isn't it too early to resign, Kinzo?  I could already counterattack it in several ways.  *cackle*cackle*cackle*...!"
units.note: MG retains I've been waiting for a while. UP correctly gives the instruction Wait just a moment.
units.japanese: しばらく待て。

units.text: "So you came, Battler. I've been waiting for a while. Be silent for Kinzo's sake. ...Isn't it too early to resign, Kinzo? I could've countered that move in several ways already. *cackle*cackle*cackle*...!"
units.note: MG retains I've been waiting for a while. UP correctly gives the instruction Wait just a moment.
units.japanese: 「来たか、戦人。しばらく待て。金蔵のために沈黙を。…まだリザインは早いぞ、金蔵？　妾ならもう数手は切り返せる。くっくっくっくっく…！」

description: もう数手は切り返せる indicates being able to fight back for a few further moves. Already and in several ways substitute a completed readiness and alternative options for that continuation.
sourceReading: Beatrice says it is too early to resign: she could still counter for a few more moves.

units.text: "So you came, Battler.  I've been waiting for a while.  Be silent for Kinzo's sake.  ...Isn't it too early to resign, Kinzo?  I could already counterattack it in several ways.  *cackle*cackle*cackle*...!"
units.note: MG retains could've countered in several ways already. UP says can counterattack for several moves, restoring the continued move count.
units.japanese: 妾ならもう数手は切り返せる。

units.text: "So you came, Battler. I've been waiting for a while. Be silent for Kinzo's sake. ...Isn't it too early to resign, Kinzo? I could've countered that move in several ways already. *cackle*cackle*cackle*...!"
units.note: MG retains could've countered in several ways already. UP says can counterattack for several moves, restoring the continued move count.
units.japanese: 「来たか、戦人。しばらく待て。金蔵のために沈黙を。…まだリザインは早いぞ、金蔵？　妾ならもう数手は切り返せる。くっくっくっくっく…！」

description: Siblings corpses lacks the possessive apostrophe.
sourceReading: The exposed corpses belong to Rosa’s siblings.

units.text: Rosa finally arrived at the chapel. She pointed her gun around her, screaming the witch's name, but there was no way there would be an answer. After grimacing slightly, she noisily approached the table where her siblings corpses were still exposed, and stretched out her arm towards the gold ingot.
units.note: Both editions correctly use siblings' corpses or avoid the possessive construction.
units.japanese: 表情を少しだけ歪めた後、兄弟たちが未だに遺骸を晒すテーブルに踵を鳴らしながら近付き、黄金のインゴットに手を伸ばす。

description: The period before lowercase but creates a malformed sentence boundary.
sourceReading: Her shoulders protest under the load, but Rosa ignores it.

units.text: Without letting go of her gun, Rosa also carried the gold. ...Her shoulders were screaming. but Rosa didn't mind.
units.note: MG retains a period before lowercase but. UP uses a comma and preserves one sentence.
units.japanese: …彼女の肩が悲鳴を上げるが、楼座は構わなかった。

units.text: Without letting go of her gun, Rosa picked up the gold as well. ...Her shoulders were screaming. but Rosa didn't mind.
units.note: MG retains a period before lowercase but. UP uses a comma and preserves one sentence.
units.japanese:
楼座は銃も手放さず、その上でさらに黄金も持つ。
…彼女の肩が悲鳴を上げるが、楼座は構わなかった。

description: 御召替え means changing clothes; silk is neither stated nor implied by that expression. The English substitutes fabric for the dress’s purpose.
sourceReading: Genji presents the dress Beatrice will change into.

units.text: "......Beatrice-sama, your silk dress."
units.note: Both editions retain silk dress for the dress intended for Beatrice's change of clothes.
units.japanese: 「……ベアトリーチェさま、御召替えのドレスでございます。」

units.text: "...Beatrice-sama, your silk dress."
units.note: Both editions retain silk dress for the dress intended for Beatrice's change of clothes.
units.japanese: 「……ベアトリーチェさま、御召替えのドレスでございます」

units.text: "......Beatrice‐sama, your silk dress."
units.note: Both editions retain silk dress for the dress intended for Beatrice's change of clothes.
units.japanese: 「……ベアトリーチェさま、御召替えのドレスでございます」

description: The witch actively removes the jacket only from her shoulders. Her jacket slipped off makes this first action spontaneous. The next sentence also loses the explicit fall behind her.
sourceReading: She stands and releases the jacket at the shoulders, letting it fall behind her.

units.text: When the witch stood up, her jacket slipped off, just from her shoulders. ......After that, the jacket fell to the ground with a thump. When the furniture respectfully approached to pick up those clothes, the witch gave it a small kick and it fell over. ...The furniture was afraid of what misconduct it had shown...
units.note: MG retains the jacket spontaneously slipping off and loses the fall behind her. UP makes Beatrice remove it at the shoulders and describes it slumping down at the back.
units.japanese: 魔女は立ち上がると、上着の肩だけを外す。

units.text: The witch rose and her jacket slipped off, just from her shoulders. ...After that, the jacket fell to the ground with a thump. When the furniture respectfully approached to pick up those clothes, the witch gave it a small kick, and it fell over. ...The furniture was afraid of what misconduct it might have shown...
units.note: MG retains the jacket spontaneously slipping off and loses the fall behind her. UP makes Beatrice remove it at the shoulders and describes it slumping down at the back.
units.japanese:
魔女は立ち上がると、上着の肩だけを外す。
……すると上着はそのまま、すとんと後ろに落ちる。その衣服を拾おうと家具がうやうやしく近付いた時、魔女は小さく蹴って転がした。…家具は自分に何の不調法があったのかと怯えた…。

description: 縫い付ける is sew on; sow denotes planting seed.
sourceReading: Beatrice threatens to sew Battler’s eyeball on in place of a torn button.

units.text: "*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*, kakakaka, hah-hah-hah-hah-hah-hah-ha!!  Undo them politely.  Those buttons are each worth more than one of your eyeballs.  ...If you make a mistake and break them, I'll sow your eyeballs in instead... *cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*!!"
units.note: MG retains sow your eyeballs. UP correctly says sew on an eyeball.
units.japanese: 「くっくくくくくくくくくっかかかかっはっはっはっはっはっはっはッ！！　丁寧に外すのだぞ。そなたの目玉ひとつよりも高価なボタンであるぞ。…間違って千切るようなことがあったなら、代わりにそなたの目玉を縫い付けてやる…。

units.text: "*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*, kakakaka, hahahahahahaha!! Undo them with care. Those buttons are each worth more than one of your eyeballs. ...If you make a mistake and break them, I'll sow your eyeballs in instead... *cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*!!"
units.note: MG retains sow your eyeballs. UP correctly says sew on an eyeball.
units.japanese: 「くっくくくくくくくくくっかかかかっはっはっはっはっはっはっはッ！！　丁寧に外すのだぞ。そなたの目玉ひとつよりも高価なボタンであるぞ。…間違って千切るようなことがあったなら、代わりにそなたの目玉を縫い付けてやる…。くっくくくくくくくくくくくくくくくくくく！！」

description: 人影 here denotes the figures of people bustling in the hall, not shadows belonging to people.
sourceReading: The hall is crowded with human figures, subsequently revealed to have goat heads.

units.text: The entrance hall was bustling with a large number of people's shadows. And it was sparkling gold with the gold butterflies flying around. The gentlemen in suits and tuxedos and the ladies in dresses looked like they were having a great number of friendly chats.  At a glance, it might have looked like a fabulous medieval ball.
units.note: MG changes people's shadows to shadowy people, restoring human figures while adding indistinctness. UP directly says figures.
units.japanese: 玄関ホールは、大勢の人影で賑わっていた。

units.text: The entrance hall was bustling with a large number of people's shadows. And it was sparkling gold with the gold butterflies flying around. The gentlemen in suits and tuxedos and the ladies in dresses looked like they were having a great number of friendly chats.  At a glance, it might have looked like a fabulous medieval ball.
units.note: MG again calls 人影 shadows. UP says shadowy figures, retaining atmosphere while restoring figures as the head noun.
units.japanese: 玄関ホールは、大勢の人影で賑わっていた。

units.text: So she saw it every time. ...She saw the golden pursuers chasing them from the mansion! The mass of gold butterflies was chasing after them like a massive crawling hand!! And strange-looking shadows with goat heads were chasing after them...!!
units.note: MG again calls 人影 shadows. UP says shadowy figures, retaining atmosphere while restoring figures as the head noun.
units.japanese:
だからその度に見てしまう。
…屋敷より追い来る黄金の追っ手を、見てしまうッ！黄金の蝶たちの群がまるで這い寄る巨大な手のように追ってくる！！　そして、山羊の頭を持つ恐ろしき異形の人影が追ってくる…！！

description: One of the young woman goats requires women in this noun phrase.
sourceReading: One young female guest removes her mask.

units.text: One of the young woman goats mixed in with the goat nobles, softly removed her goat mask as the furniture passed in front of her, and spoke with eyes that had no light in them. That face, ...looked like it belonged to a long-haired, young girl...
units.note: MG corrects the noun phrase to young women goats. UP retains young woman goats.
units.japanese: 山羊の貴族の中に混じった、山羊の令嬢のひとりが、家具が自分の前を通り過ぎる時にそっと山羊の仮面を外し、光を宿さぬ瞳で言った。

units.text: One of the young woman goats, mixed in with the goat nobles, softly removed her goat mask as the furniture passed in front of her, and spoke with eyes that had no light in them. That face...looked like it belonged to a long‐haired young girl...
units.note: MG corrects the noun phrase to young women goats. UP retains young woman goats.
units.japanese: 山羊の貴族の中に混じった、山羊の令嬢のひとりが、家具が自分の前を通り過ぎる時にそっと山羊の仮面を外し、光を宿さぬ瞳で言った。そこにある顔は、髪の長き幼い少女に見えた…。

description: いい趣味ね comments ironically on Beatrice’s taste in treating her furniture, rather than identifying a hobby.
sourceReading: Bernkastel dryly says Beatrice has nice taste after calling the furniture pitiful.

units.text: ".........That's a nice hobby."
units.note: MG retains hobby. UP correctly renders the sarcastic comment as Good taste.
units.japanese: 「………いい趣味ね。」

units.text: "......That's a nice hobby."
units.note: MG retains hobby. UP correctly renders the sarcastic comment as Good taste.
units.japanese: 「………いい趣味ね」

description: The period after present separates the parallel geographical phrase and leaves lowercase east starting a fragment.
sourceReading: Old friends from all times and places gather for the banquet.

units.text: "Thank you for gathering here for my sake!!  Why don't we enjoy to the fullest this 'banquet of the witch', where old friends have gathered from past and present. east and west...!"
units.note: Both editions repair the sentence boundary and preserve the parallel time-and-place phrase.
units.japanese: 「今宵は妾のためによく集まってくれたッ！！　久々に古今東西の旧友たちが集う“魔女の宴”を存分に楽しもうではないか…！」

description: 室内を金箔に染めていた describes the butterflies making the room appear coated in gold leaf. Butterflies leafed in gold assigns that coating to the insects and drops their effect on the interior.
sourceReading: The golden butterflies that had gilded the room all fly about at once.

units.text: All at once, the butterflies leafed in gold flew all around the inside of the room. Amidst the golden storm and the brilliant gold-colored light, the cross-section of this world and a different world, ......was cut open......
units.note: Both editions retain butterflies leafed in gold and lose the butterflies’ effect on the room.
units.japanese: 室内を金箔に染めていた黄金の蝶たちが一斉に飛び交う。

units.text: All at once, the butterflies leafed in gold flew all around the inside of the room. Amidst the golden storm and the brilliant gold-colored light, the barrier between this world and another...was cut open...
units.note: Both editions retain butterflies leafed in gold and lose the butterflies’ effect on the room.
units.japanese: 室内を金箔に染めていた黄金の蝶たちが一斉に飛び交う。黄金の嵐と金色の眩い光の中、この世とこの世ならざる世界の断面が、……斬って開かれる……。

units.text: All at once, the butterflies leafed in gold flew all around the inside of the room. Amidst the golden storm and the brilliant gold‐colored light, the cross‐section joining this world and a different world......was cut open......
units.note: Both editions retain butterflies leafed in gold and lose the butterflies’ effect on the room.
units.japanese: 室内を金箔に染めていた黄金の蝶たちが一斉に飛び交う。黄金の嵐と金色の眩い光の中、この世とこの世ならざる世界の断面が、……斬って開かれる……。

description: 頭を落として means cut off the head before throwing it in the liquor pot. Drop the snake’s head retains only putting the head in the pot.
sourceReading: Behead the snake and throw the head into the liquor jar.

units.text: Come, tonight we will put aside rank. Throw open the wine cellar, drop the snake's head into the liquor pot, throw cows and chickens into the furnace alive, drink and eat and sing and dance, sneer and kill and desecrate and degrade!!
units.note: Both editions retain drop the snake’s head and omit the instruction to cut it off first.
units.japanese: 蛇の頭を落として酒壷に放り込め、

units.text: Come, tonight we will put aside rank. Throw open the wine cellar, drop the snake's head into the liquor pot, throw cows and chickens into the furnace alive, drink and eat and sing and dance, sneer and kill and desecrate and degrade!!
units.note: Both editions retain drop the snake’s head and omit the instruction to cut it off first.
units.japanese: さぁさ今宵は無礼講。酒蔵を開け放て、蛇の頭を落として酒壷に放り込め、牛も鶏も生きたまま炉に放り込め、飲めや食えや歌えや踊れや、嗤えや殺せや冒せや堕とせや！！

description: 銀のアラザン specifies silver confectionery dragees. A golden argent both changes the explicit color and fails to identify the edible decoration.
sourceReading: Decorate melted chocolate with silver dragees for a splendid dessert.

units.text: An aroma if slurped, a rich taste if gnawed, and pleasant to tear to bits! The voice of his death throes lingered on sweetly, if you adorn melted chocolate with a golden argent, it would be a wonderful dessert!
units.note: MG retains golden argent. UP correctly identifies silver dragées.
units.japanese: 断末魔の声は甘く糸を引き、溶かしたチョコレートに銀のアラザンで飾り立てれば素敵なデザート！

units.text: An aroma if slurped, a rich taste if gnawed, and pleasant to tear to bits! The sound of his death throes lingered on sweetly, and if adorned with melted chocolate and golden argent, it would make a wonderful dessert!
units.note: MG retains golden argent. UP correctly identifies silver dragées.
units.japanese: 啜れば芳香、齧れば芳醇、千切りては愉快！断末魔の声は甘く糸を引き、溶かしたチョコレートに銀のアラザンで飾り立てれば素敵なデザート！

description: 両手を後ろで組み instructs clasping both hands behind the back; put your hands behind your back omits joining them.
sourceReading: Kneel, press the forehead to the carpet and clasp both hands behind the back while pledging flesh and blood.

units.text: "Kneel and show your respect.  Rub your forehead against the carpet and show how vulgar you are.  Put your hands behind your back and swear that you will offer all your flesh and blood to me."
units.note: MG retains merely putting the hands behind the back. UP restores joining them.
units.japanese: 「跪き敬意を示せ。額を絨毯に擦り付けて己が身の卑しさを示せ。両手を後ろで組み、血肉の全てを妾に捧げることを誓え。」
candidates: Put your hands behind your back

units.text: "Kneel and show your respect. Rub your forehead against the carpet and show how vulgar you are. Put your hands behind your back and swear that you will offer all your flesh and blood to me."
units.note: MG retains merely putting the hands behind the back. UP restores joining them.
units.japanese: 「跪き敬意を示せ。額を絨毯に擦り付けて己が身の卑しさを示せ。両手を後ろで組み、血肉の全てを妾に捧げることを誓え」
candidates: Put your hands behind your back

description: ある、たったひとつのソレ is a particular single thing whose identity is withheld until the scream. Just one of those introduces an unexplained plural set; the next English line repeats those where Japanese has singular ソレ.
sourceReading: The guests wait for one thing before eating: his involuntary scream, revealed as the signal.

units.text: The goat nobles looked down upon the furniture. They had truly been waiting. Just like how one must remove the cork in order to drink champagne, before bringing the offering served at the banquet to their mouths, they were waiting for just one of those. Of course, the furniture didn't know about those. ...But it came out of his mouth all by itself. Just like there is certainly a pop when the cork comes out, it certainly came out of his mouth.
units.note: MG restores a singular one thing. UP retains an unexplained plural set in just one of those, although its next line changes the repeated those to what that was.
units.japanese: シャンパンを飲むためにはまずコルクを抜かなければならないように、宴に供された贄を口にする前に、ある、たったひとつのソレを待っていた。

units.text: The goat nobles looked down upon the furniture. They were, in fact, waiting. Just like how one must remove the cork in order to drink champagne, before bringing the offering served at the banquet to their mouths, they were waiting for just one of those. Of course, the furniture didn't know what that was. ...But it would come out of his mouth all by itself. In the same way there is always a pop when the cork is removed, it too would certainly leave his mouth.
units.note: MG restores a singular one thing. UP retains an unexplained plural set in just one of those, although its next line changes the repeated those to what that was.
units.japanese: 家具を、山羊の貴族たちが見下ろしている。彼らは実は待っていた。シャンパンを飲むためにはまずコルクを抜かなければならないように、宴に供された贄を口にする前に、ある、たったひとつのソレを待っていた。もちろんソレを家具は知らない。…でも、勝手に口にするのだ。コルクを抜けば必ず、ポンと音がするように、彼も必ず口にするのだ。

description: 一瞬だけ qualifies Rosa’s thought of abandoning her daughter. For just an instant, Rosa was ashamed instead limits her shame. 大地を蹴り戻して also describes pushing off to reverse direction, not waiting until her feet touch the ground.
sourceReading: Ashamed that she had even briefly considered abandoning Maria, Rosa pushes off and immediately runs back.
