units.note: Both restore the snack-and-sweetness wordplay linking Beatrice to Virgilia’s tea snack.
units.japanese: 「……うー。戦人もお師匠様もロノウェまでも妾を茶菓扱いだ。…妾は決して甘くはないというのにィ。」

description: WH replaces 方針 with objective after Virgilia distinguishes recognition from surrender.
sourceReading: Beatrice understands she must change her policy/approach, though she still does not understand the fable’s point.

units.text: "...I'd understand even without you telling me.  ......I don't have a clue what you mean by the North Wind and the Sun, but anyway, I understand that I will have to change my objective.  ......I'll introduce a clever scheme that will surprise even you, Teacher...!"
units.note: Both restore Beatrice saying she must change her course or direction rather than her objective.
units.japanese: 「…言われずともわかっておる。……北風と太陽の話は、何が言いたいのかさっぱりだが、とにかく、方針を変えねばならぬことはわかった。……お師匠様もあっと驚くような奇策を披露して見せるぞ…！」

description: WH reverses the emphasis of Beatrice’s complaint about Virgilia wishing her well.
sourceReading: You mean as an afterthought to wishing Battler well, do you not?

units.text: "And Battler too, right?  Hmm..."
units.note: Both retain Beatrice framing Virgilia’s good wishes as secondary to Battler rather than emphasizing that Battler is merely the occasion for wishing Beatrice well.
units.japanese: 「戦人のついでに、であろう？　ふん…。」

units.text: "After Battler, you mean? Hmm..."
units.note: Both retain Beatrice framing Virgilia’s good wishes as secondary to Battler rather than emphasizing that Battler is merely the occasion for wishing Beatrice well.
units.japanese: 「戦人のついでに、であろう？　ふん…」

units.text: "After Battler, right? Hmph..."
units.note: Both retain Beatrice framing Virgilia’s good wishes as secondary to Battler rather than emphasizing that Battler is merely the occasion for wishing Beatrice well.
units.japanese: 「戦人のついでに、であろう？　ふん…」

description: WH changes the negative assessment of inflexible thought into an apparently positive description of sound ideas.
sourceReading: We are awkwardly too clever, so our thinking is rigid.

units.text: "......You really don't know?  Think deeply.  .........We're pretty smart, so our ideas are solid.
units.note: MG retains the positive “our ideas are solid”; UP restores that their intelligence makes their thinking inflexible.
units.japanese: 「……本当にわからないの？　よく考えて。………私たちは下手に頭がいいから発想が硬いのよ。

units.text: "...You really don't know? Think deeply. ......We're pretty smart, so our ideas are solid."
units.note: MG retains the positive “our ideas are solid”; UP restores that their intelligence makes their thinking inflexible.
units.japanese: 「……本当にわからないの？　よく考えて。………私たちは下手に頭がいいから発想が硬いのよ」

description: WH renders 硬い本 as thick books, replacing serious scholarly reading with physical thickness.
sourceReading: The archive holds piles of serious books displaced from Father’s study.

units.text: Come, Eva.  Let's go to the archive and make sure no one notices.  ......There, we should find a mountain of thick books that didn't fit in Father's study.  ...I'm sure that we'll find a book that answers our question.  .........Quickly.  This is our first and last chance in our life to have our dreams made true."
units.note: MG retains “thick books”; UP changes this to “stiff books” but still treats 硬い physically rather than as serious scholarly reading.
units.japanese: さぁ、絵羽。誰にも気付かれないように、書庫へ。……あそこには、お父様の書斎から溢れ出した硬い本が山積みよ。…きっと、私たちの疑問に答えてくれる本が見付かるわ。………急いで。これが生涯で最初で最後の、私たちの夢の叶うチャンス。」

units.text: "Come on, Eva. Let's go to the library, making sure no one sees us. ...There, we should find a mountain of thick books that didn't fit in Father's study. ...I'm sure we'll find a book that answers our question. ......Quickly. This is the first and last chance we'll ever get to make our dreams come true."
units.note: MG retains “thick books”; UP changes this to “stiff books” but still treats 硬い physically rather than as serious scholarly reading.
units.japanese: 「さぁ、絵羽。誰にも気付かれないように、書庫へ。……あそこには、お父様の書斎から溢れ出した硬い本が山積みよ。…きっと、私たちの疑問に答えてくれる本が見付かるわ。………急いで。これが生涯で最初で最後の、私たちの夢の叶うチャンス」

units.text: "Come, Eva. Let's go to the archive and make sure no one notices. ......There, we should find a mountain of thick books that didn't fit in Father's study. ...I'm sure that we'll find a book that answers our question. .........Quickly. This is our first and last chance in our life to have our dreams made true."
units.note: MG retains “thick books”; UP changes this to “stiff books” but still treats 硬い physically rather than as serious scholarly reading.
units.japanese: 「さぁ、絵羽。誰にも気付かれないように、書庫へ。……あそこには、お父様の書斎から溢れ出した硬い本が山積みよ。…きっと、私たちの疑問に答えてくれる本が見付かるわ。………急いで。これが生涯で最初で最後の、私たちの夢の叶うチャンス」

description: Hideyoshi warns that pushing herself will harm Eva’s health again; WH asks whether her body is troubling her again.
sourceReading: You should rest rather than push yourself; it will affect your health again, you know.

units.text: "You should take it easy and rest.  ...Is your body troubling you again?"
units.note: MG retains a generic warning that Eva will feel worse; UP restores Hideyoshi’s warning that overexertion will damage her health again.
units.japanese: 「無理をせんと休んだ方がええで。…また体に障るで？」

units.text: "You should take it easy and rest. ...You're just gonna make yourself feel worse, you know?"
units.note: MG retains a generic warning that Eva will feel worse; UP restores Hideyoshi’s warning that overexertion will damage her health again.
units.japanese: 「無理をせんと休んだ方がええで。…また体に障るで？」

description: WH makes the unspecified thing the offerer rather than the thing to be offered.
sourceReading: That is surely what is to be offered as sacrifice.

units.text: ......The only keyhole to stick that key in, is that place. That, is definitely what offers the sacrifices. Now, do you understand............?
units.note: MG restores that the still-unspoken object is what must be offered as the sacrifices; UP retains it as the thing that performs the offering.
units.japanese: 生贄に捧げるのは、きっと、あれ。

units.text: ......The only keyhole to stick that key in...is that place. That...is definitely what offers the sacrifices. You get it now...right...............?
units.note: MG restores that the still-unspoken object is what must be offered as the sacrifices; UP retains it as the thing that performs the offering.
units.japanese: ……その鍵を挿す鍵穴は、あそこしかない。生贄に捧げるのは、きっと、あれ。もう、わかるよね……………？

description: WH weakens Eva’s nearly undoubtable dating inference to easy suspicion.
sourceReading: It may be beyond doubt that this was built when the mansion was built on the island.

units.text: As I readied my gun, and carefully stared forwards, ......I went down the stairs...... The walls, the stairs, the lights, ...all of them were very old-fashioned. ...It's easy to suspect that this had been made at the same time that the mansion had been constructed on this island.
units.note: MG retains easy suspicion; UP restores Eva’s near-certainty that the old underground works date to the mansion’s construction.
units.japanese: …この島に屋敷が建てられた当時に作られたものなのは、疑いようもないかもしれない。

units.text: As I readied my gun and carefully stared forwards, ...I descended the stairs... The walls, the stairs, the lights...all of them were very old-fashioned. ...It was easy to suspect that this had been built back when the mansion had been constructed on this island.
units.note: MG retains easy suspicion; UP restores Eva’s near-certainty that the old underground works date to the mansion’s construction.
units.japanese:
銃を構え、慎重に先をうかがいながら、……私は階段を下りていく……。壁や階段、灯りは皆、かなり古臭い。
…この島に屋敷が建てられた当時に作られたものなのは、疑いようもないかもしれない。

description: WH changes her first impression of reaching a room connected to the mansion into a room related to one of its rooms.
sourceReading: Her first impression is that she might have emerged into some room in the mansion.

units.text: My first impression when I saw the room, ......was that it might be related to one of the rooms in the mansion. That's right, it had exactly the same atmosphere about it as the sealed VIP room on the second floor.
units.note: Both restore Eva’s first impression that the chamber might connect to a mansion room, though UP adds a separate defective spoken conjecture above.
units.japanese: その部屋を見た第一印象は、……屋敷のどれかの部屋に繋がっていたのではないかというものだった。

description: WH locates the discovery in the center where the source places it farther inside, at the back.
sourceReading: And in the rear of the room she finds it.

units.text: Even though I was completely shocked by this room, I carefully, ...no, timidly searched the interior with my gun raised. And, ......in the center of the room, I found it.
units.note: MG restores the gold being farther inside at the back of the room; UP retains “in the center.”
units.japanese: そして、……部屋の奥に、それを見つける。

units.text: Although I was dumbfounded by this room, I cautiously, ...no, timidly kept my gun raised, and searched the interior. And......in the center of the room, I found it.
units.note: MG restores the gold being farther inside at the back of the room; UP retains “in the center.”
units.japanese: 私はそんな部屋に度肝を抜かれながらも、慎重に、…いや、臆病に銃を構えながら室内を探るのだった。そして、……部屋の奥に、それを見つける。

description: WH removes multiplication of two sides and height, replacing it with going randomly between parts and judging height.
sourceReading: Even roughly multiplying the number along one side by the other and then the height suggests hundreds.

units.text: Just how many ingots were piled up here? By just going from one part to another randomly and judging by the height, there was surely more than several hundred. My mind is already blank, so I can't do a good calculation. ......Even a moderate guess would put it above several billion yen.
units.note: MG still replaces multiplying two sides and height with a quick count here and there; UP restores the dimensional estimate.
units.japanese: でたらめに辺と辺を掛けて、それに高さを掛けただけでも、きっと数百を超えるだろう。

units.text: Just how many ingots were piled up there? By doing a quick count here and there and judging by the height, there had to be a few hundred at least. My mind's already gone blank, so I can't do the math well. ...Even a moderate guess would put it above several billion yen.
units.note: MG still replaces multiplying two sides and height with a quick count here and there; UP restores the dimensional estimate.
units.japanese:
そのインゴットが一体、ここに何本積み上げられているというのか？でたらめに辺と辺を掛けて、それに高さを掛けただけでも、きっと数百を超えるだろう。もう頭が真っ白でまともな計算も出来ない。
……控えめに数えても、十億円を余裕で上回るだろう。

description: WH changes comfortably above one billion yen into above several billion yen.
sourceReading: Even conservatively counted, it should comfortably exceed one billion yen.

units.text: Just how many ingots were piled up here? By just going from one part to another randomly and judging by the height, there was surely more than several hundred. My mind is already blank, so I can't do a good calculation. ......Even a moderate guess would put it above several billion yen.
units.note: MG retains a conservative estimate above several billion yen; UP restores comfortably above one billion yen.
units.japanese: ……控えめに数えても、十億円を余裕で上回るだろう。

units.text: Just how many ingots were piled up there? By doing a quick count here and there and judging by the height, there had to be a few hundred at least. My mind's already gone blank, so I can't do the math well. ...Even a moderate guess would put it above several billion yen.
units.note: MG retains a conservative estimate above several billion yen; UP restores comfortably above one billion yen.
units.japanese:
そのインゴットが一体、ここに何本積み上げられているというのか？でたらめに辺と辺を掛けて、それに高さを掛けただけでも、きっと数百を超えるだろう。もう頭が真っ白でまともな計算も出来ない。
……控えめに数えても、十億円を余裕で上回るだろう。

description: WH states only that Eva found the gold, omitting being the first finder from her argument against Krauss.
sourceReading: The fact that she was the very first to find it can no longer be changed.

units.text: ......My older brother probably wouldn't accept his loss just because I had found this gold. ...But from now on, there would be no changing the fact that I had been the one to find the gold...!
units.note: Both now preserve Eva’s claim that she was the first to find the gold.
units.japanese: …しかし、私が一番最初に見つけたという事実は、今や動かしようがない…！

description: WH replaces bracketing the headship question with a hypothetical loss of inheritance.
sourceReading: Even leaving aside all talk of Ushiromiya headship, the gold is hers alone.

units.text: Even if I lost out on the inheritance of the Ushiromiya family and everything... ...I already have 20 billion yen worth of gold!!
units.note: Both retain a hypothetical loss of headship or inheritance rather than bracketing that question entirely.
units.japanese: 仮に右代宮家の家督云々の話を抜きにしたって。

units.text: Even if I lose out on the Ushiromiya Family Headship, ...I already have 20 billion yen worth of gold!!
units.note: Both retain a hypothetical loss of headship or inheritance rather than bracketing that question entirely.
units.japanese:
仮に右代宮家の家督云々の話を抜きにしたって。
…今や、２００億円の黄金は私ひとりのものなのだからッ！！

units.text:
Even if I lose out on the inheritance of the Ushiromiya family and everything...
...this 20 billion yen's worth of gold is now mine and mine alone!!
units.note: Both retain a hypothetical loss of headship or inheritance rather than bracketing that question entirely.
units.japanese:
仮に右代宮家の家督云々の話を抜きにしたって。
…今や、２００億円の黄金は私ひとりのものなのだからッ！！

description: WH substitutes I for 私たち in the succession claim following Eva and George restoring the family.
sourceReading: That is what it means for us truly to inherit the Ushiromiya headship.

units.text: There's no way I'll waste it on foolish pleasures!! My older brother has chewed up the Ushiromiya family, but George and I will revive it! And that means that I truly have succeeded the headship of the Ushiromiya family!!
units.note: MG retains singular “I” succeeding to the headship; UP restores Eva and George as “we.”
units.japanese: それこそが、右代宮家の当主を、本当の意味で私たちが継承したという意味なのよッ！！

units.text: There's no way I'll waste it on foolish pleasures!! My older brother has chewed the Ushiromiya family to bits, but George and I will revive it! And that means I truly have succeeded the Ushiromiya Family Headship!!
units.note: MG retains singular “I” succeeding to the headship; UP restores Eva and George as “we.”
units.japanese:
下らない快楽になんか浪費するものか！！
兄が食い潰し傾かせた右代宮家は、私と譲治が復興させるのよ！それこそが、右代宮家の当主を、本当の意味で私たちが継承したという意味なのよッ！！

description: WH makes 半生 the sad half of our life, makes fulfilment future, and drops the completed sublimation/redemption of the sad life lived so far.
sourceReading: Here and now all their cherished wishes are fulfilled and their sorrowful life so far is redeemed.

units.text: Congratulations, me. Congratulations, Ushiromiya Eva. ......Right here, right now, the sad half of our life will have its heart's desire granted.
units.note: UP restores completed fulfillment but retains “the sad half of our life” for the sad life lived so far; MG retains both the half-life wording and future fulfillment.
units.japanese: …私たちの悲しい半生は、今ここに全ての念願が叶って昇華されたわ。

units.text: Congratulations, me. Congratulations, Ushiromiya Eva. ...Right here, right now, the sad half of our life will have its heart's desire granted.
units.note: UP restores completed fulfillment but retains “the sad half of our life” for the sad life lived so far; MG retains both the half-life wording and future fulfillment.
units.japanese: おめでとう、私。おめでとう、右代宮絵羽。…私たちの悲しい半生は、今ここに全ての念願が叶って昇華されたわ。

units.text: Congratulations, me. Congratulations, Ushiromiya Eva. ......Right here, right now, the sad half of our life has had its heart's desires granted.
units.note: UP restores completed fulfillment but retains “the sad half of our life” for the sad life lived so far; MG retains both the half-life wording and future fulfillment.
units.japanese: おめでとう、私。おめでとう、右代宮絵羽。…私たちの悲しい半生は、今ここに全ての念願が叶って昇華されたわ。

description: WH turns 兄さんたち into singular Nii-san in Rosa’s prediction of resistance to her succeeding.
sourceReading: Even if Father designated Rosa, her older brothers would not accept it.

units.text: "Of course.  I am the outsider of the Ushiromiya siblings.  ......Even if Father had named me as the next head, there's no way Nii-san would accept that.  I try not to have such naive dreams." "........................"
units.note: MG retains singular Nii-san; UP restores Rosa’s brothers collectively refusing to accept her.
units.japanese: 「もちろんよ。私は右代宮兄弟のはぐれ者。……仮に私が当主跡継ぎだとお父様に指名されたとしても、それを兄さんたちが認めてくれるわけもない。そこまで甘い夢は見てないつもりよ。」

units.text: "Of course. I'm the outsider of the Ushiromiya siblings. ...Even if Father had named me as the next Head, there's no way Nii-san would accept it. I try not to have such naive dreams."
units.note: MG retains singular Nii-san; UP restores Rosa’s brothers collectively refusing to accept her.
units.japanese: 「もちろんよ。私は右代宮兄弟のはぐれ者。……仮に私が当主跡継ぎだとお父様に指名されたとしても、それを兄さんたちが認めてくれるわけもない。そこまで甘い夢は見てないつもりよ」

description: WH interprets 言ったつもり as trying to say something as though obvious, instead of Eva thinking she has stated something entirely natural.
sourceReading: Eva thought she had said something perfectly obvious.

units.text: Eva had tried to say it as though it was completely obvious. ...So when she saw Rosa's expression suddenly cloud over, she was a little surprised.
units.note: Both restore Eva believing she stated an obvious point, rather than trying to say it as though obvious.
units.japanese: 絵羽は、至極当然のことを言ったつもりだった。

description: WH drops たち and narrows Eva’s reference to character dispositions to Krauss alone.
sourceReading: Rosa knows perfectly well what Krauss and the others are like.

units.text: "......What are you unsatisfied about?  You should also know what kind of a person Krauss nii-san is."
units.note: MG retains singular Krauss; UP restores Krauss and Rudolf as the two dispositions Rosa knows.
units.japanese: 「……何か不満なの？　蔵臼兄さんたちの性分は、あんただってよく知っているでしょうが。」

units.text: "...What are you unsatisfied about? You know what kind of a person Krauss nii-san is."
units.note: MG retains singular Krauss; UP restores Krauss and Rudolf as the two dispositions Rosa knows.
units.japanese: 「……何か不満なの？　蔵臼兄さんたちの性分は、あんただってよく知っているでしょうが」

description: WH recasts 腹の探りあい as hunting one another’s weaknesses rather than probing concealed intentions.
sourceReading: Rosa dislikes this mutual guessing/probing of what each person really intends.

units.text: "..................I don't like it when you search each other for weaknesses like that.  I just want to clearly specify my 2.5 billion portion.
units.note: Both retain searching one another for weaknesses instead of probing concealed intentions.
units.japanese: 「…………………そういう腹の探りあい、私は好きじゃないの。私は自分の取り分の２５億をはっきり確定させたいだけ。

units.text: ".........I don't like it when you search out each other's weaknesses like that. All I want is to reach a clear decision regarding my 2.5 billion portion."
units.note: Both retain searching one another for weaknesses instead of probing concealed intentions.
units.japanese: 「…………………そういう腹の探りあい、私は好きじゃないの。私は自分の取り分の２５億をはっきり確定させたいだけ」

units.text: ".....................I don't like searching each other for weaknesses like that. I just want to clearly lock in my 2.5 billion portion."
units.note: Both retain searching one another for weaknesses instead of probing concealed intentions.
units.japanese: 「…………………そういう腹の探りあい、私は好きじゃないの。私は自分の取り分の２５億をはっきり確定させたいだけ」

description: WH speaks of the closed room with those six people, replacing the closed rooms belonging to those six victims.
sourceReading: The closed rooms of those six cannot be created by an outside perpetrator, Rosa claims.

units.text: "It can be clearly explained by the manner of the six deaths.  The closed room with those six people definitely couldn't be created by a crime from the outside.
units.note: MG restores six separate closed rooms; UP retains a singular locked room involving the six.
units.japanese: 「６人の死亡状況ではっきり説明がつくわ。あの６人の密室は、外部犯行では絶対に作れない。
candidates: closed room with those six people

units.text: "It can be clearly explained by the manner of the six deaths. The locked room involving those six definitely couldn't be created by a crime from the outside."
units.note: MG restores six separate closed rooms; UP retains a singular locked room involving the six.
units.japanese: 「６人の死亡状況ではっきり説明がつくわ。あの６人の密室は、外部犯行では絶対に作れない」

description: WH places Thanks to that after the skill claim, making that skill the cause of being trained rather than past training explaining the skill.
sourceReading: Rosa tends to read the atmosphere in such situations because she has been trained, thanks to you/your kindness.

units.text: "......I'm a person who can read between the lines in that kind of situation.  Thanks to that, I've been well trained."
units.note: Both restore Rosa saying past experience trained her to read the situation.
units.japanese: 「……私、そういう場の空気は読む方なの。お陰様で鍛えられたから。」

description: WH reduces 出し抜かれず to without Krauss getting in the way.
sourceReading: Eva wants assurance she can transport, liquidate and fairly divide the gold without Krauss outmaneuvering her.

units.text: ......Until I have proof that I can carry that out without Nii-san getting in the way, I want some time to think.  I only want to hold off my announcement until then.  .........I'm definitely not keeping it secret because I want it all for myself."
units.note: Both retain “without Nii-san getting in the way,” narrowing Eva’s need to avoid being outmaneuvered by him.
units.japanese: ……それを兄さんに出し抜かれずに行なえる裏付けが取れるまで、しばらく考える時間が欲しい。それまで発表を待ちたいというだけの話よ。………決して、独り占めしたくて内緒にするわけじゃないわ。」
candidates: without Nii-san getting in the way

units.text: "...Until I have proof that I can do all that without Nii-san getting in the way, I want some time to think. I only want to postpone my announcement until then. ......I'm certainly not keeping it secret because I want it all for myself."
units.note: Both retain “without Nii-san getting in the way,” narrowing Eva’s need to avoid being outmaneuvered by him.
units.japanese: 「……それを兄さんに出し抜かれずに行なえる裏付けが取れるまで、しばらく考える時間が欲しい。それまで発表を待ちたいというだけの話よ。………決して、独り占めしたくて内緒にするわけじゃないわ」
candidates: without Nii-san getting in the way

units.text: "......Until I can affirm my ability to carry those out without Nii‐san getting in the way, I want some time to think. I only want to hold off my announcement until then. .........I'm definitely not keeping it secret because I want it all for myself."
units.note: Both retain “without Nii-san getting in the way,” narrowing Eva’s need to avoid being outmaneuvered by him.
units.japanese: 「……それを兄さんに出し抜かれずに行なえる裏付けが取れるまで、しばらく考える時間が欲しい。それまで発表を待ちたいというだけの話よ。………決して、独り占めしたくて内緒にするわけじゃないわ」
candidates: without Nii‐san getting in the way

description: WH adds evenly to Eva’s promise to divide the gold among the siblings.
sourceReading: She will properly share/divide the gold among the siblings.

units.text: "...Isn't that obvious!  ......I will split the gold evenly among the siblings."
units.note: MG adds an even division; UP restores division according to the siblings’ agreement.
units.japanese: 「…もちろんでしょ！……ちゃんと黄金は兄弟で山分けするわよ。」

units.text: "...Isn't that obvious?! ...I will split the gold evenly among the siblings."
units.note: MG adds an even division; UP restores division according to the siblings’ agreement.
units.japanese: 「…もちろんでしょ！　……ちゃんと黄金は兄弟で山分けするわよ」

description: WH replaces repeatedly staring at the ring with focusing on this day, losing the grounds for identifying the ring as genuine.
sourceReading: Because she has repeatedly scrutinized the ring while dreaming of inheriting it, she can identify it without doubt.

units.text: Eva stared closely at the ring. ...It certainly wasn't a fake. ...Without a doubt, it was the real thing. She had dreamed of receiving this ring someday, focused on this day over and over again, and it was now finally a certainty.
units.note: MG retains Eva focusing repeatedly on this day; UP restores her repeated scrutiny of the physical ring as the basis for authenticating it.
units.japanese: 何度も何度も凝視してきた自分だからこそ、間違いなく断定できた。

units.text: Eva stared closely at the ring. ...It certainly wasn't a fake. ...Without a doubt, it was the real thing. She'd dreamed of receiving this ring someday, focused on this day over and over again, and it was now finally a certainty.
units.note: MG retains Eva focusing repeatedly on this day; UP restores her repeated scrutiny of the physical ring as the basis for authenticating it.
units.japanese: 絵羽はその指輪をしげしげと見つめる。…断じて贋作などではない。…紛れもなく本物。その指輪をいつの日にか受け継ぐことを夢見て、何度も何度も凝視してきた自分だからこそ、間違いなく断定できた。

description: WH attributes dreaming of fitting on her finger to the personified ring instead of Eva.
sourceReading: The ring must be pleased to reach someone who has dreamed so fervently of wearing it.

units.text: "That ring is also pleased.  Because it was able to come to you and fit itself on your finger as it dreamed of doing."
units.note: Both correctly make Eva the person who long dreamed of putting on the ring.
units.japanese: 「その指輪も喜んでおろう。それほどまでに、指に通すことを夢見ていたそなたの元へ行くことができたのだから。」

description: WH uses she lay the tip instead of she laid the tip in past-tense transitive narration.
sourceReading: She places the staff tip on Eva’s shoulder and proclaims succession.

units.text: A goat attendant respectfully handed Beatrice a golden staff in the shape of the One-winged Eagle. After Beatrice stood up and received that staff, she lay the tip of it on Eva's shoulder and spoke.  It was a proclamation one thousand years in coming.
units.note: Both retain transitive past “she lay the tip” rather than “laid.”
units.japanese: ベアトリーチェは立ち上がってその杖を受け取ると、その先端を絵羽の肩に載せるようにして宣言する。それは千年ぶりの宣言。

units.text: A goat attendant respectfully handed Beatrice a golden staff in the shape of the One-Winged Eagle. After Beatrice stood up and received that staff, she lay the tip of it on Eva's shoulder and spoke. It was a proclamation one thousand years in coming.
units.note: Both retain transitive past “she lay the tip” rather than “laid.”
units.japanese: 山羊の従者がうやうやしく、片翼の鷲を模った黄金の杖をベアトリーチェに差し出す。ベアトリーチェは立ち上がってその杖を受け取ると、その先端を絵羽の肩に載せるようにして宣言する。それは千年ぶりの宣言。

units.text: A goat attendant respectfully offered Beatrice a golden staff modeled after the One‐winged Eagle. After Beatrice stood up and received that staff, she lay the tip of it on Eva's shoulder and spoke. It was a proclamation one thousand years in coming.
units.note: Both retain transitive past “she lay the tip” rather than “laid.”
units.japanese: 山羊の従者がうやうやしく、片翼の鷲を模った黄金の杖をベアトリーチェに差し出す。ベアトリーチェは立ち上がってその杖を受け取ると、その先端を絵羽の肩に載せるようにして宣言する。それは千年ぶりの宣言。

description: WH retains the offer to address inconvenience but omits Ronove’s explicit undertaking to remain always at the new witch’s side from now on.
sourceReading: From now on I shall always attend at your side; give me orders whenever you need anything.

units.text: ......I am called Ronove.  I am one of the 72 demons permitted to serve the Golden Witch. If you are ever inconvenienced in the slightest, please let me know at once."
units.note: MG omits Ronove’s undertaking to remain always at Eva’s side; UP restores it before the offer to address inconvenience.
units.japanese: これより、常にお側に控えております。何か不自由がございましたら、いつでもお申し付けください。」

units.text: ...I am called Ronove. I am one of the 72 demons permitted to serve the Golden Witch." "If you are ever inconvenienced in the slightest, please let me know at once."
units.note: MG omits Ronove’s undertaking to remain always at Eva’s side; UP restores it before the offer to address inconvenience.
units.japanese: 「……私はロノウェと申します。黄金の魔女さまにお仕えを許されている７２柱の悪魔でございます。これより、常にお側に控えております。何か不自由がございましたら、いつでもお申し付けください」

description: WH makes Ronove promise he will certainly listen to the order instead of formally acknowledging that he has heard and accepted it.
sourceReading: Ronove has duly received the predecessor’s final command.

units.text: "Yes.  I, Ronove, ...will certainly listen to the predecessor Beatrice's final order."
units.note: MG retains a future promise to obey the order; UP changes it to carrying on a wish, still replacing Ronove’s formal acknowledgment that he has heard and accepted the command.
units.japanese: しかと聞き届けました。」

units.text: "Yes. I, Ronove, ...will obey the final order of the former Beatrice."
units.note: MG retains a future promise to obey the order; UP changes it to carrying on a wish, still replacing Ronove’s formal acknowledgment that he has heard and accepted the command.
units.japanese: 「はい。先代ベアトリーチェさまの最後のご命令、…このロノウェ、しかと聞き届けました」

units.text: "Yes. If that is the final order of the predecessor Beatrice, ...I, Ronove, shall certainly carry on your wish."
units.note: MG retains a future promise to obey the order; UP changes it to carrying on a wish, still replacing Ronove’s formal acknowledgment that he has heard and accepted the command.
units.japanese: 「はい。先代ベアトリーチェさまの最後のご命令、…このロノウェ、しかと聞き届けました」

description: WH reverses the greeting request.
sourceReading: Please allow us too to offer our greetings to you.

units.text: "New Beatrice-sama.  Please, greet us as well."
units.note: MG asks Eva to come greet the sisters; UP restores the sisters asking permission to greet Eva.
units.japanese: 「新しきベアトリーチェさま。ぜひ私たちにもご挨拶させてくださいっ。」

units.text: "New Beatrice-sama, please, come greet us as well."
units.note: MG asks Eva to come greet the sisters; UP restores the sisters asking permission to greet Eva.
units.japanese: 「新しきベアトリーチェさま。ぜひ私たちにもご挨拶させてくださいっ」

description: WH substitutes Endless Witch for the explicitly named Golden Witch in Virgilia’s explanation of title succession/self-designation.
sourceReading: The Golden Witch title has merely been inherited, or will be claimed from now on.

units.text: "Calm yourself.  She has simply received the title of 'Endless Witch', and might call herself that in the future.  ......This succession ceremony is certainly nothing more than an act to promote that child's 'explanation'.  Don't fall for the same move again."
units.note: MG substitutes Endless Witch; UP restores Virgilia’s explicitly named Golden Witch title.
units.japanese: 「落ち着いて。“黄金の魔女”という称号が継承され、あるいは以後、自称するだけに過ぎません。……この継承式はそれをあの子の“解釈”で演出したものに過ぎないに違いない。同じ手に何度も掛からないで。」

units.text: "Calm yourself. She has simply received the title of "Endless Witch"...and might call herself that in the future. ...This succession ceremony is certainly nothing more than an act to promote that child's "explanation". Don't fall for the same move over and over again."
units.note: MG substitutes Endless Witch; UP restores Virgilia’s explicitly named Golden Witch title.
units.japanese: 「落ち着いて。“黄金の魔女”という称号が継承され、あるいは以後、自称するだけに過ぎません。……この継承式はそれをあの子の“解釈”で演出したものに過ぎないに違いない。同じ手に何度も掛からないで」

description: WH describes an act to promote the child’s explanation, rather than a production of the succession in her interpretation.
sourceReading: The ceremony must merely be a staging of that event according to Beatrice’s interpretation.

units.text: "Calm yourself.  She has simply received the title of 'Endless Witch', and might call herself that in the future.  ......This succession ceremony is certainly nothing more than an act to promote that child's 'explanation'.  Don't fall for the same move again."
units.note: MG retains an act to promote Eva’s explanation; UP restores the ceremony as a production performed according to her interpretation.
units.japanese: 「落ち着いて。“黄金の魔女”という称号が継承され、あるいは以後、自称するだけに過ぎません。……この継承式はそれをあの子の“解釈”で演出したものに過ぎないに違いない。同じ手に何度も掛からないで。」

units.text: "Calm yourself. She has simply received the title of "Endless Witch"...and might call herself that in the future. ...This succession ceremony is certainly nothing more than an act to promote that child's "explanation". Don't fall for the same move over and over again."
units.note: MG retains an act to promote Eva’s explanation; UP restores the ceremony as a production performed according to her interpretation.
units.japanese: 「落ち着いて。“黄金の魔女”という称号が継承され、あるいは以後、自称するだけに過ぎません。……この継承式はそれをあの子の“解釈”で演出したものに過ぎないに違いない。同じ手に何度も掛からないで」

description: WH says they can tell the current witch apart from Eva, where the source’s advantage is being able to identify the current witch as Eva.
sourceReading: Compared with the former Beatrice, the present witch is identifiable as Ushiromiya Eva, giving them an advantage.

units.text: ".........Battler-kun.  Anyway, be calm after this.  Compared to when this child was Beatrice, now that we can tell her apart from Ushiromiya Eva, the situation is advantageous to us."
units.note: Both say the old Beato can be told apart from Eva, rather than that the current witch can be identified as Eva.
units.japanese: 「………戦人くん。とにかく、以後は冷静に。この子がベアトリーチェだった時に比べれば、現在の彼女は、右代宮絵羽と判別が付くだけ、私たちに状況は有利です。」

units.text: "......Battler-kun, at any rate, stay calm from this point onwards. The fact that we can now tell her and Ushiromiya Eva apart works to our advantage, compared to the time when that child was still Beatrice."
units.note: Both say the old Beato can be told apart from Eva, rather than that the current witch can be identified as Eva.
units.japanese: 「………戦人くん。とにかく、以後は冷静に。この子がベアトリーチェだった時に比べれば、現在の彼女は、右代宮絵羽と判別が付くだけ、私たちに状況は有利です」

units.text: ".........Battler‐kun. In any case, handle what is to come with composure. Compared to when this child was Beatrice, now that we can tell her apart from Ushiromiya Eva, the situation is advantageous to us."
units.note: Both say the old Beato can be told apart from Eva, rather than that the current witch can be identified as Eva.
units.japanese: 「………戦人くん。とにかく、以後は冷静に。この子がベアトリーチェだった時に比べれば、現在の彼女は、右代宮絵羽と判別が付くだけ、私たちに状況は有利です」

description: WH makes putting on a joyful expression Battler’s action rather than a description of the person he cannot accept.
sourceReading: As a denier of witches he cannot accept her rejoicing at the succession ceremony.

units.text: Since I denied witches, I couldn't put on a joyful expression at this witch succession ceremony and accept her... ......However, when I looked at that innocent smile, it made me feel like I wanted to bless that, just for now.
units.note: MG makes the joyful expression belong to Battler viewing the ceremony; UP restores it as Eva’s expression that he cannot accept.
units.japanese: 魔女を否定する俺には、魔女の継承式で喜びの表情を見せる彼女を受け容れることはできない…。

units.text: As a person who denied the existence of witches, I couldn't view this witch succession ceremony with a joyful expression and accept her... ...However, when I looked at that innocent smile, I felt like I wanted to offer my blessings, just for that moment.
units.note: MG makes the joyful expression belong to Battler viewing the ceremony; UP restores it as Eva’s expression that he cannot accept.
units.japanese: 魔女を否定する俺には、魔女の継承式で喜びの表情を見せる彼女を受け容れることはできない…。……しかし、あの無邪気な笑顔を見ていると、…今だけは祝福したいような、そんな気持ちにさせられる。

description: WH gives sympathizing and sharing with them, omitting the specific joy being empathized with and shared.
sourceReading: Congratulating someone means feeling with them and sharing their joy.

units.text: "That's because blessing someone means the same thing as sympathizing and sharing with them."
units.note: MG omits the specific joy being empathized with and shared; UP restores it.
units.japanese: 「祝福するってことは、その喜びを共感する、共有するって意味だからな。」

units.text: "That's because blessing someone means the same thing as sympathizing and sharing with them."
units.note: MG omits the specific joy being empathized with and shared; UP restores it.
units.japanese: 「祝福するってことは、その喜びを共感する、共有するって意味だからな」

description: WH replaces recognition/acceptance of her with her succession in the analogy concerning Battler and Beato’s applause.
sourceReading: It was as if their applause were the last thing needed for her recognition.

units.text: When he did, as though some ceremony had ended, everyone applauded and highly praised the reborn Beatrice. It was just as though Battler's and Beato's applause had been the final thing needed for her succession......
units.note: Both replace the final recognition or acceptance of Eva with her succession itself.
units.japanese: それはまるで戦人たちの拍手が、彼女の承認に必要な最後のものであったかのようだった……。

units.text: When he did, as though some ceremony had ended, everyone applauded and highly praised the reborn Beatrice. It was just as though Battler's and Beato's applause had been the final thing needed for her succession...
units.note: Both replace the final recognition or acceptance of Eva with her succession itself.
units.japanese: すると何かの儀式を終えたのか、そこで一堂は大きな拍手で新生ベアトリーチェを大きく讃えた。それはまるで戦人たちの拍手が、彼女の承認に必要な最後のものであったかのようだった……。

units.text: And when he did, as though he had ended some kind of ceremony, everyone present put their hands together in loud applause, and highly praised the newly born Beatrice. It was just as though Battler's and Beato's applause had been the final thing needed for her succession......
units.note: Both replace the final recognition or acceptance of Eva with her succession itself.
units.japanese: すると何かの儀式を終えたのか、そこで一堂は大きな拍手で新生ベアトリーチェを大きく讃えた。それはまるで戦人たちの拍手が、彼女の承認に必要な最後のものであったかのようだった……。

description: WH changes having already taken a shower and being sufficiently refreshed into asking permission for a future shower.
sourceReading: She has at least been allowed a shower, so she has had enough rest and the next person can take a turn.

units.text: "Thanks for your concern.  I just can't sleep.  ......If you just let me take a shower, that will be enough.  The next person can rest."
units.note: Both restore that Rosa has already showered and considers that refreshment sufficient.
units.japanese: ……シャワーだけ浴びさせてもらったから、私はもう充分よ。次の人、休んでもいいわ。」

description: WH gives That goes without saying for 言わんこっちゃねぇ.
sourceReading: Did I not tell you? / That is what I warned you about.

units.text: "That goes without saying.  ...It's because you broke your daily cycle at your age.  ......Is it a cold?"
units.note: MG retains “That goes without saying”; UP restores Rudolf’s “Told you so.”
units.japanese: 「言わんこっちゃねぇ。…歳のくせに生活リズムを崩すからだぜ。……風邪か？」

units.text: "That goes without saying. ...That's what happens you break your sleep cycle at your age. ...Is it a cold?"
units.note: MG retains “That goes without saying”; UP restores Rudolf’s “Told you so.”
units.japanese: 「言わんこっちゃねぇ。…歳のくせに生活リズムを崩すからだぜ。……風邪か？」

description: WH interprets 缶詰 literally as food where it describes being confined here.
sourceReading: Since the early-morning murders they have been cooped up here holding guns, naturally accumulating stress.

units.text: "That's no surprise.  ......There was a murder early this morning.  And since then, we've been eating canned food and holding guns.  ...It's natural that we would start to build up stress."
units.note: Both retain literal canned-food eating where 缶詰 describes the adults being confined in the lobby with guns.
units.japanese: 「無理もない。……早朝に殺人事件。それからずっと、ここで銃を抱きながら缶詰ですもの。…ストレスが溜まって当然ね。」

units.text: "That's no surprise. ...There was a murder early this morning. And since then, we've been eating canned food and carrying guns around. ...It's natural that we'd start to build up stress."
units.note: Both retain literal canned-food eating where 缶詰 describes the adults being confined in the lobby with guns.
units.japanese: 「無理もない。……早朝に殺人事件。それからずっと、ここで銃を抱きながら缶詰ですもの。…ストレスが溜まって当然ね」

units.text: "That's no surprise. ......There was a murder early this morning. And since then, we've been eating canned food and holding guns. ...It's natural that we would start to build up stress."
units.note: Both retain literal canned-food eating where 缶詰 describes the adults being confined in the lobby with guns.
units.japanese: 「無理もない。……早朝に殺人事件。それからずっと、ここで銃を抱きながら缶詰ですもの。…ストレスが溜まって当然ね」

description: WH omits the corridor destination and changes a movement out into it to running around the second floor.
sourceReading: They hear what seems to be someone running out into the second-floor corridor, along with Maria’s cries.

units.text: And in a flash, in addition to the sound which seemed to be caused by her running around the second floor, they could hear Maria calling uu-uu-uu- over and over again, sounding displeased.
units.note: Both restore the footsteps running out into the upstairs corridor.
units.japanese: すると間髪入れずに、２階廊下へ走り出たらしい音と、真里亞のうーうーうーと連呼する不機嫌そうな声が聞こえてきた。

description: WH replaces tilting the bottle to dispense/check contents with opening it.
sourceReading: She finds and tilts the bottle, but it appears empty.

units.text: She found it and opened the bottle, but it must have been empty. Irritated, Rosa shook the bottle several times, but that didn't change the fact that nothing was in there. ...As she did that, Maria's crying grew even more intense...
units.note: MG retains opening the bottle; UP restores tipping it into Rosa’s palm.
units.japanese: それを見つけ瓶を傾けるが、どうも空っぽらしい。

units.text: She found it and opened the bottle, but it must have been empty. Irritated, Rosa shook the bottle several times, but that didn't change the fact that nothing was in there. ...As she did that, Maria's crying grew even more intense...
units.note: MG retains opening the bottle; UP restores tipping it into Rosa’s palm.
units.japanese:
それを見つけ瓶を傾けるが、どうも空っぽらしい。
楼座はイライラしながら瓶を何度も振るが、空である事実は変わらなかった。…その間にも、真里亞はますますに泣き声を強めていく…。

description: WH says when I was a kid, the whole time instead of continuing ever since childhood.
sourceReading: Ever since childhood another self has remained in her heart and encouraged her.

units.text: "............You know, when I was a kid, the whole time, there was another me inside myself, who always supported me.  ...And that other self was a witch.
units.note: MG retains the childhood-only construction; UP explicitly restores “ever since I was a kid” and the continuing state.
units.japanese: 「……………私ね。子どもの頃から、ずっとずっと心の中に、もうひとりの自分がいて、いつも私を励ましてくれたの。…そしてその自分は魔女だったわ。

units.text: "......When... I was a kid, the whole time, there was another me inside myself, who always supported me. ...And that other self was a witch."
units.note: MG retains the childhood-only construction; UP explicitly restores “ever since I was a kid” and the continuing state.
units.japanese: 「……………私ね。子どもの頃から、ずっとずっと心の中に、もうひとりの自分がいて、いつも私を励ましてくれたの。…そしてその自分は魔女だったわ」

description: WH changes I am deeply grateful and am always grateful into I was so grateful and was always grateful.
sourceReading: Eva remains grateful to her witch-self for letting her meet Hideyoshi.

units.text: .........I didn't believe in Beatrice, the witch of the forest.  I always believed that if a witch of Rokkenjima did exist, it was the witch inside my heart.  .........I was so grateful to that witch inside myself.  ...I was always grateful, ......that she let me meet up with you..."
units.note: MG retains past gratitude; UP restores Eva’s continuing present gratitude.
units.japanese: ………森の魔女ベアトリーチェなんて信じなかった。もし六軒島に魔女がいるとしたら、それは私の心の中の魔女のことだってずっと信じてきた。………その魔女の自分に、私はすごい感謝してる。…あなたに出会わせてくれて良かったなぁって、……いつも感謝してる…。」

units.text: "......I didn't believe in Beatrice, the witch of the forest. I always believed that if a witch of Rokkenjima did exist, it was the witch inside my heart. ......I was so grateful to that witch inside myself. ...I was always grateful...that she brought me to you..."
units.note: MG retains past gratitude; UP restores Eva’s continuing present gratitude.
units.japanese: 「………森の魔女ベアトリーチェなんて信じなかった。もし六軒島に魔女がいるとしたら、それは私の心の中の魔女のことだってずっと信じてきた。………その魔女の自分に、私はすごい感謝してる。…あなたに出会わせてくれて良かったなぁって、……いつも感謝してる…」

description: WH describes Eva holding back a headache, where the noise may be painfully telling on her headache.
sourceReading: Perhaps the noise aggravates her headache, explaining her moan and pulling covers over herself.

units.text: ...That probably hurt Eva's ears. Or maybe she was holding back a headache. Eva moaned as though in pain, and buried herself in the covers.
units.note: MG now makes the noise cause/aggravate the headache in context. UP also rewrites the line but produces the separate idiomatic defect registered above.
units.japanese: あるいは頭痛に堪えるのかもしれない。

units.text:
...That was probably very annoying to listen to.
Or maybe it was taking a toll on her headache.
Eva moaned as though in pain, and buried herself in the covers.
units.note: MG now makes the noise cause/aggravate the headache in context. UP also rewrites the line but produces the separate idiomatic defect registered above.
units.japanese:
…それがよほど耳障りなのだろう。
あるいは頭痛に堪えるのかもしれない。
絵羽は苦しそうに呻き、布団を被った。

description: WH limits 好きにしていい to worry about the rose all she wants.
sourceReading: Tomorrow after the rain stops she may do as she likes concerning the rose.

units.text: "Anyway, everyone is having a hard time right now.  So don't bother Mama and everyone else.  ......You can worry about that rose all you want tomorrow, when it stops raining.  So for now, listen to me...!"
units.note: Both retain the restriction of 好きにしていい to worrying about the rose rather than broader permission concerning it.
units.japanese: 「とにかく、今はみんな大変なの。だからママたちに迷惑を掛けないで。……薔薇の話は、明日、雨が上がったら好きにしていいから。だから今は聞き分けなさい…！」

units.text: "Anyway, everyone is having a hard time right now. So don't bother Mama and everyone else. ...You can worry about that rose all you want tomorrow, when it stops raining. So for now, listen to me...!"
units.note: Both retain the restriction of 好きにしていい to worrying about the rose rather than broader permission concerning it.
units.japanese: 「とにかく、今はみんな大変なの。だからママたちに迷惑を掛けないで。……薔薇の話は、明日、雨が上がったら好きにしていいから。だから今は聞き分けなさい…！」

units.text: "Anyway, everyone is having a hard time right now. So don't bother Mama and everyone else. ......You can worry about that rose all you want tomorrow, when it stops raining. So just listen to me for now...!"
units.note: Both retain the restriction of 好きにしていい to worrying about the rose rather than broader permission concerning it.
units.japanese: 「とにかく、今はみんな大変なの。だからママたちに迷惑を掛けないで。……薔薇の話は、明日、雨が上がったら好きにしていいから。だから今は聞き分けなさい…！」

description: WH replaces Rosa’s condition that Maria be satisfied after seeing the rose once with Rosa’s statement that she will agree if it is only one look.
sourceReading: All right; once you have seen it, be satisfied, understood?

units.text: "......Understood.  If it's just one look, then I'll agree.  Is that alright?"
units.note: MG retains Rosa agreeing to one look; UP restores Rosa ordering Maria to be satisfied after one look.
units.japanese: 「……わかったわ。一目見たら納得するのよ。いいわね？」

units.text: "...Understood. If it's just one look, then I'll agree. Will that work?"
units.note: MG retains Rosa agreeing to one look; UP restores Rosa ordering Maria to be satisfied after one look.
units.japanese: 「……わかったわ。一目見たら納得するのよ。いいわね？」

description: WH adds maybe and might to the claim that fiercer wind would certainly have made Rosa hesitate to go out.
sourceReading: Had the wind been worse, Rosa would surely have hesitated to go outside.

units.text: The two of them could be seen in the rose garden. The rain was still awful, but fortunately, the wind had died down a little. ...No, maybe that wasn't fortunate. Because maybe, if the wind had been a little fiercer, Rosa might have hesitated to go outside...
units.note: MG retains “maybe” and “might”; UP restores the certain counterfactual “would surely.”
units.japanese: もしも、もっとひどい風だったなら、楼座は表へ出ることを躊躇ったに違いないのだから…。

units.text: The two of them could be seen in the rose garden. The rain was still awful, but fortunately, the wind had died down a little. ...No, maybe that wasn't fortunate. Because maybe, if the wind had been a little fiercer, Rosa might have hesitated to go outside...
units.note: MG retains “maybe” and “might”; UP restores the certain counterfactual “would surely.”
units.japanese: 二人の姿は薔薇庭園にあった。雨は相変わらずひどいが、風は少しだけ収まっているのが幸いだった。……いや、幸いだったかはわからない。もしも、もっとひどい風だったなら、楼座は表へ出ることを躊躇ったに違いないのだから…。

description: WH says Hideyoshi decided several times, where he proposed calling Nanjo and Eva refused.
sourceReading: He repeatedly suggests calling Nanjo, but she firmly rejects the suggestions.

units.text: ......Even though he understood that, Hideyoshi suspected that this sudden fever was the sign of some serious illness. Several times, Hideyoshi decided to call Doctor Nanjo, but Eva resisted firmly, ...pleading with him and saying that it was even more important that he didn't take his hand away...
units.note: MG retains repeated decisions; UP restores repeated suggestions, though its “suggested to call” construction is independently defective English.
units.japanese: 秀吉は何度か南條を呼ぼうと提案したが、絵羽はそれを頑なに拒み、…それより、自分の手を離さないでほしいと懇願する…。

units.text: ...Even though he understood that, Hideyoshi suspected that this sudden fever was the sign of some serious illness. Several times, Hideyoshi decided to call for Doctor Nanjo, but Eva resisted firmly, ...pleading with him and saying that it was even more important that he didn't take his hand away...
units.note: MG retains repeated decisions; UP restores repeated suggestions, though its “suggested to call” construction is independently defective English.
units.japanese: ……そう理屈ではわかっていても、この絵羽の急な発熱は、何か良くない病気の発症ではないかと疑ってしまう。秀吉は何度か南條を呼ぼうと提案したが、絵羽はそれを頑なに拒み、…それより、自分の手を離さないでほしいと懇願する…。

description: WH changes the agreed examination at lunchtime into a deadline by lunchtime.
sourceReading: When noon comes she must let Nanjo examine her; on that promise he will stay holding her hand.

units.text: "I understand...  But you must have Doctor Nanjo look at you by lunchtime.  If you can promise me that, I'll stay here the whole time, grippin' your hand.  Tightly, like this."
units.note: Both retain “by lunchtime,” rather than having Nanjo examine Eva when noon arrives.
units.japanese: 「わかった…。でもな、お昼になったら必ず南條先生に診てもらうんやで。それを約束できるなら、ずっとここにいて、お前の手を握ったるからな。こうして、ぎゅっとな。」

units.text: "I understand... But you've gotta have Doctor Nanjo look at you by lunchtime. If you can promise me that, I'll stay here the whole time, grippin' your hand. Tightly, like this."
units.note: Both retain “by lunchtime,” rather than having Nanjo examine Eva when noon arrives.
units.japanese: 「わかった…。でもな、お昼になったら必ず南條先生に診てもらうんやで。それを約束できるなら、ずっとここにいて、お前の手を握ったるからな。こうして、ぎゅっとな」

units.text: "I understand... But you've gotta have Doctor Nanjo look at you by lunchtime. If you can promise me that, I'll stay here the whole time, grippin' your hand. Tightly, like this."
units.note: Both retain “by lunchtime,” rather than having Nanjo examine Eva when noon arrives.
units.japanese: 「わかった…。でもな、お昼になったら必ず南條先生に診てもらうんやで。それを約束できるなら、ずっとここにいて、お前の手を握ったるからな。こうして、ぎゅっとな」

description: WH replaces so that someone who is not me does not take me away with It is like I am being taken away.
sourceReading: Hold her hand so she will not be carried away by someone other than herself.

units.text: "Hold on...!!  Don't let go!!  It's like I'm being taken away by someone who isn't me...!!  Hold on to my hand...  Don't let goooooooooooooo...!!!"
units.note: Both restore a preventive plea to avoid being taken away by someone who is not herself.
units.japanese: 「握っていて…！！　離さないでッ！！　私が私じゃない誰かに連れ去られないように…！！　私の手を握っていて…。離さないでぇええええぇ…ッ！！！」

description: WH renders ゆえに無限 as Because it is eternal, replacing a conclusion and the named Endless concept.
sourceReading: The former bearer may have died but the name is hers now; therefore endless/infinite.

units.text: Maybe the Beatrice you knew met with death, but that name is mine now...!  Because it is eternal!  The concept of death does not exist for Beatrice!!"
units.note: MG restores the concluding “therefore” but retains “eternal” for the named Endless concept; UP restores “therefore it is endless.”
units.japanese: お前が知っていたベアトリーチェは死を迎えたかもしれないが、今やそれは私の名である…！　ゆえに無限！

units.text: "Maybe the Beatrice you knew met with death, but that name is mine now...! And therefore, it's eternal! The concept of death does not exist for Beatrice!!"
units.note: MG restores the concluding “therefore” but retains “eternal” for the named Endless concept; UP restores “therefore it is endless.”
units.japanese: 「お前が知っていたベアトリーチェは死を迎えたかもしれないが、今やそれは私の名である…！　ゆえに無限！　ベアトリーチェに死の概念はないのッ！！」

description: WH says nothing more unnerving that having instead of than having.
sourceReading: Nothing is more unsettling for gravity-bound humans than their feet leaving the earth.

units.text: For a human shackled to the ground by gravity, there is nothing more unnerving that having their feet stop sticking to the ground. ......However, to Beatrice, who knew the joy of being released from gravity as the new witch, it was enough to cause her whole body to shake with delight.
units.note: MG retains “more unnerving that”; UP restores “than.”
units.japanese: 重力によって束縛された人間にとって、足が大地に付かないことは、この上なく不安なこと。

units.text: For a human shackled to the ground by gravity, there is nothing more unnerving that having their feet stop sticking to the ground. ...However, to Beatrice, who, in becoming the new witch, had learned the joy of being released from gravity, it was enough to make her whole body shake with delight.
units.note: MG retains “more unnerving that”; UP restores “than.”
units.japanese: 重力によって束縛された人間にとって、足が大地に付かないことは、この上なく不安なこと。……しかし、新しき魔女として重力から解放される喜びを知ったベアトリーチェは、歓喜に全身を震わせる。

description: WH drops if this is a dream and asks the addressee to wake her from this dream.
sourceReading: Stop; if this is a dream, let me wake up.

units.text: "S, ............stop it, .........wake me from this dream......"
units.note: MG restores “if this is a dream”; UP retains the unconditional request to wake her from this dream.
units.japanese: 「や、…………やめてよ、………夢なら醒めて……。」

units.text: "S‐............Stop it, .........wake me from this dream......"
units.note: MG restores “if this is a dream”; UP retains the unconditional request to wake her from this dream.
units.japanese: 「や、…………やめてよ、………夢なら醒めて……」

description: WH makes Rosa’s body the carpet of blood rather than the body having spread a radial carpet of fresh blood.
sourceReading: Her body, which should have laid a radial carpet of blood, rapidly returns to normal.

units.text: But the witch hadn't intended to kill her. So she wished that Rosa didn't die. When she did, gold butterflies coiled about Rosa's body, reviving that life just as the witch had wished. Rosa's body, which should have been spread out like a carpet of fresh blood, rapidly returned to normal.
units.note: MG retains the body itself spread as a carpet; UP restores the body laying out a radial carpet of blood.
units.japanese: 放射状に鮮血の絨毯を敷いたはずの楼座の体が、みるみる元に戻っていく。

units.text: But the witch hadn't intended to kill her. So she wished that Rosa hadn't died. When she did, gold butterflies coiled about Rosa's body, reviving that life just as the witch had wished. Rosa's body, which should have been spread out like a carpet of fresh blood, rapidly returned to normal.
units.note: MG retains the body itself spread as a carpet; UP restores the body laying out a radial carpet of blood.
units.japanese:
しかし魔女に殺すつもりはなかった。
だから死ぬなと念じた。すると楼座の体に黄金蝶たちが纏わり付いて、その命を望んだ通りに蘇らせる。放射状に鮮血の絨毯を敷いたはずの楼座の体が、みるみる元に戻っていく。

description: WH spells irreversible as irreversable.
sourceReading: Surpassing irreversibility proves surpassing humans in the scene’s stated magical logic.

units.text: ......How easy it is to break things in this world, and how difficult it is to fix them... Anyone can take a life. But no human can revive a lost life!  By surpassing the irreversable, one proves that they have surpassed humans. ......This surely gave her a much, much greater realization that she was a witch than flying through the sky had.
units.note: MG retains “irreversable”; UP spells “irreversible” correctly.
units.japanese: でも、失った命をよみがえらせることなんて、ニンゲンには誰にもできない！　その不可逆を超えたことは即ち、ニンゲンを超えたことの証明。

units.text: ...How easy it is to break things in this world, and how difficult it is to fix them... Anyone can take a life. But no Human can revive a lost life! By surpassing the irreversable, one proves that they have surpassed Humanity. ...This surely gave her a much, much greater realization of her position as a witch than flying through the sky had.
units.note: MG retains “irreversable”; UP spells “irreversible” correctly.
units.japanese: ……世の中、壊すことがどれほど簡単で、直すことがどれほど困難なことか。命を奪うことなんて、誰にでもできる。でも、失った命をよみがえらせることなんて、ニンゲンには誰にもできない！　その不可逆を超えたことは即ち、ニンゲンを超えたことの証明。……それはきっと、空を飛べたことよりもはるかにはるかに、自身が魔女になったことを彼女に実感させるのだ。

description: WH gives so we are even for もう平気 after reviving Rosa.
sourceReading: She has revived Rosa, so it is all right now, she claims.

units.text: And I didn't know that humans could die so easily.  But I've brought you back to life, so we're even.  So get up, okay?  Play with me some more, okay?  *giggle*giggle*, ehehehaahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!"
units.note: MG retains settling accounts; UP restores that Rosa is fine now.
units.japanese: そしてニンゲンがこんなに脆く死ぬとも知らなかったの。でも生き返らせてあげたからもう平気。だから起きて？　私ともっと遊びましょう？

units.text: "And I didn't know Humans could die so easily. But I've brought you back to life, so we're even. So get up, okay? Play with me some more, okay? *giggle*giggle*giggle* Hehehehaahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!"
units.note: MG retains settling accounts; UP restores that Rosa is fine now.
units.japanese: 「そしてニンゲンがこんなに脆く死ぬとも知らなかったの。でも生き返らせてあげたからもう平気。だから起きて？　私ともっと遊びましょう？　くすくす、うふふあははははははははははははははははは！！」

description: WH changes making Rosa drown in a sea of jelly to making her fall into one, weakening the explicit lethal action in the witch’s offered dream.
sourceReading: She can make Rosa drown in a jelly sea.

units.text: Even making you fall into a sea of jelly!  Even having you get sucked into a mountain of cake!  I can even even make you sprout butterfly wings and let you walk around the garden, okay?! I'll do them one after another.  Let's start with the ocean of jelly, okay...?!
units.note: Both restore explicitly drowning Rosa in jelly.
units.japanese: あなたをゼリーの海で溺れさせてあげることも！　ケーキの山で飲み込んであげることも！　蝶の羽を生やしてお庭を散歩させてあげることさえね？！

description: WH changes 果肉 to skin in the transparent-fish fantasy.
sourceReading: The fish are probably made of grape flesh/pulp.

units.text: As Rosa sank, she was shocked to see a school of transparent fish swimming through the grape jelly ocean. They were probably made of grape skin.
units.note: Both retain grape skin instead of flesh.
units.japanese: それは多分、葡萄の果肉で出来ているに違いない。

units.text: As Rosa sank, she was shocked to see a school of transparent fish swimming through the grape jelly ocean. They were probably made of grape skin.
units.note: Both retain grape skin instead of flesh.
units.japanese: 楼座は沈みながら、グレープゼリーの海の中を泳ぐ透明な魚の群れを呆然と見ていた。それは多分、葡萄の果肉で出来ているに違いない。

description: WH substitutes frail for the pulpy, disintegrated consistency described by ぐずぐず.
sourceReading: She ends up a small mushy lump of flesh.

units.text: Then she sunk on and on, deeper and deeper, as deep as the Marianas Trench, ......crushed by the water pressure of the jelly ocean, as her ribs snapped, as her spine snapped. ...In the end, she had become a small, frail meatball.
units.note: Both retain frail instead of pulpy/disintegrated.
units.japanese: …最後は小ちゃなぐずぐずの肉団子になってしまった。

units.text: Then she sunk on and on, deeper and deeper, as deep as the Marianas Trench, ...crushed by the water pressure of the jelly ocean... as her ribs snapped, as her spine snapped. ...In the end, she became a small, frail meatball.
units.note: Both retain frail instead of pulpy/disintegrated.
units.japanese: そしてどこまでもどこまでも深く深く沈んで行き、マリアナ海溝くらい沈んで行き、……ゼリーの海の水圧でぎゅうぎゅうに押し潰されて、肋骨がぱきぽき、背骨がばきぼき。…最後は小ちゃなぐずぐずの肉団子になってしまった。

units.text: Then she sank on and on, deeper and deeper, as deep as the Mariana Trench, ......compressed tight by the water pressure of the jelly ocean, as her ribs crushed and crunched, as her spine snapped and cracked. ...In the end, she had become a small, frail meatball.
units.note: Both retain frail instead of pulpy/disintegrated.
units.japanese: そしてどこまでもどこまでも深く深く沈んで行き、マリアナ海溝くらい沈んで行き、……ゼリーの海の水圧でぎゅうぎゅうに押し潰されて、肋骨がぱきぽき、背骨がばきぼき。…最後は小ちゃなぐずぐずの肉団子になってしまった。

description: WH raises 数億個 from several hundred million to several billion cakes.
sourceReading: Several hundred million cakes fall toward Rosa.

units.text: That became the ceiling, became a mountain, ......several billion cakes were thrown down towards Rosa. If you piled those cakes up, they would surely be taller than Mount Everest. So they probably weighed, .........I'm not too sure, but it was probably heavier than all the cakes across Japan put together.
units.note: Both retain several billion rather than several hundred million.
units.japanese: それが天井となって、山となって、……数億個のケーキが楼座目掛けて振り落ちてくる。

units.text: That became the ceiling, became a mountain, ...and several billion cakes were thrown down towards Rosa. If you piled those cakes up, they would surely be taller than Mount Everest. So they probably weighed... ...I'm not too sure, but I'll bet it was heavier than all the cakes across Japan put together.
units.note: Both retain several billion rather than several hundred million.
units.japanese: それが天井となって、山となって、……数億個のケーキが楼座目掛けて振り落ちてくる。そのケーキの山はきっと、積み上げればエベレストより高い。だから重さは多分、………よくわからないけど、日本中のケーキを全部合わせたよりは重いと思う。

units.text: They were a ceiling, they were a mountain, ......and those several billion cakes were thrown down towards Rosa. If you piled those cakes up, they would surely be taller than Everest. So they probably weighed... ......I'm not too sure, but it was probably heavier than all the cakes across Japan put together.
units.note: Both retain several billion rather than several hundred million.
units.japanese: それが天井となって、山となって、……数億個のケーキが楼座目掛けて振り落ちてくる。そのケーキの山はきっと、積み上げればエベレストより高い。だから重さは多分、………よくわからないけど、日本中のケーキを全部合わせたよりは重いと思う。

description: WH removes the explicit count twice, then renders the next twice as more than once.
sourceReading: At this point the source explicitly says she has experienced death twice.

units.text: By that point, death, which most humans only have to experience once after they are born, had already been experienced repeatedly by Rosa. In other words, she gone through that which humans cannot, the precious experience of dying more than once.
units.note: Both generalize the explicit two deaths to repeated deaths or more than once.
units.japanese: この時点で楼座は、ニンゲンに生まれたなら一度だけしか味わわなくていい死の経験を、すでに二度も味わったわけだ。

units.text: By that point, death, which most Humans only have to experience once after they are born, had already been experienced repeatedly by Rosa. In other words, she gone through that which Humans cannot, the precious experience of dying more than once.
units.note: Both generalize the explicit two deaths to repeated deaths or more than once.
units.japanese: この時点で楼座は、ニンゲンに生まれたなら一度だけしか味わわなくていい死の経験を、すでに二度も味わったわけだ。つまり、ニンゲンには味わうこのとできない、二度の死という貴重な経験を味わったのだ。

units.text: By that point, death, which most Humanhumans only have to experience once after they are born, had already been experienced repeatedly by Rosa. In other words, she had gone through that which Humanhumans cannot, the precious experience of dying more than once.
units.note: Both generalize the explicit two deaths to repeated deaths or more than once.
units.japanese: この時点で楼座は、ニンゲンに生まれたなら一度だけしか味わわなくていい死の経験を、すでに二度も味わったわけだ。つまり、ニンゲンには味わうこのとできない、二度の死という貴重な経験を味わったのだ。

description: WH changes the explicit greater-than comparison to equality.
sourceReading: The spider looks larger than the roof of a canopy bed to shrunken Rosa.

units.text: That owner, which should have been small enough to crush in the palm of your hand, now looked as big as the top of a canopy bed to Rosa.
units.note: Both retain equality with a canopy instead of being larger than it.
units.japanese: 手の平で握り潰せるほどの大きさのはずのその主は、今の楼座から見れば、天蓋ベッドの屋根より大きい。

units.text: That owner, which should have been small enough to crush in the palm of your hand, now looked as big as the top of a canopy bed to Rosa.
units.note: Both retain equality with a canopy instead of being larger than it.
units.japanese: 手の平で握り潰せるほどの大きさのはずのその主は、今の楼座から見れば、天蓋ベッドの屋根より大きい。

description: WH omits the speaker’s I think when dating the childhood episode.
sourceReading: She thinks this happened before Rosa started elementary school.

units.text: Kyahhahahahahahaha, you don't remember, do you?  This happened before you got into grade school...!!  Make sure you watch closely this time, okay?  Very closely.  Kyahihihahahahahahakya-hahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!"
units.note: Both omit I think when dating the childhood spider episode.
units.japanese: 覚えてないわね、あなた小学校に上がる前だったと思うもの…！！　今度はよく見れるわよ？　しげしげとね。

units.text: "Kyahhahahahahahaha, I guess you don't remember, do you? This happened before you got into grade school...!! Make sure you watch closely this time, okay? Very closely. Kyahihihahahahahahakya-hahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!"
units.note: Both omit I think when dating the childhood spider episode.
units.japanese: 「きゃっははははははは、覚えてないわね、あなた小学校に上がる前だったと思うもの…！！　今度はよく見れるわよ？　しげしげとね。きゃひひははははははきゃーははははははははははははははははッ！！」

units.text: "Kyahhahahahahahaha, you don't remember, do you? This happened before you got into grade school...!! You'll be able to see it up close this time, you know! Very close. Kyahihi{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0kyaaha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0ha{0hahaha!!"
units.note: Both omit I think when dating the childhood spider episode.
units.japanese: 「きゃっははははははは、覚えてないわね、あなた小学校に上がる前だったと思うもの…！！　今度はよく見れるわよ？　しげしげとね。きゃひひははははははきゃーははははははははははははははははッ！！」

description: Battler asks Virgilia to make this farce stop; WH instead asks her to let him stop it.
sourceReading: 止めさせるんだ is a causative demand addressed to Virgilia to get the spectacle stopped.

units.text: "You're insane!!  Stop it already, damn iiiiiiiiit!!  Virgilia, let me stop this insane farce!!  What should I do!!"
units.note: Both restore asking Virgilia to make the farce stop.
units.japanese: 「狂ってやがるッ！！　もう止めろ畜生ォオオオォ！！　ワルギリアッ、この狂った茶番を止めさせるんだ！！　どうすりゃいいんだ！！」

description: WH substitutes surprise for the exasperation Beato would prefer to Virgilia’s indifferent expression.
sourceReading: Even an exasperated or appalled face might have been somewhat better for her.

units.text: She was hoping for approval, but Virgilia simply faced her with an indifferent expression. ...To Beato, at that moment, even a surprised face would probably have seemed better.
units.note: Both restore the exasperated look Beato would prefer to indifference.
units.japanese: …むしろ呆れ顔の方が、今のベアトにとっては幾分、マシだったかもしれない。

description: WH replaces Beato’s protest that ignoring her is too much with a prediction that Battler will do everything he can to ignore her.
sourceReading: Even so, outright ignoring me is going too far.

units.text: ...He doesn't have to accept that I'm a witch.  Because we're challenging each other in this game.  But still, saying he won't look at my face, that he won't talk to me, ......he'll probably do all he can to ignore me...  Am I really hated that muuuuuch......!"
units.note: MG retains a prediction of being ignored; UP restores the protest that ignoring her is going too far.
units.japanese: でもよぉ、顔も見ない、話もしないって、……無視はいくらなんでもないだろぉ…。妾はそんなにも嫌われ者なのかよぉおおぉ……！」

units.text: "...He doesn't have to accept that I'm a witch. We're challenging each other in this game, after all. And yet, he won't look at my face, he won't talk to me, ...and he'll probably do all he can to ignore me... Am I really hated that muuuuuch...?!"
units.note: MG retains a prediction of being ignored; UP restores the protest that ignoring her is going too far.
units.japanese: 「…魔女だと認めぬのはいいさ。それを競い合うゲームなんだから。でもよぉ、顔も見ない、話もしないって、……無視はいくらなんでもないだろぉ…。妾はそんなにも嫌われ者なのかよぉおおぉ……！」

description: WH calls the day pointless rather than an ordinary day with nothing special about it.
sourceReading: The proposed Alice tea party celebrates a day without a special occasion.

units.text: That Halloween party where candies poured out of six people's stomachs was truly wonderful!  So maybe I'll act out Alice's tea party...!  I'll invite everyone to a tea party in celebration of a completely pointless day, and entertain them one by one with my magic!
units.note: MG retains completely pointless day; UP restores the unbirthday reference in the Alice tea-party setting.
units.japanese: ６人のお腹からお菓子が溢れ出すハロウィンパーティなんて本当に素敵ッ！　ならば私はアリスのお茶会を演出しようかしら…！　何でもない日を祝うお茶会にみんなを招待して、私が魔法で次々お持て成しするの！

units.text: "That Halloween party where candies poured out of six people's stomachs was truly wonderful! So maybe I'll act out Alice's tea party...! I'll invite everyone to a tea party in celebration of a completely pointless day, and entertain them one by one with my magic!"
units.note: MG retains completely pointless day; UP restores the unbirthday reference in the Alice tea-party setting.
units.japanese: 「６人のお腹からお菓子が溢れ出すハロウィンパーティなんて本当に素敵ッ！　ならば私はアリスのお茶会を演出しようかしら…！　何でもない日を祝うお茶会にみんなを招待して、私が魔法で次々おもてなしするの！」

description: WH relocates Beato’s current tentative concession into sometimes having thought this in the past.
sourceReading: She does think, at least a little, that her conduct until now may have gone too far.

units.text: "............I have also, umm, ...sometimes thought that, in the past, ...I might have gone a little too far.  ......Well, I think that as the Golden Witch, it's a good idea to have a little elegance..."
units.note: MG retains sometimes thought; UP restores her current tentative opinion that she previously went too far.
units.japanese:
「……………わ、妾もその、
…以前までのは少しやり過ぎたかなァと、
…少しは思っておるのだ。

units.text: "......I have also, umm, ...sometimes thought that, in the past, ...I might have gone a little too far. ...Well, I think that as the Golden Witch, it's probably best to show a little elegance..."
units.note: MG retains sometimes thought; UP restores her current tentative opinion that she previously went too far.
units.japanese: 「……………わ、妾もその、…以前までのは少しやり過ぎたかなァと、…少しは思っておるのだ。……まぁ、黄金の魔女たる者、少しは気品があっても良いかと思うてな…」

description: WH prints gentler that how rather than gentler than how.
sourceReading: The revival may even be gentler than Beato’s own earlier revivals.

units.text: When Beato waved her pipe, seven colors of smoke poured out, reviving Rosa and Maria. ......Compared to how the new Beatrice had done it a short while ago, it was slightly gentler. ...It was probably gentler that how Beato had done it herself up until now.
units.note: Both restore than in the gentler comparison.
units.japanese:
……先ほどまでの新しきベアトリーチェのそれに比べると、少しだけやさしかった。
…あるいは、それまでの自らのそれと比べても。

description: There, would be friendly with Mama omits the subject of would be friendly.
sourceReading: Maria could get along with Mama there, and everyone could keep laughing together.

units.text: "...You promised, right, Beato?!  You promised that you would take Maria to the Golden Land, right?!  There, would be friendly with Mama, and everyone would laugh together...!  You promised that you would take us there, right?!"
units.note: Both restore Maria as the subject of the promised improved relationship with Mama.
units.japanese: 「…ベアトは約束したよね？！　真里亞を黄金郷へ連れてってくれるって約束したよね？！　そこではママとも仲良しになれて、みんなずっと笑い合えるの…！　そこへ連れて行ってくれるって、約束してくれたよねッ？！」

description: The English says Maria was embraced by the expression on Beato’s face rather than by Beato wearing that expression.
sourceReading: Beato embraces Maria with a loving expression.

units.text: Maria was embraced by the loving expression on Beato's face... Then, .........softly, a red bruise appeared on Maria's neck. It was a very gentle bruise. ...It's redness grew bit by bit, ...and when it distinctly formed itself into the shape of a hand...
units.note: Both make Beato the agent embracing Maria, with a loving expression.
units.japanese: 真里亞を、ベアトは慈しみの表情で抱き締める…。

description: WH prints It’s redness where the possessive Its is required.
sourceReading: The bruise gradually grows redder until a hand shape appears.

units.text: Maria was embraced by the loving expression on Beato's face... Then, .........softly, a red bruise appeared on Maria's neck. It was a very gentle bruise. ...It's redness grew bit by bit, ...and when it distinctly formed itself into the shape of a hand...
units.note: MG restores possessive Its; UP avoids the construction by saying it grew redder.
units.japanese: …それが少しずつ赤みを増し、…くっきりと手の形を浮かび上がらせた時。

description: WH uses we shall espouse to perform for the instruction to carry out future tasks by the shortest procedure.
sourceReading: The Seven Sisters should stop their earlier pranks and henceforth complete missions by the shortest procedure.

units.text: "Certainly.  From now on, we will be careful to perform in a graceful manner, suitable for the name of the Golden Witch.  ......Even the Seven Sisters of Purgatory will reform their bad behavior up until now, and we shall espouse to perform our task in the quickest possible manner.  ......Would that be acceptable?  Milady?"
units.note: Both retain we shall espouse to perform.
units.japanese: 「畏まりました。以後は黄金の魔女の名に相応しい、気品に気をつけるように致します。……煉獄の七姉妹も、これまでのような悪ふざけは改め、以後は最短の手順で任務を遂行するように。……ということで、よろしいですか？　お嬢様？」

units.text: "Certainly. From now on, we will be careful to act in a graceful manner, suitable for the name of the Golden Witch. ...Even the Seven Sisters of Purgatory will reform their bad behavior up until now, and we shall espouse to perform our task in the quickest possible manner. ...Would that be acceptable, Milady?"
units.note: Both retain we shall espouse to perform.

units.text: "Certainly. From now on, we will be careful to perform in a graceful manner, suitable for the name of the Golden Witch. ......Even the Seven Sisters of Purgatory will reform their previous bad behavior, and we shall espouse to perform our task in the quickest possible manner. ......Would that be acceptable? Milady?"
units.note: Both retain we shall espouse to perform.
units.japanese: 「畏まりました。以後は黄金の魔女の名に相応しい、気品に気をつけるように致します。……煉獄の七姉妹も、これまでのような悪ふざけは改め、以後は最短の手順で任務を遂行するように。……ということで、よろしいですか？　お嬢様？」

description: WH says she had no business there instead of explaining her hasty disappearance through awkwardness and inability to keep the moment going.
sourceReading: It may be more fitting to say she hurried away because she could not sustain the awkward situation.

units.text: Acting unsure until the very end, Beato communicated only that, became a group of gold butterflies, and hid her form in the empty air. She didn't have any business there, so it might be fitting to say that she disappeared in a hurry.
units.note: Both restore Beato’s difficulty maintaining the awkward exchange as the reason for hurried disappearance.
units.japanese: 間が持たないので、そそくさと消えたという方が相応しいかもしれない。

description: WH names the pointed gate of the fence where the source names the fence’s pointed tip.
sourceReading: The fence’s pointed end stabbed the medulla oblongata.

units.text: If we can trust Nanjo's examination, the cause of Rosa's death was a stab to the medulla oblongata with the pointed gate of the fence.  It is thought that Maria's death was due to strangling with bare hands.  However, due to the 'Devil's Proof', we cannot discount a misdiagnosis."
units.note: Both retain pointed gate of the fence rather than its pointed tip. The injury location and conditional medical report otherwise remain intact.
units.japanese: 南條の検死を信頼できるならば、楼座の死因は延髄部への柵の先端部分による刺突。真里亞については素手による絞殺と考えられます。ただし“悪魔の証明”により誤診率は否定できません。」

units.text: "If we can trust Nanjo's examination, the cause of Rosa's death was a stab to the medulla oblongata with the pointed gate of the fence. It is thought that Maria's death was due to strangling with bare hands. However, due to the "Devil's Proof", we cannot discount a misdiagnosis."
units.note: Both retain pointed gate of the fence rather than its pointed tip. The injury location and conditional medical report otherwise remain intact.

units.note: Both retain pointed gate of the fence rather than its pointed tip. The injury location and conditional medical report otherwise remain intact.

description: Battler’s refusal to speak to Beato is rendered as not wanting to listen to her, then repeated with the same shift.
sourceReading: He will not speak to her, rejecting engagement.

units.text: "Shut the hell up.  I don't want to listen to you. .........It was stated that there are no more than 18 people on this island, and now that eight people are already dead, there are 10 people to press as suspects.  One of them probably killed those two.
units.note: MG restores refusing to talk to Beato at both occurrences; UP retains not wanting to listen to her.
units.japanese: 「うるさい黙れ。お前とは口を聞かない。

units.text: "Shut the hell up. I don't want to listen to you. .........I've been told that there are no more than 18 people on this island, and now that eight people are already dead, the suspects are narrowed down to ten. One of them probably killed those two."
units.note: MG restores refusing to talk to Beato at both occurrences; UP retains not wanting to listen to her.
units.japanese:
「うるさい黙れ。お前とは口をきかない。………１８人しか島にいないと言い切られ、すでに８人が死んでいる以上、容疑者は１０人に絞られる。その中の誰かが殺したってんだろ」
「うるさい。お前とは口をきかないと言っている。目障りだから消えろ。バケモノめ」

units.text: "Shut up. Didn't I say that I didn't want to listen to you? You're an eyesore, so get lost. You monster."
units.note: MG restores refusing to talk to Beato at both occurrences; UP retains not wanting to listen to her.
units.japanese:
「うるさい黙れ。お前とは口をきかない。………１８人しか島にいないと言い切られ、すでに８人が死んでいる以上、容疑者は１０人に絞られる。その中の誰かが殺したってんだろ」
「うるさい。お前とは口をきかないと言っている。目障りだから消えろ。バケモノめ」

description: WH replaces the rejected justification that something can only be done by magic with whether it could or could not be done with magic.
sourceReading: The cruelty is not explained by her being a witch or by an act requiring magic.

units.text: "That's right.  They don't mean anything.  You're just fooling around by mangling the corpses for fun.  That has nothing to do with whether you're a witch, or whether it could or couldn't be done with magic.
units.note: Both retain whether it could or could not be done with magic instead of rejecting a justification based on magic being necessary.
units.japanese: 「そうさ。何の意味もない。お前はただ悪ふざけで死者を切り刻んで面白がっているだけだ。それは魔女だからとか、魔法じゃなきゃできないからとか、そういうのじゃない。

units.text: "That's right. They don't mean anything. You're just fooling around by mangling the corpses for fun. That has nothing to do with whether you're a witch, or whether it could or couldn't be done with magic."
units.note: Both retain whether it could or could not be done with magic instead of rejecting a justification based on magic being necessary.

units.text: "That's right. They don't mean anything. You're just fooling around by mangling the corpses for fun. That has nothing to do with whether you're a witch, or whether it could or couldn't be done with magic."
units.note: Both retain whether it could or could not be done with magic instead of rejecting a justification based on magic being necessary.
units.japanese: 「そうさ。何の意味もない。お前はただ悪ふざけで死者を切り刻んで面白がっているだけだ。それは魔女だからとか、魔法じゃなきゃできないからとか、そういうのじゃない」

description: WH makes you the subject of cannot understand, where Battler explains that he cannot understand Beato because she is cruel and heartless.
sourceReading: You are cruel and heartless, and therefore I cannot understand you; you are unpleasant as an opponent.

units.text: ......That's right, you have awful taste.  You're heartless and cruel, so you can't understand.  That's unpleasant in an opponent.  So I don't want to see your face again."
units.note: Both retain you cannot understand at row 221, despite the preceding explicit statement that Battler cannot understand her cruelty.
units.japanese: ……そうさ、お前は悪趣味だ。残酷で心がなく、だから理解することができない。相手として不快だ。だから俺はお前の顔を、二度と見たくない。」

units.text: "...That's right, you have awful taste. You're heartless and cruel, so you can't understand. That's unpleasant in an opponent. So I don't want to see your face again."
units.note: Both retain you cannot understand at row 221, despite the preceding explicit statement that Battler cannot understand her cruelty.
units.japanese: 「……そうさ、お前は悪趣味だ。残酷で心がなく、だから理解することができない。相手として不快だ。だから俺はお前の顔を、二度と見たくない」

units.text: "......That's right, you have awful taste. You're heartless and cruel, so you can't understand. That's unpleasant in an opponent. So I don't want to see your face again."
units.note: Both retain you cannot understand at row 221, despite the preceding explicit statement that Battler cannot understand her cruelty.
