description: WH connects the possibilities with and rather than maintaining separate tentative explanations.
sourceReading: Perhaps she could not understand what was being said, or perhaps the silence showed an earnest effort to understand.

units.text: As Battler went on and on by himself, Beato was shocked into silence for a long time. Maybe she couldn't understand what she was being told, and this was a sign that she was doing all she could in an effort to understand.
units.note: MG retains and between the alternative explanations for Beato’s silence; UP restores or maybe.
units.japanese: 何を言われているのか理解できなかったのかもしれないし、懸命に理解しようとする努力の表れだったのかもしれない。

units.text: As Battler went on and on by himself, Beato was shocked into silence for a long time. Maybe she couldn't understand what she was being told, and this was a sign that she was doing all she could in an effort to understand.
units.note: MG retains and between the alternative explanations for Beato’s silence; UP restores or maybe.
units.japanese: 一方的に戦人に捲くし立てられ、ベアトはしばらくの間、呆然としていた。何を言われているのか理解できなかったのかもしれないし、懸命に理解しようとする努力の表れだったのかもしれない。

description: WH replaces Battler’s deliberate current assumption with thinking he can withstand the premise.
sourceReading: He does not want to suspect Rosa but deliberately assumes her guilt now to defeat Beato.

units.text: "......I've already made my move.  If we suppose that Rosa oba-san is the culprit and died in an accident, I can deny the witch.  ......I don't want to suspect Rosa oba-san, but I think I can withstand that premise if it will beat the hell out of Beato."
units.note: MG retains bearing to accept a premise; UP restores the deliberate provisional assumption.
units.japanese: 「……俺の手はすでに指したぜ。楼座叔母さんが犯人で事故死と仮定すれば魔女は否定できる。……楼座叔母さんを疑いたくはないが、ベアトをぶっ潰すために、今は敢えてそうだと仮定する。」

units.text: "...I've already made my move. If we suppose that Aunt Rosa is the culprit and died in an accident, I can deny the witch. ...I don't want to suspect Aunt Rosa, but I think I can bear to accept that premise if it'll beat the hell out of Beato."
units.note: MG retains bearing to accept a premise; UP restores the deliberate provisional assumption.
units.japanese: 「……俺の手はすでに指したぜ。楼座叔母さんが犯人で事故死と仮定すれば魔女は否定できる。……楼座叔母さんを疑いたくはないが、ベアトをぶっ潰すために、今は敢えてそうだと仮定する」

description: WH changes a servant who should not be present into a servant who was supposed to be dead.
sourceReading: An unexpected appearance by a servant who should not be there would normally make Rosa highly wary.

units.text: "......I don't think Rosa-san is such a fool.  If a servant who was supposed to be dead popped up in front of you, any normal person'd be at their most cautious..."
units.note: Both restore a servant not supposed to be present, rather than supposed to be dead.
units.japanese: 「……楼座さんもアホちゃうと思うで。いるはずのない使用人がひょっこり姿を現したら、普通は警戒バリバリや…。」
candidates: servant who was supposed to be dead

description: Kyrie asks where everyone was around the inferred time Rosa and Maria went outside. WH instead asks about the inferred time they were attacked outside.
sourceReading: At around the time Rosa and Maria are thought to have gone outside, where was everyone?

units.text: "This is just for peace of mind, but... .........at the time we think Rosa-san was attacked outside, where was everyone...?"
units.note: MG asks about the inferred attack time; UP restores the time they went outside.
units.japanese: 「念の為なんだけど…。………楼座さんたちが外に出たと思われる頃。みんなはどこにいたのかしら…？」

units.text: "This is just for peace of mind, but... ...at the time we think Rosa-san was attacked outside, where was everyone...?"
units.note: MG asks about the inferred attack time; UP restores the time they went outside.
units.japanese: 「念の為なんだけど…。………楼座さんたちが外に出たと思われる頃。みんなはどこにいたのかしら…？」

description: WH shifts the possible uselessness of conducting a culprit search for their immediate needs to the speakers’ possible uselessness as investigators.
sourceReading: Perhaps searching for the culprit is of no use to us; survive until tomorrow and let police expose the culprit.

units.text: "That's right.  We may be useless as far as searching for the culprit is concerned.  ......We can only stay alive until tomorrow, inform the police, and follow their instructions.  Because the police will definitely expose who the culprit is."
units.note: Both make the investigators useless rather than the culprit search potentially unnecessary for their immediate survival.
units.japanese: 「そうね。…犯人探しなんて、私たちには無用かもしれないわ。

units.text: "That's right. We may be useless as far as searching for the culprit is concerned. ...We can only stay alive until tomorrow, inform the police, and follow their instructions. Because the police will definitely expose who the culprit is."
units.note: Both make the investigators useless rather than the culprit search potentially unnecessary for their immediate survival.
units.japanese: 「そうね。…犯人探しなんて、私たちには無用かもしれないわ。……ただ明日まで生き残り、警察に通報してその指示に従うだけ。犯人が誰かなんて、警察が必ず暴き出してくれるのだから」

units.text: "You're right. ...We may be useless as far as searching for the culprit is concerned. ......We can only stay alive until tomorrow, inform the police, and follow their instructions. Because the police will definitely expose who the culprit is."
units.note: Both make the investigators useless rather than the culprit search potentially unnecessary for their immediate survival.
units.japanese: 「そうね。…犯人探しなんて、私たちには無用かもしれないわ。……ただ明日まで生き残り、警察に通報してその指示に従うだけ。犯人が誰かなんて、警察が必ず暴き出してくれるのだから」

description: The source reasons from gold inherited only by the head to all of it embodying the head’s honor. WH uses that is because and reverses the explanatory relation.
sourceReading: Only the Ushiromiya head can inherit the gold; precisely for that reason, the whole of it represents the head’s honor.

units.text: "It would.  ...That gold is to be passed on only to the head of the Ushiromiya family.  That is because the whole of it is itself the honor of the head.
units.note: MG reverses the explanatory relation with that is because; UP restores that exclusive inheritance makes the gold embody the head’s honor.
units.japanese: 「あるわよ。…あれは右代宮家の当主だけが引き継げる黄金なの。だからこそそれは、全て丸ごと当主の栄誉そのものなの。

units.text: "It would. ...That gold is to be passed on only to the Head of the Ushiromiya family. That's because it, as a whole, represents no more or less than the honor of the Head."
units.note: MG reverses the explanatory relation with that is because; UP restores that exclusive inheritance makes the gold embody the head’s honor.
units.japanese: 「あるわよ。…あれは右代宮家の当主だけが引き継げる黄金なの。だからこそそれは、全て丸ごと当主の栄誉そのものなの」

description: WH uses hold up in one place for the survivors gathering and staying put.
sourceReading: They gather in one place and stop moving, effectively holing up.

units.text: "Hmm.  In the average situation, as the ceremony progresses and the victims increase, they begin to tighten their guard, and in most cases, they hold up in one place and stop moving.  That is extremely inconvenient for us."
units.note: Both restore hole up instead of hold up.
units.japanese: 「うむ。大抵の場合、儀式が進行するにつれ犠牲者が増えると、彼らは守りを固めるようになり、多くの場合、一所に固まって動かなくなるのだ。それは我らにとって非常に都合が悪い。」

description: WH changes the historical period when magic was believed in to when witches were believed in.
sourceReading: Long ago, when magic was believed in, this resistance was not a problem.

units.text: ......This wasn't a problem long ago, during the period that witches were believed in, but just like that annoyance Battler, people in the current era fundamentally deny magic.
units.note: Both retain belief in witches rather than belief in magic as the named historical condition.
units.japanese: ……大昔の、魔法が信じられていた時代は問題なかったのだが、現代人はあの小憎たらしい戦人がそうであるように、基本的に魔法を否定する。

units.text: ...This wasn't a problem long ago, when people believed in witches, but just like that annoyance Battler, people in the current era deny magic on a fundamental level."
units.note: Both retain belief in witches rather than belief in magic as the named historical condition.
units.japanese: 「……大昔の、魔法が信じられていた時代は問題なかったのだが、現代人はあの小憎たらしい戦人がそうであるように、基本的に魔法を否定する」

units.text: "......This wasn't a problem long ago, during the period when witches were believed in, but just like that annoyance Battler, people in the current era generally deny magic."
units.note: Both retain belief in witches rather than belief in magic as the named historical condition.
units.japanese: 「……大昔の、魔法が信じられていた時代は問題なかったのだが、現代人はあの小憎たらしい戦人がそうであるように、基本的に魔法を否定する」

description: WH changes 十数人 to a few dozen humans.
sourceReading: The population is only ten-odd people, in the teens.

units.text: In that sense, Rokkenjima, with its population of only a few dozen humans, was extremely favorable for witches. And even more favorable was the existence of the ghost story, about the witch who lived in the Rokkenjima forest. ...In other words, by permeating the island with the fear that a witch might exist, the magic-resisting toxin from the humans was weakened.
units.note: MG retains a few dozen; UP restores the roughly teen-sized population with ten to twenty.
units.japanese: その意味においては、魔女たちにとって人口が十数人程度しかいない六軒島は非常に好都合だった。

units.text: In that sense, Rokkenjima, with its population of only a few dozen humans, was extremely favorable for witches. And even more favorable was the existence of the ghost story about the witch who lived in the Rokkenjima forest. ...In other words, by permeating the island with the fear that a witch might exist, the magic-resisting toxin from the Humans was weakened.
units.note: MG retains a few dozen; UP restores the roughly teen-sized population with ten to twenty.
units.japanese: その意味においては、魔女たちにとって人口が十数人程度しかいない六軒島は非常に好都合だった。そしてそれ以上に好都合なのは、六軒島の森には魔女が住まうという怪談の存在。…つまり、魔女が存在するかもしれないという恐れがある程度浸透しており、ニンゲンたちの反魔法の毒素が弱まっていたことだ。

description: WH adds my to predecessor, moving the source of the test one generation back. The same line also replaces the hardship-seeking proverb with a maxim about useful future learning.
sourceReading: The test is from the predecessor, Beato herself, to her successor: young people should seek hardships even at a cost.

units.text: "Aah..., l, like they say, things you learn when you're young will definitely help you out in the future...!  This is a test passed on from my predecessor to you.  Challenge it with respect.  Wahahaha...!"
units.note: MG retains my predecessor and future-learning maxim. UP restores Beato as the predecessor giving the test, but seek out work still narrows the proverb about willingly seeking hardship.
units.japanese: 「あー…、そ、そのだな、若い内の苦労は買ってでもしろというではないか…！　先代からそなたへの、これは試練である。謹んで挑むが良いぞ。わっはっはっは…！」

units.text: "Aah, ...l-like they say, things you learn when you're young will definitely help you out in the future...! This is a test passed on from my predecessor to you. Take it on with respect. Wahahaha...!"
units.note: MG retains my predecessor and future-learning maxim. UP restores Beato as the predecessor giving the test, but seek out work still narrows the proverb about willingly seeking hardship.
units.japanese: 「あー…、そ、そのだな、若い内の苦労は買ってでもしろというではないか…！　先代からそなたへの、これは試練である。謹んで挑むが良いぞ。わっはっはっは…！」

units.text: "Aah... L‐like they say, you should seek out work while you're young...! This is a test from me to you as your predecessor. Challenge it with respect. Wahahaha...!"
units.note: MG retains my predecessor and future-learning maxim. UP restores Beato as the predecessor giving the test, but seek out work still narrows the proverb about willingly seeking hardship.
units.japanese: 「あー…、そ、そのだな、若い内の苦労は買ってでもしろというではないか…！　先代からそなたへの、これは試練である。謹んで挑むが良いぞ。わっはっはっは…！」

description: WH reduces the comparison to completely pointless and omits shouting donkey’s ears into a dug hole.
sourceReading: Her laugh without a listener is even more meaningless than shouting donkey’s ears into a hole.

units.text: She laughed loudly on the outside, but a laugh no one can hear is completely pointless. Beato gave up, and quickly stopped laughing. ...Ronove chose that time to show himself.
units.note: Both omit the comparison with shouting donkey’s ears into a dug hole, reducing it to completely pointless.
units.japanese: 高笑いを装うが、聞く者のない笑いなど、掘った穴にロバの耳を叫ぶより意味のないことだ。

units.text: She laughed loudly on the outside, but a laugh no one can hear is completely pointless. Beato gave up and quickly stopped laughing. ...Ronove chose that time to show himself.
units.note: Both omit the comparison with shouting donkey’s ears into a dug hole, reducing it to completely pointless.
units.japanese: 高笑いを装うが、聞く者のない笑いなど、掘った穴にロバの耳を叫ぶより意味のないことだ。ベアトは虚しくなり、すぐに笑うのを止める。…それを見計らった頃に、ロノウェが姿を現した。

units.text: She laughed loudly on the outside, but a laugh no one can hear is completely pointless. Beato started to feel empty, and quickly stopped laughing. ...Ronove chose that time to show himself.
units.note: Both omit the comparison with shouting donkey’s ears into a dug hole, reducing it to completely pointless.
units.japanese: 高笑いを装うが、聞く者のない笑いなど、掘った穴にロバの耳を叫ぶより意味のないことだ。ベアトは虚しくなり、すぐに笑うのを止める。…それを見計らった頃に、ロノウェが姿を現した。

description: WH says their hunger tormented them thanks to fatigue, replacing in addition to fatigue.
sourceReading: Besides fatigue, they were also suffering from hunger.

units.text: It was only natural that Natsuhi was yelling about it being reckless. ...Because Rudolf had said that he was going to the mansion to get food. Certainly, thanks to their fatigue, their hunger was tormenting them. In the beginning, they could fight their hunger just fine because of their drowsiness.  However, now it just made their minds hazy, since it was still only midday and their bodies felt like they were reaching their limits. The thought of going to the kitchen in the mansion and bringing back some food certainly was attractive.
units.note: Both restore hunger in addition to fatigue.
units.japanese: 確かに彼らは疲労に加え、空腹感にも苛まれていた。

description: WH reverses hunger and sleepiness in the initial beneficial relation, then renders despite still being midday as since it was midday.
sourceReading: At first moderate hunger was just right for fighting drowsiness; now it instead clouds consciousness and makes them feel at their physical limits although it is only noon.

units.text: It was only natural that Natsuhi was yelling about it being reckless. ...Because Rudolf had said that he was going to the mansion to get food. Certainly, thanks to their fatigue, their hunger was tormenting them. In the beginning, they could fight their hunger just fine because of their drowsiness.  However, now it just made their minds hazy, since it was still only midday and their bodies felt like they were reaching their limits. The thought of going to the kitchen in the mansion and bringing back some food certainly was attractive.
units.note: MG restores mild hunger helping fight sleepiness and despite midday. UP restores despite midday but still reverses the first relation by saying drowsiness fights hunger.
units.japanese: 初めの内こそ、ほどよい空腹感は眠気と戦えてちょうど良かったが、今は逆に意識を朦朧とさせ、まだ昼だと言うのに、もう体力の限界を感じさせている。

units.text:
It was only natural that Natsuhi was yelling about recklessness.
...Because Rudolf had said that he was going to the mansion to get food. Certainly, they were being tormented by hunger as well as their fatigue. In the beginning, they were just fine, because they could fight their moderate hunger with their drowsiness; but now it just made their minds hazy, and even though it was still only midday, their bodies felt like they were reaching their limits. The thought of going to the kitchen in the mansion and bringing back some food certainly was attractive.
units.note: MG restores mild hunger helping fight sleepiness and despite midday. UP restores despite midday but still reverses the first relation by saying drowsiness fights hunger.
units.japanese:
夏妃が無用心だと叫ぶのも無理はない。
…留弗夫が、屋敷に食料を取りに行くと言い出したからだ。確かに彼らは疲労に加え、空腹感にも苛まれていた。初めの内こそ、ほどよい空腹感は眠気と戦えてちょうど良かったが、今は逆に意識を朦朧とさせ、まだ昼だと言うのに、もう体力の限界を感じさせている。屋敷の厨房へ行き、何か食料を持ってこようという話は、確かに魅力的だった。

description: WH changes I had a gun but was alone to I was the only one holding a gun.
sourceReading: When Rudolf went outside to check Rosa and Maria, he had a gun but was on his own, yet was not attacked.

units.text: "...When I went out to check on Rosa and Maria-chan, I was the only one holding a gun.  But I wasn't attacked.  ......Maybe they'll be cautious if their opponent is a man."
units.note: Both restore Rudolf having a gun while going out alone.
units.japanese: 「…楼座たちの様子を確かめに出た時、銃を持っていたが俺はひとりだった。だが襲われなかった。……男が相手なら、向こうも慎重なのかもしれないぜ。」

description: WH turns the background of his training into a present fitness-for-task claim.
sourceReading: Despite appearances, his body was trained by pulling a food stall; he offers to handle heavy work.

units.text: "If you're countin' me as a man, I'd be pleased to help.  I don't look it, but my body's in pretty good shape for pushin' a cart.  Leave the heavy lifting to me!"
units.note: Both restore prior training through moving food stalls.
units.japanese: こう見えても、屋台を引いて鍛えた体や。力仕事は任せてな！」

description: WH makes dealing with hunger painful for everyone instead of describing Natsuhi’s distress at forcing them to remain hungry.
sourceReading: It pains her to impose hunger on everyone, but what could happen outside is uncertain.

units.text: "............Is there any way I can get you to rethink that?  It may be painful for everyone to deal with an empty stomach, ...but even so, we do not know what is happening outside now..."
units.note: Both retain hunger being painful for everyone rather than Natsuhi’s distress at imposing it.
units.japanese: 「…………何とか考え直せませんか。皆さんに空腹を強いるのは心苦しいですが、…ですがしかし、今の外は何が起こるかわかりません…。」

units.text: "......Is there any way I can get you to rethink this? It may be painful for everyone to deal with empty stomachs, ...but even so, we do not know what is happening outside now..."
units.note: Both retain hunger being painful for everyone rather than Natsuhi’s distress at imposing it.
units.japanese: 「…………何とか考え直せませんか。皆さんに空腹を強いるのは心苦しいですが、…ですがしかし、今の外は何が起こるかわかりません…」

units.text: "............Is there any way I can get you to reconsider? It may be painful for everyone to deal with an empty stomach, ...but even so, we do not know what could happen outside now..."
units.note: Both retain hunger being painful for everyone rather than Natsuhi’s distress at imposing it.
units.japanese: 「…………何とか考え直せませんか。皆さんに空腹を強いるのは心苦しいですが、…ですがしかし、今の外は何が起こるかわかりません…」

description: WH substitutes having their guard up for staying clustered together as they walk slowly.
sourceReading: If the opponent has a gun, walking slowly in a tight group is like asking to be used as a target.

units.text: ......If there was a chance that their opponent was equipped with a gun, then walking slowly with their guard up would only make them a target. It was probably correct to decide on swift action.
units.note: Both retain guard up instead of the group remaining clustered while walking slowly.
units.japanese: ……相手が銃で武装している可能性があるならば、固まってゆっくり歩くのは的にしてくれと言っているようなものだ。

units.text: ...If there was a chance that their opponent was equipped with a gun, then walking slowly with their guard up would only make them targets. Taking swift action was probably the correct choice.
units.note: Both retain guard up instead of the group remaining clustered while walking slowly.
units.japanese: ……相手が銃で武装している可能性があるならば、固まってゆっくり歩くのは的にしてくれと言っているようなものだ。迅速な行動はおそらく正しい判断だろう。

description: WH strengthens Kyrie’s teasing observation of slight enjoyment into a claim that the men are just playing around.
sourceReading: She complains about men and asks whether they are enjoying the situation a little.

units.text: "......Men.  You're just playing around in a situation like this, aren't you?"
units.note: MG retains just playing around; UP restores slightly enjoying the situation.
units.japanese: 「……男の人って嫌ぁね。この状況をちょっぴり楽しんでるでしょ。」

units.text: "...Ah, men. Even in a situation like this, you're just playing around, aren't you?"
units.note: MG retains just playing around; UP restores slightly enjoying the situation.
units.japanese: 「……男の人って嫌ぁね。この状況をちょっぴり楽しんでるでしょ」

description: WH replaces the condition that she lifts the barrier with a passive condition that it be broken.
sourceReading: No one can enter or leave unless she releases the barrier.

units.text: The instant she proclaimed that... The mansion was sealed off in a separate world. ......Unless her barrier were to be broken, no longer could anyone exit this mansion, or enter it.
units.note: MG retains passive undoing of the barrier; UP restores the successor as the agent who must dispel it.
units.japanese: ……もう、彼女が結界を解かない限り、誰も屋敷からは出られない、入れない。

units.text: The instant she proclaimed that... The mansion was sealed off into a separate world. ...Unless her barrier was undone, no longer would anyone be able to exit this mansion or enter it.
units.note: MG retains passive undoing of the barrier; UP restores the successor as the agent who must dispel it.
units.japanese: そう宣言した瞬間。屋敷は異空間に切り取られた。……もう、彼女が結界を解かない限り、誰も屋敷からは出られない、入れない。

description: WH changes What do you mean? to Yes, as you say.
sourceReading: Ronove asks her to explain the claim that the rules concern the final killing.

units.text: "Yes, as you say..."
units.note: Both restore Ronove asking what she means.
units.japanese: 「と、申しますと…。」

description: WH renders 甚振る as tease rather than torment or cruelly abuse, and repeats this softening in Leviathan’s offer.
sourceReading: The witch can torment and kill during the intervening process; Leviathan proposes torment within the predecessor’s order.

units.text: Her ranting was, for an Endless Witch, an extremely valid argument. The etiquette deciding the style of killing for the sacrifices of the fourth twilight and onward were represented by things like 'gouge the head'. However, that referred to the way they died in the end. In other words, ......in the process leading up to that, she was free to tease and kill them however she wanted. She just had to keep on reviving them, and follow the rules only when she killed them the final time.
units.note: Both retain tease for torment in the narrative statement; the same softening recurs in the offer at rows 223–224.
units.japanese: つまり、……それまでの過程でどう甚振り、どう殺そうとも、自由。

units.text: Her absurd argument was, for an Endless Witch, an extremely valid one. The etiquette that controlled the manner of killing the sacrifices of the fourth twilight and onward was represented by lines like "gouge the head". However, that referred to the way those people died in the end. In other words, ...in the process leading up to that, she was free to tease and kill them however she wanted. She just had to keep on reviving them...and follow the rules only when she killed them the final time.
units.note: Both retain tease for torment in the narrative statement; the same softening recurs in the offer at rows 223–224.
units.japanese:
彼女の暴論は、無限の魔女としては極めて正論。
第四の晩以降の生贄は、“頭を抉れ”に代表されるように殺し方の作法が決まっている。しかし、それは最終的な死に方を示したものだ。つまり、……それまでの過程でどう甚振り、どう殺そうとも、自由。何度でも蘇らし、最後の殺し方だけルールに従えばいいのだろうという話なのだ。

units.text:
Her wild logic was, for an Endless Witch, an extremely valid argument.
The sacrifices for the fourth twilight and onward had prescribed protocols for the method of killing, represented by things like "gouge the head". However, that referred to the way they died in the end. In other words, ......in the process leading up to that, she was free to tease and kill them however she wanted. She just had to keep on reviving them, and follow the rules only when she killed them the final time.
units.note: Both retain tease for torment in the narrative statement; the same softening recurs in the offer at rows 223–224.
units.japanese:
彼女の暴論は、無限の魔女としては極めて正論。
第四の晩以降の生贄は、“頭を抉れ”に代表されるように殺し方の作法が決まっている。しかし、それは最終的な死に方を示したものだ。つまり、……それまでの過程でどう甚振り、どう殺そうとも、自由。何度でも蘇らし、最後の殺し方だけルールに従えばいいのだろうという話なのだ。

description: WH changes provided you consider the degree to considering that level, implying approval of an already specified level.
sourceReading: Ronove thinks there will be no problem if she takes the extent into consideration.

units.text: "Yes.  Considering that level, I do not believe there will be a problem."
units.note: Both restore a qualified judgment conditional on limiting or considering the degree of cruelty.
units.japanese: 「はい。程度をお考え頂ければ問題ないかと思います。」

description: WH gives Hideyoshi a desire to show off his strength instead of identifying him as self-proclaimed strong.
sourceReading: Hideyoshi, who calls himself strong, replaces Kyrie as cart handler.

units.text: The two men were supposed to be devoted to guard duty, but the weight of the load was tough on Kyrie even with the cart. Hideyoshi, who wanted to show off his power, switched to be the cart-pusher, and Rudolf and his wife took up the task of guard duty.
units.note: MG retains the invented desire to show off strength; UP restores self-professed strength.
units.japanese: 力自慢を自称する秀吉が台車役を代わり、護衛役は留弗夫夫妻が勤めた。

units.text: The two men were supposed to be focused solely on guard duty, but the weight of the load was tough on Kyrie even with the cart. Hideyoshi, who wanted to show off his power, switched to be the cart-pusher, and Rudolf and his wife took up the task of guard duty.
units.note: MG retains the invented desire to show off strength; UP restores self-professed strength.
units.japanese: 男２人は護衛役に専念のはずだったが、この重さの荷物では台車であっても霧江には辛い。力自慢を自称する秀吉が台車役を代わり、護衛役は留弗夫夫妻が務めた。

description: WH turns the reminder that the outing lasts until one returns home into a claim that it will be a picnic until they get back.
sourceReading: The excursion is not over until we are back home; let’s go.

units.text: "With all this, even George and the kids will be full.  It'll be a picnic until we get back, let's go...!"
units.note: MG retains the picnic prediction; UP restores the warning that the outing is not over until home, adapted to the danger.
units.japanese: 帰るまでが遠足や、行くで…！」

units.text: "With all this, even George and the kids will be full. The trip back'll be a picnic, so let's go...!"
units.note: MG retains the picnic prediction; UP restores the warning that the outing is not over until home, adapted to the danger.
units.japanese: 「これだけあれば、譲治たちも満腹やろ。帰るまでが遠足や、行くで…！」

description: WH renders the prickling sensation of チリチリする as it is vague.
sourceReading: Kyrie feels a prickling or tingling unease and a bad premonition.

units.text: "...It's vague, .........but I have a bad feeling about this."
units.note: MG retains vague in place of the prickling sensation. UP restores sensing something but omits the prickling quality.
units.japanese: 「…チリチリするの。………嫌な予感がするわ。」

units.text: "...It's vague, ......but I've got a bad feeling gnawing at me."
units.note: MG retains vague in place of the prickling sensation. UP restores sensing something but omits the prickling quality.
units.japanese: 「…チリチリするの。………嫌な予感がするわ」

units.text: "...I sense something. .........I have a bad feeling about this."
units.note: MG retains vague in place of the prickling sensation. UP restores sensing something but omits the prickling quality.
units.japanese: 「…チリチリするの。………嫌な予感がするわ」

description: WH converts 真っ先に, marking Rudolf as first to notice, into right in front of them, locating the suspicious figure.
sourceReading: As soon as they enter the hall, Rudolf is the first to spot a suspicious figure and shout.

units.text: The instant they exited into the hall, Rudolf noticed a suspicious shadow right in front of them and yelled...
units.note: Both retain right in front of them in place of Rudolf being first to notice.
units.japanese: ホールに出た途端に、留弗夫が真っ先に不審な人影を認めて叫んだ…。

units.text: The instant they exited into the hall, Rudolf noticed a suspicious shadow right in front of them and yelled...
units.note: Both retain right in front of them in place of Rudolf being first to notice.
units.japanese: ホールに出た途端に、留弗夫が真っ先に不審な人影を認めて叫んだ…。

description: WH removes かもしれない from the narrator’s concession about guns being frightening to the sisters.
sourceReading: Guns may indeed be something they fear, but they need not fear if they avoid being hit.

units.text: Certainly, guns were frightening objects for them. ...But there was no need to fear as long as they weren't hit. They at least had enough speed to dodge those.
units.note: Both turn the qualified possibility that guns frighten them into certainty; UP also adds very.
units.japanese: 確かに銃は彼女らにとっても恐れるものかもしれない。

units.text: Certainly, guns were frightening objects for them. ...But there was no need to fear as long as they weren't hit. They at least had enough speed to dodge those.
units.note: Both turn the qualified possibility that guns frighten them into certainty; UP also adds very.
units.japanese:
確かに銃は彼女らにとっても恐れるものかもしれない。…しかし当たらなければ怯える必要はない。
彼女らにはそれをかわせるだけの素早さがあった。

units.text:
Certainly, guns were very frightening objects for them. ...But there was no need to fear as long as they weren't hit.
They at least had enough speed to dodge those.
units.note: Both turn the qualified possibility that guns frighten them into certainty; UP also adds very.
units.japanese:
確かに銃は彼女らにとっても恐れるものかもしれない。…しかし当たらなければ怯える必要はない。
彼女らにはそれをかわせるだけの素早さがあった。

description: WH prints when when in Kyrie’s statement about Asumu’s time.
sourceReading: Rudolf never failed to come to her aid, even when Asumu was around.

units.text: Because he's never failed to come and save me when I'm in trouble.  ......Not even when when Asumu-san was around, you see?  Heheh."
units.note: Both remove the duplicated when in the reference to Asumu’s time.
units.japanese: 私が困った時、彼が助けに来てくれなかったことはないんだから。……明日夢さんがいた頃であってもね？　ふふ。」

description: The source has Rudolf dodge the attacking blow, after which Belphegor again appears behind him. WH continues Belphegor as subject and says she dodged that shot.
sourceReading: When he evades that strike, she is behind Rudolf again; she repeatedly disappears into his blind spots.

units.text: She dashed, disappeared, and headed for Rudolf's back... ...Dodged that shot and again headed for Rudolf's back... ...And hid herself over and over, instantly moving into Rudolf's blind spot.
units.note: MG retains Belphegor dodging a shot; UP restores Rudolf dodging her attack before she gets behind him again.
units.japanese: その一撃をかわせば再び留弗夫の背後に。

units.text: She dashed, disappeared, and headed for Rudolf's back... ...She dodged that shot and again headed for Rudolf's back... ...And vanished over and over, instantly moving into Rudolf's blind spots.
units.note: MG retains Belphegor dodging a shot; UP restores Rudolf dodging her attack before she gets behind him again.
units.japanese: 飛び掛れば消えて留弗夫の背後に。その一撃をかわせば再び留弗夫の背後に。次々に姿を消しては留弗夫の死角に瞬間移動する。

description: WH changes the recollection of converting envy and gaining power into a present when-I-convert rule; it also renders power not losing to any sister as greater than every sister.
sourceReading: When she converted her inferiority-derived envy to power, she gained strength that would not lose to any of the sisters.

units.text: ......That inferiority complex became envy, and when I convert that into power, I gain a strength greater than that of any of the sisters."
units.note: MG retains present conversion and greater-than-all strength. UP restores past conversion but retains greater than rather than not inferior to any sister.
units.japanese: ……その劣等感が嫉妬となり、それを力として変換した時、私は姉妹の誰にも負けない力を得たのよ。」

units.text: "...That inferiority complex became envy, and when I convert that into power, I gain a strength greater than that of any of the sisters."
units.note: MG retains present conversion and greater-than-all strength. UP restores past conversion but retains greater than rather than not inferior to any sister.
units.japanese: 「……その劣等感が嫉妬となり、それを力として変換した時、私は姉妹の誰にも負けない力を得たのよ」

units.text: "......That inferiority complex became envy, and when I converted that into power, I gained a strength greater than that of any of the other sisters."
units.note: MG retains present conversion and greater-than-all strength. UP restores past conversion but retains greater than rather than not inferior to any sister.
units.japanese: 「……その劣等感が嫉妬となり、それを力として変換した時、私は姉妹の誰にも負けない力を得たのよ」

description: WH changes Kyrie’s capacity to put complete trust in her ally into the ally being completely trustworthy.
sourceReading: Leviathan envies Kyrie having one ally in whom she can place unreserved trust.

units.text: ......So since you have that single ally who is completely trustworthy, I feel the strongest envy...
units.note: MG retains an objectively trustworthy ally; UP restores Kyrie’s capacity to place full trust in the ally.
units.japanese: ……だから、そのひとりだけの味方がいて、全幅の信頼を寄せることができるあなたに、私は最上の嫉妬を感じるの…。

units.text: ...So when I see you with a single ally who's completely trustworthy, I feel the strongest envy..."
units.note: MG retains an objectively trustworthy ally; UP restores Kyrie’s capacity to place full trust in the ally.
units.japanese: 「……だから、そのひとりだけの味方がいて、全幅の信頼を寄せることができるあなたに、私は最上の嫉妬を感じるの…」

description: The witch tells the attacking furniture she has seen enough and suggests killing Rudolf. WH prints Why not kill you now?!, replacing the implied third-person victim with direct second person.
sourceReading: That is enough; why not kill him?

units.text: "Rudolf, what happened to all that vigor from a couple seconds ago?  You're supposed to slice up a fish while it's still jumping.  After it dies, it isn't interesting anymore.  That's enough.  Why not kill you now?!"
units.note: MG retains kill you; UP restores Rudolf as the third-person target.
units.japanese: もう充分よ。殺しちゃえばぁ？！」

units.text: "Rudolf, what happened to all that vigor from a couple seconds ago? You're supposed to slice up a fish while it's still flopping around. After it dies, it isn't interesting anymore. That's enough. Why not kill you now?!"
units.note: MG retains kill you; UP restores Rudolf as the third-person target.
units.japanese: 「留弗夫、先ほどまでの威勢はどこへぇ？　活造りは魚が跳ねてる内がいいわ。死んだら面白みも何もない。もう充分よ。殺しちゃえばぁ？！」

description: Rudolf calls himself underhanded for arranging the deceptive duel; WH calls him a coward.
sourceReading: Forgive me; I am an unfair or underhanded man.

units.text: "......Forgive me.  I'm a coward of a man."
units.note: Both retain coward instead of the self-description underhanded after the deceptive duel.
units.japanese: 「……許せ。俺は卑怯な男だ。」

units.text: "...Forgive me. I'm a coward of a man."
units.note: Both retain coward instead of the self-description underhanded after the deceptive duel.
units.japanese: 「……許せ。俺は卑怯な男だ」

units.text: "......Forgive me. I'm a coward of a man."
units.note: Both retain coward instead of the self-description underhanded after the deceptive duel.
units.japanese: 「……許せ。俺は卑怯な男だ」

description: WH prints as did as where as did is required.
sourceReading: Both lead pain and the pain of magic denial make her grimace.

units.text: The bullet had hit Belphegor right in the chest. ...The pain from the lead caused her to grimace, as did as the pain from the denial of magic...
units.note: MG removes the duplicated as; UP retains as did as.
units.japanese: …その鉛の痛みと、魔法を否定する痛みに、彼女は顔を歪める…。

description: WH substitutes pinning the rook and king for 王手飛車取り, a simultaneous king-check and rook threat.
sourceReading: She finally noticed the king-and-rook fork.

units.text: ......She realized that you were in the line of fire, Aneki.  So this honest girl took it without dodging, and guarded you.  In the very end, she noticed that I was pinning the rook and the king."
units.note: MG retains pinning king and rook; UP restores the fork.
units.japanese: ……射線上に姉貴がいることに気付いたのさ。だから律儀なこいつは、かわさずに受けて、姉貴を庇ったんだ。王手飛車取りに、最後に気付いたんだ。」

units.text: "...She realized that you were in the line of fire, Aneki. So this faithful girl took it without dodging, protecting you. At the very end, she saw that I was pinning the rook and the king."
units.note: MG retains pinning king and rook; UP restores the fork.
units.japanese: 「……射線上に姉貴がいることに気付いたのさ。だから律儀なこいつは、かわさずに受けて、姉貴を庇ったんだ。王手飛車取りに、最後に気付いたんだ」

description: WH changes her dislike of hand-me-down furniture to having always hated old things.
sourceReading: She used the predecessor’s furniture out of obligation; she dislikes hand-me-downs.

units.text: ".........Well, it's only natural that it'd be impossible for Predecessor-sama's worn out furniture.  ......There's no point unless I have new furniture, suitable for me.  I acted out of obligation, ......but I've hated old things from the very beginning."
units.note: Both restore second-hand or hand-me-down furniture rather than old things generally.
units.japanese: ……私には私に相応しい、新しい家具じゃないと駄目よ。私、義理で使ったけど。……元々、お古は嫌いなの。」

description: WH prints pointed a her instead of pointed at her.
sourceReading: Her raised hands resemble a conductor raising a baton rather than surrendering at gunpoint.

units.text: ...Then, the witch obediently raised her hands. But instead of raising her hands because a gun was being pointed a her, it looked more like she was a conductor facing an orchestra, waving her conductor's baton.
units.note: MG retains pointed a her; UP restores at her.
units.japanese: しかしそれは銃を突きつけられて両手を挙げるという仕草よりは、まるで指揮者がオーケストラボックスに向けて指揮棒を振り上げる時の仕草によく似ていた。

units.text: ...Then, the witch obediently raised her hands. But instead of raising her hands because a gun was being pointed a her, it looked more like she was a conductor facing an orchestra, waving her conductor's baton.
units.note: MG retains pointed a her; UP restores at her.
units.japanese: …すると魔女は素直に手を上げた。しかしそれは銃を突きつけられて両手を挙げるという仕草よりは、まるで指揮者がオーケストラボックスに向けて指揮棒を振り上げる時の仕草によく似ていた。

description: WH says the furniture gloomily bore the brunt of her dissatisfaction, rather than that she found the restraining furniture annoying and her own dissatisfaction peaked.
sourceReading: The predecessor’s furniture telling her to restrain herself was irritating, and her dissatisfaction reached its height.

units.text: ...It was unsatisfying. It was so boring, not being able to let her own power and her own cruelty run wild. ......And this furniture of the predecessor, who was telling her to act with prudence, gloomily bore the brunt of her dissatisfaction.
units.note: Both restore the witch’s irritation with the restraining furniture and her own discontent reaching a peak.
units.japanese: ……それを自重しろという先代の家具は鬱陶しく、彼女の不満は頂点だった。
candidates: gloomily bore the brunt of her dissatisfaction

description: WH renders 私語 as whispering instead of private or irrelevant chatter while on duty.
sourceReading: 410 must stop idle chatting or they will be reprimanded; execute the order promptly.

units.text: "F, 410, you mustn't whisper, you'll get in trouble...!  Let us carry out the great Lady Beatrice's order at once...!"
units.note: MG retains whispering; UP restores chat while on duty.
units.japanese: 「よ、４１０、私語は駄目です、怒られます…！　大ベアトリーチェ卿のご命令を迅速に遂行を…！」

units.text: "Y-You mustn't whisper, 410, you'll get in trouble...! Let us carry out the Great Lady Beatrice's order at once...!"
units.note: MG retains whispering; UP restores chat while on duty.
units.japanese: 「よ、４１０、私語は駄目です、怒られます…！　大ベアトリーチェ卿のご命令を迅速に遂行を…！」

description: WH uses Control Point Capture Completed for 制御点補正完了.
sourceReading: The firing curve is formed and its control points have been corrected or adjusted.

units.text: "410, Data Received.  Target Lock Acquired.  Terrain Calculation Error Correction.  Firing Curve Formation, Control Point Capture Completed.  Data Link to 45."
units.note: MG removes capture but substitutes supplemental calculations for correction of control points. UP restores adjusted control points.
units.japanese: 「４１０データ受領。標的を捕捉。地形誤差修正。射撃曲線形成、制御点補正完了。４５へデータリンク。」

units.text: "410, Data Received. Target Lock Acquired. Commencing Terrain Calculation Error Correction. Formulating Firing Curve, Supplemental Control Point Calculations Complete. Data Link to 45."
units.note: MG removes capture but substitutes supplemental calculations for correction of control points. UP restores adjusted control points.
units.japanese: 「４１０データ受領。標的を捕捉。地形誤差修正。射撃曲線形成、制御点補正完了。４５へデータリンク」

description: WH shifts trying the range of brutal killing methods she can think of to killing in as brutal a way as she can think of.
sourceReading: She intends repeated revival until bored and to try every brutal killing method that occurs to her.

units.text: Come on, bring their corpses here.  I'll keep reviving them until I'm bored, and try killing them in as brutal a way as I can think of.  Aaah, to think that being a witch could be so much fun, that taking a life could be so much fun, ahhahahahahahahahahahaha!"
units.note: MG retains a singular maximum-brutality method; UP restores trying multiple brutal ways.
units.japanese: さぁ、二人の死体をここへ。飽きるまで何度でも蘇らせて、思いつく限りの残虐な殺し方を試してやるの。あぁ、魔女がこんなにも楽しいなんてッ、命を奪うことがこんなにも楽しいなんてッ、あっははははははははははは！」

units.text: "Come on, bring their corpses here. I'll keep reviving them until I'm bored, and I'll try killing them in as brutal a way as I can think of. Aaah, to think being a witch could be so much fun, that taking a life could be so much fun, ahhahahahahahahahahahaha!"
units.note: MG retains a singular maximum-brutality method; UP restores trying multiple brutal ways.
units.japanese: 「さぁ、二人の死体をここへ。飽きるまで何度でも蘇らせて、思いつく限りの残虐な殺し方を試してやるの。あぁ、魔女がこんなにも楽しいなんてッ、命を奪うことがこんなにも楽しいなんてッ、あっははははははははははは！」

description: WH says at the tips where the source places both bodies pinned at the projectile’s singular tip.
sourceReading: The two bodies are pinned to its tip and dragged back.

units.text: As the witch rolled over laughing, the gold snake which had just been shot returned as though being pulled back. At the tips, two people were pinned and dragged along.
units.note: MG retains plural tips for the single returning projectile; UP restores the singular tip with both bodies attached.
units.japanese: その先端には、二人が縫い止められていて引き摺られていた。

units.text: As the witch rolled over laughing, the gold snake that had just been shot returned as though being reeled in. At the tips, two people were pinned and dragged along.
units.note: MG retains plural tips for the single returning projectile; UP restores the singular tip with both bodies attached.
units.japanese: 魔女が笑い転げている間に、先ほど放った黄金の蛇がずるずると手繰り寄せられるように戻ってくる。その先端には、二人が縫い止められていて引き摺られていた。

description: WH changes Beato explaining she received a protest into predicting that the opponent will object if someone goes too far.
sourceReading: She admits the restraint request follows a protest she received over excessive conduct.

units.text: "......D, damn that blabbermouth.  .........Well, to be perfectly honest, that's how it is.  If you go a little too far, umm, ...that person will object, you see?"
units.note: MG retains a future objection conditional; UP restores the already-received complaint.
units.japanese:
………まぁ、正直に言うとそういうわけだ。ちょっと目に余るとその、
…抗議を受けてな？」

units.text: "...D-Damn that blabbermouth. ......Well, to be perfectly honest, that's how it is. If you go a little too far...umm, ...that person will object, you see?"
units.note: MG retains a future objection conditional; UP restores the already-received complaint.
units.japanese: 「……あ、あのお喋りめ。………まぁ、正直に言うとそういうわけだ。ちょっと目に余るとその、…抗議を受けてな？」

description: WH turns a regardless-of-recognition assertion into a factual concession that nobody has accepted her.
sourceReading: Even without anyone recognizing her, she is already a fully fledged witch.

units.text: "Predecessor-sama, somehow or another, it seems that you can't become a witch as long as this person doesn't accept you, but I'm different.  Even though no one has accepted me, I am already an excellent witch.  .........Since you are my predecessor, I will formally pay you respect, but that is out of good will, not out of duty.
units.note: Both retain the factual concession that nobody has acknowledged the successor instead of irrespective of anyone’s recognition.
units.japanese: 「先代さまは、どうやらその何者かに認めてもらえないと魔女になれないようですが、私は違います。誰に認められずとも、もう立派な魔女です。………先代ということで、あなたに形式的な敬意は奉げますが、それは私の好意であって義務ではありません。

units.text: "Predecessor-sama, somehow or another, it seems that you can't become a witch as long as this person doesn't acknowledge you, but I'm different. Even though no one has acknowledged me, I'm an excellent witch already. ......Since you are my predecessor, I will formally pay you respect, but that's out of kindness, not out of duty."
units.note: Both retain the factual concession that nobody has acknowledged the successor instead of irrespective of anyone’s recognition.
units.japanese: 「先代さまは、どうやらその何者かに認めてもらえないと魔女になれないようですが、私は違います。誰に認められずとも、もう立派な魔女です。………先代ということで、あなたに形式的な敬意は奉げますが、それは私の好意であって義務ではありません」

units.text: "Predecessor‐sama, somehow or another, it seems that you can't become a witch as long as this person doesn't accept you, but I'm different. Even though no one has accepted me, I am already an excellent witch. .........Since you are my predecessor, I will formally pay you respect, but that is out of good will, not out of duty."
units.note: Both retain the factual concession that nobody has acknowledged the successor instead of irrespective of anyone’s recognition.
units.japanese: 「先代さまは、どうやらその何者かに認めてもらえないと魔女になれないようですが、私は違います。誰に認められずとも、もう立派な魔女です。………先代ということで、あなたに形式的な敬意は奉げますが、それは私の好意であって義務ではありません」

description: WH renders 決別 as distinction rather than separation or a definitive break.
sourceReading: Her outwardly mild words contain an unmistakable break with Beato.

units.text: At a glance, those words seemed obedient, but they contained within them a clear distinction. ...She was no longer under Beato's care for anything. So she was clearly saying nothing more than 'Don't get in the way of my fun'.
units.note: Both restore a clear parting of ways.
units.japanese: 言葉は一見大人しいが、それにははっきりとした決別が含まれている。

description: WH assigns the inability to see the pressure to the Siesta Sisters rather than describing an invisible force of theirs that Beato feels.
sourceReading: Beato feels across her whole body something invisible from the Siestas, describable as pressure.

units.text: Throughout her body, Beato felt something that couldn't be seen by the Siesta Sisters' eyes, which could only be described as an oppressive feeling. ......Most likely, they were initiating firing calculations. It was an action much like taking out a gun and cocking it.
units.note: MG restores an invisible force from the sisters. UP changes the faulty WH construction but relocates the invisible something into the sisters’ eyes; the Japanese describes the sisters’ unseen force, not an object in their eyes.
units.japanese: ベアトは全身に、シエスタの姉妹たちの目に見えぬ何か、形容するなら圧迫感を感じる。

units.text:
Throughout her body, Beato felt something invisible in the Chiester Sisters' eyes which could only be described as an oppressive feeling. ......Most likely, they were initiating firing calculations.
It was an action much like taking out a gun and cocking it.
units.note: MG restores an invisible force from the sisters. UP changes the faulty WH construction but relocates the invisible something into the sisters’ eyes; the Japanese describes the sisters’ unseen force, not an object in their eyes.
units.japanese:
ベアトは全身に、シエスタの姉妹たちの目に見えぬ何か、形容するなら圧迫感を感じる。……恐らく、射撃測量を開始しているのだ。
それは銃を抜き、撃鉄を起こす行為にかなり近い。

description: WH says it all went my way last time where Beato says it almost worked.
sourceReading: Last time it was beginning to succeed, so she thought only one more push was needed.

units.text: "......I thought that if I could show off a whirlwind of proof that I am a witch, blow away his feelings that made him deny me, and make him surrender, .........he would accept me as a witch.  ...It all went my way last time, so I thought I was just a breath away..."
units.note: Both retain it all went my way rather than the previous attempt almost succeeding.
units.japanese:
「……魔女である証拠を暴風のように見せつけ、妾を拒否する気持ちを吹き飛ばし屈服させれば、
………妾を魔女と認めると思った。…前回、うまく行き掛けたので、もう一息だと思ったのだ…。」

units.text: "...I thought that if I could show off a whirlwind of proof that I am a witch, blow away his desire to deny me, and make him surrender, ......he would acknowledge me as a witch. ...It all went my way last time, so I thought I was just a breath away..."
units.note: Both retain it all went my way rather than the previous attempt almost succeeding.
units.japanese: 「……魔女である証拠を暴風のように見せつけ、妾を拒否する気持ちを吹き飛ばし屈服させれば、………妾を魔女と認めると思った。…前回、うまく行き掛けたので、もう一息だと思ったのだ…」

units.text: "......I thought that if I could show off a whirlwind of proof that I am a witch, blow away his feelings that made him deny me, and break him completely, .........he would accept me as a witch. ...It all went my way last time, so I thought I was just a breath away..."
units.note: Both retain it all went my way rather than the previous attempt almost succeeding.
units.japanese: 「……魔女である証拠を暴風のように見せつけ、妾を拒否する気持ちを吹き飛ばし屈服させれば、………妾を魔女と認めると思った。…前回、うまく行き掛けたので、もう一息だと思ったのだ…」

description: WH changes Beato leaving the game-board-piece role and entrusting it to the new witch into surrendering her pieces on the board.
sourceReading: She has already stepped down as a piece on the board and left the role to her successor.

units.text: "Think about it yourself.  ......Fortunately, you have already given up your pieces on the game board to the new witch.  You should have time to deliberately ponder upon yourself."
units.note: MG retains giving up her pieces; UP restores Beato relinquishing her own role as a piece and entrusting affairs to the successor.
units.japanese: 「あなたが自分で考えるのです。……幸いにも、あなたはもうゲーム盤の駒を降りて、新しき魔女に委ねました。じっくりと自らについて思案する時間があるでしょう。」

units.text: "Think about it for yourself. ...Fortunately, you have already given up your pieces on the game board to the new witch. You should have plenty of time to reflect upon your own self."
units.note: MG retains giving up her pieces; UP restores Beato relinquishing her own role as a piece and entrusting affairs to the successor.
units.japanese: 「あなたが自分で考えるのです。……幸いにも、あなたはもうゲーム盤の駒を降りて、新しき魔女に委ねました。じっくりと自らについて思案する時間があるでしょう」

description: WH turns he rejects witches and rejects me into he rejects witches so rejects me.
sourceReading: Battler refuses to accept a witch and also refuses Beato herself.

units.text: "............Isn't Battler's soul already hostile towards me?  He won't accept witches, so he won't accept me.  ......In that case, what can I do so that Battler will accept me...?  Are you saying that if the north wind doesn't work, ...then I should shine on him as the sun from now on...?  I should, after all this time......?"
units.note: MG retains causal so; UP restores the parallel rejections.
units.japanese: 「…………戦人はもう敵意の塊じゃねぇかよぅ。魔女は認めない、そして妾も認めない。……それで、どうやって戦人に認めてもらうんだよゥ…。北風で駄目なら、…今からのこのこ太陽で照らせって言うのか…？　この妾が、今更……。」

units.text: "......But Battler's already a mass of hostility to me. He won't accept witches, so he won't accept me. ...In that case, what can I do to make him accept me...? Are you saying that if the north wind doesn't work, ...then I should shine on him as the sun from now on...? Me, after all this time...?"
units.note: MG retains causal so; UP restores the parallel rejections.
units.japanese: 「…………戦人はもう敵意の塊じゃねぇかよぅ。魔女は認めない、そして妾も認めない。……それで、どうやって戦人に認めてもらうんだよゥ…。北風で駄目なら、…今からのこのこ太陽で照らせって言うのか…？　この妾が、今更……」

description: WH describes the revived sun failing to reach far through the wind instead of being far inferior to it.
sourceReading: The newly revived weak sun will be far outmatched by winter’s cold wind.

units.text: "It is October now.  The Halloween season.  .........It is the month of rebirth, when the sun dies and is revived again.  When the sun is weak right after reviving, it may not reach far through the cold winter winds.
units.note: MG retains reaching through winter winds; UP restores inferiority to them.
units.japanese: 「今は１０月。ハロウィンの季節ですね。………太陽が死に、再び蘇る再生の月です。蘇ったばかりの弱々しい太陽は冬の木枯らしに遠く及ばないでしょう。

units.text: "It's October now. The Halloween season. ......It's the month of rebirth, when the sun dies and is revived again. When the sun is weak right after reviving, it may not reach far through the cold winter winds."
units.note: MG retains reaching through winter winds; UP restores inferiority to them.
units.japanese: 「今は１０月。ハロウィンの季節ですね。………太陽が死に、再び蘇る再生の月です。蘇ったばかりの弱々しい太陽は冬の木枯らしに遠く及ばないでしょう」

description: WH uses the unidiomatic noun phrase the youth me for the speaker’s girlhood self.
sourceReading: She is the girlhood version of Eva who lived within his wife’s heart.

units.text: "That's right.  I am the youth me, who was always living in the heart of your wife, Ushiromiya Eva.  ...And I'm a witch.  .........Eva became an adult by forgetting me.  So she can't use magic."
units.note: Both remove the malformed youth me noun phrase.
units.japanese: 「そうよ。あなたの妻の右代宮絵羽の胸の中にずっと住んでいた、少女時代の私。…そして魔女なの。

description: WH turns the claim that a kitchen witch is the most she amounts to into the most he can handle. It also turns quick improvisation into every once in a while.
sourceReading: At most she is a kitchen witch, whipping up thoughtful appetizers from refrigerator leftovers.

units.text: You're my wife, Ushiromiya Eva!  A witch of the kitchen, who can considerately make snacks out of leftovers in the refrigerator every once in a while, is as much as I can handle!!  Won't you open your eyes, you fool...?!!"
units.note: MG restores quick preparation and Eva’s kitchen role but softens the source’s ceiling on her witch identity to if anything. UP explicitly restores that this is the only witch she is, with whipping up snacks conveying quick improvisation.
units.japanese: 冷蔵庫の残り物でチョイチョイと、気の利いたつまみを作れる台所の魔女が関の山や！！　目を覚まさんかい、このアホンダラが…ッ！！」

units.text: You're my wife, Ushiromiya Eva! If anything, you're witch of the kitchen, who can always make the perfect snacks out of refrigerator leftovers in a flash!! Won't you open your eyes, you fool...?!!"
units.note: MG restores quick preparation and Eva’s kitchen role but softens the source’s ceiling on her witch identity to if anything. UP explicitly restores that this is the only witch she is, with whipping up snacks conveying quick improvisation.
units.japanese: 「お前はわしの女房の右代宮絵羽や！　冷蔵庫の残り物でチョイチョイと、気の利いたつまみを作れる台所の魔女が関の山や！！　目を覚まさんかい、このアホンダラが…ッ！！」

description: WH adds in the corner to the dropped gun’s location.
sourceReading: The gun had fallen beside Rudolf’s corpse and now floated with smoke trailing from its muzzle.

units.text: ......The gun, which had fallen in the corner near Rudolf's corpse, floated into the air, ...and smoke lingered near the barrel.
units.note: Both retain the added corner location; the Japanese locates the fallen gun beside Rudolf’s body without a corner.
units.japanese: ……留弗夫の遺体の脇に落ちていた銃が宙に浮いていて、…その銃口から紫煙をたなびかせている。

units.text: ...The gun, which had fallen in the corner near Rudolf's corpse, was floating in the air, ...and smoke lingered near the barrel.
units.note: Both retain the added corner location; the Japanese locates the fallen gun beside Rudolf’s body without a corner.
units.japanese: ……留弗夫の遺体の脇に落ちていた銃が宙に浮いていて、…その銃口から紫煙をたなびかせている。

units.text: ......The gun, which had fallen in the corner near Rudolf's body, was floating in the air, ...and smoke lingered near the barrel.
units.note: Both retain the added corner location; the Japanese locates the fallen gun beside Rudolf’s body without a corner.
units.japanese: ……留弗夫の遺体の脇に落ちていた銃が宙に浮いていて、…その銃口から紫煙をたなびかせている。

description: Ronove instructs Lucifer to select three; WH instead tells her to carry the three, replacing selection with transport.
sourceReading: ３人を選び explicitly assigns selection before processing according to the ceremony. The nearby discussion concerns the remaining Sisters and three corpses.

units.text: "......It is Beatrice-sama's order.  Lucifer, carry the three, and deal with them according to the etiquette of the ceremony.  Then, when you are done, lend me a hand with the cleanup."
units.note: Both retain carry three instead of select three for the ritual assignment.
units.japanese: 「……ベアトリーチェさまのご命令ですよ。ルシファーは３人を選び、儀式の作法に従い処理をするように。あと、できましたら私のお片付けにも手を貸してください。」

units.text: "...This is an order from Beatrice-sama. Lucifer, carry these three and dispose of them in accordance with the etiquette of the ceremony. Then, when you are done, lend me a hand with the cleanup."
units.note: Both retain carry three instead of select three for the ritual assignment.
units.japanese: 「……ベアトリーチェさまのご命令ですよ。ルシファーは３人を選び、儀式の作法に従い処理をするように。あと、できましたら私のお片付けにも手を貸してください」

units.text: "......It is Beatrice‐sama's order. Lucifer, carry the three, and deal with them according to the protocol of the ritual. Then, when you are done, lend me a hand with the cleanup."
units.note: Both retain carry three instead of select three for the ritual assignment.

description: WH describes Krauss and Natsuhi reaching the limits of patience rather than anxiety.
sourceReading: 焦燥 is their mounting anxious agitation over the overdue party.

units.text: ...30 minutes had already passed since Rudolf's group had left the guesthouse. By any measure, their return was too late. ...And Krauss and Natsuhi, who were waiting by the entrance, were reaching the limits of their patience.
units.note: MG retains limits of patience; UP restores restlessness from anxiety.
units.japanese: …玄関で待ち続ける蔵臼と夏妃の焦燥も限界に来ていた。

units.text: ...30 minutes had already passed since Rudolf's group had left the guesthouse. By any measure, their return was too late. ...And Krauss and Natsuhi, who waited by the entrance, were reaching the limits of their patience.
units.note: MG retains limits of patience; UP restores restlessness from anxiety.
units.japanese:
…留弗夫たちがゲストハウスを出てから、すでに３０分は経過していた。いくらなんでも、戻りが遅すぎる。
…玄関で待ち続ける蔵臼と夏妃の焦燥も限界に来ていた。

description: Eva asks why the others let him outside; WH asks why he went outside.
sourceReading: どうして表になんか出したのよ directs responsibility toward those who allowed or sent him out.

units.text: "Why did he have to go to the mansion?!!  Why did he go outside, even though it's safe here?!!  Why did he go back to the mansion?!!"
units.note: MG retains why he went; UP restores why they let him outside.
units.japanese: 「どうして屋敷に行かなくちゃいけないのよ！！　ここなら安全なのに、どうして表になんか出したのよ！！　どうして屋敷なんかに戻ったのよッ！！」

units.text: "Why did he have to go to the mansion?!! Why did he go outside, even though it's safe here?!! Why did he go back to the mansion?!!"
units.note: MG retains why he went; UP restores why they let him outside.
units.japanese: 「どうして屋敷に行かなくちゃいけないのよ！！　ここなら安全なのに、どうして表になんか出したのよ！！　どうして屋敷なんかに戻ったのよッ！！」

description: Krauss explains that Hideyoshi invoked Eva’s condition as a reason to fetch food; WH ends with he told us so.
sourceReading: その為にもと言って connects his decision to go with caring for her illness.

units.text: "..................They went to get enough food to last until tomorrow.  ...Hideyoshi-san was worried about your health, and he told us so..."
units.note: MG restores Eva’s health as partly why Hideyoshi went; UP retains he told us so.
units.japanese: 「………………。……明日までの食料を取りに行くことになったのだ。…秀吉さんは、お前の体調が悪いことを気にしてて、その為にもと言って…。」

units.text: ".................. ......They went to get enough food to last until tomorrow. ...Hideyoshi‐san was worried about your health, and he told us so..."
units.note: MG restores Eva’s health as partly why Hideyoshi went; UP retains he told us so.
units.japanese: 「………………。……明日までの食料を取りに行くことになったのだ。…秀吉さんは、お前の体調が悪いことを気にしてて、その為にもと言って…」

description: Nanjo warns of the possibility of secondary casualties in a rescue attempt. WH suggests that this is a second disaster.
sourceReading: 二次遭難 warns that those going to aid the missing party may themselves meet disaster.

units.text: "......R, Rosa-san was attacked not long ago.  ...There's a possibility that this is a second disaster.  We should act with caution here and..."
units.note: Both treat the secondary disaster as something that may already have happened instead of danger to the rescuers.
units.japanese: 「……ろ、楼座さんが襲われてすぐですぞ。…二次遭難の可能性もあります。ここはひとつ慎重に…、」

units.text: "...Th-This happened right after Rosa-san was attacked. ...This may have been a secondary disaster connected to that. We should act with caution here and..."
units.note: Both treat the secondary disaster as something that may already have happened instead of danger to the rescuers.
units.japanese: 「……ろ、楼座さんが襲われてすぐですぞ。…二次遭難の可能性もあります。ここはひとつ慎重に…、」

units.text: "......R‐Rosa‐san was attacked not long ago. ...There's a possibility that this is a second disaster. We should act with caution here and—"
units.note: Both treat the secondary disaster as something that may already have happened instead of danger to the rescuers.
units.japanese: 「……ろ、楼座さんが襲われてすぐですぞ。…二次遭難の可能性もあります。ここはひとつ慎重に…、」

description: WH replaces Battler seeing little difference between the killings with the explanation doing more harm than good.
sourceReading: 五十歩百歩 means the difference is insignificant: death remains death to Battler, as the next line explains.

units.text: And wanting to have Beato's small bit of thoughtfulness appreciated, he thought of telling Battler about that. ...But in Battler's eyes, that might do more harm than good. To humans, the gap between being alive and being dead is very large.
units.note: Both retain doing more harm than good instead of the negligible moral difference for Battler between the two killings.
units.japanese: …しかし、そんなのは戦人にとっては五十歩百歩でしかないだろう。

units.text: ...But in Battler's eyes, that might do more harm than good. To humans, the gap between being alive and being dead is very large. While saying that she had changed it to a better way of dying, and that he wanted Battler to understand Beato's feelings, might have made it possible for a demon to pardon her, ......there was no way it would work the same way for a human.
units.note: Both retain doing more harm than good instead of the negligible moral difference for Battler between the two killings.
units.japanese: …しかし、そんなのは戦人にとっては五十歩百歩でしかないだろう。

units.text: Wanting to have Beato's small bit of thoughtfulness appreciated, he thought of telling Battler about this. ...But judging by Battler's eyes, that might do more harm than good.
units.note: Both retain doing more harm than good instead of the negligible moral difference for Battler between the two killings.
units.japanese: そのベアトのささやかな気遣いを評価してもらいたくて、戦人にそれを伝えようかとも思った。…しかし、そんなのは戦人にとっては五十歩百歩でしかないだろう。

units.text: Wanting to have Beato's small bit of thoughtfulness appreciated, he thought of telling Battler about that. ...But, for Battler, that might do more harm than good.
units.note: Both retain doing more harm than good instead of the negligible moral difference for Battler between the two killings.
units.japanese: そのベアトのささやかな気遣いを評価してもらいたくて、戦人にそれを伝えようかとも思った。…しかし、そんなのは戦人にとっては五十歩百歩でしかないだろう。

description: Ronove resigns his qualification as Beato’s representative. WH instead says someone speaking in her place must relinquish his turn.
sourceReading: 私めの…代行者である資格を…返上 is his present voluntary surrender of representative status, explaining his inability to repeat in red.

units.text: "My apologies.  Someone speaking in Milady's place such as myself must relinquish his turn at this point.  ...Accordingly, 'I' cannot repeat that in red.  ......The only one qualified to repeat that, ...is Milady."
units.note: Both restore Ronove relinquishing his own position or qualification as representative.
units.japanese: 「申し訳ございません。私めの、お嬢様の代行者である資格を、これを以って返上させていただきます。…よって、“私には”、それを赤で復唱することができません。……それを復唱する資格があるのは、…お嬢様ただ一人だけでございます。」

description: WH makes nonacceptance the cause of continuing the game, where Battler states continuing as the means or purpose of denying recognition.
sourceReading: それを認めないために…降りない explicitly gives the purpose of remaining in the game.

units.text: "............Sorry, but that's advice I can't listen to.  ......I definitely won't accept that unpleasant, cruel bastard as my opponent.  ...I won't give up in this game because I don't accept her."
units.note: Both retain refusal as the reason to continue instead of continuation as the means to deny recognition.
units.japanese: 「…………悪ぃが。そいつは聞けねぇ相談だぜ。……あの不愉快な残酷野郎を、俺は絶対に対局者だなどと認めない。…それを認めないために、俺はこのゲームを降りないんだ。」

units.text: "......Sorry, but that's advice I can't listen to. ...I definitely won't accept that unpleasant, cruel bastard as my opponent. ...My refusal to accept her is why I can't step down from this game."
units.note: Both retain refusal as the reason to continue instead of continuation as the means to deny recognition.
units.japanese: 「…………悪ぃが。そいつは聞けねぇ相談だぜ。……あの不愉快な残酷野郎を、俺は絶対に対局者だなどと認めない。…それを認めないために、俺はこのゲームを降りないんだ」

units.text: "............Sorry, but that's not happening. ......I definitely won't accept that unpleasant, ruthless bitch as my opponent. ...Refusing to accept that is the reason I won't abandon this game."
units.note: Both retain refusal as the reason to continue instead of continuation as the means to deny recognition.
units.japanese: 「…………悪ぃが。そいつは聞けねぇ相談だぜ。……あの不愉快な残酷野郎を、俺は絶対に対局者だなどと認めない。…それを認めないために、俺はこのゲームを降りないんだ」

description: Ronove promises to make Milady pledge against repeating offensive speech or behavior; WH has Ronove himself pledge that she will not take unpleasant actions.
sourceReading: お嬢様には…誓約させます assigns the required commitment to Milady, with Ronove undertaking to obtain it; 言動 covers words and conduct.

units.text: "Regarding your point about her being unpleasant, I apologize in Milady's stead.  Allow me to pledge that Milady will not take unpleasant actions again."
units.note: MG retains Ronove himself pledging. UP restores obtaining Milady’s pledge, but actions still omits the source’s explicit speech-and-behavior scope.
units.japanese: 「不愉快な点につきましてはお嬢様に代わりまして謝罪します。また、お嬢様には二度と不愉快な言動を取らぬよう誓約させます。」

units.text: "As to her being unpleasant, I apologize in Milady's stead. Allow me to pledge that Milady will not undertake such unpleasant actions again."
units.note: MG retains Ronove himself pledging. UP restores obtaining Milady’s pledge, but actions still omits the source’s explicit speech-and-behavior scope.
units.japanese: 「不愉快な点につきましてはお嬢様に代わりまして謝罪します。また、お嬢様には二度と不愉快な言動を取らぬよう誓約させます」

units.text: "Regarding your point about Milady being unpleasant, I apologize in her stead. I shall obtain Milady's pledge that she will not take unpleasant actions again."
units.note: MG retains Ronove himself pledging. UP restores obtaining Milady’s pledge, but actions still omits the source’s explicit speech-and-behavior scope.
units.japanese: 「不愉快な点につきましてはお嬢様に代わりまして謝罪します。また、お嬢様には二度と不愉快な言動を取らぬよう誓約させます」
candidates: pledge that she will not take unpleasant actions

description: Virgilia promises to admonish Beato properly. WH states that Beato has listened well, asserting completed compliance.
sourceReading: よく言って聞かせますので means the teacher will firmly explain or admonish her, in support of requesting forgiveness.

units.text: "...Battler-kun.  I also apologize as that child's teacher.  She has listened well, so would you please forgive her just this once?"
units.note: Both restore the prospective promise to admonish her.
units.japanese: 「…戦人くん。…あの子の師匠として私も謝罪します。よく言って聞かせますので、どうか一度だけ許してやってはくれませんか。」

description: WH turns George having lost not only parents he would eventually part from into George not eventually parting from his parents.
sourceReading: いつか別れる親だけじゃない contrasts loss of parents with the additional loss of Shannon, the intended lifelong partner.

units.text: .........But it's different for you, Aniki.  You wouldn't have split up with your parents someday.  .........You should have lived your whole lives together, .........and you've even lost Shannon-chan too, right...?!!"
units.note: Both restore the contrast between losing a parent one would eventually part from and losing the partner intended for a shared future.
units.japanese: ………だが兄貴は違うぜ。いつか別れる親だけじゃない。………これからの人生をずっと一緒に生きていくはずの、…………紗音ちゃんまで失ったんじゃないかよ…！！」

description: WH describes the future you have built together where the source describes the future still to be built together.
sourceReading: 一緒に築いてく未来 refers to the length of shared future ahead, following それからの人生.

units.text: "It's not like human lives have different weights.  Whether it's a baby or an old person, they should all be respected the same...!  ......But still, the longer the life of a person afterwards, ...the longer the future you've built together, ............the sadder the fact of death is......!!
units.note: MG changes completed building to a future being built; UP restores the counterfactual future they would have built. The following promise further anchors both in the unrealized future.
units.japanese: 「人の命に重さなんかねぇさ。赤ん坊の命だって年寄りの命だって、同じくらいに尊いだろうよ…！　……だがよ、それからの人生が長ければ長いほど。…一緒に築いてく未来が長ければ長いほど、…………その死ってのは悲しいものなんじゃねぇのかよ……！！

description: George’s dreams exceeding a hundred-year life become dreams exceeding a thousand lifetimes, vastly enlarging the hyperbole.
sourceReading: 百年の人生 is one hundred years of life, imagined as insufficient for all their dreams.

units.text: "......There's no way I wouldn't, .........be sad, right...?  .........Together with Shannon, I painted a picture of many futures in my mind.  We talked of dreams that couldn't all come true even in a thousand lifetimes.  ......Of those dreams, even the very first one, ............having her move into my family register, could not be granted, .........so there's no way I wouldn't, ............be sad, right.........?"
units.note: Both restore a hundred-year life instead of a thousand lifetimes.
units.japanese: ………ないじゃないか…。………僕は紗音と一緒に、たくさんの未来を思い描き合ったさ。きっと百年の人生では叶え切れないくらいの夢を語り合ったさ。……その夢の、

description: WH omits within that range from Battler’s narrowly qualified understanding of murders undertaken for the epitaph.
sourceReading: その範囲内で limits the murders he can barely understand to the necessity just stated, before distinguishing gratuitous acts.

units.text: ......So judging by the circumstances of your position, ......I can just barely understand your murders.  ......Because to you, that is a necessary action.  ......In that case, all further unnecessary actions are because of your meaningless brutal hobby.
units.note: Both omit the explicit within-that-range qualification, although necessary acts versus excess is elaborated immediately afterwards.
units.japanese: ……だから、その範囲内でのお前の殺人は、……お前の立場の事情を汲み取る限り、ぎりぎりの理解は出来る。……それがお前にとっては必要な行為だからだ。……なら、それ以上の不要な行為は全て、お前の無意味な残酷趣味ということになる。

units.text: "...So, considering your circumstances, ...I can just barely bring myself to understand your murders. ...Because to you, it's a necessary course of action. ...But that means all unnecessary actions you take beyond that...are due to your meaningless and brutal tastes."
units.note: Both omit the explicit within-that-range qualification, although necessary acts versus excess is elaborated immediately afterwards.
units.japanese: 「……だから、その範囲内でのお前の殺人は、……お前の立場の事情を汲み取る限り、ぎりぎりの理解は出来る。……それがお前にとっては必要な行為だからだ。……なら、それ以上の不要な行為は全て、お前の無意味な残酷趣味ということになる」

units.text: "......So if I keep the circumstances of your position in mind, ......I can just barely understand your murders. ......Because for you, that is a necessary action. ......In that case, all further unnecessary actions are your own meaningless cruel hobby."
units.note: Both omit the explicit within-that-range qualification, although necessary acts versus excess is elaborated immediately afterwards.
units.japanese: 「……だから、その範囲内でのお前の殺人は、……お前の立場の事情を汲み取る限り、ぎりぎりの理解は出来る。……それがお前にとっては必要な行為だからだ。……なら、それ以上の不要な行為は全て、お前の無意味な残酷趣味ということになる」

description: WH says Virgilia wanted to tell Beato for a long time, rather than believing she had been conveying the warning all along.
sourceReading: ずっと伝えてきたつもりだった gives the teacher’s retrospective belief about her sustained instruction.

units.text: Virgilia had wanted to tell Beato that for a long time. But Beato had been too young to obediently listen to those words.  She had been too wild. ...She had been possessed by that detestable pleasure.
units.note: MG restores sustained attempts to tell her rather than merely wanting to; UP asserts repeated completed telling. Neither restores the narrator’s qualification that Virgilia believed she had been conveying this all along.
units.japanese: ワルギリアはそれをベアトにずっと伝えてきたつもりだった。

units.text: It was something Virgilia had been trying to tell Beato for a long time. But Beato had been too young to obediently listen to those words. She had been too wild. ...She had been possessed by that detestable pleasure.
units.note: MG restores sustained attempts to tell her rather than merely wanting to; UP asserts repeated completed telling. Neither restores the narrator’s qualification that Virgilia believed she had been conveying this all along.
units.japanese: ワルギリアはそれをベアトにずっと伝えてきたつもりだった。しかし、それに大人しく耳を傾けるには、ベアトは若すぎた。奔放すぎた。…その、忌むべき快楽に取り付かれてしまった。
candidates: tell Beato for a long time

units.text: Virgilia had told Beato that countless times before. But Beato had been too young to obediently listen to those words. She had been too wild. ...She had been possessed by that...detestable pleasure.
units.note: MG restores sustained attempts to tell her rather than merely wanting to; UP asserts repeated completed telling. Neither restores the narrator’s qualification that Virgilia believed she had been conveying this all along.
units.japanese: ワルギリアはそれをベアトにずっと伝えてきたつもりだった。しかし、それに大人しく耳を傾けるには、ベアトは若すぎた。奔放すぎた。…その、忌むべき快楽に取り付かれてしまった。

description: WH substitutes no matter how badly she broke it for repeated destruction and restoration as often as desired.
sourceReading: いくら壊しても好きなだけ元に直せる emphasizes unlimited repetition of breaking and restoring, central to the preceding life-and-death analogy.

units.text: .........Then I gained the Endless Magic.  ...When I knew that I could fix it back to normal no matter how badly I broke it, ......I was surprised at how fun it was to break a vase..."
units.note: MG retains extent of damage rather than repeated breaking. UP’s how much is compatible with quantity but does not clearly restore as often as desired, while restoration itself remains explicit.
units.japanese: ………そして無限の魔法を得て。…いくら壊しても好きなだけ元に直せると知った時。……妾は壷を壊すことがこれほどまでに楽しかったのかと驚いたものだ…。」

units.text: ......Then I gained the Endless Magic. ...When I knew that I could fix them back to normal no matter how badly I broke them, ...I was surprised at how fun it could be to break a vase..."
units.note: MG retains extent of damage rather than repeated breaking. UP’s how much is compatible with quantity but does not clearly restore as often as desired, while restoration itself remains explicit.
units.japanese: 「………そして無限の魔法を得て。…いくら壊しても好きなだけ元に直せると知った時。……妾は壷を壊すことがこれほどまでに楽しかったのかと驚いたものだ…」

units.text: ".........Then, when I gained the Endless Magic, ...and I learned that I could fix it back to normal no matter how much I broke it, ......I was surprised at how fun it was to break a vase..."
units.note: MG retains extent of damage rather than repeated breaking. UP’s how much is compatible with quantity but does not clearly restore as often as desired, while restoration itself remains explicit.
units.japanese: 「………そして無限の魔法を得て。…いくら壊しても好きなだけ元に直せると知った時。……妾は壷を壊すことがこれほどまでに楽しかったのかと驚いたものだ…」

description: WH adds at times and makes Battler’s current vague realization a history of recurring reflection.
sourceReading: 今…漠然と思った introduces a thought occurring to him now about the purpose of their ongoing game.

units.text: "......By now, I have, at times, vaguely thought about something.  .........Why do I keep going on with this strange game against you?
units.note: MG removes at times but retains ongoing thinking rather than a realization just occurring; UP restores just come to me.
units.japanese: 「……今、俺は漠然と思ったことがある。………どうして俺がお前と、こんなおかしなゲームを延々と続けてるのかだ。

units.text: "...There's this thing I've been vaguely thinking about. ......Why do I keep playing this strange game against you?"
units.note: MG removes at times but retains ongoing thinking rather than a realization just occurring; UP restores just come to me.
units.japanese: 「……今、俺は漠然と思ったことがある。………どうして俺がお前と、こんなおかしなゲームを延々と続けてるのかだ」

description: Beato denies that the game serves anyone’s intentions or design; WH instead says nobody anticipated it.
sourceReading: 誰の思惑でもない denies an ulterior plan behind the game, following her claim of mere diversion.

units.text: "...I, .........I don't know about that.  ...The reason I proposed this game to you was, umm, ......simply as a way to kill time...  No one was anticipating it."
units.note: Both restore ulterior motives rather than anticipation.
units.japanese: 「…し、………知らぬわ。…妾がそなたにゲームを申し込んでいるのはその、……単なる暇潰しだ…。誰の思惑でもないわ。」

description: WH renders the context-bound inability to falsify her visible feelings as I cannot deceive, which reads as a general incapacity.
sourceReading: 胸の内が全て顔に出る…偽れぬ binds the inability to disguising what shows on her face.

units.text: ".....................Sorry about that.  Letting everything inside my heart show up on my face is part of my personality.  I cannot deceive."
units.note: Both retain the unqualified I cannot deceive, although the nearby facial-expression context supplies a narrower reading.
units.japanese: 「……………………それは済まぬな。妾は胸の内が全て顔に出る性分。偽れぬ。」

units.text: "............Sorry about that. Letting everything inside my heart show up on my face is part of my personality. I cannot deceive."

units.text: "........................Sorry about that. Letting everything inside my heart show up on my face is part of my personality. I cannot deceive."

units.japanese: 「……………………それは済まぬな。妾は胸の内が全て顔に出る性分。偽れぬ」

description: WH moves the small degree of hope in Beato’s smile into the short time she shows a hopeful smile.
sourceReading: ほんの少しだけ望みのある笑顔 describes a smile with only a little hope.

units.text: After showing a hopeful smile for a very short while, Beato hid herself. ...Looking at that expression, Battler strongly believed that her face wasn't lying...
units.note: MG retains brief duration rather than a small degree of hope; UP restores slightly hopeful.
units.japanese: ほんの少しだけ望みのある笑顔を見せ、ベアトは姿を消す。

units.text: After showing a hopeful smile for a very short while, Beato vanished. ...After seeing her expression as she left, Battler was absolutely convinced that her face could tell no lies...
units.note: MG retains brief duration rather than a small degree of hope; UP restores slightly hopeful.
units.japanese: ほんの少しだけ望みのある笑顔を見せ、ベアトは姿を消す。…その表情を見て、彼女は自らの表情にウソをつけぬことを、戦人は固く信じるのだった…。

description: WH omits the such-as scope of front and service entrances and limits the explicit all statement to front and back doors.
sourceReading: 玄関や勝手口などの外へ通じる扉は全て covers every door communicating with the outside, naming entrances as examples.

units.text: Because the shutters were closed on the windows, they wouldn't open even if the culprit had the master key. The front and back doors that led to the outside were all sealed by chains, and they were further blocked with sofas and tables.
units.note: MG retains only front/back doors; UP restores all other doors leading outside.
units.japanese: 玄関や勝手口などの外へ通じる扉は全てチェーンで閉ざし、さらにはソファーやテーブルなどの什器で塞ぐ。

units.text: Because the shutters were closed on the windows, they couldn't be opened even if the culprit had a master key. The front and back doors that led to the outside were all sealed by chains, and they were further blocked with sofas and tables.
units.note: MG retains only front/back doors; UP restores all other doors leading outside.
units.japanese: 窓は鎧戸で閉ざしている為、例えマスターキーがあったとしても開けはしない。玄関や勝手口などの外へ通じる扉は全てチェーンで閉ざし、さらにはソファーやテーブルなどの什器で塞ぐ。

description: Eva says she cannot remain laid up with illness; WH says it is no time to fall asleep.
sourceReading: 寝込んでる refers to being confined to bed by illness, in the context of continuing fever.

units.text: "Thank you.  ...I still feel a fever, but now isn't the time to talk about that.  ......Now is not the time to fall asleep, for the children's sake as well."
units.note: Both restore being bedridden rather than merely asleep.
units.japanese: 「ありがとう。…熱はまだ感じるけど、そんなことを言ってる場合じゃないわ。……子どもの為にも、今は寝込んでる場合じゃない。」

description: WH uses had hid rather than had hidden.
sourceReading: Nanjo had withdrawn to his own room on the same floor.

units.text: For a while, Nanjo had been with them, and had tried to send them words of encouragement, but when he realized that he might actually be having the opposite effect, he had hid himself in his own room on the same second floor.
