units.note: MG uses simple past hid himself; UP avoids the construction with disappeared. Neither retains had hid.
units.japanese: しばらくの間、南條も一緒にいてくれて、彼らを励ますような言葉を掛けてくれたのだが、それはむしろ逆効果かもしれないと気付き、同じ２階の自室に姿を消していた。

description: George recognizes that it was all right to cry more; WH says he should have cried much more.
sourceReading: もっともっと泣いても良かった recalls permission to express grief, following Battler’s assurance.

units.text: That feeling should have tormented him the whole time.  ......However, until Battler had told him, he hadn't been aware of the feeling himself. ......He finally remembered, ...that he should have cried much, much more.
units.note: MG restores permission to cry; UP retains should have cried.
units.japanese: ……自分は、もっともっと泣いても良かったんだって、…やっと思い出せたのだ。

units.text: That feeling had tormented him the whole time. ......However, until Battler had told him, he hadn't been aware of the feeling himself. ......He finally remembered...that he should have cried much, much more.
units.note: MG restores permission to cry; UP retains should have cried.
units.japanese: その気持ちは、ずっと彼を苛んでいたはずだ。……しかし、戦人にさっき言われるまで、自覚できずにいた。……自分は、もっともっと泣いても良かったんだって、…やっと思い出せたのだ。

description: WH has George unable to forgive it himself, rather than unable to forgive himself if Shannon died following him.
sourceReading: 自分で自分が許せなく explicitly makes his own self the object of blame.

units.text: If he were to chase after Shannon and kill himself, she would surely be deeply dejected. ......It worked the other way around, too. If he had died, and Shannon had chased after him, throwing away her own life, he wouldn't have been able to forgive it himself.
units.note: Both restore inability to forgive himself in the reversed hypothetical.
units.japanese: 自分が死に、それを追って紗音が自ら命を捨てるようなことがあったなら、自分で自分が許せなくなってしまう。

description: WH drops the smile from the memory that keeps bringing his grief back.
sourceReading: 彼女の笑顔 recurs from the happy smile in the Okinawa photographs.

units.text: By doing that, he tried to quell his sadness.  But each time he did, he remembered Shannon's face...
units.note: Both restore the remembered smile.
units.japanese: そうすることで、悲しみを和らげようとしたのだ。でもその度に、彼女の笑顔が蘇ってしまう…。

description: Jessica’s statement about every form of separation becomes a statement about how one says farewell.
sourceReading: 別れはどんな形でも concerns the circumstances and kinds of parting, expanded immediately into old age and anticipated loss.

units.text: "......No matter how you say your farewell, it's always sad.
units.note: MG retains saying goodbye rather than every form of separation; UP restores partings no matter their form.
units.japanese: 「……別れはどんな形でも、いつも悲しいさ。

units.text: "...It's always sad when you have to say goodbye.
units.note: MG retains saying goodbye rather than every form of separation; UP restores partings no matter their form.
units.japanese: 「……別れはどんな形でも、いつも悲しいさ」

description: WH recasts having no opportunity for emotional preparation as not having that much free time.
sourceReading: その暇もねぇ refers back to gradually putting one’s feelings in order before the death.

units.text: "............I see.  So, if they get sick or something, and end up bedridden in a hospital, you might be able to ready yourself for it bit by bit, ...but when it happens suddenly on some day, you don't have that much free time."
units.note: MG’s no luxury restores lack of opportunity to prepare; UP retains not that much time, weakening no opportunity to reduced time.
units.japanese: 「……………なるほどな。…そりゃ、病気にでも掛かって、病院で寝たきりになってりゃ、少しずつ心の整理もついてくだろうけど、…ある日突然じゃ、その暇もねぇもんな。」

units.text: "...............I see, yeah. ...Sure, if they get sick or something, and end up bedridden in a hospital for several years, you might be able to ready yourself for it bit by bit, ...but when it happens suddenly some day, you don't have that much time."
units.note: MG’s no luxury restores lack of opportunity to prepare; UP retains not that much time, weakening no opportunity to reduced time.
units.japanese: 「……………なるほどな。…そりゃ、病気にでも掛かって、何年も昏睡状態になってりゃ、少しずつ心の整理もついてくだろうけど、…ある日突然じゃ、その暇もねぇもんな」

description: WH replaces the order or laws of life with divine providence.
sourceReading: 生命の摂理 specifies the order governing life; God is separately the hypothetical punisher.

units.text: .........Even if his crime of going against divine providence was punished by God, and his body was burnt and sent down to hell, ...even if that reunion only lasted a very short time, right...?"
units.note: MG retains divine providence. UP restores life as the referent but providence retains an awkward theological sense instead of the order of life.
units.japanese: ………仮に、生命の摂理に逆らった罪を神に咎められて、その身を焼かれ、地獄に落とされたとしても。…その見返りの再会が、ほんのわずかな時間だったとしても、ね…。」

units.text: "......And that would be true...even if his crime of going against divine providence was punished by God, and his body was burnt and sent down to hell, ...even if that reunion only lasted a very short time, right...?"
units.note: MG retains divine providence. UP restores life as the referent but providence retains an awkward theological sense instead of the order of life.
units.japanese: 「………仮に、生命の摂理に逆らった罪を神に咎められて、その身を焼かれ、地獄に落とされたとしても。…その見返りの再会が、ほんのわずかな時間だったとしても、ね…」

units.text: ".........Even if his sin of defying life's providence was punished by God, and his body was burnt and sent down to hell, ...and even if the reunion he got in return only lasted a very short time..."
units.note: MG retains divine providence. UP restores life as the referent but providence retains an awkward theological sense instead of the order of life.
units.japanese: 「………仮に、生命の摂理に逆らった罪を神に咎められて、その身を焼かれ、地獄に落とされたとしても。…その見返りの再会が、ほんのわずかな時間だったとしても、ね…」

description: WH drops the tentative recollection attached to Shannon’s comment about the coffee.
sourceReading: と言われたことがあったような trails off as something he seems to remember being told.

units.text: One time, I had Shannon drink it, ...but she told me that while it was delicious, it was a little strong...
units.note: MG omits the tentative recollection of Shannon’s coffee comment; UP restores if I remember her words.
units.japanese: 一度、紗音にその淹れ方で飲ませてあげたことがあったが、……おいしいけど、少し濃いですね。と言われたことがあったような…。

units.text: ...It seems my mother's orthodox method of making coffee isn't universally appreciated. One time, I made some for Shannon, ...but she told me that while it was delicious, it was a little strong...
units.note: MG omits the tentative recollection of Shannon’s coffee comment; UP restores if I remember her words.
units.japanese: 一度、紗音にその淹れ方で飲ませてあげたことがあったが、……おいしいけど、少し濃いですね。と言われたことがあったような…。

description: WH uses on the edge of losing it for the couple being carried away with excitement during the engagement.
sourceReading: のぼせ上がっていて冷静じゃなかった describes excitement or infatuated elation preventing calm judgment.

units.text: Last night, we were both on the edge of losing it, and not calm at all. Shannon had accepted the engagement courageously, but she might have regretted that as a rash action once she cooled her head.  She might have taken the ring off.
units.note: MG retains on the edge of losing it; UP restores being carried away with each other and lacking composure.
units.japanese: 昨夜は僕たちものぼせ上がっていて冷静じゃなかった。

units.text: Last night, we were both on the edge of losing it and not calm at all. Shannon accepted my engagement pretty courageously, but she might have regretted that as a rash action once she cooled her head.
units.note: MG retains on the edge of losing it; UP restores being carried away with each other and lacking composure.
units.japanese: 昨夜は僕たちものぼせ上がっていて冷静じゃなかった。紗音は半ば勇ましく婚約を受けてはくれたけど、頭を冷やしたらそれが勇み足だったと後悔しているかもしれない。

description: WH makes George the agent who does not want to burn Shannon’s body, rather than him opposing its cremation by others.
sourceReading: 遺体を…焼かれたくない is an affected passive: he does not want her remains to be burned.

units.text: I don't want, ......to burn Shannon's body. If she is burned, she'll turn to ash, ......and never again will it be possible for her to revive.
units.note: Both restore wanting her body not to be burned, without making George the cremation agent.
units.japanese: 紗音の遺体を、……焼かれたくない。

description: WH says Kinzo bet his life on the miracle magic rather than continuing to praise it throughout his life.
sourceReading: 生涯讃え続けた describes sustained lifelong veneration or praise.

units.text: I should hate that being, ............and yet, for some reason, I want to cling to her. I wonder, ...if Shannon could be revived with the magic of miracles, which Grandfather bet his life on...
units.note: MG retains bet his life on the magic; UP restores lifelong espousal.
units.japanese: お祖父さまが、生涯讃え続けたその奇跡の魔法で、…紗音を蘇らせてはくれないだろうか…。

units.text: She's an entity I should hate, ......and yet, for some reason, I want to cling to her. I wonder...if Shannon could be revived with the magic of miracles, which Grandfather bet his life on...
units.note: MG retains bet his life on the magic; UP restores lifelong espousal.
units.japanese: 憎い存在のはずなのに、…………なのになぜか、彼女にすがりたい気持ちがある。お祖父さまが、生涯讃え続けたその奇跡の魔法で、…紗音を蘇らせてはくれないだろうか…。

description: WH calls the devil’s contract collateral rather than a condition accepted in exchange for Shannon’s life.
sourceReading: その見返りに means in return for that, with George accepting whatever contract is imposed.

units.text: As collateral, she could impose any kind of devil's contract. For that, I could sacrifice all of my remaining life...
units.note: MG retains collateral; UP restores in return as the exchange condition.
units.japanese: その見返りに、どのような悪魔の契約を課せられてもいい。

units.text: As collateral, I don't care what sort of devil's contract she imposed. I wouldn't mind sacrificing all of my remaining life...
units.note: MG retains collateral; UP restores in return as the exchange condition.
units.japanese:
その見返りに、どのような悪魔の契約を課せられてもいい。
その為に、残りの生涯の全てを奉げることになってもいい…。

description: WH describes several magical steps where Beato is considering several possible methods.
sourceReading: いくつかの魔法的手段 refers to alternative means, rejected one by one before she chooses one spell.

units.text: Inside her head, she thought about several magical steps she could take to revive the dead. ......Even magic that should have been easy in the past would be difficult with her current magic power. She thought of something, then clicked her tongue, and repeated this several times.
units.note: MG retains magical steps rather than alternatives; UP restores several methods and the search for an alternative.
units.japanese: 頭の中で、死者を蘇らすいくつかの魔法的手段を思案する。

units.text: Inside her head, she thought about several magical steps she could take to revive the dead. ...Even magic that should have been easy in the past would be difficult with her current power. She thought of something, then clicked her tongue, then did so again, over and over.
units.note: MG retains magical steps rather than alternatives; UP restores several methods and the search for an alternative.
units.japanese: 頭の中で、死者を蘇らすいくつかの魔法的手段を思案する。……かつては容易に出来たはずの魔法も、今の魔力では難しくなっている。思いついては舌を打つ、を数度繰り返す。

description: WH makes his feelings change into magic and retrieve Shannon’s soul, where Beato says George can convert those feelings and bring her back.
sourceReading: そなたなら、その想いを魔力に変えて…連れ戻せる assigns conversion and retrieval to George.

units.text: ...But as I am now, I do not have the power to bring Shannon's soul up through that gap.  .........However, if it were you, who has strong feelings for Shannon, those feelings should change into magic and bring her soul out without fail.
units.note: MG makes the feelings themselves become retrieving magic; UP restores George converting those feelings and bringing back the soul.
units.japanese: …だが、今の妾にはその隙間より紗音の魂を連れ出せるほどの力はない。………しかし、紗音のことを強く想うそなたなら、その想いを魔力に変えて、彼女の魂を必ずや連れ戻せるだろう。

units.text: "...But as I am now, I do not have the power to bring Shannon's soul up through that gap. ......However, you have strong feelings for Shannon, and those feelings will surely become magic that can bring her soul out without fail."
units.note: MG makes the feelings themselves become retrieving magic; UP restores George converting those feelings and bringing back the soul.
units.japanese: 「…だが、今の妾にはその隙間より紗音の魂を連れ出せるほどの力はない。………しかし、紗音のことを強く想うそなたなら、その想いを魔力に変えて、彼女の魂を必ずや連れ戻せるだろう」

description: WH retains shaking fists but omits George deliberately clenching both hands.
sourceReading: 両の手を握り締め拳を振るわせた describes the gesture of gripping into fists and making them tremble, not only their movement.

units.text: George's fists shook in silence. ...Then he slowly regained consciousness. He had been absent-mindedly standing near the window in the hall the whole time, his mug still in his hand...
units.note: Both retain shaking fists but omit his deliberate clenching of both hands.
units.japanese: 譲治は静かに両の手を握り締め拳を振るわせた。

units.text: George's fists shook in silence. ...Then, he slowly came to his senses. He had been absent-mindedly standing near the window in the hall that whole time, his mug still in his hand...
units.note: Both retain shaking fists but omit his deliberate clenching of both hands.
units.japanese: 譲治は静かに両の手を握り締め拳を振るわせた。…そして意識がゆっくりと覚醒する。彼は廊下の窓辺でマグカップを持ったまま、ずっと放心していたのだ…。

units.text: George's fists shook in silence. ...Then he slowly regained consciousness. He had been absentmindedly standing near the window in the hall the whole time, his mug still in his hand...
units.note: Both retain shaking fists but omit his deliberate clenching of both hands.
units.japanese: 譲治は静かに両の手を握り締め拳を振るわせた。…そして意識がゆっくりと覚醒する。彼は廊下の窓辺でマグカップを持ったまま、ずっと放心していたのだ…。

description: WH adds outside the mansion to the wind and rain revealed by the window, though George and Beato are leaving the guesthouse and have not reached the mansion.
sourceReading: 風雨の屋外 names the stormy outdoors without a building label. Their stated route avoids the guarded guesthouse first floor to go to the mansion.

units.text: The window opened, exposing the wind and rain outside the mansion. ...Perhaps because of the direction or something related to the construction of the building, the wind did not blow inside.
units.note: Both retain outside the mansion while the departure is from the guesthouse; the mansion is approached only later.
units.japanese: 窓が開き、風雨の屋外が晒される。

units.text: The window opened, exposing the wind and rain outside the mansion. ...Perhaps because of the direction or something related to the construction of the building, the wind did not blow inside.
units.note: Both retain outside the mansion while the departure is from the guesthouse; the mansion is approached only later.
units.japanese: 窓が開き、風雨の屋外が晒される。…そこは向きや建物の構造上の関係なのか、風が吹き込まなかった。

description: WH spells acquired as aquired in the targeting report.
sourceReading: The report identifies two targets and Eva in the first-floor lobby.

units.text: "......In the lobby on the first floor of the guesthouse, both targets and Ushiromiya Eva aquired.  Anti-Magic Power Measurement.  Data Link to 410."
units.note: MG avoids the misspelled acquired by using identified; UP spells acquired correctly.
units.japanese: 「……ゲストハウス１階ロビーにて、標的２名と右代宮絵羽を補足。反魔法力測定。４１０へデータリンク。」

description: WH says Eva must go outside, where the source only requires her to leave the immediate gathering or her place.
sourceReading: 席を外せば means if she steps away, not necessarily if she exits the building.

units.text: "410 Data Received.  Anti-magic power is extremely small.  If Eva just goes outside, they're tuna and abalone on a chopping board.  Nihihihihi...!"
units.note: Both retain Eva going outside rather than merely leaving her place or the gathering.
units.japanese: 「４１０データ受領。反魔法力は極めて小。絵羽さえ席を外せば、まな板の上のマグロにアワビです。にひひひひ…！」

units.text: "410, Data Received. Anti-magic power levels are extremely low. If Eva just goes outside, they're tuna and abalone on a chopping board. Nihihihihi...!"
units.note: Both retain Eva going outside rather than merely leaving her place or the gathering.
units.japanese: 「４１０データ受領。反魔法力は極めて小。絵羽さえ席を外せば、まな板の上のマグロにアワビです。にひひひひ…！」

units.text: "410, data received. Anti‐magic power is extremely low. If Eva just goes outside, they're tuna and abalone on a chopping board. Nihihihihi...!"
units.note: Both retain Eva going outside rather than merely leaving her place or the gathering.
units.japanese: 「４１０データ受領。反魔法力は極めて小。絵羽さえ席を外せば、まな板の上のマグロにアワビです。にひひひひ…！」

description: WH uses silhouette creating by lightning rather than created, revealed or outlined by lightning.
sourceReading: Lightning brings out the mansion’s dark silhouette beyond the rose garden.

units.text: The witch persistently stared in the direction the presence had disappeared to. ......That was the direction of the rose garden. And beyond that, she could see the mansion's dark silhouette creating by lightning.
units.note: MG retains silhouette creating by lightning; UP restores created by lightning.
units.japanese: そしてその向こうには、雷光に黒いシルエットを浮かび上がらせる屋敷が見える。

units.text: The witch persistently stared in the direction the presence had disappeared to. ...That was where the rose garden lay. And beyond that, she could see the mansion's dark silhouette creating by lightning.
units.note: MG retains silhouette creating by lightning; UP restores created by lightning.
units.japanese: 魔女は、気配の消え去った方角を執念深く凝視する。……それは薔薇庭園の方角。そしてその向こうには、雷光に黒いシルエットを浮かび上がらせる屋敷が見える。

description: WH describes Hideyoshi putting his hand on her forehead and the fever fading in the present, rather than Eva’s recollection of how he used to comfort her, marked by regret.
sourceReading: 当ててくれれば…熱が引いたのに looks back at the relief she used to feel and laments its absence now.

units.text: Even the sound of the clock torments my body now. In times like this, ......when that person puts his hand on my forehead, the fever fades at once. ...But that person no longer exists.........
units.note: MG retains present comfort and fever fading; UP restores habitual past comfort and the present absence.
units.japanese: こんな時はいつだって、……あの人が私の額に手を当ててくれれば、たちどころに熱が引いたのに。

units.text: Even the sound of the clock torments my body now. In times like this, ...when that person puts his hand on my forehead, the fever fades at once. ...But that person no longer exists......
units.note: MG retains present comfort and fever fading; UP restores habitual past comfort and the present absence.
units.japanese: 時計の音さえ、今はこの身を苛む。こんな時はいつだって、……あの人が私の額に手を当ててくれれば、たちどころに熱が引いたのに。…でももう、あの人はいない………。

description: WH changes they are not our dreams to they are not my dreams.
sourceReading: 私たちの夢 separates the dreams shared by childhood Eva and the witch from the adult wife/mother dreams Eva later added.

units.text: "...Those are just extra dreams you gained after becoming an adult.  They aren't my dreams."
units.note: MG retains my dreams; UP restores our dreams.
units.japanese: 「…それは、あなたが大人になってから、勝手に増やした夢だわ。私たちの夢じゃない。」

units.text: "...Those are just extra dreams you added after becoming an adult. They aren't my dreams."
units.note: MG retains my dreams; UP restores our dreams.
units.japanese: 「…それは、あなたが大人になってから、勝手に増やした夢だわ。私たちの夢じゃない」

description: Eva says that is why you are a child, citing the refusal to acknowledge her adult dreams. WH says that is because you are a child.
sourceReading: だから presents the preceding reaction as grounds for her accusation of childishness.

units.text: "That's because you are a child...!!  As long as it's good for you, you're happy?!  ......That's right, everything is my fault...!!  Back then, why did I resist doing what Rosa told me to?  Why couldn't I announce to all of the siblings that I had found the gold...?  ......It's all because I'm ugly!!  My evil heart, which sprouted when I wanted to have all of the gold all to myself, ......caused you to hatch!!"
units.note: MG retains because you are a child; UP restores that is why you are a child.
units.japanese: 「だからあなたは子どもなのよ…！！　自分さえよければいいの？！　……そうよ、全て私が悪いのよ…！！　あの時、楼座の言うことにどうして私は反抗したの？　どうして兄弟みんなに、黄金を見つけたと発表できなかったの…？　……全て私が醜いから！！　黄金を独り占めしたくて芽生えさせた邪まな心が、……あなたを孵化させてしまった！！」

units.text: "That's because you're a child...!! Do you only care about what's best for yourself?! ...That's right, everything is my fault...!! Back then, why did I resist doing what Rosa told me to? Why couldn't I announce to all of the siblings that I'd found the gold...?
units.note: MG retains because you are a child; UP restores that is why you are a child.
units.japanese: 「だからあなたは子どもなのよ…！！　自分さえよければいいの？！　……そうよ、全て私が悪いのよ…！！　あの時、楼座の言うことにどうして私は反抗したの？　どうして兄弟みんなに、黄金を見つけたと発表できなかったの…？」

description: WH renders ヘソでも噛んで as give up rather than bitter regret.
sourceReading: 噛む here evokes biting one’s own navel, an idiom of frustrated regret, accompanying the dismissive invitation to die however she likes.

units.text: I don't even know you.  Why don't you just give up and die?!"
units.note: Both retain give up rather than bitter regret in the dismissive idiom.
units.japanese: あんたなんて知らないわ。ヘソでも噛んで、勝手に死んじゃえばぁ？！」

units.text: "I don't even care about you. If only you'd just give up and die!"
units.note: Both retain give up rather than bitter regret in the dismissive idiom.
units.japanese: 「あんたなんて知らないわ。ヘソでも噛んで、勝手に死んじゃえばぁ？！」

units.text: "I'm done caring about you. Why don't you just give up and die forever?!"
units.note: Both retain give up rather than bitter regret in the dismissive idiom.
units.japanese: 「あんたなんて知らないわ。ヘソでも噛んで、勝手に死んじゃえばぁ？！」

description: The witch responds to Krauss’s apology with if you think you did wrong or feel sorry; WH instead says if you do not like it.
sourceReading: 悪いと思ったなら responds to his remorse and admission of mistreating Eva, not to dissatisfaction with his current circumstances.

units.text: "If you don't like it, why don't you just give up and die right now?!  Do it, Siesta Sisters!!"
units.note: MG restores now feeling guilty; UP restores knowing oneself in the wrong. Both remove if you do not like it.
units.japanese: 「悪いと思ったなら、今すぐヘソでも噛んで死んじゃえばぁ？！

description: WH replaces eyes rolling back to show the whites with eyes bulging.
sourceReading: 白目を剥いて specifies exposed whites from rolled eyes during convulsions.

units.text: Without even the chance to scream, their eyes bulged as they went into convulsions and then collapsed.
units.note: Both retain bulging eyes instead of eyes rolling back to expose the whites.
units.japanese: 二人は悲鳴すらあげられず、白目を剥いて痙攣し、がくりと脱力する。

units.text: Without even a chance to scream, their eyes bulged as they went into convulsions and then collapsed.
units.note: Both retain bulging eyes instead of eyes rolling back to expose the whites.
units.japanese: 二人は悲鳴すらあげられず、白目を剥いて痙攣し、がくりと脱力する。

description: WH says they slipped through the door dragging the bodies, although the continuing agent is the single golden snake.
sourceReading: The previous sentence names 黄金の蛇 dragging both corpses; the omitted subject continues into the passage through the door.

units.text: The gold snake began to drag Krauss and Natsuhi's bodies back. ......They slipped through the door to the corridor, dragging the bodies, gradually increasing in speed, and rapidly pulled them outside the guesthouse.
units.note: MG retains plural they as the dragging agent; UP restores the single projectile with it.
units.japanese: ……廊下への扉をすり抜けて死体を引き摺り、次第に速度を上げて、

units.text: The gold snake began to drag Krauss and Natsuhi's bodies back. ...They slipped through the door to the corridor, dragging the bodies, gradually increasing in speed, and rapidly pulled them outside the guesthouse.
units.note: MG retains plural they as the dragging agent; UP restores the single projectile with it.
units.japanese: 黄金の蛇は、蔵臼と夏妃の二人の死体をずるずると引き摺り始める。……廊下への扉をすり抜けて死体を引き摺り、次第に速度を上げて、あっという間にゲストハウスの外へ引っ張り出していく。

description: WH says she has forgotten after several hundred years, rather than having forgotten for nearly several hundred years.
sourceReading: 数百年近くも忘れておった identifies the long duration of having forgotten how strenuous magic was.

units.text: ".........I have forgotten after several hundred years... .........Was magic, ......was resurrection, ...always this difficult of a magic......?"
units.note: MG restores forgotten for several centuries; UP retains forgotten after several hundred years.
units.japanese: 「………数百年近くも忘れておったわ…。

units.text: ".........I have forgotten after several hundred years... .........Was magic, ......was resurrection... always this difficult of a magic......?"
units.note: MG restores forgotten for several centuries; UP retains forgotten after several hundred years.
units.japanese: 「………数百年近くも忘れておったわ…。………魔法とは、……反魂とは、…こんなにも辛い魔法であったか……」

description: WH presents an unspecified it as born from sadness and from his life, shared time and dreams. The Japanese identifies the power of grief itself as born from those latter experiences.
sourceReading: 譲治の…死を悲しむ力は…人生と…時間、そして…夢の大きさから生まれる gives the lived experiences and promised future as origins of his grief’s power.

units.text: It had been born from the power of George's sadness at the death of the person he loved, ......and from the way he had tried his hardest throughout his life, from the warm time spent together with Shannon, and the size of the dream they swore to protect in the future.
units.note: MG retains an unspecified power born from both grief and experience; UP restores grief itself arising from his lived effort, shared time and promised future.
units.japanese: 譲治の、想い人の死を悲しむ力は、……それまでの彼の一生懸命だった人生と、紗音との温かな時間、そして将来を誓い合った夢の大きさから生まれるのだ。

units.text: It had been born from the power of George's sadness at the death of the person he loved, ...and from the way he had tried his hardest throughout his life, from the warm time spent together with Shannon, to the size of the dream they swore to protect in the future.
units.note: MG retains an unspecified power born from both grief and experience; UP restores grief itself arising from his lived effort, shared time and promised future.
units.japanese: 譲治の、想い人の死を悲しむ力は、……それまでの彼の一生懸命だった人生と、紗音との温かな時間、そして将来を誓い合った夢の大きさから生まれるのだ。

description: WH drops こともある from Beato’s question about witches being inferior to humans.
sourceReading: 劣ることもある asks whether there are occasions or respects in which an Endless Witch is surpassed by a finite human.

units.text: ".........Is an Endless Witch, who can do as she wants even with life and death, ......inferior to a limited human who can't even surpass the mountain of death......?"
units.note: MG retains general inferiority; UP restores there are times when.
units.japanese: 「………生死すら自在にする無限の魔女が、……死の山さえ越えられぬ有限のニンゲンに、劣ることもあるというのか……。」

units.text: "......So, is an Endless Witch, who can do as she pleases even with life and death... inferior to a limited Human who can't even surpass the mountain of death...?"
units.note: MG retains general inferiority; UP restores there are times when.
units.japanese: 「………生死すら自在にする無限の魔女が、……死の山さえ越えられぬ有限のニンゲンに、劣ることもあるというのか……」

description: The vase’s beauty makes the child unable to suppress a sigh; WH says it forced a deep breath.
sourceReading: ため息が堪えられない conveys involuntary sighing at beauty, followed by the wish to touch.

units.text: The vase was very beautiful, rich with history and value. Even as young as I was, it still forced me to take a deep breath when I witnessed its beauty. ......But that just made me want to touch it.
units.note: Both retain a forced deep breath instead of an unsuppressible sigh at beauty.
units.japanese:
幼い私が見ても、その美しさにため息が堪えられないほどに。
……でも、だから触れてみたかったのです。

units.text: The vase was very beautiful, rich with history and value. Even as young as I was, it still forced me to take a deep breath when I witnessed its beauty. ...But that just made me want to touch it.
units.note: Both retain a forced deep breath instead of an unsuppressible sigh at beauty.
units.japanese: それは、とてもとても美しくて、価値と歴史のある素晴らしい壷でした。幼い私が見ても、その美しさにため息が堪えられないほどに。……でも、だから触れてみたかったのです。

units.text: The vase was very, very beautiful, rich with history and value. Even as young as I was, it still forced me to take a deep breath when I witnessed its beauty. ......But that just made me want to touch it.
units.note: Both retain a forced deep breath instead of an unsuppressible sigh at beauty.
units.japanese: それは、とてもとても美しくて、価値と歴史のある素晴らしい壷でした。幼い私が見ても、その美しさにため息が堪えられないほどに。……でも、だから触れてみたかったのです。

description: WH says Grandfather and those who saw his grief cried, where the child anticipates that they will surely cry.
sourceReading: きっと泣くでしょう projects the consequences of the broken vase, with others expected to cry upon seeing Grandfather grieve.

units.text: I'm sure that Grandfather also cried at the loss of his precious vase. I'm sure that all of the people who valued Grandfather and saw him like that cried. By just the loss of a single life, the whole world would be filled with so much sadness. ......I cried even more at how terrible that would be.
units.note: Both restore anticipated crying, using future will or remembered would rather than completed crying.
units.japanese:
お祖父さまも、大切な壷が失われたことを、きっと泣くでしょう。
それを見て、お祖父さまを大切に思う人たちもみんな、きっと泣くでしょう。

description: WH replaces the land-of-the-dead frost still covering Shannon’s eyes with fog, then explicitly makes that fog dissolve under her lover’s warmth.
sourceReading: 霜 continues the earlier frozen coffin imagery and is melted by the returning warmth before her eyes regain their light.

units.text: Then, ...those eyelids slowly opened. Shannon's eyes were there, but they were still wrapped in the fog of the land of the dead.
units.note: MG retains fog; UP restores frost and its melting under her lover’s warmth.
units.japanese:
そして、…ゆっくりとその瞼が開く。
そこには紗音の瞳があったが、まだ死者の国の霜が降りたままだった。
しかし、……人の世の、…いや。
……彼女の魂を呼び戻した想い人の温かさで、ゆっくりと溶かされていき、………次第に、輝きを取り戻していく。

units.text: However, ......the human world's, ...no. ......The lover's warmth which had called her soul back slowly dissolved that fog, .........and her eyes gradually regained their sparkle.
units.note: MG retains fog; UP restores frost and its melting under her lover’s warmth.
units.japanese:
そして、…ゆっくりとその瞼が開く。
そこには紗音の瞳があったが、まだ死者の国の霜が降りたままだった。
しかし、……人の世の、…いや。
……彼女の魂を呼び戻した想い人の温かさで、ゆっくりと溶かされていき、………次第に、輝きを取り戻していく。

units.text: Then, ...those eyelids slowly opened. Shannon's eyes were there, but they were still wrapped in the fog of the land of the dead.
units.note: MG retains fog; UP restores frost and its melting under her lover’s warmth.
units.japanese:
そして、…ゆっくりとその瞼が開く。そこには紗音の瞳があったが、まだ死者の国の霜が降りたままだった。
しかし、……人の世の、…いや。……彼女の魂を呼び戻した想い人の温かさで、ゆっくりと溶かされていき、………次第に、輝きを取り戻していく。

units.text: However, ...the human world's warmth... ...No, her lover's warmth, which had called back her soul, slowly dissolved that fog, ......and her eyes gradually regained their sparkle.
units.note: MG retains fog; UP restores frost and its melting under her lover’s warmth.
units.japanese:
そして、…ゆっくりとその瞼が開く。そこには紗音の瞳があったが、まだ死者の国の霜が降りたままだった。
しかし、……人の世の、…いや。……彼女の魂を呼び戻した想い人の温かさで、ゆっくりと溶かされていき、………次第に、輝きを取り戻していく。

description: WH assigns both lovers the motive of preventing the other from going beyond reach; the source continues George holding her so she cannot go beyond his reach again.
sourceReading: 彼女が…自分の手の届かないところ…抱き締めた continues his intensified embrace after her weak arms.

units.text: To stop each other from going once more to a place the other's hand couldn't reach, they hugged each other very tightly, and yet very gently......
units.note: MG retains reciprocal prevention of departure; UP restores George preventing Shannon from passing beyond his reach.
units.japanese: 彼女が二度と自分の手の届かないところに行ってしまわないように、きつくきつく、だけれどもやさしくやさしく、抱き締めた……。

units.text: To stop each other from going once more to a place the other's hand couldn't reach, they hugged each other so tightly, and yet so gently...
units.note: MG retains reciprocal prevention of departure; UP restores George preventing Shannon from passing beyond his reach.
units.japanese: 彼女が二度と自分の手の届かないところに行ってしまわないように、きつくきつく、だけれどもやさしくやさしく、抱き締めた……。

description: WH identifies the feelings embodied in the ring as a miracle made real, rather than stating that they made this miracle happen.
sourceReading: 二人の想いが、この奇跡を実現させた assigns the feelings as causal agent of the miracle.

units.text: Beato understood. ......That ring, ......no. ............The feelings of the pair, embodied in that ring, were a miracle made real.
units.note: MG retains feelings as the miracle; UP restores feelings causing the miracle.
units.japanese: …………指輪の形をした、二人の想いが、この奇跡を実現させたのだ。

units.text: Beato understood. ...That ring, ...no. ......The feelings of the pair, embodied in that ring, were a miracle made real.
units.note: MG retains feelings as the miracle; UP restores feelings causing the miracle.
units.japanese: ベアトは理解する。……その指輪が、……いや。…………指輪の形をした、二人の想いが、この奇跡を実現させたのだ。

description: WH writes away from she who rather than away from her who or from the woman who.
sourceReading: The admission places true magic farthest from the woman who called herself a Great Witch.

units.text: By now, she had no choice but to accept it. ......She had to accept that true magic, true magical power... ...exists in the place farthest away from she who called herself a Great Witch.
units.note: Both retain from she who rather than the object pronoun her or a noun phrase.
units.japanese: …大魔女を名乗った彼女と、もっとも遠く離れたところにあったことを、認めなければならない。

units.text: By now, she had no choice but to accept it. ...She had to accept that true magic, true magical power... ...Exists in the place furthest away from she who called herself a Great Witch.
units.note: Both retain from she who rather than the object pronoun her or a noun phrase.
units.japanese: 今こそ認めざるを得ない。……本当の魔法とは、魔力とは。…大魔女を名乗った彼女と、もっとも遠く離れたところにあったことを、認めなければならない。

units.text: By now, she had no choice but to accept it. ......She had to accept that true magic, true magical power... ...existed in the place farthest away from she who called herself a Great Witch.
units.note: Both retain from she who rather than the object pronoun her or a noun phrase.
units.japanese: 今こそ認めざるを得ない。……本当の魔法とは、魔力とは。…大魔女を名乗った彼女と、もっとも遠く離れたところにあったことを、認めなければならない。

description: WH makes Ushiromiya blood the force that saw George through; Beato says she witnessed the miracle-working blood.
sourceReading: 見届けさせてもらった identifies Beato as witness and the Ushiromiya blood as what she has seen demonstrated.

units.text: "No.  I did not do anything.  ......The thing that revived Shannon...was your magical power.  It was your magic.  ............The Ushiromiya blood, which succeeds in miracles, ...definitely saw you through."
units.note: MG retains blood seeing George through; UP restores Beato witnessing the blood capable of miracles.
units.japanese: ……紗音を蘇らせたのは、そなたの魔力。そなたの魔法。…………奇跡を成し遂げる右代宮の血、…確かに見届けさせてもらったぞ。」

units.text: "No. I did nothing. ...What revived Shannon...was your magical power. It was your magic. ......The Ushiromiya blood, which makes miracles come true, ...surely saw you through."
units.note: MG retains blood seeing George through; UP restores Beato witnessing the blood capable of miracles.
units.japanese: 「いいや。妾は何もできなかった。……紗音を蘇らせたのは、そなたの魔力。そなたの魔法。…………奇跡を成し遂げる右代宮の血、…確かに見届けさせてもらったぞ」

description: WH asks killing something is not like that, reversing Beato’s recognition that this is precisely what killing means.
sourceReading: そういうことじゃねぇか is an affirmative rhetorical question: losing the teacher who could praise her is what killing entails.

units.text: Oh, but didn't I kill that Teacher who praised me myself? ......Don't be naive, Beatrice. ...In the end, killing something isn't like that, right...?
units.note: Both restore the recognition that this is what killing means, rather than denying it.
units.japanese: …モノを殺すってのはつまり、そういうことじゃねぇかよォ…。

description: WH assigns retirement to the witch patting her head and then has Virgilia say Beato is not fully adult and avoids duty. The exchange concerns Beato boasting she has gone beyond full qualification into retirement.
sourceReading: 隠居までした魔女 refers to Beato herself; 一人前どころか…現役を退いたと豪語する describes her claim to retirement, making late learning embarrassing.

units.text: "......Did you come to sneer at how pathetic I am?  ......And after all this time, ...if I have my head patted by a retired witch, the other witches will laugh at me......"
units.note: MG corrects Virgilia’s reply to recognize Beato’s boast of retirement but still assigns retirement to the head-patting witch at row 424. UP restores Beato as retired in both lines.
units.japanese:
……それに、隠居までした魔女が、…今更頭なんか撫でられちゃ、他の魔女の笑い者だぜ……。」
「そうですね。……一人前どころか、現役を退いたと豪語するあなたなのに、今頃になって魔法の使い方を覚えたなど、恥ずかしくて誰にも言えませんね。」

units.text: "That's right.  ......Not only are you not a full adult, but you boast about avoiding your duty, and the fact that you only learned how to use magic now is so embarrassing that you can't tell anybody."
units.note: MG corrects Virgilia’s reply to recognize Beato’s boast of retirement but still assigns retirement to the head-patting witch at row 424. UP restores Beato as retired in both lines.
units.japanese:
……それに、隠居までした魔女が、…今更頭なんか撫でられちゃ、他の魔女の笑い者だぜ……。」
「そうですね。……一人前どころか、現役を退いたと豪語するあなたなのに、今頃になって魔法の使い方を覚えたなど、恥ずかしくて誰にも言えませんね。」

units.text: "...Did you come to sneer at how pathetic I am? ...Anyway, ...if I have my head patted by a retired witch after all that's happened, the other witches will laugh at me..."
units.note: MG corrects Virgilia’s reply to recognize Beato’s boast of retirement but still assigns retirement to the head-patting witch at row 424. UP restores Beato as retired in both lines.
units.japanese:
「……無様な妾を、わざわざ嘲笑いに来たかよ。……それに、隠居までした魔女が、…今更頭なんか撫でられちゃ、他の魔女の笑い者だぜ……」
「そうですね。……一人前どころか、現役を退いたと豪語するあなたなのに、今頃になって魔法の使い方を覚えたなど、恥ずかしくて誰にも言えませんね」

units.text: "That's right. ...According to your bragging, you were not only a full adult, but a retired one, and yet only now have you learned how to use magic. That certainly does sound too embarrassing to tell anyone."
units.note: MG corrects Virgilia’s reply to recognize Beato’s boast of retirement but still assigns retirement to the head-patting witch at row 424. UP restores Beato as retired in both lines.
units.japanese:
「……無様な妾を、わざわざ嘲笑いに来たかよ。……それに、隠居までした魔女が、…今更頭なんか撫でられちゃ、他の魔女の笑い者だぜ……」
「そうですね。……一人前どころか、現役を退いたと豪語するあなたなのに、今頃になって魔法の使い方を覚えたなど、恥ずかしくて誰にも言えませんね」

description: WH adds just, leaving head-patting among her purposes rather than denying she came for that.
sourceReading: 頭を撫でに来たわけでもありません denies that comforting or praising purpose.

units.text: "You have let me live until now.  That is why I can appear like this.  ......However, I did not come just to pat your head."
units.note: MG retains not just to pat her head; UP restores denial of that purpose.
units.japanese: 「あなたが未だに私を生かしていますよ。だからこうして現れられます。……もっとも、あなたの頭を撫でに来たわけでもありませんが。」

units.text: "You are still allowing me to live even now. That is why I can appear like this. ...However, I did not come just to pat your head."
units.note: MG retains not just to pat her head; UP restores denial of that purpose.
units.japanese: 「あなたが未だに私を生かしていますよ。だからこうして現れられます。……もっとも、あなたの頭を撫でに来たわけでもありませんが」

description: WH uses despondency for her comfortable drained state after expending all her strength.
sourceReading: 心地よい虚脱感 is pleasant slackness or exhaustion after the intense effort.

units.text: Beato gazed at the couple hugging each other with a sense of pleasant despondency.
units.note: Both retain pleasant despondency instead of comfortable depletion after exertion.
units.japanese: ベアトは心地よい虚脱感の中、抱き合う二人を見つめるのだった。

units.text: Beato gazed at the couple hugging each other with a sense of pleasant despondency.
units.note: Both retain pleasant despondency instead of comfortable depletion after exertion.
units.japanese: ベアトは心地よい虚脱感の中、抱き合う二人を見つめるのだった。

units.text: With a sense of pleasant despondency, Beato gazed at the couple hugging each other.
units.note: Both retain pleasant despondency instead of comfortable depletion after exertion.
units.japanese: ベアトは心地よい虚脱感の中、抱き合う二人を見つめるのだった。

description: WH attaches in an instant to shooting Virgilia; Japanese explicitly binds that instant to Beato’s escape.
sourceReading: その瞬間に逃げ去ったベアト states she fled in that moment while the snake failed to notice.

units.text: The snake, which had snuck in through the keyhole, had shot through George and Shannon, and had then shot through Virgilia in an instant, completely failed to notice as Beato escaped...
units.note: Both attach in an instant to the successive shooting rather than explicitly to Beato’s escape. MG’s that instant in the next line partially supplies the simultaneity, but retains the added shooting attachment.
units.japanese: 鍵穴より侵入し、譲治と紗音の二人を撃ち抜き、さらにワルギリアまでも撃ち抜いた黄金の蛇は、その瞬間に逃げ去ったベアトについては完全に気付けなかった…。

units.text: After sneaking in through the keyhole, the snake shot through George, Shannon, and then Virgilia in an instant, completely failing to notice Beato as she used that instant to escape...
units.note: Both attach in an instant to the successive shooting rather than explicitly to Beato’s escape. MG’s that instant in the next line partially supplies the simultaneity, but retains the added shooting attachment.
units.japanese: 鍵穴より侵入し、譲治と紗音の二人を撃ち抜き、さらにワルギリアまでも撃ち抜いた黄金の蛇は、その瞬間に逃げ去ったベアトについては完全に気付けなかった…。

units.text: The snake, which had snuck in through the keyhole, shot through George and Shannon, and then shot through Virgilia in an instant, completely failed to notice as Beato escaped...
units.note: Both attach in an instant to the successive shooting rather than explicitly to Beato’s escape. MG’s that instant in the next line partially supplies the simultaneity, but retains the added shooting attachment.
units.japanese: 鍵穴より侵入し、譲治と紗音の二人を撃ち抜き、さらにワルギリアまでも撃ち抜いた黄金の蛇は、その瞬間に逃げ去ったベアトについては完全に気付けなかった…。

description: WH describes the player having been attacked by pieces, rather than the absurdity of a player descending as a god and being killed by a piece.
sourceReading: 駒に討ち取られたなんて follows she must flee lest she die, imagining the humiliating fatal outcome.

units.text: It wasn't even funny that the chess player had descended like a god, and had been attacked by the pieces.
units.note: MG restores a player descending as a god but retains merely attacked instead of killed and omits the no-laughing-matter judgment. UP restores both death and the judgment.
units.japanese: チェスのプレイヤーが、神様気取りで降臨し、駒に討ち取られたなんて、笑い話にもならないのだから。

units.text: To think that a chess player had descended, thinking they were like a god, ...only to be attacked by the pieces.
units.note: MG restores a player descending as a god but retains merely attacked instead of killed and omits the no-laughing-matter judgment. UP restores both death and the judgment.
units.japanese: チェスのプレイヤーが、神様気取りで降臨し、駒に討ち取られたなんて、笑い話にもならないのだから。

description: WH replaces the destination of Eva’s brief absence with a specific act of washing her hands.
sourceReading: お手洗いに行っている means going to the lavatory.

units.text: Something hard to believe had happened... Apparently, when Eva oba-san had left for a second to wash her hands, Krauss oji-san and Natsuhi oba-san had disappeared.
units.note: MG retains washing hands; UP restores lavatory destination.
units.japanese: 絵羽伯母さんが、ちょっとお手洗いに行っている間に、蔵臼伯父さんと夏妃伯母さんがいなくなってしまったというのだ。

units.text: Something hard to believe had happened... Apparently, when Aunt Eva had left for a second to wash her hands, Uncle Krauss and Aunt Natsuhi had disappeared.
units.note: MG retains washing hands; UP restores lavatory destination.
units.japanese: 信じ難いことが起きた…。絵羽伯母さんが、ちょっとお手洗いに行っている間に、蔵臼伯父さんと夏妃伯母さんがいなくなってしまったというのだ。

description: WH explicitly says every opening had been rigorously checked where Japanese states the closures were all secure.
sourceReading: 戸締りは全て厳重で describes stringent securing, followed separately by locks on the inside and no broken openings.

units.text: There's no way they went hiding somewhere. Of course, the doors and windows had all been rigorously checked, and all were locked from the inside.  Not one of them was broken. And that wasn't just the first floor.  The second floor was the same. Again, all of the doors and windows possessed locks which had been designed so that they couldn't be set from the outside.
units.note: Both retain an added assertion of rigorous checking rather than only securely closed and internally locked openings.
units.japanese: もちろん、戸締りは全て厳重で、内側から鍵が掛けられている。破られているものはひとつもない。

units.text: There's no way they went hiding somewhere. Of course, the doors and windows had all been rigorously checked, and all were locked from the inside. Not one of them was broken. And that wasn't just true for the first floor. The second floor was the same.
units.note: Both retain an added assertion of rigorous checking rather than only securely closed and internally locked openings.
units.japanese: どこかに隠れているわけもない。もちろん、戸締りは全て厳重で、内側から鍵が掛けられている。破られているものはひとつもない。それは１階だけじゃない、２階も同様だ。

units.text: There's no way they went hiding somewhere. Of course, the doors and windows had all been rigorously checked, and all were locked from the inside. Not one of them was broken. And that wasn't just the first floor—the second floor was the same.
units.note: Both retain an added assertion of rigorous checking rather than only securely closed and internally locked openings.
units.japanese: どこかに隠れているわけもない。もちろん、戸締りは全て厳重で、内側から鍵が掛けられている。破られているものはひとつもない。それは１階だけじゃない、２階も同様だ。

description: WH postpones Battler’s assent until the anticipated proposal to search.
sourceReading: この期に及んでは、俺もそれに賛成だ says that under the present circumstances he too agrees.

units.text: At this rate, it's only a matter of time before we start talking about leaving the guesthouse to search for them. .........When that time comes, I'll agree.
units.note: MG postpones assent to when the proposal comes; UP restores present support.
units.japanese: ………この期に及んでは、俺もそれに賛成だ。

units.text: At this rate, it's only a matter of time before we start planning to leave the guesthouse to go search for them. ......When that time comes, I'll agree.
units.note: MG postpones assent to when the proposal comes; UP restores present support.
units.japanese: このままでは、ゲストハウスを出て彼らを探しに行こうという話になるのも、時間の問題だろう。………この期に及んでは、俺もそれに賛成だ。

description: WH adds big, happy family and makes the morning’s actual confinement sound like an unrealized expectation.
sourceReading: １２人もの大所帯でここに閉じ篭ったはず recalls that they had holed up here that morning as a large group of twelve.

units.text: Since shutting ourselves up inside the guesthouse should have been safe, we should have been a big, happy family of 12 people and stayed shut in since this morning. And yet, now there were only four people here. ......In other words, it means that being here is not safe...
units.note: Both restore actual confinement that morning, but retain the unsupported happy description of the twelve-person group.
units.japanese: ゲストハウスに閉じ篭ってれば安全だと言って、俺たちは今朝、１２人もの大所帯でここに閉じ篭ったはずなんだ。

units.text: We'd thought staying holed up in the guesthouse would be safe, which was why our big, happy group of 12 people locked themselves up here this morning. And yet, now there's only four of us left. ...That means staying here is no guarantee of safety...
units.note: Both restore actual confinement that morning, but retain the unsupported happy description of the twelve-person group.
units.japanese: ゲストハウスに閉じ篭ってれば安全だと言って、俺たちは今朝、１２人もの大所帯でここに閉じ篭ったはずなんだ。なのにそれが、今やここには４人しかいない。……つまり、ここにいることが安全を意味したりはしないのだ…。

units.text: We said that shutting ourselves up inside the guesthouse would be safe, and shut ourselves in this morning as a big, happy family of twelve people. And yet, now there are only four people here. ......In other words, being here does not imply safety...
units.note: Both restore actual confinement that morning, but retain the unsupported happy description of the twelve-person group.
units.japanese: ゲストハウスに閉じ篭ってれば安全だと言って、俺たちは今朝、１２人もの大所帯でここに閉じ篭ったはずなんだ。なのにそれが、今やここには４人しかいない。……つまり、ここにいることが安全を意味したりはしないのだ…。

description: WH asks how they hid themselves away and uses hid after had, replacing the source’s neutral disappearance with self-concealment.
sourceReading: 姿を消した asks how they vanished from this place.

units.text: However, ...before that, there was something that we must not forget. That was the fact that all of the doors and windows were locked from the inside. ......This is a closed room. How had they hid themselves away from this place?
units.note: Both restore neutral vanishing and avoid had hid.
units.japanese: どうやって彼らはここから姿を消したというのか。

description: WH says the trick is not effective at all, strengthening Battler’s assessment beyond the source.
sourceReading: 大して有効ではない means not particularly effective with so few survivors, contrasted with possible usefulness when more survive.

units.text: .........To say it the other way around, the more survivors there are, the more effective this trick might be, but since our numbers have shrunk so much, it isn't effective at all."
units.note: MG retains not effective at all; UP restores not particularly effective. The trailing at all does not erase UP’s limiting particularly.
units.japanese: ………逆に言えば、このトリックは、もっと生存者が多ければ有効かもしれないが、これだけ人数が減った状況下では、大して有効ではないんだ。」

units.text: "......To say it the other way around, the more survivors there are, the more effective this trick might be, but since our numbers have shrunk so much, it isn't effective at all."
units.note: MG retains not effective at all; UP restores not particularly effective. The trailing at all does not erase UP’s limiting particularly.
units.japanese: 「………逆に言えば、このトリックは、もっと生存者が多ければ有効かもしれないが、これだけ人数が減った状況下では、大して有効ではないんだ」

description: WH renders the self-defeating idiom as a chance of having your own neck strangled, losing the explicit action of putting oneself in difficulty.
sourceReading: 自分の首を絞める here means the trick can work against its own user by narrowing suspicion onto that user.

units.text: ...No, to the contrary, there would be a chance of having your own neck strangled. ......It should have been more expedient to make it look like the culprit was outside, and to intentionally leave a door unlocked, or break a window...
units.note: MG adds by using it but retains passive neck-strangulation wording; UP restores self-defeating agency with dig their own grave.
units.japanese: …いや、それどころか、自分の首を絞める可能性だってある。
candidates: chance of having your own neck strangled

units.text: ...No, on the contrary, there'd be a chance of having your own neck strangled by using it. ...It would have been more advantageous to make it look like the culprit was outside, to intentionally leave a door unlocked or break a window...
units.note: MG adds by using it but retains passive neck-strangulation wording; UP restores self-defeating agency with dig their own grave.
units.japanese: …いや、それどころか、自分の首を絞める可能性だってある。……むしろ、外に犯人がいるように見せ掛けるため、わざと鍵を開け放したり、窓を破ったりした方が好都合なはずなのだ…。
candidates: chance of having your own neck strangled

description: WH repeats he was in it looked like he was he was trying.
sourceReading: Japanese gives a single description of Nanjo apparently suppressing the frightening thoughts rising in him.

units.text: As Doctor Nanjo shook with fear, it looked like he was he was trying to erase the fearsome thoughts that he kept imagining one after the other.
units.note: Both retain the duplicated he was in narrative prose.
units.japanese: 南條先生はわなわなと震えながら、沸き起こる恐ろしい想像を次々に掻き消しているようだった。
candidates: looked like he was he was trying

units.text: As Doctor Nanjo shook with fear, it looked like he was he was trying to erase the fearsome thoughts that he kept imagining one after the other.
units.note: Both retain the duplicated he was in narrative prose.
units.japanese: 南條先生はわなわなと震えながら、沸き起こる恐ろしい想像を次々に掻き消しているようだった。
candidates: looked like he was he was trying

units.text: As Doctor Nanjo shook with fear, it looked like he was he was trying to erase the fearsome thoughts that he kept imagining, one after the other.
units.note: Both retain the duplicated he was in narrative prose.
units.japanese: 南條先生はわなわなと震えながら、沸き起こる恐ろしい想像を次々に掻き消しているようだった。
candidates: looked like he was he was trying

description: WH says Battler has been shut inside for a long time, losing his explicit declaration that he has had enough of confinement.
sourceReading: もう、引き篭もりはたくさんだぜ is a fed-up refusal to continue holing up, followed by the desire for outside air.

units.text: ".........I've been shut up inside for a long time already.  ...I've started wanting to breathe some outside air."
units.note: MG retains duration instead of the explicit fed-up refusal; UP restores had enough.
units.japanese: 「………もう、引き篭もりはたくさんだぜ。…俺も外の空気を吸いたくなってきた。」

units.text: "......I've been shut up inside for a long time already. ...I've started wanting to breathe some outside air."
units.note: MG retains duration instead of the explicit fed-up refusal; UP restores had enough.
units.japanese: 「………もう、引き篭りはたくさんだぜ。…俺も外の空気を吸いたくなってきた」

description: WH asserts the parents had days enjoying tea together where Battler only imagines they might have.
sourceReading: 二人でお茶を飲んでくつろぐ日もあったのかもしれない speculates about possible peaceful days in the arbor.

units.text: Normally, the arbor was probably a wonderful location to enjoy tea peacefully while appreciating the roses on a good sunny day. ......Unexpectedly, even Krauss oji-san and Natsuhi oba-san, had their days where they relaxed and enjoyed their tea together there.
units.note: Both explicitly mark imagined shared tea days with maybe.
units.japanese: ……案外、あの蔵臼伯父さんと夏妃伯母さんにも、そこで二人でお茶を飲んでくつろぐ日もあったのかもしれない。

description: WH tells Jessica and the children they had better stay, removing the source’s if-you-want-to condition.
sourceReading: 朱志香ちゃんたちは、ここにいたければいるといい permits Jessica and her companions to remain if they wish while Eva searches the mansion.

units.text: "......We still, ...haven't found George.  ...Jessica, you children better stay here.  I'll go in the mansion."
units.note: MG retains had better stay; UP restores if you want at row 42. The later separate recommendation to remain beside the parents is present in the Japanese.
units.japanese: 「………まだ、…譲治が見つかってないわ。…朱志香ちゃんたちは、ここにいたければいるといい。私は屋敷へ行くわ。」

units.text: "...We still...haven't found George. ...Jessica, you children had better stay here. I'll go into the mansion."
units.note: MG retains had better stay; UP restores if you want at row 42. The later separate recommendation to remain beside the parents is present in the Japanese.
units.japanese: 「………まだ、…譲治が見つかってないわ。…朱志香ちゃんたちは、ここにいたければいるといい。私は屋敷へ行くわ」

description: WH suggests Jessica has broken free from grief rather than reached a stopping point in its immediate expression.
sourceReading: 悲しみに一区切りがついたのだろう imagines grief has reached a temporary division or pause, before the anger that now occupies her face.

units.text: In the end, we had no choice but to console Jessica and head for the mansion together. ...Fortunately, Jessica stood up. Perhaps she had been able to break free from her grief. ......But, what had surfaced in its place was an expression like a demon.
units.note: MG retains break free from grief; UP limits the stopping point to the moment, consistent with continuing anger and bereavement.
units.japanese: 悲しみに一区切りがついたのだろう。

units.text: In the end, we had no choice but to console Jessica and head for the mansion together. ...Fortunately, Jessica stood up. Perhaps she had been able to break free from her grief. ...But...what had surfaced in its place was an expression like a demon's.
units.note: MG retains break free from grief; UP limits the stopping point to the moment, consistent with continuing anger and bereavement.
units.japanese: 結局、俺たちは、朱志香を慰めて、全員で屋敷に行く他なかった。…幸い、朱志香は立ち上がってくれた。悲しみに一区切りがついたのだろう。……しかし、代わりに浮かべている形相はまるで鬼のそれだ。

description: WH explains the written record as a difficult code to break rather than a number difficult to memorize.
sourceReading: 規則性でもない限り、ちょっと暗記では難しい says eight digits are hard to commit to memory without a pattern.

units.text: Even though she said that, she probably suspected that it might actually mean something. Using an old receipt or something from inside her pocket, Eva oba-san deftly wrote that number down with a short ballpoint pen. Without any kind of pattern, that eight digit number would probably be a pretty difficult code to break.
units.note: Both restore difficulty memorizing rather than breaking a code. MG’s code noun does not change the explicit memorization rationale.
units.japanese: ８桁の数字では、何か規則性でもない限り、ちょっと暗記では難しいだろうから。

description: WH asserts the digits use the same paint as the magic circle instead of identifying this as likely.
sourceReading: 同じ塗料だろうが is conjectural about common paint; 明らか explicitly establishes recent application in the next clause.

units.text: It was drawn with the same paint as the magic circle, ...but it had clearly been written very recently. The way it had dried and the condition of the color was completely different from the magic circle part.
units.note: MG asserts identical paint; UP explicitly restores probably. Both preserve recent writing inferred from different drying and color.
units.japanese: 魔法陣を描いたのと同じ塗料だろうが、…明らかについ最近、記されたものだ。
candidates: same paint as the magic circle

units.text: It was drawn with the same paint as the magic circle, ...but it had clearly been written very recently. The way it had dried and the condition of the color was completely different from the magic circle part.
units.note: MG asserts identical paint; UP explicitly restores probably. Both preserve recent writing inferred from different drying and color.
units.japanese: 魔法陣を描いたのと同じ塗料だろうが、…明らかについ最近、記されたものだ。魔法陣の部分と乾き方や色の具合がまったく違った。
candidates: same paint as the magic circle

description: WH says had been there here this morning, duplicating incompatible location wording.
sourceReading: Japanese reports that only the magic circle was drawn as of morning.

units.text: From what the two of them said, only the magic circle had been there here this morning. However, right now, there were eight digits written in the upper part of the magic circle. 07151129.
units.note: MG removes the duplicate here; UP retains there here.
units.japanese: 二人が言うには、朝の時点では、魔法陣だけが描かれていたという。

units.text: From what the two of them said, only a magic circle had been there here this morning. However, right now, there were eight digits newly written in the upper part of the magic circle.
units.note: MG removes the duplicate here; UP retains there here.
units.japanese: 二人が言うには、朝の時点では、魔法陣だけが描かれていたという。しかし、今そこの魔法陣には、その上辺りに、８桁の数字が新たに記されていた。

description: WH replaces Eva’s renewed clinging to George with crouching beside him.
sourceReading: 再び譲治の兄貴にしがみ付く describes again physically clinging to her son after pushing Nanjo aside.

units.text: Brushing him aside, Eva oba-san once again crouched beside George-aniki, and started crying at the top of her lungs...
units.note: Both retain crouching beside George rather than clinging to him again.
units.japanese: それを押しのけ、絵羽伯母さんは再び譲治の兄貴にしがみ付くと、あらん限りの声を張り上げて泣き叫んだ…。

units.text: Brushing him aside, Aunt Eva once again crouched beside George-aniki... and started crying at the top of her lungs...
units.note: Both retain crouching beside George rather than clinging to him again.
units.japanese: それを押しのけ、絵羽伯母さんは再び譲治の兄貴にしがみ付くと、あらん限りの声を張り上げて泣き叫んだ…。

units.text: Brushing him aside, Auntie Eva once again crouched beside George‐aniki, and started crying at the top of her lungs...
units.note: Both retain crouching beside George rather than clinging to him again.
units.japanese: それを押しのけ、絵羽伯母さんは再び譲治の兄貴にしがみ付くと、あらん限りの声を張り上げて泣き叫んだ…。

description: WH turns Battler’s approximate hourly victim rate into they probably were not killed with the speed of a single person.
sourceReading: 時速１人くらいのスピードで殺されてるんじゃねぇだろうか conjectures approximately one victim per hour; the negative-shaped question is tentative affirmation.

units.text: Dad and Kyrie-san died, and starting with the servants, people have been killed off one by one. ...And there's been a hell of a lot of them by now. I don't know what time the first murders started, ...but they probably weren't killed with the speed of a single person.
units.note: Both explicitly restore an approximate rate of one person per hour.
units.japanese: 最初の殺人が何時の時点で始まったか知らねぇが、…それこそ、時速１人くらいのスピードで殺されてるんじゃねぇだろうか。
candidates: killed with the speed of a single person

description: WH drops the explicit more-than relation from the time remaining before the expected boat.
sourceReading: まだ１２時間以上もたっぷりある says there are still more than twelve hours, abundantly, until around nine tomorrow.

units.text: We believe that the boat will come for us around 9:00 tomorrow. ......There's still a full 12 hours until then. ...How many more sacrifices to the witch will there have to be for us to survive...?
units.note: Both retain a full twelve hours without the source’s explicit more than twelve.
units.japanese: ……それまで、まだ１２時間以上もたっぷりあるんだぞ。

units.text: We believe that the boat will come for us around 9:00 tomorrow. ...There's still a full 12 hours until then. ...How many more sacrifices to the witch will there have to be for us to survive...?
units.note: Both retain a full twelve hours without the source’s explicit more than twelve.
units.japanese: 明日の９時くらいに、船が迎えに来てくれると俺たちは信じている。……それまで、まだ１２時間以上もたっぷりあるんだぞ。…あと、魔女の生贄が何人いてくれりゃ、俺たちは生き残れるってんだ…。

units.text: We believe that the boat will come for us around nine tomorrow. ......There's still a full twelve hours until then. ...How many more sacrifices to the witch would there have to be for us to survive...?
units.note: Both retain a full twelve hours without the source’s explicit more than twelve.
units.japanese: 明日の９時くらいに、船が迎えに来てくれると俺たちは信じている。……それまで、まだ１２時間以上もたっぷりあるんだぞ。…あと、魔女の生贄が何人いてくれりゃ、俺たちは生き残れるってんだ…。

description: WH introduces an effort to project toughness where Battler labels his father fearless or reckless.
sourceReading: 怖い者知らずの親父 characterizes the father who, Battler guesses, complained of hunger; it does not describe pretending or trying to look tough.

units.text: ............Why did Dad and Kyrie-san, ...even go outside? It's not like we'd die from being without food for a day. ...And yet, why did gluttony get ahold of them and make them go to get food? ......I'll bet that Dad was trying to act tough and started complaining about being hungry...
units.note: Both restore fearless father rather than an effort to act tough.
units.japanese: ……どうせ、怖い者知らずの親父が、腹が減ったと騒いだに決まってるんだ…。

description: WH says Jessica knew how George slipped out of the mansion; Eva’s Japanese accuses her of knowing he slipped out of the guesthouse.
sourceReading: 譲治がこっそりゲストハウスを抜け出すのを is knowledge of George’s secret guesthouse departure, following the first/second-floor dispute there.

units.text: He didn't come down to the first floor, right?!  So did he disappear from the second floor?!  Who was on the second floor?!  You people were there, right?!!  You knew, didn't you?!  You knew how George slipped out of the mansion!!  You brazenly made a face as if you didn't know anything!!  If you had stopped George, he would, ......he would...!!!"
units.note: Both restore guesthouse as the place George slipped out of, and knowing that rather than knowing how.
units.japanese: あなたは知ってたんでしょう？！　譲治がこっそりゲストハウスを抜け出すのを！！　それを自分は何も知らないような顔をぬけぬけとッ！！　あんたが譲治を止めててくれれば、譲治は、……譲治はッ！！！」
candidates: knew how George slipped out of the mansion

description: WH’s first observation says Jessica had fallen on the floor rather than describing her rolling about while covering her eyes.
sourceReading: 床を転げまわっていた gives continuing movement expressing pain after the gunshot.

units.text: The sudden sound of a gunshot shook me out of my half-asleep trance. ...Smoke was rising out of the barrel of the gun Eva oba-san held. Jessica had fallen on the floor, covering both her eyes. Eva oba-san and Doctor Nanjo were looking down at her, shocked...
units.note: MG’s initial observation still substitutes falling to the floor, although the later rolling description is retained; UP restores rolling in both observations.
units.japanese: 朱志香が両目を覆いながら床を転げまわっていた。
candidates: Jessica had fallen on the floor

units.text: The sudden sound of a gunshot shook me out of my half-asleep trance. ...Smoke was rising out of the barrel of the gun Aunt Eva held. Jessica had fallen to the floor and was covering both her eyes. Aunt Eva and Doctor Nanjo were looking down at her in shock...
units.note: MG’s initial observation still substitutes falling to the floor, although the later rolling description is retained; UP restores rolling in both observations.
units.japanese: 突然の銃声に、俺の寝惚けた意識は吹っ飛ぶ。…絵羽伯母さんが抱く銃の銃口から、紫煙が立ち上っている。朱志香が両目を覆いながら床を転げまわっていた。それを、呆然としながら、絵羽伯母さんと南條先生が見下ろしている…。

description: WH asks whether an impact caused the trigger to be pulled, introducing a particular physical cause.
sourceReading: 何かの拍子に means at some moment or through some chance occurrence during the struggle; it does not specify an impact.

units.text: Jessica had grabbed at Eva oba-san, and it had turned into a scuffle... Had they then started fighting over the gun Eva oba-san had been holding? Did some kind of impact cause the trigger to be pulled...?
units.note: MG specifies an impact as the proposed trigger cause; UP’s some movement or other preserves an unspecified circumstance. Both retain the question and uncertainty about the injury mechanism.
units.japanese: それで何かの拍子に引き金が引かれてしまったということなのか…。

units.text: So, did Jessica grab at Aunt Eva, which turned into a scuffle...? Did they start fighting over Aunt Eva's gun? Did some kind of impact cause the trigger to be pulled...?
units.note: MG specifies an impact as the proposed trigger cause; UP’s some movement or other preserves an unspecified circumstance. Both retain the question and uncertainty about the injury mechanism.
units.japanese: 朱志香が、絵羽伯母さんに掴み掛かって、取っ組み合いになって…。それで絵羽伯母さんが持っていた銃が奪い合いみたいな形になって？それで何かの拍子に引き金が引かれてしまったということなのか…。

description: WH asks whether Eva is suicidal, while Battler calls being alone here an extremely dangerous, suicidal action.
sourceReading: 自殺行為もいいとこだ evaluates the risk of separation in this mansion, not a wish to kill oneself.

units.text: I was also worried about Jessica's condition, but anyways, right then, I couldn't leave Eva oba-san alone. Why would she go off on her own in this mansion, of all places?  Is she suicidal...?!
units.note: Both retain a question about suicidal intent instead of directly evaluating solitary movement as a suicidal action. Surrounding danger context remains.
units.japanese: よりにもよって、この屋敷の中でひとりになるなんて、自殺行為もいいとこだ…！

units.text: I was also worried about Jessica's condition, but right then, I couldn't leave Aunt Eva alone. Why would she go off on her own in this mansion, of all places? Is she suicidal...?!
units.note: Both retain a question about suicidal intent instead of directly evaluating solitary movement as a suicidal action. Surrounding danger context remains.
units.japanese: 朱志香の容態も気になったが、とにかく今は絵羽伯母さんをひとりにさせてはいけない。よりにもよって、この屋敷の中でひとりになるなんて、自殺行為もいいとこだ…！

units.text: I was also worried about Jessica's condition, but anyway, right then, I couldn't leave Auntie Eva alone. Why would she go off on her own in this mansion, of all places? Is she suicidal...?!
units.note: Both retain a question about suicidal intent instead of directly evaluating solitary movement as a suicidal action. Surrounding danger context remains.
units.japanese: 朱志香の容態も気になったが、とにかく今は絵羽伯母さんをひとりにさせてはいけない。よりにもよって、この屋敷の中でひとりになるなんて、自殺行為もいいとこだ…！

description: WH categorically states no threat to her life rather than the source’s provisional assessment.
sourceReading: 命に別状はないだろうが says the injury probably does not endanger life, followed by need for prompt appropriate medical examination.

units.text: The barrel had probably been near her eyes. There was a possibility that the flames from the discharge had injured her corneas. ...There was no threat to her life, but it would probably be necessary to have a suitable doctor look at her as soon as possible.
units.note: Both categorically deny a threat to life rather than retaining the source’s provisional assessment. The following specialist-care necessity remains probabilistic.
units.japanese: …命に別状はないだろうが、一刻も早く、然るべき医者に見せる必要があるだろう。

units.text: The barrel had probably been near her eyes. There was a possibility that the flames from the discharge had injured her corneas. ...There was no threat to her life, but it would probably be necessary to take her to a doctor as soon as possible.
units.note: Both categorically deny a threat to life rather than retaining the source’s provisional assessment. The following specialist-care necessity remains probabilistic.
units.japanese:
銃口に目が近かったのだろう。
発砲の時の炎で、角膜を傷付けた可能性がある。…命に別状はないだろうが、一刻も早く、然るべき医者に見せる必要があるだろう。

units.text:
The barrel had probably been near her eyes.
There was a possibility that the flames from the discharge had damaged her corneas. ...There was no threat to her life, but it would probably be necessary to have a suitable doctor look at her as soon as humanly possible.
units.note: Both categorically deny a threat to life rather than retaining the source’s provisional assessment. The following specialist-care necessity remains probabilistic.
units.japanese:
銃口に目が近かったのだろう。
発砲の時の炎で、角膜を傷付けた可能性がある。…命に別状はないだろうが、一刻も早く、然るべき医者に見せる必要があるだろう。

description: WH turns the separate effects on her eyes and appearance into doing nothing good for the beauty of her eyes.
sourceReading: 目にはもちろん、美容にもよくありません says frowning is bad for the eyes, naturally, and also for beauty: a medical warning softened with an appearance joke.

units.text: So for now, Jessica-san, you should devote yourself to resting your body and keeping your eyes safe.  ...Of course, if you wrinkle your forehead too much, it will do nothing good for the beauty of your eyes."
units.note: Both separately identify harm to the eyes and to appearance rather than beauty of the eyes.
units.japanese: だから朱志香さんは、今は体を休め、目を楽にすることに専念するのです。…あまり眉間にしわを寄せては、目にはもちろん、美容にもよくありませんぞ。」

description: WH calls blindness a fact where Japanese describes fear that she might lose her sight.
sourceReading: 失明するかもしれない恐れ contrasts possible blindness with the more pressing fear of never seeing Kanon’s face before removal of his body.

units.text: Jessica was now less fearful about the fact that she was blinded, and more frightened that the police would carry Kanon's body away while she still couldn't see, and that she would have to say her final farewell without being able to see his face.
units.note: MG retains blindness as a fact; UP restores fear that she might go blind.
units.japanese: 今の朱志香には、失明するかもしれない恐れよりも、目が見えない内に嘉音の死体が警察に運び出され、その顔を見ることもできず、お別れすることになるかもしれない方を恐れていた。

units.text: Jessica was now less fearful about the fact that she was blinded, and more frightened that the police would carry Kanon's body away while she still couldn't see, and that she would have to say her final farewell without being able to look at his face.
units.note: MG retains blindness as a fact; UP restores fear that she might go blind.
units.japanese: 今の朱志香には、失明するかもしれない恐れよりも、目が見えない内に嘉音の死体が警察に運び出され、その顔を見ることもできず、お別れすることになるかもしれない方を恐れていた。

description: WH writes I hope she is not to shaken by this, using to where too is required.
sourceReading: Nanjo hopes Eva is not unduly distressed.

units.text: "...............Well then, now I am worried more about Eva-san.  I hope she isn't to shaken by this."
units.note: Both correct to shaken to too shaken.
units.japanese: 「………………。…さて、今度は絵羽さんの方が心配です。気に病まれていなければ良いのですが。」

description: WH locates the threat to Nanjo’s life just a second ago instead of stating he is being threatened right now.
sourceReading: たった今、生命を脅かされている is an ongoing present threat inferred from his frightened voice.

units.text: Jessica couldn't do anything except call out from the bed. ...Judging by the tone of his voice, Nanjo was in the corridor, confronting someone. And he was scared. His life must have been threatened just a second ago.
units.note: MG retains just a second ago; UP restores the current threat at this very moment.
units.japanese: 彼がたった今、生命を脅かされているのは間違いなかった。

units.text: Jessica couldn't do anything except call out from the bed. ...Judging by the tone of his voice, Nanjo was in the corridor, confronting someone. And he was scared. His life must have been threatened just a second ago.
units.note: MG retains just a second ago; UP restores the current threat at this very moment.
units.japanese:
朱志香はベッドの上から、呼び掛けるしかない。
…声の加減を聞く限り、南條は廊下にいて、何者かと対峙しているのだ。そして怯えている。彼がたった今、生命を脅かされているのは間違いなかった。

description: WH makes Jessica ask whether someone is there where she demands to know who is there.
sourceReading: そこに誰がいるんだよ asks the identity of the person in Nanjo’s location, followed by a demand for an answer.

units.text: "Doctor Nanjo!!  Doctor Nanjo!!  Is someone there?!  Answer me!!"
units.note: MG retains whether anyone is there; UP restores asking who is there.
units.japanese: そこに誰がいるんだよ？！　返事をしろよ！！」

units.text: "Doctor Nanjo!! Doctor Nanjo!! Is someone there?! Answer me!!"
units.note: MG retains whether anyone is there; UP restores asking who is there.
units.japanese: 「南條先生！！　南條先生！！　そこに誰がいるんだよ？！　返事をしろよ！！」

description: WH substitutes a candy jar and candy for things like confectionery tins and bottles stacked on the shelf.
sourceReading: 菓子缶や瓶のようなもの names hard containers falling and striking her head, with uncertainty about precise objects.

units.text: She searched around with her hands, trying to find some way to escape. But even though she should have known this room well, just being unable to see made it like a closed room of darkness. She ran into a shelf or something, and something like a candy jar and candy fell down, hitting her on the head.
units.note: MG restores bottles and removes loose candy but retains jars rather than confectionery tins. UP restores tins of sweets and bottles.
units.japanese: 棚か何かにぶつかってしまい、その上に積んであった菓子缶や瓶のようなものが降ってきて、彼女の頭にぶつかる。

units.text: She searched around with her hands, trying to find some way to escape. But even though she should have known this room well, just being unable to see made it like a closed room of darkness. She ran into a shelf or something, and things like a candy jars and bottles fell down, hitting her on the head.
units.note: MG restores bottles and removes loose candy but retains jars rather than confectionery tins. UP restores tins of sweets and bottles.
units.japanese: 何とか逃れようと、手探りで辺りを探る。しかし、よく知るはずの部屋は、目が見えなくなっただけで、暗黒の密室も同然だ。棚か何かにぶつかってしまい、その上に積んであった菓子缶や瓶のようなものが降ってきて、彼女の頭にぶつかる。

description: WH says it was doubtful she would protect her head rather than that even managing to shield it was difficult.
sourceReading: 頭を守ることすらおぼつかない describes uncertain ability or impaired coordination preventing a defensive action.

units.text: ...As she was now, it was doubtful that she would even protect her head to block it. ...She was painfully aware of how powerless humans become just by losing their sense of sight. Of course, she had no time to admire that.
units.note: Both restore difficulty managing to protect her head rather than doubting she would try.
units.japanese: …今の彼女には、それを防ぐために頭を守ることすらおぼつかない。

description: WH says you are very much hated for that, reversing Ronove’s statement that Beato strongly dislikes romantic love.
sourceReading: お嬢様はとてもそれを嫌われます uses honorific active 嫌われます: Milady dislikes the previously discussed romantic feeling.

units.text: "......Love is the single element.  Romantic love is even more pure, more sacred.  ...For some reason, you are very much hated for that, Milady."
units.note: Both restore Beato as the person who dislikes romantic love.
units.japanese: 「……愛とは一なる元素。恋心はそれ以上に純粋で、尊いものでございます。…なぜかお嬢様はとてもそれを嫌われますが。」

description: WH says she may save Jessica, omitting that Jessica alone may be rescuable through this means.
sourceReading: 朱志香だけは救えるかもしれぬ links limited power and borrowing feelings to this particular rescue opportunity.

units.text: "......Hmm.  ...And for that very reason, I may be able to save Jessica.
units.note: MG omits the limiting scope entirely; UP adds at least, preserving a minimum rescue prospect but not explicitly Jessica alone as the person whose feelings permit this method.
units.japanese: 「……うむ。…だからこそ、朱志香だけは救えるかもしれぬのだ。

units.text: "...Indeed. ...And for that very reason, I may be able to save Jessica.
units.note: MG omits the limiting scope entirely; UP adds at least, preserving a minimum rescue prospect but not explicitly Jessica alone as the person whose feelings permit this method.
units.japanese: 「……うむ。…だからこそ、朱志香だけは救えるかもしれぬのだ」

units.text: "......Mm. ...And for that very reason, I may be able to save Jessica at least."
units.note: MG omits the limiting scope entirely; UP adds at least, preserving a minimum rescue prospect but not explicitly Jessica alone as the person whose feelings permit this method.
units.japanese: 「……うむ。…だからこそ、朱志香だけは救えるかもしれぬのだ」

description: WH adds through that door to the equal-number-of-lives condition for atonement.
sourceReading: 同じ数だけの命を救うことでしか贖えぬのかもしれぬ proposes saving as many lives as she has taken, without specifying a method.

units.text: "...I know.  .........By now, I have toyed with and taken more lives than I can count.  ...So I may not be able to compensate except by saving the same number of lives through that door.
units.note: MG retains bringing the saved lives through that door; UP removes the unsupported route requirement.
units.japanese: 「…承知しておるわ。………妾はこれまで、数えることも出来ぬほどの命を弄び、奪ってきた。…ならばその罪は、同じ数だけの命を救うことでしか贖えぬのかもしれぬ。

units.text: "...I know. ......By now, I have toyed with and taken more lives than I can count. ...So, I may not be able to make up for it...except by saving the same number of lives, bringing them through that door."
units.note: MG retains bringing the saved lives through that door; UP removes the unsupported route requirement.
units.japanese: 「…承知しておるわ。………妾はこれまで、数えることも出来ぬほどの命を弄び、奪ってきた。…ならばその罪は、同じ数だけの命を救うことでしか贖えぬのかもしれぬ」

description: WH asks if something happens to end it here, obscuring Ronove’s explicit risk that Beato herself may perish.
sourceReading: ここで果てるようなことがあっても良いのですか addresses her dying here and then her duty to return to Battler’s opposite seat.

units.text: ...Is it alright if something happens to end it here?  ...You have a duty to return to the seat across from Battler-sama, Milady."
units.note: MG now addresses Beato’s satisfaction in ending it here but still leaves her own death implicit; UP explicitly says expire here.
units.japanese: …ここで果てるようなことがあっても良いのですか。…お嬢様には、戦人さまの向かいの席に戻る、義務があるのですよ。」

units.text: ...Are you truly satisfied to end it here? ...You have a duty to return to the seat across from Battler-sama, Milady."
units.note: MG now addresses Beato’s satisfaction in ending it here but still leaves her own death implicit; UP explicitly says expire here.
units.japanese: 「…ここで果てるようなことがあっても良いのですか。…お嬢様には、戦人さまの向かいの席に戻る、義務があるのですよ」

description: WH asks whether Kanon will come back when she goes to safety instead of whether he will go away or return to the dead.
sourceReading: そこに行ったら…帰っちゃうの asks whether reaching the destination will mean his leaving her; his silence prompts her refusal to go.

units.text: "............If I go there, ...will you, ...come back, Kanon-kun......?"
units.note: Both restore Kanon leaving after arrival at safety rather than coming back.
units.japanese:
「…………そこに行ったら、
…嘉音くんは、
………帰っちゃうの……？」

description: WH adds much more often to the girl’s unspoken declaration, replacing stronger affection with frequency of confession.
sourceReading: もっともっと大好きだよ is the content she lacked courage to tell the boy: she loves him still more, or very much more.

units.text: "............Yes...  Then, ...me too.  .........The story of a cowardly girl, ......who couldn't muster the courage, ......to tell the boy she loved that she did love him, much, much more often.  ......And, ......the story of how that girl, after being given a miracle by god to be reunited with that boy, .........used that chance to muster up her courage."
units.note: MG retains more often; UP restores depth of affection but retains unsupported iterative keep telling.
units.japanese: 「……………うん…。なら、…私もしたいよ。………大好きな男の子にね、……もっともっと大好きだよって、……勇気を振り絞れなかった臆病な女の子の話を。……そして、……その男の子に再会できる奇跡を神様が下さって、…………その勇気を振り絞る機会を、もう一度与えてもらった女の子が、………勇気を振り絞る話を。」

units.text: "......Yes... Then, ...I want to tell you a story too. ......It's the story of a cowardly girl...who couldn't muster the courage... to tell the boy she loved how she felt...much, much more often.
