units.note: MG retains more often; UP restores depth of affection but retains unsupported iterative keep telling.
units.japanese:
「……………うん…。なら、…私もしたいよ。………大好きな男の子にね、……もっともっと大好きだよって、……勇気を振り絞れなかった臆病な女の子の話を」
「……そして、……その男の子に再会できる奇跡を神様が下さって、…………その勇気を振り絞る機会を、もう一度与えてもらった女の子が、………勇気を振り絞る話を」

units.text: ......The story of how that girl, after being reunited with that boy by a miracle from god, ......used that chance to finally muster up her courage."
units.note: MG retains more often; UP restores depth of affection but retains unsupported iterative keep telling.
units.japanese:
「……………うん…。なら、…私もしたいよ。………大好きな男の子にね、……もっともっと大好きだよって、……勇気を振り絞れなかった臆病な女の子の話を」
「……そして、……その男の子に再会できる奇跡を神様が下さって、…………その勇気を振り絞る機会を、もう一度与えてもらった女の子が、………勇気を振り絞る話を」

units.text: "...............Yeah... Then, ...I want to tell one too. .........The story of a cowardly girl, ......who couldn't muster her courage... ...to keep telling the boy she loved just how much she loved him."
units.note: MG retains more often; UP restores depth of affection but retains unsupported iterative keep telling.
units.japanese:
「……………うん…。なら、…私もしたいよ。………大好きな男の子にね、……もっともっと大好きだよって、……勇気を振り絞れなかった臆病な女の子の話を」
「……そして、……その男の子に再会できる奇跡を神様が下さって、…………その勇気を振り絞る機会を、もう一度与えてもらった女の子が、………勇気を振り絞る話を」

units.text: "......And, ......about how God gave her a miracle to be reunited with that boy, ............and how, when she was given one more chance to muster up her courage, .........she did."
units.note: MG retains more often; UP restores depth of affection but retains unsupported iterative keep telling.
units.japanese:
「……………うん…。なら、…私もしたいよ。………大好きな男の子にね、……もっともっと大好きだよって、……勇気を振り絞れなかった臆病な女の子の話を」
「……そして、……その男の子に再会できる奇跡を神様が下さって、…………その勇気を振り絞る機会を、もう一度与えてもらった女の子が、………勇気を振り絞る話を」

description: WH omits about from the initial ten-step instruction toward the sofa.
sourceReading: １０歩ほど gives approximately ten steps, after which she will touch the sofa and follow it.

units.text: "Please walk 10 steps in that direction.  You will touch the sofa.  Please continue along that.  ......Do it slowly.  ......Stay calm.  Believe my words."
units.note: Both omit about from the first ten-step instruction. UP restores slowly, which does not correct the lost approximation.
units.japanese: 「そのままゆっくり１０歩ほどを歩いて下さい。ソファーに触ります。それに沿って進んでください。……ゆっくりと。……落ち着いて。僕の言葉を信じて。」

units.text: "Please walk 10 steps in that direction. You will touch the sofa. Please continue along that. ...Do it slowly. ...Stay calm. Believe in my words."
units.note: Both omit about from the first ten-step instruction. UP restores slowly, which does not correct the lost approximation.
units.japanese: 「そのままゆっくり１０歩ほどを歩いて下さい。ソファーに触ります。それに沿って進んでください。……ゆっくりと。……落ち着いて。僕の言葉を信じて」

units.text: "Please walk ten steps, slowly, in the direction you're facing. You will touch the sofa. Please continue along that. ......Do it slowly. ......Stay calm. Believe my words."
units.note: Both omit about from the first ten-step instruction. UP restores slowly, which does not correct the lost approximation.
units.japanese: 「そのままゆっくり１０歩ほどを歩いて下さい。ソファーに触ります。それに沿って進んでください。……ゆっくりと。……落ち着いて。僕の言葉を信じて」

description: WH places the witch just around the corner where Japanese places her immediately alongside the escape route.
sourceReading: そのすぐ脇 locates her right beside them while she looks at Nanjo’s body and fails to notice them.

units.text: Very quietly, Jessica and Kanon slowly snuck out of the servant room. Just around the corner, the witch could be seen cruelly looking down at Nanjo's corpse, but the witch did not even notice their presence.
units.note: Both retain around the corner rather than immediately alongside the escape route.
units.japanese: そのすぐ脇では、南條の死体を残酷に見下ろす魔女の姿があったが、魔女はその気配に気付きもしない。

units.text: Very quietly, Jessica and Kanon slowly snuck out of the servant room. Just around the corner, the witch could be seen cruelly looking down at Nanjo's corpse, but she didn't even notice their presence.
units.note: Both retain around the corner rather than immediately alongside the escape route.
units.japanese: 朱志香と嘉音が、静かに静かに、ゆっくりと使用人室を抜け出す。そのすぐ脇では、南條の死体を残酷に見下ろす魔女の姿があったが、魔女はその気配に気付きもしない。

units.text: Quietly, quietly, Jessica and Kanon snuck slowly out of the servant room. Directly around the corner, the witch could be seen cruelly looking down upon Nanjo's corpse, but the witch did not even notice their presence.
units.note: Both retain around the corner rather than immediately alongside the escape route.
units.japanese: 朱志香と嘉音が、静かに静かに、ゆっくりと使用人室を抜け出す。そのすぐ脇では、南條の死体を残酷に見下ろす魔女の姿があったが、魔女はその気配に気付きもしない。

description: WH places Ronove at her side instead of attending behind her.
sourceReading: その後に控える gives his position behind the witch as he meets Kanon’s eyes.

units.text: However, Ronove, who was waiting at her side, met Kanon's eyes. ...Kanon thought 'oh no', grimacing and blocking Jessica with his back.
units.note: Both retain at/by her side instead of attending behind her.
units.japanese: しかし、その後に控えるロノウェは、嘉音と目が合った。

units.text: However, Ronove, who stood at the ready by her side, met Kanon's eyes. ...Kanon thought "Oh no", grimacing and blocking Jessica with his back.
units.note: Both retain at/by her side instead of attending behind her.
units.japanese: しかし、その後に控えるロノウェは、嘉音と目が合った。…嘉音は、しまったと思い、表情を歪めその背中に朱志香を庇う。

units.text: However, Ronove, who was waiting at her side, met Kanon's eyes. ...Kanon thought "oh no", grimacing and blocking Jessica with his back.
units.note: Both retain at/by her side instead of attending behind her.
units.japanese: しかし、その後に控えるロノウェは、嘉音と目が合った。…嘉音は、しまったと思い、表情を歪めその背中に朱志香を庇う。

description: WH says as though Ronove had not found fault with Kanon being there, replacing the source’s pretence that the sighting itself was imagined.
sourceReading: 姿を見咎めたこと自体が気のせいであったかのように describes acting unaware as though having noticed the figure was only a mistaken impression.

units.text: However, Ronove did not inform his master. As though he hadn't even found fault with Kanon being there in the first place, he pretended not to recognize him. ......No, maybe he did appear to chuckle.
units.note: Both restore pretended failure to spot Kanon; UP explicitly restores imagined sighting.
units.japanese: 彼の姿を見咎めたこと自体が気のせいであったかのように、素知らぬふりをする。

description: WH writes Thank you for letting be with Kanon-kun, omitting the object me required after letting.
sourceReading: 嘉音くんに会わせてくれて thanks Beatrice for enabling Jessica to meet Kanon.

units.text: "Uh, umm, ............thank you, Beatrice...!!  Thank you for letting be with Kanon-kun......!!"
units.note: Both supply the missing me after letting.
units.japanese: 「あ、あの、…………ありがとう、ベアトリーチェ…！！　嘉音くんに会わせてくれて、ありがとう……！！」
candidates: Thank you for letting be with Kanon-kun

description: WH replaces 攻性防壁 with Attack-Proof Barrier and 魔法反応装甲 with Anti-Magic Armor.
sourceReading: 攻性 makes the barrier offensive in function; 反応 marks the armor as reactive to magic rather than simply opposing magic. The source separately gives seventy-two layers and impossibility of sniping into the parlor.

units.text: "45, Data Received.  Target Comparison, Confirmed as the Predecessor Lady Beatrice.  Parlor Defensive Wall Analysis.  72-Layered Multilayered Defensive Wall, Attack-Proof Barrier and Anti-Magic Armor.  Sniping into the parlor is impossible.  Data Link to 410."
units.note: MG retains Attack-Proof Barrier and Anti-Magic Armor; UP restores attack barrier and magic reactive armor.
units.japanese: 「４５データ受領。標的照合、先代ベアトリーチェ卿と確認。客間防御壁を解析。多層防御壁７２層、攻性防壁及び魔法反応装甲。客間への狙撃は不可能。４１０へデータリンク。」

units.text: "45, Data Received. Checking Target, Confirmed as the Predecessor Lady Beatrice. Analyzing Parlor Defensive Wall. 72-Layered Multilayered Defensive Wall, Attack-Proof Barrier and Anti-Magic Armor. Sniping into the parlor will be impossible. Data Link to 410."
units.note: MG retains Attack-Proof Barrier and Anti-Magic Armor; UP restores attack barrier and magic reactive armor.
units.japanese: 「４５データ受領。標的照合、先代ベアトリーチェ卿と確認。客間防御壁を解析。多層防御壁７２層、攻性防壁及び魔法反応装甲。客間への狙撃は不可能。４１０へデータリンク」

description: WH says Beato did not think the obstructions would be permitted where she says she does not intend or hope to be permitted.
sourceReading: 許されようとも思わぬわ is a defiant refusal to seek pardon or permission after Ronove’s warning, not merely an earlier expectation about what would be allowed.

units.text: "......Ugh......uu........., I didn't think they would be permitted.........Still, the Siesta Sisters really have gotten rusty.  To think that they failed to bring me down.  ...And twice, at that...!"
units.note: Both retain a past expectation instead of Beato’s present lack of intention to seek permission/forgiveness.
units.japanese: 「……ぐ……ぅ………、許されようとも思わぬわ…。……しかしシエスタ姉妹も腕が落ちたものよ。妾を仕留め損なうとはな。…それも二度も…！」

units.text: "...Ugh...uu...... I didn't think they would be... ...Still, the Chiester Sisters really have gotten rusty. To think that they failed to bring me down. ...And twice, at that...!"
units.note: Both retain a past expectation instead of Beato’s present lack of intention to seek permission/forgiveness.
units.japanese: 「……ぐ……ぅ………、許されようとも思わぬわ…。……しかしシエスタ姉妹も腕が落ちたものよ。妾を仕留め損なうとはな。…それも二度も…！」

units.text: "......ugh......u......... I never thought I would... ......Still, the Chiester Sisters really have gotten rusty. To think that they failed to bring me down. ...And twice, at that...!"
units.note: Both retain a past expectation instead of Beato’s present lack of intention to seek permission/forgiveness.
units.japanese: 「……ぐ……ぅ………、許されようとも思わぬわ…。……しかしシエスタ姉妹も腕が落ちたものよ。妾を仕留め損なうとはな。…それも二度も…！」

description: WH changes the snake’s spiral like a morning-glory vine into a funnel-shaped helix.
sourceReading: 朝顔の蔦が描くような螺旋 compares the extending snake with the winding vine, not the flower’s funnel shape.

units.text: The gold snake that had pierced Beatrice grew even longer, drawing a funnel-shaped helix and awaiting its next order. ...It was prepared to pierce a vital spot as soon as the evil witch told it to.
units.note: MG retains funnel-shaped helix; UP restores a morning-glory vine.
units.japanese: ベアトを貫いた黄金の蛇は、そのまま伸びて朝顔の蔦が描くような螺旋を描き、次の命令を待っていた。

units.text: The gold snake that had pierced Beatrice grew even longer, drawing a funnel-shaped helix and awaiting its next order. ...It was prepared to pierce a vital spot as soon as the evil witch told it to.
units.note: MG retains funnel-shaped helix; UP restores a morning-glory vine.
units.japanese: ベアトを貫いた黄金の蛇は、そのまま伸びて朝顔の蔦が描くような螺旋を描き、次の命令を待っていた。…残酷なる魔女が命じれば、すぐにでも急所を貫く用意があるということだ。

description: WH says Beato always says warm pleasant things that shock the successor, replacing contempt for soft or naïve remarks.
sourceReading: 温いことばかり言って私を呆れさせる conveys exasperation at weak, soft or insufficiently ruthless talk; 呆れ is being appalled or exasperated.

units.text: ......But you've always been in the way.  You always say warm, pleasant things that shock me.  ......What changed you?  You explored the depths of evil for one thousand years, and I let you live to learn what happened to make you change so much."
units.note: Both retain warm pleasant remarks and shock instead of dismissive soft/naive remarks and exasperation.
units.japanese: ……なのにあなたは邪魔ばかり。温いことばかり言って私を呆れさせる。……何があなたを変えたの？　千年間、邪悪の限りを尽くしたあなたに、その千年を翻すような何が起こったのか、それだけを知りたくて生かしたのよ。」

units.text: "...But you've always been in the way. You always say warm, pleasant things that shock me. ...What changed you? You explored the depths of evil for one thousand years, and I let you live...because I wanted to know what happened to make you change so much."
units.note: Both retain warm pleasant remarks and shock instead of dismissive soft/naive remarks and exasperation.
units.japanese: 「……なのにあなたは邪魔ばかり。温いことばかり言って私を呆れさせる。……何があなたを変えたの？　千年間、邪悪の限りを尽くしたあなたに、その千年を翻すような何が起こったのか、それだけを知りたくて生かしたのよ」

units.text: "......But you've always been in the way. You always say warm, pleasant things that shock me. ......What changed you? You explored the depths of evil for one thousand years, so I let you live just to find out...what happened to overturn that millennium?"
units.note: Both retain warm pleasant remarks and shock instead of dismissive soft/naive remarks and exasperation.
units.japanese: 「……なのにあなたは邪魔ばかり。温いことばかり言って私を呆れさせる。……何があなたを変えたの？　千年間、邪悪の限りを尽くしたあなたに、その千年を翻すような何が起こったのか、それだけを知りたくて生かしたのよ」

description: WH asks And you noticed that rather than whether noticing true magic was the reason for Beato’s change.
sourceReading: それに気付いたから……？ elliptically asks because you realized that, resuming the reason-for-change question after Beato explains true magic.

units.text: "And you noticed that......?  What, ...is it?"
units.note: Both ask whether she realized it rather than whether realizing it caused her change.
units.japanese: 「それに気付いたから……？　それは、…何？」

units.text: "And this is what you realized...? Then what...is it?"
units.note: Both ask whether she realized it rather than whether realizing it caused her change.
units.japanese: 「それに気付いたから……？　それは、…何？」

units.text: "And you realized what that is......? What...is it?"
units.note: Both ask whether she realized it rather than whether realizing it caused her change.
units.japanese: 「それに気付いたから……？　それは、…何？」

description: WH says the successor no longer cares whether Beato reached deep understanding, rather than what insight she reached.
sourceReading: 何を達観したか identifies the content of the granny’s detached insight as the object of lost interest.

units.text: "......Well, that's fine.  It's no longer interesting whether or not some good-as-dead granny reached some deep understanding.  I'm bored now, so I'll kill you quickly.  If I kill you, the barrier to the parlor will dissolve.
units.note: Both restore content of insight rather than whether she reached understanding.
units.japanese: 「……ま、いいわ。死に損ないのババァが何を達観したかなんて、もう興味も何もない。もう飽きたから、あっさり殺してあげるわ。あんたを殺せば、客間の結界は解ける。

description: WH adds a whole bunch of times to torturing Kanon and Jessica to death.
sourceReading: たっぷり虐め殺して describes thoroughly or extensively tormenting them to death, with two lovers simultaneously as toys; no count of repeated deaths is given here.

units.text: ......Then I'll torture Kanon and Jessica to death a whole bunch of times.  ......Being able to have two lovers as my toys at the same time, ......sounds fun right?  Kuhhihihhihhihihihhihihihihi!! Kill her...!!!"
units.note: Both retain repeated deaths not explicitly specified by the source’s extensive torment-to-death wording.
units.japanese: ……そしたら嘉音と朱志香もたっぷり虐め殺してあげるわね。……愛し合う二人を同時に玩具にできるなんて、……これは楽しそうよねぇ？　くっひひっひっひひひっひひひひひ！！

units.text: "...Then I'll torture Kanon and Jessica to death a whole bunch of times. ...Being able to have two lovers as my toys at the same time...sounds pretty fun, right? Kuhhihihhihhihihihhihihihihi!!" "Kill her...!!!"
units.note: Both retain repeated deaths not explicitly specified by the source’s extensive torment-to-death wording.
units.japanese: 「……そしたら嘉音と朱志香もたっぷり虐め殺してあげるわね。……愛し合う二人を同時に玩具にできるなんて、……これは楽しそうよねぇ？　くっひひっひっひひひっひひひひひ！！　殺せ…！！！」

units.text: "......Then I'll torture Kanon and Jessica to death a whole bunch of times. ......Being able to have two lovers as my toys at the same time, ......sounds fun, right? Kuhhi{0hi{0hhi{0hhi{0hi{0hi{0hhi{0hi{0hihihi!! Kill her...!!!"
units.note: Both retain repeated deaths not explicitly specified by the source’s extensive torment-to-death wording.
units.japanese: 「……そしたら嘉音と朱志香もたっぷり虐め殺してあげるわね。……愛し合う二人を同時に玩具にできるなんて、……これは楽しそうよねぇ？　くっひひっひっひひひっひひひひひ！！　殺せ…！！！」

description: WH describes Beatrice steadily watching her heart where Japanese describes a vague or dazed gaze.
sourceReading: ぼんやりと見ている conveys unfocused awareness in her exhausted, fading state.

units.text: Beatrice, whose form had become fragile and faint like incense smoke, lay on the floor, ......steadily watching her own heart... There, the cruel witch could be seen...
units.note: Both retain steadily watching rather than a vague/dazed gaze.
units.japanese: 線香の煙のように儚く薄い姿となったベアトリーチェは床に倒れ、……自らの心臓をぼんやりと見ている…。

units.text: Beatrice, whose form had become fragile and faint like incense smoke, lay on the floor, ...steadily watching her own heart... There, the cruel witch could be seen...
units.note: Both retain steadily watching rather than a vague/dazed gaze.
units.japanese: 線香の煙のように儚く薄い姿となったベアトリーチェは床に倒れ、……自らの心臓をぼんやりと見ている…。そこへ、残酷なる魔女の姿が…。

description: WH has the successor poke the heart with a fingernail rather than nudge it with her toe.
sourceReading: 爪先 is the toe or tip of the foot; 小突く describes nudging the fallen heart.

units.text: The cruel witch poked Beatrice's heart with her fingernail. Beatrice had no words with which to respond to that provocation. ......However, ...instead of words, she returned a single expression. ......It looked humiliating only to the cruel witch. Because she had gently curved her mouth, ......and smiled.
units.note: Both retain fingernail instead of toe.
units.japanese: 残酷なる魔女は、爪先でベアトリーチェの心臓を小突く。

units.text: The cruel witch poked Beatrice's heart with her fingernail. Beatrice had no words with which to respond to that provocation. ...However, ...instead of words, she returned a single expression. ...It felt humiliating only to the cruel witch. Because she had gently curved her mouth...and smiled.
units.note: Both retain fingernail instead of toe.
units.japanese:
残酷なる魔女は、爪先でベアトリーチェの心臓を小突く。ベアトリーチェはその挑発に返す言葉など何もない。……だが、…言葉の代わりに、表情をひとつ返した。
……それは、残酷なる魔女にとってのみ屈辱的に見えた。口を緩やかに曲げて、……笑っていたからだ。

units.text:
The merciless witch poked Beatrice's heart with her fingernail. Beatrice had no words with which to respond to that provocation. ......However, ...instead of words, she returned a single expression.
......It looked insulting only to the cruel witch. Because she had gently curved her mouth, ......and smiled.
units.note: Both retain fingernail instead of toe.
units.japanese:
残酷なる魔女は、爪先でベアトリーチェの心臓を小突く。ベアトリーチェはその挑発に返す言葉など何もない。……だが、…言葉の代わりに、表情をひとつ返した。
……それは、残酷なる魔女にとってのみ屈辱的に見えた。口を緩やかに曲げて、……笑っていたからだ。

description: WH describes rough squeaking of heels where Japanese identifies Battler’s rough heel-striking footfalls.
sourceReading: 荒々しく踵を鳴らす gives forceful sounding of heels, with no squeak specified.

units.text: ......Footsteps were approaching that place. There was no way she had misheard it.  ...That rough squeaking of the heels was the sound of Battler's footsteps...
units.note: MG retains squeaking of heels; UP restores shoes striking the ground.
units.japanese: 聞き違えるわけもない。…この荒々しく踵を鳴らす音は、戦人の足音だ…。

units.text: ...Footsteps were approaching that place. There was no way she had misheard it. ...That rough squeaking of heels was the sound of Battler's footsteps...
units.note: MG retains squeaking of heels; UP restores shoes striking the ground.
units.japanese: ……そこへ、近付いてくる足音があった。聞き違えるわけもない。…この荒々しく踵を鳴らす音は、戦人の足音だ…。

description: WH replaces the command for separate individual firing with attacking everywhere.
sourceReading: 各個射撃 orders each shooter to fire individually, as the following narration explains their separate bows versus joint precision guidance.

units.text: "45, understood, attacking everywhere!!"
units.note: MG retains attacking everywhere; UP restores individual firing.
units.japanese: 「４５了解、各個射撃！！」

units.text: "45, understood, attacking everywhere!!"
units.note: MG retains attacking everywhere; UP restores individual firing.
units.japanese: 「４５了解、各個射撃！！」

description: WH says when that was blocked by resistance where Japanese describes trying to stop the warhead with resistance.
sourceReading: 防ごうとした場合 makes the blocking attempt hypothetical, then states eight-digit resistance still cannot avoid penetration.

units.text: The warheads for the golden bows could penetrate any magical armor with their mutual corrosion. When that was blocked by anti-magic resistance power, even something with eight digits wouldn't escape penetration. ...Furthermore, even among the resistance power of famous gods that appear in myths, there are not many who reach nine digits. For that reason, nine digits were enough to measure almost all sensible values. ...Battler had buried all 9 of those digits with nines......
units.note: Both restore attempting to block rather than successful blocking.
units.japanese: 対魔法抵抗力でそれを防ごうとした場合、８桁あっても貫通は免れない。

description: WH equates Battler’s experience to two passing dragonflies where source says he did not consider it even that much.
sourceReading: 程度にも思っていない puts his notice or concern below the level of a pair of dragonflies passing beside him.

units.text: The Siesta Sisters dropped their golden bow in shock... ...To this Battler, it was as though a pair of dragonflies had flown past his shoulder.
units.note: MG equates it to passing dragonflies; UP restores even less perceptible than that.
units.japanese: …当の戦人は、トンボが２匹、自分の脇を通り過ぎて行った程度にも思っていない。

units.text: The Chiester Sisters dropped their golden bows in shock... ...To Battler himself, it was as though a pair of dragonflies had flown past his shoulder.
units.note: MG equates it to passing dragonflies; UP restores even less perceptible than that.
units.japanese: シエスタ姉妹が呆然としながら黄金の弓を落とす…。…当の戦人は、トンボが２匹、自分の脇を通り過ぎて行った程度にも思っていない。

description: WH adds On the opposing side to the summoning of transparent Hideyoshi.
sourceReading: 向こう側の透けて見える describes seeing the other side through his form; it modifies his transparency rather than assigning him a side of the arena.

units.text: On the opposing side, a transparent Hideyoshi oji-san was summoned. ...Magic sure is convenient. He looked as though he couldn't see what was going on here, almost like a person on the other side of the TV.
units.note: MG adds opposing-side placement; UP restores seeing through Hideyoshi’s summoned form.
units.japanese: 向こう側の透けて見える秀吉伯父さんが呼び出される。

units.text: On the opposing side, a transparent Uncle Hideyoshi was summoned. ...Talk about convenient. He looked as though he couldn't see what was going on here, almost like a person on the other side of the TV.
units.note: MG adds opposing-side placement; UP restores seeing through Hideyoshi’s summoned form.
units.japanese:
向こう側の透けて見える秀吉伯父さんが呼び出される。…まったく魔法っての便利なもんだぜ。
ただ、こちらの状況は見えていないようで、まるでテレビの向こうの人物のようだった。

description: WH has Battler call his opponent slow rather than easy to beat.
sourceReading: チョロイ相手 is an easy or readily handled opponent after the refusal to certify Eva’s presence.

units.text: "Yeah, I'll take it.  This opponent is slow!!
units.note: MG retains slow opponent; UP restores easy opponent with piece of cake.
units.japanese: 「あぁ、いただきだぜ、チョロイ相手だッ！！

units.text: "Yeah, I'll take it. This opponent's slow!!
units.note: MG retains slow opponent; UP restores easy opponent with piece of cake.
units.japanese: 「あぁ、いただきだぜ、チョロイ相手だッ！！」

description: WH says a shot had been taken at the witch while she did not understand, rather than that she had already lost a point or round.
sourceReading: 一本取られた refers to the concluded defeat announced by witch-side resignation.

units.text: It seemed that the witch still didn't understand how to make a winning move, and she lost her composure in irritation. She was probably also angry that a shot had been taken at her while she still didn't get what was going on. ...However, I won't go easy on her at all. Just like she didn't go easy on the victims at all, I won't go easy on her...!!
units.note: Both retain a shot being taken at her rather than losing a round/point.
units.japanese: 訳がわからない内に一本取られたことにも、腹を立てているのだろう。

units.text: It seemed that the witch still didn't understand how to make a winning move, and she lost her composure in irritation. She was probably also angry that a shot had been taken at her while she still didn't get what was going on. ...However, I won't go easy on her at all. Just like she didn't go easy on the victims at all, I won't go easy on her...!!
units.note: Both retain a shot being taken at her rather than losing a round/point.
units.japanese: 魔女は勝手がまだわからないらしく、イライラと落ち着きなくしている。訳がわからない内に一本取られたことにも、腹を立てているのだろう。…だが、俺は一切の手加減をしない。ヤツが、犠牲者たちに一切の手加減をしなかったように、俺も一切の手加減をしない…！！

units.text: It seemed that the witch still didn't understand how to approach things, and was losing her composure in irritation. She was probably also angry that a shot had been taken at her while she still didn't get what was going on. ...But I won't go easy on her at all. Just like she didn't go easy on the victims at all, I won't go the slightest bit easy on her...!!
units.note: Both retain a shot being taken at her rather than losing a round/point.
units.japanese: 魔女は勝手がまだわからないらしく、イライラと落ち着きなくしている。訳がわからない内に一本取られたことにも、腹を立てているのだろう。…だが、俺は一切の手加減をしない。ヤツが、犠牲者たちに一切の手加減をしなかったように、俺も一切の手加減をしない…！！

description: WH narrows the witch not yet knowing how things work to not understanding how to make a winning move.
sourceReading: 勝手がまだわからないらしく means still unfamiliar with the practical workings or manner of proceeding.

units.text: It seemed that the witch still didn't understand how to make a winning move, and she lost her composure in irritation. She was probably also angry that a shot had been taken at her while she still didn't get what was going on. ...However, I won't go easy on her at all. Just like she didn't go easy on the victims at all, I won't go easy on her...!!
units.note: MG retains failure to know a winning move; UP restores unfamiliarity with how to proceed.
units.japanese: 魔女は勝手がまだわからないらしく、イライラと落ち着きなくしている。

units.text: It seemed that the witch still didn't understand how to make a winning move, and she lost her composure in irritation. She was probably also angry that a shot had been taken at her while she still didn't get what was going on. ...However, I won't go easy on her at all. Just like she didn't go easy on the victims at all, I won't go easy on her...!!
units.note: MG retains failure to know a winning move; UP restores unfamiliarity with how to proceed.
units.japanese: 魔女は勝手がまだわからないらしく、イライラと落ち着きなくしている。訳がわからない内に一本取られたことにも、腹を立てているのだろう。…だが、俺は一切の手加減をしない。ヤツが、犠牲者たちに一切の手加減をしなかったように、俺も一切の手加減をしない…！！

description: WH says Battler has even less room to counter where the successor asserts no room to counter at all.
sourceReading: さらにあなたには反論の余地もない adds absence of any rebuttal room to absence of her demonstration obligation.

units.text: "It's a 'Devil's Proof', right?!  Just because you don't know about that magic doesn't deny its existence!  And I don't bear the responsibility of acting out that magic for you.  And yet, you have even less room to counter this argument!!
units.note: MG retains even less room; UP restores no room for counterargument.
units.japanese: 「“悪魔の証明”よぅ？！　戦人くんが知らない魔法だからと言って、存在を否定することにはならない！　そしてその魔法を、私は実演する義務も負わない。それでいて、さらにあなたには反論の余地もない！！

units.text: "It's a "Devil's Proof", right?! Just because you don't know about that magic doesn't deny its existence! And I don't bear the responsibility of acting out that magic for you. And yet, you have even less room to counter this argument!!
units.note: MG retains even less room; UP restores no room for counterargument.
units.japanese: 「“悪魔の証明”よぅ？！　戦人くんが知らない魔法だからと言って、存在を否定することにはならない！　そしてその魔法を、私は実演する義務も負わない。それでいて、さらにあなたには反論の余地もない！！」

description: WH concludes it is impossible to explain where Japanese concludes proof is impossible.
sourceReading: 証明は不能 follows the red assertion that the reason was never told or written and Battler can only speculate: proposed reasons are available but cannot be established by objective evidence.

units.text: So it is impossible to explain!!  You don't have a single counter to my move!  Isn't it your turn to resign now, Battler-kuuun...?!?!"
units.note: MG retains impossible to explain; UP restores impossible to prove.
units.japanese: つまり証明は不能ッ！！　私の手に対し、あなたは一切の反撃の一手を持たない！　今度はあんたがリザインする番なのよぅ、戦人くぅん…？！？！」

units.text: So it's impossible to explain!! You don't have a single counter to my move! Isn't it your turn to resign now, Battler-kuuun...?!?!"
units.note: MG retains impossible to explain; UP restores impossible to prove.
units.japanese: 「つまり証明は不能ッ！！　私の手に対し、あなたは一切の反撃の一手を持たない！　今度はあんたがリザインする番なのよぅ、戦人くぅん…？！？！」

description: WH says the name was stolen from the witch who used to be here instead of the former witch who is there now.
sourceReading: そこにいる元の魔女 makes current presence explicit while 元 modifies her former status as witch.

units.text: I am the Golden Witch!!  I stole that name from the witch that used to be here!!  You can't deny that I am Beatrice!!!"
units.note: Both restore former witch over there rather than vanished/past-location wording.
units.japanese: 私こそは黄金の魔女！！　そこにいる元の魔女から、名前を奪い取った！！　あなたに私がベアトリーチェであることを否定など出来ないのよッ！！！」

description: WH says the time limit is over where Ronove announces imposing or cutting a time limit and asks whether resignation is appropriate.
sourceReading: 制限時間を切ります introduces a limit to further consideration; it does not use a completed-expiration expression such as 時間切れ.

units.text: "Battler-sama.  The time limit is over, so will you resign......?"
units.note: MG retains already expired deadline. UP removes expiry but still describes a pre-existing approaching deadline instead of Ronove announcing he will impose/cut a limit.
units.japanese: 「戦人さま。……制限時間を切りますが、リザインでよろしいですか……？」

units.text: "Battler-sama, your time limit is over, so will you resign...?"
units.note: MG retains already expired deadline. UP removes expiry but still describes a pre-existing approaching deadline instead of Ronove announcing he will impose/cut a limit.
units.japanese: 「戦人さま。……制限時間を切りますが、リザインでよろしいですか……？」

units.text: "Battler‐sama. ......You are closing in on the time limit—will you resign......?"
units.note: MG retains already expired deadline. UP removes expiry but still describes a pre-existing approaching deadline instead of Ronove announcing he will impose/cut a limit.

description: WH has Beato say she does not know a single winning move, rather than not quite understanding how the human-side approach works.
sourceReading: 今ひとつ勝手がわからぬ expresses incomplete practical familiarity; 物証 specifies physical evidence she dimly recalls needing.

units.text: "R, right now, I don't know a single winning move using the human side's style of fighting............Evidence was required, right...?  ......Then what should I search for?"
units.note: MG removes winning-move wording but overstates incomplete procedural familiarity as completely clueless; UP restores do not quite understand the process.
units.japanese: 「ニ、ニンゲン側の戦い方は今ひとつ勝手がわからぬ…。………確か、物証が必要だったか…。……なれば、何を探せばいいのか。」

units.text: "I-I am completely clueless when it comes to fighting on the Human side... ......We need to find evidence, right...? ...Then what should I search for?"
units.note: MG removes winning-move wording but overstates incomplete procedural familiarity as completely clueless; UP restores do not quite understand the process.

description: WH replaces the airline-ticket stub in Kyrie’s pockets with a boat-ticket stub.
sourceReading: 航空券の半券 is a stub of an air ticket, listed alongside handkerchief, tissue, house key, lighter, cigarette butt and one hundred-yen coin.

units.text: Laid on the floor, ......was a handkerchief, tissue, a key to her house, the stub of a boat ticket, a lighter, a cigarette butt, and a single hundred yen coin...
units.note: MG retains boat ticket; UP restores plane ticket.
units.japanese: 床に並んだのは、……ハンカチ。化粧紙。自宅の鍵。航空券の半券。ライター。煙草の吸殻。百円玉が１枚…。

units.text: Laid on the floor... was a handkerchief, tissue, a key to her house, the stub of a boat ticket, a lighter, a cigarette butt, and a single hundred yen coin...

description: WH describes the successor closing in on Beato where Japanese says she berates her while laughing uproariously.
sourceReading: 詰る means reproach or abuse verbally, matching the immediately preceding taunts.

units.text: The witch fell over laughing, closing in on Beato. ...Beato hung her head, trying to withstand this shame.
units.note: Both restore verbal lambasting/taunting without added physical approach.
units.japanese: 魔女はげらげらと笑い転げてベアトを詰る。

description: WH says the objects were scraped together until she sneered rather than gathered even at the cost of being mocked.
sourceReading: 嘲笑われてまで掻き集めた stresses enduring humiliation to obtain the objects.

units.text: "I, I don't need consoling...!  Just how could you argue back with this pile of rubbish...?!!  Just how could you strike back with this rubbish I scraped together until she sneered at me...?!"
units.note: Both restore enduring ridicule during the search rather than an until boundary.
units.japanese: あやつに嘲笑われてまで掻き集めたこのガラクタが、どうやって一矢報いれるというのか…！」

description: WH says the survivors rechecked all doors and windows in the mansion instead of the guesthouse.
sourceReading: ゲストハウス内 explicitly locates the securing of doors and windows inside the guesthouse.

units.text: I will reconstruct it.  ......After Rosa and Maria's deaths, the remaining survivors rechecked all of the doors and windows in the mansion.  They constructed a barricade.  They rechecked that their defenses were solid."
units.note: Both retain mansion instead of guesthouse for the security check, despite the surrounding guesthouse reconstruction request.
units.japanese: 再構築します。……楼座、真里亞の死亡後、残った生存者はゲストハウス内全ての戸締りを再確認。バリケードを構築。篭城の結束を再確認。」

description: WH says no truth can be accepted from the false witch, where Virgilia says no truth exists that the false witch can receive or withstand.
sourceReading: 偽の魔女に、受けられる真実 uses the false witch as the recipient of the attack; 受ける echoes the immediately preceding 受け手, a responding move.

units.text: "......There cannot be one.  There is no truth that can be accepted from a false witch dressed up with truths and falsehoods."
units.note: Both retain truth accepted from the false witch rather than truth she can withstand/counter.
units.japanese: 「……あるわけがない。虚実にて着飾った偽の魔女に、受けられる真実など、ありはしない。」

units.text: "...There cannot be one. There is no truth that can be accepted from a false witch dressed up with truths and falsehoods."

description: WH makes the yell be sucked into the flicker; Japanese makes the roar swallow the flickering and restore the cruel witch’s form.
sourceReading: 咆哮はその明滅を飲み込み places the roar as agent and the flickering as object; the following causative describes the recovery of her original form.

units.text: Her body flickered repeatedly, flashing as though Eva's figure and the witch's figure overlapped. However, that yell was sucked into the flicker, ...making it return to the original form of the cruel witch.
units.note: MG retains yell being sucked into flicker; UP restores roar overcoming the flicker and restoring her form.
units.japanese: しかし、咆哮はその明滅を飲み込み、…再び元の、残酷なる魔女の姿を取り戻させる。

units.text: Her body flickered repeatedly, flashing as though Eva's figure and the witch's figure overlapped. However, that yell was sucked into the flicker, ...making it return to the original form of the cruel witch.
units.note: MG retains yell being sucked into flicker; UP restores roar overcoming the flicker and restoring her form.
units.japanese: その体は明滅を繰り返し、時折、絵羽の姿と魔女の姿を重なるようにちらつかせた。しかし、咆哮はその明滅を飲み込み、…再び元の、残酷なる魔女の姿を取り戻させる。

description: WH retains sealing humans inside an inescapable red barrier but omits the explicit killing in the threat.
sourceReading: 封じて殺す means seal or confine and kill, followed by farewell and the demand to sleep forever in the magic closed room.

units.text: "I'll seal you, and humans as well, ......in a red barrier that most certainly cannot be escaped from.  Farewell, lowly humans.  Sleep for all eternity in a absolute closed room of magic with no exits.  ......Come on, listen carefully.  Listen to the red truth."
units.note: MG omits explicit killing; UP adds barrier of death but still omits the speaker’s explicit sealing-and-killing action.
units.japanese: 「あんたを。ニンゲンを。……絶対に逃れられぬ赤き結界にて封じて殺す。さらばだニンゲンどもよ。出口なき絶対の魔法密室にて、永遠に眠るがいいわ。……さぁ、心して聞きなさい。赤き真実を。」

units.text: "I'll seal you, and Humans as well, ...in a red barrier that most certainly cannot be escaped from. Farewell, lowly Humans. Sleep for all eternity in a absolute closed room of magic with no exits. ...Come on, listen carefully. Listen to the red truth."

units.text: "I'll seal you, and Humanhumans as well, ......in a red barrier of death that most certainly cannot be escaped from. Farewell, lowly Humanhumans. Sleep for all eternity in an absolute locked room of magic with no exits. ......Now, prepare yourself. For the red truth."
units.note: MG omits explicit killing; UP adds barrier of death but still omits the speaker’s explicit sealing-and-killing action.
units.japanese: 「あんたを。ニンゲンを。……絶対に逃れられぬ赤き結界にて封じて殺す。さらばだニンゲンどもよ。出口なき絶対の魔法密室にて、永遠に眠るがいいわ。……さぁ、心して聞きなさい。赤き真実を」

description: WH makes the successor say she hates humans, where she rejects being human and wants to remain a witch.
sourceReading: 私はまだ魔女でいたいのよ、ニンゲンは嫌なのよ contrasts the desired witch state with the unwanted human state.

units.text: "A, ...are you insane?!?!  S, stop it...!  I still want to be a witch!  I hate humans...!!"
units.note: Both restore rejection of becoming human rather than hatred of humans.
units.japanese: 「しょッ、…正気ッ？！？！　や、やめなさい…！　私はまだ魔女でいたいのよ、ニンゲンは嫌なのよ…！！」

description: WH renders the teacher’s instruction as Go, while you still believe rather than go as or according to what you believe.
sourceReading: あなたの信じるままに authorizes following her own convictions; it supplies no temporal still or expiration of belief.

units.text: "......I had a good disciple in the very end.  ......Go, while you still believe."
units.note: Both restore doing what one believes rather than continuing only while belief lasts.
units.japanese: 「……良き弟子を最後に持てました。……あなたの信じるままに、お行きなさい。」

description: WH adds the successor’s personal vow not to let the addressee get away with this, replacing a warning that the addressee too will not escape consequences.
sourceReading: あんたもただじゃ済まない warns that the addressed party will also be affected by the denial; it does not identify the successor as the agent administering consequences.

units.text: "Let gooooooooooooooooooo!!  I won't let you get away with this either, okay?!
units.note: Both give a warning that the addressee too will suffer consequences.
units.japanese: あんたもただじゃ済まないのよ？！

description: After saying She’s insane, WH asks Do you plan on dying and taking us with you, switching from warning the restraining party about Beato to addressing Beato herself.
sourceReading: あいつは狂ってる followed by 私たちを巻き込んで自分も死ぬ気よ continues the third-person warning: that woman intends to die while dragging us into it.

units.text: She's insane!!  Do you plan on dying and taking us with you?!  Stop it, don't deny it!!
units.note: MG changes third-person plans to second-person address; UP restores she.
units.japanese: あいつは狂ってる！！　私たちを巻き込んで自分も死ぬ気よ？！　やめて、否定しないで！！

units.text: She's insane!! Do you plan on dying and taking us with you?! Stop it, don't deny it!!
units.note: MG changes third-person plans to second-person address; UP restores she.
units.japanese: 「あいつおかしいわッ！！　私たちを巻き込んで自分も死ぬ気よ？！　やめて、否定しないで！！」

description: WH narrates the evil witch covering her ears, where she tries to cover them.
sourceReading: 耳を塞ごうとする is attempted action, not completed ear covering.

units.text: After that, was a world where Battler could not hear anything. Beato was saying something with red. Even the evil witch covered her ears at those bitter contents. ......That was...the red truth.  Words of power. ......Words that denied her own existence. Unique words that only witches could use, which denied witches.
units.note: MG completes covering ears; UP restores the attempt.
units.japanese: その辛辣な内容に、邪悪なる魔女までもが耳を塞ごうとする。

units.text: After that...was a world where Battler could hear nothing. Beato was saying something in red. Even the evil witch covered her ears at those bitter contents. ...That was...the red truth. Words of power. ...Words that denied her own existence. Unique words that only witches could use, which denied witches.
units.note: MG completes covering ears; UP restores the attempt.
units.japanese:
あとは、戦人にとっては何も聞こえぬ世界。
ベアトが赤にて、何かを語っている。その辛辣な内容に、邪悪なる魔女までもが耳を塞ごうとする。……それは、赤き真実。力ある言葉。
　……自らの存在を否定する言葉。魔女にしか使えぬ、魔女を否定する唯一の言葉。

description: WH describes moves that could only be solved by witches rather than solving or explaining the difficulty with a witch-only move.
sourceReading: 魔女にしか解けぬ一手で describes the move by which the witch can solve what humans cannot, not a move serving as the problem to solve.

units.text: Beato spoke. With the red truth, she cut up the bright-red game board that the witch had released. She explained difficult problems that could not be solved by humans, with moves that could only be solved by witches, and began cornering the witch.
units.note: Both turn the witch-only solving move into moves that themselves can be solved by witches.
units.japanese: 人間には解けぬ難題を、魔女にしか解けぬ一手で、説明し、追い詰めていく。
candidates: moves that could only be solved by witches

description: WH says She probably explained all the riddles and the entire tale, where Japanese continues what Battler would understand if he broke his promise and listened.
sourceReading: 全ての謎を理解し…物語を全て理解するだろう continues the hypothetical Battler victory and understanding, followed by however he must reach the truth himself.

units.text: ......She probably explained all the riddles on the island, all of the magic and tricks, closed rooms, spells, curses, legends, ...and the entire tale of anger and sadness.
units.note: Both restore the hypothetical result for Battler if he eavesdropped.
units.japanese: ……この島の全ての謎を理解し、全ての魔法とトリックと、密室と呪いと祟りと伝説と、…怒りと悲しみの物語を全て理解するだろう。

description: WH places Beato and the evil witch at the center of the gathering light instead of locating the light between them.
sourceReading: ベアトと邪悪な魔女の中央に locates the gathering brilliance centrally between the two figures.

units.text: A brilliant light gathered with Beato and the evil witch at the center, and grew gradually stronger... It was..., the power of truth. .........Its heat and brilliance like the sun, shone on all of the falsehoods that hid in the darkness, trying to deceive, ...and burnt them to nothing.
units.note: Both place the witches at the center of the light rather than locating the light between them, retaining the canonical spatial defect.
units.japanese: ベアトと邪悪な魔女の中央に、眩い光が集まり、どんどんと強くなっていく…。

description: WH says there have been many murders and I don’t have a clue how they were carried out, replacing the existence of some murders whose methods remain unknown.
sourceReading: どうやって行なったのかわからぬ殺人も、いくつかはある explicitly limits the unknown-method murders to some and leaves room for others he does understand.

units.text: But in his last moments, he realized without a doubt that she was a murderer.  And not just for killing him... .........There have been many murders, and I don't have a clue how they were carried out. However, ......while my ears were covered, ......Beato exposed all of them with the red, blasting away all magic. ...In other words, .........even though I didn't understand it, ......had that been nothing more or less than proof that magic can all be explained with humans?
units.note: MG broadens the unknown methods to many murders; UP restores the several unresolved subset.
units.japanese: ………一体、どうやって行なったのかわからぬ殺人も、いくつかはある。

description: WH uses So for Beato’s promise to become a witch again, where Japanese uses but.
sourceReading: だが contrasts no longer being a witch with the determination nevertheless to become one again.

units.text: "............With this, ...I am no longer a witch.  ...............So, I will definitely...become a witch again.........And then, ......I will make it so that I can be called the Golden Witch again, .........and once again, ............return, ......so that I can be accepted as your opponent........."
units.note: Both restore but in the promise to return as a witch.

sourceReading: お前自らが否定しようとも makes Battler’s recognition hold despite her own denial.

units.text: "No, it was magic.  .........You were definitely...the Golden Witch.  .........You even denied yourself.  .........I'll accept it.  ... ... ... ... 'You are definitely, ...the Golden Witch'."

description: WH describes the space as made to be like the mansion hall rather than the decoration causing recognition that it is that hall.
sourceReading: 屋敷の、ホールであることを気付かせる means it makes them realize it is the mansion’s hall.

units.text: ......The world was wrapped in a deep blue sky, then a deep blue ocean was spread out below them. An island rose up, trees sprouted and created a forest, walls surrounded us and a ceiling swallowed us. And was adorned with more and more things, ......made to be like the hall in the Ushiromiya mansion.
units.note: MG retains made to be like the hall; UP restores recognition of the hall.

And was adorned with more and more things, ...made to be like the hall in the Ushiromiya mansion.
units.note: MG retains made to be like the hall; UP restores recognition of the hall.
units.japanese: ……世界は真っ青な大空に包まれ、次に眼下は真っ青な海で敷き詰められた。島が隆起し、木々が生えて森を成し、塀が俺たちを囲んで屋根が俺たちを飲み込んだ。それはどんどんと装飾されていき、……右代宮家の屋敷の、…ホールであることを気付かせる。
candidates: made to be like the hall

description: WH has Beelzebub leave food out of gratitude rather than condescending pity or mercy.
sourceReading: お情けであんたらの分も残してあげてる portrays sparing their portions as a favor from her generosity, matching the demand that they feel honored.

units.text: "You should be honored!!  Normally, I would have eaten all of it, but I left you some out of gratitude!"
units.note: MG retains gratitude; UP restores condescending pity.
units.japanese: 「あんた光栄に思いなさいよね！！　本当は私が全部食べるところを、お情けであんたらの分も残してあげてるんだからね！」

units.text: "You should be honored!! Normally, I would've eaten all of it, but I left you some out of gratitude!"
units.note: MG retains gratitude; UP restores condescending pity.
units.japanese: 「あんた光栄に思いなさいよね！！　本当は私が全部食べるところを、お情けであんたらの分も残してあげてるんだからね！」

description: WH says our Jessica cannot do such a thing, replacing Natsuhi’s refusal to give her daughter to a servant’s child.
sourceReading: うちの朱志香がやれるわけありません uses やる for giving the family’s daughter in marriage, as shown by the proposed pairing and Krauss’s reply about choosing a partner.

units.text: "With a servant child...?!!  You can't, our Jessica cannot do such a thing...!!"
units.note: MG makes Jessica unable to do it; UP restores Natsuhi refusing to give her away.
units.japanese: 「使用人の子となんて…！！　駄目です、うちの朱志香がやれるわけありません…！！」
candidates: Jessica cannot do such a thing

units.text: "With a servant child...?!! You can't, our Jessica cannot do such a thing...!!"
units.note: MG makes Jessica unable to do it; UP restores Natsuhi refusing to give her away.
units.japanese: 「使用人の子となんて…！！　駄目です、うちの朱志香をやれるわけありません…！！」
candidates: Jessica cannot do such a thing

description: WH reverses Kyrie’s judgment by saying the scene proves a parent can let go of their children.
sourceReading: 親が子離れしてない証拠 explicitly says this is evidence that the parents have not separated emotionally from their children.

units.text: "That's right.  It's proof that a parent can let go of their children."
units.note: Both restore parental failure to let go.
units.japanese: 「そうよ。親が子離れしてない証拠ね。」
candidates: parent can let go of their children

description: WH says He’ll elope right away, instead of advising Battler to elope quickly with his partner rather than introduce her to Rudolf.
sourceReading: 紹介しちゃ駄目よ and とっとと駆け落ちしちゃうのよ are successive instructions to the listener, with すぐ手を出すから giving the reason: this man will make advances.

units.text: "You can't introduce her to this guy, alright?  He'll get his hands on her immediately.  He'll elope right away."
units.note: Both predict another person eloping rather than advising Battler to elope.
units.japanese: 「この人に紹介しちゃ駄目よ？　すぐ手を出すから。とっとと駆け落ちしちゃうのよ。」

units.text: "Don't you dare introduce her to this man, okay? He'll get his hands on her immediately. They'll run off together right away."
units.note: Both predict another person eloping rather than advising Battler to elope.
units.japanese: 「この人に紹介しちゃ駄目よ？　すぐ手を出すから。とっとと駆け落ちしちゃうのよ」

units.text: "You can't introduce her to this guy, you know? He'll get his hands on her immediately. He'll elope right away."
units.note: Both predict another person eloping rather than advising Battler to elope.
units.japanese: 「この人に紹介しちゃ駄目よ？　すぐ手を出すから。とっとと駆け落ちしちゃうのよ」

description: WH has Battler and Beato turn their heads to see what is going on, instead of looking at each other in puzzlement before ascending.
sourceReading: 何事かと顔を見合わせて describes an exchanged glance between the two.

units.text: Grandfather and Virgilia were standing on the landing at the top of the staircase, beckoning us. After Beato and I turned our heads to see what was going on, we climbed the stairs together. From the hall, it looked like a very high stage. A small table had been set up there, as well as a piece of parchment and an old-fashioned quill pen.
units.note: MG changes mutual puzzlement to looking toward the event; UP restores the exchanged look.
units.japanese: 俺とベアトは何事かと顔を見合わせてから、二人で階段を登った。

units.text: Grandfather and Virgilia were standing on the landing at the top of the staircase, beckoning to us. Beato and I turned our heads to see what was going on, then climbed the stairs together. From the hall, it looked like a very high stage. A small table had been set up there, as well as a piece of parchment and an old-fashioned quill pen.
units.note: MG changes mutual puzzlement to looking toward the event; UP restores the exchanged look.
units.japanese: 階段の踊り場の上に、祖父さまとワルギリアがいて、手招きをしている。俺とベアトは何事かと顔を見合わせてから、二人で階段を登った。そこは、ホールから見るとまるで、とても高いステージの上のようだった。そこには小さなテーブルが用意され、そこに羊皮紙と、古風な羽ペンが用意されていた。

description: WH says when you believed in the end the Golden Land was completed, whereas Beato explains that the last participant’s belief completes it.
sourceReading: 最後のそなたが信じてくれることで…完成する presents completion through his believing, not a completed past event.

units.text: "Magic is a miracle.  ......Miracles cannot be completed unless everyone believes.  ......And, when you believed in the end, this miracle, ...the Golden Land was completed."
units.note: MG retains completed past belief; UP restores completion when the last participant believes.
units.japanese: 「魔法とは即ち、奇跡。……奇跡は全員が信じあわねば完成せぬ。……そして、最後のそなたが信じてくれることで、この奇跡は、…黄金郷は完成するのだ。」

units.text: "Magic is a miracle. ...Miracles cannot be made complete unless everyone believes. ...And, when you believed in the end, this miracle, ...the Golden Land, was completed."
units.note: MG retains completed past belief; UP restores completion when the last participant believes.
units.japanese: 「魔法とは即ち、奇跡。……奇跡は全員が信じあわねば完成せぬ。……そして、最後のそなたが信じてくれることで、この奇跡は、…黄金郷は完成するのだ」

description: WH says You are wriggling like a worm, rather than teasing that he should write his name in worm-like strokes.
sourceReading: 自分の名前くらいとっとと書け。ミミズがのたくるようにな connects the worm simile to the written name or handwriting.

units.text: "You klutz.  Shooting ink is a bad omen.  Can't you at least write your name quickly?  You are wriggling like a worm.  *cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*...!"
units.note: MG restores writing rather than bodily wriggling but turns the instruction into a present description; UP attaches scrawl to the imperative.
units.japanese: 「下手くそめ。インク弾きは縁起が悪いのだぞ。自分の名前くらいとっとと書け。ミミズがのたくるようにな。くっくくくくくくくくく…！」

units.text: "You klutz. Shooting ink is a bad omen. Can't you at least write your name quickly? Your pen's wriggling all over the place like a worm. *cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*cackle*...!"
units.note: MG restores writing rather than bodily wriggling but turns the instruction into a present description; UP attaches scrawl to the imperative.
units.japanese: 「下手くそめ。インク弾きは縁起が悪いのだぞ。自分の名前くらいとっとと書け。ミミズがのたくるようにな。くっくくくくくくくくく…！」

description: WH says they have gathered the signatures as well as the form for the covenant, instead of the signatures completing the document’s formal requirements.
sourceReading: 二人のサインが揃い、誓約書の書式が揃いました means both signatures are in place and the covenant is complete in form.

units.text: "Very well.  We have gathered the two signatures, as well as the form for the covenant.  ......Both of you, your oath please.  We'll start with Beatrice.  Put your hand on the covenant, and take the oath.
units.note: Both add gathering a form separately rather than signatures completing the formal requirements.
units.japanese: 「結構。二人のサインが揃い、誓約書の書式が揃いました。……二人には宣誓を。まずはベアトリーチェから。誓約書に手を添え、誓約を。
candidates: signatures, as well as the form for the covenant

units.text: "Very well. We have gathered the two signatures, as well as the form for the covenant. ...Both of you, your oath please. We'll start with Beatrice. Put your hand on the covenant and take the oath."
units.note: Both add gathering a form separately rather than signatures completing the formal requirements.
units.japanese: 「結構。二人のサインが揃い、誓約書の書式が揃いました。……二人には宣誓を。まずはベアトリーチェから。誓約書に手を添え、誓約を」
candidates: signatures, as well as the form for the covenant

units.text: "Very good. We have gathered the two signatures, as well as the form for the covenant. ......Both of you, your oath please. We'll start with Beatrice. Put your hand on the covenant, and take the oath."
units.note: Both add gathering a form separately rather than signatures completing the formal requirements.
units.japanese: 「結構。二人のサインが揃い、誓約書の書式が揃いました。……二人には宣誓を。まずはベアトリーチェから。誓約書に手を添え、誓約を」
candidates: signatures, as well as the form for the covenant

description: WH replaces the specified order to throw the newcomer out with the generic get her.
sourceReading: 摘み出せ orders removal or ejection from the party, matching the claim that uninvited guests are unwanted.

units.text: "......Wh, ......who are you?!  Who is this?!  Where did you come from?!  Those without invitations are not needed in my party.  Servants, get her!!"
units.note: Both explicitly eject the uninvited guest.
units.japanese: 妾のパーティーに招待状なき客は必要ない。家具ども、摘み出せッ！！」

description: WH says the girl did not move at all where Japanese says she was not shaken at all.
sourceReading: 動じない describes remaining emotionally unperturbed by the encirclement and aimed bows.

units.text: But the girl didn't move at all. ...On the contrary, she was still staring at us on the landing, as though she didn't mind at all. ......Who is she looking at...?  Beato?  Grandfather? ............It couldn't be, ......me.........?
units.note: Both give physical immobility instead of being unfazed.
units.japanese: しかし女はまったく動じない。

units.text: But the girl didn't move at all. ...On the contrary, she was still staring at us on the landing, as though she didn't mind at all. ...Who is she looking at...? Beato? Grandfather? ......Could it be...me......?
units.note: Both give physical immobility instead of being unfazed.
units.japanese: しかし女はまったく動じない。…それどころか、まったく気にもせず、相変わらず踊り場の俺たちを凝視している。……誰を見ているんだ…？　ベアト？　祖父さま？…………まさか、……俺………？

units.text: But the woman didn't move at all. ...On the contrary, she was still staring at us on the landing, not paying them the slightest bit of attention. ......Who is she looking at...? Beato? Grandfather? ............It couldn't be......me.........?
units.note: Both give physical immobility instead of being unfazed.
units.japanese: しかし女はまったく動じない。…それどころか、まったく気にもせず、相変わらず踊り場の俺たちを凝視している。……誰を見ているんだ…？　ベアト？　祖父さま？…………まさか、……俺………？

description: WH locates the lifting grip at Battler’s nape rather than his collar.
sourceReading: 襟首 refers here to the neck of the garment or collar gripped to lift him; subsequent narration identifies the goat’s arm and his feet off the floor.

units.text: At that time, something incredibly strong lifted me by the nape of my neck. ...Wh, what's going on...?! And after being made to turn around behind me, ......I saw Virgilia, with an eerie smile on her face, and the muscular forms of goat monsters... A goat monster that looked like it was 2 meters tall was grabbing me with an arm as thick as a log...!
units.note: Both place the grip at the nape rather than the collar.
units.japanese: その時、俺の襟首がものすごい力で掴みあげられる。

units.text: At that time, something incredibly strong lifted me by the nape of my neck. ...Wh-What's going on...?! And after being made to turn around behind me, ...I saw Virgilia, with an eerie smile on her face, and the muscular forms of goat monsters... A goat monster that looked about 2 meters tall was grabbing me with an arm as thick as a log...!
units.note: Both place the grip at the nape rather than the collar.
units.japanese: その時、俺の襟首がものすごい力で掴みあげられる。…な、何事…？！そして後に振り返させられると、……そこに、不気味な笑顔を浮かべたワルギリアと、そして屈強な山羊のバケモノたちの姿が…。俺は、身長が２ｍはありそうな山羊のバケモノの、丸太のように太い腕で掴み上げられている…！

units.text: Just then, something incredibly strong lifted me by the nape of my neck. ...Wh‐what's going on...?! And after I was forced to turn around, ......I saw Virgilia with an eerie smile on her face, and the muscular forms of goat monsters... A goat monster that looked like it was two meters tall was holding me up with an arm as thick as a log...!
units.note: Both place the grip at the nape rather than the collar.
units.japanese: その時、俺の襟首がものすごい力で掴みあげられる。…な、何事…？！そして後に振り返させられると、……そこに、不気味な笑顔を浮かべたワルギリアと、そして屈強な山羊のバケモノたちの姿が…。俺は、身長が２ｍはありそうな山羊のバケモノの、丸太のように太い腕で掴み上げられている…！

description: WH calls the chandelier electrocuted rather than electrically charged.
sourceReading: 帯電 describes accumulating an electrical charge before the lightning discharge.

units.text: As Beato waved her gold pipe, the massive chandelier hanging in the hall was electrocuted, and from that, a terrible purple thunderbolt fell...! It should have been a direct hit on the girl right below it, turning her to ash. However, ......not a single hair was singed.
units.note: MG retains electrocuted; UP restores electrical charging.
units.japanese: ベアトが黄金の煙管を振り上げると、ホールの天上の巨大なシャンデリアがバリバリと帯電して、そこから凄まじい紫の落雷が落ちる…！

units.text: As Beato waved her gold pipe, the massive chandelier hanging in the hall was electrocuted, and from that, a terrible purple thunderbolt fell...! It should have been a direct hit on the girl right below it, turning her to ash. However, ...not a single hair was singed.
units.note: MG retains electrocuted; UP restores electrical charging.
units.japanese: ベアトが黄金の煙管を振り上げると、ホールの天上の巨大なシャンデリアがバリバリと帯電して、そこから凄まじい紫の落雷が落ちる…！それは、真下の女に直撃し、消し炭にしてしまうはずだった。しかし、……髪の毛一本、焦がせていない。

description: WH says it was worth having the newcomer show up uninvited, rather than acknowledging that her capacity explains her daring intrusion.
sourceReading: 飛び入りするだけのことはある appraises the newcomer as having the ability befitting or justifying her uninvited entry, after surviving lightning.

units.text: "Hoh...!!  So it was worth having you show up uninvited...!!  Tell me!  Say your name!!"
units.note: MG’s not just a fluke reasonably acknowledges the capacity explaining the intrusion; UP states that capacity explicitly.
units.japanese: 「ほぉ…！！　飛び入りするだけのことはある…！！　聞こう！　名を名乗れ！！」

description: WH renders 何でも as No matter what, replacing a hearsay introduction with an unconditional qualifier.
sourceReading: 何でも here introduces something reportedly learned about acting harsh then weak and affectionate to increase favorable impressions, consistent with the following heard/studied references.

units.text: No matter what, after acting bad-tempered and exploring the depths of cruelty, by acting properly incompetent and soft, you get a massive rise on that goodwill meter thing, ri-ght?
units.note: MG Apparently and UP I hear restore hearsay.
units.japanese: 何でも、ツンツンと残虐を尽くした後に程よくヘタれてデレて見せると、好感度ってヤツが大幅アップするんだろー？

description: WH gives the literal quoted tears please rather than the sentimental tearjerker appeal that made Battler fall for it.
sourceReading: お涙頂戴 names a contrived sentimental appeal or tearjerker, paired with コロリ describing his being taken in.

units.text: And for you, just as expected, it was 'tears please', and you're down!!
units.note: Both retain tears please rather than the sentimental tearjerker appeal.
units.japanese: そうしたらお前、案の定、お涙頂戴でコロリだよ！！

units.text: "And for you, just as expected, it was "tears please", and you're down!!
units.note: Both retain tears please rather than the sentimental tearjerker appeal.
units.japanese: 「そうしたらお前、案の定、お涙頂戴でコロリだよ！！」

units.text: "And I tried it out, and just as expected, it was "tears please", and you're down!!"
units.note: Both retain tears please rather than the sentimental tearjerker appeal.
units.japanese: 「そうしたらお前、案の定、お涙頂戴でコロリだよ！！」

description: WH has the newcomer thank Beato for bringing everyone together rather than for letting her meet everyone like this.
sourceReading: みんなに会わせてくれて refers to causing or allowing the speaker to meet the others, continuing her envy and desire to join them.

units.text: "Yes, I understand.  Who would ever play with someone like you?  ......But I will thank you a bit.  ......For bringing everyone together like this."
units.note: MG restores letting the newcomer meet everyone; UP retains bringing everyone together.
units.japanese: ……でも少しだけ感謝するわ。……こうして、みんなに会わせてくれて。」

units.text: "Yes, I'm aware of that. Who would ever play with someone like you? ......But I will thank you a bit. ......For bringing everyone together like this."
units.note: MG restores letting the newcomer meet everyone; UP retains bringing everyone together.
units.japanese: 「えぇ、わかってるわ。誰があんたなんかと遊ぶものですか。……でも少しだけ感謝するわ。……こうして、みんなに会わせてくれて」

description: WH says Battler could manage a half-day plane trip, instead of predicting that half a day on a plane would overcome his difficulty.
sourceReading: 半日も飛行機に乗ってればきっと克服できる presents exposure as the means of overcoming the fear or aversion.

units.text: "Battler-kun, why don't you come with your aunt on an overseas trip sometime soon?  What about Europe?  I'm sure you could manage a half-day trip on a plane.  *giggle*giggle*giggle*!"
units.note: MG merely manages the trip; UP restores overcoming fear.
units.japanese: 「戦人くん、今度伯母さんと一緒に海外旅行に行きましょうよ。ヨーロッパとか行かない？　半日も飛行機に乗ってればきっと克服できるわよぅ。くすくすくす！」

units.text: "Battler-kun, why don't you come with your aunt on an overseas trip sometime soon? How about Europe? I'm sure you could manage a half-day trip on a plane. *giggle*giggle*giggle*!"
units.note: MG merely manages the trip; UP restores overcoming fear.
units.japanese: 「戦人くん、今度伯母さんと一緒に海外旅行に行きましょうよ。ヨーロッパとか行かない？　半日も飛行機に乗ってればきっと克服できるわよぅ。くすくすくす！」

description: WH says Rosa’s tone grew frightened where Japanese says it became a little scary.
sourceReading: 声色がちょっぴり怖くなる describes how intimidating the reprimand sounds, not fear felt by its speaker.

units.text: The tone of Rosa oba-san's voice grew a little frightened. And Battler, as soon as he realized that they really were fooling around too much...just as expected, bumped into someone.
units.note: Both restore frightening tone.
units.japanese: 楼座叔母さんの声色が、ちょっぴり怖くなる。

description: WH reduces the apology gesture toward the person struck to apologized.
sourceReading: 拝む仕草を送りながら specifies a prayer-like hands gesture while hurrying to his parents.

units.text: After George urged him to hurry on, Battler apologized to the person he had bumped into and ran up to his parents, who were telling him to come quickly. With a clunking sound, the doors on the three taxis were shut one after another, and they departed, heading for the harbor......
units.note: UP restores the gesture but omits prayer-like folded hands; MG simply apologizes.
units.japanese: 譲治に急かされ、戦人はぶつかった人に拝む仕草を送りながら、早く来いと呼ぶ両親のもとへ駆けていく。

units.text: After George urged him to hurry on, Battler apologized to the person he had bumped into and ran up to his parents, who were telling him to come quickly. With a clunking sound, the doors on the three taxis were shut one after another, and they departed for the harbor...
units.note: UP restores the gesture but omits prayer-like folded hands; MG simply apologizes.
units.japanese: 譲治に急かされ、戦人はぶつかった人に拝む仕草を送りながら、早く来いと呼ぶ両親のもとへ駆けていく。３台のタクシーは、次々にバンバンっと扉を閉め、港へ向けて出発していった……。

units.text: Rushed on by George, Battler made an apologetic gesture to the person he had bumped into and ran up to his parents, who were telling him to come quickly. With clunking sounds, the doors on the three taxis were shut one after another, and they departed, heading for the harbor......
units.note: UP restores the gesture but omits prayer-like folded hands; MG simply apologizes.
units.japanese: 譲治に急かされ、戦人はぶつかった人に拝む仕草を送りながら、早く来いと呼ぶ両親のもとへ駆けていく。３台のタクシーは、次々にバンバンっと扉を閉め、港へ向けて出発していった……。

description: WH has the black cat wandering around the shadows rather than dozing in the shade near the taxi stand.
sourceReading: まどろんでいた means it had been dozing before moving toward the girl.

units.text: ...After that, something else moved. It was a black cat wandering around the shadows near the taxi rank. It came up right behind the girl, ......and leisurely...changed its form into that of a human. It wasn't a cat.  It was a witch. Of course, the girl was also a witch.
units.note: MG cat wanders; UP restores dozing.
units.japanese: タクシー乗り場の近くの影でまどろんでいた黒猫だった。
candidates: black cat wandering around the shadows

units.text: ...Then, something else moved. It was a black cat wandering around the shadows near the taxi rank. It came up right behind the girl... and leisurely...changed its form into that of a Human. This was no cat. It was a witch. Of course, the girl was also a witch.
units.note: MG cat wanders; UP restores dozing.
units.japanese:
…すると、今度は別のものが動く。
タクシー乗り場の近くの影でまどろんでいた黒猫だった。それは女のすぐ後までやってくると、……ゆるりと、ニンゲンの姿を模して形を変えた。猫ではない。魔女だった。
もちろん、女の方だって、魔女なのだ。
candidates: black cat wandering around the shadows

description: WH says all pieces are already gathered, whereas Bernkastel says they will soon all be in place.
sourceReading: 駒たちがもうすぐ全て揃う uses もうすぐ for an imminent event, distinct from the following guess that Beato and Battler are already seated.

units.text: "How reliable.  ......Come, let us go with them.  To Rokkenjima.  All of the pieces are already gathered.  ......The curtain will open on the fourth game.  By this time, Beato and Battler are already seated."
units.note: MG pieces already gathered; UP restores imminent gathering.
units.japanese: 「頼もしいわね。……さぁ、彼らと一緒に行きましょう。六軒島へ。駒たちがもうすぐ全て揃う。……第４のゲームが幕を開けるわ。ベアトも戦人も、もう席についてる頃よ。」
candidates: Beato and Battler are already seated

units.text: "I'm glad to hear it. ...Come, let us go with them. To Rokkenjima. All of the pieces are already gathered. ...The curtain will open on the fourth game. By this time, Beato and Battler will already be seated."
units.note: MG pieces already gathered; UP restores imminent gathering.
units.japanese: 「頼もしいわね。……さぁ、彼らと一緒に行きましょう。六軒島へ。駒たちがもうすぐ全て揃う。……第４のゲームが幕を開けるわ。ベアトも戦人も、もう席についてる頃よ」

description: WH says she surely turned her face up, where Japanese describes her looking upward sharply or resolutely.
sourceReading: きっと天を仰ぐ uses きっと for the forceful or firm manner of the gaze, alongside clenched fists.

units.text: As she stood there with her fists still clenched, she surely turned her face up to the heavens. A single teardrop from the depths of her eyes dripped down into the air. And when time started moving again, the two witches' figures were sucked into a blowing gale and erased in an instant.
units.note: Both retain surely rather than resolute upward look.
units.japanese: 縁寿は両拳を握り締めたまま、きっと天を仰ぐ。

units.text: As she stood there with her fists still clenched, she surely turned her face up to the heavens. A single teardrop from the depths of her eyes dripped down into the air. And when time started moving again, the two witches' figures were swallowed up by a blowing gale and erased in an instant.
units.note: Both retain surely rather than resolute upward look.
units.japanese:
縁寿は両拳を握り締めたまま、きっと天を仰ぐ。
瞳の淵に溜まった涙の雫が一粒、宙に零れ落ちる。そして二人の魔女の姿は、時が動き出す時に吹く暴風に飲み込まれて瞬時に消え去った。

sourceReading: 瞳の淵に溜まった涙の雫 describes a drop pooled at the eye’s rim.

description: WH reports that Battler made no effort to touch the food rather than that it showed no sign of being touched.
sourceReading: 手を触れた様子もありません is an observational statement about apparent lack of contact, not a claim about effort or attempt.

units.text: "......In truth, he has been crouching and clutching at his knees for some time now.  I spoke to him several times, but he did not answer.  I also carried him food, but he made no effort to touch it."
units.note: MG removes lack of effort but asserts never touched; UP restores appearance.
units.japanese: 「……実は、膝を抱いてうずくまられて、もうだいぶになります。何度かお声をお掛けしたのですが、お返事をされません。お食事もお運びしたのですが、手を触れた様子もありません。」

units.text: "...In truth, he has been crouching and clutching at his knees for some time now. I spoke to him several times, but he did not answer. I also brought him some food, but he never even touched it."
units.note: MG removes lack of effort but asserts never touched; UP restores appearance.
units.japanese: 「……実は、膝を抱いてうずくまられて、もうだいぶになります。何度かお声をお掛けしたのですが、お返事をされません。お食事もお運びしたのですが、手を触れた様子もありません」

description: WH says Bernkastel’s guest will be coming, whereas Ronove says the guest is already present.
sourceReading: お客人もお出でになっております reports the guest’s arrival or present attendance as a reason to begin promptly.

units.text: "Because Lady Bernkastel's guest will be coming, it may be more appropriate to open the fourth game quickly.  However, it might be useful if you were to show a little consideration, Milady."
units.note: Both retain future arrival of already-present guest.
units.japanese: 「ベルンカステル卿のお客人もお出でになっておりますので、第４のゲームは速やかに開始された方がよろしいでしょう。

units.text: "Lady Bernkastel's guest will be arriving, so it may be best to open the fourth game quickly. However, perhaps you ought to show a little concern for Battler's feelings, Milady."
units.note: Both retain future arrival of already-present guest.
units.japanese: 「ベルンカステル卿のお客人もお出でになっておりますので、第４のゲームは速やかに開始された方がよろしいでしょう。ただ、お嬢様は戦人さまに多少、気を遣われても良いかもしれませんな」

units.text: "Because Lady Bernkastel's guest will be coming, it may be more appropriate to open the fourth game quickly. However, it might be useful if you were to show him a little consideration, Milady."
units.note: Both retain future arrival of already-present guest.
units.japanese: 「ベルンカステル卿のお客人もお出でになっておりますので、第４のゲームは速やかに開始された方がよろしいでしょう。ただ、お嬢様は戦人さまに多少、気を遣われても良いかもしれませんな」

description: WH compares Beelzebub’s sweetness to honey pancakes rather than the honey on pancakes.
sourceReading: パンケーキのハチミツ names the honey belonging to or served on pancakes as the sweet comparison.

units.text: "So are you gonna eat me inste~ad?!  Kyaha!  If you can eat me, just try it!  I'll bet I'd be as sweet as honey pancakes.  Kya!"
units.note: Both compare honey pancakes rather than honey on pancakes.
units.japanese: きゃっはァ！　私が食べられるものなら食べてごらんなさいよ、きっとパンケーキのハチミツのように甘いから。

units.text: "What, are you gonna eat me up insteeead?! Kyaha! If you think you can, just try it! I'll bet I'll be as sweet as honey pancakes. ...kya!"
units.note: Both compare honey pancakes rather than honey on pancakes.
units.japanese: 「代わりにオマエを食べてやるぞ〜って？！　きゃっはァ！　私を食べられるものなら食べてごらんなさいよ、きっとパンケーキのハチミツのように甘いから。ッきゃ！」

units.text: "What, are you gonna eat me inste~ad?! Kyaha! Try it if you think you can! I'll bet I'd be as sweet as honey pancakes. ...kya!"
units.note: Both compare honey pancakes rather than honey on pancakes.
units.japanese: 「代わりにオマエを食べてやるぞ〜って？！　きゃっはァ！　私を食べられるものなら食べてごらんなさいよ、きっとパンケーキのハチミツのように甘いから。ッきゃ！」

description: WH describes the flags and confetti as completely stupid and out of place, rather than creating a thoroughly celebratory atmosphere; red-and-white confetti colors also disappear.
sourceReading: おめでたい雰囲気満点 describes an abundance of festive atmosphere, with 紅白 paper confetti conventionally celebratory.

units.text: ...She opened the door forcefully. Like a marathon runner drawn on a certain caramel box, with her hands held high and with an idiotic cheeriness, ......Beato appeared. For some reason, flags from around the world and confetti scattered about, looking completely stupid and out of place.
units.note: Both restore celebratory atmosphere but omit red-and-white colors.
units.japanese: なぜだか、万国旗やら紅白の紙吹雪が舞い散り、実におめでたい雰囲気満点だった。
candidates: completely stupid and out of place

units.text: ...She flung the door open. Like a marathon runner drawn on a certain caramel box, with her hands held high and an idiotic cheeriness, ...Beato appeared. For some reason, flags from around the world and confetti scattered about, perfectly completing this magnificent entrance.
units.note: Both restore celebratory atmosphere but omit red-and-white colors.
units.japanese: …威勢良く扉が開き。某キャラメルの箱に書かれたマラソンの人みたいに、両手を高々と上げて、馬鹿みたいに明るそうに振る舞いながら、……ベアトが登場する。なぜだか、万国旗やら紅白の紙吹雪が舞い散り、実におめでたい雰囲気満点だった。

units.text: ...The door opened forcefully. Like a marathon runner drawn on a certain caramel box, with her hands held high and with an idiotic cheeriness, ......Beato appeared. For some reason, countless country flags and confetti scattered everywhere, creating what was clearly intended to be the perfect party atmosphere.
units.note: Both restore celebratory atmosphere but omit red-and-white colors.
units.japanese: …威勢良く扉が開き。某キャラメルの箱に書かれたマラソンの人みたいに、両手を高々と上げて、馬鹿みたいに明るそうに振る舞いながら、……ベアトが登場する。なぜだか、万国旗やら紅白の紙吹雪が舞い散り、実におめでたい雰囲気満点だった。

description: WH places Battler in a futon rather than under or inside a blanket.
sourceReading: 毛布の中で specifies a blanket, not a futon bed.

units.text: "Pu kukukukuku!!  No, no, he was sleeping like a baby in his futon, clutching his knees.  I informed him that it was time to wake up, but he just wouldn't get up.  I tried to feed him, but it seems that a naughty cat wandered in and prevented that.  Pu ku ku, pu- ku ku ku ku!"
units.note: MG futon versus UP blanket.
units.japanese: 「ぷっくくくくく！！　いえいえ、毛布の中で、膝を抱くようにぐっすりお休みでございまして。お目覚めの時間をお知らせしたのですが、まるでお起きになられず。食事をしようにも、悪戯猫が迷い込んでそれどころではなかったようで。ぷっくっく、ぷーっくっくっくっく！」

units.text: "Pukukukukuku!! No, no, he was sleeping like a baby in his futon, clutching his knees. I informed him that it was time to wake up, but he just wouldn't rise. I tried to feed him, but it seems that a naughty cat wandered in and prevented that. Pu ku ku, pu ku ku ku ku!"
units.note: MG futon versus UP blanket.
units.japanese: 「ぷっくくくくく！！　いえいえ、毛布の中で、膝を抱くようにぐっすりお休みでございまして。お目覚めの時間をお知らせしたのですが、まるでお起きになられず。食事をしようにも、悪戯猫が迷い込んでそれどころではなかったようで。ぷっくっく、ぷーっくっくっくっく！」

description: WH has Ronove say I tried to feed him, where the Japanese explains that trying to eat was obstructed by the naughty cat.
sourceReading: 食事をしようにも…それどころではなかった describes Battler’s inability to get on with eating, accounting for the observed chase.

units.note: MG changes eating to feeding by Ronove; UP restores Battler’s preoccupation.
units.japanese: 「ぷっくくくくく！！　いえいえ、毛布の中で、膝を抱くようにぐっすりお休みでございまして。お目覚めの時間をお知らせしたのですが、まるでお起きになられず。食事をしようにも、悪戯猫が迷い込んでそれどころではなかったようで。ぷっくっく、ぷーっくっくっくっく！」

units.text: "Pukukukukuku!! No, no, he was sleeping like a baby in his futon, clutching his knees. I informed him that it was time to wake up, but he just wouldn't rise. I tried to feed him, but it seems that a naughty cat wandered in and prevented that. Pu ku ku, pu ku ku ku ku!"
units.note: MG changes eating to feeding by Ronove; UP restores Battler’s preoccupation.
units.japanese: 「ぷっくくくくく！！　いえいえ、毛布の中で、膝を抱くようにぐっすりお休みでございまして。お目覚めの時間をお知らせしたのですが、まるでお起きになられず。食事をしようにも、悪戯猫が迷い込んでそれどころではなかったようで。ぷっくっく、ぷーっくっくっくっく！」

description: WH calls the emotional deception a rear attack rather than an indirect or underhanded tactic.
sourceReading: 搦め手 here is figurative strategy, contrasted with the direct adversarial relationship and referring to the prior apparent alliance.

units.text: "Hoh?  Why's that?  So you really are weak against the rear attack?"
units.note: Both retain rear attack for the indirect tactic, including recurrence190.
units.japanese: 「ほぉ？　何でだぁ？　やはり搦め手は苦手かぁ？」

units.text: "Hoh? Why's that? So you really are weak against a rear attack?"
units.note: Both retain rear attack for the indirect tactic, including recurrence190.
units.japanese: 「ほぉ？　何でだぁ？　やはり搦め手は苦手かぁ？」

units.text: "Hoh? And why is thaaat? So you really are weak against the rear attack?"
units.note: Both retain rear attack for the indirect tactic, including recurrence190.
units.japanese: 「ほぉ？　何でだぁ？　やはり搦め手は苦手かぁ？」

description: WH has Beato say I don’t get it instead of leaving open whether she will repeat the trick.
sourceReading: わからんぞォ followed by またやるかもな means who knows or you never know, a teasing refusal to guarantee she will not repeat it.

units.text: "..................I don't get it.  I might do it again when you've forgotten, right...?"
units.note: MG does not understand; UP leaves recurrence open.
units.japanese: 「………………。……わからんぞォ？　忘れた頃にまたやるかもなァ…？」

units.text: "...... ...I don't get it. I might do it again when you've forgotten, right...?"
units.note: MG does not understand; UP leaves recurrence open.
units.japanese: 「………………。……わからんぞォ？　忘れた頃にまたやるかもなァ…？」

description: WH says Battler forgot she was his enemy for a second rather than nearly forgetting it for a moment.
sourceReading: 忘れかけた retains the incomplete or incipient forgetting.

units.text: "...That's right.  I forgot that you were my enemy for just a second.  I won't show such a disgraceful display again.  ......I won't fall for your rear attack again.  Not again...!"
units.note: Both restore almost forgetting.
units.japanese: 「…そうだな。お前が敵であることを、一瞬だけ忘れかけた。

description: WH says Battler is waiting for an answer on Nanjo’s murder rather than withholding or postponing his own answer for now.
sourceReading: 答えを保留する makes him actively reserve his answer while insisting he has not lost heart and will break the red.

units.text: ".........I'm still waiting for an answer on that one.  But that doesn't mean that I've lost heart.  I will definitely break your 'red truth', and show that I can deny witches...!"
units.note: Both restore withholding their own answer.
units.japanese: 「………今はまだ答えを保留するさ。だがな、挫けたわけじゃねぇぞ。必ずお前の“真っ赤な真実”を破り、魔女を否定して見せる…！」

description: WH turns Beato’s statement that he does not betray her expectations into Don’t betray my expectations.
sourceReading: 妾の見込みを裏切らぬ affirms that her estimate of him is borne out, following the praise of his phoenix-like recovery.

units.text: "Hmph.  A good disposition.  You truly are a man like a phoenix.  Don't betray my expectations!  With that, let us raise the curtains on the fourth game.
units.note: MG imperative; UP restores statement of fulfilled expectation.
units.japanese: 「ふ。良い心意気だ。やはりそなたは不死鳥の如き男よ。妾の見込みを裏切らぬ！　それでは第４のゲームの幕を開けよう。

units.text: "Hmph. A commendable attitude. You truly are a man like a phoenix. Don't betray my expectations! With that, let us raise the curtains on the fourth game.
units.note: MG imperative; UP restores statement of fulfilled expectation.
units.japanese: 「ふ。良い心意気だ。やはりそなたは不死鳥の如き男よ。妾の見込みを裏切らぬ！　それでは第４のゲームの幕を開けよう」

description: WH asks whether his earlier predicament happened because he was serious, instead of whether that sorry performance was his serious effort.
sourceReading: あの体たらくが本気だったとでも questions whether the observed conduct represents genuinely serious fighting, not whether seriousness caused the situation.

units.text: "You can't possibly mean that your predicament earlier happened because you've been serious, can you?  ......Don't be a fool.  How long do you intend to go along with the witch's farce like this?"
units.note: Both ask whether the earlier performance was his serious effort.
units.japanese: 「まさか、あの体たらくが本気だったとでも？

description: WH says Don’t be a fool rather than Don’t insult me or Don’t take me for a fool.
sourceReading: 馬鹿にしないで objects to being treated dismissively or insultingly by the other speaker.

units.text: "You can't possibly mean that your predicament earlier happened because you've been serious, can you?  ......Don't be a fool.  How long do you intend to go along with the witch's farce like this?"
units.note: Both restore the objection to being insulted.
units.japanese: ……馬鹿にしないで。いつまで、こんな魔女の茶番に付き合ってるつもりなの。」

description: WH says You sure talk a lot instead of calling his proposed eventual victory a very patient or long-term prospect.
sourceReading: 気の長い話ね responds to the preceding possibility of a thousand years and the promise to win someday.

units.text: "You sure talk a lot.  Are you even trying to win?  Even the finite can become endless if it's treated the wrong way.  By now, you've become an Achilles who can't even outstrip a turtle.
units.note: Both restore the long-term/patient prospect.
units.japanese: 「気の長い話ね。あなた勝つ気あるの？　有限も、その扱いを間違えれば無限と化す。今のあなたはすでに、亀すら追い越せないアキレスなのよ。
