description: WH describes friendly play while following rules rather than friendly play protected by the rules.
sourceReading: ルールに守られて is passive protection by rules, not compliance with them.

units.text: That may be a serious contest for you two, but looking at it from far away, I only see you playing around and following the rules like you're good friends."
units.note: MG follows the rules; UP restores being protected by them.
units.japanese: あなたたちにとってそれは真剣勝負でしょうけれど、それを離れて見ている私には、仲良くルールに守られて、ただ遊んでいるようにしか見えない。」

units.text: "That may be a serious contest for you two, but looking at it from far away, I only see you playing around and following the rules like you're good friends."
units.note: MG follows the rules; UP restores being protected by them.
units.japanese: 「あなたたちにとってそれは真剣勝負でしょうけれど、それを離れて見ている私には、仲良くルールに守られて、ただ遊んでいるようにしか見えない」

description: WH says people get lazy from their own certainty rather than neglecting their own verification and delegating it to others.
sourceReading: 自らの確認を怠り、それを他人に委ねた時 explicitly makes checking the neglected task and the thing entrusted to others.

units.text: "People don't just get tricked out of the blue.  They get lazy from their own certainty, and when they entrust things to other people, that's when they get tricked.  ......Saying that you thought the light had turned green just because you saw other people start crossing doesn't count as an excuse for getting into an accident.  Get it...?"
units.note: Both restore neglecting personal verification and delegating it.
units.japanese: 「人はいきなり騙されたりはしない。自らの確認を怠り、それを他人に委ねた時、騙される。……他の人が渡り始めたからもう信号は青になったと思った、じゃ、事故の言い訳にはならないってこと。わかる…？」
candidates: get lazy from their own certainty

description: WH says just fighting together doesn’t make a united front rather than fighting together is not the only form of cooperation.
sourceReading: 一緒に戦うばかりが共闘ではない rejects exclusivity of side-by-side fighting as the definition of cooperation.

units.text: "No, I'm not an outsider.  With Beatrice and Ushiromiya Battler, ...and I who gaze down from above, it's almost like a fight in the shape of a triangle.  At a glance it might not be a united front, but just fighting together doesn't make a united front."
units.note: Both preserve that fighting together is only one form of cooperation.
units.japanese: 「いいえ、外野じゃないわ。ベアトリーチェと右代宮戦人。…そしてそれを俯瞰する私が、まるで三角形のような形になって戦うのよ。一見、これは共闘ではないけれど、一緒に戦うばかりが共闘ではない。」
candidates: fighting together doesn't make a united front

description: WH says the one further away can accurately gauge the witch instead of saying separated viewpoints allow accurate measurement.
sourceReading: 二つの視点…同じ場所…離れている方が concerns the distance between the two perspectives, in the preceding binocular analogy.

units.text: "Just now, he described fighting with you as closing the distance.  But you can't measure distance with a single eye.  Only with two eyes are things visible in three dimensions, and only then can distance be measured.  ......And even if there are two fields of vision, it's pointless if they're in the same place.  The one further away can accurately gauge the witch."
units.note: MG plural witches makes the separated objects the targets rather than viewpoints; UP singular witch retains viewpoints as the antecedent.
units.japanese: 「さっき彼は戦うことを、あなたとの距離を詰めると表現した。でも、ひとつの目では距離は測れない。ふたつの目があって初めて物事は立体的に見え、その距離も測れる。……そして二つの視点があっても、同じ場所からでは意味がない。離れている方が、魔女を正確に測ることが出来る。」
candidates: further away can accurately gauge the witch

units.text: "Just now, he described fighting with you as closing the distance. But you can't measure distance with a single eye. Only with two eyes are things visible in three dimensions, and only then can distance be judged.
units.note: MG plural witches makes the separated objects the targets rather than viewpoints; UP singular witch retains viewpoints as the antecedent.
units.japanese:
「さっき彼は戦うことを、あなたとの距離を詰めると表現した。でも、ひとつの目では距離は測れない。ふたつの目があって初めて物事は立体的に見え、その距離も測れる」
「……そして二つの視点があっても、同じ場所からでは意味がない。離れている方が、魔女を正確に測ることが出来る」

units.text: ...And even when you have two fields of vision, it's pointless if they're in the same place. You can pin down witches more accurately when they're far apart."
units.note: MG plural witches makes the separated objects the targets rather than viewpoints; UP singular witch retains viewpoints as the antecedent.
units.japanese:
「さっき彼は戦うことを、あなたとの距離を詰めると表現した。でも、ひとつの目では距離は測れない。ふたつの目があって初めて物事は立体的に見え、その距離も測れる」
「……そして二つの視点があっても、同じ場所からでは意味がない。離れている方が、魔女を正確に測ることが出来る」

description: WH has Battler decide whether she is worthy of trust rather than evaluate whether the advice is trustworthy and select or reject it.
sourceReading: それが refers to the preceding 助言, and 取捨する explicitly describes choosing what to take and discard.

units.text: "......Maybe.  She's been saying that over and over again herself.  ...So of course, I can't blindly accept her advice.  But whether she's worthy of trust or not, I can think for myself and decide.  As long as I don't stop thinking for myself, I won't be tricked by anyone again...!"
units.note: MG evaluates trusting her; UP restores selecting advice to trust.
units.japanese: だが、それが信用に値するものか否か、俺は自ら考えて、取捨することが出来る。俺が自ら考えることを止めない限り、俺はもう誰にも騙されない…！」

units.text: "...Maybe. She's been saying that over and over again herself. ...So of course, I can't blindly accept her advice. But as to whether she's worthy of trust or not, I can think for myself and make a decision. As long as I don't stop thinking for myself, I won't be tricked by anyone again...!"
units.note: MG evaluates trusting her; UP restores selecting advice to trust.
units.japanese: 「……かもな。こいつは、さっきからそれをずっと重ねて言っている。…だからこいつの助言は、もちろん鵜呑みになんか出来ないだろうさ」「だが、それが信用に値するものか否か、俺は自ら考えて、取捨することが出来る。俺が自ら考えることを止めない限り、俺はもう誰にも騙されない…！」

description: WH describes Gohda helping unload the boat instead of assisting the passengers as they disembark.
sourceReading: 下船の介添え is assistance in getting off the vessel; the following sentence specifies all guests leaving it.

units.text: The boat docked in the harbor, .........and Gohda could be seen, helping unload it. Then, ......the boat dropped off all of the passengers, .........and began to separate from the island. The relatives started to get swallowed up by the island.
units.note: Both describe unloading the boat rather than helping passengers disembark.
units.japanese: ………待っていた郷田が、下船の介添えをしているのが見える。

units.text: There was the boat docked in the harbor... ...and Gohda, helping to unload it. Then, ...once all of its passengers had disembarked, ...the boat began to separate from the shoreline. The relatives were gradually swallowed up by the island.
units.note: Both describe unloading the boat rather than helping passengers disembark.
units.japanese: 船が船着場に接岸し、………待っていた郷田が、下船の介添えをしているのが見える。そして、……船は全ての客を降ろし、………島を離れていく。島に、親族たちが飲み込まれていく。

units.text: The boat docked in the harbor, .........and Gohda, who had been waiting there, could be seen helping to unload it. And finally, ......the boat dropped off all of the passengers, .........and began to separate from the island. The relatives started to get swallowed up by the island.
units.note: Both describe unloading the boat rather than helping passengers disembark.
units.japanese: 船が船着場に接岸し、………待っていた郷田が、下船の介添えをしているのが見える。そして、……船は全ての客を降ろし、………島を離れていく。島に、親族たちが飲み込まれていく。

description: WH calls the remaining family group the rest of the parents rather than all the relatives.
sourceReading: 親族のみんな denotes the relatives, following the separately named father and mother.

units.text: Maria onee-chan, who I had loved, started dashing, and Onii-chan chased after her. They were swallowed up by the forest. Following them, Father and Mother were also swallowed up. The rest of the parents were swallowed up... ......They were swallowed up, leaving only me behind...
units.note: MG narrows all relatives to remaining parents; UP restores relatives.
units.japanese: 親族のみんなも飲み込まれていく…。

units.text: Maria onee-chan, whom I'd loved, started dashing, and Onii-chan chased after her. They were swallowed up by the forest. Following them, Father and Mother were also swallowed up. The rest of the parents were swallowed up... ...They were swallowed up, leaving only me behind...
units.note: MG narrows all relatives to remaining parents; UP restores relatives.
units.japanese: 大好きだった真里亞お姉ちゃんが駆け抜け、その後をお兄ちゃんが追っていく。森の中に飲み込まれていく。その後を追って、お父さんもお母さんも飲み込まれていく。親族のみんなも飲み込まれていく…。……私だけを置いて、飲み込まれていく…。

description: WH makes responding to the greeting a means of stifling discomfort instead of an action performed while suppressing it.
sourceReading: 違和感を噛み殺して返した describes suppressing awkwardness to manage the response.

units.text: 'Good day to you' is the standard greeting used here. No matter how many years pass by, this style of greeting still feels very awkward... Even though I had responded to the greeting in order to stifle that awkward feeling, the classmate who had spoken looked at me blankly.
units.note: Purpose substitution remains.
units.japanese: そんな違和感を噛み殺して返した挨拶なのに、挨拶してきたクラスメートは、きょとんとしたような表情を見せる。

units.text: "Good day to you" is the standard greeting used here. No matter how many years pass by, this style of greeting still feels very awkward... Even though I'd responded to the greeting in order to stifle that awkward feeling, the classmate who had spoken looked at me blankly.
units.note: Purpose substitution remains.
units.japanese: “御機嫌よう”は、ここでは標準的な挨拶言葉。何年もこの挨拶で過ごしても、未だに強い違和感を覚える…。そんな違和感を噛み殺して返した挨拶なのに、挨拶してきたクラスメートは、きょとんとしたような表情を見せる。

units.text: "Good day to you" is the standard greeting used here. No matter how many years pass by, this style of greeting still feels very awkward... I had responded to the greeting in order to stifle that awkward feeling, but the classmate who had spoken looked at me blankly.
units.note: Purpose substitution remains.
units.japanese: “御機嫌よう”は、ここでは標準的な挨拶言葉。何年もこの挨拶で過ごしても、未だに強い違和感を覚える…。そんな違和感を噛み殺して返した挨拶なのに、挨拶してきたクラスメートは、きょとんとしたような表情を見せる。

description: WH says the actual meaning was innocent and cruel rather than the girls themselves being innocent and cruel beneath their refined manners.
sourceReading: 本質的な部分 contrasts their essential nature with outward speech and behavior.

units.text: Their choice of words and manner were certainly what you would expect of a school for rich girls, but the actual meaning was as innocent and cruel as you would expect from kids of that age. ......It seems they found it funny that I'd mistakenly thought the greeting was directed at me.  No, it might be the opposite. ...Maybe I should say that they didn't know what to do after being greeted by an introverted kid like me.
units.note: UP restores underlying nature.
units.japanese: 彼女らの言葉遣いや振る舞いなどは、確かにお嬢様学校らしいものだが、本質的な部分はみんな歳相応に無邪気で残酷だ。

units.text: Their choice of words and manner were certainly what you'd expect from a school for rich girls, but the actual meaning was as innocent and cruel as you'd expect from kids of that age. ...It seems they found it funny that I'd mistakenly thought the greeting was directed at me. No, it might be the opposite. ...Maybe they didn't know how to react after being suddenly greeted by a gloomy, quiet kid like me.
units.note: UP restores underlying nature.
units.japanese: 彼女らの言葉遣いや振る舞いなどは、確かにお嬢様学校らしいものだが、本質的な部分はみんな歳相応に無邪気で残酷だ。……私が、自分に掛けられた挨拶だと誤解したことが面白かったらしい。いや、その逆かもしれない。…私みたいな根暗な子に突然挨拶をされて、対応に困った、というべきか。

description: WH substitutes forced to live my life in dreariness for spending a mind-numbingly long stretch of months and days confined at the academy.
sourceReading: 気の遠くなるような月日を経る emphasizes the overwhelming duration of the confinement.

units.text: I was truly among the latter, and was confined in Saint Lucia Academy, ......forced to live my life in dreariness.
units.note: UP restores daunting duration.
units.japanese: 私はまさにその後者として、聖ルチーア学園に幽閉され、………気の遠くなるような月日を経ることになる。
candidates: forced to live my life in dreariness

units.text: I was truly among the latter...and was confined in Saint Lucia Academy, ...forced to live my life in dreariness.
units.note: UP restores daunting duration.
units.japanese: 私はまさにその後者として、聖ルチーア学園に幽閉され、………気の遠くなるような月日を経ることになる。
candidates: forced to live my life in dreariness

description: WH makes an injury’s seriousness the hospital-room status analogy instead of the severity of an illness one has contracted.
sourceReading: 自分の掛かった病の重さ refers to disease or illness, not injury.

units.text: Just like how the seriousness of an injury becomes a sign of status in a hospital room, how noble a birth one had became a sign of status here. Those who aren't permitted to go out in public places are probably nothing more than filthy people to them. They must think that getting involved with students like that would dirty them as well.
units.note: Both retain injury for illness.
units.japanese: 病室では自分の掛かった病の重さがステータスになるように、ここでは生まれの高潔さがステータスとなる。

units.text: Just like how the seriousness of an injury becomes a sign of status in a hospital room, how noble a birth one had became a sign of status here. Those girls who couldn't be acknowledged in public were probably nothing more than filth to the others. They must've thought that getting involved with such students would dirty them as well.
units.note: Both retain injury for illness.
units.japanese: 病室では自分の掛かった病の重さがステータスになるように、ここでは生まれの高潔さがステータスとなる。公の場に出ることが許されない存在など、汚らわしいものでしかないのだろう。そういう生徒にかかわると、自分までもが穢れてしまうとでも思っているに違いない。

units.text: Just like how the seriousness of your injury grants you status in a hospital room, here, status is granted by the nobility of your birth. Those who aren't permitted to go out in public are probably nothing more than filth to them. They must think that getting involved with students like that would dirty them as well.
units.note: Both retain injury for illness.
units.japanese: 病室では自分の掛かった病の重さがステータスになるように、ここでは生まれの高潔さがステータスとなる。公の場に出ることが許されない存在など、汚らわしいものでしかないのだろう。そういう生徒にかかわると、自分までもが穢れてしまうとでも思っているに違いない。

description: WH narrates being kept like a pet as a past state instead of the lifetime of powerless captivity Ange realizes awaits her.
sourceReading: 生涯…飼い殺される describes being maintained in subjugation without a meaningful role for her whole life, followed by even elementary-school Ange understanding that prospect.

units.text: ......However, that wasn't something I could endure. I couldn't possibly live together with Eva oba-san. ......As my life was continually compared with her dead son's, I was kept like a pet. I understood that even when I was in elementary school.
units.note: UP would be restores the anticipated lifetime; suffocated is a free rendering of wasted captivity.
units.japanese: ……私は生涯を亡き息子に当てつけられながら、飼い殺される。

units.text: ...However, that wasn't something I could endure. I couldn't possibly live together with Aunt Eva. ...I was kept like a pet, my life continually compared with her dead son's. I understood that even when I was still in elementary school.
units.note: UP would be restores the anticipated lifetime; suffocated is a free rendering of wasted captivity.
units.japanese:
……しかし、それは私にとってはたまったものではない。
私は絵羽伯母さんとは到底一緒に生活をすることは出来ない。……私は生涯を、亡き息子の当てつけにされながら、飼い殺される。それを、まだ小学生の私ですら、理解した。

description: WH makes throw it away refer to the family crest rather than retaining the separately named family name.
sourceReading: 家紋に泥を塗り、その名を捨て去ろう identifies dishonoring the crest and attempting to abandon the name as distinct accusations.

units.text: I was caught by the guards and brought back, .........and for being a coward who had smeared the Ushiromiya family crest with mud and tried to throw it away, .........in a way that makes my whole body shake and shiver just remembering it, .........I was punished.
units.note: UP separates name from crest.
units.japanese: 私は護衛たちに捕らえられて連れ戻され、………右代宮の家紋に泥を塗り、その名を捨て去ろうとした卑怯者として、………思い出すだけでも未だに全身が震えて悪寒が走るほどの、

units.text: I was caught by the guards and brought back, ......and for being a coward who had smeared the Ushiromiya family crest with mud and tried to throw it away, ......in a way that makes my whole body shake and shiver just remembering it, ......I was punished.
units.note: UP separates name from crest.
units.japanese: 私は護衛たちに捕らえられて連れ戻され、………右代宮の家紋に泥を塗り、その名を捨て去ろうとした卑怯者として、………思い出すだけでも未だに全身が震えて悪寒が走るほどの、………罰を受けた。

description: WH says I had stolen the inheritance rather than describing Eva’s resentment that her son’s intended succession would be taken from him by Ange succeeding.
sourceReading: 私に奪われることになる presents a prospective passive deprivation from Eva’s viewpoint, not Ange’s completed act of theft.

units.text: How should I describe what Eva oba-san was like when she punished me? In a frenzy?  Gleeful? ......The anger and sadness of losing her beloved son, and well as the hatred and pain that I had stolen the inheritance from the son who should have succeeded it.  And the dark pleasure at being able to let those feelings out on me. ......I was hit with all of those negative emotions at once.
units.note: MG removes completed had stolen but retains inheritance rather than prospective headship.
units.japanese: ……最愛の息子を失った怒りと悲しみと、息子が継ぐはずだった家督を私に奪われることになる恨み辛み。そしてそんな感情を私にぶつけて発散できる黒い喜び。

units.text: How should I describe what Aunt Eva was like when she punished me? In a frenzy? Gleeful? ...I saw the anger and sadness of losing her beloved son, and well as the hatred and pain from me stealing that inheritance from the son who should've received it. And the dark pleasure at being able to let those feelings out on me. ...I was hit with all those negative emotions at once.
units.note: MG removes completed had stolen but retains inheritance rather than prospective headship.
units.japanese: 私を罰する絵羽伯母さんを何という言葉で例えればいいだろう。凶乱？　嬉々として？……最愛の息子を失った怒りと悲しみと、息子が継ぐはずだった家督を私に奪われることになる恨み辛み。そしてそんな感情を私にぶつけて発散できる黒い喜び。……そんな、負の感情のありったけをぶつけられた。

description: WH calls classmates’ derisive laughter calm and pleasant where Japanese treats it as comparatively mild and unable to hurt her heart.
sourceReading: 涼やかなもの…堪えるわけもない places the mockery below the threshold of harm compared with Eva’s treatment.

units.text: Compared to that lifestyle, the derisive laughter of my classmates here was calm and pleasant.  ......It was no match for my heart...
units.note: UP comparative even felt refreshing can convey the refreshing mildness of 涼やか; following no match confirms diminished impact, not enjoying bullying. Parent accepts this closer reading.
units.japanese: そんな生活に比べれば、ここでのクラスメートの冷笑など涼やかなもの。……私の心に、堪えるわけもない…。

units.text: Compared to that lifestyle, the derisive laughter of my classmates here was calm and pleasant. ...It caused my heart no trouble...
units.note: UP comparative even felt refreshing can convey the refreshing mildness of 涼やか; following no match confirms diminished impact, not enjoying bullying. Parent accepts this closer reading.
units.japanese: そんな生活に比べれば、ここでのクラスメートの冷笑など涼やかなもの。……私の心に、堪えるわけもない…。

description: WH says Maria had certainly been nine when she died rather than recalling that she was nine, if memory serves.
sourceReading: 享年は確か９歳 uses 確か as a recollection qualifier, followed by the resulting younger appearance.

units.text: On the open diary, ...no, in the world of the diary, Maria onee-chan showed herself... She had certainly been nine when she died.  ......So her form was already younger than me. But I call her Onee-chan, so she also affectionately calls me Ange.
units.note: Both restore uncertain recollection.
units.japanese: 彼女の享年は確か９歳。……だからその姿はすでに私よりも幼い。
candidates: certainly been nine when she died

description: WH says she calls Ange affectionately because Ange calls her Onee-chan.
sourceReading: 呼ぶし、彼女も…呼んでくれる coordinates the two affectionate forms of address; it does not say the second depends on the first.

units.text: On the open diary, ...no, in the world of the diary, Maria onee-chan showed herself... She had certainly been nine when she died.  ......So her form was already younger than me. But I call her Onee-chan, so she also affectionately calls me Ange.
units.note: UP restores reciprocity rather than causation.
units.japanese: でも、私は彼女をお姉ちゃんと呼ぶし、彼女も私を縁寿と親しみを込めて呼んでくれる。

units.text: On the pages of the open diary...no, in the world of the diary, Maria onee-chan showed herself... I'm pretty sure she was nine when she died. ...So her form was already younger than me. But I call her Onee-chan, so she affectionately calls me Ange.
units.note: UP restores reciprocity rather than causation.
units.japanese: 開かれた日記の上に、…いや、日記の世界に、真里亞お姉ちゃんが姿を現す…。彼女の享年は確か９歳。……だからその姿はすでに私よりも幼い。でも、私は彼女をお姉ちゃんと呼ぶし、彼女も私を縁寿と親しみを込めて呼んでくれる。

description: WH expands the newspaper’s fast-eating ranking from the class newspaper to her grade’s newspaper.
sourceReading: 学級新聞 refers to a classroom or class newspaper, not the whole school year.

units.text: I read it in the diary.  No, I heard it from Maria onee-chan. It seemed that she had been ranked number 1 among the girls in the speed-eating ranking of her grade's newspaper. It seems that she had been very proud of that, but had been a little disappointed that her mother, Rosa oba-san, hadn't praised her very much for it.
units.note: Both retain grade rather than class newspaper.
units.japanese: 学級新聞の早食いランキングで女子で一番だったことがあるらしいのだ。

units.text: I read about it in her diary. No, I heard it from Maria onee-chan. She was ranked number 1 among the girls in the speed-eating ranking for her grade's newspaper. She was apparently very proud of that, but a little disappointed that her mother, Aunt Rosa, hadn't praised her very much for it.
units.note: Both retain grade rather than class newspaper.
units.japanese: 日記で読んだ。いや、真里亞お姉ちゃんに聞いた。学級新聞の早食いランキングで女子で一番だったことがあるらしいのだ。彼女はそれを誇らしく思ったが、それを母親の楼座叔母さんはあまり褒めてくれなかったのがちょっぴり残念だったらしい。

units.text: I read it in the diary. No, I heard it from Maria onee‐chan. She was once ranked number 1 among the girls on the speed‐eating leaderboard in her grade's newspaper. She had been very proud of that, but had apparently been a little disappointed that her mother, Auntie Rosa, hadn't praised her very much for it.
units.note: Both retain grade rather than class newspaper.
units.japanese: 日記で読んだ。いや、真里亞お姉ちゃんに聞いた。学級新聞の早食いランキングで女子で一番だったことがあるらしいのだ。彼女はそれを誇らしく思ったが、それを母親の楼座叔母さんはあまり褒めてくれなかったのがちょっぴり残念だったらしい。

description: WH gives Maria an imperative Talk about Sakutaro instead of her promise that she will talk about him.
sourceReading: さくたろのこと話すよ declares the speaker’s intended action, then begins introducing the stuffed animal.

units.text: "Uu-!  Talk about Sakutaro!  You know, Sakutaro is a re-ally cute stuffed animal!  I'm sure you would like him too, Ange!  Uu-!"
units.note: MG inclusive invitation retains participation; UP imperative assigns the telling to listener.
units.japanese: 「うー！　さくたろのこと話すよ！　さくたろはね、とっても可愛いぬいぐるみなの！　縁寿もきっと気に入るよ！　うー！」

units.text: "Uu! Talk about Sakutaro! Sakutaro is...a reeeeally cute stuffed animal! I'm sure you'd like him too, Ange! Uu!"
units.note: MG inclusive invitation retains participation; UP imperative assigns the telling to listener.
units.japanese: 「うー！　さくたろのこと話すよ！　さくたろはね、とっても可愛いぬいぐるみなの！　縁寿もきっと気に入るよ！　うー！」

description: WH says Rosa wanted Maria to spend her birthday at a wonderful restaurant instead of making a practice of doing so.
sourceReading: 必ず…過ごすようにしていた describes ensuring or regularly arranging that birthday practice, clarified by home parties then expensive restaurants.

units.text: Today was Maria's birthday. Rosa had wanted to let Maria spend her birthday at a wonderful restaurant no matter what. When Maria had been in kindergarten, they had sometimes invited other kids from the neighborhood over and had a party at home. Rosa would make a wonderful cake and snacks and decorate the house herself, making it a huge celebration. But when they had moved and Maria had stopped having friends in the neighborhood, Rosa had started splurging at expensive restaurants instead.
units.note: MG always restores habitual force, but tried to let weakens established observance.
units.japanese: 楼座は彼女の誕生日を、必ず素敵なレストランで過ごすようにしていた。
candidates: spend her birthday at a wonderful restaurant

units.text: Today was Maria's birthday. Rosa always tried to let Maria spend her birthdays at great restaurants. When Maria had been in kindergarten, they sometimes invited other kids from the neighborhood over and had a party at home. Rosa would make a wonderful cake and snacks and decorate the house herself, making it a huge celebration. But when they moved and Maria no longer had friends in the neighborhood, Rosa had started splurging at expensive restaurants instead.
units.note: MG always restores habitual force, but tried to let weakens established observance.
units.japanese: 今日は真里亞の誕生日。楼座は彼女の誕生日を、必ず素敵なレストランで過ごすようにしていた。真里亞がまだ幼稚園の頃は、近所のお友達を招いてホームパーティーをしたこともある。楼座が腕によりを掛けた、手作りの素敵なケーキやお菓子、室内のレイアウトなどをして、とても盛大に祝ったものだ。ただ、引越しの関係で、近所に友人を持たなくなってからは奮発した高級レストランがそれに変わるようになった。

description: WH says Battler did not always come rather than habitually not coming despite the repeated invitations.
sourceReading: いつも来てくれない describes the recurring nonattendance blamed on his discomfort with their father.

units.text: Even though we always sent an invitation to Battler onii-chan, he didn't get along with Dad or something, so he didn't always come. ......So when he did come, I was really happy... ...The birthday parties when the whole four-person family gathered made for fun memories that I will never forget...
units.note: MG kept not coming restores habitual absence; UP did not always come retains scope shift.
units.japanese: 戦人お兄ちゃんにはいつも招待状を送るのに、お父さんが苦手とかでいつも来てくれない。

units.text: Even though we always sent an invitation to Battler onii‐chan, he didn't get along with Dad or something, so he didn't always come. ......So when he did come, I was really happy. ...The birthday parties when the whole four‐person family was together made for fun memories that I will never forget...
units.note: MG kept not coming restores habitual absence; UP did not always come retains scope shift.
units.japanese: 戦人お兄ちゃんにはいつも招待状を送るのに、お父さんが苦手とかでいつも来てくれない。……だから来てくれた時はすごい嬉しかったっけ。…四人家族が全員揃った時のお誕生会は生涯忘れられない楽しい思い出だ…。

description: WH locates the wrapped gift in the corner of Rosa’s bag rather than beside the bag.
sourceReading: ママの鞄の脇にある locates the parcel alongside the bag, outside it.

units.text: "Uu-!  Was re-ally looking forward to it.  Was so excited, wondering if Mama would show Maria the wrapped present in the corner of her bag right away."
units.note: Both keep gift inside bag rather than beside it.
units.japanese: 「うー！　すっごく楽しみだった。ママの鞄の脇にあるプレゼントの包みを、早く見せてもらえないかなと、ずっとわくわくしてた。」

units.text: "Uu-! I was reeeally looking forward to it. I got so excited, wondering when Mama would show me the wrapped present in the corner of her bag."
units.note: Both keep gift inside bag rather than beside it.
units.japanese: 「うー！　すっごく楽しみだった。ママの鞄の脇にあるプレゼントの包みを、早く見せてもらえないかなと、ずっとわくわくしてた」

units.text: "Uu! Was reeeally looking forward to it. Was so excited the whole time, wondering when Mama would show me the wrapped present in the side of her bag."
units.note: Both keep gift inside bag rather than beside it.
units.japanese: 「うー！　すっごく楽しみだった。ママの鞄の脇にあるプレゼントの包みを、早く見せてもらえないかなと、ずっとわくわくしてた」

description: WH says it seemed to be some kind of brand name instead of saying that Rosa’s company apparently has a brand name too.
sourceReading: ブランド名もあるらしい supplies existence of a brand name for the company, followed by uncertain recollection of its name.

units.text: Rosa oba-san ran a clothing design company. It seemed to be some kind of brand name.  ......What was it, Anti-Rosa...? It seems that their catch phrase was 'I can't forgive the way I was before today'. ...Unfortunately, I've never met someone who knew of that brand name. Maybe it wasn't that famous.
units.note: UP restores company having a brand name.
units.japanese: 一応、ブランド名もあるらしい。……何だっけ、アンチローザだったっけ…？
candidates: seemed to be some kind of brand name

units.text: Aunt Rosa ran a clothing design company. It seemed to be some kind of brand name. ...What was it, Anti-Rosa...? It seems their catch phrase was "I can't forgive the me of yesterday". ...Unfortunately, I've never met someone who knew of that brand name. Maybe it wasn't that famous.
units.note: UP restores company having a brand name.
units.japanese:
楼座叔母さんは洋服のデザイン会社をやっている。一応、ブランド名もあるらしい。
……何だっけ、アンチローザだったっけ…？“昨日までの自分が、許せない”、がキャッチコピーらしい。…残念ながら、そのブランド名を知っている人間には会った事がない。あまり有名ではないのだろう。
candidates: seemed to be some kind of brand name

description: WH inserts a hypothetical in which Ange is as naive as Maria and would act the same way.
sourceReading: 真里亞お姉ちゃんの単純さなら…そうするだろう predicts Maria’s action from her straightforward nature; Ange smiles when that prediction is fulfilled.

units.text: As soon as she proclaimed that, she started tearing into her meal. Rosa oba-san got mad at her, saying that was rude. It seemed that she had expected this would happen right away. I had also thought that, if I were as naive as Maria onee-chan, I would probably do the same thing, so it was kind of pleasant when my expectations weren't betrayed.
units.note: MG restores prediction of Maria’s behavior; UP keeps hypothetical self-comparison.
units.japanese: 私も、真里亞お姉ちゃんの単純さなら、きっとそうするだろうと思ったので、予想を裏切られなくて何だか微笑ましくなった。

units.text:
As soon as she proclaimed that, she started tearing into her meal. Auntie Rosa scolded her, telling her not to make a scene.
It seemed that she had seen it coming immediately. I had been thinking that, if I were as straightforward as Maria onee‐chan, that would probably be exactly what I would do as well, so it brought a kind of warm smile to my face when my expectations weren't betrayed.
units.note: MG restores prediction of Maria’s behavior; UP keeps hypothetical self-comparison.
units.japanese:
そう宣言すると、がっつくように食事を急ぎ始める。みっともない真似をしないようにと楼座叔母さんが怒る。
すぐに想定できた事態らしい。私も、真里亞お姉ちゃんの単純さなら、きっとそうするだろうと思ったので、予想を裏切られなくて何だか微笑ましくなった。

description: WH places Sakutaro’s white area on his chest rather than his belly.
sourceReading: 白いお腹 specifies the white belly in the description of the stuffed lion.

units.text: Before Rosa oba-san finished talking, Maria started unwrapping it. As soon as she did, ......yellow and orange peeked out. What appeared was a slightly blank-looking lion stuffed animal, with cute round eyes and a white chest. It was about the size of a small pillow. It looked pretty big next to a short person like Maria onee-chan, but it probably wasn't that large.
units.note: Both place white area on chest rather than belly.
units.japanese: そこに現れたのは、つぶらな瞳と白いお腹が可愛らしい、ちょっとのっぺりとしたライオンのぬいぐるみだった。

units.text: Before Aunt Rosa finished talking, Maria started unwrapping it. As soon as she did, ...yellow and orange peeked out. What appeared was a slightly blank-looking lion stuffed animal, with cute round eyes and a white chest. It was about the size of a small pillow. It looked pretty big next to someone as short as Maria onee-chan, but it probably wasn't that large.
units.note: Both place white area on chest rather than belly.
units.japanese: 楼座叔母さんが言い終わらない内に、さっそく包装を開き始める。するとすぐに、……黄色と橙色がのぞく。そこに現れたのは、つぶらな瞳と白いお腹が可愛らしい、ちょっとのっぺりとしたライオンのぬいぐるみだった。大きさは小さな枕くらい。背の低い真里亞お姉ちゃんが持つとそこそこの大きさに見えるけど、多分、そう大きくはないだろう。

units.text: Before Auntie Rosa finished her sentence, Maria onee‐chan started unwrapping the present. And straight away, ......yellow and orange peeked out. What appeared was a slightly blank‐looking stuffed lion, with cute round eyes and a cute white chest. It was about the size of a small pillow. It looked pretty big held by a short person like Maria onee‐chan, but it probably wasn't that large.
units.note: Both place white area on chest rather than belly.
units.japanese: 楼座叔母さんが言い終わらない内に、さっそく包装を開き始める。するとすぐに、……黄色と橙色がのぞく。そこに現れたのは、つぶらな瞳と白いお腹が可愛らしい、ちょっとのっぺりとしたライオンのぬいぐるみだった。大きさは小さな枕くらい。背の低い真里亞お姉ちゃんが持つとそこそこの大きさに見えるけど、多分、そう大きくはないだろう。

description: WH retains the brick and its corner but generalizes the explicitly targeted back of the head to over the head.
sourceReading: 後頭部 is the back of the head, an additional concrete detail in Ange’s coldly specified threat.

units.text: "......That's a horrible rule.  I want to find the person who made that and hit them over the head with a brick.  Using the corner, of course."
units.note: Both generalize targeted back of head.
units.japanese: 「……最低なルールね。それを作ったヤツの後頭部を煉瓦で殴ってやりたいわ。もちろん角で。」

units.text: "...That's a horrible rule. I'd like to find the person who made it and hit them over the head with a brick. Using the corner, of course."
units.note: Both generalize targeted back of head.
units.japanese: 「……最低なルールね。それを作ったヤツの後頭部を煉瓦で殴ってやりたいわ。もちろん角で」

units.text: "......That's a horrible rule. I want to find whoever made that and hit them over the head with a brick. The corner of it, obviously."
units.note: Both generalize targeted back of head.
units.japanese: 「……最低なルールね。それを作ったヤツの後頭部を煉瓦で殴ってやりたいわ。もちろん角で」

description: WH introduces the witch’s protection promise with Then rather than presenting it as another consideration in the angel’s deliberation.
sourceReading: それに adds the promise of protecting all the others to the reduction in victims; it is part of the reasoning for acceptance.

units.text: "Uu-.  The angel thought about it.  Compared to half the class meeting with misfortune, having only one person be unfortunate would be much better.  Then, the witch said that she would protect the safety of all the other students, using her powerful magic."
units.note: MG Then imposes sequence; UP Plus restores additional consideration.
units.japanese: 「うー。天使様は考えたの。クラスの半分が不幸になることに比べたら、クラスの１人だけが不幸になることの方がずっと良い。それに、魔女はその強力な力で他全員の生徒の安全を守ってくれると言う。」

units.text: "Uu-. The angel thought about it. Compared to half the class meeting with misfortune, having only one person be unfortunate would be much better. Then, the witch said that she'd protect the safety of all the other students, using her powerful magic."
units.note: MG Then imposes sequence; UP Plus restores additional consideration.
units.japanese: 「うー。天使様は考えたの。クラスの半分が不幸になることに比べたら、クラスの１人だけが不幸になることの方がずっと良い。それに、魔女はその強力な力で他全員の生徒の安全を守ってくれると言う」

description: WH attributes different peace of mind to a small difference in the girls’ thinking.
sourceReading: ものの考え方ひとつで means through one’s way of thinking alone, not that their ways of thinking differ only slightly. Ange has just called Maria’s thinking unusual and excessively compassionate.

units.text: ...Maria onee-chan's idea was too compassionate. The misfortune of my and her situations are very similar.  ......And yet, maybe you could say that because of a small difference in our way of thinking, there's a difference in how peaceful our hearts are.
units.note: Both add small difference in outlook.
units.japanese: 私と彼女の境遇の不幸さはとても近い。……にもかかわらず、ものの考え方ひとつで、心の安らぎは違うというのだろうか。

units.text: ...Maria onee-chan's idea was too compassionate. Both of us are suffering from a very similar type of misfortune. ...And yet, maybe a small difference in our way of thinking changes how peaceful our hearts are.
units.note: Both add small difference in outlook.
units.japanese: …真里亞お姉ちゃんの考えは、慈悲深過ぎる。私と彼女の境遇の不幸さはとても近い。……にもかかわらず、ものの考え方ひとつで、心の安らぎは違うというのだろうか。

units.text: ...Maria onee‐chan's thinking is too compassionate. The miserableness of our situations is very similar. ......And yet, there's a difference in our inner peace, just because of a small difference in our way of thinking?
units.note: Both add small difference in outlook.
units.japanese: …真里亞お姉ちゃんの考えは、慈悲深過ぎる。私と彼女の境遇の不幸さはとても近い。……にもかかわらず、ものの考え方ひとつで、心の安らぎは違うというのだろうか。

description: WH specifically says Maria changed the stuffed animal’s facial expressions.
sourceReading: 感情表現 is expression of emotion, here through skillful puppet-like movement; the next sentence specifies waving a short hand and tilting the head.

units.text: Skillfully moving the stuffed animal like it was a puppet, Maria onee-chan changed Sakutaro's facial expressions. She was controlling him, but the charming way he waved his short hand and cocked his head to the side, made it feel like he really was a new friend called Sakutaro.
units.note: Both restore emotional expression.
units.japanese: 真里亞お姉ちゃんは、まるでパペットのようにぬいぐるみを器用に動かし、さくたろの感情表現をしてみせる。

description: WH says a personality had been sublimated into his existence, reversing the direction of the narrated development.
sourceReading: その存在は人格にまで昇華されていた says that the imagined existence had already been elevated to a personality/personhood before their meeting.

units.text: Maria onee-chan had given the name 'Sakutarou' to the stuffed animal she was to receive on her birthday, and had warmed and expanded his existence in her heart for a long, long time. Therefore, even before she had met him, a personality had been sublimated into his existence. Even at the first moment they had met, he and she had been friends.
units.note: Both restore existence developing into personality.
units.japanese: だから、出会う前からその存在は人格にまで昇華されていた。
candidates: personality had been sublimated into his existence

description: WH links possible refusal of a pet to Maria treating objects as precious, instead of listing pet refusal and care for objects as separate possible contributing motives.
sourceReading: …こともあるかもしれないし、…気持ちもあったかもしれない offers parallel possibilities; the following isolation speculation joins these various circumstances.

units.text: Of course, I don't think anything could be as personified and loved as Sakutarou was, but that wasn't anything extraordinary in Maria onee-chan's eyes. She loved the things she owned very much, treating them just like friends or beloved pets. Maybe Rosa oba-san hadn't let her keep a pet at some point in time, so she treated objects as though they were precious. ......Maybe she was so isolated that she had been forced to find a friend nearby. Because of those various conditions, this wasn't anything extraordinary from her perspective.
units.note: UP restores separate possible motives.
units.japanese: 楼座叔母さんにペットを飼うことを許してもらえなかったこともあるかもしれないし、物を大切にするという気持ちもあったかもしれない。

units.text: Of course, that wasn't anything extraordinary in Maria onee-chan's eyes, although I don't think she'd personified and loved anything quite as much as Sakutarou. She loved the things she owned very much, treating them just like friends or beloved pets. Maybe Aunt Rosa hadn't let her keep a pet at some point in time, so she felt like treasuring objects instead. ...And maybe she was so isolated that she'd been forced to find a friend nearby. Because of all that, what happened that day wasn't anything extraordinary from her perspective.
units.note: UP restores separate possible motives.
units.japanese: 確かに、さくたろうほどにまで人格化されて愛された存在はないだろうが、真里亞お姉ちゃんにとってそれは特別なことではない。彼女は自分の持ち物をとてもよく愛し、まるで友人やよく懐いたペットのように扱った。楼座叔母さんにペットを飼うことを許してもらえなかったこともあるかもしれないし、物を大切にするという気持ちもあったかもしれない。……身近に友人を見つけなければならないほど、彼女が孤立していたこともあったかもしれない。そんな様々な事情から、彼女にとってこのようなことは特別なことではなかったのだ。

description: WH specifies that Rosa’s company is starting to get orders rather than starting to attract attention.
sourceReading: 注目され始めた describes newly growing attention, still qualified by みたい; orders are not specified.

units.text: "Sorry.  Mama just can't get her work finished...  The next season's lineup is having a tough time.  It looks like we're finally starting to get orders bit by bit, and I want to somehow give an impact here that can answer their expectations..."
units.note: UP restores attention rather than orders.
units.japanese: 「ごめんね。ママ、どうしても仕事が片付かなくて…。来期のラインナップが難航してるの。ようやく少しずつ注目され始めたみたいで、何とかここで期待に応えられるインパクトを与えたいのよ…。」

units.text: "Sorry. Mama just can't get her work finished tonight... The next season's lineup is having a tough time. It looks like we're finally starting to get orders bit by bit, and I want to somehow give it a bit more impact so we can answer to their expectations..."
units.note: UP restores attention rather than orders.
units.japanese: 「ごめんね。ママ、どうしても仕事が片付かなくて…。来期のラインナップが難航してるの。ようやく少しずつ注目され始めたみたいで、何とかここで期待に応えられるインパクトを与えたいのよ…」

description: WH replaces Maria’s instruction to put the receipt with the change with Rosa saying she will check both.
sourceReading: お釣りと一緒にレシートも入れておくのよ orders the child to keep or put the receipt together with the change.

units.text: "I'll make sure that I can come back this time tomorrow.  Let's eat dinner together tomorrow.  You haven't eaten dinner yet, have you Maria?  Buy a bento at the convenience store and eat it.  No sweets, and no soda.  I'll check the receipt and the change, understand?"
units.note: UP restores instruction to child, but obtaining receipt omits keeping it with change.
units.japanese: 「明日のこの時間には帰れるようにするわ。明日は一緒に夕食を取りましょう。真里亞は夕食はまだよね？　コンビニでお弁当を買ってきて食べてね。お菓子は駄目よ、ジュースも駄目よ。お釣りと一緒にレシートも入れておくのよ、わかった？」

units.text: "I'll make sure I come back this time tomorrow. Let's eat dinner together then. You haven't eaten dinner yet, have you Maria? Buy a bento at the convenience store and eat it. No sweets, and no soda. I'll check the receipt and the change, understand?"
units.note: UP restores instruction to child, but obtaining receipt omits keeping it with change.
units.japanese: 「明日のこの時間には帰れるようにするわ。明日は一緒に夕食を取りましょう。真里亞は夕食はまだよね？　コンビニでお弁当を買ってきて食べてね。お菓子は駄目よ、ジュースも駄目よ。お釣りと一緒にレシートも入れておくのよ、わかった？」

units.text: "I'll make sure I can come back by this time tomorrow. Let's eat dinner together tomorrow. You haven't eaten dinner yet, have you, Maria? Buy a bento at the convenience store and eat that. No sweets, and no soda. Make sure you get a receipt with your change, understand?"
units.note: UP restores instruction to child, but obtaining receipt omits keeping it with change.
units.japanese: 「明日のこの時間には帰れるようにするわ。明日は一緒に夕食を取りましょう。真里亞は夕食はまだよね？　コンビニでお弁当を買ってきて食べてね。お菓子は駄目よ、ジュースも駄目よ。お釣りと一緒にレシートも入れておくのよ、わかった？」

description: WH makes Rosa suspect that Maria would go shopping with the toy without her knowledge, rather than inferring that such an outing may already have occurred.
sourceReading: 買い物に出たことでもありそうな気配を察する is an inference of possible past experience from Maria’s manner of speaking.

units.text: From Maria's manner of speech, Rosa got the feeling that Maria would go shopping with that stuffed animal without her knowing about it. Rosa's forehead creased, and after sourly saying that Maria definitely must not do that, she hung up.
units.note: Both restore possible prior shopping.
units.japanese: 真里亞の口調から、自分の与り知れない内に、あのぬいぐるみと一緒に買い物に出たことでもありそうな気配を察する。

description: WH renders 口をすっぱくして as sourly saying, replacing insistent repetition with an irritable tone.
sourceReading: The idiom describes repeatedly or emphatically telling someone, here that taking Sakutaro out is absolutely forbidden.

units.text: From Maria's manner of speech, Rosa got the feeling that Maria would go shopping with that stuffed animal without her knowing about it. Rosa's forehead creased, and after sourly saying that Maria definitely must not do that, she hung up.
units.note: Both retain sourly rather than insistent repeated warning.
units.japanese: 楼座は眉間にしわをよせながら、それだけは絶対駄目だと口をすっぱくして伝え、電話を切るのだった。

units.text: From Maria's manner of speech, Rosa got the feeling that Maria might've gone shopping with that stuffed animal without her knowing about it. Rosa's forehead creased, and after sourly saying that Maria definitely mustn't do that, she hung up.
units.note: Both retain sourly rather than insistent repeated warning.
units.japanese: 真里亞の口調から、自分の与り知れない内に、あのぬいぐるみと一緒に買い物に出たことでもありそうな気配を察する。楼座は眉間にしわをよせながら、それだけは絶対駄目だと口をすっぱくして伝え、電話を切るのだった。

units.text: From Maria's manner of speech, Rosa got the feeling that Maria had been going shopping with that stuffed animal without her knowing about it. Rosa's forehead creased, and after sourly telling Maria that she was absolutely not to, she hung up.
units.note: Both retain sourly rather than insistent repeated warning.
units.japanese: 真里亞の口調から、自分の与り知れない内に、あのぬいぐるみと一緒に買い物に出たことでもありそうな気配を察する。楼座は眉間にしわをよせながら、それだけは絶対駄目だと口をすっぱくして伝え、電話を切るのだった。

description: WH says Mama says not to take me outside a lot, which attaches a lot to taking the toy outside instead of to how often Mama gives the prohibition.
sourceReading: ママはよく…いけないって言う means Mama often says not to take me outside; it is not permission for occasional outings.

units.text: 『Mama says not to take me outside a lot.  And she usually says Maria can't do it because she's too old...』 "Uu-?  But Maria isn't embarrassed at all to be with Sakutaro, right?"
units.note: UP restores frequency of prohibition rather than permitted outings.
units.japanese: 『ママはよく、ボクをお外に連れて行っちゃいけないって言うし。真里亞のことをよく、もう何歳になったんだから駄目とか、そういう言い方をするし…。』
candidates: Mama says not to take me outside a lot

units.text: "Mama says not to take me outside a lot. And she usually says Maria can't do it because she's too old..."
units.note: UP restores frequency of prohibition rather than permitted outings.
units.japanese: 『ママはよく、ボクをお外に連れて行っちゃいけないって言うし。真里亞のことをよく、もう何歳になったんだから駄目とか、そういう言い方をするし…』
candidates: Mama says not to take me outside a lot

description: WH says we will always be by your side instead of asserting that Maria and Sakutaro are always right beside Ange already.
sourceReading: いっつも…すぐ側にいる states their present enduring proximity, with weak magic explaining why Ange cannot perceive it.

units.text: "Maria and Sakutaro are close friends to Ange, right?  We'll a-lways be by your side, Ange.  It's just that your magic is weak, so you cannot perceive it unless you open Maria's diary like this."
units.note: Both assert current companionship rather than future promise.
units.japanese: 「真里亞もさくたろも、縁寿の身近なお友達だよ？　いっつも真里亞たちは縁寿のすぐ側にいる。

description: WH substitutes witches for magic in Ange’s summary of Maria’s account of what fills the world.
sourceReading: 魔法や霊 means magic and spirits; 魔法 is not 魔女. The breeze analogy concerns natural nearby unseen phenomena.

units.text: According to her, this world is full of witches and spirits. As if they were as natural and nearby as a light breeze.
units.note: Both restore magic and spirits.
units.japanese: 彼女に言わせれば、この世は魔法や霊でいっぱいらしい。

description: WH repeats Maria’s merry appearance rather than the narrator’s judgment that she would look conspicuously out of place.
sourceReading: 浮いて見えただろう describes standing out incongruously among closing shops and homebound workers; good spirits already appear in 上機嫌.

units.text: With her knapsack on her back, half of Sakutaro's face peeking out, she triumphantly walked through the late night shopping district. Anyways, it was this time of day.  Everyone in the shopping district was either a shop owner lowering the shutters on their shops, or employees rushing, or else staggering, on their way home. Amidst all that, Maria, who was in a good mood as though she was hiking, probably looked quite merry.
units.note: UP restores conspicuously standing out.
units.japanese: そんな中、まるでハイキングのように上機嫌な真里亞はとても浮いて見えただろう。

units.text: With her knapsack on her back and half of Sakutaro's face peeking out of it, she triumphantly walked through the shopping district late at night. Well, it was that time of day, after all. Everyone in the shopping district was either a shop owner lowering the shutters on their shops, or an employee rushing, or else staggering, on their way home. Amidst all that, Maria, who was in a good mood like someone on a hike, probably looked quite merry.
units.note: UP restores conspicuously standing out.
units.japanese: 真里亞は、さくたろが半分顔をのぞかせたナップザックを背負って、深夜の商店街を意気揚々と歩いている。何しろこの時間だ。商店街には、シャッターを下ろすお店の店主や、家路を急いだり、あるいは千鳥足だったりする会社員ばかりだ。そんな中、まるでハイキングのように上機嫌な真里亞はとても浮いて見えただろう。

description: WH gives convenience stores an opening limit of midnight instead of saying they operate into the late night.
sourceReading: 深夜まで営業している specifies late-night availability, not a precise twelve-o’clock closing time.

units.text: The supermarket had been closed for a while by this time. However, the recently popular convenience stores stayed open until midnight. It was very convenient for Maria, whose mother's return was often late.
units.note: UP restores late-night operation rather than midnight limit.
units.japanese: しかし、最近、流行のコンビニエンスストアは深夜まで営業している。

units.text: The supermarket had been closed for a while by this time. However, convenience stores, which had been growing in popularity lately, stayed open until midnight. It was very convenient for Maria, whose mother's return was often late.
units.note: UP restores late-night operation rather than midnight limit.
units.japanese: この時間にはスーパーはとっくに閉まっている。しかし、最近、流行のコンビニエンスストアは深夜まで営業している。母の帰宅が深夜を越えることも多い真里亞にとってはとても便利だった。

description: WH calls Sakutaro’s choice simply a small yogurt, dropping its explicit designation as a confectionery yogurt.
sourceReading: 小さいお菓子ヨーグルト identifies a small candy/confectionery-style yogurt, contrasting with Maria’s earlier reasoning that fruit yogurt is not お菓子.

units.text: "Uu-.  Then, how about a small yogurt?  It's 30 yen.  That's cheap."
units.note: Both omit snack/sweet qualification.
units.japanese: 「うー。じゃあ、この小さいお菓子ヨーグルトは？　３０円だね。安い。」

units.text: "Uu-. Then how about a small yogurt? It's 30 yen. That's cheap."
units.note: Both omit snack/sweet qualification.
units.japanese: 「うー。じゃあ、この小さいお菓子ヨーグルトは？　３０円だね。安い」

units.text: "Uu. Then what about this small yogurt? It's 30 yen. That's cheap."
units.note: Both omit snack/sweet qualification.
units.japanese: 「うー。じゃあ、この小さいお菓子ヨーグルトは？　３０円だね。安い」

description: WH says the soda sounds pretty weird although Maria is already drinking it and offers Sakutaro a taste.
sourceReading: 微妙 here evaluates the drink in the context of ongoing drinking; later narration explicitly describes sharing its dubious taste.

units.text: "......Uu-.  Yuzukoshou soda sounds pretty weird...  You want to try too, Sakutaro...?"
units.note: Both restore odd soda flavor.
units.japanese: 「……うー。柚子胡椒ソーダって微妙…。さくたろも飲んでみる…？」

description: WH describes summoning Maria in a world where she does not exist rather than summoning Maria, who is no longer in this world.
sourceReading: もうこの世にはいない私 is an attributive description of Maria with explicit no-longer temporal force; it is not an indefinite a-world location.

units.text: "Yeah.  Come on, look.  In a world where I don't exist, you have summoned me and are talking with me."
units.note: UP restores no longer in this world rather than a world without Maria.
units.japanese: 「うん。だってほら、もうこの世にはいない私をこうして呼び出して、語らっているよ。」

units.text: "Yeah. Come on, look. In a world where I don't exist, you summoned me, and you're talking with me."
units.note: UP restores no longer in this world rather than a world without Maria.
units.japanese: 「うん。だってほら、もうこの世にはいない私をこうして呼び出して、語らっているよ」

description: WH uses passive be shown a smile where Maria cites Ange’s ability to sometimes show a smile as evidence of magical talent.
sourceReading: 縁寿 is the person able to reunite, converse and 時に笑顔を見せられる; the potential construction says she can show a smile, fitting her question about learning to smile on gray nights.

units.text: "Yeah.  You have inflated the fragment of my soul that I left in the diary, and are reviving me.  I also said it a short while ago, right?  Since you are able to be reunited with me and have a conversation, and be shown a smile every once in a while, you must have some magical talent, Ange.  Maria onee-chan guarantees it.  Uu-!"
units.note: Both restore causal grounds for talent inference.
units.japanese: 「うん。私が日記に残した魂のカケラを、縁寿は魔法で膨らませて私を蘇らせてる。さっきも言ったよね？　こうして私と再会して会話が出来て、時に笑顔を見せられるんだから、縁寿は魔法の才能がきっとあるんだよ。真里亞お姉ちゃんが保証する。うー！」

description: WH instructs Ange to close her eyes after she can already visualize Maria with them closed, rather than keeping them gently closed.
sourceReading: 目を閉じていて asks her to maintain closed eyes and the image; next Maria explicitly asks her to open them once.

units.text: "Once you can visualize me even with your eyes closed, .........without changing anything, slowly and softly close your eyes.  .........How is it?  Can you still see me?"
units.note: Both instruct closing eyes rather than keeping them closed.
units.japanese: 「瞼を閉じても私をイメージできるようになったら、………そのまま、ゆっくり柔らかく目を閉じていて。………どう？　まだ私が視えている？」

units.text: "Once you can visualize me even when your eyes are closed, ......without changing anything, slowly and softly close your eyes again. ......How is it? Can you still "see" me?"
units.note: Both instruct closing eyes rather than keeping them closed.
units.japanese: 「瞼を閉じても私をイメージできるようになったら、………そのまま、ゆっくり柔らかく目を閉じていて。………どう？　まだ私が視えている？」

units.text: "Once you can visualize me even with your eyes closed, .........without changing anything, slowly and softly close your eyes. .........Well? Still ‘see’see me?"
units.note: Both instruct closing eyes rather than keeping them closed.
units.japanese: 「瞼を閉じても私をイメージできるようになったら、………そのまま、ゆっくり柔らかく目を閉じていて。………どう？　まだ私が視えている？」

description: WH renders Ange’s question about merely convincing herself of Maria’s encouragement as having the wrong idea.
sourceReading: 私がそう思い込んでるだけ questions whether the encouragement is only her own assumption; the following そう思い込んでしまう refers to adopting that skeptical assumption and thereby failing to see.

units.text: Cheering me?  Really? Do I just have the wrong idea...? No, that's not it. It's because I have the wrong idea that I cannot see her.
units.note: Both restore doubt about merely imagined encouragement.
units.japanese: 私がそう思い込んでるだけじゃないの…？

description: WH locates Maria’s vivid form in the empty space before Ange and asks it to rise, dropping the image clearly seen behind her eyelids.
sourceReading: 瞼の裏に鮮明に見えている姿 is the internally visualized form to be made to appear in 目の前の虚空; the source distinguishes origin and destination.

units.text: I steadied my breathing. I concentrated my mind. Make the vivid form of Maria onee-chan in the empty space before you...rise to the surface. .........Understand magic, ......and see...Maria onee-chan......
units.note: UP restores image behind eyelids projected into empty space.
units.japanese: 目の前の虚空に、瞼の裏に鮮明に見えている真里亞お姉ちゃんの姿を、浮かび上がらせろ。

units.text: I steadied my breathing. I concentrated my mind. Make the vivid form of Maria onee-chan in the empty space before you...rise to the surface. ......Understand magic, ...and "see" Maria onee-chan...
units.note: UP restores image behind eyelids projected into empty space.
units.japanese:
呼吸を整える。
精神を集中する。目の前の虚空に、瞼の裏に鮮明に見えている真里亞お姉ちゃんの姿を、浮かび上がらせろ。………魔法を理解し、……お姉ちゃんを、視るんだ……。

description: WH says the room makes its business-like theme clear, removing how it announces the owning company’s stature and intimidates.
sourceReading: この会議室の主である企業の格を知らしめ威圧している describes corporate rank communicated through lavish refined equipment and space, not a decorative business theme.

units.text: Ange and an old gentleman wearing an expensive suit were alone in a massive, modern conference room. All of the newest machines for presentations were installed there, but they didn't upset the refined and composed atmosphere in the conference room, and that alone was enough to make the business-like theme of the room abundantly clear.
units.note: UP restores corporate stature but omits intimidation.
units.japanese: プレゼンテーション用のあらゆる最新機材が準備され、それでいて上品で落ち着いた雰囲気を損なっていないその会議室は、ただそれだけで、この会議室の主である企業の格を知らしめ威圧している。

units.text: Ange and an old gentleman wearing an expensive suit were alone in a massive, modern conference room. All of the newest machines for presentations were installed there, but they didn't upset its refined and composed atmosphere, and that alone was enough to make the business-like theme of the room abundantly clear.
units.note: UP restores corporate stature but omits intimidation.
units.japanese: 広大で近代的な会議室に、縁寿と、上等なスーツを着た老紳士が二人きりでいた。プレゼンテーション用のあらゆる最新機材が準備され、それでいて上品で落ち着いた雰囲気を損なっていないその会議室は、ただそれだけで、この会議室の主である企業の格を知らしめ威圧している。

units.text: Ange and an old gentleman wearing an expensive suit were alone in a massive, modern conference room. The conference room was equipped with all the latest equipment for presentations, while keeping intact a refined and composed atmosphere; that alone was enough to make abundantly clear the worth of the corporation that was its owner.
units.note: UP restores corporate stature but omits intimidation.
units.japanese: 広大で近代的な会議室に、縁寿と、上等なスーツを着た老紳士が二人きりでいた。プレゼンテーション用のあらゆる最新機材が準備され、それでいて上品で落ち着いた雰囲気を損なっていないその会議室は、ただそれだけで、この会議室の主である企業の格を知らしめ威圧している。

description: WH literally says I won’t say anything bad instead of framing the ensuing return-home recommendation as advice worth taking.
sourceReading: 悪いことは言わない is an assurance that the advice is for the listener’s good, introducing the suggestion to end running away and go to the Sumadera family.

units.text: "So, you were testing your luck...!  My, my, you truly are Kinzo-san's grandchild.  The nerve to trust your life to chance.  ...The Chairman was also a person who could stake her life on a bet like it was nothing, so is this the Ushiromiya blood as well?  ......You really will be something big in the future.  I won't say anything bad.  Why not give up this running away from home act and return to the Sumadera family?"
units.note: MG blunt introduction and UP advice remove literal bad-speech promise.
units.japanese: いやはや、やっぱり金蔵さんのお孫さんだねぇ。運否天賦に命を預けてもけろりとしてる、その度胸。…会長も博打に平気で命を賭けられる人だったが、これも右代宮の血なのかねぇ。……やっぱりあんた、将来大物になるよ。悪いことは言わない。家出ごっこはこの辺で切り上げて、須磨寺の家に戻ったらどうだい。」

units.text: My, my, you truly are Kinzo-san's grandchild.  The nerve to trust your life to chance.  ...The Chairman was also a person who could stake her life on a bet like it was nothing, so is this the Ushiromiya blood as well?  ......You really will be something big in the future.  I won't say anything bad.  Why not give up this running away from home act and return to the Sumadera family?"
units.note: MG blunt introduction and UP advice remove literal bad-speech promise.
units.japanese: いやはや、やっぱり金蔵さんのお孫さんだねぇ。運否天賦に命を預けてもけろりとしてる、その度胸。…会長も博打に平気で命を賭けられる人だったが、これも右代宮の血なのかねぇ。……やっぱりあんた、将来大物になるよ。悪いことは言わない。家出ごっこはこの辺で切り上げて、須磨寺の家に戻ったらどうだい。」

description: WH says Ange would inherit the family wealth after Eva’s death rather than that she has inherited it.
sourceReading: 絵羽伯母さんが死んだ後…私が相続している states the current inherited ownership after Eva’s death; the following wealth she bears and guardian speculation use that existing position.

units.text: After Eva oba-san's death, I would inherit all of the wealth of the Ushiromiya family. If that hadn't been their goal, there's no way they would have been able to say such disgusting words.
units.note: UP restores completed inheritance.
units.japanese: 絵羽伯母さんが死んだ後、右代宮家の全ての財産は私が相続している。

units.text: When Aunt Eva died, I would inherit all the wealth of the Ushiromiya family. If that wasn't what they were after, there's no way they would've been able to say such disgusting words.
units.note: UP restores completed inheritance.
units.japanese: 絵羽伯母さんが死んだ後、右代宮家の全ての財産は私が相続している。それが目当てでなかったら、あんな虫唾が走るような言葉を口になんか出来るものか。

description: WH describes Eva letting her true intentions slip to him rather than his reputed role as the one person to whom she could reveal her real feelings.
sourceReading: 本音を漏らせる describes being able to let out honest feelings; ともされる marks this as a reported characterization of their relationship.

units.text: For that reason, after Eva lost Hideyoshi, he had become the only person to which Eva would have let her true intentions slip. When Eva's heart had been torn by the loss of her family, and she had taken it out on Ange, he had acted as a buffer between the two, so although Ange didn't trust him, she found him a very easy person to question...
units.note: UP restores confidant role but omits reported-status qualification.
units.japanese: その為、秀吉を失った後の絵羽が、唯一本音を漏らせる人物だったともされる。

units.text: For that reason, when Eva lost Hideyoshi, he became the only person to whom Eva might have let her true intentions slip. Whenever Eva's heart was torn by the loss of her family, whenever she took it out on Ange, he had acted as a buffer between the two, so although Ange didn't trust him, she found him a very easy person to question...
units.note: UP restores confidant role but omits reported-status qualification.
units.japanese: その為、秀吉を失った後の絵羽が、唯一本音を漏らせる人物だったともされる。家族を失った絵羽が心を病み、縁寿に辛く当たるようになると、彼はその間の緩衝材的な役割も担ってくれたため、心が許せるほどではないが、縁寿にとっても訪ねやすい人物だった…。

units.text: For that reason, after Eva lost Hideyoshi, he had become the only person to whom she could reveal her true thoughts. When Eva's heart had been torn by the loss of her family, and she had taken it out on Ange, he had also acted as a buffer between the two, so although Ange didn't trust him, she too found him an easy person to pay a visit...
units.note: UP restores confidant role but omits reported-status qualification.
units.japanese: その為、秀吉を失った後の絵羽が、唯一本音を漏らせる人物だったともされる。家族を失った絵羽が心を病み、縁寿に辛く当たるようになると、彼はその間の緩衝材的な役割も担ってくれたため、心が許せるほどではないが、縁寿にとっても訪ねやすい人物だった…。
candidates: person to whom she could reveal

description: WH calls Kinzo’s desired justification an official stance instead of a pretext for bypassing the eldest son.
sourceReading: 建前 is the publicly defensible rationale contrasted with his alleged underlying wish to select Eva; the epitaph is proposed as that pretext.

units.text: However, Kinzo, who was stubborn even to himself, was blocked by the title of next head that he had given to Krauss, and he had searched for an official stance by which he could skip over Krauss and select Eva as the next head. That official stance was the riddle of the epitaph.
units.note: Both retain official stance rather than pretext.
units.japanese: しかし自らにも頑固な金蔵は、自ら蔵臼に与えた次期当主という肩書きが邪魔で、蔵臼を飛び越えて絵羽を次期当主に選ぶことの出来る(建前/・・)を探していた。

units.text: However, Kinzo, who was stubborn even against himself, was stymied by the title of Successor that he'd already given to Krauss, and he'd searched for an official stance by which he could skip over Krauss and select Eva as his successor. That official stance was the riddle of the epitaph.
units.note: Both retain official stance rather than pretext.
units.japanese: しかし自らにも頑固な金蔵は、自ら蔵臼に与えた次期当主という肩書きが邪魔で、蔵臼を飛び越えて絵羽を次期当主に選ぶことの出来る建前を探していた。その建前が、碑文の謎。

units.text: However, Kinzo, stubborn even to himself and obstructed by the title of successor that he had given to Krauss, searched for an official stance by which he could skip over Krauss and select Eva as his successor. That official stance was the riddle of the epitaph.
units.note: Both retain official stance rather than pretext.
units.japanese: しかし自らにも頑固な金蔵は、自ら蔵臼に与えた次期当主という肩書きが邪魔で、蔵臼を飛び越えて絵羽を次期当主に選ぶことの出来る建前を探していた。その建前が、碑文の謎。

description: WH describes the ring as reminiscent of rich people’s dark hobbies rather than combining imposing weight with wealthy bad taste.
sourceReading: 金持ち的な悪趣味さ evaluates ostentatious or tasteless design, not sinister pastimes; the gold, crest and diamond are the objects of this judgment.

units.text: The Ushiromiya family...Head's Ring. That ring, with the heft of gold and the one-winged seal on it, had a diamond arranged on a pedestal, and felt both sturdy and reminiscent of the dark hobbies of the rich. Kinzo had worn that on his finger without removing it even for a moment.
units.note: UP restores gaudy taste rather than dark hobbies.
units.japanese: 黄金の重みがあり、片翼の紋章の入ったその指輪には、台座の部分にダイヤがあしらわれ、重厚感と金持ち的な悪趣味さを兼ね備えている。

units.text: The Ushiromiya Family...Head's Ring. That ring, with the heft of gold and the one-winged seal on it, had a diamond arranged on a pedestal, and felt both sturdy and reminiscent of the dark hobbies of the rich. Kinzo had worn that on his finger without removing it even for a moment.
units.note: UP restores gaudy taste rather than dark hobbies.
units.japanese: 右代宮家、当主の指輪。黄金の重みがあり、片翼の紋章の入ったその指輪には、台座の部分にダイヤがあしらわれ、重厚感と金持ち的な悪趣味さを兼ね備えている。それは、金蔵が一時も外すことなく指にはめていたものだ。

description: WH makes Eva the most drastic person here, replacing the general observation that she can take very bold action when the stakes are critical.
sourceReading: ここ一番では…思い切ったこともしちゃう describes a disposition at decisive moments; it does not compare her with other people present or rank her first.

units.text: Certainly, when it comes to this, Eva-san was the most drastic person here.  Possibly, ......she might have committed murder just once in her life to grab this chance to have the Ushiromiya family wealth all to herself.  ............But you know, I don't think that's true."
units.note: Both restore drastic action capability.
units.japanese: 確かに、絵羽さんはここ一番ではずいぶん思い切ったこともしちゃう人だよ。あるいは、……右代宮家の財産を独り占めできるチャンスに、生涯でただ一度の殺人を犯したかもしれない。…………だがね、俺はそうは思わない。」

description: WH frames the investigation as Eva’s person being clean and nothing unnatural found on her, rather than ordinary surrounding circumstances and absence of suspicious preparations.
sourceReading: 身辺…普通 and 不自然な準備が見つけられなかった concern her circumstances/activity before the conference and preparations for a staged massacre, not merely things physically on her person.

units.text: But as a matter of fact, Eva's person had been perfectly clean when she had gone to the family conference. Nothing unnatural was found on her that could have been used to brutally murder her family and make it look like an accident. The servants who escaped harm by being off-duty on that day also stated that they hadn't seen anything strange regarding anyone related to the event, Eva included.
units.note: MG broadens first sentence but retains physical-person reading of absent preparations.
units.japanese:
しかし、親族会議に向かう絵羽の身辺は、まったくにもって普通だった。
一族を事故に見せ掛けて虐殺するような、あらゆる不自然な準備が見つけられなかったのだ。

units.text: But as a matter of fact, there had been nothing at all that implicated Eva as she went to the family conference. Nothing unnatural was found on her that could've been used to brutally murder her family and make it look like an accident. The servants who escaped harm by being off-duty on that day also stated that they hadn't seen anything strange regarding anyone related to the event, Eva included.
units.note: MG broadens first sentence but retains physical-person reading of absent preparations.
units.japanese: しかし、親族会議に向かう絵羽の身辺は、まったくにもって普通だった。一族を事故に見せ掛けて虐殺するような、あらゆる不自然な準備が見つけられなかったのだ。当日は非番で難を逃れた使用人たちも、彼女を含め、全ての関係者について不自然な様子が見られなかったと証言した。

units.text: But as a matter of fact, en route to the family conference, Eva's person had been perfectly clean. Nothing unnatural was found on her that could have been used to brutally murder her family and make it look like an accident. The servants who escaped harm by being off‐duty on that day also stated that they hadn't seen anything strange regarding anyone related to the event, Eva included.
units.note: MG broadens first sentence but retains physical-person reading of absent preparations.
units.japanese: しかし、親族会議に向かう絵羽の身辺は、まったくにもって普通だった。一族を事故に見せ掛けて虐殺するような、あらゆる不自然な準備が見つけられなかったのだ。当日は非番で難を逃れた使用人たちも、彼女を含め、全ての関係者について不自然な様子が見られなかったと証言した。

description: WH has the executive concede there is nothing he can say to counter Ange, where he says that pursuing her objection has no end.
sourceReading: それを言い出したらキリがない points to unending argument and introduces the difficulty of proving a negative.

units.text: "There's nothing I can say to counter that.  It becomes a Devil's Proof.  To expose it as a crime, you just need to find evidence.  But what could you find to show that she was innocent?  It is impossible to prove a negative fact."
units.note: UP restores endlessly extensible objection.
units.japanese: 「それを言い出したらキリがないなぁ。悪魔の証明になっちまうよ。犯罪を暴くには証拠を見つければいい。でも、無実を示すには何を見つけりゃいいんだい？　消極的事実の証明は不可能だ。」

units.text: "There's nothing I can say to counter that. It becomes a Devil's Proof. To expose it as her crime, you would simply need to find evidence. But what could you possibly find to prove her innocence? It's impossible to prove a negative fact."
units.note: UP restores endlessly extensible objection.
units.japanese: 「それを言い出したらキリがないなぁ。悪魔の証明になっちまうよ。犯罪を暴くには証拠を見つければいい。でも、無実を示すには何を見つけりゃいいんだい？　消極的事実の証明は不可能だ」

description: WH says Ange hated Eva from the very beginning rather than identifying her basic current hatred as the reason she will not believe her.
sourceReading: そもそも…大嫌い supplies the fundamental reason or premise, not a claim about when the hatred began; 思わない states no inclination to believe.

units.text: ......Anyways, I hated Eva oba-san from the very beginning.  So I don't plan on believing her story."
units.note: UP restores current hatred.
units.japanese: ……というか、私はそもそも絵羽伯母さんなんて大嫌い。だから私は彼女の話を信じようなんて思わない。」

units.text: "...Anyway, I hated Aunt Eva from the very beginning. So I don't even want to believe her."
units.note: UP restores current hatred.
units.japanese: 「……というか、私はそもそも絵羽伯母さんなんて大嫌い。だから私は彼女の話を信じようなんて思わない」

description: WH replaces a hypothetical physical alibi with unspecified concrete proof.
sourceReading: 物理的なアリバイ is a specific exculpatory constraint, posed to test whether Ange would believe evidence even against her hatred.

units.text: No, even if truth does exist, whether you believe it or not is determined by whether you have love or not.  ......Can you really call truth without certainty truth?  Even if Eva-san had been able to show concrete proof, would you have been able to believe it?"
units.note: Both restore explicit physical alibi.
units.japanese: いや、仮にもし。真実が存在したとしても、それを信じるか信じないかは、愛があるか否かで決められちまう。……絶対性の宿らない真実なんて、真実と呼べるのかい？　絵羽さんが物理的なアリバイを示したとしても、君はそれを信じられたかい？」

description: WH says Ange would interpret neutral information as malicious instead of saying she would interpret it with malice.
sourceReading: 悪意を以って assigns ill will to Ange’s interpretive stance; it does not assert that the information itself is read as evidence of malicious intent.

units.text: It's hard to counter that. ...I hate Eva oba-san, so I'll probably deny all information beneficial to her, and interpret all neutral information as malicious. ......In other words, inside me, the truth is already decided. And despite that, just what in the world is this 'truth' that I'm still searching for, unsatisfied...?
units.note: Both restore adverse interpretation of neutral evidence.
units.japanese: …私は絵羽伯母さんが大嫌いだから、彼女に利するあらゆる情報は否定するし、中立的なあらゆる情報は悪意を以って解釈するだろう。

description: WH says you cannot see anything from a single journalist’s viewpoint rather than that a single newspaper limits you to that viewpoint.
sourceReading: 記者の目線ひとつでしかものが見られない expresses only-from-one-viewpoint restriction; it allows partial sight and motivates comparative reading.

units.text: It's the same with newspapers.  You can't see anything from the single viewpoint of a writer who made the article in a single newspaper.  Sometimes you can only process information composedly and in three dimensions when you read multiple newspapers.
units.note: UP restores access limited to one journalist viewpoint.
units.japanese: 新聞だってそうさ。ひとつの新聞だけじゃ、その記事を書いた記者の目線ひとつでしかものが見られない。複数の新聞を読むことで初めて、立体的かつ冷静に分析が出来ることもある。

units.text: "It's the same with newspapers. You can't see anything from the single viewpoint of a writer who wrote an article in a single newspaper. Sometimes you can only process information composedly and in three dimensions when you read multiple newspapers."
units.note: UP restores access limited to one journalist viewpoint.
units.japanese: 「新聞だってそうさ。ひとつの新聞だけじゃ、その記事を書いた記者の目線ひとつでしかものが見られない。複数の新聞を読むことで初めて、立体的かつ冷静に分析が出来ることもある」

description: WH has the Sumaderas act like guards instead of assuming the role of her guardians.
sourceReading: 保護者面 means putting on a parental/guardian face, recalling wealth-control through guardianship in the previous exchange.

units.text: "Oh, the Sumadera family?  Those guys act so proud, like they're my guards or something."
units.note: UP restores guardians rather than guards.
units.japanese: 「あぁ、須磨寺の家ですか。あいつら、何を偉そうに保護者面して。」

units.text: "Oh, the Sumadera family? Those guys act so proud, like they're my guards or something."
units.note: UP restores guardians rather than guards.
units.japanese: 「あぁ、須磨寺の家ですか。あいつら、何を偉そうに保護者面して」

description: WH makes Ange leave at a dash rather than walking quickly after her silent deep bow.
sourceReading: 早歩き specifies fast walking, maintaining composure while acting urgently.

units.text: After bowing silently and deeply, Ange left that place at a dash. After watching her leave, the female secretary straightened her glasses and whispered.
units.note: Both retain dash rather than quick walking.
units.japanese: 縁寿は無言で深く会釈をしてから、早歩きにその場を退出した。

units.text: After bowing silently and deeply, Ange left that place at a dash. After watching her leave, the female secretary straightened her glasses and whispered.
units.note: Both retain dash rather than quick walking.
units.japanese: 縁寿は無言で深く会釈をしてから、早歩きにその場を退出した。彼女が出て行ったのを見届けてから、秘書の女性が眼鏡を直しながら囁く。

units.text: After bowing silently and deeply, Ange left that place at a dash. After watching her leave, the secretary straightened her glasses and whispered.
units.note: Both retain dash rather than quick walking.
units.japanese: 縁寿は無言で深く会釈をしてから、早歩きにその場を退出した。彼女が出て行ったのを見届けてから、秘書の女性が眼鏡を直しながら囁く。

description: WH says Okonogi told the Sumaderas Ange would be coming, rather than notifying them she was there.
sourceReading: 縁寿ちゃんが来てるよと通報した reports present arrival/presence, paired with his claim he stalled her enough and warned her to flee.

units.text: "We did stall her, more than enough.  If they still don't make it in time, that's the Sumadera family's error.  ......I told Ange-chan to run for it.  I informed the Sumaderas that Ange-chan would be coming.  Whether she is caught or not, I will not be blamed.
units.note: UP restores notification that Ange is already here.
units.japanese: 「足止めならしたよ、充分に。それに間に合わないのは須磨寺の過失だね。……縁寿ちゃんには逃げろと言ったし。須磨寺には縁寿ちゃんが来てるよと通報したし。捕まっても捕まらなくても双方に恨まれない。

units.text: "We did stall her, more than enough. If they still don't make it in time, that's their own fault. ...I told Ange-chan to run for it. I informed the Sumaderas that Ange-chan would be coming. Whether she's caught or not, I will not be blamed."
units.note: UP restores notification that Ange is already here.
units.japanese: 「足止めならしたよ、充分に。それに間に合わないのは須磨寺の過失だね。……縁寿ちゃんには逃げろと言ったし。須磨寺には縁寿ちゃんが来てるよと通報したし。捕まっても捕まらなくても双方に恨まれない」

description: WH has the smoking employee glare at Ange before leaving, rather than leaving after Ange glares at him.
sourceReading: First-person encounter followed by ぎろりと睨みつけると makes Ange’s glare the trigger for his hurried cigarette extinguishing and disappearance.

units.text: I found the door to the emergency exit. After opening that heavy door, I found the outside staircase I had expected. I bumped into a man who looked like an employee skipping work and smoking a cigarette. After glaring at me, he quickly crushed up his cigarette and went away.
units.note: Both make the man glare rather than Ange glaring at him.
units.japanese: ぎろりと睨みつけると、そそくさと煙草を揉み消して姿を消す。

units.text: I found the door to the emergency exit. After opening that heavy door, I found the outside staircase I'd hoped for. I bumped into a man who looked like an employee skipping work and smoking a cigarette. After glaring at me, he quickly crushed out his cigarette and went away.
units.note: Both make the man glare rather than Ange glaring at him.
units.japanese:
非常階段の扉を見つける。その重い扉を開けると、期待通りの外階段だった。サボリで煙草を吸ってた社員風の男とばったり出くわす。
ぎろりと睨みつけると、そそくさと煙草を揉み消して姿を消す。

units.text:
I found the door to the emergency staircase. After opening that heavy door, I found the outside stairs I was hoping to see. Once outside, I immediately encountered a man smoking a cigarette, who looked like an employee skipping work.
After glaring at me, he quickly crushed up his cigarette and went away.
units.note: Both make the man glare rather than Ange glaring at him.
units.japanese:
非常階段の扉を見つける。その重い扉を開けると、期待通りの外階段だった。サボリで煙草を吸ってた社員風の男とばったり出くわす。
ぎろりと睨みつけると、そそくさと煙草を揉み消して姿を消す。

description: WH turns the inference of several other cars from tire sounds into an inference of several other allies.
sourceReading: 数台 specifies a count of vehicles; one of those vehicles has come to block this escape route.

units.text: Just when I thought that, with an incredible squealing of the tires, a black car slid right under me and came to a sudden stop. ......Judging from the sound of the tires, it felt like they had several other allies, and that one of them had come here to block this path.
units.note: UP them refers to preceding cars; MG generalizes vehicles to allies.
units.japanese: ……タイヤの音から、他にも数台お仲間がいて、ここを塞ぎに１台来た、という感じだった。

units.text: Just when I thought that, a black car slid right under me and came to a sudden stop with an incredible squealing of the tires. ...Judging by the sound of tires, it seemed they had several other allies, and that one of them had come here to block this path.
units.note: UP them refers to preceding cars; MG generalizes vehicles to allies.
units.japanese: そう思った時、タイヤをすごい音で鳴かせながら、黒い乗用車が真下に滑り込んで急停車する。……タイヤの音から、他にも数台お仲間がいて、ここを塞ぎに１台来た、という感じだった。

description: WH reduces Ange’s imagined authorization to tear off an arm while keeping her alive to permission to drag her by the arm.
sourceReading: 腕の一本くらい引っこ抜けても構わない conveys severe dismemberment or wrenching an arm off as acceptable; 息さえしてれば supplies the minimal alive condition.

units.text: The three of them began to clamor up the emergency exit. ......They had already announced that they planned to be rough.  This is pretty bad. They had probably been ordered to drag me by the arm if they had to, as long as I was breathing.
units.note: Both restore tolerance of arm injury rather than active order to tear it off.
units.japanese: 息さえしてれば、腕の一本くらい引っこ抜けても構わないくらいに命じられてるのだろう。

description: WH says Kasumi has waited so long to talk, shifting the duration or leisurely manner of the desired tea-room conversation onto her prior waiting.
sourceReading: ゆっくりとお茶室で語らいたくて modifies the desired unhurried conversation; she had prepared even the implements and waited, without a stated long waiting period.

units.text: "......Oh, I'm glad we made it in time.  ......Thank you, Okonogi.  It seems I can finally take my mischievous niece home.  ......I've waited so long to talk with that girl in my tea room, with all of the tools prepared.  Ehheheheheheheh...!"
units.note: UP restores desire for leisurely talk rather than lengthy waiting.
units.japanese: 「……あら、間に合って良かった。……ありがとうね、小此木。ようやくやんちゃな姪を連れて帰れそうだわ。……私、あの子と一緒に、ゆっくりとお茶室で語らいたくてお道具まで準備して待ってたんだから。うっふふふふふふふ…！」

units.text: "...Oh, I'm glad we made it in time. ...Thank you, Okonogi. It seems I can finally take my mischievous niece home. ...I've waited so long to talk with that girl in my tea room, with all of the tools prepared. Heheheheheheh...!"
units.note: UP restores desire for leisurely talk rather than lengthy waiting.
units.japanese: 「……あら、間に合って良かった。……ありがとうね、小此木。ようやくやんちゃな姪を連れて帰れそうだわ。……私、あの子と一緒に、ゆっくりとお茶室で語らいたくてお道具まで準備して待ってたんだから。うっふふふふふふふ…！」

description: WH says we received a response where control requests a response about whether the target has been secured.
sourceReading: 応答されたし is a request to reply, followed by impatience when no reply arrives: what happened, respond.

units.text: "01 calling 12, is it secure, we received a response.  ......What happened?!  Respond!"
units.note: UP restores request for response.
units.japanese: 「０１より１２、確保したか、応答されたし。……どうした？！　応答しろ！」

units.text: "01 calling 12, is the package secure, we received a response. ...What happened?! Respond!"
units.note: UP restores request for response.
units.japanese: 「０１より１２、確保したか、応答されたし。……どうした？！　応答しろ！」

description: WH specifies just three of them at the point where the repeated bare three is about to be reinterpreted through the third-floor jump.
sourceReading: たった３だもんね repeats the number without a unit; the next sentence reveals she thought she could jump from the third floor after surviving a higher fall.

units.text: .........Ohohoh.........Owow... Look, see...that worked out, didn't it?  It's just three of them. I've already tried that once from a higher place.  I knew I could do it from just the third floor...!
units.note: UP keeps ambiguous three until floors rather than prematurely specifying people.
units.japanese: ほらね、…何とかなったでしょ。たった３だもんね。

units.text: ......Nnnggg... ...Owow... See, ...that worked out perfectly, didn't it? There was just the three of them, after all. I've already tried that once from a higher place. I knew I'd be able to jump down just three floors...!
units.note: UP keeps ambiguous three until floors rather than prematurely specifying people.
units.japanese:
………つつつ…。……痛たた…。
ほらね、…何とかなったでしょ。たった３だもんね。もっと高いところを経験してるもの。
３階くらいなら飛び降りられると思った…！
