description: WH makes Ange apologize and guess the roof has never been dented this badly instead of indignantly saying it need not dent so much.
sourceReading: 失礼しちゃうわ expresses taking offense, followed by a complaint about excessive denting; she immediately insists it is not her weight.

units.text: "......Sorry about that.  I'll bet it's never been dented this badly."
units.note: Both preserve roof dent and weight joke.
units.japanese: 「……失礼しちゃうわ。ここまでへこむこともないだろうに。」

description: WH says Ange fell with the black-suited man rather than that both were rolled over together.
sourceReading: 転がされる is an externally caused rolling movement, followed by 仰向けにされて describing her being turned face up, still on the ground after face-down restraint.

units.text: Along with the black-suit guy, I fell with a *thunk*. After landing face up, the first thing I saw was...an arm stuck out right in front of my eyes.
units.note: UP restores being rolled over rather than falling.
units.japanese: その黒服ごと、私たちはごろんと転がされる。

units.text: Along with the black-suit guy, I fell with a *thunk*. After landing face up, the first thing I saw...was an arm stuck out right in front of my eyes.
units.note: UP restores being rolled over rather than falling.
units.japanese: その黒服ごと、私たちはごろんと転がされる。仰向けにされて最初に目に入ったのは、私の目の前にずいっと突き出された腕だった。

description: WH makes Ange the subject of suddenly taking off while on all fours, rather than the passenger affected by Amakusa’s abrupt acceleration.
sourceReading: 急発進された is passive from Ange’s perspective after Amakusa gets into the driver’s seat; the resulting motion makes her flail like an overturned turtle.

units.text: I climbed over the hand brake and slid into the passenger's seat. Pushing me in, Amakusa also got into the driver's seat. Since I had suddenly taken off while still on all fours, I had to kick and struggle around on the chair for a while, like a turtle that's been flipped over...
units.note: Both restore on-all-fours state.
units.japanese: 四つん這い状態のままで急発進されたので、私は椅子の上でしばらくの間、引っ繰り返された亀のようにジタバタしなくてはならなかった…。

description: WH changes Ange’s joke about jumping out a window next time she misses a down elevator into trying to escape a downward-moving elevator.
sourceReading: 降りのエレベーターを逃したら means if she misses the elevator going down, treating a jump as a flippant substitute for ordinary transport.

units.text: "There's nothing wrong.  Humans are surprisingly durable.  Next time I try to a escape a downward moving elevator, I'll jump out a window instead."
units.note: MG retains escape reading and try to a escape typo; UP restores missing a down elevator.
units.japanese: 私、次からは降りのエレベーターを逃したら、窓から飛び降りることにするわ。」

units.text: "I'm fine. Humans are surprisingly durable. Next time I try to a escape a downward moving elevator, I'll jump out a window instead."
units.note: MG retains escape reading and try to a escape typo; UP restores missing a down elevator.
units.japanese: 「問題ないわ。人間って案外頑丈よ。私、次からは降りのエレベーターを逃したら、窓から飛び降りることにするわ」

description: WH says Amakusa took a pass at Ange, specifying romantic or sexual intent where the Japanese describes bothering or teasing her despite the no-chat instruction.
sourceReading: ちょっかいを出す covers meddling, teasing or pestering and can in some contexts include flirting; this passage explains excessive chat and disregard for isolation rules without expressly specifying flirtation.

units.text: The guards were sternly told not to chat with me unnecessarily, but he came and took a pass at me, didn't he? Eva oba-san had particularly disliked that, and had supposedly dismissed him right before she died.
units.note: Both retain taking a pass for teasing/interference.
units.japanese: 護衛たちは私に対し、余計なお喋りをしないように強く言われていたらしいが、彼はそんなのお構いなしに私にちょっかいを出してきたっけ。

units.text: The guards were sternly told not to chat with me unnecessarily, but he came and took a pass at me, didn't he? Aunt Eva was apparently particularly put off by that...and had supposedly dismissed him shortly before she died.
units.note: Both retain taking a pass for teasing/interference.
units.japanese: 護衛たちは私に対し、余計なお喋りをしないように強く言われていたらしいが、彼はそんなのお構いなしに私にちょっかいを出してきたっけ。その辺を特に嫌われて、絵羽伯母さんが死ぬ直前頃に解雇されたはずだ。

units.text: Apparently, the guards had been sternly told not to chat with me unnecessarily, but I recall that didn't stop him coming to take a pass at me. Aunt Eva had particularly disliked that, and I believe she dismissed him right before she died.
units.note: Both retain taking a pass for teasing/interference.
units.japanese: 護衛たちは私に対し、余計なお喋りをしないように強く言われていたらしいが、彼はそんなのお構いなしに私にちょっかいを出してきたっけ。その辺を特に嫌われて、絵羽伯母さんが死ぬ直前頃に解雇されたはずだ。

description: WH says Okonogi took advantage of Amakusa here and there instead of holding various weaknesses over him.
sourceReading: 弱みを握られてンで、逆らえん describes present leverage arising from vulnerabilities or compromising matters known to Okonogi, explaining inability to oppose him.

units.text: "He probably wanted to buy some gratitude from you, lady.  ......After I was fired, I got indebted to President Okonogi in various ways.  He took advantage of me here and there, and now I can't say no to him.  Hyahha!"
units.note: MG restores compromising knowledge; UP restores current leverage but leaves its basis unspecified.
units.japanese: 「お嬢に恩を売りたいんでしょうぜ。……クビの後、小此木の社長には色々と世話になってましてね。色々と弱みを握られてンで、逆らえんのですわ。ヒャッハ！」

units.text: "He probably wants you to owe him one, missy. ......After I got the axe, President Okonogi helped me out a bunch, you see. He's got me right where he wants me, can't say no to him. Hyahha!"
units.note: MG restores compromising knowledge; UP restores current leverage but leaves its basis unspecified.
units.japanese: 「お嬢に恩を売りたいんでしょうぜ。……クビの後、小此木の社長には色々と世話になってましてね。色々と弱みを握られてンで、逆らえんのですわ。ヒャッハ！」

description: WH reports a fake license plate rather than a fake driving license presented to rent the car.
sourceReading: 提示した免許証 refers to the presented driving-license credential; the preceding rental-car identification supplies the context of presentation.

units.text: "......Kasumi-sama.  The escaping car was a rental.  The license plate they displayed was a fake.  This is clearly a pro.  They will probably abandon the car.  Pursuit will be difficult.  ......Should we have the police chase them?"
units.note: Both retain license plate rather than presented driving license.
units.japanese: 「……霞さま。逃走車両はレンタル。提示した免許証は偽装とのこと。明らかにプロです。恐らく車両は放棄するでしょう。追跡は困難です。……警察に追わせますか。」

units.text: "...Kasumi-sama, the escaping car was a rental. The license plate they displayed was a fake. We're clearly dealing with a pro. They'll probably abandon the car. Pursuit will be difficult. ...Should we have the police chase them?"
units.note: Both retain license plate rather than presented driving license.
units.japanese: 「……霞さま。逃走車両はレンタル。提示した免許証は偽装とのこと。明らかにプロです。恐らく車両は放棄するでしょう。追跡は困難です。……警察に追わせますか」

units.text: "......Kasumi‐sama. The getaway vehicle was a rental. The license plate on display was a fake. He's clearly a pro. They will probably abandon the car. Pursuit will be difficult. ......Should we have the police chase them?"
units.note: Both retain license plate rather than presented driving license.
units.japanese: 「……霞さま。逃走車両はレンタル。提示した免許証は偽装とのこと。明らかにプロです。恐らく車両は放棄するでしょう。追跡は困難です。……警察に追わせますか」

description: WH has Mother sternly say she would leave it to Kasumi; the Japanese has Kasumi leave after boldly telling her mother to entrust it to her.
sourceReading: 母上に、私にお任せをと啖呵を切って…出て来た makes Kasumi the speaker and actor, boasting to her mother before coming out.

units.text: Mother sternly said that she would leave it to me when I left the mansion, you see?  Do you intend to embarrass me further......?  It looks like it might be better for me to serve some matcha for everyone at once, doesn't it?  ......Our underground tea room is cramped, so you'll have to wait in line, won't you......?"
units.note: Both restore bold declaration to mother.
units.japanese: 母上に、私にお任せをと啖呵を切ってお屋敷を出て来たんですよ？　あなた、私にさらに恥をかかせるおつもり……？　あんたらまとめて、お抹茶を振舞った方が良さそうねぇ？　……地下のお茶室は狭いから、順番待ちの行列になっちゃうかしら……？」

description: WH changes Ange’s qualification that the foregoing applies if the box stays closed into an assertion that it cannot stay closed.
sourceReading: 閉まったままならね means if it remains closed, agreeing only conditionally with the preserved endless possibilities before proposing to wrench it open.

units.text: "......It can't remain closed.  I just have to wrench it open.
units.note: Both restore remaining-closed condition.
units.japanese: 「……閉まったままならね。私が抉じ開ければいいだけの話。

description: WH drops the family wealth from the description of the original conspiracy suspicions.
sourceReading: 絵羽伯母さんと右代宮家の財産を巡る identifies the suspicions as involving Eva and the Ushiromiya assets.

units.text: ".........That's right.  By itself, the Rokkenjima accident gave rise to nothing but suspicion of a conspiracy regarding Eva oba-san and the Ushiromiya family.
units.note: Both restore family wealth/assets.
units.japanese: 「………そうよ。元々、六軒島の事故は、ただそれだけならば、絵羽伯母さんと右代宮家の財産を巡る陰謀疑惑でしかなかった。

description: WH says the bottle made things return to the occult theory rather than beginning to rewrite the earlier account retroactively as an occult/witch theory.
sourceReading: 遡って塗り替え始めた describes retrospectively replacing the account of past events after a later discovery, directly paralleling delayed starlight revising earlier history.

units.text: "That's right.  The false truth that exists before the light from an exploding star reaches Earth is almost like the conspiracy theory, which is the human theory.  .........The wine bottle with a letter in it that drifted ashore several years later, the 'message bottle', painted over that theory and made things return to the occult theory, which is the witch's theory.
units.note: UP restores retroactive rewriting rather than returning to occult theory.
units.japanese: 「そう。恒星爆発の光が地球に届くまでの間の虚偽の真実が、陰謀説という人間説だったかのよう。………数年後に漂着した手紙入りのワインボトル、『メッセージボトル』が、それをオカルト説という魔女説に遡って塗り替え始めた。
candidates: made things return to the occult theory

units.text: ......The wine bottle with a letter in it that drifted ashore several years later, the "message bottle", painted over that theory and made things return to the occult theory, which is a witch's theory."
units.note: UP restores retroactive rewriting rather than returning to occult theory.
units.japanese: 「………数年後に漂着した手紙入りのワインボトル、『メッセージボトル』が、それをオカルト説という魔女説に遡って塗り替え始めた」
candidates: made things return to the occult theory

description: WH makes Natsuhi say the siblings do not truly wish to meet Father rather than that their premature inheritance calculations make his unwillingness to meet understandable.
sourceReading: お父様の会いたくないという気持ちもわかろう describes understanding Father’s reluctance as a consequence of their inheritance talk.

units.text: "...Considering that everyone has started aiming for the inheritance while the sun is still in the sky, it seems that you do not truly wish to meet with Father."
units.note: Both restore premature inheritance expectations.
units.japanese: 「…日も沈まぬ内から、遺産分配の皮算用を始める皆さんのことを思えば、お父様の会いたくないという気持ちもわかろうというものです。」

description: WH says the siblings alternate between bluffing and returning to their original demand instead of first bluffing and finally retreating to that point.
sourceReading: 最初は…最後には orders the response: initial bravado, then eventual change of argumentative ground and repeated demand to see Kinzo.

units.text: Eva and the rest realized that he had seen through to their current lack of funds, and alternating between bluffing and returning to the point at hand and arguing back, they repeatedly pressed Krauss to let them meet with Kinzo.
units.note: UP restores progression from initial front to final demands.
units.japanese: 絵羽たちは、自分たちが火の車であることを見抜かれていると気付き、最初は虚勢を張り、最後には論点を戻して反論し、金蔵に会わせろ会わせろと押し問答になった。

units.text: Eva and the rest realized that he had seen through to their current lack of funds, and alternating between bluffing and returning to the point at hand and arguing back, they repeatedly pressed Krauss to let them meet with Kinzo.
units.note: UP restores progression from initial front to final demands.
units.japanese: 絵羽たちは、自分たちが火の車であることを見抜かれていると気付き、最初は虚勢を張り、最後には論点を戻して反論し、金蔵に会わせろ会わせろと押し問答になった。

description: WH replaces Kyrie’s large sigh with a deep breath before she intervenes.
sourceReading: 大きくため息をつきながら conveys sighing in response to the escalating quarrel.

units.text: Eva made as though to tackle Krauss, and Hideyoshi and Kyrie cut in between them, trying to calm both sides. ......Then, Kyrie took a deep breath and spoke.
units.note: UP restores deep sigh rather than inhalation.
units.japanese: ……すると霧江が大きくため息をつきながら言った。

units.text: Eva made as though to tackle Krauss, and Hideyoshi and Kyrie cut in between them, trying to calm both sides. ...Then, Kyrie took a deep breath and spoke.
units.note: UP restores deep sigh rather than inhalation.
units.japanese: 絵羽は蔵臼に取っ組みかかろうとしていて、その間に秀吉と霧江が入り、双方をなだめている。……すると霧江が大きくため息をつきながら言った。

description: WH describes disagreeing sourly instead of a fruitless failure to connect or understand one another.
sourceReading: 不毛なすれ違い identifies unproductive cross-purposes, which Kyrie attributes to the lack of gratitude and tries to repair through acknowledgment.

units.text: It's because we have no feelings of gratitude that we disagree so sourly.  ......Isn't that right, Krauss nii-san?"
units.note: Both restore fruitlessness but retain conflict rather than talking past one another.

description: WH describes the hypothetical choking victim as senile rather than physically weakened by old age.
sourceReading: 老衰した老人 describes age-related decline; it does not specifically establish cognitive impairment. The later proposed dementia/wandering scenario uses the distinct 痴呆.

units.text: However, people can die in many ways.  For example, senile old people sometimes die when food gets caught in their throats.  Normally, this is called death by old age in its broadest sense. But with your argument, that becomes a death by accident, and I bear the responsibility of supervision.  ......This is unjustly disadvantageous to me."
units.note: UP restores old and infirm rather than senile.
units.japanese: しかし、人の死因は数多ある。例えば、老衰した老人が食事を喉に詰まらせて亡くなることもあるだろう。本来ならそれもまた広義の意味での老死となるに違いない。

description: WH specifies that an autopsy must be carried out rather than retaining the broader requirement for examination of the death/body.
sourceReading: 検死 requires postmortem examination to establish cause of death; it does not itself specify invasive dissection, unlike 解剖.

units.text: "When Father passes away, an autopsy will certainly be carried out, and we will check that he died of old age in the most general meaning, within the bounds of common sense.  ......A death of any other cause will be held as the caretaker's responsibility.

description: WH renders no more than eighteen humans on the island as no humans other than the eighteen.
sourceReading: １８人を超える人間はいない places a numerical upper bound on island occupants without identifying them with the eighteen named people.

units.text: "That's it...!  The witch mentioned the names of 18 people one after another, and announced whether they were alive or dead.  And on top of that, she announced that there were no humans other than the 18.  ......There was a single illusion in there."
units.note: UP restores numerical upper bound rather than named-set exclusivity.
units.japanese: 「そういうことさ…！　魔女は赤で１８人の名前を次々に挙げ、生死を宣言した。さらにその上、島には１８人を超える人間はいないとも宣言したわけだ。……ここにはひとつの錯覚があった。」

description: WH turns Beatrice’s criticism of how long Battler took into a claim that he has finally gotten a feel for it.
sourceReading: ようやくの感は否めぬ says it undeniably feels like finally/at long last: the answer has been a long time coming. 感 does not mean Battler has acquired a feel for solving it.

units.text: "*cackle*, hahahahahahaha...!  Bravo, bravo.  I cannot deny that someone as incompetent as you has finally gotten a feel for it, but somehow or another, you have managed to come up with a single answer.
units.note: UP restores the counterargument wording.
units.japanese: 「くっくっく、くっはははははは…！　ブラヴォー、ブラヴォー。そなた如き無能にしては、ようやくの感は否めぬが、兎にも角にも、ひとつの解答を出してみせた。

units.text: "*cackle* Hahahahahahaha...! <Bravo, bravo>. I wish I could deny that someone as incompetent as you has finally gotten a feel for it, but somehow or another, you've managed to come up with a single answer.

description: Battler tells Beatrice not to act tough rather than not to make a production of withholding her answer.
sourceReading: もったいぶるんじゃねぇ targets her affected withholding/keeping him in suspense, immediately followed by the demand to say whether she can repeat it.

units.text: "What's wrong, Beato!  Don't act so tough!!  I asked if you can repeat it!  Answer!!"
units.note: UP restores acting tough rather than stalling.
units.japanese: 「どうしたよベアト！　もったいぶるんじゃねぇ！！　復唱できるってのかよ！　答えろ！！」

description: WH says Battler cannot demand repetition to check reasoning premises, instead of saying blue cannot be used for that kind of demand.
sourceReading: 使えない has blue as its contextual object: blue cannot be used for a premise-checking repetition request that does not itself deny the witch. This distinguishes blue assertions from the less restricted ordinary requests.

units.text: ......And only then would the witch, who claimed that it was a closed room murder with magic, be responsible for making a counterargument. In other words, I can't demand that she repeats something that checks the premises of my reasoning. .........That will probably be significantly disadvantageous for me.
units.note: UP restores the restriction on blue rather than prohibiting repetition requests.
units.japanese: つまり、推理の前提を確認するような復唱の要求には使えない。

units.text: ...Only then would the witch, who claimed that this was a closed room murder made with magic, be responsible for making a counterargument. In other words, I can't demand that she repeat something that merely confirms the premises of my reasoning. ......That'll probably be a significant disadvantage for me.
units.note: UP restores the restriction on blue rather than prohibiting repetition requests.
units.japanese: ……と、こうなって初めて、魔法で密室殺人を行なったと主張する魔女に、反論する義務が生まれるわけだ。つまり、推理の前提を確認するような復唱の要求には使えない。………それは、俺に相当の不利を強いることになるだろう。

description: WH gives a literal glance at the witch’s complexion for Battler’s dependence on her reaction.
sourceReading: 顔色をうかがう means watching or gauging the other person’s mood/reaction, here to learn whether the proposed theory works.

units.text: "In the pitiful way you've been fighting up until now, you've made a single theory, glanced at the witch's complexion, and if that one didn't work, you'd then start making another theory.  You won't corner a witch like that."
units.note: UP restores gauging the witch reaction rather than literal complexion.
units.japanese: 「これまでのあなたは、仮説をひとつ立てては魔女の顔色をうかがい、それが駄目だったらその時、改めて別の仮説を立てるという情けない戦い方だった。それじゃ魔女は追い詰められない。」

description: WH renders the shortened proverb as an awkward gun firing many shots, losing the eventual lucky-hit implication.
sourceReading: 下手な鉄砲、数撃ちゃ何とやら invokes 下手な鉄砲も数撃てば当たる: even poor shooting may succeed by luck if attempted often. Beatrice teasingly applies that proverb to Battler’s barrage strategy. Lexical verification: Shogakukan Digital Daijisen on Kotobank, https://kotobank.jp/word/下手な鉄砲も数撃てば当たる-624879 .

units.text: "So it's an awkward gun, that fires many shots.  *cackle*cackle*!  That sort of crude analogy is just like you."
units.note: UP restores an interrupted proverb rather than an awkward gun.
units.japanese: 「下手な鉄砲、数撃ちゃ何とやらか。くっくっくっく！　そなたらしい、粗野な例えよ。」

units.note: Both restore the police witnessing condition.

description: WH tells Krauss he could fabricate any story instead of explaining how the siblings could fabricate grounds for a compelled meeting.
sourceReading: 話は何とでもでっち上げられるわ leads directly into easily arranging a situation requiring Krauss to permit a meeting before a third party: Eva’s side can devise whatever pretext is necessary.

units.text: "......Y, ......yes...  That's right, Nii-san.  You could fabricate any story.  We could easily set it up so that you have to hold a meeting with Father under the supervision of a third party...!"

description: WH states that nothing received from the witch would remain instead of retaining Kinzo’s inability to leave those things behind under the original agreement.
sourceReading: 魔女より得たものは何も残せぬのが初めからの約束 uses transitive 残せぬ: he cannot leave anything obtained from the witch. The contrast with passing on the Ushiromiya name is about what he can leave to successors.

units.text: ".........I thought that I would have no regrets in my life if only I could meet Beatrice, but it seems that things won't go so smoothly.  ......It was promised from the beginning that nothing received from the witch would remain.  However, the Ushiromiya name is not the property of the witch.  ......Who is fit to succeed that name?  It seems that this alone must be resolved by my own hand.  ......Rejoice, Krauss!!  I have changed my mind."
units.note: Both retain nothing remaining rather than inability to leave the witch-derived possessions.
units.japanese: 「…………ベアトリーチェにさえ会えれば、我が人生には何の悔いもないと思っていたが、どうやらそういうわけにも行かぬらしい。……魔女より得たものは何も残せぬのが初めからの約束。しかし、右代宮の名は魔女のものではない。……その名を継ぐのが誰に相応しいか。どうやらそれだけは、わしが自らの手で解決せねばならぬようだ。……喜べ蔵臼！！　気が変わったぞ。」

description: Sakutaro’s explanation says Rosa would feel bad if she made Maria lonely rather than feels sorry for making her lonely.
sourceReading: 寂しくさせてることを申し訳ないと思ってる presents the current loneliness and Rosa’s supposed regret as the reasons Sakutaro thinks she promised a gift.

units.note: UP restores actual remorse rather than hypothetical remorse.

大丈夫、思い出せるよ。……今から私が、
……ううん、彼女が。教えてあげる。」

units.text: "It's okay, I remember. ...Now I... ...no, she. She will teach you."
units.note: UP restores reassurance that Ange can remember.
units.japanese: 「大丈夫、思い出せるよ。……今から私が、……ううん、彼女が。教えてあげる」

description: WH inserts every time a child plays with dolls into Beatrice’s explanation.
sourceReading: いわゆる子どもの頃のお人形遊びなど introduces familiar childhood doll play as an example. It does not state that animation occurs on every occasion; preceding explanation says spirits not uncommonly inhabit responding to innocent children.

units.text: According to Beatrice, every time a child plays with dolls, the dolls actually gain a will and converse with them, sometimes even moving by their own will. However, the power imbued into such a vessel is very weak because of this innocence. If even a tiny bit of the toxin from a human's common sense, which says that there's no way a doll can talk or move, gets involved, it instantly reverts to being a non-speaking doll......
units.note: UP removes the universal every-time doll-play reading.
units.japanese: ベアトリーチェが言うには、いわゆる子どもの頃のお人形遊びなどは、本当に人形が意思を持って対話をし、自らの意思で動くことさえあるという。
candidates: every time a child plays with dolls

units.text: According to Beatrice, every time a child plays with dolls, the dolls actually gain a will and converse with them, sometimes even moving by their own will. However, because of their innocence, the power imbued into such a vessel is very weak. If they get struck with even a tiny bit of the toxin from a Human's common sense, which says that there's no way a doll can talk or move, they instantly revert to being non-speaking dolls...
units.note: UP removes the universal every-time doll-play reading.
units.japanese: ベアトリーチェが言うには、いわゆる子どもの頃のお人形遊びなどは、本当に人形が意思を持って対話をし、自らの意思で動くことさえあるという。しかし、その依り代に宿らせる力は、無垢ゆえにとても弱い。人形が喋るわけがない、動くわけがない、というニンゲンの常識の毒がわずかでも入り込むと、たちどころにそれは、物言わぬただの人形に逆戻りする……。
candidates: every time a child plays with dolls

description: WH makes the cloth-and-cotton vessel a shell instead of the core of manifestation.
sourceReading: 依り代を核に identifies the material vessel as the nucleus/core around which Sakutaro manifests.

units.text: ".........How incredible.  This Sakutarou, with a cloth and cotton vessel as a shell, has completely materialized into the human world.  He has his own character, talks with the summoner freely, and even moves by his own will.
units.note: UP restores core rather than shell.
units.japanese: 「………何と言うことか。…さくたろうとやらは、その布地と綿の依り代を核に、完全に人間界に顕現している。自らの人格を持ち、召喚者と自在に対話をし、

units.text: "......How incredible. This Sakutarou, with a cloth and cotton vessel as a shell, has completely materialized into the human world. He has his own personality, talks with the summoner freely, and even moves by his own will."
units.note: UP restores core rather than shell.
units.japanese: 「………何と言うことか。…さくたろうとやらは、その布地と綿の依り代を核に、完全に人間界に顕現している。自らの人格を持ち、召喚者と自在に対話をし、しかも自らの意思で動いている」

description: WH separates lack of awareness and inability to use the power where Beatrice says Maria cannot yet use it consciously.
sourceReading: それを自覚して使えぬ means unable to exercise it with conscious recognition. Beatrice has just insisted that Maria already performs magic despite calling herself an apprentice.

units.text: "No, it is magic.  .........Because you have not become aware of it and cannot use it, you are still an apprentice, ......but even so, what magical power it is!  The materialization of your friend, Sakutarou is excellent proof of that."
units.note: Both restore inability to use the power consciously.
units.japanese: 「いいや、魔法だ。………それを自覚して使えぬから未だ見習いなのであろうが、

description: WH says the power lies in the human world and discusses summoning magical power, losing that Maria’s power keeps the created being there.
sourceReading: それを強力な力で人間界に留めている says she maintains that entity in the human world by strong power. The following clause praises power sufficient to manifest as a life-form despite modern anti-magic poison; it does not say power itself is summoned.

units.text: Furthermore, that strong magical power lies in the human world.  ......In this era so filled with the toxin that denies magic, summoning a magical power that can materialize a single life-form is not easy even for me."
units.note: UP restores tethering the being rather than locating/summoning magical power.
units.japanese: しかも、それを強力な力で人間界に留めている。……これほどまでに魔法を否定する毒気に満たされた現代において、一個の生命体たりえるほどに顕現できる魔力は、妾とて容易なことではないわ。」
candidates: power lies in the human world

units.text: "Furthermore, that strong magical power lies in the human world. ...In this era so filled with the toxin that denies magic, summoning a magical power that can materialize a single life-form is not easy even for me."
units.note: UP restores tethering the being rather than locating/summoning magical power.
units.japanese: 「しかも、それを強力な力で人間界に留めている。……これほどまでに魔法を否定する毒気に満たされた現代において、一個の生命体たりえるほどに顕現できる魔力は、妾とて容易なことではないわ」
candidates: power lies in the human world

description: WH predicts that Beatrice must acknowledge Maria as superior rather than that she must regard her with particular respect.
sourceReading: 妾と双璧どころか、妾とて一目置かざるを得ない大魔女 intensifies the forecast beyond simple equal standing to a Great Witch even Beatrice must take seriously/defer to. 一目置く does not itself explicitly assign superior overall magical rank.

units.text: ......It is easy to make 100 from 1.  However, giving birth to 1 from 0 is not easy.  ...When you become a full witch, you may not only be a match for me, but might instead grow into a Great Witch that even I must acknowledge as superior.
units.note: Both retain acknowledgement as superior rather than respect.
units.japanese: ……１を１００にすることは容易い。しかし、０から１を生じることは容易くはない。…そなたが一人前の魔女になったなら、妾と双璧どころか、妾とて一目置かざるを得ない大魔女に成長するであろう。

units.text: "...It is easy to make 100 from 1. However, giving birth to 1 from 0 is not. ...When you do become a full witch, beyond just becoming a match for me, you might grow into a Great Witch that even I must acknowledge as superior."
units.note: Both retain acknowledgement as superior rather than respect.
units.japanese: 「……１を１００にすることは容易い。しかし、０から１を生じることは容易くはない。…そなたが一人前の魔女になったなら、妾と双璧どころか、妾とて一目置かざるを得ない大魔女に成長するであろう」

units.text: "......It is simple to make a hundred from one. However, creating one from zero is not easy. ...When you become a full witch, you may not only be a match for me, but might even grow into a Great Witch that I must acknowledge as superior."
units.note: Both retain acknowledgement as superior rather than respect.
units.japanese: 「……１を１００にすることは容易い。しかし、０から１を生じることは容易くはない。…そなたが一人前の魔女になったなら、妾と双璧どころか、妾とて一目置かざるを得ない大魔女に成長するであろう」

description: WH substitutes gulp for Sakutaro’s little bow after thanking Virgilia for the sweet.
sourceReading: ぺこり is the brief bow/nod gesture accompanying his thanks. It is not a swallowing sound.

units.text: 『Uryu.  Thank you very much for the candy.  ...*gulp*.』
units.note: UP restores bow rather than gulp.
units.japanese: 『うりゅ。飴をどうもありがとうございます。…ぺこり。』

units.text: ‘Uryu. Thank you very much for the candy. ...*gulp*.’
units.note: UP restores bow rather than gulp.
units.japanese: 『うりゅ。飴をどうもありがとうございます。…ぺこり』

description: WH says the magical effect could be controlled when Beatrice writes and Virgilia signs, rather than that the magic takes effect through writing and a witness signature.
sourceReading: ベアトリーチェが記し、ワルギリアが立会人にサインすることで効力を発揮する describes the act that makes the magic effective. It does not describe subsequent regulation/control of its effect, and expressly identifies the signer as a witness.

units.text: ......It was something like a written declaration made by witches to a high-order world. It was magic whose effect could be controlled if Beatrice wrote and Virgilia signed. Maria didn't understand what Beato was writing at first, but partway through, she figured out the wonderful magic power of this document, and her eyes began to sparkle...
units.note: UP restores taking effect rather than control of effect.
units.japanese: ベアトリーチェが記し、ワルギリアが立会人にサインすることで効力を発揮する、魔法。

units.text: ...It was something like a written declaration made by witches to a high-order world. It was magic whose effect could be controlled if Beatrice wrote and Virgilia signed. Maria didn't understand what Beato was writing at first, but partway through, she figured out the wonderful magical power of this document, and her eyes began to sparkle...
units.note: UP restores taking effect rather than control of effect.
units.japanese: ……それは、魔女が高位世界に対して記す宣言書のようなもの。ベアトリーチェが記し、ワルギリアが立会人にサインすることで効力を発揮する、魔法。最初は何を書いているのか理解できなかった真里亞も、途中からその書面の素晴らしき魔力を理解し、瞳を輝かせ始める…。

description: WH makes Beatrice ask to try animal ears on instead of asking to nibble the ears.
sourceReading: あとで妾にもかじらせよ uses かじる, to bite/nibble: let me nibble them later. It continues her delighted reaction to the new form’s ears.

units.text: "I think the muffler adds some charm points.  And the ears!  Animal ears sure are nice, truly cute!  Let me try some on later.  *cackle*!"
units.note: Both restore nibbling the ears.
units.japanese: 獣耳はいいぞォ、実に可愛い！　あとで妾にもかじらせよ。くっくっく！」

description: WH makes a magical compendium already inside Maria’s heart the means to create a galaxy.
sourceReading: その胸の内より魔法大系はおろか、銀河を生み出す describes creating from within not merely a system of magic but even a galaxy. Both are products of origin magic, not a pre-existing handbook and the thing made using it.

units.text: ......But after one thousand years of training, it is not unthinkable that you could use the magical compendium that resides inside your heart to create a galaxy."
units.note: UP restores creation of a magic system and galaxy.
units.japanese: ……しかし千年の修行を経たならば、その胸の内より魔法大系はおろか、銀河を生み出すことも夢ではあるまい。」

units.text: ...But after one thousand years of training, you could conceivably use the magical compendium that resides inside your heart to create a galaxy."
units.note: UP restores creation of a magic system and galaxy.
units.japanese: 「……しかし千年の修行を経たならば、その胸の内より魔法大系はおろか、銀河を生み出すことも夢ではあるまい」

description: WH says the outfit gains value if Maria acts pompously rather than if she is coy about showing it.
sourceReading: もったいぶった方が価値が出る follows the warning not to display formal witch dress indiscriminately: holding back/making others wait raises its value.

units.text: "The full dress of a witch must not be shown indiscriminately.  Such a thing is worth more if you act pompously.  *cackle*!"
units.note: MG restores withholding display; UP restores restraint but adds most grandiose occasions restriction, recorded under the same parent.
units.japanese: もったいぶった方が価値が出るというもの。くっくっく！」

units.text: "The full dress of a witch must not be shown indiscriminately. Such a thing is worth more if you reserve it for those most grandiose occasions. *cackle*!"
units.note: MG restores withholding display; UP restores restraint but adds most grandiose occasions restriction, recorded under the same parent.
units.japanese: 「魔女の正装は濫りに見せてはならぬぞ。もったいぶった方が価値が出るというもの。くっくっく！」

description: WH says the friend wanted to witness their worth instead of asking the professor to assess that worth confidentially.
sourceReading: その価値を内密に見て欲しい reports the friend’s request that the speaker examine/appraise the books privately.

units.text: "Yes, I will never forget that.  It happened in April of 1987.  I received a certain strange request from a friend.  ......There was a large collection of books, which were the former possessions of a very rich man and were being sold at auction, and it was thought that some of them might have been extremely valuable to the study of archeology and folklore, as well as in an occult sense, so this friend wanted to witness their worth confidentially."
units.note: UP restores asking the professor to appraise privately.
units.japanese: 「えぇ、あれは忘れもしない。１９８７年４月のことです。私は友人から、ある奇妙な依頼を受けました。……とある大富豪の遺品である蔵書が大量に競売に掛けられていて、その一部に、民俗学的にも考古学的にも、あるいはオカルト的な意味でも極めて価値の高いものが含まれていると思われる、その価値を内密に見て欲しいというのです。」
candidates: friend wanted to witness their worth

units.text: ...There was a large collection of books, the former possessions of a very rich man, that were being sold at auction, and it was thought that some of them might've been extremely valuable to the study of archeology and folklore, as well as in an occult sense, so this friend wanted to witness their worth confidentially."
units.note: UP restores asking the professor to appraise privately.
units.japanese: 「……とある大富豪の遺品である蔵書が大量に競売に掛けられていて、その一部に、民俗学的にも考古学的にも、あるいはオカルト的な意味でも極めて価値の高いものが含まれていると思われる、その価値を内密に見て欲しいというのです」
candidates: friend wanted to witness their worth

description: WH identifies him as the person in the best position rather than one of the people best placed to understand Kinzo’s research.
sourceReading: もっとも理解できる立場にある人間のひとり expressly retains a group of comparably qualified people.

units.text: His true life work was...the study of occultism, western magic, alchemy, and everything else to do with the occult, as well as demonology. In short, he was the person in the best position to understand the details of Kinzo's research...
units.note: UP restores one of the best positioned people.
units.japanese: つまり、金蔵の研究内容をもっとも理解できる立場にある人間のひとりであった…。

units.text: His true life work was... the study of occultism, Western magic, alchemy, and everything else to do with the occult, as well as demonology. In short, he was the person in the best position to understand the details of Kinzo's research...
units.note: UP restores one of the best positioned people.
units.japanese: 彼の本当のライフワークは、神秘学、西洋魔法、錬金術、それら全てを内包するオカルト、そして悪魔学。つまり、金蔵の研究内容をもっとも理解できる立場にある人間のひとりであった…。

description: WH says the dealer possessed the documents after Eva had them sold at auction instead of receiving them with instructions to auction them.
sourceReading: 競売に掛けるよう依頼して預けた means Eva entrusted them to the dealer requesting they be put up for auction. The appraisal follows this consignment.

units.text: April, 1987. A major city antique shop obtained a large quantity of ancient documents that were thought to have a high historical value. They came into possession of them after Ushiromiya Eva had had them sold at auction.
units.note: Both restore entrusted texts and auction request.
units.japanese: これは、右代宮絵羽が競売に掛けるよう依頼して預けたものであった。

description: WH says authorities gathered the old books from antique shops, where the dealer assembled authorities to appraise the books.
sourceReading: 古物商によって鑑定のために集められた権威たち are the experts gathered by the dealer for appraisal; the books astound those experts.

units.text: And these old books, which were later called 'the Ushiromiya Library', were later gathered from antique shops by authorities in the field so that they could be appraised...and the authorities were astounded.
units.note: UP restores gathering authorities rather than gathering books.
units.japanese: そして、後に「右代宮蔵書」と呼ばれるそれら古文書は、古物商によって鑑定のために集められた権威たちの度肝を抜いた。

units.text: These old books, which would eventually be called "the Ushiromiya Library", were later gathered from antique shops by authorities in the field so that they could be appraised, ...and those authorities were astounded.
units.note: UP restores gathering authorities rather than gathering books.
units.japanese: そして、後に「右代宮蔵書」と呼ばれるそれら古文書は、古物商によって鑑定のために集められた権威たちの度肝を抜いた。

description: WH says collectors could not satisfy their desire to hoard the books rather than that the books were valuable enough to make them want to hoard them for possessive satisfaction.
sourceReading: 好事家たちが死蔵して独占欲を満たしたくなるほどに価値ある describes an inducement: their value makes collectors want to keep them hidden and satisfy the desire for exclusive possession. 満たしたくなる is wanting to satisfy, not inability to satisfy.

units.text: Those books, which were so valuable that dilettantes just couldn't satisfy their desire to hoard them away, were discovered in large numbers at the end of the 20th century, and their release to the public had given the entire world a massive shock...
units.note: UP restores books inciting possessive hoarding.
units.japanese: そんな、好事家たちが死蔵して独占欲を満たしたくなるほどに価値ある蔵書が２０世紀末に大量に発見、公開されたことは、全世界に大きな衝撃を与えた…。

units.text: Those books, which were so valuable that enthusiasts could never satisfy their desire to hoard them away, were discovered in large numbers at the end of the 20th century, and their release to the public had given the entire world a massive shock...
units.note: UP restores books inciting possessive hoarding.
units.japanese: そんな、好事家たちが死蔵して独占欲を満たしたくなるほどに価値ある蔵書が２０世紀末に大量に発見、公開されたことは、全世界に大きな衝撃を与えた…。

description: WH reduces the bottle’s sealing condition to the bare fact that it was sealed as a basis for the police judgment.
sourceReading: 現場の状況とボトルの封印状況 are the circumstances at the scene and the condition/state of the bottle’s sealing. The source leaves the relevant observed condition unspecified rather than asserting that simple seal presence is the entire basis.

units.text: "It seems that, due to evidence from the surrounding area and the fact that the bottle was sealed, the police had decided that its likelihood of being a fabrication was low and that it had been abandoned no earlier than a few days before the accident.  And the handwriting for both matched.  This caused the credibility of the scraps of paper discovered by the fisherman to rise.
units.note: UP restores intact state of bottle seal.
units.japanese: 「警察は現場の状況とボトルの封印状況から、捏造の可能性は低く、事故直前の数日以内に投棄したものと判断したようです。　また双方の筆跡は一致しました。これにより、漁師の発見したノート片の信憑性が増すこととなりました。

units.text: "It seems that, due to evidence from the surrounding area and the fact that the bottle had been sealed, the police had decided that its likelihood of being a fabrication was low and that it had been abandoned no earlier than a few days before the accident. And the handwriting for both matched. This caused the credibility of the scraps of paper discovered by the fisherman to rise."
units.note: UP restores intact state of bottle seal.
units.japanese: 「警察は現場の状況とボトルの封印状況から、捏造の可能性は低く、事故直前の数日以内に投棄したものと判断したようです。また双方の筆跡は一致しました。これにより、漁師の発見したノート片の信憑性が増すこととなりました」

description: WH supplies attention as the motive in Ange’s speculation about the author of the witch accounts.
sourceReading: 愉快犯的犯行 describes a crime committed for amusement or the thrill of doing it. Ange can only conceive of someone seeking to generate a witch illusion doing such a thing; no particular desire for attention is specified.

units.text: ......I can only imagine that someone who wanted to give rise to an illusion of a witch carried out this crime for attention. However, the 17 people other than Eva oba-san had lost their lives, and a vast wealth or maybe even 10 tons of gold had moved around secretly in the darkness. With a conclusion like that, it just doesn't make sense for this to be a witch's illusion.
units.note: Both restore pleasure motive rather than the inherited attention motive.
units.japanese: ……魔女幻想を生み出したい何者かの、愉快犯的犯行としか思えない。

description: Kasumi’s resentment at Ange adopting a name she had so strongly rejected becomes a claim that Ange had rejected it repeatedly.
sourceReading: あんなに名乗るのは嫌だと言ってた emphasizes the degree of Ange’s professed aversion to using the Sumadera name. The barb contrasts that strong aversion with her now casually adopting it.

units.text: "...............What a bad child, Ange-chan.  ......I wonder if that craftiness is from Nee-san's blood.  ......To think that she would casually take on the name Sumadera after saying she'd hate to call herself that so often...
units.note: Both retain repeated rejection rather than emphatic rejection.
units.japanese: 「………………いけない子ねぇ、縁寿ちゃんは。……そういう悪知恵、姉さんの血なのかしらねぇ。……あんなに名乗るのは嫌だと言ってた須磨寺の名を、気安く名乗ってくれちゃうなんて…。

units.text: ".........What a bad child, Ange-chan. ...I wonder if that craftiness is from Nee-san's blood. ...To think she'd casually take on the name Sumadera after saying she'd hate to go by it so often..."
units.note: Both retain repeated rejection rather than emphatic rejection.
units.japanese: 「………………いけない子ねぇ、縁寿ちゃんは。……そういう悪知恵、姉さんの血なのかしらねぇ。……あんなに名乗るのは嫌だと言ってた須磨寺の名を、気安く名乗ってくれちゃうなんて…」

units.text: "..................What a bad child that Ange‐chan is. ......I wonder if that craftiness is from Nee‐san's blood. ......To think that she would casually take on the name Sumadera after saying so often how she'd hate to call herself that..."
units.note: Both retain repeated rejection rather than emphatic rejection.
units.japanese: 「………………いけない子ねぇ、縁寿ちゃんは。……そういう悪知恵、姉さんの血なのかしらねぇ。……あんなに名乗るのは嫌だと言ってた須磨寺の名を、気安く名乗ってくれちゃうなんて…」

description: The Japanese compares the vessel’s importance for weakened Ange to bicycle training wheels, then escalates it to a chain. WH instead says it is important for her bike to have those parts.
sourceReading: 次に、依り代 introduces the vessel as the topic. 今の縁寿には自転車の補助輪、…いえ、チェーンくらい大事 means that for Ange now it is as important as training wheels—no, as a bicycle chain. The revision intensifies the comparison from assistance to a basic operating necessity.

units.text: ".........Next is the vessel.  ...Right now, it's important for your bike to at least have training wheels, ...no, a chain."
units.note: UP restores bicycle analogy for the vessel rather than advising physical bicycle equipment.
units.japanese: 「………次に、依り代。…今の縁寿には自転車の補助輪、…いえ、チェーンくらい大事。」

units.text: "......Next is the vessel. ...Right now, it's important for your bike to at least have training wheels...no, a chain."
units.note: UP restores bicycle analogy for the vessel rather than advising physical bicycle equipment.
units.japanese: 「………次に、依り代。…今の縁寿には自転車の補助輪、…いえ、チェーンくらい大事」

description: WH replaces the reassurance about continuing protection in an old charm with a statement about prior fitting of protection.
sourceReading: まだ十分な魔法防御が備わってる says it still possesses sufficient magical defense. In context Ange has retrieved a bracelet received long ago; Maria assures her its defense remains sufficient.

units.text: ".........It's alright.  That has already been fitted with the required amount of magical defense.  As long as you wear that, you'll certainly be fine."
units.note: UP restores still sufficient magical protection.
units.japanese: 「………大丈夫。それには、まだ十分な魔法防御が備わってる。それを身に着けている限り、絶対に大丈夫。」

units.text: "......It's okay. That has already been fitted with the required amount of magical defense. As long as you wear that, you'll definitely be fine."
units.note: UP restores still sufficient magical protection.
units.japanese: 「………大丈夫。それには、まだ十分な魔法防御が備わってる。それを身に着けている限り、絶対に大丈夫」

description: WH makes the stake the subject of the first upward movement, then describes Mammon’s stake rising again.
sourceReading: 私がかざす手を徐々に高め、頭より高く掲げる describes Ange gradually raising her extended hand above her head. As if drawn to that hand, the stake also levitates high and begins vibrating.

units.text: The stake I held out rose bit by bit, rising higher than my head, and as though it was being attracted upwards, Mammon's stake once again floated up high into the air, ......and gradually began to shake.
units.note: MG restores the hand as first subject but retains once again; UP restores both hand and likewise.
units.japanese: 私がかざす手を徐々に高め、頭より高く掲げると、まるでそれに吸い寄せられるように、マモンの杭もまた、宙高く浮かび上がり、……徐々に震え始める。

units.text: After I raised my hands bit by bit, lifting them higher than my head, as though it was being attracted upwards, Mammon's stake once again floated up high into the air...and gradually began to shake.
units.note: MG restores the hand as first subject but retains once again; UP restores both hand and likewise.
units.japanese: 私がかざす手を徐々に高め、頭より高く掲げると、まるでそれに吸い寄せられるように、マモンの杭もまた、宙高く浮かび上がり、……徐々に震え始める。

description: WH reverses the relation between summoning and rehabilitation in Maria’s caution and Ange’s answering challenge.
sourceReading: マモンを呼び出せただけで、リハビリには十分 says merely having managed to summon Mammon is sufficient for rehabilitation: it is enough practice toward regaining her ability. Ange replies that just one already counts as rehabilitation (１人だけでリハビリになっちゃうの), then elects to keep going as a pastime.

units.text: ".........Ange.  Don't overdo it.  You'll need enough rehabilitation just from summoning Mammon."
units.note: UP restores summoning as sufficient rehabilitation rather than requiring rehabilitation afterward.
units.japanese:
「………縁寿。無理しないで。マモンを呼び出せただけで、リハビリには十分だよ。」
「あら、１人だけでリハビリになっちゃうの？　どうせ暇潰しよ。

units.text: "Oh, I'll need rehabilitation just from one?  Well, I'm just killing time anyways.  .........Alright, Mammon.  I've already got myself started.  I'll call as many as I can."
units.note: UP restores summoning as sufficient rehabilitation rather than requiring rehabilitation afterward.
units.japanese:
「………縁寿。無理しないで。マモンを呼び出せただけで、リハビリには十分だよ。」
「あら、１人だけでリハビリになっちゃうの？　どうせ暇潰しよ。

units.text: "......Ange, don't overdo it. You'll need plenty of rehabilitation just from summoning Mammon."
units.note: UP restores summoning as sufficient rehabilitation rather than requiring rehabilitation afterward.
units.japanese:
「………縁寿。無理しないで。マモンを呼び出せただけで、リハビリには十分だよ」
「あら、１人だけでリハビリになっちゃうの？　どうせ暇潰しよ。………いいわ、マモン。乗りかかった船だわ。呼べるところまで呼んであげる」

units.text: "Oh, I'll need to rehabilitate after just one? Well, I'm just killing time anyway. ......Okay, Mammon. I've gone this far. I'll call as many as I can."
units.note: UP restores summoning as sufficient rehabilitation rather than requiring rehabilitation afterward.
units.japanese:
「………縁寿。無理しないで。マモンを呼び出せただけで、リハビリには十分だよ」
「あら、１人だけでリハビリになっちゃうの？　どうせ暇潰しよ。………いいわ、マモン。乗りかかった船だわ。呼べるところまで呼んであげる」

description: Satan’s reproach gains an accusation that the sisters are not appreciative of another chance to serve.
sourceReading: 再びお役に立てる機会を賜るどころか、新しい主人の負担になる contrasts being granted another opportunity to be useful with instead becoming a burden to the new master. The disgrace is their negative effect on Ange rather than insufficient gratitude for an opportunity.

units.text: "We are furniture who have been granted rest by Beatrice, and whose duty has been finished!  Not only are you not honored at being given another chance to be of some use, but you're putting a burden on our new master, you disgrace to furniture!!  Erase yourselves right away!!"
units.note: Both retain an accusation of dissatisfaction instead of contrast between usefulness and burden.
units.japanese: 「私たちはベアトリーチェさまより休むことを許された、役目を終えた家具なのよ！　再びお役に立てる機会を賜るどころか、新しい主人の負担になるなんて、そんなの家具の名折れッ！！　早く姿を消しなさいッ！！」

units.text: "We are furniture who have been granted rest by Beatrice and whose duty has been finished! Not only are you not honored at being given another chance to be of some use, but you're putting a burden on our new master, you disgrace to all furniture!! Erase yourselves right away!!"
units.note: Both retain an accusation of dissatisfaction instead of contrast between usefulness and burden.
units.japanese: 「私たちはベアトリーチェさまより休むことを許された、役目を終えた家具なのよ！　再びお役に立てる機会を賜るどころか、新しい主人の負担になるなんて、そんなの家具の名折れッ！！　早く姿を消しなさいッ！！」

units.text: "We are furniture that has been permitted rest by Beatrice, furniture that has finished its duty! Not content to be graced with the opportunity to once again be of some use, you are putting a burden on your new master—this is a DISGRACE to furniture!! Erase yourselves RIGHT NOW!!"
units.note: Both retain an accusation of dissatisfaction instead of contrast between usefulness and burden.
units.japanese: 「私たちはベアトリーチェさまより休むことを許された、役目を終えた家具なのよ！　再びお役に立てる機会を賜るどころか、新しい主人の負担になるなんて、そんなの家具の名折れッ！！　早く姿を消しなさいッ！！」

description: WH places the remembered rest stop at a peak instead of a mountain pass.
sourceReading: 峠 denotes the mountain pass. The later rest-stop viewing platform at 150862 repeats that location; 麓 is the foot of the mountain seen below.

units.text: "............Imagine...a vast space............The scene from when I looked down at the base from the rest stop at the peak......
units.note: Both retain peak for mountain pass.
units.japanese: 「……………広大な空間を、イメージ……。……峠のドライブインから麓を見下ろした時の風景……。

units.text: "......Imagine...a vast space... ...The scene from when I looked down at the mountain's base from a rest stop at the peak...
units.note: Both retain peak for mountain pass.
units.japanese: 「……………広大な空間を、イメージ……。……峠のドライブインから麓を見下ろした時の風景……」

units.text: "...............Imagine...a vast space...... ......The scenery when I looked down at the base of the mountain, from the rest stop at the peak......"
units.note: Both retain peak for mountain pass.
units.japanese: 「……………広大な空間を、イメージ……。……峠のドライブインから麓を見下ろした時の風景……」

description: WH adds making his eyes round while reducing Sakutarou’s playful rubbing gesture.
sourceReading: 猫のように、私にその頭を押し付けてくりくりしてじゃれ付いてくる describes him pressing and rubbing/nuzzling his head against Ange, frolicking affectionately like a cat. No eyes are mentioned.

units.text: Looking happy and making his eyes round, Sakutaro pressed his head against me like a cat. Suddenly getting a cute younger brother, ......felt a bit confusing, a bit embarrassing, and a bit pleasant. .........Unable to understand why I couldn't honestly accept this feeling, I felt tears well up in my eyes.
units.note: MG removes round eyes but omits rubbing/play; UP restores the action.
units.japanese: さくたろは嬉しそうにしながら、猫のように、私にその頭を押し付けてくりくりしてじゃれ付いてくる。

units.text: Looking happy, Sakutaro pressed his head against me like a cat. Suddenly getting a cute younger brother...felt a bit confusing, a bit embarrassing, and a bit nice. ......Unable to understand why I couldn't honestly accept this feeling, I felt tears well up in my eyes.
units.note: MG removes round eyes but omits rubbing/play; UP restores the action.
units.japanese: さくたろは嬉しそうにしながら、猫のように、私にその頭を押し付けてくりくりしてじゃれ付いてくる。こんな可愛らしい弟が突然出来てしまって、……困惑するような恥ずかしいような嬉しいような。………なんでこの気持ちに素直になれなかったのか、わからなくて、目頭が熱くなるのを感じた。

description: WH makes Ange unable to attain the meditative state after a long effort instead of requiring a long effort to attain it.
sourceReading: 長い時間を掛けて瞑想しなくては至れない境地 means a state she cannot reach without spending a long time meditating. Maria reaches it with just a few low breaths. The comparison concerns required effort, not Ange failing after that effort.

units.text: Maria onee-chan lifted both hands up to the level of her head, and quietly unified her mind. ......The state that I had not been able to reach after meditating for a long period of time, she reached in the span of a few quick breaths.
units.note: Both restore the prolonged meditation condition; quiet breaths remain a separate inherited candidate.
units.japanese: ……私が、長い時間を掛けて瞑想しなくては至れない境地に、わずか数回の低い呼吸で至ってしまう。

description: WH repeatedly uses shady for the sisters’ threatening demeanor.
sourceReading: 物騒 describes alarming danger or menace here, reinforced by Ange’s fear that they could finish Sakutarou off immediately. It is not merely an impression of suspicious or disreputable behavior.

units.text: "......That's unexpected.  To think that Sakutaro would be so loved by such shady people."
units.note: UP restores dangerous and combative or unsettling descriptions.
units.japanese: 「……意外。さくたろが、あんな物騒な連中にこんなに可愛がられてるなんて。」

units.text: "...That's unexpected. To think that Sakutaro would be so loved by such shady people."
units.note: UP restores dangerous and combative or unsettling descriptions.
units.japanese: 「……意外。さくたろが、あんな物騒な連中にこんなに可愛がられてるなんて」

units.text: "......That's unexpected.  To think that Sakutaro would be so loved by such shady people."
units.note: Later occurrences retain MG shady; UP restores dangerous and frightening.
units.japanese: 「……意外。さくたろが、あんな物騒な連中にこんなに可愛がられてるなんて。」

units.text: Your own effort isn't something that you can observe by yourself. In that sense, ...even though these words came from a shady demon girl who controls one of the seven deadly sins, ...they made me very happy.
units.note: Later occurrences retain MG shady; UP restores dangerous and frightening.
units.japanese:
自らの努力というものは、自らには観測できない。その意味において、……この、七つの大罪のうちの一つを司るという物騒な悪魔少女であっても、……私に掛けてくれたその言葉はとても嬉しいものだ。
……………私にも魔法の友達が現れるなら、さくたろうみたいな可愛い子がいいと思ってたけど。この七つの大罪を司る、物騒な七姉妹の五女ひとりだけでも、私の心はこんなにも安らぐ。……真里亞お姉ちゃんは多分、こんなことはとっくに知っていた。だからこそ私に、あんなにも繰り返し繰り返し、魔女の世界を勧めてくれたのだ。

units.text: ......I'd thought that if a magical friend were to appear for me too, a cute kid like Sakutarou would be best. But even this fifth sister of the shady Seven Sisters who controlled the seven deadly sins...was enough to calm my heart so much all by herself. ...Maria onee-chan has probably known that since long ago. That's why she recommended the world of witches to me over and over and over again.
units.note: Later occurrences retain MG shady; UP restores dangerous and frightening.
units.japanese:
自らの努力というものは、自らには観測できない。その意味において、……この、七つの大罪のうちの一つを司るという物騒な悪魔少女であっても、……私に掛けてくれたその言葉はとても嬉しいものだ。
……………私にも魔法の友達が現れるなら、さくたろうみたいな可愛い子がいいと思ってたけど。この七つの大罪を司る、物騒な七姉妹の五女ひとりだけでも、私の心はこんなにも安らぐ。……真里亞お姉ちゃんは多分、こんなことはとっくに知っていた。だからこそ私に、あんなにも繰り返し繰り返し、魔女の世界を勧めてくれたのだ。

description: WH turns a reported ability at Maria’s level into a hypothetical future ability of Ange herself.
sourceReading: 真里亞お姉ちゃんクラスになると introduces the level represented by Maria; 呼び出すことさえ出来るという reports that even an orchestra-sized number can be summoned at once. The surrounding comparison admires Maria’s present ability and apprentice status. No explicit first-person promise about Ange’s potential is made.

units.text: If I reached Maria onee-chan's class, I would be able to summon enough people to perform in an orchestra. For a witch apprentice, that's awe-inspiring...
units.note: Both restore Maria-level reported capacity rather than future Ange ability.
units.japanese: 真里亞お姉ちゃんクラスになると、オーケストラが演奏できるくらいの人数を一度に呼び出すことさえ出来るという。

description: WH replaces withholding attention with a hostile-looking gaze in Ange’s account of the girls’ behavior when she avoids triggering collective punishment.
sourceReading: 彼女たちは冷酷に私を無視はするけれども、干渉だけはしない says they coldly ignore her, but at least do not interfere. Her desired minimal peace is freedom from interference despite exclusion.

units.text: As long as I avoided this, the girls would look at me coldly, but they wouldn't get in my way. ......That alone was enough for me.
units.note: UP restores cold disregard rather than looking coldly.
units.japanese: これさえ気をつければ、彼女たちは冷酷に私を無視はするけれども、干渉だけはしない。

units.text: As long as I avoided this, the girls would look at me coldly, but they wouldn't get in my way. ...That alone was enough for me.
units.note: UP restores cold disregard rather than looking coldly.
units.japanese: これさえ気をつければ、彼女たちは冷酷に私を無視はするけれども、干渉だけはしない。……私にはそれだけで充分なのだ。

description: WH moves the locus and recipient of magic from the hair accessory to Ange herself in Mammon’s explanation of the vessel.
sourceReading: Asked whether magic resides in the accessory, Mammon answers 縁寿さまが宿らせている: more precisely Ange is making it reside there. Her strong desire to call her brother gives magical power to the accessory under discussion. The subject is Ange’s desire; the continuing object is the accessory.

units.text: "Maybe I should say that it resides in you, Ange-sama.  ......Your strong desire to call your brother to you gives you magical power.
units.note: UP535 restores imbuing the accessory, but536 still gives power to Ange.
units.japanese: 「縁寿さまが宿らせている、というべきかもね。……縁寿さまの、兄を呼び出したいという強い想いが魔力を与えている。

units.text: "Maybe I should say that it resides in you, Ange-sama. ...Your strong desire to call your brother gives you magical power.
units.note: UP535 restores imbuing the accessory, but536 still gives power to Ange.
units.japanese: 「縁寿さまが宿らせている、というべきかもね。……縁寿さまの、兄を呼び出したいという強い想いが魔力を与えている」

units.text: "Maybe I should say that you are imbuing it with that power. ......Your strong desire to call your brother to you is giving you magical power."
units.note: UP535 restores imbuing the accessory, but536 still gives power to Ange.
units.japanese: 「縁寿さまが宿らせている、というべきかもね。……縁寿さまの、兄を呼び出したいという強い想いが魔力を与えている」

description: WH converts inclusion of Bernkastel into a comparative statement about Lambdadelta.
sourceReading: ベルンカステルも含め includes Bernkastel in the observation about elusive witch existence. Ange then tentatively describes beings higher than herself; the source does not rank Lambdadelta as stranger than Bernkastel here.

units.text: But there's some kind of difference between her and Beatrice. Even compared to Bernkastel, there's something strange about Lambdadelta's existence. ......How should I put it, ...maybe like she's a being from a higher dimension... In any event, I was still unsure about how to deal with her.
units.note: UP restores Bernkastel inclusion alongside Lambdadelta.
units.japanese: ベルンカステルも含め、ラムダデルタの存在はどこか掴み所がない。

units.text: But there's some kind of difference between her and Beatrice. Even compared to Bernkastel, there's something strange about Lambdadelta's existence. ...It's...how should I put it... Maybe like she's a being from a higher dimension... In any event, I was still unsure about how to deal with her.
units.note: UP restores Bernkastel inclusion alongside Lambdadelta.
units.japanese: しかし、ベアトリーチェとは何かが違う。ベルンカステルも含め、ラムダデルタの存在はどこか掴み所がない。……何と言うか、…自分より次元の高い存在とでも言うべきなのか…。いずれにせよ、私は彼女にどう接していいか、未だに戸惑っている。

description: WH reverses Lambdadelta’s initial response to Ange asking whether she has business with her.
sourceReading: まぁね is a qualified affirmative, roughly yes/sort of. She immediately explains overhearing their conversation and wanting to tell Ange something useful.

units.text: "Not really.  When I listened in on your conversation, it started to get a bit interesting.  I thought I'd let you hear something good."
units.note: UP restores qualified assent.
units.japanese: 「まぁね。あなたたちの会話に耳を傾けてたら、ちょっと面白い話になったんでね。あなたにちょっと、良い話を聞かせてあげようと思って。」

units.text: "Not really. When I listened in on your conversation, it started to get a bit interesting. I thought I'd let you hear something good."
units.note: UP restores qualified assent.
units.japanese: 「まぁね。あなたたちの会話に耳を傾けてたら、ちょっと面白い話になったんでね。あなたにちょっと、良い話を聞かせてあげようと思って」

description: WH removes Ange’s uncertainty about whether she is beginning to fall into a trap.
sourceReading: 罠に落ちかけているかもしれないと自覚しながらも is awareness that she may be on the verge of falling into a trap, despite which she prompts the next explanation.

units.text: Damn... I'm letting her take the initiative. ...But I won't be released until I lend an ear to her story. ...So it's something I'll have to hear anyways... Even though I realized that I was falling into a trap, I urged her forwards.
units.note: UP restores possible impending trap rather than certain present entrapment.
units.japanese: 私は罠に落ちかけているかもしれないと自覚しながらも、その先を促してしまう。

units.text: Damn... I'm letting her take the initiative. ...But I won't be released until I lend an ear to her. ...So it's something I'll have to hear anyway... Even though I realized I was falling into a trap, I urged her forwards.
units.note: UP restores possible impending trap rather than certain present entrapment.
units.japanese: まずい…。向こうのペースに乗せられた。…しかし私は、彼女の話に耳を傾けない限り解放されないのだ。…ならば、いずれは聞かねばならぬ話…。私は罠に落ちかけているかもしれないと自覚しながらも、その先を促してしまう。

description: WH omits bringing the outcome and changes the domain of the happiest-outcome promise into an added receiving condition.
sourceReading: あなたが享受できる可能性の中で、もっとも幸せな結末を探して持ってくることを約束する promises to search for and bring the happiest outcome among the possibilities Ange can enjoy. The bounded set of available outcomes is the basis for choosing the happiest one.

units.text: And, ......in the end, she said this. 'I'm giving you a chance for revenge.  ...In exchange, if it is possible for you to receive it, I promise to search for the happiest resolution for you.'
units.note: Both restore bounded outcomes and bringing the result; MG accepting is less exact but does not retain the canonical added conditional structure.
units.japanese: “あなたに、復讐のチャンスを。…見返りに、あなたが享受できる可能性の中で、もっとも幸せな結末を探して持ってくることを約束するわ。”

description: WH changes the feared reduction of Ange’s own aims into a restriction on what her furniture existence can do.
sourceReading: お兄ちゃんの側にいられればいいだけの describes being satisfied merely if she can remain by her brother’s side. She fears she may have sunk to furniture with only that aim, rather than the innocent sister praying for his victory. The possibility markers qualify her feared self-change.

units.text: ......But I might be different now. ...I might have been degraded into a witch's furniture, .........that can only be by Onii-chan's side......
units.note: Both restore reduction to merely remaining by Onii-chan side.
units.japanese: …お兄ちゃんの側にいられればいいだけの、………魔女の家具に、成り下がっているのかもしれない……。

description: WH weakens the lethal act attributed to some sisters in the occult message bottle to an unspecified attack, then repeats that weakening in Ange’s hypothetical forgiveness.
sourceReading: 私の家族を手に掛けてさえいる in the cruel sacrificial-ritual and lost-family context means even having killed her family members. The following conditional 私の家族に手を掛けていた maintains that alleged killing while Ange denies belief and distinguishes furniture from the commanding master.

units.text: It's said that they were originally furniture that existed to carry out Beatrice's cruel sacrifice ceremony. ......According to the occult message bottle, which I didn't like, ...it seems that several of them even attacked my family.
units.note: Both retain attacked rather than killed family in the attributed bottle account.
units.japanese: ……私を不快にさせる、オカルトメッセージボトルによるならば、…彼女らの何人かは、私の家族を手に掛けてさえいるらしい。

units.text: It's said that they were originally furniture that existed to carry out Beatrice's cruel sacrifice ceremony. ...According to the occult message bottle I hated, ...it seems that several of them even attacked my family.
units.note: Both retain attacked rather than killed family in the attributed bottle account.
units.japanese: 彼女らは本来は、ベアトリーチェの残酷な生贄の儀式を行なうための家具だったという。……私を不快にさせる、オカルトメッセージボトルによるならば、…彼女らの何人かは、私の家族を手に掛けてさえいるらしい。

units.text: It's said that they were originally furniture that existed to carry out Beatrice's cruel sacrificial ritual. ......If that sickening occult message bottle was to be believed, ...it seemed that several among them even attacked my family.
units.note: Both retain attacked rather than killed family in the attributed bottle account.
units.japanese: 彼女らは本来は、ベアトリーチェの残酷な生贄の儀式を行なうための家具だったという。……私を不快にさせる、オカルトメッセージボトルによるならば、…彼女らの何人かは、私の家族を手に掛けてさえいるらしい。

description: Maria’s reassurance changes whose enjoyment she describes.
sourceReading: さくたろもみんなに会えて喜んでる says Sakutarou too is happy to see everyone, answering concern about the sisters overwhelming him.

units.text: "Ahahahahaha.  Everyone's happy to meet Sakutaro.  ...How's it going, Ange?  How is studying?"
units.note: Both restore Sakutaro happiness at meeting everyone.
units.japanese: 「あははははは。さくたろもみんなに会えて喜んでるよ。

description: WH changes Ange’s appraisal of her current timeline study into a comparison favoring something else.
sourceReading: 年表を頭に入れるだけでも、まぁ、多少はマシかしら means that for now even just getting the timeline into her head should improve things somewhat.

units.text: They were nice enough to pass around printouts from a quiz that another class took earlier.  Their beautiful sense of solidarity is enough to bring tears to my eyes.  ......Well, at least it's probably better than just putting a timeline into my head."
units.note: Both restore appraisal that memorizing the timeline offers some improvement, rather than favoring something else.
units.japanese: ご丁寧にも、他のクラスで先にあった小テストのプリントが回してもらえたの。麗しい連帯感に涙が出るわ。……とりあえず、年表を頭に入れるだけでも、まぁ、多少はマシかしら。」

description: WH assigns the hypothetical learning and future creation to Maria rather than Ange.
sourceReading: もっと私の原初の魔法を学んだなら addresses Ange: if she learns more of Maria’s Magic of Origins, she will be able to create friends to her taste. The next sentence contrasts that prospective capacity with creation still being difficult for Ange now.

units.text: "*giggle*.  If I had learned the Magic of Origins more, I'm sure I would be able to give birth to friends you would like, Ange.  Creation would still be a little too hard for you now."
units.note: Both restore Ange learning and creating desired friends.
units.japanese: 「くす。もっと私の原初の魔法を学んだなら、きっと縁寿の好みの友達を生み出せるようにもなるよ。今の縁寿に創造はまだちょっと難しいね。」

description: WH changes Ange’s desired reassurance about eventual fulfillment into a request for proof of that outcome.
sourceReading: 絶対に叶うという保証を、誰かがくれたなら asks for someone to give a guarantee that her wish will certainly come true. Sakutarou immediately offers to guarantee it, and she thanks him even as consolation; Maria objects to the doubting emotion.

units.text: "If someone gave me some proof that it would definitely be granted, at least that would calm my heart."
units.note: Both retain proof in place of guarantee.

sourceReading: The players choose りゅ from うりゅー. Mammon answers 竜頭, and Leviathan says リュート would be more elegant. The written リュート begins with precisely that disputed sound, making her counterproposal immediately legible in Japanese.

units.text: "I wanted to say it first!  'Lute' would have been wonderful!"
units.note: Both restore ryuuto reading needed for the Japanese word-chain game.
units.japanese: 「私が一番に言いたかったのにぃ！　“リュート”の方が素敵ぃ！」

description: WH describes Mammon as shocked rather than exasperated by the surrounding classmates.
sourceReading: 呆れた表情 conveys appalled/exasperated disbelief at their foolish behavior. Her next remark calls this the same strange school as always and asks why their own good grades are not enough.

units.text: They were surrounding me, twittering like small birds.  They were annoying, smelly. On the outside of that circle was Mammon, a shocked expression on her face...
units.note: MG exasperated restores reaction; UP weary expression conveys weary irritation in context.
units.japanese: その輪の外にマモンがいて、呆れた表情を浮かべている…。

description: WH increases the stated number surrounding Ange’s desk.
sourceReading: 十数人 means a number in the teens, ten and some more, not multiple dozens.

units.text: After school in the classroom, dozens of my classmates crowded around my desk. First, before we started studying... Why were my grades so bad? What was the reason? It was decided that we couldn't start until I could clearly answer those questions, become aware of the problem, and show regret for my actions.
units.note: UP around a dozen preserves low-teens scale; MG dozens does not.
units.japanese: 放課後の教室に、私の席を取り囲むように十数人のクラスメートがいた。

sourceReading: 当然、私は足を遠ざけた explicitly states that she kept her distance from their group seeking to improve the class average. Earlier exclusion explains her choice; the next sentence imagines they would have ignored her if she tried to join.

description: 皆まで言わせないでよ is rendered as “you don’t all have to tell me,” assigning the telling to her companions and reading 皆 as all of them.

I get it already, you don't all have to tell me.  ...You guys can't do anything.  You are nothing more than my delusions, illusions, daydreams...!  I haven't had a single friend from the very beginning.  You are just a phantom, a pretend friend I created in my heart, in my isolation, right?  I've known from the very beginning!!!"

sourceReading: Rosa felt guilty about leaving a child as young as Maria alone and probably knew society would not accept it; this motivates her instructions to avoid adult scrutiny.

units.text: It was probably because Rosa was liable for making such a young girl like Maria watch over the house by herself, and because she knew that this was not something that would be permitted by society. description: Not knowing where the killer lurks becomes not knowing whether a killer is hiding.
sourceReading: どこに潜んでるかわからねぇ concerns location.

units.text: Then, morning came. ......My tension and fatigue mixed together with my drowsiness, making for the worst kind of dawn. Humans are pretty incredible. ......Even though I didn't know whether or not a murderer was hiding somewhere, I prioritized drowsiness and fatigue over worrying for my own life. ......By that time, I was already starting to get pretty ridiculous. For a full six hours before dawn, I had walked around the mansion, yelling at them to show themselves. I had searched diligently, and so tired myself out, letting my guard down. Even so, no one came to attack me. I had been dumbfounded for a while, and had basically figured I'd let them do whatever the hell they wanted.........

Humans are pretty incredible. ......Even though I didn't know where the hell the murderer was hiding, I was prioritizing drowsiness and fatigue over worrying for my own life. ......By this time, I was starting to feel pretty ridiculous. そして、朝が来た。……緊張感と疲労感、そして眠さが入り混じった、最悪の夜明けだった。人間ってすげえもんだ。……殺人犯がどこに潜んでるかわからねぇってのに、自分の命の心配より、眠気と疲れを優先しやがる。……その頃にはもう、何だか馬鹿馬鹿しくなり始めていた。夜が明けるまで、６時間もたっぷり、俺は屋敷を歩き回り、姿を見せやがれと怒鳴って回っていたのだから。丹念に探したし、疲れて隙も晒した。
それでも、誰も襲いかかっては来ない。もう俺は呆れ果て、好きにしやがれとなったわけだ………。
