……うっすらと赤い模様が、紗音が押さえる頬全体に広がっていくのです。その赤い模様は、紗音にとって、堪え難い苦痛を与えているようでした…。頬に当てる手はいつしか爪を立てるほどになり、全身に汗が玉のように浮いていきます…。

description: どのような奇怪な最期を遂げたのか becomes death George and the rest were experiencing.
sourceReading: Seeing the strange pattern, Battler desperately imagines what bizarre end George and the others had previously met and freezes.

units.text: Looking at this bizarre spectacle, ......Battler was petrified as he frantically thought with his pitifully clumsy imagination...about the nature of this strange death George and the rest were experiencing... Eventually, ......that redness reached the nearby Jessica as well......
units.note: MG experiencing retains present-death shift; UP had experienced restores inference concerning earlier deaths.
units.japanese: その奇怪な模様を見て、……戦人は、譲治たちがどのような奇怪な最期を遂げたのか、哀れなほど拙い想像力で必死に考え、立ち竦みます…。
candidates: death George and the rest were experiencing

units.text: Looking at this bizarre spectacle, ...Battler was petrified as he frantically thought with his pitifully clumsy imagination... about the nature of this strange death George and the rest were experiencing... Eventually, ...that redness reached the nearby Jessica as well...
units.note: MG experiencing retains present-death shift; UP had experienced restores inference concerning earlier deaths.
units.japanese: その奇怪な模様を見て、……戦人は、譲治たちがどのような奇怪な最期を遂げたのか、哀れなほど拙い想像力で必死に考え、立ち竦みます…。やがて、……その赤い模様はさらに隣の朱志香にも……。
candidates: death George and the rest were experiencing

description: 身内を疑いたくなかった is rendered did not want to doubt our friends.
sourceReading: Jessica says they did not want to suspect their own family/inner circle, turned away from reality and surrendered to the witch.

units.text: "B, ...Battler......!  We, ......didn't want to doubt our friends...  We refused to face reality, ...and gave in to the witch......!  But, ...Battler, you won't.........won't, ......give in to the witch......!  Geh, ggghh, ......gggggghhkkkkkkk!!!"
units.note: Both friends retain loss of family/own circle in 身内; preceding family-suspicion discussion supplies intended context but does not restore lexical relationship.
units.japanese: ……身内を疑いたくなかった…。現実から目を逸らしたから、

units.text: "Ba‐ Battler...! We... ...didn't want to doubt our friends... We refused to face reality... and gave in to the witch...! But... Battler, you won't... ...won't... give in to the witch...! Geh, ggghh, ...gggggghhkkkkkkk!!!"
units.note: Both friends retain loss of family/own circle in 身内; preceding family-suspicion discussion supplies intended context but does not restore lexical relationship.
units.japanese: 「ば、…戦人……ッ！　私たちは、……身内を疑いたくなかった…。現実から目を逸らしたから、…魔女に屈してしまった……！　でも、…戦人なら…。……戦人なら、……魔女になんか屈しない……！　ひぐッ、ぐかかか、……くかかかかかかかッ！！！」

units.text: "Ba‐ ...Battler......! We... ...didn't want to doubt our friends... We refused to face reality, ...and gave in to the witch......! But... I know you... ......I know you won't... ...give in to that witch......! Geh... ggghh... ......gggggghhkkkkkkk!!!"
units.note: Both friends retain loss of family/own circle in 身内; preceding family-suspicion discussion supplies intended context but does not restore lexical relationship.
units.japanese: 「ば、…戦人……ッ！　私たちは、……身内を疑いたくなかった…。現実から目を逸らしたから、…魔女に屈してしまった……！　でも、…戦人なら…。……戦人なら、……魔女になんか屈しない……！　ひぐッ、ぐかかか、……くかかかかかかかッ！！！」

description: それだけ意味がある取引 becomes the only meaningful transaction.
sourceReading: Though the transaction may seem trivial to Rosa, it has enough significance to Beatrice to justify her offer.

units.text: "It probably isn't that big a thing for you at all.  However, that is the only meaningful transaction as far as I am concerned."
units.note: MG says the bargain is important enough to Beatrice to deserve the reward; UP says that is how significant it is. Neither retains the invented exclusivity.
units.japanese: 「そなたにとってはまったく大したことではないかもしれない。しかし、妾にとってはそれだけ意味がある取引だといういうことだ。」

description: そなたの心の隙間など、顔に書いてある becomes it is written on your face and in the corners of your heart.
sourceReading: Beatrice says the void in Rosa's heart is obvious because it is written on her face.

units.text: "......You don't have to say it out loud.  I can understand it right away, it's written on your face and in the corners of your heart, *cackle*cackle*!"
units.note: MG retains the void as written both on Rosa’s face and in corners of her heart. UP correctly says the cracks in her heart are written on her face.
units.japanese: 「……口にせずとも良い。そなたの心の隙間など、顔に書いてあるからすぐにわかるぞ、くっくっく！」
candidates: written on your face and in the corners of your heart

units.text: "...No need to thank me out loud. I can tell right away. It's written on your face and in the corners of your heart, *cackle*cackle*!"
units.note: MG retains the void as written both on Rosa’s face and in corners of her heart. UP correctly says the cracks in her heart are written on her face.
units.japanese: 「……口にせずとも良い。そなたの心の隙間など、顔に書いてあるからすぐにわかるぞ、くっくっく！」
candidates: written on your face and in the corners of your heart

description: どこまで遡れば癒せるのか becomes How far must the deep wounds in your heart recede before they can be healed.
sourceReading: Beatrice asks how far back she must trace Rosa's deep emotional wounds to heal them, then discovers suffering rooted from birth.

units.text: "How far must the deep wounds in your heart recede before they can be healed?
units.note: MG retains wounds themselves receding. UP correctly asks how far back Beatrice must trace the wounds.
units.japanese: 「そなたの深き心の傷はどこまで遡れば癒せるのか。
candidates: far must the deep wounds in your heart recede before they can be healed

units.text: "How far must the deep wounds in your heart recede before they can be healed?
units.note: MG retains wounds themselves receding. UP correctly asks how far back Beatrice must trace the wounds.
units.japanese: 「そなたの深き心の傷はどこまで遡れば癒せるのか」
candidates: far must the deep wounds in your heart recede before they can be healed

description: 痛みなくして癒しはない is rendered removing the pain is not healing, repeating the preceding distinction rather than its consequence.
sourceReading: Since healing is pleasurable compensation for enduring pain, there is no healing without pain; one must know pain to know healing joy.

units.text: Strictly speaking, it's different. Healing isn't the same thing as removing pain. It's the pleasure earned from withstanding pain. Therefore, removing the pain isn't healing. To know the joy of healing, you have to know the pain.
units.note: MG retains removing pain is not healing, which only repeats the prior distinction. UP correctly states that there can be no healing without pain.
units.japanese: ゆえに、痛みなくして癒しはない。

units.text: Strictly speaking, that's not quite right. Healing isn't the same thing as removing pain. It's the pleasure we earn as compensation for withstanding pain. Therefore, removing the pain isn't healing. To know the joy of healing, you have to know the pain.
units.note: MG retains removing pain is not healing, which only repeats the prior distinction. UP correctly states that there can be no healing without pain.
units.japanese:
厳密には違う。
癒しとは痛みを取り除くことではない。
痛みに耐えた対価として支払われる快楽なのだ。ゆえに、痛みなくして癒しはない。
癒しの悦びを知るには、痛みを知らなくてはならないのだ。

description: そなたの痛みに報いる悦びがいる becomes there is joy as a reward for your pain.
sourceReading: Beatrice concludes that Rosa needs joy to compensate for her pain, then describes qualification for pleasure and its transmission to others.

units.text: "In that case, ......there is joy as a reward for your pain.  You can boast of the suffering in your past.  Because you are qualified to know a kind of pleasure that those who have not known suffering cannot taste.  ...Those that have known this pleasure, cannot help but give the same joy to other people...  *cackle*cackle*..."
units.note: MG changes the sentence but still says Rosa must know joy in order to compensate herself, rather than needing a pleasure that rewards her pain. UP correctly describes joy compensating for pain.
units.japanese: 「となれば、……そなたの痛みに報いる悦びがいる。そなたは苦難の過去を誇っていい。苦難を知らぬ者には味わえぬ快楽を知る資格があるからだ。…この快楽を知る者は、同じ悦びを他者にも与えずにはいられなくなる…。くっくっくっく…。」
candidates: joy as a reward for your pain

units.text: "Which means...you must know joy, in order to compensate you for your pain. You should be proud of your past sufferings. After all, they are what make it possible for you to know pleasure that those without pain will never experience. ...Those who experience this pleasure...cannot help but pass on the same joy to others... *cackle*cackle*..."
units.note: MG changes the sentence but still says Rosa must know joy in order to compensate herself, rather than needing a pleasure that rewards her pain. UP correctly describes joy compensating for pain.
units.japanese: 「となれば、……そなたの痛みに報いる悦びがいる。そなたは苦難の過去を誇っていい。苦難を知らぬ者には味わえぬ快楽を知る資格があるからだ。…この快楽を知る者は、同じ悦びを他者にも与えずにはいられなくなる…。くっくっくっく…」
candidates: know joy, in order to compensate

description: バルブ becomes bulb-like things instead of valve-like fittings; repeated large bulb at the tightening action.
sourceReading: The human-shaped coffin-like press has large valve-like fittings, later tightened by three muscular goat servants.

units.text: As the witch snapped her fingers, a bright red veil that had been set up before something large was removed. ......The solemn and massive machine there was just like a coffin for a large-sized person, with many large bulb-like things stuck to it, and it looked like a sinister torture device. By its unnerving shape, she could tell that with a human's strength, it could tighten and compress something. ...And it seemed that there were still some squeezed dregs remaining, ...because of the bright red remains that stained it.
units.note: Both editions retain bulb-like fittings and bulbs where the source identifies large valve-like fittings that the servants tighten.
units.japanese: 大きな人型棺桶にいくつかの大きなバルブのようなものを取り付け、

units.text: As the witch snapped her fingers, a bright red veil that had been set up before something large was removed. ...The solemn and massive machine there was just like... a coffin for a large-sized person, with many large bulb-like things stuck to it, and it looked like a sinister torture device. By its unnerving shape, she could tell that with a human's strength, it could be used to tighten and compress something. ...And it seemed that there were still some squeezed dregs remaining, ...because of the bright red remains that stained it.
units.note: Both editions retain bulb-like fittings and bulbs where the source identifies large valve-like fittings that the servants tighten.
units.japanese: 魔女が指を鳴らすと、いつの間にか用意されていた大きな何かに掛けられた真っ赤なベールが取り払われました。……そこにあった大型の厳しい機械はまるで大きな人型棺桶にいくつかの大きなバルブのようなものを取り付け、拷問道具のように厳しくしたもの。人力で何かを締め付け、圧搾するのであろうことがわかる、不気味な形状をしていました。…そして、その中にはまだ搾りかすが残っているらしいことが、真っ赤に汚れた残滓でわかりました。

units.text: As the witch snapped her fingers, a bright red veil was pulled off something large which had not been there moments ago. ......The solemn and massive machine there was just like... a coffin for a large‐sized person, with many large bulb‐like things stuck to it, and it looked like a sinister torture device. By its unnerving shape, you could tell that it used manpower to tighten and compress something. ...And it seemed that there were still some squeezed dregs remaining inside, because of the bright red remains that stained it.
units.note: Both editions retain bulb-like fittings and bulbs where the source identifies large valve-like fittings that the servants tighten.
units.japanese: 魔女が指を鳴らすと、いつの間にか用意されていた大きな何かに掛けられた真っ赤なベールが取り払われました。……そこにあった大型の厳しい機械はまるで大きな人型棺桶にいくつかの大きなバルブのようなものを取り付け、拷問道具のように厳しくしたもの。人力で何かを締め付け、圧搾するのであろうことがわかる、不気味な形状をしていました。…そして、その中にはまだ搾りかすが残っているらしいことが、真っ赤に汚れた残滓でわかりました。

description: 二口目はいらぬか is rendered Do you need me to say it in a different way.
sourceReading: Beatrice asks whether Rosa wants a second mouthful, then reminds her of swallowing blood after Krauss struck her; servants next pour more drink despite resistance.

units.text: "Do you need me to say it in a different way?  Have you forgotten the day this man hit you, and you swallowed the blood that ran into your mouth?"
units.note: MG revises the line to putting it a different way but still loses the offer of a second sip. UP correctly asks whether Rosa wants another sip.
units.japanese: 「二口目はいらぬか？　この男に殴られて、口中に滲んだ血を飲み込んだ日を忘れたか？」
candidates: need me to say it in a different way

units.text: "Do you need me to put it a different way? Have you forgotten the day this man hit you, when you swallowed the blood that ran into your mouth?"
units.note: MG revises the line to putting it a different way but still loses the offer of a second sip. UP correctly asks whether Rosa wants another sip.
units.japanese: 「二口目はいらぬか？　この男に殴られて、口中に滲んだ血を飲み込んだ日を忘れたか？」

description: 単なるアペリティフである以上 becomes was not a simple aperitif, reversing the proposition.
sourceReading: Since this ghastly substance is only the aperitif, Rosa inevitably fears the banquet still to follow.

units.text: ......Now that she knew that this ghastly substance wasn't a simple aperitif, Rosa couldn't help but feel uncomfortable about what would happen if this banquet continued.
units.note: MG retains the reversed claim that the substance was not a simple aperitif. UP correctly says that if this was only the aperitif, the coming banquet is alarming.
units.japanese: ……このような不気味なるものが単なるアペリティフである以上、楼座はこの後に続くだろう宴に不安を覚えないわけもありませんでした。

units.text: ...Now that she knew that this ghastly substance wasn't a simple aperitif, Rosa couldn't help but feel uncomfortable about what would happen if this banquet continued.
units.note: MG retains the reversed claim that the substance was not a simple aperitif. UP correctly says that if this was only the aperitif, the coming banquet is alarming.
units.japanese: ……このような不気味なるものが単なるアペリティフである以上、楼座はこの後に続くだろう宴に不安を覚えないわけもありませんでした。

description: 舌はひとりから１枚しか奪えぬ becomes You cannot steal more than one out of one tongue.
sourceReading: Normally only one tongue can be taken from one person; Beatrice claims she can repeatedly take Eva's tongue and use five in the salad.

units.text: "It goes without saying, but I made this salad liberally using five of Eva's tongues.  You can't steal more than one out of one tongue.  But I can steal it over and over.  *cackle*cackle*!!"
units.note: Both editions correctly say only one tongue can be taken from one person and Beatrice can take it repeatedly.
units.japanese: 「言うに及ばず、そのサラダには絵羽の舌を５枚も惜しげなく使っている。舌はひとりから１枚しか奪えぬ。しかし妾なら、何度でも奪える。くっくっくっく！！」
candidates: steal more than one out of one tongue

description: その嘘の顛末 becomes the details of those lies instead of their outcome.
sourceReading: The peppery sting represents what Eva's sweet lies ultimately led to: Rosa being badly scolded after following her instructions.

units.text: Maybe it was quite sweet, soft and enchanting in her mouth. After all, Eva's lies were always sweet, and young Rosa had always listened to them. ...So you could say that the taste of the stimulating pepper seasoning that was added expressed the details of those lies well.
units.note: MG changes details to truth behind the lies but still does not express their outcome. UP retains details of those lies.
units.japanese: …だからピリリと胡椒で刺激的に味付けがしてあるのは、その嘘の顛末をよく味で表現していると言えました。

units.text: It probably would be quite sweet, soft and enchanting in her mouth. After all, Eva's lies were always sweet, and young Rosa had always listened to them. ...And, you might say the stimulating pepper seasoning expressed the truth behind those lies well.
units.note: MG changes details to truth behind the lies but still does not express their outcome. UP retains details of those lies.
units.japanese: それはさぞや口の中で甘く柔らかくとろけるでしょう。だって、絵羽の嘘はいつも甘く、幼い楼座はいつもそれに耳を貸してしまったのですから。…だからピリリと胡椒で刺激的に味付けがしてあるのは、その嘘の顛末をよく味で表現していると言えました。

units.text: How sweet, soft and enchanting it must have tasted in her mouth. After all, Eva's lies were always sweet, and young Rosa had always listened to them. ...So you could say that the taste of the stimulating pepper seasoning that had been added expressed the details of those lies well.
units.note: MG changes details to truth behind the lies but still does not express their outcome. UP retains details of those lies.
units.japanese: それはさぞや口の中で甘く柔らかくとろけるでしょう。だって、絵羽の嘘はいつも甘く、幼い楼座はいつもそれに耳を貸してしまったのですから。…だからピリリと胡椒で刺激的に味付けがしてあるのは、その嘘の顛末をよく味で表現していると言えました。

description: 何日も帰ってこなくても、泣いちゃって、近所の人に慰めてもらってママに恥をかかせた becomes Mama who cried after Maria did not come home for several days and had to be consoled.
sourceReading: When Rosa did not return for days, Maria cried and neighbors comforted Maria, which Maria presents as having embarrassed her mother. This follows Rosa bringing men home and staying away with men.

units.text: ".........After all, Maria always does horrible things to Mama.  Even when Mama brings a man over, Maria can't stay quiet.  When Mama stayed over with a man, Maria got lonely and unruly and made a mess of the room.  When Maria went to search by herself, she got lost, the police picked her up and Mama was shamed.  Mama, who cried after Maria didn't come home for several days, who had to be consoled by the neighbors, was shamed."
units.note: Both editions correctly make Maria cry and receive the neighbors’ consolation when Rosa stays away for days; Rosa is the one embarrassed.
units.japanese: 「………だって、真里亞はいつもママにひどいことばかり。ママが男の人を連れてくる時も静かにできなかった。ママが男の人とお泊まりしてくる時、寂しくて暴れてお部屋を台無しにした。勝手に探しに行って迷子になって警察のお世話になってママに恥をかかせた。何日も帰ってこなくても、泣いちゃって、近所の人に慰めてもらってママに恥をかかせた。」

description: 家具となって魂まで屈服していた becomes surrendered so that even your soul was furniture.
sourceReading: Beatrice says Battler should have become furniture and submitted even to the depths of his soul.

units.text: "Ba........., Battler?!?!  Y, ......you bastard, ...you should have surrendered so that even your soul was furniture!!"
units.note: MG retains surrendered so far that even your soul was furniture. UP separately states that Battler became furniture and submitted down to his soul.
units.japanese: …か、…家具となって魂まで屈服していたはずッ！！」
candidates: surrendered so that even your soul was furniture

units.text: "...B-Battler?!?! ...Y-You bastard, ...I thought you'd surrendered so far that even your soul was furniture!!"
units.note: MG retains surrendered so far that even your soul was furniture. UP separately states that Battler became furniture and submitted down to his soul.
units.japanese: 「ば………、戦人ッ？！？！　き、……貴様ッ、…か、…家具となって魂まで屈服していたはずッ！！」
candidates: surrendered so far that even your soul was furniture

description: 妾を否定してみろ、そしてそれを妾は ... 叩き潰す becomes Try to deny me, I will ... smash you to bits.
sourceReading: Beatrice invites denial and promises to crush that denial completely, then to force repeated submission and teach defeat.

units.text: I wouldn't have you any other way, Battler!!  Try to deny me, I'll completely and thoroughly smash you to bits!  Let me make you surrender over and over again.  I'll teach you, one who has licked my shoes, the taste of defeat over and over again!!"
units.note: Both editions retain smashing Battler himself rather than explicitly crushing his attempted denial.
units.japanese: 妾の期待する右代宮戦人とはそうでなくてはならん！！　妾を否定してみろ、そしてそれを妾は完膚なきまでに叩き潰す！　何度でも屈服させてやろうぞ、一度靴を舐めたそなたに、何度でも敗北の味を教え込んでやるッ！！」

units.text: I wouldn't have you any other way, Battler!! Try to deny me, I'll completely and thoroughly smash you to bits! Let me make you surrender over and over again. I'll teach you, one who has licked my shoes, the taste of defeat over and over again!!"
units.note: Both editions retain smashing Battler himself rather than explicitly crushing his attempted denial.
units.japanese: 「妾の期待する右代宮戦人とはそうでなくてはならん！！　妾を否定してみろ、そしてそれを妾は完膚なきまでに叩き潰す！　何度でも屈服させてやろうぞ、一度靴を舐めたそなたに、何度でも敗北の味を教え込んでやるッ！！」

units.text: "That is exactly what I expect from you, Ushiromiya Battler!! Try to deny me, I'll completely and thoroughly smash you to bits! I will break you over and over again, and I'll teach you, one who has licked my shoes, the taste of defeat over and over!!"
units.note: Both editions retain smashing Battler himself rather than explicitly crushing his attempted denial.
units.japanese: 「妾の期待する右代宮戦人とはそうでなくてはならん！！　妾を否定してみろ、そしてそれを妾は完膚なきまでに叩き潰す！　何度でも屈服させてやろうぞ、一度靴を舐めたそなたに、何度でも敗北の味を教え込んでやるッ！！」

description: 何度かは負けてる becomes I lost many times.
sourceReading: Battler says he has never been invincible and has lost a few/some times, but always rises and settles the fight.

units.text: I've never had the experience of being invincible in a fight.  I lost many times.
units.note: Both editions retain many or loads of losses for Battler’s more limited “a few/some times.”
units.japanese: 俺は喧嘩で無敵だったためしはねぇ。何度かは負けてる。

units.text: I've never been invincible in a fight. I've lost loads of times.
units.note: Both editions retain many or loads of losses for Battler’s more limited “a few/some times.”
units.japanese: 「俺は喧嘩で無敵だったためしはねぇ。何度かは負けてる」

units.text: "I've never had the experience of being invincible in a fight. I've lost many times."
units.note: Both editions retain many or loads of losses for Battler’s more limited “a few/some times.”
units.japanese: 「俺は喧嘩で無敵だったためしはねぇ。何度かは負けてる」

description: 一本取られただけ becomes just because you took a shot at me.
sourceReading: Battler says one point scored against him does not mean he will concede defeat.

units.text: "Don't think I'm out just because you took a shot at me.  Entertain me, Beatriiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiice!!"
units.note: Both editions retain taking a shot at Battler rather than Beatrice scoring one point against him.
units.japanese: 「一本取られただけで俺が参ると思うなよ。楽しませてやるぜ、ベアトリーチェぇえええええええぇッ！！」

units.text: "Don't think I'm out just because you took a shot at me. I'll give you a good show, Beatriiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiice!!"
units.note: Both editions retain taking a shot at Battler rather than Beatrice scoring one point against him.
units.japanese: 「一本取られただけで俺が参ると思うなよ。楽しませてやるぜ、ベアトリーチェぇえええええええぇッ！！」

units.text: "Don't think I'm out just because you took a shot at me. Entertain me, Beatriceeeeeeeeeeeee!!"
units.note: Both editions retain taking a shot at Battler rather than Beatrice scoring one point against him.
units.japanese: 「一本取られただけで俺が参ると思うなよ。楽しませてやるぜ、ベアトリーチェぇえええええええぇッ！！」

description: 楽しませてやるぜ becomes Entertain me.
sourceReading: Battler promises to entertain Beatrice by continuing the fight.

units.text: "Don't think I'm out just because you took a shot at me.  Entertain me, Beatriiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiice!!"
units.note: MG correctly promises to give Beatrice a good show. UP retains the reversed command Entertain me.
units.japanese: 「一本取られただけで俺が参ると思うなよ。楽しませてやるぜ、ベアトリーチェぇえええええええぇッ！！」

units.text: "Don't think I'm out just because you took a shot at me. Entertain me, Beatriceeeeeeeeeeeee!!"
units.note: MG correctly promises to give Beatrice a good show. UP retains the reversed command Entertain me.
units.japanese: 「一本取られただけで俺が参ると思うなよ。楽しませてやるぜ、ベアトリーチェぇえええええええぇッ！！」

description: その子、増長するから程々になさいよ becomes This kid is getting arrogant, so calm her down, replacing advice to moderate playing along with a direct calming instruction.
sourceReading: Bern comments that Beatrice is accommodating, then advises her not to indulge Lambda too much because it will make Lambda conceited.

units.text: "......Nice job playing along with her, Beato.  This kid's getting arrogant, so calm her down.  See you, I'm leaving."
units.note: Both restore moderating Beato’s playing along.
units.japanese: 「……ベアトって付き合いがいいのね。その子、増長するから程々になさいよ。じゃあね、私は席を外すわ。」

description: 次のゲームの準備が整ったら呼ぼうぞ becomes I shall call for some after preparing for the next game.
sourceReading: Beatrice agrees to try the tea suggestion, then promises to call Bernkastel when the next game is ready and tells her to devise strategy until then.

units.text: "Oh, I see.  I shall try it.  I shall call for some after preparing for the next game.  Until then, feel free to polish up your strategy at your leisure."
units.note: MG calls for some, retaining the misplaced supplies referent; UP restores calling Bernkastel.
units.japanese: 「そうか、わかったぞ。試してみよう。次のゲームの準備が整ったら呼ぼうぞ。それまでゆっくり戦略でも練るが良い。」
candidates: shall call for some after preparing for the next game

units.text: "Oh, I see. I shall try it. I'll call for some after preparing the next game. Until then, feel free to polish up your strategy at your leisure."
units.note: MG calls for some, retaining the misplaced supplies referent; UP restores calling Bernkastel.
units.japanese: 「そうか、わかったぞ。試してみよう。次のゲームの準備が整ったら呼ぼうぞ。それまでゆっくり戦略でも練るが良い」

description: ベルンカステルを煙に撒く becomes speaking in riddles for Bernkastel's sake.
sourceReading: Lambda initially thought Beatrice's playful flourishes were strategy because they sometimes bewildered or threw Bernkastel off.

units.text: "What do I mean?  That's what I want to hear.  .........You play a lot in your game.  ...At first, I thought you were speaking in riddles for Bernkastel's sake every now and then, as part of your tactics.
units.note: Both restore confounding Bernkastel rather than speaking for her sake.
units.japanese: 「どういう意味？　私が聞きたいくらいよ。………あんたのゲームには、遊びが多い。…それは時にベルンカステルを煙に撒くから、あんたなりの策略なんだと、私も最初は思ってた。
candidates: speaking in riddles for Bernkastel's sake

description: あんたはゲーム盤である必要なんかない becomes There is no need for this to be a game board for you.
sourceReading: Lambda tells Beatrice that she need not be a game board, only a birdcage imprisoning Bernkastel forever.

units.text: "..................This is why you're useless.  There's no need for this to be a game board for you.  It's alright if this is a bird cage to lock Bernkastel up here for all eternity.
units.note: MG restores Beato as board or cage; UP retains this being a board for you.
units.japanese: 「……………だからアンタは使えないのよ。あんたはゲーム盤である必要なんかない。ベルンカステルを、永遠にここに閉じ込める鳥篭でさえあればいいの。
candidates: need for this to be a game board

units.text: "...............This is why you're useless. There's no need for this to be a game board for you. It simply needs to be a bird cage to lock Bernkastel up here for all eternity."
units.note: MG restores Beato as board or cage; UP retains this being a board for you.
units.japanese: 「……………だからアンタは使えないのよ。あんたはゲーム盤である必要なんかない。ベルンカステルを、永遠にここに閉じ込める鳥篭でさえあればいいの」
candidates: need for this to be a game board

description: 褒めても何も出ぬ becomes what one would call empty praise.
sourceReading: Beatrice dismisses the compliment as flattery and says praising her will not get Bern anything. Bern immediately offers flattery in lieu of lodging payment.

units.text: "Such jests.  ......From your point of view, mine is but a trifling power.  This is most certainly what one would call empty praise."
units.note: MG empty praise loses no benefit for flattery; UP flattery will get you nowhere restores transactional idiom.
units.japanese: 「ご冗談を。……そなたから見れば、こんなのは瑣末な力。褒めても何も出ぬとはまさにこのこと。」

units.text: "You jest. ...From your point of view, mine is but a trifling power. This is most certainly what one would call empty praise."
units.note: MG empty praise loses no benefit for flattery; UP flattery will get you nowhere restores transactional idiom.
units.japanese: 「ご冗談を。……そなたから見れば、こんなのは瑣末な力。褒めても何も出ぬとはまさにこのこと」

description: 全ての目が、貴女の掌を出ない becomes you never let the dice fall from your hand.
sourceReading: Every possible die outcome remains within Beatrice's grasp; none disappoints her, so she is invariably satisfied, unlike Bern wanting a particular outcome.

units.text: "......When I roll the dice, I have a roll I clearly want to get.  Unlike you.  You, on the other hand, never let the dice fall from your hand.  So, whatever the roll might have been, you're never disappointed.  Whatever roll the dice show you, you are satisfied 'without fail'.  .........In that sense, you far surpass me.
units.note: MG literal dice never leaving hand is retained. UP anticipates all outcomes removes literal holding but substitutes foreknowledge for every outcome staying within her grasp; satisfaction follow-up survives.
units.japanese: 「……私は賽を振る時、はっきりと出したい目がある。貴女とは違う。でも貴女にとっては、全ての目が、貴女の掌を出ない。そして、どの目であっても、貴女の期待を裏切らない。サイコロが何の目を見せようとも“必ず”貴女は満足する。………その意味において、貴女は私を遥かに凌駕する。
candidates: never let the dice fall from your hand

units.note: MG literal dice never leaving hand is retained. UP anticipates all outcomes removes literal holding but substitutes foreknowledge for every outcome staying within her grasp; satisfaction follow-up survives.

「そして、どの目であっても、貴女の期待を裏切らない。サイコロが何の目を見せようとも“必ず”貴女は満足する。………その意味において、貴女は私を遥かに凌駕する」

units.note: MG literal dice never leaving hand is retained. UP anticipates all outcomes removes literal holding but substitutes foreknowledge for every outcome staying within her grasp; satisfaction follow-up survives.

description: 貴方が ... エールを送っても届かないのに似てる compares Bern empathy without assistance to the reader's familiar experience cheering at television. English You are much like someone ... turns the reader into the analogous ineffective spectator.
sourceReading: Bern empathizes but does not help, like when you cheer for people on television yet cannot reach them; the television-viewer role illustrates Bern's own relation to the addressed person.

units.text: ......Don't get the wrong idea.  I have no intention of becoming your ally. I do feel empathy for you, but I won't help you. ...You're much like someone sitting in front of the television, yelling at the people on the other side even though your voice won't reach them.
units.note: MG correctly analogizes Bern herself to TV spectator; UP generic someone cannot reach screen characters preserves empathetic spectator relation without incorrectly assigning reader spectator status.
units.japanese: …貴方が、テレビの前でその向こうの人物にいくらエールを送っても届かないのに似てるわ。

description: そなたが妾と逆の目に張っているとお伝えしたら becomes After informing me that you were betting against me.
sourceReading: Beatrice tells Bern that after she informed Lambda of Bern betting against her, Lambda said she would bet against Bern.

units.text: After informing me that you were betting against me, she said that she would bet against you."
units.note: MG retains the malformed perspective in After informing me that you were betting against me. UP correctly makes Beatrice the one who informed Lambdadelta.
units.japanese: そなたが妾と逆の目に張っているとお伝えしたら、卿はそなたの逆の目に張ると仰せになられた。」
candidates: After informing me that you were betting against

units.text: After informing me that you were betting against me, she said that she would bet against you."
units.note: MG retains the malformed perspective in After informing me that you were betting against me. UP correctly makes Beatrice the one who informed Lambdadelta.
units.japanese: 「そなたが妾と逆の目に張っているとお伝えしたら、卿はそなたの逆の目に張ると仰せになられた」
candidates: After informing me that you were betting against

description: どういう勝敗になろうとも becomes No matter what issue we fight over.
sourceReading: Bern says their battle will be meaningful regardless of how victory and defeat turn out.

units.text: "............I'll be counting on you, Lambda.  And Beato. ...No matter what issue we fight over, this will be a very significant battle for us."
units.note: MG retains no matter what we fight over and changes battle outcome into subject matter. UP correctly says no matter who wins or loses.
units.japanese: 「…………こちらこそよろしくよ、ラムダ。そしてベアト。…どういう勝敗になろうとも、これは私たちにとってとても有意義な戦いになるわね。」

units.text: "......I'll be counting on you, Lambda. And you, Beato. ...No matter what we fight over, this will be a very significant battle for us all."
units.note: MG retains no matter what we fight over and changes battle outcome into subject matter. UP correctly says no matter who wins or loses.
units.japanese: 「…………こちらこそよろしくよ、ラムダ。そしてベアト。…どういう勝敗になろうとも、これは私たちにとってとても有意義な戦いになるわね」

description: 私たちには勝敗以上に意義がある becomes who wins and who loses will be important.
sourceReading: Lambda does not intend to lose, but agrees that the battle has significance beyond victory or defeat; Beatrice then identifies their shared hatred of boredom.

units.text: "That's right.  Of course, I don't feel like losing, but who wins and who loses will be important."
units.note: MG says they have a goal beyond victory; UP says the battle matters beyond victory. Neither retains the claim that who wins and loses is itself important.
units.japanese: 「そうね。もちろん負ける気はないけど、私たちには勝敗以上に意義がある。」
candidates: wins and who loses will be important

description: 困ったことに is rendered Since when we are in trouble, making inference from moves dependent on being in trouble.
sourceReading: Unfortunately for them, since they are trying to infer the opponent's strategy from her moves, intentionally suboptimal moves constitute formidable informational noise.

units.text: Since when we are in trouble, we try to seek out our opponent's strategy by looking at their moves, this creates a very formidable amount of noise in our information. This could cause a troublesome amount of disorder.
units.note: MG retains the conditional framing; UP restores “This is unfortunate for us,” as an evaluation of the situation.
units.japanese: 困ったことに、相手の指し手から手の内を探ろうとしている私たちにとって、これは非常に手ごわい情報のノイズ。
candidates: Since when we are in trouble

units.text: Since, when we're in trouble, we try to seek out our opponent's strategy by looking at their moves, this creates a very formidable amount of noise in our information. That might cause a troublesome amount of disorder.
units.note: MG retains the conditional framing; UP restores “This is unfortunate for us,” as an evaluation of the situation.
units.japanese: 困ったことに、相手の指し手から手の内を探ろうとしている私たちにとって、これは非常に手ごわい情報のノイズ。厄介な撹乱になりうるわ。

description: 付け込ませたいかのように隙がある becomes One that makes me want to take advantage of it.
sourceReading: There is an opening as though Beatrice wants to let them exploit it. Bern does not know whether it is a trap or a test.

units.text: Although you may not be able to believe it, this game was also like that. ......Even though those developments looked so overpowering, ...there actually was a weak point. One that makes me want to take advantage of it. ......Even though I don't know if it's a trap or if she's testing us.
units.note: Both editions say the gap makes the listener want to exploit it, rather than making Beatrice want exploitation.
units.japanese: 付け込ませたいかのように隙がある。

description: 魔女の戦いは守りが肝心よ becomes What is the most important element in defense during a witch's battle.
sourceReading: Bern states that defense is crucial in a witches' battle, then advises avoiding defeat rather than pursuing victory.

units.text: What's the most important element in defense during a witch's battle? Rather than trying to win, try not to lose. ...If you lose when you accept her, then you definitely must not accept her. ......Making you accept witches. There is no longer any doubt that this is one of Beatrice's victory conditions.
units.note: MG retains the question about what matters in defense; UP states that defense itself is crucial.
units.japanese: 魔女の戦いは守りが肝心よ？
candidates: most important element in defense during a witch's battle

units.text: What's the most important element in defense during a witch's battle? Rather than trying to win, try not to lose. ...If accepting her means your defeat, then you definitely mustn't accept her. ...Making you accept witches. There is no longer any doubt that this is one of Beatrice's victory conditions.
units.note: MG retains the question about what matters in defense; UP states that defense itself is crucial.
units.japanese: 魔女の戦いは守りが肝心よ？勝とうとするより、負けないようにしなさい。…認めたら負けなら、断じて認めては駄目。……あなたに魔女を認めさせること。これがベアトリーチェの勝利条件のひとつであることはもはや、疑いようもないのだから。
candidates: most important element in defense during a witch's battle

description: あの子 ... 負けず嫌い becomes I would really hate that girl even if I did not lose; predicted present teeth-grinding/tears becomes I will make her do those things.
sourceReading: Lambda says Bern is intensely averse to losing and imagines she is now grinding her teeth and crying in frustration.

units.text: Because of that, I won't be able to rest until I see Bern's speechless face. Because of that, and because someone like you is Bern's piece, I'm feeling just great! And also, I'd really hate that girl even if I didn't lose, so I'll definitely make her grind her teeth in regret, crying like a baby, she's so lame, *giggle*, hoh-hoh-hoh-hoh-hoh-ho!
units.note: Both editions restore Bernkastel as the sore loser and make her present reaction a prediction. The separate loss of ざまぁ is registered under WH-EP02-HIDDEN-015.
units.japanese: しかもあの子はあれでいて本当に負けず嫌いだから、きっと今頃悔しくって歯軋りをして涙をぽろぽろ流してるわよ、本当にざまぁないわよ、くすくす、ほーっほっほっほっほっほ！

description: 勝率を ... 絶対に近付けてやる becomes will associate myself just a tiny bit with you and your hopeless chances at winning.
sourceReading: Lambda promises to move the reader's hopeless win probability a little closer to certainty through her power.

units.text: You're so pathetic, I'll help you just a little bit. I, the great Lady Lambdadelta, the Witch of Certainty and the strongest in the universe, will associate myself just a tiny bit with you and your hopeless chances at winning.  You should thank me.
units.note: MG retains association with hopeless chances; UP restores moving the listener’s chances closer to certainty.
units.japanese: この宇宙最強で絶対の魔女である大ラムダデルタ卿が、あんたの絶望的な勝率を、ほんのちょっぴりだけ絶対に近付けてやるわ。感謝なさい。
candidates: associate myself just a tiny bit with you and your hopeless chances at winning

units.text: You're so pathetic, I'll help you just a little bit. I, the great Lady Lambdadelta, the Witch of Certainty and the strongest in the universe, will associate myself just a tiny bit with you and your hopeless chances at winning. You should thank me.
units.note: MG retains association with hopeless chances; UP restores moving the listener’s chances closer to certainty.
units.japanese: あんまり情けないから、ちょっとだけ力を貸してあげるわ。この宇宙最強で絶対の魔女である大ラムダデルタ卿が、あんたの絶望的な勝率を、ほんのちょっぴりだけ絶対に近付けてやるわ。感謝なさい。
candidates: associate myself just a tiny bit with you and your hopeless chances at winning

description: 勝ちが見えると遊び出す becomes playing around by making it look like she has won.
sourceReading: Beatrice starts playing around once she sees victory ahead, instead of completing checkmate.

units.text: While that kid will frame the board so that she can win with just a few more moves, she will intentionally not corner you. She'll do things like take worthless pieces and place excess pieces on the board to make things one-sided. In short, you could say she has the bad habit of playing around by making it look like she's won.
units.note: Both editions restore imminent victory as the trigger for Beatrice’s wasteful play.
units.japanese: 早い話が、勝ちが見えると遊び出す悪い癖があるってわけ。
candidates: playing around by making it look like

description: そうだと言われなければ、信じられないくらい becomes Even if someone told you that was so, she was unbelievably aged and worn out, reversing the identifying-information condition.
sourceReading: Eva has aged and wasted away so much that one would not believe the person is Eva unless told so.

units.text: Was the person on the bed, ............Eva? Even if someone told you that was so, she was unbelievably aged and worn out.
units.note: MG retains the reversed identification condition; UP restores unless told.
units.japanese: そうだと言われなければ、信じられないくらいに彼女は老け込み、やつれていた。
candidates: someone told you that was so, she was unbelievably aged and worn

units.text: Was the person on the bed... ...Eva? Even if someone told you that was so, she was unbelievably aged and worn out.
units.note: MG retains the reversed identification condition; UP restores unless told.
units.japanese: ベッドの上にいるのは、…………絵羽なのだろうか。そうだと言われなければ、信じられないくらいに彼女は老け込み、やつれていた。
candidates: someone told you that was so, she was unbelievably aged and worn

description: 猜疑心の強い is rendered extremely jealous, recurring for paranoia about assassination and aftermath of failed cult relief.
sourceReading: Eva is cunning and highly suspicious; distrust supports guarded wealth, assassination beliefs and increased distrust after cult approaches.

units.text: All of the Ushiromiya family's massive fortune had come into the possession of Ushiromiya Eva. ...It was said that this fortune also included the 10 tons of hidden gold that Ushiromiya Kinzo was rumored to have hidden. It couldn't be helped that this vast wealth would fall into the cunning, sly, and extremely jealous Eva's hands, ......but it was rumored that if it passed on to Ange, who was no more than a young girl, certain people were plotting to snatch it away at once.
units.note: Both restore suspicion and paranoia at the two occurrences.
units.japanese: その莫大な財産は、老獪で狡猾で猜疑心の強い絵羽の手元にあってはどうしようもないが、……小娘に過ぎない縁寿に相続されれば、自在に掠め取れるのではないかと目論む者たちがいると噂される。

units.text: All of the Ushiromiya family's massive fortune had come into the possession of Ushiromiya Eva. ...It was said that this fortune also included the 10 tons of hidden gold that Ushiromiya Kinzo was rumored to have hidden. It couldn't be helped that this vast wealth would fall into the cunning, sly, and extremely jealous Eva's hands, ......but it was rumored that if it passed on to Ange, who was no more than a young girl, certain people were plotting to snatch it away at once.
units.note: Third recurrence also restores paranoia or suspicion.
units.japanese: その莫大な財産は、老獪で狡猾で猜疑心の強い絵羽の手元にあってはどうしようもないが、……小娘に過ぎない縁寿に相続されれば、自在に掠め取れるのではないかと目論む者たちがいると噂される。

description: 財産 ... 絵羽の手元にあってはどうしようもない becomes It could not be helped that this vast wealth would fall into Eva hands.
sourceReading: Predators can do nothing with the fortune while shrewd Eva controls it, but hope they can freely skim it once young Ange inherits.

units.text: All of the Ushiromiya family's massive fortune had come into the possession of Ushiromiya Eva. ...It was said that this fortune also included the 10 tons of hidden gold that Ushiromiya Kinzo was rumored to have hidden. It couldn't be helped that this vast wealth would fall into the cunning, sly, and extremely jealous Eva's hands, ......but it was rumored that if it passed on to Ange, who was no more than a young girl, certain people were plotting to snatch it away at once.
units.note: MG substitutes inability to complain for inability to obtain the fortune; UP restores inability to act against Eva’s hold.

candidates: helped that this vast wealth would fall

units.text: All of the Ushiromiya family's massive fortune had come into the possession of Ushiromiya Eva. ...It was said that this fortune also included the 10 tons of hidden gold that Ushiromiya Kinzo was rumored to have hidden. While this vast wealth lay in Eva's cunning, sly, and suspicious hands, no one was able to complain, ...but it was rumored that as soon as it was passed on to Ange, who was no more than a young girl, certain people were plotting to snatch it away.
units.note: MG substitutes inability to complain for inability to obtain the fortune; UP restores inability to act against Eva’s hold.
units.japanese: 右代宮家の莫大な財産は、その全てが右代宮絵羽によって占有されている。…その財産には、かの右代宮金蔵が隠し持っていたと囁かれる、１０ｔの隠し黄金も含むと言われていた。その莫大な財産は、老獪で狡猾で猜疑心の強い絵羽の手元にあってはどうしようもないが、……小娘に過ぎない縁寿に相続されれば、自在に掠め取れるのではないかと目論む者たちがいると噂される。

description: 教祖たちをずいぶん招き入れた becomes searched for the founders.
sourceReading: Eva invited numerous leaders of strange new religions into her circle, perhaps seeking peace, but they failed to relieve her.

units.text: For a time, Eva had searched for the founders of several strange and new religious cults, perhaps looking for peace in her heart. ...But in the end, they did not give her heart any relief, and only further increased her jealousy...
units.note: MG searches for cult founders; UP restores inviting them in.
units.japanese: 絵羽は一時期、心の安寧を求めたのか、おかしな新興宗教の教祖たちをずいぶん招き入れた。

units.text: For a time, Eva had searched for the founders of several strange and new religious cults, perhaps seeking peace in her heart. ...But they gave her heart no relief, and if anything, they ended up increasing her paranoia further...
units.note: MG searches for cult founders; UP restores inviting them in.
units.japanese: 絵羽は一時期、心の安寧を求めたのか、おかしな新興宗教の教祖たちをずいぶん招き入れた。…だが結局、彼らは彼女の心に救いを与えられず、むしろ猜疑心をさらに肥大させる結果となった…。

description: わかんないわ。馬鹿だから becomes I do not get it. Because it is stupid.
sourceReading: Ange says she does not understand because she is stupid, sarcastically echoing the contemptuous family framing.

units.text: "Not only that, ......I decided that until the very day that I die, ...I'll increase that fortune as much as I can, inflate it to massive proportions and have you inherit all of it.  ...*cackle*cackle*, can you even imagine what that would be like...?" "......I don't get it.  Because it's stupid."
units.note: MG calls it stupid; UP restores the speaker’s self-description.
units.japanese: 「……わかんないわ。馬鹿だから。」

units.text: "...I don't get it. Because it's stupid."
units.note: MG calls it stupid; UP restores the speaker’s self-description.
units.japanese: 「……わかんないわ。馬鹿だから」

description: 自分はここから一歩も動いていない becomes she would not move a step from where she was.
sourceReading: Ange silently signals that she has not moved, preempting any accusation she caused Eva's coughing or death.

units.text: Perhaps because he found the violent coughing odd, as he gave a short knock on the door, the guard flew in. Ange glanced at him, wordlessly showing that she wouldn't move a step from where she was. ......Ange was prepared for some kind of trap to frame her in Eva's death. However, that was fortunately a needless anxiety.
units.note: MG gives future intention not to move; UP restores not having moved.
units.japanese: 縁寿はじろりとそれを見て、無言で、自分はここから一歩も動いていないとアピールする。

units.text: Perhaps because he found the violent coughing suspicious, the guard gave a short knock on the door and rushed in at the same time. Ange glanced at him, wordlessly making it clear that she didn't intend to move a step from where she was. ...Ange was prepared for some kind of trap to frame her in Eva's death.
units.note: MG gives future intention not to move; UP restores not having moved.
units.japanese: 咳き込む声に不審を感じたのか、短いノックと同時に護衛が飛び込んできた。縁寿はじろりとそれを見て、無言で、自分はここから一歩も動いていないとアピールする。……自分に、絵羽殺しの濡れ衣を着せるための、何かの罠さえ縁寿は覚悟していた。

description: 誰にも心を許さず ... 誰も愛さず becomes No one trusted her ... No one loved her, with added so causal links.
sourceReading: Ange lets nobody into her heart, refuses to trust, loves nobody and refuses to try loving, after her environment has shaped her.

units.text: The environment makes the person. By now, she had a heart as wild as those around her feared. ...No one trusted her, so she didn't even try to believe them. No one loved her, so she didn't even try to love.
units.note: MG reverses who trusts and loves whom and adds causal links; UP restores Ange’s agency.
units.japanese:
…誰にも心を許さず、信じようとしない。
誰も愛さず、愛そうとしない。

units.text: The environment makes the person. By now, she had a heart as wild as those around her feared. ...No one trusted her, so she never bothered to believe in anyone. No one loved her, so she never even tried to love.
units.note: MG reverses who trusts and loves whom and adds causal links; UP restores Ange’s agency.
units.japanese:
環境が、人を作る。
今や彼女は、周囲が恐れる通りの荒んだ心を持っている。…誰にも心を許さず、信じようとしない。
誰も愛さず、愛そうとしない。

description: 魔女の娘は魔女 becomes the witch girl was a witch, losing the daughter relation.
sourceReading: Everyone says the witch's daughter is a witch, extending Eva's public stigma to her ward as a daughter.

units.text: And on top of all of this, when Eva had caught an incurable illness, it was whispered that this too was a conspiracy, and this time, Ange was set up as the mastermind... Everyone whispered that the witch girl was a witch. Even the talk shows and the weekly magazines whispered that. ...So Ange also, definitely, no, as though it might as well be true, accepted it.
units.note: Both restore the witch’s daughter relation.
units.japanese: 魔女の娘は魔女だと、誰もが囁く。

description: 思えてならない becomes could not really imagine, reversing the affirmative irresistible feeling.
sourceReading: Ange cannot help feeling that precisely within the unseen starlight lies what she truly seeks.

units.text: ...Ange couldn't really imagine that the thing she really sought could be in that unseen starlight. The world of reality below her looked so far away from here. ...She could imagine that this place was the closest to the world she really should be in.
units.note: Both restore the irresistible affirmative feeling about unseen starlight.
units.japanese: …縁寿には、その見えない星明りの中にこそ、自分が本当に求めるものがあるように思えてならない。

description: 戦人兄さんの ... その手に ... 届きそうなのに makes his hand the target of her reach, but English that hand will reach me reverses the direction, repeated at his hand never reached me.
sourceReading: She nearly reaches the hand of Battler who used to lovingly pat her, but cannot; each recurrence of the dream makes her stretch her own hand more forcefully.

units.text: ...She repeated this thought over and over, ...and dreamed about her family. Myself as I was 12 years ago calls out frantically, urging them not to go to the family conference. But both Dad and Mom are too far away, and my hand won't reach them. Battler nii-san has always really loved me, and his hand always pats my head, .........but even though it looks like that hand will reach me, even it does not reach. For some reason, I started having that dream over and over again.
units.note: UP restores Ange reaching at315–316 but still reverses the direction at322; MG retains both reversals.
units.japanese:
私のことを、とても可愛がってくれた戦人兄さんの、私を撫でてくれるその手に、
………あとちょっとで届きそうなのに、それさえも届かない。

units.text: ...Lately, ...she'd been dreaming about her family over and over again. The person I was 12 years ago calls out frantically, urging them not to go to the family conference. But both Dad and Mom are too far away, and my hand won't reach them. Battler nii-san always loved me a lot, and he'd always pat my head, ......but even though it looks like that hand's about to touch me, even it does not reach. For some reason, I started having that dream over and over.
units.note: UP restores Ange reaching at315–316 but still reverses the direction at322; MG retains both reversals.
units.japanese: …このところ、繰り返し繰り返し、…家族の夢を見るのだ。１２年前の私が、必死に呼び掛けて、親族会議に行かないようにと訴えるのだ。しかし、お父さんにもお母さんにも、遠くて手が届かない。私のことを、とても可愛がってくれた戦人兄さんの、私を撫でてくれるその手に、………あとちょっとで届きそうなのに、それさえも届かない。そんな夢を、なぜか繰り返し見るようになっていた。

units.text: ...Recently, ...I've been having a dream about my family, over and over again. My self of twelve years ago calls out frantically, urging them not to go to the family conference. But both Mom and Dad are too far away, and my hand won't reach them. I reach for the hand of Battler nii‐san, who always really loved me—for the hand that would always pat my head— .........but even though it looks like it's so close to reaching, even that falls short. For some reason, I started having that dream over and over again.
units.note: UP restores Ange reaching at315–316 but still reverses the direction at322; MG retains both reversals.
units.japanese: …このところ、繰り返し繰り返し、…家族の夢を見るのだ。１２年前の私が、必死に呼び掛けて、親族会議に行かないようにと訴えるのだ。しかし、お父さんにもお母さんにも、遠くて手が届かない。私のことを、とても可愛がってくれた戦人兄さんの、私を撫でてくれるその手に、………あとちょっとで届きそうなのに、それさえも届かない。そんな夢を、なぜか繰り返し見るようになっていた。

description: 享受できる可能性の中で ... 探して持ってくる becomes if it is possible for you to receive it ... search for the happiest resolution.
sourceReading: Bern promises to find and bring the happiest ending among possibilities available to Ange. Earlier warnings exclude guaranteeing the specific family-return wish.

units.text: ".........I'm giving you a chance for revenge.  In exchange, if it is possible for you to receive it, I promise to search for the happiest resolution for you."
units.note: Both restore searching and bringing the happiest outcome within available possibilities.
units.japanese: 「………あなたに、復讐のチャンスを。…見返りに、あなたが享受できる可能性の中で、もっとも幸せな結末を探して持ってくることを約束するわ。」

description: 可能性の数値は、結果の前に無力 becomes Trying to read any probabilities before the result is useless.
sourceReading: Numerical possibilities are powerless in the face of the actual outcome, so Bern cannot give Ange a numerical probability.

units.text: "......Trying to read any probabilities before the result is useless.  So I cannot tell you that number."
units.note: MG retains temporal before the result; UP restores numerical probabilities powerless in the face of the result.
units.japanese: 「……あらゆる可能性の数値は、結果の前に無力よ。だからその数字を、私には語ることができない。」

sourceReading: 惣菜パンとしてなら imagines the curry-potato snack as savory filled bread, a familiar category children might like.

units.text: Apparently Natsuhi, not realizing that it had a curry-like spicy flavor, had started choking after putting it in her mouth. To describe it in Japanese terms, it was like fried dumplings stuffed with mashed, curry-flavored potatoes. As a household dish, it would probably be pretty popular with the kids. However, it was something of a shock to Natsuhi, who expected that a treat to go with tea would be something sweet.

sourceReading: 勝ち馬には放って置いても means investors gather around a winning horse even when left alone. The winning prospect explains the self-reinforcing influx of funds.

sourceReading: Krauss depends on trust and financial strength. If both are shaken, nothing remains. Disappearance sacrifices one support, risking collapse without asserting inevitable loss of everything.

units.text: ......Krauss's existence was based solely upon the trust and power of his assets as a financial fixer. If either of those weakened, nothing would remain. It was probably better than losing your neck, but you still might die from the blood loss, and even on the off-chance that you did survive, you would have to bear a heavy wound that wouldn't heal for the rest of your life......

description: Protecting Kinzo silence becomes keeping things quiet for him.
sourceReading: Natsuhi insists on preserving Kinzo’s nonresponse even during the emergency.

units.text: The atmosphere, which had been so agitated a second ago, suddenly went cold......and an eerie feeling filled the room as everyone stared at Natsuhi. ......They could understand why Natsuhi would protect the study under normal circumstances. It was understood that she probably didn't want to disturb the research of Kinzo, whom she respected, and she was therefore trying to keep the unpleasant relatives away. However, ......this was an extraordinary situation. A murder had occurred. Natsuhi's persistence in keeping things quiet for Kinzo even in a situation like this...was hard to understand using common sense.

description: Greatest serial-murder mysteries become longest mysteries.
sourceReading: Erika compares death totals against the world and Japanese serial-murder records, calling these the highest/greatest examples.

units.text: "Non non.  You've got it all wrong.  .........As far as I know, the mystery novel with the most dead people in a serial murder was 'And then there were none' by Agatha Christie, which had 10 deaths.  In the realm of Japanese mysteries, it's probably 'The Tokyo Zodiac Murders' by Shimada Souji.  Though there were less than 10 deaths in that one." "......Did you know?  If 13 people die at this rate, it will lead to the most infamous and famous development in the history of the mystery genre, the completion of a 13 person serial murder case, get it?  And if everyone on this island is killed......that would make it a historical achievement in the world of serial murder mysteries, with even more deaths than the longest murder mystery in the world and the longest one in Japan put together, don't you see?!  ......Hey, didn't you know?  Everyone?"

Beato might have been a fearsome witch, but blood flowed through her veins and she did breathe. She felt both pain and fatigue. But Dlanor......was like a doll made of marble. She felt no fatigue, no pain, no hesitation. Even if Beato's sharp wedges had aimed right for Dlanor's eyes, she wouldn't have shut them. ......No, it's doubtful that she ever even blinks in the first place......

description: WH reverses the demon knowledge restriction in Beatrice hiding-place hypothesis.
sourceReading: Kinzo might be hiding in an unobtrusive blind spot which even demons cannot know:悪魔さえ知り得ない.

units.text: "Even if, as you say, this is a closed room and impossible to escape from, you can't deny the possibility that he is still hiding in this room.  I'm not talking about a hidden door!  He might be under the bed or above the ceiling!  He might be hiding in a truly unobtrusive blind spot that only demons could know of, right?!" "Or, it might be that Natsuhi, who was ordered to speak specially on Kinzo's behalf, considered herself both his representative and another Kinzo!  In other words, it's possible that Natsuhi was also Kinzo!" "I've got plenty more!!  At 23:00 last night, Kinzo escaped out the window!  Natsuhi watched him go, then locked the window!!  This doesn't lead to any problems.  In fact, it might be the most beautiful blue truth yet!  How's that?!  Dlanor A. Knox?!  Hyahhahahahaaaaahhhh!!  There are many ways to escape from this closed room!!"

description: Established supreme witch reputation becomes ambition.

units.text: Beato struggled to her feet......but that was the best she could do. She no longer had the energy to fight. She had taken all of the denying red head on from close range. It was all she could do to withstand a pain so strong it felt like she'd vomit up all her insides... Even Beato, who had aimed for the title of strongest and most evil witch all this time, ......couldn't do a thing against a witch hunter. No matter how sturdy a sandcastle you build on the beach, it can never win against the rising tide......

description: Erika ugly smile becomes an unspecified hideous expression.
sourceReading: Erika endures humiliation while forcing or wearing an ugly smile at the back of her ignoring master.

units.text: As the two witches giggled, they continued discussing the letter and the knock. There was no room for Erika to step in. If she contented herself with that, ......she would literally have no place to go, ......and would be buried in an eternal oblivion. Erika endured with a hideous expression, looking with shame at the back of the master who was ignoring her. And with both fists clenched, she thought frantically for some kind of breakthrough. I am the detective, I am Furudo Erika. I am the piece and double and servant of the great Lady Bernkastel...!! I'll definitely make her satisfied... satisfied... definitely, definitely, gah, ggghggghhhhhh, ......Ushiromiya Battler... ...how dare you... ...humiliate me so............ As she stood there, ignored by the witches and shrouded in darkness, it looked like someone had told her to go stand all alone in the hallway...

description: Landing without a waist impact becomes landing on his feet.
sourceReading: Battler slips from considerable height, lands successfully and avoids hitting his waist/lower back. The source does not specify that he lands on his feet.

units.text: When he escaped to the courtyard through the window... Battler really did use the rain gutter to crawl down the wall, just like Erika said. His hand had slipped halfway, and he had fallen from a considerable height, but he had managed to land on his feet. ......No one had witnessed this, but most likely, everyone in the dining hall now except Erika had realized that something like this had happened. Since the very beginning, no one had believed that he'd jumped down from the third floor window. ......Even if they hadn't witnessed that directly. So they had no clue what Erika was complaining about all of a sudden and started to whisper, staring at her with cold eyes and dubious faces......

description: Farther inside the room becomes its center.
sourceReading: Natsuhi hears clunking from deeper within the room beyond the closet near the entrance. 奥の方 describes depth from that entrance, not the geometric center.

units.text: .........Don't tell me... ...Hideyoshi-san... ...is the mastermind...?!  Or else, an accomplice...?! Is he planning to do something to me in this room...? It would take some time to unlock the door from this side, much less to remove the chain. ......If Hideyoshi-san doesn't intend to let me escape from here, he won't give me enough time to undo the chain... In that case........., ......if he opens the closet door......and sees me crouching here pathetically... ...just what kind of fearsome words will he say...? I don't want to be found, I don't want to be found... I beg you, pass right on by the closet door... Please keep going into the center of the room......! My head was so filled with a throbbing sound that it felt like it was about to explode, and I almost missed hearing his noisy footsteps. So when I heard a clunking sound coming from the center of the room, I finally realized that he'd passed by the closet, and was deeply relieved.

units.japanese:
………まさか、…秀吉さんが、……黒幕…？！
あるいは、その一味…？！私にこの部屋で危害を加えるつもりだろうか…？こちら側からの施錠とはいえ、チェーンロックを外すのに手間取る。……もし秀吉さんが私を逃すつもりがないのなら、私がもたもたとチェーンを外す時間を与えるわけがない…。ならば………、……今にもこのクローゼットをがばっと開き、……みすぼらしく座り込んだ私を見下ろし、……一体、どんな恐ろしい言葉を投げかけてくるというのか…。見つかりたくない見つかりたくない…。
お願いだからクローゼットの前をそのまま通り過ぎて…。
どうかそのまま奥へ行って……！彼の賑やかな足音を聞き逃すくらいに、頭の中は爆発しそうな鼓動音でいっぱいだった。だから、ガタンガタンという音が、部屋の奥の方から聞こえてきた時、彼がクローゼットの前を無事に通り過ぎたものだと知り、深く安堵した。

units.text:
.........Don't tell me... ...Hideyoshi‐san... ...is the mastermind...?!
Or else, an accomplice...?! Is he planning to do something to me in this room...? The door may only be locked from the inside, but it will still take some time to remove the chain. ......If Hideyoshi‐san doesn't intend to let me escape from here, there's no chance he'll give me time to fumble around with the chain... In that case......... ......when he opens the closet door wide in just a moment... ...and looks down upon me sitting here pathetically, ......just what kind of horrifying words will he say...? I don't want to be found, I don't want to be found...
I beg you, pass right on by the closet door...
Please keep going into the center of the room......! My head was filled almost to bursting with a throbbing sound so loud that I almost missed hearing his noisy footsteps. So when I heard a clunking sound coming from the center of the room, I finally realized that he'd passed by the closet, and was deeply relieved.

description: WH introduces holders of truth in the past and future where the Japanese describes the formation times of the truths themselves.
sourceReading: 真実は、未来に生まれたものが、過去に生まれたものを飲み込む says that, among truths, one born later swallows one born earlier.

units.text: .........Now that Natsuhi and Beatrice had practically been placed on the guillotine, ......they cried out with all the strength of their determination... However, that did nothing except bring a cold smile to Lambdadelta's face. Erika had constructed a truth that Lambdadelta could accept. ......And no one could construct a more convincing truth to deny Erika's. In that case, the most convincing truth would swallow up everything else......and become the one and only 'truth'. Even if it happened to be different from the real truth. The truth of those in the past is swallowed up by the truth of those in the future. ......This can happen even for a mixture of truth and lies. As long as everyone acknowledges it as true...!

The true Kinzo... ...never once trusted Natsuhi during his entire life. The true Kinzo... ......never once thought about allowing Natsuhi to bear the One-winged Eagle. ......Because, of course... ...Kinzo had already vanished before the start of the game. units.text: I get it.  ......Dlanor is offering me a helping hand. If she hadn't jumped in here, it'd all be over. And now, I fully understand how I'm supposed to fight. But because I understand how, ......I am unable to fight right now. After all, I can't win by simply countering Erika's truth. description: WH changes Dlanor’s general guarantee that no one can defeat the seals into a past assertion that nobody broke them.
sourceReading: 何者にも破れず、誤魔化すことは出来ない expresses inability to defeat or circumvent the seals and deceive their function, following the guarantee of completeness.

units.text: The only reason Erika's theory is so strong is because of those seals. She was given red so quickly just because Lambdadelta easily bought the alibis created by those seals. But the seals aren't red truth! Just sticking paper in a door crack is far from perfect. There's no way something like that can prove anything with 'certainty'...! "Begin, Battler!!  Ready to let those goats turn you into a pile of meat along with your beloved Beatrice?!" "Oh, and I'll mix the leftovers from your precious sister into that pile.  Wouldn't that make for a wonderful stack of meat?  ......Then we can wrap it up in a dumpling, steam it and maybe add some soy sauce!!" "No, the best way would be to fry them in a pan with some eggs and ketchup!!" ""Ahyahhahahahahahahhhayhhyahyayhyahahahaaaaaaaaaahhhh!!"" "D, dammiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiittt!!  Can't we doubt the reliability of these seals of Erika's?!  Something like wedging some paper in a door can't create a perfect alibi!  It might be that someone noticed by chance and happened to put it back in the same place...!!" The blade of my blue truth should have slashed diagonally through Dlanor's chest. ...However, Dlanor's expression didn't budge in the slightest, and there wasn't a single wound on her chest. "I was wondering what you'd throw out there, but this is ridiculous..." "......Allow me to explain.  This is what I sealed the doors with.  ......Did you think this was paper, Battler-san?" Erika once again held up the thing that looked like brown paper. "This is duct tape.  Its adhesive power is extremely strong.  ......I used scissors to make it easier to tear." "Furthermore, I wrote my signature, which cannot be reproduced, across the entire tape, as well as the door and the frame on either side.  Therefore, it's impossible to tear it off without leaving a mark, and it's impossible to reattach too...!" "Permission to unsheathe the 'Red Key'." "Granted." "Due to the above, the seals are guaranteed to be PERFECT.  <Miss> Erika's seals were not broken by anyone, and deception is IMPOSSIBLE!!"

description: WH replaces the elliptical assertion that the other witch is also Game Master with a statement that she is there too.
sourceReading: ゲームマスターはすでにラムダデルタ、そして、ヤツもだ extends the predicate Game Master to ヤツ, contextually Bern who has just threatened permanent banishment.

units.text: At this point, the Game Master is Lambdadelta, ......and she's there too. This probably doesn't mean losing a single game, but being banished from this game for all eternity for losing. From what the witches have said in the past, I can faintly imagine the place 'pieces' are sent when they're banished. It's known as the depths of oblivion, ......an eternal darkness that lies on the far side of an eternal oblivion and where there is no concept of life or death... ......I'm going to disappear, aren't I... However, ......Beato will remain. As long as Beato remains, no matter how suspicious Natsuhi oba-san is, ......there will always remain space for the witch to be the culprit...in other words, room for Natsuhi oba-san to not be the culprit. ......As long as that space exists, ......someone will eventually expose the truth. It doesn't have to be me. Anyway, ......eventually, someone will smash this fake truth to pieces......! I understood that this was the time for me to abandon myself for the sake of this other person who would eventually appear, ......for the sake of the real truth......

units.japanese: ゲームマスターはすでにラムダデルタ、……そして、ヤツもだ。一つのゲームの敗北でなく、本当の意味でこのゲームから、敗者として永遠に追放されるだろう。追放された“駒”がどこへ追放されるか、魔女たちが話してきたことから薄っすらと想像がついている。そこは忘却の深遠と呼ばれる、永遠の暗闇で、……生きるという概念も死ぬという概念もない、永遠の忘却の彼方…。……俺は、消えるな。しかし、……ベアトは残る。ベアトが残る限り、夏妃伯母さんがどんなに疑わしくとも、……常に、魔女の仕業である余地、即ち、夏妃伯母さんが犯人でないわずかの余地を残すことが出来る。……その余地さえあれば、……必ず誰かがいつか、真実を暴いてくれる。それが俺でなくてもいい。とにかく、……この偽りの真実を、誰かがきっといつか打ち破ってくれる……！俺はいつかきっと現れるその誰かのために、……本当の真実を守るために、……我が身を投げ出すべき時が、今であることを理解する……。

It's known as the depths of oblivion, ......an eternal darkness that lies on the far side of an eternal oblivion and where there is no concept of life or death... ......I'm...going to disappear. But still, ......Beato will remain. As long as Beato remains, no matter how suspicious Aunt Natsuhi is, ......there will always remain space for the witch to be the culprit...in other words, room for Aunt Natsuhi to not be the culprit. ......As long as that wiggle room is there, ......someone will eventually expose the truth. It doesn't have to be me. Eventually, ......someone, at least, will smash this fake truth to pieces......! I understood that this... ...was the time to abandon myself for the sake of this other person who would eventually appear, ......for the sake of the real truth......

units.japanese: ゲームマスターはすでにラムダデルタ、……そして、ヤツもだ。一つのゲームの敗北でなく、本当の意味でこのゲームから、敗者として永遠に追放されるだろう。追放された“駒”がどこへ追放されるか、魔女たちが話してきたことから薄っすらと想像がついている。そこは忘却の深遠と呼ばれる、永遠の暗闇で、……生きるという概念も死ぬという概念もない、永遠の忘却の彼方…。……俺は、消えるな。しかし、……ベアトは残る。ベアトが残る限り、夏妃伯母さんがどんなに疑わしくとも、……常に、魔女の仕業である余地、即ち、夏妃伯母さんが犯人でないわずかの余地を残すことが出来る。……その余地さえあれば、……必ず誰かがいつか、真実を暴いてくれる。それが俺でなくてもいい。とにかく、……この偽りの真実を、誰かがきっといつか打ち破ってくれる……！俺はいつかきっと現れるその誰かのために、……本当の真実を守るために、……我が身を投げ出すべき時が、今であることを理解する……。

description: WH replaces Kinzo’s complex about being dismissed as nouveau riche with holding a grudge after elite condescension.
sourceReading: コンプレックスを持っていた states an insecurity or inferiority complex about being looked down on by the refined upper class.

units.text: As though the time to talk had suddenly come at hand, Kumasawa and Nanjo openly delved into territory that should never have been touched upon again...... This was concerning the period during which Kinzo was most feared for his ferocity. It has been said that, though Kinzo had many assets and connections, he held a grudge after being looked down upon by members in the elite as being an upstart. Because of this, apparently, Kinzo wanted to find Krauss a wife from a noble family and use this to raise the Ushiromiya family's status... Then, he overcame Natsuhi's family in a financial struggle, ......and proposed that a marriage be performed as a method of reconciliation. And the person he picked......was Natsuhi. Natsuhi had been raised to be clean and pure in a family of Shinto priests--making her a true noble lady. By choosing her, not only did Kinzo cause them the worst possible humiliation, he also won what he considered to be a nice trophy. So that marriage proposal was humiliating to Natsuhi from the very beginning......

units.text: "Natsuhi-san, you gained Kinzo-san's trust and are the person who served closest to him, right?  So, shouldn't you know better than anyone else?  ......This incident is actually the crime of the family head, carried out by Ushiromiya Kinzo-san." "Y, .........you dare... ...call Father......a criminal......?" "Don't worry.  I have prepared more than enough evidence and testimony to explain the 'why dunnit' if Kinzo-san was actually the culprit.  If you say, for example, that you have put yourself on the line to cover for Kinzo's crime, I am more than capable of supporting you." "Ever since the late period of the author Ellery Queen, even the theory created by the detective can sometimes change the plot itself.  You really can't afford to be careless in this day and age." "......I won't let you... ...treat Father like the culprit!!" "Natsuhi-san.  Calm down, place your hand on your chest, and think carefully.  ......If you accuse Kinzo-san of being the culprit, this entire case will be resolved.  You will no longer be held accountable for another person's actions, and your honor will be restored." In other words, by pushing the crime onto Kinzo, Natsuhi would be saved...... However......... "I, ......I have been entrusted with the honor of the Ushiromiya family...by Father......Did you really think......that I would defile Father's honor...the Ushiromiya family honor...just to clear away the false accusations made against me...?!!"

units.text:
Natsuhi, who had failed in her scheme to cast suspicion on Battler, changed her plan to include the murder of all present. 
(*Trial Summary, p.58) 
(*Supplemental Materials T, p.19) 
(*Bernkastel Documents, p.1348) 
(*Great Court Internal Documents: Library of Law A09 #9974) Predicting that one of those present would eventually want to take a rest in a private room, Natsuhi concealed herself inside a closet in one of the guest rooms. When Hideyoshi visited that room at approximately 13:00, she murdered him. 
(*Trial Summary, p.61) 
(*Supplemental Materials T, p.26) 
(*Great Court Internal Documents: Library of Law A09 #9974) Natsuhi once again concealed herself in the closet from the time the others became aware of the incident to the time that they carried out Hideyoshi's body. 
Furthermore, as proof of this, a button from Natsuhi's clothes was found in the closet. Afterwards, she exited the closet and tried to return to her own room. However, Furudo Erika discovered her on the way, and Natsuhi confessed to her crimes after questioning. 
(*Trial Summary, p.63) 
(*Supplemental Materials T, p.32) 
(*Submitted Evidence #26) 
(*Bernkastel Documents, p.1348) 
(*Lambdadelta Documents, line 7) 
(*Great Court Internal Documents: Library of Law A09 #9974) 
(*Great Court Internal Documents: Legal Mgmt. U99 #0107) 
(*Great Court Official Notice #01724434)

戦人を犯人と疑わせる目論見が失敗した夏妃は、計画を、全員殺害に変更しました。
（※裁判概要書：５８ページより）
（※補足資料Ｔ：１９ページより）
（※ベルンカステル文書：１３４８ページより）
（※大法院内務文書：法総書Ａ０９第９９７４号より）いずれ関係者が、休憩のために個室を欲しがることを予測した夏妃は、客室の一室のクローゼット内に潜伏。午後１時頃、この部屋に訪れた秀吉を殺害しました。
（※裁判概要書：６１ページより）
（※補足資料Ｔ：２６ページより）
（※大法院内務文書：法総書Ａ０９第９９７４号より）事件に気付いた関係者が、秀吉の遺体を運び出すまでの間、再び夏妃はクローゼット内に潜伏。
なお、その証拠として、クローゼット内に、夏妃の着衣のボタンを発見しました。その後、クローゼットを脱出して自室に戻ろうとしました。しかしその途上で、古戸ヱリカに発見されて追及を受け、事件を自白しました。
（※裁判概要書：６３ページより）
（※補足資料Ｔ：３２ページより）

description: WH relocates ambiguity from the vividly remembered instant to its remembered feeling.
sourceReading: 鮮明に覚えているのに ... 曖昧で describes paradoxical clarity and ambiguity of the recollection, followed by the strange feeling.

units.text: The rough fence snapped from the base, .........and the servant, ......along with the baby held in her arms, .........fell down towards the rocky beach below...... Even though... ...I remember that moment vividly, ...for some reason I recall a vague... ...and very strange feeling. It almost felt as though instead of falling, ......the two of them were silently swallowed up into empty space. So I didn't even hear the sound of them crashing to the rocky beach. description: Observer receiving the candy becomes gaining an observer.
sourceReading: After the observer verifies and overturns an empty cup, candy appears inside and the observer can actually obtain it. This is magic accompanied by a real result.

units.text: Then, there is another kind, which we might call true magic: 'magic that matches a result'. The cup trick is an example of 'magic that matches a result', since an observer actually checks to see that the cup's contents were empty before the candy appears, and thus an actual observer is gained.

description: Leaving with an unset chain not counting as escape becomes inability to leave.
sourceReading: Battler is free to leave through the door, but departing with the chain unlocked does not qualify as the required escape. He must solve the condition of leaving while maintaining the chain.

units.text: ......I'll make it simple.  There is no exit to escape from except for this door.  However, the chain lock on this door is set. units.japanese: 「そ、その二人には犯行時刻の明白なアリバイが…！！」「あの程度でアリバイかよ。ボンクラのお前にわかるように説明してたら、時間がいくらあっても足りねェや、面倒臭ェ。主席を名乗りたかったら、その程度の捜査と推理を見せてみな。それまで、このメイドへの逮捕状は俺が預かるぜ」「な、なら貴方に！！　そのメイドが犯行を犯さなかったことが証明できる也や？！　犯行時刻に彼女が台所を離れていたことは明らかと知り給え！　彼女は犯行時刻にどこで何を！　その女にも本官にも貴方にもッ、誰にも証明は不可能なりや！　なればこそ審問の拷問具で、赤き真実を搾り出す他なき也ッ！！」

units.text: "Th‐those two already have a clear alibi for the time of the crime...!!" "That, an alibi? Dammit, a fool like you couldn't understand no matter how easy I make it for you. If you want to call yourself a Chief Inquisitor, try and figure out at least that much for yourself. Until then, I'll be taking that maid's arrest warrant." "Th‐then what about you?! Can you prove that this maid didn't commit the crime?! Know that she was clearly away from the kitchen at the time of the crime! What was she doing then, and where?! She can't prove it, I can't prove it, and you can't prove it! No one can! That's why we have no choice but to use these torture devices to interrogate her until the red truth is squeezed out!!"

description: The prime of adulthood becomes past her prime.
sourceReading: Rudolf asks whether Beatrice looked middle-aged or in mature/prime adulthood.

units.text: "Did she look middle-aged or past her prime?" "If I had to call her an adult or a child, she was clearly closer to being a child.  There's no way she was middle-aged." "And isn't that strange?  We have the Beatrice you met, and the Beatrice who gave Father the gold, but their ages don't match." "In other words, they're different people." "Different people...who look very similar and have the same name..." "It might have been her daughter.  It makes sense for them to look alike if they were mother and child." "His mistress's daughter......  It is possible.  Perhaps Father had an illegitimate child with the Beatrice who gave him the gold." "And then, Rosa bumped into Beatrice the Second.  ......Makes those ages work out nicely." "............" "I see......  In other words, there are two people who can be called Beatrice." Kinzo secretly raised his mistress's child in a hidden mansion. That would make logical sense.  Everyone nodded, agreeing. ......However, Will's expression was slightly unsatisfied, and he scratched at his head...

sourceReading: Kinzo says no one can defile the story belonging to him and Beatrice, whatever others say.

units.text: "Pft, hahahahahahahahahaha!  You entertain me, boy.  You think you can write my will for me?!" "But that is none of your business.  Beatrice is mine alone.  No matter what anyone says, no one can defile me and that tale.  What they say is of no consequence!  No matter how Krauss and the others misconstrue it, it will not be painful or vexing for me."

sourceReading: Lion asks how Kinzo loved Beatrice through to the end and lived on because of that love, so its strength can guide them.

units.text: Of course, 'this game's' Genji probably wouldn't remember that. However, near the end of the first game, when the survivors had all gathered in Kinzo's study... Genji was asked whether Kinzo and Beatrice ever had a child together, and he denied it, saying 'I have not heard of anything like that'. "That may have been a lie, but in a way, it was a perfect sort of answer for one of Kinzo's confidants.  ......After all, in Kinzo's eyes, she wasn't a daughter, but Beatrice reborn." "Will...!  I don't know what you're talking about, but I will not let you slander the family head!" "This isn't slander.  It's reasoning.  ......However, I understand the heart.  In your eyes, Beatrice was the woman you loved most.  She remained that way even after death, for all eternity, and without fading in the slightest.  I doubt you thought of her as Beatrice reborn at the moment of her birth." description: Making the daughter an object of obsession is omitted.
sourceReading: The narration suggests Kinzo may have had pangs of conscience that he might be forcing his own feelings on another person and making her an object of gratification for his obsession.

units.text: Kinzo sobbed quietly for a while, wiping away his tears... Because of love, he believed she was Beatrice reborn, and had raised her that way. However, somewhere in his heart, ......he might have felt pangs of conscience, telling him that he might be forcing his emotions on someone who wasn't really Beatrice. Then, the Beatrice of Kuwadorian had an unexpected guest, Rosa. That woman just couldn't believe that she was the Beatrice that Kinzo desired.  She couldn't stand the fact that she didn't understand who she was, and she wanted to escape to the outside world. Then, .........she fell from the cliff...and died.
