description: Finding the infinite within finite fate becomes creating it
sourceReading: She tried to find or discover the infinite within limited fate, by entrusting her fate to God. 見出す is repeated.

units.text: Clair hung her head and let a single tear drop down... Humans will carelessly say that people have infinite possibilities. However, the Endless Witch......knows how limited those possibilities really are. So, out of her limited fate, she tried to create the infinite. By entrusting her fate to God, she tried to create the infinite. However, this did not mean that she was resigned to her fate. She spun the roulette of fate with an unshakable and certain will. A certain fate, where absolutely no one could escape if the epitaph was not solved. And all of it sealed up on the island.  Clair as well. October 4th and 5th, 1986, were sealed away by an absolute and certain will, ......and she abandoned herself to that short span of time and the many fates that could be chosen on that island.

クレルは俯き、涙の雫を一滴、零す…。人の可能性は無限だと、ニンゲンたちは軽々しく口にする。
しかし、無限の魔女は、……本当は有限であることを、知ってしまった。だから彼女は、その有限の運命の中に、無限を見出そうとした。自分の運命を、神に委ねることで、無限を見出そうとした。しかしそれは、自分の運命の放棄ではない。
なぜなら、運命のルーレットに、絶対の意思で臨んだから。誰も碑文の謎を解けないなら、誰も絶対に逃れられない、絶対の、運命。それで島を閉ざした。自分ごと。１９８６年１０月４日から５日は、絶対の意志で封じられ、………その狭い時間と島の中で選ばれるいずれかの運命に、……彼女は身を任す。

sourceReading: 海の藻屑 denotes being swallowed or lost in the sea, conventionally perishing there, in contrast with the other fate 死ぬ. It does not literally say transform into seaweed.

units.text: "Auaurora.  Was that enough of an answer check for you?  If you still don't get it, why not gather the other observer witches and have a tea party or something?  Then you can listen to their theories." "I'm mean, so I won't give any more hints than this.  There are no witches who don't think.  After all, witches who don't think either die or turn to seaweed." "......Yes, now you can look back and have a drink, ...while seeing how much of your theory was right.  I'm tired of playing the part of the bad guy...and of being a miko.  You're done with me now.  ......Bye, Lion.  And bye to you too, observer witches."

description: Increase tied to the number of observed losers becomes only slight increase
sourceReading: In Ange’s reasoning, checking others and confirming losing slices increases the winning probability according to how many such losers she observes: その数だけ.

units.text: However, I stopped myself. If I check my piece first, my chance of winning is one in 15. However, if I wait for some other people to check their slices, then when I see that they've lost, my chances will go up, if only slightly. In other words, instead of searching for the almond right away, my chances will go up if I wait for some other people to lose.

description: Love without expectation of return becomes unrewarded love
sourceReading: 無償の愛 identifies love given freely without requiring recompense. It differs from the preceding 報われぬ愛, love that goes unrewarded. The final narration repeats 無償 while saying he must not demand to be remembered.

units.text: "Hmph......  Let her forget.  One smile from her is the greatest parting gift I could ever take with me, when my time comes.  This is...the essence of unrewarded love."

sourceReading: The love Kinzo bestows on Ange as grandfather is already sufficient: もう充分だ. The narration judges sufficiency, not his capacity to give more.

units.text: ".........That's why...I should be apologizing to all three of you.  ......I forced Asumu to raise a kid that wasn't hers.  ......That woman wasn't anywhere near as generous and accepting as she looked.  ......There's a chance she figured it out.  ...However, she raised Battler, who loved her as a mother, with all the affection she had."

description: Jessica’s rejection of searching for externally hidden happiness loses the search distinction
sourceReading: Self, happiness and fate are made by oneself; they are neither gifts from others nor things hidden by others that one must search for, 誰かに隠されて探すものでもない.

units.text: "Ange......  Don't forget.  Your self, your happiness, your fate.  You're the one who creates all of these things.  Only you can choose.  Those aren't things that someone else can give you, and they aren't things that someone else can hide from you.  ......Remember."

description: Hachijo satire explanation literalizes shelves and loses detective-novel classification
sourceReading: Hachijo describes inducing ignorant readers to set that aside and feel they had exhausted their reasoning; she intended recognition of irony and self-mocking foolishness, yet the work was treated as a detective novel.

units.text: "This little scheme of yours is far more interesting than the manuscript I wrote.  In that case, it wouldn't be fitting to hand it over to you.  ......It was always a worthless story.  Just something for my ignorant readers to put on their shelves and let them think that they've managed to solve a great puzzle.  I was hoping that they'd recognize the irony and laugh at their own foolishness, but it looks like you've taken it seriously.  Yes, I can say I'm ashamed at my own failure as a writer."

description: Delighted clap at being outwitted becomes slapping oneself for being easily tricked
sourceReading: After rereading the opening, Tohya spontaneously claps in appreciation, thinking the author got him; he calls that feeling the essence of detective fiction.

units.text: "I liked it a lot.  Still, if you don't explain that part about the ocean currents a bit more clearly, it might be a little unfair for the reader...  Oh, but I thought it was great that you had the foreshadowing with the ring right there at the beginning.  ......After I finished, I had to go back to the beginning and slap myself for being so easily tricked.  I think that feeling's the best part of a detective novel."

Okonogi, who had carried great responsibility in the Ushiromiya Group thanks to his position as Eva's closest confidant, was the most natural choice to be Eva's successor, and thanks in part to his ability, everything had now been wrapped up smoothly.

description: Ange says Sumadera can dispose of Kasumi, radical spearhead they find hard to handle. English labels an overenthusiastic radical faction and drops their difficulty managing her.

units.text: "We can be sure that the Sumadera family is chasing me.  My actions are being intentionally leaked to them." "Then, we will bump into each other on Rokkenjima.  I will be killed by them.  After that, you will kill the Sumadera hit men, and President Okonogi will have a trump card to use in negotiations with the Sumaderas.  ......If I die, the Ushiromiya group will be stable for the time being.  Plus, they'll be able to draw the line with the Sumadera family.  On the other side, the Sumadera family itself will be able to neatly do away with Kasumi oba-san, the leader of their overenthusiastic radical faction.  ......Both sides will finish their bargaining with a draw, and everyone'll be happy."

description: あなたに退屈をしたくない gives Bern as the person unwilling to become bored with Lambda; English let you get bored assigns boredom to Lambda and Bern a preventative motive.
sourceReading: Because I do not want to get bored with you. Their separate departures sustain Bern interest in Lambda.

units.text: "In the end, I'd like to have Beato stuffed too.  Then I'll decorate the reception hall with her." "Galaxy Express?" "The one that isn't 'Night on the-'." "......You know, I read that back when I wasn't a witch.  ...I always thought it strange that humans who obtained eternal life would become so cruel.  ......At the time, I honestly couldn't relate." "......After becoming a witch and living a thousand years, I fully understand it.  ......That writer could understand our cruelty really well, in the truest sense.  *giggle*giggle*!" "......Where will you go next?  I'll bet we say farewell with our backs turned, right?" "That's because I don't want to let you get bored." "Thanks, Bern.  But you can be sure that I'll count to a hundred and then start searching for you again." "You really don't let a person get bored.  That's why I like you, love you.  ............Let's meet again somewhere.  However, we may not be reunited for another hundred or thousand years...if ever." "That's alright.  The sea of Fragments is tiny to a pair who love each other." "The Third Man?" "No, Children of Paradise of course."

units.text: 'Of course not.  I'll give you the thing that people like you always demand.  The reason you always stop thinking and then moan about it is 'lack of information'!  If you are then given information, you start doubting whether the information is true or not by 'denying the basis'!  Isn't that convenient?  What clever little words to hide your own incompetence.'

units.text: In other words, ......Beato wants me to be capable of solving it. At least it has the power to silence any negative thoughts about it just being useless anyway...

description: 迎合 is catering or accommodating; rise to fame replaces responsive author-reader relation with public success.
sourceReading: Reader waiting for the writer to cater to them never learns mystery enjoyment.

units.text: Along with these one-sided feelings they can't express, they lament the passage of a summer which will never come again, and the days of their youth end. The writer who wouldn't write until he gained the support of readers...goes for all eternity without releasing his maiden work. The reader who waited for the writer's rise to fame...goes their whole life without knowing the joy of the mystery genre.

description: Conditional premise is a fair contest with Beatrice; English retains contest but drops fair.
sourceReading: If this game is a fair contest between me and Beatrice.

units.text: If this game is a battle between me and Beato... ...Then because this tale is solvable, no elements will appear which make it impossible to solve. In other words, things like magic mustn't appear. When they do appear, I shouldn't suspect that the mystery element is breaking down, ......but I should instead question why it was shown and suspect the witnesses and observers. That's right, ......that was... ...Beato's greatest weapon in the 2nd game. Depictions of magic, which couldn't exist in a mystery. By showing me that, she forced me to think that this tale wasn't a mystery, and therefore, that reasoning was impossible...and I surrendered...... However, if I had believed unshakably that it was a mystery... ......It would have been completely obvious to doubt the witnesses who claimed to have seen it.

description: Asked what happened during the two days, Lion thinks the answer is in the cat box and can only describe a sad crossing or failure of feelings to meet. English substitutes my close call with a sad life, making Lion personal avoided fate the available account instead of the sad emotional misalignment just learned.
sourceReading: Even I could only tell her that there was a sad failure of feelings to meet.

units.text: The answer she seeks is inside the cat box. All I can tell her about is my close call with a sad life. However, I doubt that explanation would satisfy her. Then, ......a pillar of bright light pierced the stage. There stood a white shadow. ......That white dress was obviously Clair's. Of course, Ange didn't recognize her.  She looked suspicious, apparently wondering who in the world this was. However, even I felt as though something was wrong. ......Didn't she settle all of her regrets in that funeral a short while ago, before being sent off into the next world...? She stood all alone in the narrow beam of light in the center of the stage, and the expression on her face was lifeless. The light began to grow brighter and brighter. It shone more and more fiercely on her, until it became blinding just to look at her. The world was enveloped by a light so bright that we couldn't open our eyes, enveloped by a sound like wind or television static......and our minds began to go blank...

彼女の求める答えは、猫箱の中だ。自分にも、悲しい想いのすれ違いがあっただけだとしか、話せないだろう。しかし、その説明で彼女が納得するわけもない。するとその時、……眩しい光が一筋、舞台を切り裂いた。そこには、白い人影が立っていた。

units.text: Rokkenjima.  A world without Lion. ......The day of the Ushiromiya family's family conference. The mysterious letter that Maria read aloud after dinner, just as she had been told to. The writer of the letter claimed to be the Golden Witch Beatrice and challenged the family. Try and solve the riddle of the epitaph.  Otherwise, I will take everything. It was Beatrice's announcement of the game's start, the same as the usual game's. Had an unknown person appeared, related to the problem of the inheritance's distribution? Where was the 20 billion yen worth of gold hidden? What was the purpose of this letter?  For what goal had it been written? Who on Earth is this Beatrice? It was the usual dinner on October 4th, ......where several bits of suspicion and paranoia intertwined.

六軒島。理御のいない世界。
……右代宮家、親族会議の日。食事を終えたら読むように言われた、と真里亞が言い出して読み上げた、謎の手紙。黄金の魔女ベアトリーチェを自称する、その手紙の主は、親族たちを挑発する。碑文の謎を解いてみせよ。さもなくば、全てを頂戴すると。それは、いつものゲームと同じ、……ベアトリーチェのゲームの開会宣言文。遺産相続問題に、未知なる人物が登場？
２００億円の黄金の隠し場所は何処に？
この手紙の意図は？　一体何の目的で？
ベアトリーチェとは一体、何者なのか？いくつもの疑問と疑心暗鬼が交錯する、………いつのゲームでも変わらぬ、１０月４日の晩餐。

......The day of the Ushiromiya family's family conference. The mysterious letter that Maria read aloud after dinner, just as she had been told to. The writer of the letter claimed to be the Golden Witch Beatrice and challenged the family. Solve the riddle of the epitaph. Otherwise, I will take everything. It was the letter that declared the start of Beatrice's game, just as it had appeared in so many games before. Had an unknown person appeared to complicate the inheritance problem?
Where was the 20 billion yen's worth of gold hidden?
What was the purpose of this letter? For what goal had it been written?
Who on Earth was this Beatrice? It was that tangled web of suspicion and paranoia that had been a constant in every game: .........the dinner of October 4th.

units.japanese:
六軒島。理御のいない世界。
……右代宮家、親族会議の日。食事を終えたら読むように言われた、と真里亞が言い出して読み上げた、謎の手紙。黄金の魔女ベアトリーチェを自称する、その手紙の主は、親族たちを挑発する。碑文の謎を解いてみせよ。さもなくば、全てを頂戴すると。それは、いつものゲームと同じ、……ベアトリーチェのゲームの開会宣言文。遺産相続問題に、未知なる人物が登場？
２００億円の黄金の隠し場所は何処に？
この手紙の意図は？　一体何の目的で？
ベアトリーチェとは一体、何者なのか？いくつもの疑問と疑心暗鬼が交錯する、………いつのゲームでも変わらぬ、１０月４日の晩餐。

description: The source describes an on-paper army/navy pincer attack on American landing forces converging on Kujukuri Beach. English adds those forces pressing toward Tokyo, an unstated operational direction.
sourceReading: An ambitious on-paper plan for army and navy to pincer American troops landing at Kujukuri Beach.

units.text: By this time, Kinzo was probably the only one who knew. The secret base on Rokkenjima had started out as a submarine base. However, when that plan reached a standstill, it was redefined as a top secret base for homeland defense. A huge plan had been drawn up to have the army and navy perform a pincer attack on American forces if the latter decided to land on Kujuukuri Beach and press towards Tokyo. As a trump card for this massive defensive maneuver, the navy started stockpiling large quantities of explosives and fuel in absolute secrecy. And Rokkenjima base was the location those were stockpiled at. The total weight of the buried explosives was 900 tons. Also, fearing that the Americans might find out the island's secrets and seize the explosives, they set up a system for the self-destruction of the entire island...... Kinzo, who knew all of this, decided not to remove this device, but to tie it in with this strange clock that could cause the explosion any night at midnight. ......Kinzo is famous for building up his funds using a vast store of gold, and then using those funds in several sink-or-swim gambles, one after another. Just what did his stockpile of gold......and the 900 tons of sleeping explosives mean to him? At this point, we can only guess. Perhaps the true source of Kinzo's mad power......wasn't the gold after all. If he lost a big gamble and all that he owned, he could erase this entire island from existence with this device. His whole life, he must have put the gold and everything else he had on the line......

units.japanese: 恐らく、今となっては金蔵以外の、誰にもわからないことだろう。六軒島の秘密基地は、当初こそ潜水艦基地として作られた。しかし、その計画が頓挫した後は、本土防衛のための極秘計画の基地として再定義されていた。九十九里浜に殺到する米軍上陸部隊を、陸軍と海軍が挟撃する机上の大作戦。海軍はその一大反抗作戦の切り札として、莫大な量の弾薬、燃料を極秘裏に備蓄していた。六軒島基地は、その極秘の備蓄基地だったのだ。地下に埋められている爆薬の総量は９００ｔ。しかも、米軍に島が見破られ、接収されるかもしれないことを恐れた彼らは、万一の時、その爆薬で島ごと自決できる仕掛けを施した……。それを熟知する金蔵は、この仕掛けを解除するどころか、毎日２４時に起爆するという奇妙な時計に繋いだのだ。……金蔵が、莫大な黄金をもとに軍資金を作り、それを元手に、乗るか反るかの大博打を何度も繰り返したことは有名だ。その彼にとって、軍資金の黄金と、……島の地下に眠る９００ｔの爆薬は、どのような意味があったのだろう。今となっては、全ては憶測の域を出ない。恐らく金蔵の狂気の力の、真の源は、……黄金ではなかったのだろう。大博打に負けて全てを失ったら、いつでもこの世から島ごと消え去れる、仕掛け。彼は全ての人生に、黄金と自らの全てを賭けていたに違いない……。

units.japanese: 恐らく、今となっては金蔵以外の、誰にもわからないことだろう。六軒島の秘密基地は、当初こそ潜水艦基地として作られた。しかし、その計画が頓挫した後は、本土防衛のための極秘計画の基地として再定義されていた。九十九里浜に殺到する米軍上陸部隊を、陸軍と海軍が挟撃する机上の大作戦。海軍はその一大反抗作戦の切り札として、莫大な量の弾薬、燃料を極秘裏に備蓄していた。六軒島基地は、その極秘の備蓄基地だったのだ。地下に埋められている爆薬の総量は９００ｔ。しかも、米軍に島が見破られ、接収されるかもしれないことを恐れた彼らは、万一の時、その爆薬で島ごと自決できる仕掛けを施した……。それを熟知する金蔵は、この仕掛けを解除するどころか、毎日２４時に起爆するという奇妙な時計に繋いだのだ。……金蔵が、莫大な黄金をもとに軍資金を作り、それを元手に、乗るか反るかの大博打を何度も繰り返したことは有名だ。その彼にとって、軍資金の黄金と、……島の地下に眠る９００ｔの爆薬は、どのような意味があったのだろう。今となっては、全ては憶測の域を出ない。恐らく金蔵の狂気の力の、真の源は、……黄金ではなかったのだろう。大博打に負けて全てを失ったら、いつでもこの世から島ごと消え去れる、仕掛け。彼は全ての人生に、黄金と自らの全てを賭けていたに違いない……。

description: Beatrice says she planned to die with everything if they reached the ninth twilight without anyone solving the riddle. English waits until the ninth twilight ended, moving the stated condition from arrival to completion.
sourceReading: If none of you solved it and we reached the ninth twilight, I intended to die along with everything.

units.text: Kinzo probably looked at this clock at times, ......maybe flipping the activation switch and letting the clock tick down. Whenever things got tough and he got stuck, he would hide in here...and flip the switch...... Maybe he decided to blow everything away if he didn't think of a brilliant plan before 24:00 came. He would gaze at the mountain of gold, listening to the clock tick towards his death as he searched for an idea...... Perhaps Ushiromiya Kinzo's real study wasn't the one in the mansion, but this place instead...... "......That sort of switch sounds just like Dad.  ......So, maybe each time Dad worried about something, all of us kids were put on the line as well..." "For our Father, ......it wouldn't be unthinkable......" "This device now belongs to all of you.  ......If you want a massive explosion, use it whenever you please." "A, are you crazy...?!  Who'd want a big explosion...?!!" "......These explosives are half a century old, right?  Would they really go off?" "Yes, of course.  The explosives and the fuses are still working.  ......I tested them myself." "You tested them......?" "......Could it be......that?" "Yes, now I finally understand.  So that's why the shrine disappeared without a trace..." This summer, the shrine had disappeared without a trace, along with the reef under it. It felt strange that the waves could have destroyed it without a trace like that, but no one had paid it much mind. And now, this piece perfectly fit into the hole left by that strange feeling...... "Indeed.  .........I used that shrine to test whether the explosives were still working after half a century.  I believe you are all aware of the result." "............" "The little bit I used was enough to make that entire reef vanish.  It's easy to see how 900 tons of that would cause an explosion large enough to rewrite the map..." "......If an explosion like that happened, all of us would most certainly die.  But what about you?  I somehow doubt that you were willing to commit suicide with the rest of us..." "This underground VIP room is connected to an underground passage from the remnants of the military base.  If you go straight along that, you'll come out at the hidden mansion on the opposite side of the island, Kuwadorian.  It's about two kilometers away.  If you make it all the way there, you should be able to escape the blast." "......I see.  So, you planned to escape to there just before the blast." "I have only said that such a thing is possible.  ......You may not believe this, but if the ninth twilight ended before any of you could solve the riddle, ......I planned to die along with everything else." "......There's something seriously wrong with this girl..." "She's insane...  There's no point thinking about it!  If we hadn't solved the epitaph, she would have used those guns, or else that switch, to massacre all of us, right?!  There can be no doubting that now!!" "You are correct.  ......You have ended this game in the best possible way, without there being even a single victim.  ......I wish to convey my respect and admiration.  Though there were seven of you, you solved the riddle, which I spent so much time on, in a single night.  ......That is worthy of praise." "I also admire you for your graciousness and honesty in defeat.  .........We haven't decided how you will be dealt with, but I hope to do all I can to reach a gentlemanly agreement."

description: Confronting Eva raised gun, Rosa asks whether Eva will kill her too under the pretext of an accidental discharge. English makes her ask about dying in the explosion, substituting the future cover-up event for an immediate staged shooting and misconnecting the warning about a third death.
sourceReading: Are you going to kill me too and call it an accidental discharge?

units.text: "What do you think you're doing with that gun, Nee-san?  ......Are you going to have me die in the explosion too?  That'll make finding an excuse even harder.  In fact, it'll also make it harder to explain away the other two deaths as accidents too..." "If three people are killed together, that would become a fairly huge crime.  ......It would probably lead to the death penalty.  If you're lucky, it'll be life in prison.  Even in the best case, you'll be put away for more than a decade, right?" "Give yourself up.  If you do, this'll be no more than a pair of unfortunate accidents.  Of course, your jail term won't be too terrible either.  ......Don't worry about George-kun.  We'll take good care of him.  And we'll make sure that all 5 billion of your share will be waiting for you when you get back."

description: Kyrie holds the qualification to handle the same type of gun and the pair enjoy shooting together. English asserts she has the same firearms skill, removes qualification and shifts same from gun to degree of skill.
sourceReading: Kyrie too held the qualification to handle the same gun; both knew it well enough to enjoy shooting together.

units.text: "Sorry 'bout this, Aniki, Aneki, Rosa.  ......Well, that's just how the cookie crumbles.  Give me a break, okay?  Aniki and Aneki get into a fight, Rosa gets dragged in, and I'm the one who picks up the pieces.  ......Just the same way it's always been, right?" At the start, Rudolf and Kyrie hadn't planned to kill everyone and take everything for themselves. Kyrie had quickly realized by the size of the gun in her hands that it would probably hold five rounds at a time. .........Yes.  Both Kyrie and Rudolf knew a lot about these guns. Rudolf, who had gotten his interest in guns from western movies from his Father, owned a shotgun of a similar design. Since Kyrie had the same skill at handling firearms, they both knew enough about these guns......to enjoy shooting together... Including the witch, there had been eight people there.  Six people besides the two of them. Each gun held five rounds.  ......That was one short.  They didn't have enough to kill everyone. "......I was honestly surprised when they got into a fight and one of the guns went off." That coincidental accident......had provided the missing bullet. It wasn't the second shot.  The very first shot, which had accidentally killed Natsuhi, had guaranteed the result of this massacre... In this smoke and corpse-filled room of gold, the two of them wore easygoing smiles, hardly any different from the ones they usually wore... "......What do we do now?" Rudolf picked up Rosa's gun.  Then, he fired a test shot at the wall and ejected the old shell with a smooth motion like Kyrie's. Kyrie went to the box of bullets on the table, casually picked up a few, and loaded them one after another into her gun. "Set the bomb switch to 'on'.  Then, we just need to wait 24 hours." "The others'll get worried when they realize everyone's missing in the morning." "Then we just need to make sure no one gets worried." "Guess so.  ......What about Battler?" "He's your son.  Not mine." "Don't say that.  Look how attached he is to you.  He really respects you." "Then think of a clever way to trick him.  I'll worry about Ange.  You worry about Battler-kun.  Fair enough?" "Nn, ......sure." "I'm kind to my own children, ......but it's a real pain to be nice to Asumu-san's kid.  You understand, I hope?" "............" Kyrie's voice had grown cold. Kyrie had acted warmly towards Battler because that had been the adult thing to do. He was Rudolf's son, so she just tried to avoid being unkind. But underneath, he was the son of Asumu, the woman she hated even after the other's death. Now that she had given birth to Ange and finally built up a new family, .........was Battler's return really such a happy thing for her......? "Get yourself ready.  Now that we've come this far, ......we can only go for the billion yen or die trying.  If you can't convince Battler-kun, I'm sorry, but I won't be taking any chances." "......No need to threaten me.  I'll take care of it.  I'll find a good story to tell him." "Make sure you do a good job of it.  ......If Ange hears that Battler-kun has died in an accident, I'm sure she'll be very sad." "Sure..................  ...How do we start?" "We have nothing to gain by waiting for morning.  Now is the best time." "......Oh, wonderful.  Not even time for a break."

description: Japanese notes Kyrie confidently asserts what only theatergoers know despite supposedly being unable to view it, and speculates she may possess something extraordinary. English says she knew the fact and was extraordinary, strengthening assertion and possibility into narrator confirmation.
sourceReading: Because Kyrie, who should not be able to view it, asserts this, perhaps she possesses something extraordinary.

units.text: And Kyrie, who did not have the theatergoing ability, knew this fact also.  ......Apparently, she really was an extraordinary person. So, for some time, Eva could only grind her teeth in silence, still pointing her gun...... "......I don't understand.  You're also a mother.  You've felt the pain of giving birth to your own child.  How can you not know how precious a life is...?!  How are you capable of doing all this...?!" "To create a child, all you need to do is sleep with someone." "What does that have to do with anything...?!!" "Children are bonds...is what I mean." "What?!" "Children are bonds that can tie you to your husband.  ......A bond to make Rudolf-san acknowledge me, so I could take him back from that woman." "But you've killed Rudolf-san now.  So, ......you understand what that means, right?" "What do you mean... ...I understand?!" "Right now, I'm no man's wife, so there's no need for me to be a mother.  ......I am me.  Kyrie.  Now that Rudolf-san's dead, I'm not even an Ushiromiya anymore.  I live to benefit me." "Right, Rudolf is dead, so maybe you aren't a wife anymore.  But you still have Ange-chan, right...?!  You're still a mother, aren't you...?!" "Didn't you hear what I just said about bonds?  Now that Rudolf-san is gone, Ange is of no use to me." "......Y, ...you...... how can any mother say that about her own daughter?!" "Eva nee-san.  Let's put a stop to this.  Stop pretending to be so noble." "Pretending...?!" "Did either of us marry because we wanted children?  We didn't, right?  We married because we wanted to live with the man we loved.  And, once you've married, you never want to let that man go, for the rest of your life, correct?  Children are weapons to be used for that goal." "Who would have children for a reason like that...?!!" "Some people would." Kyrie kept on speaking emotionlessly, ignoring the falling rain...... Her relaxed smile did not falter for an instant. "Ange was just a chain I used to tie Rudolf-san to me.  ......Or, you could call her a chess piece, someone to play the role of the kid in our family drama.

units.text: "Only Eva returned alive.  Even though the police claimed it was an accident, the public didn't believe it.  Then, she took over her husband's company, and the harder she worked to make it more and more successful, the more enemies she made.  A public image of her as a great queen of conspiracy grew stronger and stronger." "......I'm sure she wanted to tell people about the truth.  That truth that no one would ever believe without proof.  ......Bit by bit, Eva's heart began to snap.  You rejected Eva, so she rejected you in turn.  The relationship between the last two members of your family was completely strained.  Each time she compared you with her beloved son, she grew more and more twisted and broken."

description: Japanese addresses Hiraoka as 兵曹; WH moves the rank to narration and specifies Warrant Officer. The transfer is unobjectionable, but the historical rank is changed.
sourceReading: Petty Officer Hiraoka; the precise petty-officer grade is unspecified. Japan Aeronautic Association's historical table distinguishes the NCO petty-officer grades from warrant-officer 兵曹長. Reference: https://www.aero.or.jp/culture/aviationand-culture/20071215-8265/; research evidence: source/evidence/hiraoka-rank-research.json.

units.text: Warrant Officer Hiraoka was lying face down, his entire body drenched in blood. Judging by the trail of blood behind him, it was clear that he had somehow managed to crawl here from a different room before dying. No, he was still twitching.  He might not be dead yet. ......But, on this island without a doctor... ...no, even if we had a doctor... how could anyone possibly... ...save a man who had been shot this many times in the chest... When I looked into the room he must have crawled out of, I saw two more blood-stained Japanese corpses.
units.note: Both warrant officer retains changed rank, source兵曹; rank moved from address to narration unobjectionable.

description: Krauss claims comprehensive awareness of Kinzo’s assets. WH instead gives him control over all assets; Rosa and Eva repeat control for the same source term. Knowing an asset exists and exercising control over it are distinct claims.
sourceReading: Krauss has a full grasp of Father’s assets; Rosa and Eva challenge whether there are assets outside his knowledge. Hidden gold is their counterexample.

units.text: "N, no, that's impossible!  As the agent to the head, I am in control over all of Father's assets!  There shouldn't be anyone who can freely do that without me knowing it!"
units.note: MG control assets repeats control interpretation; UP full knowledge restores epistemic claim.
units.japanese: 「い、いや、それはない！　私は当主代行として親父殿の全ての財産を把握している！　私に知られずにそれらを自由にできる人間はいないはずだ！」

units.text: "N-No, that's impossible! As the Family Head's representative, I control all of Father's assets! It should be impossible for anyone to do as they please with them without me knowing it!"

description: Japanese lists a ceasefire, anti-preemption rules, protecting shares in different situations, and worst-case legal responses as subjects being discussed. WH makes share protection and grounds for legal action consequences of the agreement/rules.
sourceReading: They are endlessly discussing several measures, including possible legal responses. No claim that these particular rules supply grounds for litigation.

units.text: I haven't been told the details, but they argue on and on about their ceasefire agreement and rules to prevent anyone from getting ahead, under which their portions are protected, and which can, in the worst case scenario, even become grounds for legal action. ......That they would go this far to preserve their shares was more than shocking...
units.note: Both restore enumerated negotiations including protecting shares and legal measures, not consequences solely of ceasefire.
units.japanese: 詳しくは話してもらえなかったが、兄弟は休戦協定と抜け駆け防止のルール、様々な状況下での取り分の防衛、最悪の場合の法的対応などを延々と協議しているらしい。

description: Beyond exasperation, Battler feels the siblings’ formidable tenacity. WH more than shocking retains surprise but drops the specific grudging recognition of their strength.

units.note: MG resilience and UP force to be reckoned with restore grudging acknowledgment beyond disgust.
units.japanese: ……ここまで来ると、呆れを通り越して逞しさを感じちまう…。

sourceReading: She briefly holds her breath and watches the far end/depth of the corridor fearfully while carrying the curtain bundle.

units.text: At first, she thought she had made some mistake, but after a while, she killed her breathing.  Grasping a curtain, she fearfully gazed into the center of the hall...... However, other than the occasional crack of thunder brightening the hallway, she was unable to glimpse any flicker again.

description: もう少し楽観的な考え方に変わって来る explicitly says Natsuhi becomes more optimistic after learning relatives are also missing. English says her optimistic thinking began to change, omitting the direction and permitting reduced optimism.
sourceReading: Her thinking shifts to something a little more optimistic.

units.text: When she had heard that Gohda alone was missing, she had thought that he might have slept in or was loafing around somewhere, but once she heard that several of the relatives were also missing, her optimistic way of thinking began to change. Could last night's family conference have continued all night and still be going on? It was also imaginable that they had wanted to cool off their heads after being in that stuffy room, and had all gone off on their own walks through the rain. ...The part about 'cooling off their heads' really sounded like something Krauss would like to say. Probably, Gohda had been called to go with them to aid them with something.
units.note: Both more optimistic direction explicit.
units.japanese: 郷田ひとりだけ姿が見えないと聞いた時は、寝坊したのか、どこかで油を売っているのかと思ったが、親族たちも含めての不在だということになると、もう少し楽観的な考え方に変わって来る。

description: Japanese says the facts cannot be known unless the police investigate. English substitutes until police arrive and assigns the future knowledge specifically to Nanjo. Arrival alone is not the investigative step named by the source.
sourceReading: Only police investigation can clarify the scene; a brief look is insufficient.

units.text: Hideyoshi, fidgeting as he remembered that horrible scene, kept muttering, 'Unbelievable.  That can't be somethin' of this world, it's the work of the devil.' Every once in a while, he tried to ask a question and bumped into Nanjo, but Nanjo, in a calm doctor-like manner, kept repeating that nothing could be understood by only glancing at the scene, and that until the police arrived, he wouldn't know anything.
units.note: Both police arriving instead of investigation.
units.japanese: 南條は医者らしく冷静に、少し見ただけでは何もわからない、警察が調べなければわからないと繰り返すのだった。

units.text: Hideyoshi kept on fidgeting, and every time he remembered that horrible scene, he started muttering about how he couldn't believe it, how it couldn't have been something from this world, how it must have been the work of demons. Every now and then, his mutterings produced a question directed at Nanjo, but the latter kept repeating in a calm, doctor-like manner that nothing could be understood by only glancing at the scene, and that until the police arrived, they wouldn't learn anything.
units.note: Both police arriving instead of investigation.

description: 気付きもしなかったという方 refers to taking the position that she never even noticed the prank. WH better if she did not notice omits the presentation/pretence, despite her having plainly noticed and ordered it cleaned.
sourceReading: It would be better to act as though she had never noticed it.

units.text: Who in the world would pull such a childish and disgusting prank! Natsuhi had a pretty good idea, but of course there was no proof, so even if she pushed the issue, it would just seem as though she was making a fuss about nothing. On the contrary, after having such a prank played on her, it would definitely be better if she didn't notice it. Natsuhi gave the order to have it cleaned, and headed off to the parlor with a squeak of her heels.
units.note: MG act as though/UP say not noticed preserves feigned ignorance.
units.japanese: むしろ、こんな悪戯がされていたこと自体、気付きもしなかったという方がかえっていいに違いない。

units.text: ".........Rigor mortis has set in across the entire body... ......Probably, at least six hours have passed since death... As far as I can tell by looking at the damaged area, there is a high probability that they were damaged after their deaths..."

description: ニンゲン側に認められた identifies the human side as recipient of a legitimate game right. WH makes the human side the party acknowledging the right, shifting its role from beneficiary to recognizer.
sourceReading: This is a legitimate right of the game granted to the human side.

units.text: "Detective's authority.  ......The detective has the right to inspect all crime scenes.  Stand back, Ushiromiya Battler.  This is an official right of this game, which the human side has acknowledged."
units.note: Both right granted to human side restores recipient rather than acknowledger.
units.japanese: これはニンゲン側に認められた、ゲームの正当な権利よ。」

description: Japanese makes Erika and her sympathizers the people Battler cannot forgive. English places those who sympathized with her after cornering Natsuhi, making them additional targets of Erika’s harassment, with her naturally referring to Natsuhi. The accomplice group disappears from the object of Battler’s anger.
sourceReading: He cannot forgive Erika, who enjoys cornering Natsuhi, or those who side with Erika.

units.text: He wasn't feeling compassion for Natsuhi because her lie was about to be exposed. However, he couldn't excuse Erika, who called herself an intellectual rapist and was simply enjoying cornering Natsuhi and those who sympathized with her. Then, he whispered softly. ".........It's useless." Beato and the others definitely heard that...
units.note: MG corners Natsuhi and sympathizers wrongly groups targets; UP cannot forgive Erika or people going along with her restores supporters.
units.japanese: それを、知的強姦と称して、......ただただ夏妃を追い詰めて楽しんでいるだけのヱリカと、その同調者たちが、許せないのだ。

units.text: He wasn't feeling compassion for Natsuhi because her lie was about to be exposed. However, he couldn't excuse Erika, a self-proclaimed intellectual rapist, who simply enjoyed cornering Natsuhi and those who sympathized with her. Then, he whispered softly.
units.note: MG corners Natsuhi and sympathizers wrongly groups targets; UP cannot forgive Erika or people going along with her restores supporters.
units.japanese: 夏妃の嘘が暴かれそうになっていることに同情しているのではない。それを、知的蹂躙と称して、……ただただ夏妃を追い詰めて楽しんでいるだけのヱリカと、その同調者たちが、許せないのだ。そして、小さく呟く。

description: WH consistently renders 梅干 as dried plums without identifying the salt-pickled ume preparation. This loses the distinctive salty/sour food in Bern’s tea preference and recurring food jokes, and readily suggests an ordinary dried fruit instead.
sourceReading: Umeboshi, or salted/pickled plums. MAFF explains the preparation as salt-pickling ume followed by drying: https://www.maff.go.jp/j/keikaku/syokubunka/traditional-foods/bunrui/tsukemono.html .

description: The fictional title 黒首島奇譚 uses an island name composed of black and neck. WH substitutes Beatnik Island, losing that name imagery and introducing an unrelated cultural word. The replacement recurs in the subsequent title mention.
sourceReading: Strange Tale of Black-Neck Island, or a consistent transliteration of the Japanese island name if its reading is independently established.

units.text: "......And so, the curtain closes on the strange tale of Beatnik Island.  ......The End."
units.note: Both Kurokubi Island restores actual proper title, not Beatnik. Transliteration acceptable; black-neck literal gloss unnecessary.
units.japanese: 「......“斯様にして、我が黒首島奇譚は幕を閉じるのである。”.........＜了＞。」

description: The narration of Kanon putting first his right knee and then his left into the mud is omitted.
sourceReading: After tears spill and he howls, Kanon drops his right knee and then his left into the muddy ground before confessing his feelings for Jessica.

units.text: Tears were coming from both of Kanon's eyes. ...And he howled. "......I, liked Milady...!!  And after seeing Milady on that day, I started liking her even more...!  And when I heard that Milady also liked me, I was really happy...!!  But I'm furniture, ......and I can't accept Milady's feelings!!"
units.note: This passage exists in the original PC script and is omitted from the PS3-derived Japanese. The original WH omission is not counted against MG or UP.
units.japanese: そして、泥濘に膝を、右、左とつける…。

description: In ‘Gohda, who was a show off,’ show-off is a count noun and requires a hyphen.
sourceReading: The narration characterizes the ostentatious Gohda as taking particular pride in his special exemption from ordinary servant duties.

units.text: ...It seemed that Gohda, who was a show off, had a particular feeling of supremacy about that. He left the preparations of the inside of the mansion to Genji and the rest, and worked on preparing breakfast in the kitchen.
units.note: Both preserve the inherited unhyphenated noun while retaining the intended characterization.
units.japanese:
…見栄っ張りな郷田は、その辺りに優越感を特に感じるらしい。
館内の準備を源次たちに任せ、厨房で朝食の準備に勤しむのだった。

description: ファンシーな包み紙 means fancy, decorative or cute wrapping paper; WH’s fantasy-styled wrappings changes the wrappers’ visual quality into a fantasy theme.
sourceReading: Rosa sees candies in very fancy wrappers, along with cookies, ramune sweets and chocolates, scattered across the jam-covered carpet.

units.text: When she approached even closer to them, ......she realized that candies were scattered all over the floor. They were all candies, cookies, sodas and chocolates, with very fantasy-styled wrappings... And they were all distributed across the carpet, which was covered with blackberry and cranberry jam...
units.note: MG keeps heavily fantasy-themed packaging. UP describes the candies as being in very fancy wrapping.
units.japanese: それはとてもファンシーな包み紙に包んだ飴玉や、クッキー、ラムネにチョコレート…。

units.text: When she approached even closer to them, ...she realized that there were snacks scattered all over the floor. Candies, cookies, soda and chocolates, ...all with heavily fantasy-themed packaging... They were all scattered across a carpet covered with blackberry and cranberry jam...
units.note: MG keeps heavily fantasy-themed packaging. UP describes the candies as being in very fancy wrapping.
units.japanese: 彼らにさらに近付くと、……床にたくさんのお菓子が散らばっているのがわかった。それはとてもファンシーな包み紙に包まれた飴玉や、クッキー、ラムネにチョコレート…。そして、それらはブラックベリーとクランベリーのジャムいっぱいの絨毯の上にばら撒かれていた…。

description: 封筒 identifies the physical envelope handed to Maria, but WH calls it a letter while Rosa is determining which object contains the chapel key.
sourceReading: Rosa becomes certain that the envelope Beatrice handed Maria is relevant, then retrieves and tears open that same container to obtain the key.

units.text: Rosa was sure. ......There could be no mistake. ......That letter which had been handed to Maria............
units.note: MG calls the object an envelope throughout Rosa’s recognition and retrieval. UP calls it a letter at the recognition point, then restores envelope when Rosa retrieves and tears the container.
units.japanese:
その時、楼座の脳裏に昨日の出来事が蘇る…。
……そうだ、
……あの魔女は薔薇庭園で出会った時、
…真里亞に、封筒を渡していなかったっけ。
そうだ、間違いない、渡していた。
開けようとする真里亞に、まだ開けるなと言ってから、
“それを開ける時はすぐ訪れる”と、確かに言っていた…。
楼座は確信する。
……間違いない。
……真里亞に渡された、あの封筒…………。
楼座はゲストハウスへ駆けて戻ると、足音を忍ばせながらいとこ部屋に近付き、
そっと扉を開け、中をうかがう…。
中からは、若者らしい元気のいいいびきが聞こえてきた。
子どもたちは４人いる。
真里亞もいる。
…すやすやと眠っていた。
ほっと胸を撫で下ろしてから、忍び足で室内に入る。
……目指すのは、ソファーの上に置かれている真里亞の手提げだった。
真里亞は、自分の宝物をいつも持ち歩きたがる。
…母親が常に化粧道具を肌身離さず持ち歩いていることの模倣だろう。
もちろん、単なる物真似だから、その中身はがらくたばかりだ。
真里亞の場合は、オカルトを想起させる不気味な小物や、それが記された自由帳などだ。
……こんな女の子らしくないものを、楼座は持ち歩いて欲しいなどと思ったことは一度もない。
しかし、無理にやめさせようとして、ものすごい大喧嘩をして以来、それには触れないようにしていた。
「………………………、…あった。
………これね………」
黄金の鷲の紋章の入った洋形封筒…。
取り出してみると、中に重たい棒状の物が入っているのがわかった。
…重さと手触りでわかる。
……間違いない。
これは、……鍵だ。
楼座は、一度振り返り、真里亞が熟睡しているのを確認した後、
一息に封筒を破き、中身を手の平の上に零した。
……それは、古く凝った意匠の施された鍵だった…。

sourceReading: Hearing Nanjo reassures George that the cousins are not the only people remaining on the island; the sentence establishes at least one other present person, not the presence of everyone else.

units.text: "It's Doctor Nanjo.  ...Great.  It looks like everyone but us hasn't disappeared from this island."
units.note: MG retains everyone but us hasn’t disappeared. UP reorders this to everyone hasn’t disappeared ... but us, preserving the same unstable negative scope instead of clearly saying they are not the island’s only remaining people.

…よかった。
この島から、僕たち以外が消えてしまったわけではないようだよ」

description: ‘After they died of sitting them on chairs’ grammatically makes being seated the cause of death and leaves the killer’s actions without a coherent construction.
sourceReading: Battler condemns the culprit for going to the trouble, after killing the victims, of seating them, cutting open their abdomens, pulling out their entrails and stuffing them with sweets.

sourceReading: Kanon’s sequence is likened to check followed by repeated pressure and checkmate in seven moves.

units.text: If this battle of drawing sparkling loci was chess... ...Then Kanon coming from behind was check. And press, and press, and press, and press. Use seven moves, and make it mate...!
units.note: MG retains make it mate. UP uses the standard chess expression mate in seven.

description: 私を見捨てる says Kanon could have abandoned Jessica but did not. Let me go instead ordinarily means release me, changing the action available to him and weakening her evidence that he chose to return and protect her.
sourceReading: Jessica argues that Kanon is human because he came to save her of his own will and refused many opportunities to abandon her.

units.text: Kanon-kun rushed to save me of his own will.  And he stood in the path of a fearsome witch, you.  Even though he had many chances to just let me go, he didn't."
units.note: MG retains let me go. UP directly restores the claim that Kanon had opportunities to abandon Jessica but chose not to.
units.japanese: 嘉音くんは自分の意思で、私を助けに駆け付けてくれた。そして恐ろしい魔女であるあんたの前に立ちはだかってくれた。私を見捨てることなんていくらでもできただろうに、そうしなかった。」

units.text: Kanon-kun rushed to save me of his own free will. And he stood in the path of a fearsome witch like you. He had so many chances to just let me go, but he didn't."
units.note: MG retains let me go. UP directly restores the claim that Kanon had opportunities to abandon Jessica but chose not to.

description: 開かずの礼拝堂 is the never-opened or perpetually closed chapel. Forbidden chapel replaces its observed closed status with a prohibition, weakening the later tension between the nickname and the existence of a working key.
sourceReading: The servants called it the never-opened chapel and found it eerie like a haunted house, even though Kinzo kept it clean for possible use.

units.text: "......As far as I know, the Master has never come here.  We even call this the 'forbidden chapel', ...umm, I thought it was eerie, like a haunted house."
units.note: MG changes the nickname to sealed chapel, preserving a closed-state meaning. UP retains forbidden chapel at both occurrences in this span, turning the nickname into an access rule.
units.japanese: 「……私の知る限りでも、ここにお館様がいらっしゃったことはありません。私たちも、ここを　“開かずの礼拝堂”と呼んで、…その、オバケ屋敷のような感じで、薄気味悪く思っておりました。」

description: 不利な証拠 means evidence unfavorable to or incriminating for the culprit. Disadvantageous evidence is nonidiomatic and leaves unstated whose position the evidence would damage.
sourceReading: Nanjo observes that such an elaborate staging creates a high chance that police will find evidence against the culprit.

units.text: "Well, umm, ............they carried six human corpses all the way over here, and made these elaborate decorations.  ...We can't tell whether she called the six of them over here before killing them, or whether she killed them before carrying them over here, ...but either way, it would take a lot of effort......  Why did the culprit want six people to die here......?" "......That is true.  In doing something that elaborate, there would be an extremely high chance that when the police came, some disadvantageous evidence would be found.
units.note: Both retain disadvantageous evidence without directly identifying it as evidence against the culprit. The surrounding discussion still supplies the investigative-risk relation.

description: 妾は全ての犯行を魔法で行なう uses nonpast aspect for Beatrice’s claimed general method: she performs every crime with magic. I carried out all of the crimes with magic turns it into a completed-past assertion about the crimes already committed.
sourceReading: Beatrice explains generally that because she commits every crime by magic, demonstrating the magic directly would make any impossible crime trivial and spoil the game.

units.text: "The reason is simple.  I carried out all of the crimes with magic.  So for any impossible crime, all I have to do is wave my magic staff before your eyes."
units.note: MG retains carried out all the crimes, strengthening the black-text explanation into a past-completion claim. UP uses present carry out and restores the general method. Neither wording is red.

description: 私だけが知ってたって意味がない becomes If only I know the truth, that’s pointless, replacing the concessive ‘even if I alone know’ with a wish-like conditional. 死んでわかった then becomes present I know after dying rather than a realization reached upon death.
sourceReading: Even if Jessica alone knows the truth, that has no value; dying made her understand that truth belongs to the living.

units.text: "If only I know the truth, that's pointless!!  I know after dying.  Truth belongs to living humans!!  If the truth doesn't remain, the dead won't be rewarded!!  They won't know why Kanon-kun risked his life!!"
units.note: MG retains both If only I know and present I know it after dying. UP retains If only I know but changes the second clause to found out by dying, restoring a completed realization though expressing its trigger freely.

description: 年季の入った粗末なチェスセット becomes a crude chess set which had many years of experience. 年季の入った describes the set as old or well-worn; the translation unnaturally assigns personal experience to the object.
sourceReading: Genji and Nanjo face each other across an old, well-worn, unpretentious chess set.

units.text: Genji and Nanjo were facing each other across a crude chess set which had many years of experience. ...It had still only just begun. And because the opening game of the experienced players had been endlessly refined, it looked like a ceremony where they just moved specified pieces in a specified order.
units.note: MG changes which to that but still gives the chess set years of experience. UP says the set had seen many years, restoring an idiomatic age description.
units.japanese: 源次と南條は、年季の入った粗末なチェスセットで向かい合っている。
candidates: crude chess set which had many years of experience

units.text: Genji and Nanjo were facing each other across a crude chess set that had many years of experience. ...The game had still only just begun. And, because the opening game of these experienced players had been honed to perfection, it looked like a ceremony where they just moved specified pieces in a specified order.
units.note: MG changes which to that but still gives the chess set years of experience. UP says the set had seen many years, restoring an idiomatic age description.
units.japanese: 源次と南條は、年季の入った粗末なチェスセットで向かい合っている。…まだまだ始まったばかり。そして年季の入ったプレイヤーの序盤は限りなく洗練されているため、互いが決まった順序で決められた駒を動かすだけの儀式のように見えた。

description: その可能性はありえない becomes that possibility wasn't possible, an avoidable tautology rather than that possibility was inconceivable or could not be true.
sourceReading: The narration considers a member of the household as a possible visitor, then rejects that possibility as inconceivable under the circumstances.

units.text: As Gohda fearfully approached the back door, he called out. ......And he checked with his eyes the location of a butcher's knife set in a nearby sink. ......He didn't pick it up yet. Because there was still a possibility that this was a member of the family. However, that possibility wasn't possible...
units.note: MG revises wasn't possible to was impossible but preserves the possibility/impossible tautology. UP retains the original wording exactly.
units.japanese: しかし、その可能性はありえない…。

units.text: As Gohda fearfully approached the back door, he called out. ...And his eyes flashed towards the butcher's knife that sat in a nearby sink. ...He didn't pick it up yet. Because there was still a possibility that this was a member of the family. However, that possibility was impossible...
units.note: MG revises wasn't possible to was impossible but preserves the possibility/impossible tautology. UP retains the original wording exactly.
units.japanese:
郷田は恐る恐る勝手口に近付きながら声を掛ける。
……そして、近くの流しに置いてある肉切り包丁の位置を目で確認する。……まだ手には取らない。
家人の誰かの可能性もあるから。
しかし、その可能性はありえない…。

However, that possibility wasn't possible...

description: 納品書 becomes statements of delivery. The documents are delivery slips or delivery notes whose envelopes are opened with the knife, not statements about delivery.
sourceReading: The knife serves as a letter opener for envelopes containing delivery slips and invoices.

units.text: Genji took a knife with a classical design from a stationary box placed near the chess set. ...It was something to be used instead of a paper knife to open envelopes for statements of delivery and bills. But it was fundamentally a knife. So the blade on it could injure someone...
units.note: MG retains statements of delivery. UP substitutes invoices, which is idiomatic English but still changes the delivery note into a billing document alongside the separately named bills.
units.japanese: …それは、納品書や請求書の封筒を開けるのに、ペーパーナイフ代わりにしていたものだった。

units.text: Genji took a knife with a classical design from a stationary box placed near the chess set. ...It was something to be used instead of a paper knife to open envelopes for statements of delivery and bills. But it was still a knife. So the blade on it could injure someone...
units.note: MG retains statements of delivery. UP substitutes invoices, which is idiomatic English but still changes the delivery note into a billing document alongside the separately named bills.

だからそれには人を傷付ける刃が付けられている…。

units.text:

So the blade on it could injure someone...

だからそれには人を傷付ける刃が付けられている…。

description: 彼の作る泥の水溜り becomes the puddles of mud he left. The source describes the muddy pool forming beneath the barely breathing Kanon and rapidly turning red, not multiple puddles left behind along his route.
sourceReading: As Kanon lies there barely breathing, the muddy pool forming around him rapidly turns bright red with blood.

units.text: It was Kanon. ......His breath was feeble, ......and the puddles of mud he left quickly became drenched bright-red.
units.note: Both retain multiple puddles left by Kanon. MG revises became drenched to were drenched, while UP otherwise preserves the original wording.
units.japanese: ……息も絶え絶えで、……すぐに彼の作る泥の水溜りは真っ赤に染まっていく。

units.text: It was Kanon. ...His breath was feeble, ...and the puddles of mud he left were quickly drenched bright red.
units.note: Both retain multiple puddles left by Kanon. MG revises became drenched to were drenched, while UP otherwise preserves the original wording.
units.japanese: それは嘉音だった。……息も絶え絶えで、……すぐに彼の作る泥の水溜りは真っ赤に染まっていく。

units.text: It was Kanon. ......His breath was feeble, ......and the puddles of mud he left quickly became drenched bright‐red.
units.note: Both retain multiple puddles left by Kanon. MG revises became drenched to were drenched, while UP otherwise preserves the original wording.
units.japanese: それは嘉音だった。……息も絶え絶えで、……すぐに彼の作る泥の水溜りは真っ赤に染まっていく。

description: Nanjo's 嘉音さん becomes Kanon-kun as he instructs the wounded Kanon to press the injury, changing his polite address to a more familiar or senior-to-junior form.
sourceReading: Nanjo addresses him politely as Kanon-san while urgently telling him to press firmly against the wound.

units.text: "Kanon-kun, put your hand against the wound!  Please, push firmly!  Let's carry him to the bed in the servant room!!  Everyone, please, lend a hand."
units.note: MG retains Kanon-kun while changing put to place. UP restores Kanon-san.
units.japanese: 「嘉音さん、傷口に手を当てて！　しっかり押さえて下さい！

units.text: "Kanon-kun, place your hand against the wound! Please, push firmly! Let's carry him to the bed in the servant room!! Everyone, please, lend a hand."
units.note: MG retains Kanon-kun while changing put to place. UP restores Kanon-san.
units.japanese: 「嘉音さん、傷口に手を当てて！　しっかり押さえて下さい！　使用人室のベッドに運びましょう！！　皆さん、手を貸してください」

description: 確か４発か５発の弾が込められたはずだ becomes Rosa-sama's gun surely has four or five shots loaded. Genji recalls or infers that four or five rounds had been loaded; English asserts that the gun currently has that many shots despite earlier firing.
sourceReading: Genji believes or recalls that Rosa's gun was loaded with four or five rounds, using that initial load as the basis for assessing the danger.

units.text: ".........Rosa-sama's gun surely has four or five shots loaded."
units.note: MG retains surely has and therefore a present verified load. UP says I believe and had four or five shots loaded, restoring both qualification and retrospective loading.
units.japanese: 「………楼座さまの銃は、確か４発か５発の弾が込められたはずだ。」
candidates: Rosa-sama's gun surely has four or five shots loaded

description: 次を撃たせずに銃を奪い取れるかも becomes we should be able to take the gun from her before she shoots again. Gohda offers successful disarmament as a possibility, not an expected result.
sourceReading: Gohda reasons that, if everyone attacks together after allowing one shot, they might manage to seize the gun before Rosa fires another.

units.text: "That is no small number.  ...But loading cartridges into a Winchester should require quite a lot of practice.  She might be able to get one shot off, but if everyone attacks her at once, we should be able to take the gun from her before she shoots again..."
units.note: Both retain should be able to take the gun, strengthening the proposed disarmament from a possibility to an expected result.
units.japanese: 「決して少ない数ではないですね。…でも、ウィンチェスター銃は弾の装填に結構な慣れが必要だったはず。一発目は撃たせてしまうかもしれませんが、みんなで襲い掛かれば、次を撃たせずに銃を奪い取れるかも…。」
candidates: able to take the gun from her before she shoots again

description: あまりよい傾向だと思っていない becomes didn't think of this as that great of a trend. In this medical context 傾向 is a sign or development, while trend is unidiomatic for Kanon's sudden cessation of painful gasping.
sourceReading: Nanjo apparently does not regard the easing of Kanon's gasping as a good sign and watches him continuously.

units.text: Did some medicine take effect at the brink of death, or had Kanon finally stopped even feeling pain? ...For the time being, Kanon had at least gotten over his painful gasping. Nanjo apparently didn't think of this as that great of a trend, and didn't let his eyes off Kanon for a second.
units.note: MG uses good sign. UP retains great of a trend.
units.japanese: 南條はそれをあまりよい傾向だと思っていないらしく、一時も目を離さなかった。
candidates: didn't think of this as that great of a trend

units.text: Had some medicine taken effect at the brink of death, or had Kanon finally stopped even feeling pain? ...For the time being, Kanon had at least gotten over his painful gasping. Nanjo apparently didn't think of this as that great of a trend, and didn't let his eyes off Kanon for a second.
units.note: MG uses good sign. UP retains great of a trend.
units.japanese: 何かの薬が土壇場で効いてくれたのだろうか、それともとうとう嘉音は痛みを感じることすら失われてしまったのか。…嘉音はとりあえず苦痛に喘ぐことだけはなくなった。南條はそれをあまりよい傾向だと思っていないらしく、一時も目を離さなかった。
candidates: didn't think of this as that great of a trend

description: 苦痛に喘ぐことだけはなくなった becomes had at least gotten over his painful gasping. The source observes only that Kanon has stopped gasping in pain, possibly because he can no longer feel it; gotten over conventionally suggests recovery.
sourceReading: Whatever the cause, for the moment Kanon is no longer gasping in pain; Nanjo does not regard the change as reassuring.

units.text: Did some medicine take effect at the brink of death, or had Kanon finally stopped even feeling pain? ...For the time being, Kanon had at least gotten over his painful gasping. Nanjo apparently didn't think of this as that great of a trend, and didn't let his eyes off Kanon for a second.
units.note: MG neutrally says the painful gasping had subsided. UP retains gotten over even though the next line preserves Nanjo's concern.
units.japanese: …嘉音はとりあえず苦痛に喘ぐことだけはなくなった。
candidates: least gotten over his painful gasping

Nanjo apparently didn't think of this as that great of a trend, and didn't let his eyes off Kanon for a second.

candidates: least gotten over his painful gasping

description: 人の生命力 becomes the power of human life. The source refers to human vitality or the human life force sometimes exceeding ordinary expectations; the English noun string is an unnatural calque.
sourceReading: Nanjo considers that human vitality can sometimes exceed what conventional knowledge would predict.

units.text: ......He knew because he was a doctor. It wouldn't have been unexpected if Kanon had lost consciousness after losing so much blood. And yet somehow, he had preserved his awareness so clearly. ......Was it youth?  Or was it tenacity? ...Sometimes, the power of human life surpassed common knowledge......
units.note: Both retain power of human life; UP adds emphatic did but does not repair the calque.
units.japanese: …時に人の生命力は常識を超えることもあるし……。

units.text: ...He knew because he was a doctor. After losing so much blood, Kanon might easily have lost consciousness. And yet, somehow, he was still intensely aware of his surroundings. ...Was it youth? Or was it tenacity? ...Sometimes, the power of human life surpassed common knowledge...
units.note: Both retain power of human life; UP adds emphatic did but does not repair the calque.
units.japanese:
……彼は医者だからわかる。嘉音の出血量なら意識を失って当然だ。
なのにこんなにもはっきりとした意識を保てるなんて。……若さ？　それとも執念？
…時に人の生命力は常識を超えることもあるし……。

units.text:
......He knew because he was a doctor. Kanon should have been expected to fall unconscious after losing so much blood.
And yet somehow, he had preserved his awareness so clearly. ......Youth? Or tenacity?
...Sometimes the power of human life did surpass common knowledge......
units.note: Both retain power of human life; UP adds emphatic did but does not repair the calque.
units.japanese:
……彼は医者だからわかる。嘉音の出血量なら意識を失って当然だ。
なのにこんなにもはっきりとした意識を保てるなんて。……若さ？　それとも執念？
…時に人の生命力は常識を超えることもあるし……。

description: 私たちにも何か武器がいるのでは becomes Are there any weapons we can... . Gohda asks whether they also need some kind of weapon; the translation trails off before supplying either need or a usable predicate.
sourceReading: Alarmed by Kanon's accusation, Gohda asks Genji whether they should arm themselves too.

units.text: ".........Damn...!  What a person...  Genji-san, what should we do?!  Are there any weapons we can..."
units.note: MG retains the unfinished Are there any weapons we can. UP explicitly asks whether they also need weapons, despite stiff word order.
units.japanese: 「………くそ…！　何て人だ…。源次さん、どうしましょう！　私たちにも何か武器がいるのでは…。」

units.text: "......Damn...! What a person... Genji-san, what should we do?! Are there any weapons we can..."
units.note: MG retains the unfinished Are there any weapons we can. UP explicitly asks whether they also need weapons, despite stiff word order.
units.japanese: 「………くそ…！　何て人だ…。源次さん、どうしましょう！　私たちにも何か武器がいるのでは…」

description: にわかには信じられん becomes I cannot believe it so suddenly. Genji says the accusation is not something he can readily believe; suddenly is an unidiomatic rendering of his inability to accept it on the spot.
sourceReading: Genji finds it difficult to believe at once that Rosa would do such a thing.

units.text: "......I cannot believe it so suddenly.  ......That Rosa-sama would do something like......"
units.note: MG uses the idiomatic find it hard to believe. UP changes cannot to can't but retains so suddenly.
units.japanese: 「……にわかには信じられん。……楼座さまがそのようなことを……。」

units.text: "......I can't believe it so suddenly. ......That Rosa‐sama would do something like......"
units.note: MG uses the idiomatic find it hard to believe. UP changes cannot to can't but retains so suddenly.
units.japanese: 「……にわかには信じられん。……楼座さまがそのようなことを……」

description: 指が、深々と、根元まで becomes The finger ... to the base immediately after Kanon inserts two fingers. The source continues to describe the fingers reaching deeply to their bases; English changes the visible count to one.
sourceReading: Both fingers sink deep into the chest wound, all the way to their bases.

units.text: Kanon held up two fingers, showed them to everyone, and slowly started to stick them into the gruesome wound right in the center of his chest... ......Plunging, slimy, squishy, wet. The finger, went in deep, to the base... ......*squish*, *gloop*, *bloop*...
units.note: MG uses plural fingers and bases. UP restores plural fingers but retains singular base.
units.japanese: 指が、深々と、根元まで…。

units.text:
Kanon held up two fingers, showed them to everyone, and slowly started to stick them into the gruesome wound right in the center of his chest... ......Plunging, slimy, squishy, wet.
The fingers...went in deep...to the base... ......Squich, gloop, blorp...
units.note: MG uses plural fingers and bases. UP restores plural fingers but retains singular base.
units.japanese:
嘉音が、立てて見せた二本の指を、ゆっくり、ずぶりと、胸のど真ん中の、惨たらしい傷の中に入れていく…。……ずぶり、ぬめり、ごぷり、溢れて。
指が、深々と、根元まで…。……ぐぽりゅ、ぶぷり、ぬぶる…。

description: デカブツ becomes fatass. The insult targets Gohda as a large hulking brute or big lug; English narrows it to an insult about fatness.
sourceReading: Pinned by Gohda's large body, the false Kanon calls him a big brute while demanding release.

units.text: "L, et...go, you fatass!!"
units.note: Both retain fatass; MG omits you while UP preserves the original phrasing more closely.
units.japanese: 「は、な…せッ、このデカブツがッ！！」

units.text: "L...et...go, fatass!!"
units.note: Both retain fatass; MG omits you while UP preserves the original phrasing more closely.
units.japanese: 「は、な…せッ、このデカブツがッ！！」

units.text: "Let...me...go, you fatass!!"
units.note: Both retain fatass; MG omits you while UP preserves the original phrasing more closely.
units.japanese: 「は、な…せッ、このデカブツがッ！！」

description: 血を吐き出して becomes vomiting blood themselves. Nanjo and Kumasawa lie fallen while their slashed throats emit blood; vomiting relocates the blood to their mouths and stomachs.
sourceReading: Not everyone is merely bloodstained: some of those present are collapsed and pouring or spurting out their own blood from the wounds just inflicted.

units.text: However, not everyone was just stained with blood. Some of them were lying on the ground, vomiting blood themselves.
units.note: MG uses spurting out blood, consistent with the cut throats. UP retains vomiting blood.
units.japanese: 自ら血を吐き出して倒れている者もいた。

units.text:
However, not everyone was just stained with blood.
Some of them were lying on the ground, vomiting blood themselves.
units.note: MG uses spurting out blood, consistent with the cut throats. UP retains vomiting blood.
units.japanese:
しかし、血に塗れた者だけではない。
自ら血を吐き出して倒れている者もいた。

description: 彼らの歯切れは悪い becomes they spoke awkwardly. The source describes their answers as hesitant, evasive, or lacking crispness despite claiming to have witnessed the crime; awkwardly can instead suggest clumsy delivery.
sourceReading: Although the witnesses admit seeing the crime, their account is halting and evasive when asked what they saw.

units.text: Doctor Nanjo and Kumasawa-san had been killed. We understood that much. ...And it seemed that it had occurred in front of these people's eyes. But even so, they spoke awkwardly.
units.note: Both retain spoke awkwardly before describing the witnesses falling silent when pressed.
units.japanese: にもかかわらず、彼らの歯切れは悪い。

units.text: ...And it seemed that it had occurred in front of these people's eyes. But even so, they spoke awkwardly. They admitted that they had definitely seen the crime with their own eyes. But when asked to explain what they had seen, their mouths went suddenly shut. I could understand why Rosa oba-san was irritated and flaring up...
units.note: Both retain spoke awkwardly before describing the witnesses falling silent when pressed.
units.japanese: にもかかわらず、彼らの歯切れは悪い。

units.text: But even so, they spoke awkwardly. They admitted that they had definitely seen the crime with their own eyes. But when asked to explain what they had seen, their mouths went suddenly shut. I could understand why Aunt Rosa was irritated and flaring up...
units.note: Both retain spoke awkwardly before describing the witnesses falling silent when pressed.
units.japanese:
にもかかわらず、彼らの歯切れは悪い。目の前で犯行を確かに見たと認めている。
なのに、何を見たのか説明を求めると急に口を閉ざしてしまうのだ。それがもどかしく、楼座叔母さんが短気になるのもわからなくはなかった…。

units.text:
But even so, they spoke awkwardly. They admitted that they had definitely seen the crime with their own two eyes.
But when asked to explain what they had seen, their mouths went suddenly shut. I could understand why Auntie Rosa was irritated and losing her patience...
units.note: Both retain spoke awkwardly before describing the witnesses falling silent when pressed.

なのに、何を見たのか説明を求めると急に口を閉ざしてしまうのだ。それがもどかしく、楼座叔母さんが短気になるのもわからなくはなかった…。

description: 頭を抱え掻き毟る becomes held his head and scratched at it. Gohda clutches his head and claws or tears at his hair in distress; scratched at it weakens the frantic self-directed action.
sourceReading: Overwhelmed by what he saw, Gohda clutches his head and frantically claws at or tears at his hair despite his imposing build.

units.text: In a manner that didn't match his large body, Gohda held his head and scratched at it... I didn't have a clue whether he was confused because he couldn't remember, or whether he was confused because he had seen something terrifying, and couldn't accept it.
units.note: Both retain held his head and scratched at it.

description: 厨房の勝手口に ... 現れた becomes appeared from the back door in the kitchen. The source locates Kanon's appearance at the kitchen back door; from asserts that he emerged through it.
sourceReading: The charitable reconstruction is that the seriously wounded Kanon appeared at the kitchen's back door and was then carried to the servant room.

units.text: Kanon had appeared from the back door in the kitchen with a serious injury. Then he had been taken to the servant room and cared for. ......Then, something terrifying had happened. Since these people couldn't imagine that Kanon-kun could have pulled it off, they had started to suspect whether that really had been Kanon-kun.  Is that how things are?
units.note: MG locates the appearance near the back door. UP retains appeared from the back door.

description: 何かの手掛かりがあれば becomes if we could find any clues. The source leaves the existence or availability of a clue impersonal while emphasizing Battler exposing the culprit and truth with his own hands; English assigns finding clues to a collective we.
sourceReading: Even now, Battler wants to expose the culprit and truth himself if there is any clue available.

units.text: .........But it was a little surprising that Rosa oba-san was also concerned about the bodies, just like I was. Even at this point, I still wanted to expose the culprit and the truth myself, if we could find any clues.
units.note: MG assigns clue finding to Battler himself, aligning with his emphasized personal agency. UP retains collective we.

description: 南條先生の遺体が安置された becomes Doctor Nanjo's body had been enshrined. In this practical crime-scene account 安置 means that the body was laid or left at rest in the room; enshrined introduces religious or commemorative treatment.
sourceReading: Battler imagines a second culprit waiting under the bed while Nanjo's body lay in the servant room and the others departed.

units.text: That person had hidden under the bed in the servant room beforehand, and while Doctor Nanjo's body had been enshrined here, that person had waited for Genji-san and the rest to leave. Then later, they had crawled out, taken the master key back from Doctor Nanjo's pocket, and carried the two corpses away for some reason. If they had then locked the door with the master key, this closed room would be created.
units.note: Both retain enshrined for the body lying in the room; MG changes the surrounding tense and pronouns.

sourceReading: George registers the existence of the tradition before observing that Kumasawa knew such old stories well.

units.text: "............When it came to those old stories, ...Kumasawa was very knowledgeable."
units.note: MG still begins directly with Kumasawa's knowledge. UP restores a reaction as Interesting story, which is more evaluative than the source but preserves the response beat.
units.japanese: 「…………そんな話が。…熊沢はそういう昔話に詳しかったな。」

units.text: "......When it comes to those old stories, ...Kumasawa was very knowledgeable."

description: その話はもうしなくても大丈夫 tells Shannon that she does not need to keep talking about the matter. You don't have to worry about that changes permission to stop into emotional reassurance.
sourceReading: George stops Shannon from continuing the painful account and assures her that he will not blame her.

units.text: "...Shannon.  You don't have to worry about that anymore.  ......I don't blame you for that."
units.note: Both editions retain You don't have to worry about that anymore and omit George's permission to stop discussing the painful subject.
units.japanese: 「…紗音。その話はもうしなくても大丈夫だよ。……僕は君を責めたりなんかしない。」
candidates: don't have to worry about that anymore

description: 眉唾だと思ってしまう says George cannot help regarding the witch and evil-spirit story as dubious. It just sounded fake presents the story as seeming false or fabricated rather than preserving his skeptical uncertainty.
sourceReading: George listens seriously for Shannon's sake while remaining unable to accept the supernatural account as credible.

units.text: ......Even if he was told a story about witches and evil spirits, it just sounded fake to him. Even so, he listened seriously to Shannon's story, trying find a hint that might relieve at least a little of the pain in her heart.
units.note: Both editions retain sounded fake while preserving that this is George's attributed reaction.
units.japanese: ……魔女や悪霊の話を聞かされても、どうしても眉唾だと思ってしまう。

units.text: ...All this talk about witches and evil spirits just sounded fake to him, even though he was trying to be open-minded. Even so, he listened seriously to Shannon's story, trying find a hint that might relieve at least a little of the pain in her heart.
units.note: Both editions retain sounded fake while preserving that this is George's attributed reaction.
units.japanese: ……魔女や悪霊の話を聞かされても、どうしても眉唾だと思ってしまう。それでも紗音の話を真剣に聞いたのは、彼女の心の痛みを少しでも和らげるヒントが欲しかったからだ。

description: オカルトに詳しい says Kinzo is knowledgeable about the occult. Knows everything about the occult turns expertise into exhaustive knowledge.
sourceReading: George expects the occult-knowledgeable Kinzo to understand why they used Natsuhi's spirit mirror.

units.text: "Grandfather knows everything about the occult.  I'm sure he'll understand if it's about the power of Natsuhi oba-san's spirit mirror.  Don't worry, he won't get mad at you."
units.note: Both editions retain Grandfather knows everything about the occult.
units.japanese: 「オカルトに詳しいお祖父さまだもの。夏妃伯母さんの霊鏡の力だってきっと理解してくれる。大丈夫、怒られたりなんかしない。」
candidates: Grandfather knows everything about the occult

description: 息を殺す is the idiom hold one's breath or remain perfectly quiet. Killed his breathing transfers the Japanese wording literally into unnatural English.
sourceReading: Genji remains motionless and silent while concealing the object beside the chessboard and waiting for the golden butterfly.

units.text: Genji killed his breathing even more than before. .........As he did, .........something flashed gold. From inside an ice pail set on the counter, ...a small gold butterfly appeared, softly and silently. It was almost as though it had seen George and the rest off, and was trying to secretly chase after them......
units.note: Both editions retain Genji killed his breathing.
units.japanese: 源次はなおも息を殺し続ける。

units.text: Genji killed his breathing even more than before. ......As he did, ......something flashed gold. From inside an ice pail set on the counter, ...a small gold butterfly appeared, softly and silently. It was almost as though it had seen George and the rest off...and was trying to secretly chase after them...
units.note: Both editions retain Genji killed his breathing.
units.japanese:
源次はなおも息を殺し続ける。
………すると、………何か黄金色のものが閃いた。配膳台の上に置かれたアイスペールの中から、…小さな黄金の蝶が音もなく、ひらりと現れたのだ。それはまるで、譲治たちが飛び出していくのを見届け、自らもこっそり後を追うかのようだった……。

units.text:
Genji killed his breathing even more than before.
.........As he did, .........something flashed gold. From inside an ice pail set on the counter, ...a small gold butterfly appeared, softly and silently. It was almost as though it had watched George and the rest leave, and was trying to secretly follow them......
units.note: Both editions retain Genji killed his breathing.
