units.text: "That dunce Rudolf just wants to fool around with women!! Rosa bore the baby of a nobody!! Jessica is incompetent and illiterate!! George has none of what it takes to be a man! Battler is a fool who threw away the honor of the Ushiromiya family!! And Maria is obscene to the eye!!"
units.japanese: 「留弗夫の間抜けは女遊びばかりッ！！　楼座はどこの馬の骨ともわからん男の赤ん坊など生みおって！！　朱志香は無能で無学だ！！　譲治には男としての器がない！　戦人は右代宮家の栄誉を自ら捨ておった愚か者だッ！！　真里亞など見るのも汚らわしいッ！！」

description: The sole miracle occupies one outcome among more roulette outcomes than asougi multiplied by nayuta, a named enormous-number product. / Countless, enumerable results omits the named product and its deliberately extravagant scale. / Retains both named numbers and their product.
sourceReading: The sole miracle occupies one outcome among more roulette outcomes than asougi multiplied by nayuta, a named enormous-number product.

units.text: "After all, Moses was able to magnificently summon a miracle engraved on but one of the countless, enumerable results on the roulette of those with power.
units.japanese: 「なぜならモーゼは、力ある者たちのルーレットの、阿僧祇、那由他を掛けたよりも多く存在する目の中にひとつだけ刻まれた奇跡を見事引き寄せることができたからだ」

description: Battler judges Nanjo a calm old gentleman from listening to Nanjo conversation with the women sitting near him. / He looked calm as he listened to the discussion makes Nanjo the listener and replaces Battler assessment from conversation with a visual impression. / From listening in on his conversation preserves Battler as listener and Nanjo participating.
sourceReading: Battler judges Nanjo a calm old gentleman from listening to Nanjo conversation with the women sitting near him.

units.text: Nanjo's probably the only person who could enter Rokkenjima despite being neither a family member nor a servant. He looked like a calm old gentleman as he listened to the discussion between Kyrie and the other women, who sat near to him. ...Considering how long he stayed by the side of our short-tempered Grandfather, his generous heart was probably nothing to laugh at.
units.japanese: 親族と使用人を除いて、ただひとり六軒島に出入りできる存在とも言えるだろう。席の近い霧江さんたち女性陣との会話を聞いている限り、落ち着きのある老紳士という感じだ。……短気な祖父さまとこれだけ長く付き合えたのだから、その大らかさはただものではないだろう。

description: Battler uses Taisho 12, 1923, as the earthquake date when calculating family revival duration. / Taisho 13:1924 changes both era year and corresponding Western year, contradicting MG earlier Taisho 12:1923 at row 79. / Taisho 12:1923 preserves source date consistently.
sourceReading: Battler uses Taisho 12, 1923, as the earthquake date when calculating family revival duration.

units.text: I'm pretty sure this all happened during {ruby:Showa 25:1950 or so. The Great Kanto Earthquake happened in {ruby:Taisho 13:1924, so... ......That means Grandfather was able to revive the near-dead Ushiromiya family in only about 20 years to a level even higher than it had ever been before.
units.japanese:
朝鮮特需が確か、昭和２５年頃だっけ？
んで、関東大震災が大正１２年ってことは。……祖父さまは瀕死の右代宮家を、わずか２０数年でかつて以上に復興させちまったわけだ。

description: Gohda first says the difficult circumstances nevertheless gave him this new cooking opportunity; he then separately thanks Madam for giving that opportunity. / Thanks to the Madam at 175 replaces the retrospective benefit of the prior trouble with the later explicit gratitude recipient. / Thanks to this preserves retrospective causal connection, followed by thanks to Madam at 178.
sourceReading: Gohda first says the difficult circumstances nevertheless gave him this new cooking opportunity; he then separately thanks Madam for giving that opportunity.

units.text: "The world is a difficult place. However, thanks to the Madam, I was given a chance to display my skills as a chef once again, this time for the Ushiromiya family.
units.japanese: 「……世の中というのは難しいものです。しかし、そのお陰でこうして今日、右代宮家で再び料理人として腕を振るう機会を賜ることができました」

description: Kumasawa has stolen Gohda’s customary role/the show with her food jokes, leaving him seriously defending the actual dinner menu. / His show had totally been stolen conveys お株を奪われる idiom. / His stock had been stolen from him introduces an opaque literal stock theft instead of someone usurping his specialty/role.
sourceReading: Kumasawa has stolen Gohda’s customary role/the show with her food jokes, leaving him seriously defending the actual dinner menu.

units.text: Kumasawa‐san, together with Shannon‐chan, bowed and pushed the serving cart away. Amusingly, Gohda‐san, who looked just as though his stock had been stolen from him, explained very seriously that tonight's dinner would actually be calf steak.
units.japanese: 熊沢さんは紗音ちゃんと一緒にお辞儀すると、配膳ワゴンを押しながら退出していった。すっかりお株を奪われてしまった郷田さんが、今晩は仔牛のステーキですのでと大真面目に弁明しているのも可笑しかった。

description: Natsuhi confronts Eva with an openly displeased expression, not concealing it (憮然とした表情を隠すこともなく). / Astonished substitutes surprise for the displeasure conveyed by her rebuke. / Astonished likewise changes emotion; unable to hide also replaces openly not concealing with inability to conceal.
sourceReading: Natsuhi confronts Eva with an openly displeased expression, not concealing it (憮然とした表情を隠すこともなく).

units.text: Natsuhi jumped on Eva, not even bothering to hide her astonished expression. Eva stared back daringly, but Hideyoshi realized what was going on and tried to smooth things over with a forced smile.
units.japanese: 夏妃が憮然とした表情を隠すこともなく絵羽に突きつける。それに対し絵羽は不敵な表情を返すが、それに気付いた秀吉がすぐに取り繕うように苦笑いする。

units.text: Natsuhi jumped on Eva, unable to hide her astonished expression. In response, Eva returned a defiant look, but Hideyoshi noticed and tried to smooth things over with a forced smile.
units.japanese: 夏妃が憮然とした表情を隠すこともなく絵羽に突きつける。それに対し絵羽は不敵な表情を返すが、それに気付いた秀吉がすぐに取り繕うように苦笑いする。

description: Leaving is an expected courtesy for Nanjo as an outsider; others envy his ability to escape. / To an outsider it may have seemed turns outsider into an observer evaluating the courtesy, rather than Nanjo role warranting withdrawal. / Courtesy expected of an outsider preserves role-based explanation.
sourceReading: Leaving is an expected courtesy for Nanjo as an outsider; others envy his ability to escape.

units.text: Nanjo rose from his seat and exited the parlor. ...To an outsider, it may have seemed like a normal act of courtesy, but his back was watched by several glances envious of his ability to escape.
units.japanese: 南條は席を立ち、客間を出て行く。……部外者ならば当然の気遣いだろうが、この場を退出できることを羨む眼差しがその背中を見送っていた。

description: Eva addresses Krauss: she hears he is very bullish/confident now (兄さん、今は大変強気だそうじゃない), then cites boom and rising yen as reasons for that confidence. / I hear the times have been extremely good lately replaces Krauss stance with a statement about economic conditions. / I hear these are very good times likewise removes the opening assessment of Krauss confidence.
sourceReading: Eva addresses Krauss: she hears he is very bullish/confident now (兄さん、今は大変強気だそうじゃない), then cites boom and rising yen as reasons for that confidence.

units.text: "Nii-san, I hear the times have been extremely good lately. Yes, since last year, we've been in an unprecedented boom, and the yen keeps on rising. It seems that it's no longer a dream that the dollar will reach 100 yen.
units.japanese: 「兄さん、今は大変強気だそうじゃない？　そうよねぇ、去年以降、空前の好景気で円は上がる一方。＄が１００円に至るのだって夢物語じゃなさそうよぅ？」
candidates: hear the times have been extremely good lately

units.text: "Nii‐san, I hear these are very good times nowadays. That's right, since last year the yen has just been going up and up thanks to the unprecedented boom in prosperity. It seems that it's no longer a dream that the dollar will reach 100 yen."
units.japanese: 「兄さん、今は大変強気だそうじゃない？　そうよねぇ、去年以降、空前の好景気で円は上がる一方。＄が１００円に至るのだって夢物語じゃなさそうよぅ？」
candidates: hear these are very good times

description: Hideyoshi asks where Krauss obtained the massive funds supporting his recent investments, then explains their investigation into who could have supplied them. / Who exactly do you expect to provide funding and you’ll need enough recasts the initial question as prospective funding need, rather than source of funds already obtained. / Who supplied you with funds preserves the retrospective question.
sourceReading: Hideyoshi asks where Krauss obtained the massive funds supporting his recent investments, then explains their investigation into who could have supplied them.

units.text: ".........However, Krauss nii-san, after all your failures in the past, who exactly do you expect to provide you with funding? And this isn't some small amount we're talkin's about. You'll need enough funding to fill the massive hole you've dug."
units.japanese: 「………だがな、蔵臼兄さん。これまで、さんざん負け続けた兄さんが、どこから軍資金を調達したって言うんや。それも半端ない軍資金や。あれだけの穴を埋められる軍資金やで？」
candidates: exactly do you expect to provide

description: Eva asks whether a person like Krauss would be allowed to call himself successor. UP makes the courts the people who would address him as successor, changing the agent and action of the challenge.

units.text: "Let me say it clearly, Nii‐san—what you are doing is embezzlement. You are betraying our father. I imagine that we will leave you to the mercy of the courts after this is all over. Do you think those people will kindly agree to address you as "successor to the Ushiromiya head house"?"
units.japanese: 「はっきり言うわ、兄さんがしているのは横領よ。お父様に対する裏切りよ？　然るべき決着が付いた後には司法に委ねることになるでしょうねぇ？　そんな輩に右代宮本家跡継ぎを名乗らせるとお思い？」

description: Natsuhi invokes their daily effort to remain noble and upright so as to inherit the family glory. MG replaces this with effort to earn that glory, omitting the moral ideal she claims to uphold. UP preserves striving to be paragons of nobility.

units.text: They are making light of the fact that we protect the glory of the Ushiromiya family, even though we are constantly expending every effort to earn that glory from Father. They trample all of that underfoot with their hateful rambling!!!
units.japanese: 「私たちが右代宮家の栄光を守り、お父様からそれを受け継ぐため日々高潔であろうとする全ての努力を蔑ろにして踏み躙る、何という聞き難い暴言ッ！！」

description: The painful, distressing atmosphere left after Natsuhi breaks down becomes a somewhat embarrassed mood in both editions, weakening the narration from witnessed emotional pain to social embarrassment.

units.text: Natsuhi was already unable to hide her tears. She flew from the room in that state. After that, all that remained was a somewhat embarrassed mood about the parlor...
units.japanese:
夏妃はもはや涙も隠せない。
そのまま客間を飛び出していった。後には痛々しい空気だけが残り、客間を満たしていた…。

units.text:
Natsuhi could no longer hide her tears.
She flew from the room in that state. After that, all that remained was a somewhat embarrassed mood about the parlor...
units.japanese:
夏妃はもはや涙も隠せない。
そのまま客間を飛び出していった。後には痛々しい空気だけが残り、客間を満たしていた…。

description: Kumasawa says Natsuhi cannot simply reconcile herself to the fact that the delay in childbirth was not her fault. Both editions say she will not allow herself to see it that way, making emotional inability sound like deliberate refusal.

units.text: Even so, Madam won't allow herself to see things this way... ......She probably can't help but cry bitter tears as a woman...at her inability to carry out the duties expected of a wife...
units.japanese: だからといって、奥様にはそうと割り切れるはずもない…。……ただただ、妻としての責務を全うできなかったことに、女として悔し涙を零すしかできないでしょう…。

units.text: Even so, Madam won't allow herself to see things this way... ......She probably can't help but cry bitter tears at her inability to carry out the duties expected of a wife...
units.japanese: だからといって、奥様にはそうと割り切れるはずもない…。……ただただ、妻としての責務を全うできなかったことに、女として悔し涙を零すしかできないでしょう…。

description: Kinzo initially had no political or financial connections. Both editions replace the political world with the business world, eliminating one of the two stated spheres of his initial isolation.

units.text: Grandfather came from a branch family and had no connections in the business world or the financial world. Even though he later built connections with the occupying forces, he supposedly started as a nameless person who hadn't yet gained anyone's trust.
units.japanese: 祖父さまは分家筋から来た人間で、政界にも財界にもコネクションはなく、後に進駐軍に太いコネクションを築くにしても、一番の最初は誰の信頼も得ていない無名の人物だったはずだ。

units.text: Grandfather came from a branch family and had no connections in the business world or the financial world. Even though he later built connections with the occupying forces, in the beginning he was supposedly a nameless person who had not yet gained anyone's trust.
units.japanese: 祖父さまは分家筋から来た人間で、政界にも財界にもコネクションはなく、後に進駐軍に太いコネクションを築くにしても、一番の最初は誰の信頼も得ていない無名の人物だったはずだ。

description: The narrated account says Kinzo was a great magician who kept studying alchemy and demon summoning. Both editions instead say he researched in order to become a great magician, replacing a claimed existing status with an aim.

units.text: Grandfather then went on and on about his continuing research into alchemy and techniques for summoning demons in order to become a great magician. ...And the entity summoned as the result of the demon-calling ceremony...was the Golden Witch Beatrice.
units.japanese: 祖父さまは偉大なる魔術師で、錬金術、悪魔召喚の術を研究し続けていて云々かんぬん。…そして、悪魔を呼び出す儀式の果てに召喚したのが、黄金の魔女ベアトリーチェなのだという。
candidates: in order to become a great magician

units.text: He then went on and on about how he continued to research alchemy and techniques for summoning demons in order to become a great mage. ...And the entity summoned as the result of the demon‐calling ritual was the Golden Witch Beatrice.
units.japanese: 祖父さまは偉大なる魔術師で、錬金術、悪魔召喚の術を研究し続けていて云々かんぬん。…そして、悪魔を呼び出す儀式の果てに召喚したのが、黄金の魔女ベアトリーチェなのだという。
candidates: in order to become a great mage

description: Jessica says Kinzo himself had the epitaph written. MG says he wrote it himself, replacing personal commissioning with personal authorship. UP preserves had it written himself.

units.text: "This epitaph was made two years ago. And since Grandfather wrote it himself... ...yeah, it does make the Legend of the Gold seem more believable.
units.japanese: 「この碑文を書かせたのは２年前。それも祖父さま自身ってなると、……なるほど、黄金伝説も信憑性が増してくるじゃねぇか」

description: The parents actually got lost in the uninhabited forest, making their exploration dangerous. Both editions describe only a danger of getting lost, losing the reported occurrence that prompted the warning.

units.text: However, since there was the danger of them getting lost in the abandoned forest, Grandmother began to spread the story that the witch lived in the forest and approaching it was forbidden.
units.japanese: だが、無人の森に入って迷子になったりして危なかったため、祖母さま辺りが、森には魔女が住んでいるから危ない、近寄ってはいけない、というような話を吹き込んだんだとか…。
candidates: there was the danger of them getting lost

units.text: However, since there was the danger of them getting lost in the abandoned forest, Grandmother or someone began to spread the story that the witch lived in the forest and approaching it was too dangerous...
units.japanese: だが、無人の森に入って迷子になったりして危なかったため、祖母さま辺りが、森には魔女が住んでいるから危ない、近寄ってはいけない、というような話を吹き込んだんだとか…。
candidates: there was the danger of them getting lost

description: The warning is reportedly attributed to Grandmother or someone in that circle. MG states directly that Grandmother began spreading it, removing both the approximate attribution and reported status. UP retains Grandmother or someone.

units.text: However, since there was the danger of them getting lost in the abandoned forest, Grandmother began to spread the story that the witch lived in the forest and approaching it was forbidden.
units.japanese: だが、無人の森に入って迷子になったりして危なかったため、祖母さま辺りが、森には魔女が住んでいるから危ない、近寄ってはいけない、というような話を吹き込んだんだとか…。
candidates: Grandmother began to spread the story

description: George allows a human sponsor explanation conditionally: if such a person existed, Kinzo might have called that sponsor a witch. WH connects “no way anyone would ... lend” directly to “Because of that ... call his sponsor a witch,” losing the hypothetical bridge.

units.text: "......Well, it's certainly not a realistic story. At that time, when Grandfather was still nameless without any connections, there's no way anyone would have just lent him a massive quantity of gold bars for free. ......Although, it's not unthinkable to suggest that's exactly why Grandfather called his sponsor a witch."
units.japanese: 「……確かに現実的な話じゃないよね。当時、無名で何のコネクションもなかったお祖父さまに、無償で莫大な金塊を融資する人物なんているわけがない。……それがいたからこそ、お祖父さまはそのスポンサーを魔女と呼んだ、というなら考えられない話じゃないけど」
candidates: that's exactly why Grandfather called his sponsor a witch

description: Jessica proposes a wealthy, leisured lady as Kinzo’s possible benefactor. Both editions make her a rich man’s wife, adding a husband and locating her wealth in him.

units.text: "Hehehe, maybe some rich man's leisured wife generously granted it to Grandfather. And maybe he started calling this person a witch."
units.japanese: 「へへへ、祖父さまに、大金持ちの有閑マダムが気前よく恵んでくれて。そのご婦人を魔女と呼んだ、ってことじゃねぇのかー？」

units.text: "Hehehe, maybe some rich man's leisured wife generously granted it to Grandfather. And maybe then he started calling this lady a witch?"
units.japanese: 「へへへ、祖父さまに、大金持ちの有閑マダムが気前よく恵んでくれて。そのご婦人を魔女と呼んだ、ってことじゃねぇのかー？」

description: George recalls Maria writing her ambition in a school anthology of compositions. Both editions replace the anthology with social studies, inventing a subject and losing the form of the written recollection.

units.text: "Come to think of it, Maria-chan, in social studies at your school, when you were asked to write what you wanted to be when you grew up, you wrote "a witch", didn't you?"
units.japanese: 「確か真里亞ちゃんは学校の文集に、将来なりたいものは『魔女』って書いたんだっけ？」

units.text: "Come to think of it, Maria‐chan, in social studies at your school, when you were asked to write what you wanted to be when you grew up, you wrote "a witch", didn't you?"
units.japanese: 「確か真里亞ちゃんは学校の文集に、将来なりたいものは『魔女』って書いたんだっけ？」

description: A little moisture wells at the corners of Maria’s eyes. Both editions say tears start running, advancing the restrained onset of tears to flowing tears.

units.text: Maria nodded seriously. Tears started to run from the corners of her eyes.
units.japanese:
真里亞は真剣に頷く。
目の端に涙がちょっぴり滲んでいた。

units.text:
Maria nodded seriously.
Tears started to run from the corners of her eyes.
units.japanese:
真里亞は真剣に頷く。
目の端に涙がちょっぴり滲んでいた。

description: Battler is flustered because he does not understand Maria’s insistence. MG makes him impatient, shifting his immediate emotional response from being unsettled to irritation. UP’s feeling pressured preserves the predicament.

units.text: I started getting impatient, not knowing why Maria was jumping on me like this. Then, Jessica tapped me on the shoulder and whispered.
units.japanese: 真里亞が何でこんなにも突っかかってくるのかわからなくて焦る。すると朱志香が俺の肩を叩いて小声で教えてくれた。

description: George estimates that several decades must have passed since Kinzo met the woman. Both editions state that several decades have passed, removing the estimated status of the elapsed time within his speculation.

units.text: "Ahahahaha. In addition to the patron theory, there's also a theory that she was Grandfather's first love. ...Either way, although it's been several decades since he met her, even now she holds a special place in his heart. ...Which must mean that he's still captivated by her."
units.japanese: 「あはははは。パトロン説の他にも、お祖父さまの初恋の人だという説もあるんだ。…どちらにせよ、彼女に出会ってから数十年を経ているだろうにも関わらず、今なお心の中に大きく居座り続けているんだから、…それは今なお虜にしているということなんだろうね」

units.text: "Ahahahaha. In addition to the patron theory, there's also a theory that she was Grandfather's first love. ...Either way, although it's been several decades since he met her, even now she holds a special place in his heart. ...Which must mean that he is still captivated by her even today."
units.japanese: 「あはははは。パトロン説の他にも、お祖父さまの初恋の人だという説もあるんだ。…どちらにせよ、彼女に出会ってから数十年を経ているだろうにも関わらず、今なお心の中に大きく居座り続けているんだから、…それは今なお虜にしているということなんだろうね」

description: Krauss says that without the expansion of foreign demand the family would not have recovered and Kinzo would have been pursued as a fraud. Both editions make failure to restore the family an additional condition alongside the absent Korean War demand, instead of preserving failure of restoration as a consequence.

units.text: ...Luckily, his use of those funds proved successful. If the Korean War Demands hadn't come and the Ushiromiya family had not been restored, Father would probably have been hounded after as the crook of the century."
units.japanese: 「……運よく、その資産の運用に成功できた。もし当時の外需拡大がなかったら右代宮家の再興はならず、親父殿は世紀のペテン師として追われていただろう」
candidates: and the Ushiromiya family had not been restored

units.text: "......Fortunately, his use of those funds proved successful. If the Korean war demands hadn't come and the Ushiromiya family had not been restored, Father would probably have been hounded after as the crook of the century."
units.japanese: 「……運よく、その資産の運用に成功できた。もし当時の外需拡大がなかったら右代宮家の再興はならず、親父殿は世紀のペテン師として追われていただろう」
candidates: and the Ushiromiya family had not been restored

description: Eva challenges Krauss: if he insists his funds cannot possibly come from embezzling Kinzo’s personal assets, the other explanation follows. Both editions say if we rule out embezzlement, removing Krauss’s denial as the premise and making the siblings themselves perform the exclusion.

units.text: "Nii-san, you've gathered a massive supply of funds. That's a fact. If we rule out the possibility that you've been embezzling Father's personal funds, ...then there's only one possibility left, right?"
units.japanese: 「兄さんが莫大な軍資金を調達したのは事実。それが、お父様の個人資産の横領では断じてありえないと言うなら。……つまりはそういうことよぅ？」
candidates: If we rule out the possibility

units.text: "Nii‐san, the fact is that you've obtained a massive amount of funding. If we rule out the possibility that you have been embezzling Father's personal funds, ......then there's only one possibility left, right?"
units.japanese: 「兄さんが莫大な軍資金を調達したのは事実。それが、お父様の個人資産の横領では断じてありえないと言うなら。……つまりはそういうことよぅ？」
candidates: If we rule out the possibility

description: Rudolf says the distribution payment will be settled as part of the inheritance at Kinzo’s death. MG instead says the gold will be liquidated and distributed, adding a requirement to sell the gold itself. UP retains payment of the distribution money.

units.text: "Our fourth condition: The gold will be liquidated and distributed along with the inheritance at the time of Father's death. However, as a deposit, 10% of our portions are to be paid to us promptly. These payments must be made before March of next year."
units.japanese: 「条件の４。分配金は親父の死亡時に遺産分配に含めて清算する。ただし、手付金として俺たちの取り分の１０％を即納してもらう。支払いは来年３月までだ」
candidates: The gold will be liquidated and distributed

description: The narrator explicitly calls Eva’s guarantee sophistry before explaining that the siblings would not honor it. UP calls it insignificant details, replacing exposure of a deceptive promise with dismissal of details. MG play on words is weaker than sophistry but retains verbal evasion in context.

units.text: Insignificant details. The others, who were forcing Krauss to pay money for some nonexistent gold, would of course not ensure Krauss's portion if they actually found the gold. From the beginning, this deal had been nothing more than a threat directed at Krauss.
units.japanese: 詭弁だ。存在しない黄金にカネを払わせた彼らが、仮に本当に黄金を見つけたとして、蔵臼に取り分を保証するわけなどない。この取引は初めから蔵臼に対して脅迫的なのだ。

description: Krauss says his numerous advance investments are guaranteed to return funds in future, although they presently leave his finances strained. Both editions call the investments themselves future investments, moving the expenditure into the future instead of preserving money already committed.

units.text: "The part about promptly paying ten percent of your share, 750 million yen. As you pointed out, my financial situation is far from prosperous. While I can guarantee that I will collect on various future investments, I must admit that I am quite poor at the present moment."
units.japanese: 「分け前の１割、７億５千万円を即納する点だよ。お前たちの指摘通り、私の財政状況は決して裕福ではない。数々の先行投資によって、未来に必ず回収できると保証されながらも、今のこの時点では火の車であることは認めなければならない」

units.text: "The part about promptly paying ten percent of each portion, 750 million yen. As you pointed out, my financial situation is not prosperous. While I am guaranteed to definitely collect on various future investments, at this time I have no choice but to admit that I am very poor."
units.japanese: 「分け前の１割、７億５千万円を即納する点だよ。お前たちの指摘通り、私の財政状況は決して裕福ではない。数々の先行投資によって、未来に必ず回収できると保証されながらも、今のこの時点では火の車であることは認めなければならない」

description: Rudolf forbids strange suspicions and negotiation: Krauss is to answer whether he will sign. Both editions instead forbid suspicious moves or anything suspicious, replacing Krauss’s probing suspicion about their motives with suspect conduct in general.

units.text: "Quit it, Aniki. All we're asking is whether you're gonna sign or not. Just forget about making any strange deals or any other suspicious moves."
units.japanese: 「よせよ兄貴。俺たちは兄貴がサインするかしないかしか聞いてない。妙な勘繰りも交渉もなしだ」

units.text: "Quit it, Aniki. All we're asking is whether you're going to sign or not. Just forget about making any strange deals or anything suspicious."
units.japanese: 「よせよ兄貴。俺たちは兄貴がサインするかしないかしか聞いてない。妙な勘繰りも交渉もなしだ」

description: Hideyoshi makes a hand-rubbing gesture while assuming a deferential expression. UP gives clasped hands, changing the ingratiating gesture. MG preserves rubbing his hands.

units.text: Hideyoshi had a humble expression on his face and had his hands clasped together, but his eyes were not calm at all. ......Krauss had already seen through the shadow in the depths of those eyes.
units.japanese: 秀吉は謙遜するような表情を浮かべながら揉み手のような仕草をするが、その瞳は決して落ち着いたものではなかった。……蔵臼は、その瞳の中の影をすでに見抜いていた。

description: Hideyoshi operates a restaurant chain. UP specifies a fast-food chain, narrowing the business type beyond the Japanese. MG preserves restaurant chain.

units.text: Hideyoshi's company was a fast‐food‐chain operating company that he had started from nothing. Through Hideyoshi's management efforts, performance of the business repeatedly rose and magnified, and ultimately it succeeded in becoming a stock‐listed company.
units.japanese: 秀吉の会社は、ゼロからスタートした外食チェーン運営会社だった。秀吉の経営努力により次々と業績を上げ事業を拡大、ついに念願の株式上場を果たした。

description: The narrator describes Rudolf’s niche business as not respectable or aboveboard. UP renders this as not a sunny job, an opaque literal image that weakens the shady-business characterization. MG not exposed to the light of day preserves the concealment metaphor in context.

units.text: Rudolf had been building a large amount of wealth with a certain type of niche market. ...However, a niche is a niche. It's definitely not a sunny job. An American corporate giant was trying to accuse Rudolf's company of violating their rights. For various reasons, it was thought that winning the trial was extremely unlikely, and Rudolf was being pressed to surrender outright.
units.japanese: 留弗夫はある種の隙間産業で莫大な財を築いていた。…だが、隙間は隙間。決して日向の仕事ではない。米国の巨大企業は留弗夫の会社を権利侵害で告訴しようとしていた。様々な条件から、裁判での勝ち目は非常に薄いと考えられ、留弗夫は全面的な降伏を迫られていたのである。

description: The narrator sums up the siblings’ common desperate need for cash with nothing to it / in short. UP says there was nothing to fear, inserting an explicit fear judgment where the source simply demystifies their motives.

units.text: ......There was nothing to fear. Every one of them,
units.japanese: ……何のことはない。彼らは全員が全員、

description: Krauss sarcastically recalls that the siblings said he had no sponsors. Both editions say they claimed he had no influence, replacing the specific denied funding contacts with his general influence.

units.text: "...However, if you do insist on relying on your big brother, I wouldn't mind using my influence to help you find such a sponsor. .........Oh wait, I do believe you said that I have no influence. Well then, I'm afraid I won't be much help to you. ......Hehheheheheheheh!"
units.japanese: 「……もしお前たちが、どうしてもこの兄を頼りたいというなら。私の口利きでスポンサーを探してやってもよいのだがね。………おっと、私にはそんなものはいないと言っていたか。それではどうにもならんねぇ。……ふっふふふふふふふふ！」

units.text: "......If you're still set on relying on your older brother, I could use my influence to find you sponsors. .........Oh wait, you already said that I have no influence. Well then, I can't do anything, can I? ......Hehheheheheheheh!"
units.japanese: 「……もしお前たちが、どうしてもこの兄を頼りたいというなら。私の口利きでスポンサーを探してやってもよいのだがね。………おっと、私にはそんなものはいないと言っていたか。それではどうにもならんねぇ。……ふっふふふふふふふふ！」

description: Krauss says that if the hidden gold were found he could immediately give the others 2.5 billion each. MG says if you found it you could divide it, assigning the hypothetical discovery and distribution to the listeners instead of preserving Krauss as giver.

units.text: "In times like these, it certainly would be nice to find Father's hidden gold. If you did, you could split it up into 2.5 billion yen portions right now. How sad, how sad. How very sad! How extremely, totally, truly, hopelessly sad!"
units.japanese: 「こんな時、本当に親父殿の隠し黄金が見付かればいいんだがねぇ。そうすればすぐに２５億ずつをこの場で切り分けてやれるのだが。残念残念、残念至極！　非常に極めて実にどうしようもなく残念だ！」
candidates: If you did, you could split it up

description: Kinzo says he only wants to see Beatrice’s smile once more. MG says one last time, adding finality beyond the renewed encounter he asks for. UP preserves one more time.

units.text: I'll let you have the lives of all those others! I don't need wealth or honor or assets or gold or anything! All I want is to see your smile one last time!! *coughcoughcough*!!"
units.japanese: 「他のやつらの命はくれてやる！　富も名誉も財産も黄金も何もいらぬ！　ただお前の微笑みがもう一度見たいだけなのだッ！！　ゲホンゲホンゴホン！！」

description: Kinzo explicitly includes Ushiromiya family headship among the rewards for solving the epitaph. MG calls it inheritance of the family, losing the specific office of head. UP preserves succession to family headship.

units.text: "That's fine. ...It all comes down to this. I will give all that I have built up to the one who solves the mystery of Beatrice's epitaph. Wealth, honor, gold, and the inheritance of the Ushiromiya family. Everything that I have established!
units.japanese: 「よい。……つまりはこういうことだ。ベアトリーチェの碑文の謎を解いた者には、私が築き上げてきた全てを与えよう。富、名誉、黄金、そして右代宮家の家督、私が築き上げてきた全てだ！」
candidates: the inheritance of the Ushiromiya family

description: Krauss professes to negotiate favorable accommodation on interest. UP instead promises to negotiate borrowing the interest too, inventing additional financing of interest payments.
sourceReading: MG retains highest interest rate. UP replaces it with borrowing the interest as well; that is a different misconstrual of accommodation on interest, not retained highest-rate wording.

units.text: "I told you, didn't I? All I can do is find other sponsors for you. Of course, I will do my utmost to negotiate so that you can borrow the interest as well. Hehheheheh, gahahahahahahahaha!!"
units.japanese: 「言ったではないか。私にできるのは他のスポンサーを探すだけだよ。もちろん、利息を融通してもらえるようには最大限、交渉するがね。ふふふふふ、くっくくくくくくく！！」

description: The narrator supposes that disrespectful discussion about Kinzo is probably taking place in the parlor and that Genji must feel disapproval. Both editions say Genji knows the discussion is taking place, replacing the probable content of an unseen conversation with his knowledge of it.

units.text: For the most part, Genji also understood the family's situation. ...It must have made him want to frown, knowing that right now in the lounge, the master he served was being discussed so disrespectfully. But it would have been very difficult to gather that from his indifferent expression.
units.japanese: 源次も一族の状況は大体わかっている。…客間で現在、仕える主に対して不敬な話題が交わされているであろうことには、眉をひそめたい気持ちもあったに違いない。だがそれを、その淡白な表情から測るのはとても難しかった。
candidates: knowing that right now in the lounge

units.text: For the most part, Genji also understood the family's situation. ...It must have made him want to frown, knowing that right now in the parlor, the master he served was being discussed so disrespectfully. But it would have been very difficult to gather that from his indifferent expression.
units.japanese: 源次も一族の状況は大体わかっている。…客間で現在、仕える主に対して不敬な話題が交わされているであろうことには、眉をひそめたい気持ちもあったに違いない。だがそれを、その淡白な表情から測るのはとても難しかった。
candidates: knowing that right now in the parlor

description: The third treasure revives even lost love. UP instead revives all the love they possessed, dropping loss and adding all plus an unspecified plural possessor. MG preserves resurrection of the love that was lost.

units.text: One even revives all the love they possessed.
units.japanese: 一つは、失った愛すらも蘇らせる。

description: George locates Sogakishi about five kilometers north of Odawara Castle. MG says north of Odawara, losing the specific reference point. UP preserves the castle.

units.text: "It was about five kilometers to the north of Odawara. We definitely found a place called Sogakishi there.
units.japanese: 「小田原城の、北に５ｋｍくらいだったかな。そこには確かに曽我岸という地名があるよ」

description: George suggests that the branch families probably were not restricted to Odawara. MG states that not all branch families lived there, converting his supposition about geographic scope into a definite distribution of residences. UP preserves probably not limited to that.

units.text: "The Ushiromiya family may have been living in Odawara, but not all of the branch families were. Grandfather often called himself part of a branch of a branch family, the least connected to the successor."
units.japanese: 「右代宮本家は小田原に住んでたかもしれないけど、分家はその限りじゃなかったろうね。お祖父さまはよく自分のことを、分家も分家、跡継ぎにもっとも縁遠かった、と言われるくらいだからね」

description: Kinzo described himself as a branch of a branch, furthest removed from becoming heir. MG makes him least connected to the successor, turning remoteness from succession into a relationship with an unspecified successor. UP preserves succession.

units.text: "The Ushiromiya family may have been living in Odawara, but not all of the branch families were. Grandfather often called himself part of a branch of a branch family, the least connected to the successor."
units.japanese: 「右代宮本家は小田原に住んでたかもしれないけど、分家はその限りじゃなかったろうね。お祖父さまはよく自分のことを、分家も分家、跡継ぎにもっとも縁遠かった、と言われるくらいだからね」

description: Jessica says she has never heard of Kinzo’s hometown and doubts he would tell her even if asked. UP says she has never asked about it, replacing absence of received information with a claim about her own past questioning. MG preserves never heard.

units.text: "I've never even asked about Grandfather's old home. And he probably wouldn't give it away if I did."
units.japanese: 「祖父さまの故郷なんて聞いたこともないぜ。聞いても、素直に教えちゃくれねぇだろうしよー」

description: Battler accepts sacrifices for the witch’s revival as one possible interpretation. MG says that is what it would mean, strengthening a possible reading into the meaning. UP preserves you can take it that way.

units.text: "...I see, sacrifices to restore the witch... Yeah, that's what it'd mean. Near the end, the witch'll be revived on the ninth twilight... ...That last part is guaranteed."
units.japanese: 「…なるほど魔女復活のための生贄か…。そういう解釈にもなるな。その結果、第九の晩に魔女が蘇って……。…最後は極めつけだな」

description: Shannon says Kanon told her that he saw something like the lights on a patrol. MG directly says Kanon saw it, removing the explicit reported status of his sighting. UP preserves said he saw.

units.text: "In addition, some servants have also seen will-o'-the-wisps and glittering butterflies dancing around. ...Kanon-kun also saw something like that when he went patrolling one night.
units.japanese: 「他にも、鬼火や輝く蝶々が舞っているのを見たという使用人も。……嘉音くんもそれらしいものを、以前、夜の見回りの時に見たことがあると言ってました」

description: Shannon advises against excessive fear, then reports that respect prevents the witch doing harm. UP makes not acting oddly afraid an additional condition for safety and omits the reported they say framing. MG separates reassurance and respect condition and retains I hear.

units.text: "Ah, ...but, there's nothing to be afraid of, you know? Beatrice‐sama is another ruler of this mansion separate from the Master. So, she won't do anything bad, as long as you respect her and don't act oddly afraid."
units.japanese: 「あ、…でも、怯えることはないんですよ？　ベアトリーチェさまはお館様とは異なる、もう一人のお屋敷の主です。だから変に怯えたりしないで、敬意を持っていれば、決して悪いことはしないのだそうです」

description: Battler guesses Maria may have finished consulting her notebook before she closes it. MG states she finally found what she sought, changing tentative completion of research into definite discovery. UP preserves perhaps finished research.

units.text: When Maria finally found what she was looking for, she snapped the notebook shut and threw it into her handbag. She then began fishing through that bag's contents. There seemed to be various jumbled up things in there.
units.japanese: やがて調べ物を終えたのか、手帳をパチンと勢いよく閉じるとそれを手提げに放り込み、さらにその中身を漁り始める。どうもごちゃごちゃと色々なものがしまわれているようだった。

description: Maria says scorpions have protective power to ward off evil. Both editions describe warding off or blocking magic, broadening the protection into opposition to magic generally rather than harmful beings/influences.

units.text: "Uu-! With these charms, you don't even need to worry about Beatrice! Because scorpions have the power to ward off magic!"
units.japanese:
「うー！　このお守りならベアトリーチェも大丈夫！　サソリは魔除けの力があるから！」
俺の余計な一言でもう一度真里亞に火をつけてしまった…。真里亞は再び手帳を取り出すと、様々なページを開いては突きつけ、いかにサソリには神聖な力があって、古来から魔除けの魔法陣に描かれてきたかを延々と説かれることになった。

units.text: I'd said too much and angered Maria again... Maria took out her notebook again, pointing out various pages as she went on and on about how the scorpion had such incredible holy power that it had been used in magic-repelling magical circles since ancient times.
units.japanese:
「うー！　このお守りならベアトリーチェも大丈夫！　サソリは魔除けの力があるから！」
俺の余計な一言でもう一度真里亞に火をつけてしまった…。真里亞は再び手帳を取り出すと、様々なページを開いては突きつけ、いかにサソリには神聖な力があって、古来から魔除けの魔法陣に描かれてきたかを延々と説かれることになった。

units.text: "Uu! With these charms, even Beatrice is no problem! Because the scorpion has the power to block magic!"
units.japanese:
「うー！　このお守りならベアトリーチェも大丈夫！　サソリは魔除けの力があるから！」
俺の余計な一言でもう一度真里亞に火をつけてしまった…。真里亞は再び手帳を取り出すと、様々なページを開いては突きつけ、いかにサソリには神聖な力があって、古来から魔除けの魔法陣に描かれてきたかを延々と説かれることになった。

units.text: I had inflamed Maria again because I said too much... Maria took out her notebook again, and turned and pointed to page after page, going on and on about how the scorpion had holy power, and had been drawn on magic‐repelling magic circles since ancient times.
units.japanese:
「うー！　このお守りならベアトリーチェも大丈夫！　サソリは魔除けの力があるから！」
俺の余計な一言でもう一度真里亞に火をつけてしまった…。真里亞は再び手帳を取り出すと、様々なページを開いては突きつけ、いかにサソリには神聖な力があって、古来から魔除けの魔法陣に描かれてきたかを延々と説かれることになった。

description: Battler remembers that Maria looked bored because she could not follow their excited gold-location discussion. UP says she had not shared their excitement, omitting inability to keep up and replacing conversational exclusion with lack of shared enthusiasm. MG preserves could not keep up.

units.text: If it would keep her in this good of a mood, it would probably be worth it to let Maria lead the discussion for a while longer. When you think about it, she hadn't shared in our excitement when we talked about the gold's hidden location, so I think she had gotten a little bored.
units.japanese: こんなにも上機嫌になってくれるなら、もうしばらく話の主役を真里亞に譲ってもいいだろう。思えば、黄金の隠し場所の話で盛り上がっていた時は付いていけず、少し退屈そうにしていたように思う。

description: Rosa says she does believe Maria and is searching accordingly. MG says she already believed her and looked hard, shifting the ongoing assertion and activity into completed past actions. UP preserves current belief and search.

units.text: "I already believed you and looked hard for it, didn't I?! But it isn't here!"
units.japanese: 「ちゃんと信じて探してるでしょ？！　でもないじゃない！」

description: George asks Battler to understand how Maria and Rosa feel and suggests that they would not want witnesses there. UP limits both the feelings and wish for privacy to Maria alone, removing Rosa from the stated rationale for leaving. MG preserves the two of them and they.

units.text: "Well then, you can understand Maria‐chan's feelings right now. ......I'm sure she doesn't want us to be here now. ......Do you understand as well, Jessica‐chan?"
units.japanese: 「じゃあ、今の真里亞ちゃんたちの気持ちはわかるよね。……僕たちに、ここにいてほしいとは思わないんじゃないかな。……朱志香ちゃんにもわかるよね？」

description: Rosa strikes the head of Maria, who is crouching and increasingly voicing dissatisfaction. Both editions replace the crouching posture with a quivering head, losing her physical position and introducing trembling of the head.

units.text: Aunt Rosa struck Maria's quivering head, from which an increasingly unhappy voice was rising. I tried to stop it, but Aunt Rosa pushed me away... My back hit George-aniki.
units.japanese: うずくまりながら、ますますに不満の声を上げるその頭を楼座叔母さんは引っ叩く。俺は止めようとするが、叔母さんに突き飛ばされてしまう…。俺の背中が譲治の兄貴にぶつかった。

units.text: Auntie Rosa struck Maria's quivering head from which an increasingly unsatisfied voice was rising. I tried to stop her, but she thrust me away... My back collided with George‐aniki.
units.japanese: うずくまりながら、ますますに不満の声を上げるその頭を楼座叔母さんは引っ叩く。俺は止めようとするが、叔母さんに突き飛ばされてしまう…。俺の背中が譲治の兄貴にぶつかった。

description: The narrator supposes that Rosa’s departure looked cold and hurtful to Maria. MG says Maria viewed it as meant to injure, adding attributed malicious intention to the child’s perception. UP preserves cold, hurtful gesture without assigning a purpose.

units.text: After blasting her with those last few words, Rosa spun on her heels and quickly returned to the mansion. Maria probably viewed that as a cold gesture meant to injure. But that wasn't Rosa's intention. ...It was because the hand with which she had so emotionally struck Maria's cheek...was still numb. ...It was because, if she stayed there screaming, she might again be taken over by her emotions and continue slapping her daughter's cheek over and over.
units.japanese: 楼座はその言葉を最後にぶつけると、ぐるりと踵を返して屋敷へ足早に戻っていく。真里亞にとってそれは、とても冷たく傷つく仕草に見えただろう。だが楼座にしてみればそういうつもりではなかった。…感情的に頬を叩いてしまった手が、まだじんじんしていたから。…このまま叫び続けていると、また感情に飲み込まれて、娘の頬を何度も打ってしまいそうだったから。

description: Kinzo hears the rain and infers it has finally begun, later than forecast. MG says it seems to be pouring down thickly, replacing onset with an unsupported intensity description. UP preserves finally started to rain.

units.text: .........Kinzo noticed the sound of the raindrops beating on the window. It seemed to be pouring down thickly. It had begun to rain later than the weather report had predicted.
units.japanese:
………金蔵は窓を叩く雨粒の音に気付く。
とうとう降り出したらしい。
天気予報で予想していたよりは遅い降り出しであった。

description: George says he prudently did not schedule outside appointments for Monday. MG says he cleared outside business from his schedule, inventing cancellation of existing appointments. UP preserves not making appointments.

units.text: "It looks like we won't be able to head out on Sunday after all. ...Just in case, I cleared all outside business from my Monday schedule, and I'm glad I did."
units.japanese: 「やっぱり、日曜日の内には引き上げられないか。…念の為、月曜日に外部とのスケジュールを入れなくて正解だったよ」

description: Jessica describes daily insistent instructions about self-study and submissions. Both editions say the teacher instructs sourly, transferring the sour-mouth idiom into an emotional manner instead of preserving repeated admonition.

units.text: "That does happen sometimes. Still, I'd get a call from my homeroom teacher every single day, who'd sourly guide me on how I should teach myself and what I had to turn in."
units.japanese: 「そういうこともあるぜ？　でも、毎日、きっちり担任から電話が掛かってきて、どう自習しろ、何を提出しろとすっぱく指導されるけどなー」

units.text: "Yep, that happens. But then, every single day, I'll get a call from my homeroom teacher, sourly instructing me on what to study and what to turn in."
units.japanese: 「そういうこともあるぜ？　でも、毎日、きっちり担任から電話が掛かってきて、どう自習しろ、何を提出しろとすっぱく指導されるけどなー」

description: Jessica wants city life where she can reach a convenience store in under five minutes in casual clothes and sandals. UP generalizes the destination to a shop, weakening the specific easy-access convenience-store image. MG preserves convenience store.

units.text: "...In the end, I got stuck with a high school close to home. Man, I hate this island. I just want to go live in a city. A city where it doesn't matter if rain or even spears fall from the sky, 'cause as long as you stick some casual clothes and sandals on, you can still get to a shop in less than five minutes..."
units.japanese: 「…結局、高校も地元になっちまったのさ。はー、こんな島はごめんだぜ。早く都会で生活したいよ。雨が降ろうが槍が降ろうが、ラフな格好でサンダルを履けば、５分足らずでコンビニに行けるような都会に引っ越したいぜ…」

description: After realizing Rosa does not believe her, Maria raises her voice unhappily again. UP instead says she made an angry face, replacing the audible reaction with a facial expression. MG preserves crying out unhappily.

units.text:
Maria, who quickly picked up that her mother didn't believe her, made an angry face once again. So Rosa stopped pursuing the subject.
It looked like it would be faster to ask the person who had lent Maria the umbrella during dinner rather than ask Maria herself...
units.japanese:
母が自分の言葉を信用してくれなかったことをすぐに感じ取った真里亞は、再び不機嫌そうな声を上げる。なので楼座はそれ以上を追求するのを止めた。
真里亞に聞くより、夕食の席で貸してくれた人を聞いた方が早そうだ…。

description: The family-conference dinner is one of Gohda’s annual opportunities to shine. MG calls it his biggest time to shine of the whole year, while UP calls it his highlight scene for the whole year, replacing one of several showcases with a single annual peak.

units.text: When Gohda was told to start the family conference dinner, his biggest time to shine of the whole year, he nodded with a broad grin.
units.japanese: 郷田は、年間を通しての見せ場のひとつである親族会議の晩餐の開始をようやく告げられ、満面の笑みで頷いた。
candidates: biggest time to shine of the whole year

units.text: Upon finally being told to begin the family conference dinner, his highlight scene for the whole year, Gohda nodded, grinning broadly.
units.japanese: 郷田は、年間を通しての見せ場のひとつである親族会議の晩餐の開始をようやく告げられ、満面の笑みで頷いた。
candidates: highlight scene for the whole year

description: Maria pouts while quietly repeating the witch’s name. Both editions describe her mouth as a thin line, replacing protruding lips with a compressed-mouth expression.

units.text: Maria, her mouth a thin line, said the witch's name in a small voice. Aunt Rosa explained the situation one more time. As she did, Kumasawa-san cackled.
units.japanese:
真里亞は口を尖らせながら、小声で魔女の名を口にする。楼座叔母さんが状況をもう一度説明してくれた。
すると熊沢さんはからからと笑う。

units.text:
Maria, her mouth a thin line, said the witch's name in a small voice. Auntie Rosa explained the situation one more time.
As she did, Kumasawa‐san cackled.
units.japanese:
真里亞は口を尖らせながら、小声で魔女の名を口にする。楼座叔母さんが状況をもう一度説明してくれた。
すると熊沢さんはからからと笑う。

description: Genji tells the servants to hurry the dinner service already underway. Both editions tell them to prepare the dinner table instead, changing the task from serving the meal to table preparation. MG also describes service timing as timing while setting the table; UP correctly describes dish-serving timing there.

units.text: "Okay, everyone. When serving a dinner, proper timing while setting the table is essential. Please immediately see to setting out the soup. Genji-san, the women are in the middle of an important job, so please don't get in their way."
units.japanese:
「さぁさぁ皆さん。ディナーは配膳のタイミングも大事です。すぐにスープの配膳に取り掛かってください。源次さん、彼女らは大切なお仕事中ですのでお引止めになられないで下さい」
「……郷田の指示に従いなさい。今は晩餐の配膳を急ぐように」

units.text: "......Obey Gohda's instructions. Hurry and prepare the dinner table."
units.japanese:
「さぁさぁ皆さん。ディナーは配膳のタイミングも大事です。すぐにスープの配膳に取り掛かってください。源次さん、彼女らは大切なお仕事中ですのでお引止めになられないで下さい」
「……郷田の指示に従いなさい。今は晩餐の配膳を急ぐように」

units.text: "......Obey Gohda's order. Let us now hurry to prepare the dinner table."
units.japanese: 「……郷田の指示に従いなさい。今は晩餐の配膳を急ぐように」

description: Krauss says the gloomy atmosphere makes Gohda’s accomplished dinner lack savor. UP says the dinner has been poorly received, replacing the depressed atmosphere with an assertion about the diners’ reception of the meal. MG preserves the gloomy atmosphere.

units.text: "......My, my. How truly irksome that this dinner, which Gohda worked so hard to create, has been so poorly received."
units.japanese: 「……やれやれ。せっかく郷田が腕を揮ってくれた晩餐も、こうも沈み込んでしまっては実に味気ないというものだ」

description: Kyrie points out that the mansion has many examples of the same crest, then proposes a stamp as a possible means for another person to seal the letter. UP instead asks whether several identical seals could exist, replacing the broader existing crest examples with a hypothetical multiplicity of seals. MG preserves the crest-bearing objects.

units.text: "But, in this mansion, couldn't there be several identical seals? For example, if there was some kind of stamp for wax seals, couldn't someone other than Kinzo‐san have sealed it?"
units.japanese: 「でも、このお屋敷には、それと同じ紋章がいくつもあるのでは？　例えば、封蝋用のハンコのようなものがあれば、金蔵さんでなくても封蝋はできるのでは？」

description: Krauss doubts Kinzo would use such a stylish or elaborate method of announcement through Maria. Both editions call it a joke-like approach, replacing the method’s manner with an implication of joking.

units.text: "Impossible. Whenever Father has announced something to us in the past, he would always send Genji if he didn't do it directly, correct? ...I cannot believe that he would use such a joke-like approach."
units.japanese: 「ありえんね。親父殿が私たちに何かを発表する時は、直接でなければいつだって源次さんを通してじゃないか。……このような小洒落た方法でするとは思えんね」

units.text: "Impossible. Whenever Father has announced something to us in the past, if he didn't do it directly, he would always send Genji‐san, right? ......I can't believe that he would use such a joke‐like approach."
units.japanese: 「ありえんね。親父殿が私たちに何かを発表する時は、直接でなければいつだって源次さんを通してじゃないか。……このような小洒落た方法でするとは思えんね」

description: The letter says Beatrice has taken custody of the family-head ring as evidence that she has inherited the main family’s headship. Both editions instead describe the ring as signifying transfer of headship from one individual to another, losing the specific assertion that the letter’s speaker has succeeded to that position.

units.text: ......The collection of the interest will proceed shortly, but if any one of you fulfills the terms of this special clause, I shall return everything, including the portion that has already been collected. Furthermore, as the first step in this collection of Kinzo-sama's debt, I have taken possession of the Ushiromiya family "Head's Ring", which signifies the passage of the Ushiromiya Family Headship from one individual to another. I ask that you confirm this for yourselves by examining the imprint on the wax seal.
units.japanese:
……利子の回収はこれより行ないますが、もし皆様の内の誰か一人でも特別条項を満たせたなら、すでに回収した分も含めて全てお返しいたします。なお、回収の手始めとしてすでに、右代宮本家の家督を受け継いだことを示す
“右代宮家当主の指輪”をお預かりさせていただきました。封印の蝋燭にてそれを、どうかご確認くださいませ。
candidates: Headship from one individual to another

units.text: ......The collection of the interest will proceed shortly, but if any one of you fulfills the terms of this special clause, I shall return everything, including the portion that has already been collected. Furthermore, as the first step in this collection of Kinzo‐sama's debt, I have taken possession of the "Ushiromiya Family Head's Ring", which signifies the passage of the Ushiromiya family headship from one individual to another. I ask that you confirm this for yourselves by examining the imprint on the wax seal.
units.japanese:
……利子の回収はこれより行ないますが、もし皆様の内の誰か一人でも特別条項を満たせたなら、すでに回収した分も含めて全てお返しいたします。なお、回収の手始めとしてすでに、右代宮本家の家督を受け継いだことを示す
“右代宮家当主の指輪”をお預かりさせていただきました。封印の蝋燭にてそれを、どうかご確認くださいませ。
candidates: headship from one individual to another

description: Krauss claims to know all of Kinzo’s assets, and Eva and Kyrie propose assets he does not know about. MG repeatedly changes knowledge into control, making the dispute about assets outside his control rather than outside his awareness. UP preserves knowledge.

units.text: "N-No, that's impossible! As the Family Head's representative, I control all of Father's assets! It should be impossible for anyone to do as they please with them without me knowing it!"
units.japanese:
「い、いや、それはない！　私は当主代行として親父殿の全ての財産を把握している！　私に知られずにそれらを自由にできる人間はいないはずだ！」
「じゃあつまり、蔵臼兄さんの把握していない財産ってことじゃないの？」
「………………あるわよぅ。兄さんが把握していないお父様の資産」

units.text: "So, this must mean there are some assets you don't control, right, Krauss nii-san?"
units.japanese:
「い、いや、それはない！　私は当主代行として親父殿の全ての財産を把握している！　私に知られずにそれらを自由にできる人間はいないはずだ！」
「じゃあつまり、蔵臼兄さんの把握していない財産ってことじゃないの？」
「………………あるわよぅ。兄さんが把握していないお父様の資産」

units.text: "...............Oh, but there is such a thing. An asset of Father's that you don't control."
units.japanese:
「い、いや、それはない！　私は当主代行として親父殿の全ての財産を把握している！　私に知られずにそれらを自由にできる人間はいないはずだ！」
「じゃあつまり、蔵臼兄さんの把握していない財産ってことじゃないの？」
「………………あるわよぅ。兄さんが把握していないお父様の資産」

description: Battler jokes that the interest collection might be retirement pay for Beatrice’s many years of service. Both editions instead call it retirement money for her old age, replacing length of service with her age as the stated basis.

units.text: "So it's basically one of those things, right? Doesn't it sound just like one of those contracts with the devil? The contract has expired, so they've come to collect the interest. Is she trying to grab some retirement money for her old age or something? What a cheeky witch."
units.japanese: 「要するにあれだろ？　よくある悪魔の契約みたいなヤツなんだろ？　んで、契約がおしまいってことになるから、利子を回収に来たってわけだ。いんや、長年の退職金のつもりかなぁ？　ちゃっかりした魔女だぜ」
candidates: retirement money for her old age

units.text: "So it's basically one of those things, right? Just like one of those contracts with the devil you always hear about? And, the contract has expired, so she's come to collect the interest. Is she trying to grab some retirement money for her old age or something? What a cheeky witch."
units.japanese: 「要するにあれだろ？　よくある悪魔の契約みたいなヤツなんだろ？　んで、契約がおしまいってことになるから、利子を回収に来たってわけだ。いんや、長年の退職金のつもりかなぁ？　ちゃっかりした魔女だぜ」
candidates: retirement money for her old age

description: George says responsibility for dependents may create times when he has to fight. Both editions assert that there are times when he must fight, removing the possibility marker from his tentative defense.

units.text: ".........If it were only for my own benefit, then no, I wouldn't want to do that. However, when your family and your employees, your subordinates and their families are all counting on you, ...there are some times when you must fight."
units.japanese: 「…………………自分だけの話だったら、そんなことはしたくないよ。でも、家族や社員、部下やその家族の生活を背負ったら、…戦わなければならない時もあるかもしれない」

units.text: ".....................If it would just be about me, then no, I wouldn't want to do that. However, when your family and your employees, your subordinates and their families are all counting on you, ...there are some times when you must fight."
units.japanese: 「…………………自分だけの話だったら、そんなことはしたくないよ。でも、家族や社員、部下やその家族の生活を背負ったら、…戦わなければならない時もあるかもしれない」

description: Battler guesses Maria is still sulking in front of the portrait. UP says she is huddled up on the floor there, adding a particular posture and floor location while losing explicit sulking. MG preserves pouting.

units.text: "She's probably still huddled up on the floor in front of the portrait."
units.japanese: 「多分、まだ肖像画の前でいじけてるんだろうぜ」

description: Kyrie describes a conspicuous attempt to suggest the existence of a nineteenth person. MG says the nineteenth person was revealed spectacularly, replacing the ostentatious suggestion with a stated revelation. UP preserves a powerful suggestion.

units.text: "It's simple. Beatrice is one of the 18 people. That's why they want to create the illusion that there are more than 18 people. ...The 19th person was revealed so spectacularly.
units.japanese: 「簡単よ。ベアトリーチェは１８人の中にいるのよ。だからこそ、１８人以外の人物が存在するような幻想を作り出しているのよ。…これ見よがしな１９人目のアピール」

description: Kyrie jabs Rudolf with her elbow after his joking response about the siblings’ discussion. Both translations say she poked the weak spot under my arm, explicitly making the first-person narrator Battler the target instead.

units.text: Kyrie-san poked the weak spot under my arm with her elbow.
units.japanese: 霧江さんに、肘で脇の下の急所を小突かれる。
candidates: poked the weak spot under my arm

units.text: Kyrie‐san poked the weak spot under my arm with her elbow.
units.japanese: 霧江さんに、肘で脇の下の急所を小突かれる。
candidates: poked the weak spot under my arm

description: Rudolf predicts that he will probably be killed tonight. MG retains probable killing but omits tonight, removing the explicit time limit from his ominous prediction. UP preserves tonight.

units.text: "..................I'm probably... .........I will probably... be killed."
units.japanese: 「……………俺は多分。………今夜、殺されるだろうな」

description: Natsuhi treats the letter as equivalent to a message in Kinzo’s own hand using a fictitious messenger. MG says it passes a message Kinzo had written himself, changing equivalence of authority into an assertion of literal writing by him. UP preserves may as well have been written in his own handwriting.

units.text: ...There was no need to play some clumsy detective game. Natsuhi knew that this so-called 19th person, Beatrice, couldn't exist. Naturally, Beatrice was nothing more than a fictional character used to pass a message that Kinzo had written himself. As proof, Kinzo had remained stubbornly neutral as to that letter's authenticity. ......He was completely ignoring these reckless claims that he shouldn't be able to ignore: that he had given up the Head's Ring. ............In short, Kinzo had wordlessly admitted that the letter held his own message.
units.japanese: …下手くそな推理ごっこをするまでもなく、ベアトリーチェなどという１９人目の存在がいるわけがないのはわかる。これは、ベアトリーチェという架空の存在を使者にした、金蔵直筆のメッセージも同然なのだ。その証拠に、金蔵はあの手紙の真偽について、頑なに不介入を貫き続けている。……当主の指輪を預かっているという、金蔵が捨て置けるわけもない暴言を放置している。…………つまり、金蔵は無言で、あの手紙を自分のメッセージだと認めているのだ。

description: Natsuhi believes she is fighting alongside Krauss as his wife and only ally. MG says she wanted to fight alongside him, replacing her belief about an ongoing effort with a desire. UP restores had believed she was fighting alongside him.

units.text: ...Natsuhi, as Krauss's only ally in his painful position and as his wife, wanted to fight alongside him. She kept trying to explain to him that the existence of the gold itself was a farce and that there was no need for him to compromise. Krauss had always told Natsuhi. He had told all of the siblings. He always, always said that the hidden gold was nothing more than an illusion created by Kinzo. Therefore, Natsuhi had believed it as his wife, and had supported her husband on that foundation. Even so, Natsuhi's words didn't reach Krauss. ...Even though Natsuhi had fought so hard and had lent all of her strength, he continued to fight by himself and was trying to compromise with the other three siblings...
units.japanese:
…夏妃は苦しい立場の蔵臼の唯一の味方として、妻として、共に戦っているつもりだった。隠し黄金など存在自体がまやかしだと繰り返し、蔵臼に譲歩する必要などないと説き続けた。蔵臼はいつも夏妃に言ってきた。兄弟全員に言ってきた。
隠し黄金など、金蔵の生み出した幻想に過ぎないと、いつもいつも言ってきた。だからそれを夏妃は妻として信じ、それを拠り所に夫を支えてきた。しかし、蔵臼には夏妃の言葉が届かない。…夏妃がこれほどまでに戦い、力を貸しているのに、ひとりで戦いを進め、兄弟３人に妥協をしようとしている…。

description: Krauss switches on a weak or inadequate light. Both editions call it a flickering light, adding temporal fluctuation where the source describes faint illumination.

units.text: Just as he said, when Krauss pushed a switch on the wall, a flickering light turned on and lit up the room.
units.japanese: その言葉通り、蔵臼は壁のスイッチを押すと、頼りない明かりがつき、部屋を照らし出した。

units.text: True to his word, Krauss pushed a switch on the wall, and a flickering light turned on and lit up the room.
units.japanese: その言葉通り、蔵臼は壁のスイッチを押すと、頼りない明かりがつき、部屋を照らし出した。

description: Natsuhi believes she has devotedly supported Krauss as his wife and closest confidant. Both editions say she thought she should be his closest confidant and that this was why she supported him, changing her perceived existing role into an expectation and adding an explicit causal motive.

units.text: ......But to Natsuhi, this truth was more than enough to split open her heart. She had thought that, as Krauss's wife, she should be his closest confidant, which was why she had selflessly supported him. ...And yet, he had hid this fact from her until today. ......Why?
units.japanese: ……しかし、夏妃にとってこの事実は心を引き裂いて余りあるものだった。蔵臼の妻として、もっとも身近な理解者として献身的に支えてきたつもりだった。…にもかかわらず、その自分に今日までこの事実は伏せられてきた。………なぜ？

units.text: ......But to Natsuhi, this truth was more than enough to split open her heart. She had thought that, as Krauss's wife, she should be his closest confidant, which was why she had been selflessly supporting him. ...And yet, he had hidden this fact from her until today. .........Why?
units.japanese: ……しかし、夏妃にとってこの事実は心を引き裂いて余りあるものだった。蔵臼の妻として、もっとも身近な理解者として献身的に支えてきたつもりだった。…にもかかわらず、その自分に今日までこの事実は伏せられてきた。………なぜ？

description: Natsuhi says she cannot become bedridden and leave Jessica behind. Both translations say it is not good to go to sleep and leave her alone, replacing illness-related incapacitation with ordinary sleep.

units.text: "......Thank you for being so considerate. ......It isn't good of me to go to sleep and leave you alone."
units.japanese: 「…………気遣いをありがとう。………お前を残して寝込むわけには行きません」

units.text: "............Thank you for being considerate. .........It isn't good of me to go to sleep and leave you alone."
units.japanese: 「…………気遣いをありがとう。………お前を残して寝込むわけには行きません」

description: Rosa thinks Maria will feel reassured if she stays with the cousins. MG says Rosa herself would feel more reassured, moving the stated reassurance from the child to the mother. UP explicitly preserves comforting for her.

units.text: "I see. Then could I ask you to take Maria with you? ...I'd feel much more reassured if she stays with all of you cousins."
units.japanese: 「そう。なら真里亞も一緒にしてあげてもいいかしら。…いとこのみんなと一緒の方が、きっと安心できると思うしね」

description: Kanon guesses that Krauss wanted to keep Kinzo’s direct servants as far from the conference as possible. MG says Krauss tried as best he could to do so, replacing conjectured desire with stated action. UP preserves probably wanted.

units.text: "...After such a mysterious letter appeared, it was only natural that Krauss-sama would suspect one of us. .........We serve directly under the Master, so Krauss-sama tried as best he could to keep us far away from the family conference."
units.japanese: 「………あんな怪しげな手紙が現れたら、蔵臼さまが僕たちを疑うのは当然だからね。………お館様直属の僕たちを、極力、親族会議の席から遠ざけたかったんだろうよ」

description: Watching Shannon leave, Kanon lets out a deep sigh. Both editions say he took a deep breath, removing the explicit sigh from the emotionally charged departure.

units.text: Shannon hurriedly stood from her seat before her brother's mood could change and flew out of the servant room after giving a quick bow...... As he watched her go, Kanon took a single deep breath...
units.japanese: 紗音は、弟の機嫌が変わってしまう前にそそくさと席を立つと、ぺこりと頭を下げて使用人室を飛び出していった…。その背中を見送りながら、嘉音は深い溜め息をひとつ漏らす…。

units.text: Shannon hurriedly stood from her seat before her brother's mood could change, gave a quick bow, and flew out of the servant room... As he watched her disappear, Kanon took a single deep breath...
units.japanese: 紗音は、弟の機嫌が変わってしまう前にそそくさと席を立つと、ぺこりと頭を下げて使用人室を飛び出していった…。その背中を見送りながら、嘉音は深い溜め息をひとつ漏らす…。

description: George says Shingen immediately gave rewards for battlefield achievements. Both editions specify a medal, narrowing the unspecified reward to a particular object.

units.text: "In order to unite his troops, Shingen showed his excellent leadership in many ways. For example, when a soldier succeeded well in battle, he would immediately honor them with a medal. Normally, that kind of thing was put off until after the war, and they were all awarded at once."
units.japanese: 「信玄は部下たちを結束させるため、数々のリーダーシップを発揮してるんだよ。例えば、戦場で武功を立てた部下に対し、すぐその場で褒章を与えたり。普通、こういうのは戦が終わってからまとめてやるものだからね」

units.text: "In order to unite his troops, Shingen utilized several strategies. For example, when a soldier succeeded well in battle, he would immediately honor them with a medal. Normally, that kind of thing was put off until after the war and they were all awarded at once."
units.japanese: 「信玄は部下たちを結束させるため、数々のリーダーシップを発揮してるんだよ。例えば、戦場で武功を立てた部下に対し、すぐその場で褒章を与えたり。普通、こういうのは戦が終わってからまとめてやるものだからね」

description: The narrator says Kinzo at one point permitted the trusted servants to wear the crest and serve near him. Both editions say he would sometimes allow it, changing a particular past authorization into intermittent or repeated permission.

units.text: Kinzo couldn't even trust his own blood relatives, and those "excellent" servants sent from the Fukuin House were the only ones he could rely on. Because of that, Kinzo would sometimes allow them to wear the family crest, as servants under his direct control, and have them work close to him...
units.japanese: それら福音の家から送られる“優秀な”使用人は、もはや血縁すら信用できない金蔵にとっては唯一信頼できる存在であった。そのためある時、金蔵は彼らを直属の使用人として家紋をまとうことを許し、自分の身近に仕えさせたのである…。

units.text: To Kinzo, who could not even trust his own blood relatives, those "excellent" servants sent from the Gospel House were the only ones he could trust. Because of that, Kinzo would sometimes allow them to wear the family crest as servants under his direct control, and have them work close to him...
units.japanese: それら福音の家から送られる“優秀な”使用人は、もはや血縁すら信用できない金蔵にとっては唯一信頼できる存在であった。そのためある時、金蔵は彼らを直属の使用人として家紋をまとうことを許し、自分の身近に仕えさせたのである…。

description: The narrator says the fear that life will be monotonous only belongs to one’s student years. MG says life is only like that for underage students, turning the restriction on a fear into a factual restriction on monotonous life. UP preserves these thoughts only arise during student years.

units.text: However, life's only like that for underage students. Compared to a human's life, the time they spend as students is nothing more than a blink of the eye, a period where they break through the shells of their immaturity. The inside of the shell might be a hot, suffocating and boring world, but the world beyond that shell is vast and filled with limitless possibilities.
units.japanese: しかし、それは未成年の学生である内だけの話だ。人の人生において学生時代など卵の殻を割るまでの未熟かつ瞬きする間の日々でしかない。殻の内側は温かくも窒息しそうで退屈な世界かもしれないが、殻の外には無限の可能性に満ちた広大な世界が広がっているのだ。

description: Shannon would keep pretending not to notice unless George admonished or explained matters to her. UP instead says as long as George did not realize that truth, changing his corrective conversation into his own realization as the condition. MG preserves George admonishments.

units.text: That may have been a truth she was deliberately averting her eyes from. ...As long as George did not realize that truth, she would have continued pretending not to notice, as her real life slipped away, neglected, bit by bit...
units.japanese: 彼女にとって、それはわざと目を背けていたことなのかもしれない。…それを譲治に諭されない限り、彼女は気付かないふりをし続け、自分の本当の人生を少しずつ蔑ろにしていく…。
candidates: long as George did not realize that truth

description: George turns away while acting just a little curtly. UP says he seemed slightly uncomfortable, replacing his manner toward Shannon with an inferred emotional state. MG preserves acting bluntly.

units.text: George faced away from Shannon, seeming slightly uncomfortable.
units.japanese: 譲治はほんの少しだけ素っ気無くしながら、紗音に背を向ける。

description: The family members repeatedly contradict or reject one another’s long statements. MG replaces both instances of denial with interruption, losing the explicit opposition to what was said. UP preserves opposed and rebuttal.

units.text: She began to hear the tumultuous voices of the family discussion coming from the dining hall. Someone was speaking at great length, only to be interrupted by someone else. This second person also began to speak in a very long, drawn-out fashion, until yet another person interrupted. That kept on repeating. It was as though their displeasure was seeping out through their voices.
units.japanese:
食堂からは、親族たちが喧々諤々と議論する声が聞こえてくる。誰かが冗長に語っては、それを誰かが否定し、それを長々と語ると、また別の誰かが否定する。そんなことの繰り返し。
声にも不機嫌さが滲み出ているようだった。

description: The source describes the ancient belief that mirrors hold mysterious powers. MG restricts this to a strange power residing in this mirror, making the general cultural belief sound specific to Natsuhi’s heirloom. UP preserves powers dwelling within mirrors.

units.text: She had heard that this was a spiritual mirror for warding off evil spirits, and she had been given it specially by her Grandmother when her Grandfather's mementos had been distributed. It had been believed since long ago that a strange power resided in this mirror. Perhaps people thought it could reflect calamity and malice in the same way it reflected light.
units.japanese:
この鏡は魔除けの霊鏡だそうで、祖父の形見分けの時に祖母から特にと贈られたものだ。鏡には不思議な力が宿ると古来より信じられている。
光を跳ね返すその様から、災厄や悪意をも跳ね返すと信じられたのだろう。

description: Natsuhi lets out a sigh in anticipation of the trouble Genji will report. MG says she takes a deep breath, replacing the weary exhalation with a different breathing action. UP preserves breathing out slowly.

units.text: No servant had ever come to her this early in the morning, nor had they come to wake her in person. ...Perhaps something bad had happened. Maybe some fatal oversight had been made while preparing breakfast, something that would shame the household in front of their guests. ...Natsuhi took a deep breath in anticipation for whatever troubles she was about to hear of...
units.japanese:
使用人がこのような早朝に、それも直接やって来るなど、これまでにないことだった。…何かマズイことでもあったのだろうか。
例えば、朝食の準備に致命的な手抜かりがあり、客人たちの前で恥をかくことになる、とか。…夏妃は、これから聞かされるであろうトラブルに先んじるように溜め息を漏らす…。

description: The imagined blood-soaked hands touch or manipulate the door and knob. MG says someone tried to force the door, adding a forced-entry intention to the interpretation of the marks. UP preserves groping at the door and knob.

units.text: Natsuhi exited into the hall and turned around for a second to close the door to her room. The creepy "thing" she saw there silenced her completely. ...It was an unpleasant sight, as though someone had dipped their fingers in a reddish-black liquid and scratched at the door around the doorknob. It was probably some sort of awful prank... arranged by some person who wanted to make it look as though they'd tried to force the door with bloody hands.
units.japanese: 夏妃は廊下に出て、自分の部屋の扉を閉めようと一度振り返った。そこで目にした気持ちの悪い“それ”に絶句したのだ。…それは、赤黒い液体を指につけてドアノブの辺りを掻き毟ったような、不快なもの。まるで両手を血に浸し、扉やノブを弄ったかのような…、そんな風に演出したくて何者かが残した悪趣味な悪戯だろう。

description: The source says Genji alone was permitted to carry the study-door key because of Kinzo’s special trust. Both re-edits retain his permission and trust but omit alone, losing the explicit restriction on who was authorized to carry it.

units.text: Genji handed Natsuhi a sparkling gold key of ornate design. It was the key to Kinzo's study. The study had an autolock and couldn't be unlocked as long as Kinzo forbade entrance. However, since Genji was especially trusted by Kinzo, he was allowed to carry a key to that door...
units.japanese:
源次が、金色に輝く凝った意匠の鍵を夏妃に差し出す。
それは金蔵の書斎の鍵だった。書斎の扉は常にオートロックで施錠されていて、金蔵が入室を許さない限り開錠されない。だが、源次だけは金蔵の特別の信頼を得ていて、扉の鍵を持つことが許されていたのである…。

units.text:
Genji handed Natsuhi a sparkling gold key of ornate design.
It was the key to Kinzo's study. The study would always lock itself, and couldn't be unlocked as long as Kinzo forbade entrance. However, since Genji was especially trusted by Kinzo, he was allowed to carry a key to that door...
units.japanese:
源次が、金色に輝く凝った意匠の鍵を夏妃に差し出す。
それは金蔵の書斎の鍵だった。書斎の扉は常にオートロックで施錠されていて、金蔵が入室を許さない限り開錠されない。だが、源次だけは金蔵の特別の信頼を得ていて、扉の鍵を持つことが許されていたのである…。

description: Eva’s unreasonable demand makes Natsuhi’s clenched fist tremble. MG says she clenches her fists slightly, dropping the trembling and replacing the described manifestation of distress with the act of clenching. UP preserves the fist shaking.

units.text: Natsuhi responded, looking discouraged. However, knowing Kinzo's temperament, she had absolutely no confidence in her ability to bring him out. ...Eva was clearly mocking her, confident that Natsuhi wouldn't be able to get Kinzo to come down. But even so, Natsuhi would lose face if she gave up, saying it was impossible and letting Eva go instead... Eva's mean-spirited and unreasonable demand made Natsuhi clench her fists slightly.
units.japanese:
夏妃は憮然として言い返す。
だが、金蔵の気性を知っている以上、書斎から連れ出せる自信はまったくなかった。…絵羽だって、どうせ連れ出せないだろうと高を括っている。だからと言って、自分には無理だと引き下がり絵羽に行かせては自分の立つ瀬がない…。夏妃は、絵羽の意地悪な無理難題に、小さな握り拳を震わせるのだった。

description: Maria appears unhappy because her mother is absent from the expected place, frustrating her expectation. UP adds that this made her feel she had been tricked, turning disappointment into a sense of deception. MG preserves being irritated and thrown off balance.

units.text:
Maria kept groaning "uu‐uu" and looking unhappy.
It seemed like she wasn't simply lonely because she couldn't find her mother, but actually unhappy because her mother wasn't in the place she thought she was, and this made her feel like she'd been tricked. If we could have just told her where her mother was, that might have been enough to satisfy her, but unfortunately, as long as we were here, we had no way of finding that out.
units.japanese:
真里亞は不愉快そうに、うーうー唸り続ける。
母の姿が見えなくて寂しいというよりは、いると思っていた場所にいなかったので、肩透かしが不愉快だったという風に見えた。今どこにいると一言教えてあげられればそれで納得してくれるのかもしれないが、生憎、楼座叔母さんがどこにいるのか、ここにいる以上わかりようもなかった。

description: Something hot wells up around Natsuhi’s eyes, evoking tears she has not felt since childhood. Both re-edits move this to warmth welling up inside her, losing the eye location and its tearful manifestation.

units.text: Without saying anything more, Kinzo remained with his back to Natsuhi. However, Natsuhi couldn't help but feel something warm well up inside her that she hadn't felt since long ago, when she had been just a child... Natsuhi bowed silently to his back and left the room...
units.japanese: 金蔵はそれ以上は何も言わず、夏妃に背を向けたままだった。だが、夏妃は子供の頃以来、忘れて久しい、熱い何かが目元にこみ上げてくるのを感じずにはいられなかった…。夏妃はその背中に黙礼し、部屋を後にした…。

units.text: Without saying anything more, Kinzo remained with his back to Natsuhi. However, Natsuhi couldn't help but feel something warm well up inside her that she hadn't felt since long ago, when she had been just a child... Natsuhi bowed silently to his back and left the room...
units.japanese: 金蔵はそれ以上は何も言わず、夏妃に背を向けたままだった。だが、夏妃は子供の頃以来、忘れて久しい、熱い何かが目元にこみ上げてくるのを感じずにはいられなかった…。夏妃はその背中に黙礼し、部屋を後にした…。

description: The maintenance path is one ordinary rose-viewing visitors do not enter. MG describes it as normally off limits, adding a rule restricting entry where the source describes visitor usage. UP preserves not used by those simply appreciating the garden.

units.text: Kanon, Genji, Eva, and Hideyoshi came cutting across the rose garden holding umbrellas. They entered a small path just off the rose garden, which was normally off limits for those appreciating the garden and only used by those maintaining it. As they dashed down that, the storehouse came into view in front of them.
units.japanese: 傘を差した４人が薔薇庭園を、嘉音、源次、絵羽、秀吉の順で駆け抜けていく。薔薇庭園を抜け、普通に薔薇を鑑賞する人は立ち入らない管理用の小道に入っていく。それをさらに駆け抜けていくと、前方に倉庫が見えてくるのだった。

description: The dark red substance evokes blood and the design suggests something ominous. UP says meant to look like blood and intended to suggest something ominous, turning perceived resemblance into asserted design intentions. MG preserves looked like blood and seemed to suggest.

units.text: There was no longer any point in being choosy with words. ......A ghastly dark red substance meant to look like blood... ...had been used to draw some kind of figure or mark, ...intended to suggest something ominous.
units.japanese: もう言葉は選ばない。……血をイメージさせる赤黒い不気味な何かで、……不気味な何かを暗示させるような図形、マークのようなものが描いてあるのだ。

description: George enjoys the program from Maria’s perspective, contrasting with Battler and Jessica mocking the children’s show. UP retains only enjoying it along with Maria, omitting his adoption of her viewpoint. MG preserves from her perspective.

units.text: Thanks to a kids' program that they had come across, Maria was feeling much better. Battler and Jessica were making fun of the kids' program at every turn, cackling. George was enjoying the program along with Maria. Nanjo sat on a sofa by himself, passing the time by reading quietly.
units.japanese: 子ども向けの番組にめぐり合えたお陰で、真里亞はすっかり機嫌を直していた。戦人や朱志香は、幼児番組にいちいちツッコミを入れてはケタケタ笑っている。譲治は真里亞の目線で、一緒に番組を楽しんでいるのだった。南條は離れたソファーに座り、静かに読書で時間を潰していた。

description: Nanjo observes rigor mortis across almost the entire body. UP says across the entire body, removing the approximation from the extent of his observation. MG preserves almost.

units.text: ".........Rigor mortis has set in across the entire body... ......Probably, at least six hours have passed since death... As far as I can tell by looking at the damaged area, there is a high probability that they were damaged after their deaths..."
units.japanese: 「………死後硬直をほぼ全身に認められる…。……多分、死後６時間以上は経過しとるだろう…。損壊部位の状況を見る限り、死後に破壊された可能性が高い…」

description: The open mouth has exposed gums. UP gives exposed ridges of the teeth, replacing gum tissue with a different anatomical feature. MG preserves gums exposed.

units.text: Their faces were smashed, forced into an expression that a normal person couldn't make even after death. ...I couldn't tell where the eyes or the nose were, but I could find the mouth...because it was gaping wide, the ridges of the teeth exposed! But the front teeth were missing, and even the cheek that should have covered that was all torn up and exposed! The stylish makeup that he spent way too much time fussing over for a guy...is no help at all...!!
units.japanese: 顔面は粉砕され、真っ当な人間ならたとえ死後でも浮かべられないような表情を作らされている。…目の位置も鼻の位置もわからねぇ、口はわかるぜ、歯茎が剥き出しになってて口をぽっかりと開けているから！でも、前歯は飛んでるし、そもそもそれを覆う頬っぺただってぐちゃぐちゃで剥き出しで！　男のくせにやたら気遣ってたお洒落化粧も何の役にも立っちゃいない…！！

description: George shakes slightly while biting his lower lip. Both re-edits replace the bitten lip with a trembling lower lip, losing his deliberate restraint gesture.

units.text: George fell completely silent. ...He shook slightly, his lower lip trembling...
units.japanese: 譲治は沈黙する。……下唇を噛みながら、小さく震える…。

units.text: George was completely silent. ......He shook slightly, his lower lip trembling...
units.japanese: 譲治は沈黙する。……下唇を噛みながら、小さく震える…。

description: The source describes Shannon’s head crushed from the side, leaving half her expression. UP describes half the face smashed off but omits the side direction of the head damage. MG preserves smashed in from the side.

units.text:
...Hideyoshi looked down upon Shannon's body lying at his feet.
.........Just like the other bodies, it was in such a horrible state that it would make anyone want to cover their eyes. ......Half of the face had been smashed off, and no more than half of her expression remained. .........If that remaining half, soaked red with blood, had been wiped clean, that graceful smiling face might have peeked out. .........Only half of it......
units.japanese:
…秀吉は、足元の紗音の遺体を見下ろす。
………それは、他の遺体と同じような目を覆いたくなるような惨状。……頭部を側面から砕かれ、表情は半分しか残っていなかった。………血で真っ赤に染まったその半分の表情は、綺麗に拭いてあげたなら、あのお淑やかな笑顔をそこに覗かせてくれるのだろうか。………半分だけ……。

description: Eva says they entered the crime scene with shoes on in their confusion. UP says they tracked muddy footprints all over the scene, adding visible trace evidence and its widespread distribution. MG preserves walking in with shoes on.

units.text: "Wait a second! Stop. This is the scene of the crime, isn't it? Then we can't disturb it. In our confusion, we've tracked muddy footprints all over the scene, and I'm sure that will have caused trouble for the police's investigation!"
units.japanese: 「ちょっとちょっと！　お待ちなさいよ。ここは犯行現場なんでしょ？　なら変に手を加えちゃ駄目よ。私たちは混乱してて現場に土足で踏み入っちゃったけど、それはきっと警察の捜査の邪魔になったわよぅ？」
candidates: tracked muddy footprints all over the scene

description: Nanjo says they cannot know until police investigate. Both re-edits replace police investigation with police arrival as the condition for learning anything, losing the specific need for examination rather than mere presence.

units.text: Hideyoshi kept on fidgeting, and every time he remembered that horrible scene, he started muttering about how he couldn't believe it, how it couldn't have been something from this world, how it must have been the work of demons. Every now and then, his mutterings produced a question directed at Nanjo, but the latter kept repeating in a calm, doctor-like manner that nothing could be understood by only glancing at the scene, and that until the police arrived, they wouldn't learn anything.
units.japanese: 秀吉はそわそわしながら、先ほどの惨状を思い出しては、信じられない、この世のものとは思えない、悪魔の仕業やと呟き続けている。それらを時々、問い掛けの形に変えて南條にぶつけていたが、南條は医者らしく冷静に、少し見ただけでは何もわからない、警察が調べなければわからないと繰り返すのだった。

units.text: Hideyoshi, fidgeting as he remembered that horrible scene, kept muttering. Unbelievable—That can't be somethin' of this world—It's the work of the devil. Every once in a while, he turned these into questions and bounced them off Nanjo, but Nanjo, in a calm doctorly manner, kept repeating that nothing could be understood by only glancing at the scene, and that until the police arrived, he wouldn't know anything.
units.japanese: 秀吉はそわそわしながら、先ほどの惨状を思い出しては、信じられない、この世のものとは思えない、悪魔の仕業やと呟き続けている。それらを時々、問い掛けの形に変えて南條にぶつけていたが、南條は医者らしく冷静に、少し見ただけでは何もわからない、警察が調べなければわからないと繰り返すのだった。
