sourceReading: The speaker hypothesizes Eva committing murder only once in her lifetime, not planning never to commit any others.

units.text: "It is true that Eva‐san was the kind of person to take drastic action when it came to the crunch. It could be possible......that she committed the only murders she planned on committing in her life to grab this chance to make the Ushiromiya wealth all her own. ............But you know, I don't think that's true."
units.japanese: 「確かに、絵羽さんはここ一番ではずいぶん思い切ったこともしちゃう人だよ。あるいは、……右代宮家の財産を独り占めできるチャンスに、生涯でただ一度の殺人を犯したかもしれない。…………だがね、俺はそうは思わない」

description: UP presupposes Eva’s crimes where Ange questions failure to discover criminality.
sourceReading: 事件性 asks whether criminality could not be discovered.

units.text: "......That just means that the police couldn't find the evidence of her crimes, doesn't it?"
units.japanese: 「……それは単に、警察は事件性を発見できなかった、ってだけの話じゃないんですか？」

description: MG replaces excessive courtesy with neatness and cleanliness in the suspicious taxi arrangement.
sourceReading: ご丁寧すぎ refers to excessive courtesy or accommodating arrangements.

units.text: Ange wasn't a fool herself. She got off the elevator, but on the third floor. A taxi in the second level of the basement? That's so neat and clean that I don't like it. It's probably better to refuse for now.
units.japanese: 縁寿も馬鹿ではない。エレベーターから降りる彼女だが、そこは地上の３階だった。地下２階にタクシー？ご丁寧すぎて気持ち悪い。ここは辞退した方がいいだろう。

description: MG turns Ange’s voiced inhalation into a spoken instruction to take a deep breath.
sourceReading: すぅ represents inhaling before the subsequent shout.

units.text: "Take a deep breath...... ......Haaaaaaaaaaaaahh!!"
units.japanese: 「すぅ………。…………はぁああああああ！！」

description: MG omits like in it looks I’m in for a happy vacation.
sourceReading: Amakusa anticipates a pleasant vacation and extra earnings.

units.text: "My name probably came up since I know you, and I've got lots of crazy experience. Thanks to you, it looks I'm in for a happy vacation plus some pocket money."
units.japanese: 「お嬢と面識があって、ドタバタの経験も豊富ってことでご指名が来たんでしょうぜ。お嬢のお陰で、ハッピーな休暇と小遣い稼ぎになりそうです」
candidates: looks I'm in for a happy vacation

description: UP misspells outmaneuvered as outmanuevered.
sourceReading: Okonogi says Amakusa handled the situation well.

units.text: "......Still, looks like he outmanuevered them pretty well. ......Now we'll just let Ange‐chan do as she pleases. I'm counting on you, Amakusa."
units.japanese: 「……しかし、あいつ、うまく立ち回ってくれたようだな。……あとは縁寿ちゃんの好きにさせるさ。頼むぜぇ、天草ぁ」

description: UP replaces conditions of truth not being denied or observed with impossibility of denial or observation.
sourceReading: 否定されない限り and 観測されない限り condition persistence on nonoccurrence, not inability.

units.text: ".........As long as truth can't be denied, it keeps its form."
units.japanese:
「………真実は、否定されない限り、その形状を維持する」
「そう。真実は、観測されない限り、その形状を維持する」

units.text: "That's right. As long as truth can't be observed, it keeps its form."
units.japanese:
「………真実は、否定されない限り、その形状を維持する」
「そう。真実は、観測されない限り、その形状を維持する」

description: UP adds senility to a reference to a decrepit old man with little time left to live.
sourceReading: 後先短い老いぼれ refers to an aged, decrepit person with little life remaining; it does not specify mental decline.

units.text:
.........Three months left to live...? A senile old man not long for this world...?
Just who are you referring to?
units.japanese:
………余命３ヶ月…？　後先短い老いぼれ…？
それは誰のことを指して言ったのか。

description: UP specifies exactly half of Rosa dessert where the source only says she will share her portion.
sourceReading: ママの分のデザートも分けてあげる promises sharing the mother portion without specifying a fraction.

units.text: "......Alright, it's already dinnertime. Let's all go together. ......Maria, you can even have half of my dessert too for being so good."
units.japanese: 「……さ、もうお夕飯よ。みんなも行きましょう。……偉い真里亞には、あとでママの分のデザートも分けてあげるわ」

description: UP turns Ange instruction to judge objectively into an answer about her own method of judging.
sourceReading: 客観的に判断してよ asks Maria to judge objectively.

units.text: "............By thinking about it objectively."
units.japanese: 「…………客観的に判断してよ」

description: MG changes Ange contrary reading of the diary into a realization that Maria happiness was not true.
sourceReading: そうではないと読み解いた describes interpreting the account as not happy.

units.text: "...Even though you describe it as a happy scene, I read between the lines and realized that that wasn't true."
units.japanese: 「……真里亞お姉ちゃんは幸せだと記述したのに、私はそうではないと読み解いた」

description: MG writes It's value increases where the possessive Its is required.
sourceReading: The English noun phrase requires possessive Its, not the contraction It is.

units.text: "The full dress of a witch must not be shown indiscriminately. It's value increases if you're stingy with it. *cackle*!"
units.japanese: 「魔女の正装は濫りに見せてはならぬぞ。もったいぶった方が価値が出るというもの。くっくっく！」

description: MG misspells millennium as millenium.
sourceReading: The English word millennium takes two n letters.

units.text: "This is because...contained within "the Ushiromiya Library" were many extremely vital documents that had never been found, though their existence had been known of for more than a millenium."
units.japanese: 「『右代宮蔵書』には、なんと千年以上にも亘る間、その存在だけが知られているにもかかわらず、発見されていなかった数々の極めて重要な文献さえ含まれていたからです」

description: Both English versions make inferred alternate authorship categorical; UP also calls it knowledge.
sourceReading: 別の人物が書いたらしい retains inferential or reported qualification.

units.text: ...Looks like researching about the message bottle really was a waste of time. No, if there's one thing I've found, it's that the notebook supposedly written by Maria onee-chan was actually written by a different person faking her name. And, that person wrote up an occult legend on their own, put it into the bottle as though it was the truth, and threw it into the sea.
units.japanese: ……やはり、メッセージボトルのことを調べても時間の無駄だったろうか。いや、ひとつ収穫があったとすれば、真里亞お姉ちゃんが記したとされるそれは、彼女の名を騙る別の人物が書いたらしいこと。そして、オカルトな物語を勝手に書き上げ、それが真相だと言わんばかりに瓶詰めにして海に放り込んだこと。

units.text: ......Maybe it really had been a waste of time to research about the message bottle. No, if there was one thing I'd gotten out of this, it was the knowledge that those pages, supposedly written by Maria onee‐chan, had actually been written by a different person faking her name. And that person had taken it upon themselves to write an occult story, put it into a bottle as though it was the truth, and throw it into the sea.
units.japanese: ……やはり、メッセージボトルのことを調べても時間の無駄だったろうか。いや、ひとつ収穫があったとすれば、真里亞お姉ちゃんが記したとされるそれは、彼女の名を騙る別の人物が書いたらしいこと。そして、オカルトな物語を勝手に書き上げ、それが真相だと言わんばかりに瓶詰めにして海に放り込んだこと。

description: UP moves the writing cutoff from by the day before the accident to before that preceding day.
sourceReading: 事故前日までに permits completion by the day before the accident.

units.text: In that case, it's probably more realistic to say that these diaries were written slowly over a long period of time before the day prior to the accident. In which case, .........would that mean that everything on Rokkenjima was premeditated, and prepared for over a long stretch of time...?
units.japanese: だとすると、この日記は、事故前日までにゆっくり時間を掛けて執筆されたという方が現実的だろう。だとしたら、………六軒島の全ては、長い時間を掛けて準備された「計画的犯行」ということになるのだろうか…？

description: MG uses singular makes with plural two differing contents.
sourceReading: Plural subject requires make.

units.text: If someone was plotting to make out those two days to be the work of a witch, then they really did go one step too far. And because there were two, it suggests that an undiscovered third one, or possibly even more might exist. ...In other words, the two differing contents makes both of them harder and harder to swallow.
units.japanese: 謎の二日間を、魔女の仕業にしたい何者かの仕組んだこととするならば、まさに蛇足なのだ。そして、２つ存在するということは、未発見の３つ目、あるいはそれ以上がある可能性すら示唆する。……つまり、２つの内容をますますに鵜呑みに出来なくしているわけだ。

description: UP writes unlikely had any experiences without a grammatical construction.
sourceReading: An adverb or modal construction is needed: likely had no experience or was unlikely to have had.

units.text: Ange snorted at the old professor, who was undoubtedly an earnest scholar, and unlikely had any experiences with women at all.
units.japanese: 縁寿は、女性経験と無縁そうな、学問一筋だったに違いない老教授をふっと笑う。

description: MG generalizes Amakusa current bed and the sofa here into multiple own beds and sofas.
sourceReading: 今の自分のベッド and ここのソファー identify his current bed and this sofa.

units.text: ...According to Amakusa, the sofas here were more pleasant than his own beds had been recently. Poor guy.
units.japanese: …天草曰く、今の自分のベッドより、ここのソファーの方が快適だとか。気の毒な話だ。

description: UP adds that Maria calls Ange mean when an argument escalates.
sourceReading: ひどいと marks the severe-case escalation into a quarrel; it does not report Maria calling Ange mean.

units.text: However, according to Maria onee‐chan, Beatrice was a good witch. If I held negative emotions towards Beatrice, she would get mad, argue with me and call me mean, and refuse to talk to me for a while.
units.japanese: しかし、真里亞お姉ちゃんはベアトリーチェは良い魔女だという。ベアトリーチェに対しネガティブな感情を私が持つと、へそを曲げてしまうし、ひどいと喧嘩になって、しばらく口も聞いてくれなくなる。

description: MG introduces the misspelling forgotting in its rewritten sentence.
sourceReading: The English present participle is forgetting.

units.text: Sakutaro had gotten the punishment game. He spent the whole time cheering for everyone else's answers, completely forgotting to think of any himself. ...Because of that, he'd been squished by the Seven Sisters and had his ears thoroughly nibbled, hadn't he?
units.japanese: 罰ゲームはさくたろだった。みんなの解答を、きゃっきゃと褒めてるばっかりで、自分が解答するのをすっかり忘れてたから。……そんなわけで七姉妹に揉みくちゃにされて、耳をはむはむされまくっていたっけ。

description: UP misorders no longer be as no be longer.
sourceReading: The English phrase requires no longer be able.

units.text: In other words, I would no be longer able to escape after school by leaving the classroom... After school, the first class study group meeting started right away.
units.japanese: つまり私は、放課後に逃げるように教室を後にすることが、出来なくなったわけだ…。放課後に、さっそく第１回のクラス勉強会が開かれた。

description: UP omits the second as in as much as you wanted.
sourceReading: The comparative construction requires as much as you wanted.

units.text: "If you'd just have asked, we'd have taught you as much you wanted. Wouldn't weeeee?!"
units.japanese: 「言ってくれれば私たち、いくらでも教えてあげたよ？　ねーーー？！」

description: MG omits the article in be the only one.
sourceReading: The construction requires the only one.

units.text: "...What is it, Mammon? Are you gonna be only one to fulfill my order? That's right. You're my best friend. ......You alone will do it for me. Get them!"
units.japanese: 「……なぁに、マモン。あなただけは私の命令を遂行してくれるの？　そうよね。私の一番のお友達だもんね。…………あなただけは、やってくれるわよね。こいつらを！」

description: UP replaces stuffed animals with animals in Ange rejection of toy play.
sourceReading: ぬいぐるみ specifies stuffed toys.

units.text: "*giggle*giggle*giggle*!! *giggle*giggle*giggle*giggle*giggle*!! I don't wanna play with stupid animals, let's all play outsi~de!! I'm bored with animals no~w!! *giggle*giggle*giggle*!!"
units.japanese: 「きゃっきゃっきゃっきゃ！！　きゃーッきゃっきゃっきゃっきゃっきゃ！！　ぬいぐるみ遊びなんかより、みんなでお外で遊ぶ方がいいー！！　ぬいぐるみもう飽きたー！！　きゃっきゃっきゃっきゃ！！」

description: MG removes the killed action from Ange metaphor about her soul.
sourceReading: 殺された魂 means her soul was killed.

units.text: "And yet, ......my dead soul is still locked up inside this cage of flesh. So I'll ask someone. If no one answers, ...I'll do it myself."
units.japanese: 「なのに、…………私の殺された魂は、未だにこの肉の檻に閉じ込められている。だから、誰かに求めよう。それに誰も応えてくれないなら、……自分でしよう」

description: MG specifies saying goodbye to your childhood self beyond the broader parting in the source.
sourceReading: 成長や決別 describes growing up or parting/moving on.

units.text: "Maybe. Or, she might forget, and it'll never come. ...In the human world, we call that growing up and saying goodbye to your childhood self. ......Still."
units.japanese: 「来ないで、そのまま忘れてしまうこともあるかもしれない。…人の世ではそれを、成長や決別と呼ぶから。…………でも」
candidates: saying goodbye to your childhood self

description: UP changes the overnight stay outcome into an offered permission.
sourceReading: そこで一晩を過ごすことになった reports spending the night there.

units.text: ......After that, I was taken to the police station, which was bigger than the police box, and they said I could spend the night there. And they asked me all kinds of things about myself. A lady who called herself the district welfare officer came by and asked about various things. And she said to me, "You poor thing".
units.japanese: ……その後、私は、もっと大きい警察署に連れて行かれ、そこで一晩を過ごすことになった。そして、私のことを色々と聞かれた。民生委員のおばさんと名乗る人がやって来て、色々と話を聞かれた。そして、可哀想にね、と言われた。

description: UP replaces Rosa striking Maria shoulders with bearing down on them.
sourceReading: 両肩を容赦ない力で叩き states forceful hitting of both shoulders.

units.text: After fiercely closing in on Maria, Rosa mercilessly bore down on her small shoulders, ......and dropped her gaze onto the stuffed animal Maria was holding: Sakutaro.
units.japanese: 楼座は、猛然と真里亞に迫ると、その小さな両肩を容赦ない力で叩き、……真里亞が抱いている、さくたろのぬいぐるみに目を落とした。

description: UP replaces Maria repeated explicit sadness with unspecified emotional overwhelm.
sourceReading: 悔しい悔しい悲しい悲しい pairs repeated frustration with repeated sadness.

units.text: "Hate Mama, hate Mama...!! Can't stand it, can't stand it, it's too much, it's too much...!! Want to twist Mama up like she did to Sakutaro...! Want to stick my fingernails in and tear her, turn her into cloth and cotton!!"
units.japanese: 「ママが憎いよ、ママが憎い…！！　悔しい悔しい悲しい悲しい…！！　さくたろがそうされたように、ママをねじり上げてやりたい…！　爪を立てて引き裂いて、布地と綿にしてやりたい！！」

description: UP substitutes satisfaction for recognition in the self-validation dialogue.
sourceReading: 認める concerns acknowledging oneself63 and wanting acknowledgment69;79 adds satisfying someone before recognition.

units.text: "Don't just laugh it off. What I'm trying to say is that there's no self about it—in this world, the only one capable of satisfying you is yourself."
units.japanese:
「茶化さんでください。俺が言いたいのは、自己も何も、自分を認められるのは世の中で自分だけしかいないってことです」
「人は、誰かに認められたくて努力をするわ。……多くの場合、それは親ね。親に褒められたくて、子どもは努力を覚える。………だから私は、覚えなかったわけだけど」
「誰かに認めて欲しくて、だけれど何を努力すればいいのかわからないのが、人の世の苦しみです。俺にもそういう頃があった」

units.text: "People work hard when they want to satisfy someone. ......In most cases, that someone is their parents. Children learn how to work hard because they want to be praised by their parents. .........Of course, that's why I never learned."
units.japanese:
「茶化さんでください。俺が言いたいのは、自己も何も、自分を認められるのは世の中で自分だけしかいないってことです」
「人は、誰かに認められたくて努力をするわ。……多くの場合、それは親ね。親に褒められたくて、子どもは努力を覚える。………だから私は、覚えなかったわけだけど」
「誰かに認めて欲しくて、だけれど何を努力すればいいのかわからないのが、人の世の苦しみです。俺にもそういう頃があった」

units.text: "The anguish of the human world comes when you want to satisfy someone, you want recognition, but you don't know where to put the effort. I had a time like that too."
units.japanese:
「茶化さんでください。俺が言いたいのは、自己も何も、自分を認められるのは世の中で自分だけしかいないってことです」
「人は、誰かに認められたくて努力をするわ。……多くの場合、それは親ね。親に褒められたくて、子どもは努力を覚える。………だから私は、覚えなかったわけだけど」
「誰かに認めて欲しくて、だけれど何を努力すればいいのかわからないのが、人の世の苦しみです。俺にもそういう頃があった」

description: UP changes Amakusa refreshing manner into eloquence.
sourceReading: 爽やかに describes his refreshing or brisk manner.

units.text:
Amakusa continued stretching as he spoke.
In an annoyingly eloquent way. Hearing it told to me as though from a teacher made me instinctively want to resist, but what he was saying was extremely sensible.
units.japanese:
天草は柔軟運動を続けながら言う。
悔しいぐらいに爽やかに。教師みたいな言われ方をされると、ついつい反抗したくなるが、彼が言っていることは至極まともだった。

description: MG changes bringing a demon as proof into finding one.
sourceReading: 連れて来れば requires presenting or bringing the demon.

units.text: "Right?! To prove the existence of demons, you just need to find one."
units.japanese: 「だって！　悪魔の存在を証明するには悪魔を連れて来れば良いけれどォ」

description: UP adds a deferred perhaps one day to the request to acknowledge witches.
sourceReading: The interrupted request follows acknowledgment already made, without future deferral.

units.text: "If you will accept that much, perhaps one day, witches could also— ...No, that was a foolish question. You already have a clear answer to that question."
units.japanese: 「そこまでお認めになったなら、魔女もお認めになって……。…いえ、愚問でした。その問いに対する答えを、すでに縁寿さまは明確にお持ちだ」

description: MG misspells reunion as reuinon.
sourceReading: Standard spelling and auxiliary construction required.

units.text: If their existence is permitted, they're definitely capable of existing here. No, even if I don't permit it, they can exist. Because I acknowledged them, they showed their reuinon's joy to me as well.
units.japanese: その存在を許されたから、彼女らは確かにここに存在することが出来る。いや、私が許さなくたって、彼女らは存在出来るのだ。私が認めたから、彼女らは再会の喜びを、私にも見せてくれたのだ。

description: MG writes shouldve be possible rather than should be or should have been possible.
sourceReading: Standard spelling and auxiliary construction required.

units.text: Maria onee-chan had despaired, thinking that Sakutarou had died. Which meant she hadn't been able to summon him like this anymore. In the past, Onee-chan said it was more advantageous in a summoning to have a vessel. However, a vessel is like training wheels, and it shouldn't be absolutely necessary. ...In other words, even if the stuffed animal lion that was Sakutarou's vessel didn't exist, it should've be possible to summon him.
units.japanese: 真里亞お姉ちゃんは、さくたろうは死んでしまったと思い、絶望した。それはつまり、もうこうして召喚できなかったという意味だ。召喚には依り代がある方が有利だと、かつてお姉ちゃんは言っていた。しかし、依り代は補助輪のようなもので、絶対必要なものではないはず。……つまり、さくたろうの依り代であるライオンのぬいぐるみが存在しなくても、召喚は可能のはず。

description: UP omits explicit sweetness from Gaap tongue-melting image.
sourceReading: 甘くて explicitly gives sweetness alongside melting.

units.text: ".........So you are Gretel? I see, you look like a wise kid, ......*giggle*. I like that kind of kid. ......Their tongues just melt in the mouth."
units.japanese: 「………あなたがグレーテル？　なるほど、賢い子みたいね、……くす。そういう子は好きよ。……舌が甘くてとろけるから」

description: MG adds an assurance that Rosa is fine to her thanks.
sourceReading: ありがとう、僕 thanks the child without stating that Rosa is fine.

units.text: "...Thanks, I'm fine, little guy. ......Where are we...? It's really...cold."
units.japanese: 「…ありがとう、僕。………ここはどこ…？　すごく、……寒いわ」

description: UP duplicates causal conjunctions in because since.
sourceReading: The source provides one cause of the inability to make friends, not two consecutive causal conjunctions.

units.text: I mean, she won't come around even when I apologize, and there's nothing I can do now anyway, and it's all Maria's fault in the first place...!! I mean she can't make any friends because since she's forever taken up with this make‐believe stuffed animal thing, and that's why she's treated like a weirdo, and, you know...!! This is a good opportunity...for instructive guidance! It's not like I was pampered all the time myself...!!
units.japanese: だって、謝っても機嫌直さないし、もうどうしようもないし、そもそも真里亞が悪いし…！！いつまでもこんなぬいぐるみ遊びにかまけているから友達が出来ないわけで、変人扱いをされてるわけで…！！これはいい機会、教育的指導！　私だって甘やかしてばかりいるわけじゃないんだから…ッ！！

description: MG changes finishing quickly being insufficient into inability to finish quickly this time.
sourceReading: 早く終わらすだけじゃ駄目 requires more than speed: a sufficiently good design is needed.

units.text: Mama just can't finish her job quickly this time. Unless I give them a better design, I won't be given another job, ...that's how tough this work is. So it'll just have to take some time."
units.japanese: 「ママの仕事は早く終わらすだけじゃ駄目なの。より良いデザインをあげないと、次から仕事をもらえない、大変な仕事なのよ。だからどうしても時間が掛かっちゃうの」

description: MG replaces contempt with neglect in Maria account of her anger and sadness.
sourceReading: 蔑まれてきた denotes being despised or scorned.

units.text: I'll teach you all of my pain...!! Teach you much, much more...!! It's still not enough, not close to enough...!! Since I was born, since before I was born...!! I can't get rid of the anger and sadness of being neglected so long...!!"
units.japanese: 「真里亞の苦しみの全てを教えてやる…！！　もっともっと教えてやる…！！　まだまだ足りない、全然足りない…！！　生まれた時から、生まれる前から…ッ！！　蔑まれてきたこの怒りと悲しみが、どうしても消せないの……！！」

description: UP omits instant death from the narrated injury assessment.
sourceReading: 即死 explicitly identifies death as instantaneous.

units.text:
Six people had been killed in the dining hall.
They had all witnessed the exact moments when the six had been killed. And what's more, it had been done by half‐destroying their heads— anyone could tell with just a single glance that they had been dealt a fatal injury. Everyone understood that calling for an ambulance now would be completely meaningless......
units.japanese:
食堂で６人が殺された。
殺される瞬間を、全員が目撃した。それも、頭部を半壊されるという、誰が見ても一目で即死が理解できる致命的な損傷によってだ。救急に電話することが、もはや何の意味もないことを誰もが理解している……。

description: MG replaces seeking explanation from Kinzo through speech with finding a verbally expressible reason.
sourceReading: 口で言って refers to speaking to Kinzo to seek understanding or explanation.

units.text: "Everyone, listen to me. .........Father is... ...hopeless now. We've passed the point... of searching for a reason or an explanation that can be expressed in words."
units.japanese: 「みんな、聞きたまえ。……………親父は、………もう駄目だ。…口で言って、理解や説明が求められる段階に、…もうない」

description: MG replaces propping the bed upright with sliding it into place.
sourceReading: 立てかけて specifies standing or leaning the bed upright as a barricade.

units.text: "If so, then that's even more of a reason to hold out in our room... Let's slide a bed in place, and block the window too. ...If we do that much, then no matter how many guns they've got, they shouldn't be able to raid us."
units.japanese: 「だとすれば、ますますに部屋に篭城するべきだね…。ベッドを立てかけて、窓も塞ごう。……そこまですれば、いくら銃を持っていても、踏み込むことはできないはず」

description: MG misspells siege as seige.
sourceReading: The English noun is spelled siege.

units.text: George had things like drinks, canned food, crackers, and other types of snacks he had found in the lounge and a storage room, as well as a first aid kit. They were all consumables that would be essential during a seige.
units.japanese: 譲治はラウンジや倉庫から見つけてきた、飲み物や缶詰、クラッカーなどの軽食、そして救急箱。篭城する上で欠かせない消耗品ばかりだった。

description: MG omits the article in at top of the stairs.
sourceReading: The English construction requires at the top.

units.text: They had apparently set up a barricade at top of the stairs as well. It had been set up in a way that would create a racket, so it would serve as a warning alarm as well. That had apparently been Battler's idea.
units.japanese:
彼らは階段上にもバリケードを設けてきたらしい。
賑やかに音がするように仕掛けをしたので、警報代わりにもなるという。戦人の発案らしかった。

description: UP changes fear of cutting losses into not knowing when to cut them.
sourceReading: 損切りを恐れれば identifies reluctance or fear concerning accepting a loss.

units.text: "If you're risk‐averse, biding your time until the situation improves again is not a bad idea. ......However, if you don't know when to cut your losses, what you have might become worthless scraps of paper. ......And what we have is our lives."
units.japanese: 「リスクを恐れるなら、事態が好転するまで塩漬けにするのも悪くない。……もっとも、損切りを恐れれば、紙切れ同然になるかもしれんがね。……我々の命がだが」

description: UP inserts an incorrect article in not a much of a paradise.
sourceReading: The English construction is not much of a paradise.

units.text: "............If that witch is there, then it's not a much of a paradise."
units.japanese: 「…………あの魔女がいるなら、ろくな理想郷じゃないよ」

description: MG changes apologizing for idle talk into apologizing for butting in.
sourceReading: 無駄口 labels idle or unnecessary talk; the PC English says blathering. MG newly makes it an interruption.

units.text: "......True enough. I apologize for butting in."
units.japanese: 「…………確かに。無駄口を失礼しました」

description: MG omits Gaap explicit identification of the failed attempt to shorten her name.
sourceReading: 詰まった identifies stumbling or failing in the attempt.

units.text: "Lia, you just tried to shorten my name, didn't you?"
units.japanese: 「リーア、今、私の名前を縮めようとして詰まったでしょ」

description: MG introduces an extra article in proof of that a curse.
sourceReading: The English construction cannot combine that with a in this position.

units.text: "......For the past 12 years, you've been constantly enslaved by Beatrice-sama's curse. ...This might be proof of that a curse. But please, hang in there. Breaking through that was supposed to be part of the goal of this journey."
units.japanese: 「………この１２年間。縁寿さまはずっとベアトリーチェさまの呪縛に捕らわれてきた。…これがその、まさに呪縛の証となるのかもしれません。ですが、どうかしっかり。それを打ち破るための旅でもあるはずです」

description: MG changes uncertainty about the purpose of the trip into doubt whether any reason exists.
sourceReading: 目的さえ未だにあやふや concerns an unclear purpose, not its nonexistence.

units.text: "......Yeah, I won't die. I promise. ......After all, I'm still not sure if there's any reason why I need to go to Rokkenjima."
units.japanese: 「………えぇ、死にません。約束します。………そもそも私。どうして六軒島に行かなくてはならないかの目的さえ、未だにあやふやなんですから」

description: MG changes the captain not understanding into his not seeing anything.
sourceReading: わからん repeats inability to understand.

units.text: "Wh-What is it? You see something there, don't you?! I don't...I don't see anything... Wh-What is it you see...?!"
units.japanese: 「ど、どうしたんだね？　何があるんだね？！　わからん、…わしにはわからん…。あ、あんたには何が見えてるのかね…？！」

description: MG adds hostile speech to the simple question about the own room.
sourceReading: 自分の部屋 only asks about the own room; it contains no insult or query about Kinzo game.

units.text: "Really, go to your room? What's your game, you damn geezer..."
units.japanese: 「自分の部屋？」

description: MG changes the red trajectory or trail into a curved blade or sword.
sourceReading: 赤い軌跡 describes a red visible trace, without specifying curved weapon geometry.

units.text: Kanon sliced the metal bars again with his red curved blade. But there was a harsh, strange noise, and the metal bars only had a slight scratch.
units.japanese: 再び嘉音が赤い軌跡で鉄格子を斬る。しかし、激しい異音がするだけで、鉄格子にはわずかの傷がつくだけだった。

description: UP narrows anti-personnel effectiveness to ground troops.
sourceReading: 対人 describes effectiveness against people, without restricting them to ground troops.

units.text: The strength of each individual one is low, but they pierce through all shields and possess total lethality against ground troops. And on top of that, each one of the 48 possesses autonomous guidance towards their individual targets.
units.japanese: それぞれの威力は低いが、あらゆるシールドを貫通し、対人なら完全な殺傷力を有する。しかもその上、４８発の全てが個別目標に自律誘導する。

description: MG turns plots the child finds entertaining into plots designed to entertain her and predicts their future twists.
sourceReading: あの子の面白がる筋書き describes plots she enjoys and the twists they contain.

units.text: "So, furniture was able to repel weapons, if only for a moment. ......I see, a plot to entertain that child truly will be filled with unexpected turns!"
units.japanese: 「家具が武具を、一時的にとはいえ退けますか。………なるほど、あの子の面白がる筋書きは、実に大番くるわせが多いこと！」

description: MG omits combat from the named spirit-particle combat area of influence.
sourceReading: 霊子戦影響下 expressly identifies spirit-particle combat influence.

units.text: "...Sorry! We've entered Virgilia-sama's Spirit Particle Area of Influence!! Our magic power has been neutralized!"
units.japanese: 「……ごめん！　ワルギリアさまの霊子戦影響下に入った！！　私たちの魔力が中和されてる！」

description: MG omits is from one who so blissfully unaware of his place.
sourceReading: 身の程知らず modifies the addressee; grammatical English requires who is so blissfully unaware.

units.text: "Hohhohohoho. You think you can win even with a fluke...? Allow me to explain so that even one who so blissfully unaware of his place can understand."
units.japanese: 「ほっほほほほ。まぐれでも勝てるつもりとお思いですか…？　身の程知らずのあなたのために、私が状況を整理して差し上げましょう」

description: MG mixes future marriage with the past tense when I got home.
sourceReading: 帰ったら結婚することになってる presents a current plan to marry after returning home.

units.text: And I...a-actually have a childhood friend, ...and I'm gonna marry her when I got hooooome!!!
units.japanese: それに俺、…じ、実は幼馴染がいて、帰ったら結婚することになってるっすーーー！！！

description: MG makes Jessica gruesome bodily transformation into a change of scenery.
sourceReading: そのあまりに惨い変わり様 follows Jessica corpse and flesh being thrown back into her room, referring to her grievously altered state.

units.text: Jessica's corpse and lumps of flesh fell from the ceiling and poured out all over her room. Ronove shook his head slightly at this gruesome change of scenery.
units.japanese: 朱志香の死体と肉片が、天井から朱志香の部屋にどさどさぐちゃぐちゃと降り注ぐ。そのあまりに惨い変わり様に、ロノウェは小さく首を横に振った。

description: MG omits to from okay for you think that.
sourceReading: The English construction requires for you to think. OriginalWH185990 instead has grammatical alright if you think that.

units.text: ...Yes, it's okay for you think that. Even I still haven't sorted out what it was I saw."
units.japanese: 「……えぇ、思ってくれていいわ。私だって、何を見たのか、未だに整理がつかない」

description: MG changes Jessica personal wish not to die into a general claim about people.
sourceReading: 死にたくないさ expresses her personal reluctance before339 generalizes to anyone.

units.text: "People don't want to die. ...So no one would want to choose the first option. ...People want to live in happiness...and struggle as much as life will let them. So normally, the first choice should be impossible from the beginning."
units.japanese: 「死にたくないさ。……だから一番なんて、誰だって選びたくない。……人は、幸せに生きたくて、生の限りを足掻いてるんだぜ。だから本当は、まず一番目なんてありえないはずなんだ」

description: UP introduces the unnatural construction let out a voice for Shannon speaking up.
sourceReading: 声をあげる means raising her voice or speaking up in response to the scene.

units.text:
Shannon, who had been looking at the three‐sided mirror, let out a voice. ...They looked to see that George, who had been silent this whole time, had raised his head.
......It seemed that George had also decided on an answer...
units.japanese:
三面鏡を見ていた紗音が声をあげる。…見れば、ずっと沈黙していた譲治が顔を上げている。
……譲治もどうやら、答えを決めたらしい…。

description: UP adds a lack of better options as the reason for George first target.
sourceReading: とりあえずさ introduces the starting point or immediate choice, without claiming inferior alternatives.

units.text: ".........Well, for lack of a better option... the first one will be you, then—I hope that won't be a problem?"
units.japanese: 「………とりあえずさ。その一番目が、君になるわけだけど、いいかな」

description: UP narrows Gaap claim that the parents were killed all too easily into their being killed without a fight.
sourceReading: 呆気なく殺された describes how unceremoniously or easily they were killed, without specifying whether they resisted.

units.text: "*chuckle*, nice words. ......Nowww I get it. So you say that the way you can still stand up after being kicked down so many times is the strength you received from Shannon. In that case, what did you receive from your mother and father, who were killed without a fight? .........?"
units.japanese: 「くす、言うわね。……なぁるほど。何度も蹴り倒されて転がされ、それでも立ち上がるのが紗音からもらった強さだと。なら、呆気なく殺されたあんたのお父さんとお母さんからは何をもらったの？　………？」

description: UP changes Kanon seeming rejection into technically actual rejection.
sourceReading: 一見拒絶する concerns outward appearance, distinguished from words penetrating his heart.

units.text: Those words were probably aimed at Kanon... Kanon had, technically, rejected Jessica's words. ......But Jessica knew that, no matter how obstinate his heart was, those words would eventually soak through.
units.japanese: それは多分、嘉音に語り掛ける言葉…。朱志香の言葉を一見拒絶する嘉音。……だが、その頑なな心に、少しずつ染み透っているのを、朱志香は知っている。

description: MG substitutes jumpy nervousness for Maria description of Battler as impatient or hasty.
sourceReading: せっかち describes impatience or haste, not nervous startle. OriginalPC186520–186521 has hasty.

units.text: "Yeah. Battler just came back. He sure is jumpy. Kihihihihihihihihihihi..."
units.japanese: 「うん。戦人、今、帰ってきたよ。せっかちだよね。きひひひひひひひひひひ……」

description: UP combines all and this many ungrammatically in You have killed all this many people.
sourceReading: これだけ大勢 describes this many people or such a large number. OriginalWH189672 uses such a large number of people.

units.text: ".........Stop being so stupid. Just how irresponsible are you? You've killed all this many people. On top of that, using your witch's power, you've done it over and over. In gruesome ways! .........There's no way I can allow you to escape without taking responsibility...!"
units.japanese: 「………ふざけないで。なんて無責任な人なの。あんたはこれだけ大勢の人間を殺した。しかも、魔女の力によって、何度も何度も。惨たらしい殺し方で！　………その責任を取らず、逃げ出すなんて、絶対に許せない…！」

description: UP uses a invite instead of an invite.
sourceReading: Invite begins with a vowel sound and requires an here.

units.text: "Try and guess, you could win a invite to Hawaii! Ahhyah{0hyah{0hhyaaaah!! Fffinally. FINALLY!! Mmmmmmm, it was soooo looo{-o{-o{-o{-ong, the days leading up to today were reee{-e{-eeally long...!!"
units.japanese: 「当ててみろよォ、ハワイへご招待するぜぇ？　あっひゃっひゃっっひゃああぁッ！！　ぃやっとだ。やっとッ！！　んんんん、長かったぜええぇええぇ、本ッ当ぉおおぉに今日まで長い日々だった…！！」

description: MG omits dismantling the hat stand to make the spear.
sourceReading: 帽子掛けを分解して explicitly says the hat stand was taken apart.

units.text: I took the spear I'd made from the hat stand... and went outside without even an umbrella.
units.japanese: 俺は帽子掛けを分解して作った槍を持ち、傘も差さずに表へ出る。

description: MG literalizes Kyrie earnest efforts as tearing her heart apart.
sourceReading: 心を砕いてくれた means she took pains or made earnest efforts to maintain contact. OriginalWH188305 wracked her brains retains effort.

units.text: But since then, six years have passed. ...Time healed the anger. Kyrie-san understood my anger, and even so, she tried to interact with me, even if it meant tearing her heart apart.
units.japanese: でもそれから６年を経た。……時間は怒りを癒した。霧江さんも、俺の怒りを理解していて、それでもなお交流しようと、心を砕いてくれた。

description: MG adds as if it were true to Ange love for her believed real brother.
sourceReading: 本当の兄だと信じて慕ってくれた reports believing and affection without a narrator qualification of truth.

units.text: Ange didn't know anything about the situation, and even though I lived in a separate house, she was raised believing that I was her real big brother and loved me as if it were true. ...Dad casually said to come home any time I wanted.
units.japanese: 縁寿は何も事情を知らず、俺のことを別居してはいるけど、本当の兄だと信じて慕ってくれた。……親父はけろっとして、いつでも帰って来いなんて言ってやがる。

description: MG turns the funeral date attached to Battler declaration into a subsequent event.
sourceReading: 祖父ちゃんの葬式の日に attaches the day to saying he would forgive if his father apologized.

units.text: "It started to feel more and more ridiculous!! I thought it was about time for me to cool my head as well. So I said I'd put it all behind me as long as Dad apologized. Then came the day of Grandpa's funeral!
units.japanese: 「だんだん馬鹿らしくなってきたんだよ！！　そろそろ俺も頭を冷やしてもいいかなって思ったんだ。だから俺は、親父が謝ったら全部水に流すと言ってやったんだ。祖父ちゃんの葬式の日に！」

description: UP uses thrusted instead of the irregular past thrust.
sourceReading: OriginalWH195171 uses grammatical thrusting; UP rewrites it as thrusted.

units.text: Kasumi let out a piercing scream. At the same time, the two remaining black‐suits came for me at once, and thrusted their guns against my head. ......Like they were trying to use me as a hostage against something their eyes couldn't ‘see’see. .........Against the Seven Sisters of Purgatory, high‐level furniture who had now reached the level of weapons, this was completely and totally pointless.
units.japanese: 霞が金切り声のような悲鳴を上げる。それと同時に黒服の二人が私に組みかかり、銃を私の頭に突きつけた。……目に視えぬ何者かに対し、人質にでもしているつもりなのだ。………こんなことは、今や武具の域にまで達した上級家具、煉獄の七姉妹に対して、まったく何の意味もない。

description: UP omits Beelzebub's explicit cry of happiness after permission to kill.
sourceReading: しッあわせぇえ explicitly declares happiness; originalPC195215 and WH195216 preserve both gratitude and joy.

units.text: "I am so very grateful...!! Diiiiiee!!!"
units.japanese: 「ありがたきッ！！　しッあわせぇえ！！　死ねえッ！！！」

description: MG omits to in a journey reach an end.
sourceReading: The purpose construction requires a journey to reach an end. Original WH191514 has a journey to end this.

units.text: When I started my journey to expose the past of 12 years ago, my goal had been abstract, and I hadn't understood. But now, ...I have no doubts. This journey...was induced by several thoughts and fates over 12 years. A journey to reach an end for me, Ushiromiya Ange. And, a journey reach an end as the last witch of Mariage Sorcière.
units.japanese: １２年前を暴く私の最後の旅は、初めはその目的も抽象的で、わからなかった。しかし、……今は私は、疑わない。この旅は、…………１２年を経て、様々な思いや運命によって誘われたもの。私、右代宮縁寿にとっての、終わらせる旅。そして、マリアージュ・ソルシエールの最後の魔女としての、終わらせる旅。

description: UP changes the witch's accusation of a vague inkling into knowing very well.
sourceReading: 薄々は想像がついてる explicitly limits awareness to a faint inkling; originalPC195722–195723 and MG preserve this degree.

units.text: Ehheheheheh! I think you know very well what! That woman you hated and despised the most! And that woman hated and despised you the most as well...!
units.japanese: うっふふふふふ！　薄々は想像がついてるくせに！あんたが、もっとも憎み、恨んだ、あの女よ！そして女もあなたをもっとも恨み、憎んだ…！

description: UP promotes the inference of hidden handguns into realized obvious possession.
sourceReading: 想起させる says the unnatural pocketed hands clearly suggest handgun possession; it does not state perception confirming the weapons. OriginalWH191803 retains likelihood.

units.text:
......Before what.
...Ange could more or less guess. The way the black‐suits had their hands unnaturally stuck into their pockets made me realize that they were obviously in possession of handguns. .........This is a deserted island.
There could be no more convenient place to dispose of someone.
units.japanese:
……何を待つというのか。
…だが、縁寿には大体察しがついていた。黒服たちの、不自然にポケットに突っ込んだ手などは、明らかな拳銃の所持を想起させる。………ここは無人島。
これほど都合のいい処理の場所はあるまい。

description: MG replaces Ange refusal to apologize with You say something like that?, addressed to Kasumi.
sourceReading: 誰が言うもんか refuses to say the requested apology herself. OriginalWH192320–192321 Who would say something like that preserves rhetorical refusal.

units.text: ".........You... say something like that? ......Gwah, ......ghhh...!!"

description: UP omits at in for least a moment.
sourceReading: The duration construction requires for at least a moment. OriginalWH192646 at least a little is grammatical though separately changes duration to amount.

units.text: In order to let her forget her pain and sorrow for least a moment, ............the black witch, the very same that possessed Aunt Rosa, ......taught her magic. It was the same magic of anger and sadness that Beatrice had taught Maria onee‐chan, when she was mourning for Sakutarou after he was torn apart. ......That same magic, that witch, had surely dwelled inside Aunt Rosa too.
units.japanese: その彼女の痛みと悲しみをわずかの間だけ忘れさせるために、…………楼座叔母さんに取り憑いたのと同じ、黒き魔女が、……魔法を教えたのだ。それは、さくたろうを引き裂かれて嘆き悲しんだ真里亞お姉ちゃんに、ベアトリーチェが教えたのと同じ、怒りと悲しみの魔法。……同じ魔法は、魔女は、きっと楼座叔母さんにも宿っていただろう。

description: MG misspells embarrassing as embarassing.
sourceReading: The intended English word is embarrassing. OriginalWH193620 has shocking, so this spelling error is introduced by MG.

units.text: "To think she had something like this as a friend... That Ushiromiya Maria kid's mind is so pathetic it's embarassing, what a joooke. ......She's like, a moron. If only she'd just give up...and diiiiiiiieee...!"
units.japanese: 「こんなのを友達にしてるなんて、右代宮真里亞って子の、頭の可哀想さに呆れて、ヘソでお茶が沸いちゃうわ〜。………バッカみたいぃ。ヘソ噛んで、死んじゃえばァぁああぁ……？」

description: UP uses sung as simple past after removing had.
sourceReading: She sung requires She sang or She had sung. OriginalWH194058 has grammatically correct She had sung.

units.text: But partway through, she forgot the lyrics. But her mama was enjoying it so much, so she tried to sing until the very end. With "uu‐uu‐uu". ......She sung it with fake lyrics, but her mama was very pleased...... After that, "uu" remained as an incantation to remember that day she had spent in fun and happiness with her mama.
units.japanese: でも、途中で歌詞がわからなくなって。でも、こんなにもママが喜んでくれてるから、最後まで歌い続けたくて。うーうーうー、と。……歌詞を誤魔化して歌ったんだけど、それをママはとても喜んでくれて……。それ以来、“うー”は彼女にとって、ママと楽しく幸せに過ごした日の、思い出の呪文となって残った。

description: UP changes Beatrice's prior prohibition into a joint decision with Maria.
sourceReading: それはならぬと言ったはず means I thought I said that must not happen; originalPC196525–196526 and MG retain Beatrice speech act.

units.text: "......Maria. We decided against that. As long as I have you, I am satisfied. Tell me that you too are satisfied as long as you have me."
units.japanese: 「……マリア。それはならぬと言ったはず。妾にはそなただけがいれば良い。だからそなたも、妾だけがいれば良いと、言っておくれ」

description: UP adds small and nondescript to the description of the smoking room.
sourceReading: とても薄暗い specifies only very dim lighting; originalPC197755–197756 adds neither size nor unremarkable decor.

units.text: ......It was a small, nondescript, and very dimly lit smoking room. There was no door to exit by, and while there were windows, ......they let no light into this place—Beatrice's smoking room. Even as Beato moaned from the pain of being slammed against that cold hard floor, she shakily rose to her feet......
units.japanese: ……そこは、とても薄暗い、喫煙室。出ることの出来る扉はなく、窓はあれど光も差さぬ、……薄暗きベアトリーチェの喫煙室。ベアトはその冷たく硬い床に叩き付けられた痛みに呻きながらも、ふらふらと立ち上がる……。

description: MG rewrites I will disappear as ungrammatical I am disappear.
sourceReading: OriginalWH198832–198833 I will disappear is grammatical; MG contraction I am lacks going to or a progressive participle.

units.text: "...I'm......... ...disappear now, but... ...Onii-chan, fight with all you've got, ......and I'm sure, you'll... ...come back to me......
units.japanese: 「…私は………、…もう消えちゃうけれど……。……お兄ちゃんは、がんばって戦って、………きっと、私のところへ………帰ってきてね………」

description: MG replaces Ange's apology for gripping Battler painfully with a duplicate explanation of the grip.
sourceReading: ごめんね is a separate apology afterぎゅっとしてて; originalWH198888–198889 preserves I held it so tightly followed by Sorry.

units.text: "......In a second, I'm going to take my hand away...... It must have hurt, right......? I held you so tightly... I held it so tightly......
units.japanese: 「……この手を、今から離すね……。痛かったでしょ……？　ぎゅっとしてて、………ごめんね………」

description: MG supplies one in a billion where the Japanese specifies one in ten billion.
sourceReading: 百億 is ten billion, preserved by UP. OriginalWH199354–199356 omits this numerical clause, so MG introduces the specific wrong quantity.

units.text:
.........Are my chances at victory not even one in a billion...? no.........is it certain that there is not even a Fragment of a miracle...
 that could make my victory happen?
units.japanese:
………………妾の勝ちは百億にひとつも、
いや………、ひとカケラの奇跡も絶対になく、
ありえぬということか。

description: MG uses might been hiding without the required auxiliary.
sourceReading: Might be hiding or might have been hiding is required. OriginalWH200070 uses grammatical was hiding.

units.text: Then, morning came. ...My tension and fatigue combined with my drowsiness, making for the worst kind of dawn. Humans are pretty incredible. ...Even when a murderer might been hiding somewhere, we prioritize drowsiness and fatigue over our own lives. ...By that time, I was starting to feel pretty ridiculous. After all, for a full six hours before dawn, I'd walked around the mansion, yelling at the culprits to show themselves. My search had been a careful one, and I'd tired myself out and let my guard down. Even so, no one came to attack me. Basically, I lost patience with them and figured they could do whatever the hell they wanted......
units.japanese:
そして、朝が来た。……緊張感と疲労感、そして眠さが入り混じった、最悪の夜明けだった。人間ってすげえもんだ。……殺人犯がどこに潜んでるかわからねぇってのに、自分の命の心配より、眠気と疲れを優先しやがる。……その頃にはもう、何だか馬鹿馬鹿しくなり始めていた。夜が明けるまで、６時間もたっぷり、俺は屋敷を歩き回り、姿を見せやがれと怒鳴って回っていたのだから。丹念に探したし、疲れて隙も晒した。
それでも、誰も襲いかかっては来ない。もう俺は呆れ果て、好きにしやがれとなったわけだ………。

description: MG transfers firmly laid from the carpet to a solid floor.
sourceReading: しっかりと modifies carpet being laid on floor. OriginalWH200212 preserves this attachment; MG instead asserts a solid floor in an inquiry into concealed pitfalls.

units.text: The room had a solid floor with a carpet that looked dignified, if a bit worn out. ...No matter how you looked at it, it was single piece. If a pitfall had opened up, there would have to be a seam just in that place. ...And, if there had been some trick like a pitfall, wouldn't it creak when you walked on it?? No matter how much I walked around, feeling the carpet, I just couldn't imagine that a pitfall was hidden here.
units.japanese: 床にはしっかりと、くたびれてはいるが貫禄ある絨毯が敷かれている。……どう見ても一枚物だ。落とし穴が開くってんなら、ちゃんとそこだけ切れ目が入れてあるってことになる。……それに、落とし穴なんて細工があったら、あるけばギシギシとか、音を立てるんじゃないか？？いくら歩き回り、絨毯を撫で回してみても、とても落とし穴が隠されているとは思えない。

description: MG drops I cannot from the statement that the stakes cannot be pulled out.
sourceReading: 抜けぬか expresses inability. OriginalPC203323–203324 explicitly has Seems I cannot / pull them out after all; UP preserves inability.

units.text: ......As I feared, ...pull them out after all...... ...ggghh......

description: MG duplicates is across the split sentence The only resolution permitted is / is to continue on resisting.
sourceReading: OriginalWH203401 has no first is; the later is supplies the predicate. UP restructures the complete passage grammatically.

units.text: I will have no victory...and no end through a tie. ......The only resolution permitted is... is to continue on resisting... ...until defeat is given to me...in this game... That's right, I... ...am fighting......only to be killed by Battler......
units.japanese: 勝利はなく、引き分けによる終了もない。……唯一許された決着、……敗北を与えられるまで、………延々と抗うだけの、……ゲーム……。そうさ、私は、………戦人に殺されるためだけに、………戦っている………。
candidates: resolution permitted is... is to continue on resisting

description: UP substitutes passion for compassion when Beatrice recalls obtaining sympathy through apparent frailty.
sourceReading: 同情 means sympathy or compassion. OriginalPC203743 and MG retain compassion; following970 explicitly says sympathize.

units.text: Battler's eyes burned with the flames of hatred... ......The days when I could earn his passion by appearing frail are now a matter of the distant past. ......Having been tricked once, Battler will never sympathize with me again.
units.japanese: 戦人の目が憎悪の炎に燃える…。……弱々しい仕草に同情を得られたのは、もう遠い過去の話だ。……一度騙された戦人は、二度と妾に情けなど掛けない。

description: UP makes Ange play and discard herself where Bern says she was forced to play her trump card prematurely.
sourceReading: いきなり切らされたわ follows Bern intention to use the piece after more support: Bern was compelled to play it immediately. OriginalPC206841–206843 uses passive was used; MG remains passive.

units.text: ".........In truth, I wanted to have her support him a bit more before playing her out. She really did play and discard herself straight away. What a waste for a piece that required so much preparation."
units.japanese: 「………本当はもっとサポートさせて、それから切りたかったんだけどね。いきなり切らされたわ。仕込みにずいぶん掛かった駒なのに、勿体無かった」

description: UP restricts the six-year-old’s possible maneuvering to verbal persuasion.
sourceReading: Bernkastel cannot imagine what actions the child could take to make them turn back.

units.text: "What verbal acrobatics a six‐year‐old girl could possibly perform to persuade them to turn back, I can't even imagine. ......But yes. If you had been in this place, the probability wouldn't have been zero. If there is a probability other than zero, I can find a miracle."
units.japanese: 「６歳の女の子が、どう立ち回れば彼らを引き返させることが出来るのか、私には想像もつかないけれど。……そうね。もしこの場に居たなら、確率はゼロではなかったわ。ゼロでない確率ならば、私は奇跡を探し出せる」

description: UP replaces reluctantly agreeing to a deal he cannot refuse with being unable to pass up a deal.
sourceReading: 断りきれない話を渋々承諾 explicitly combines inability to refuse with reluctant acceptance. OriginalPC7222–7223 and MG preserve reluctance.

units.text: Krauss claimed to hold honor as a virtue. ...However, Natsuhi knew that he most often used this as an excuse after he couldn't bring himself to pass up a deal.
units.japanese: 蔵臼は、義理を大事にしたいという美徳を掲げていた。…しかしそれは、断りきれない話を渋々承諾した際の言い訳にもっとも使われることを、夏妃は知っていた。

description: MG uses may gave been instead of may have been.
sourceReading: Modal perfect requires have been. OriginalPC7619 and UP use grammatical might have lessened.

units.text: ...Krauss had seriously believed that he would succeed with several businesses...and that he would definitely gain huge profits. So, he had figured that even if he stepped over a few legal lines, he would be able to pay everything back before too long and pretend that the whole thing had never happened. ...This may gave been the factor that lessened his resistance towards breaking a couple laws.
units.japanese: ……蔵臼は本気で、数々の事業が成功し、必ず大きな実りがあると信じていた。だから、多少、法に触れることになろうとも、すぐにそれを返済して、なかったことに出来ると信じていた。……だからこそ、触法に対する抵抗感が少なかったのかもしれない。

description: MG adds that nothing mattered to Krauss but survival where the Japanese describes heedless means of raising money.
sourceReading: 形振り構わなかった describes disregarding appearances or scruples in obtaining money. OriginalPC7607–7610 and UP preserve this.

units.text: If it would come to criminal charges, ...then he must have broken some laws. He's probably been so intent on raising a large sum of money...that nothing had mattered to him but survival.
units.japanese: 刑事訴訟ということは、…何かの法に触れたということだ。多額の金を捻出するために、形振り構わなかったということだろう。

description: MG omits to from would not be able to solve it.
sourceReading: Able requires the to infinitive here. OriginalPC7793 and UP use grammatical there is no way we cannot solve it.

units.text: Yes, it's a fanciful riddle that Father created...!! We should be able to solve it, ...and there's no reason we wouldn't be able solve it...! It's the only way!!"
units.japanese: 「そうだ、あんなの親父が作った気紛れななぞなぞなんだ…！！　解けるはずさ、解けないはずがないんだ…！　それしかないんだ！！」

description: UP uses repeated himself that with an unlicensed that-clause complement.
sourceReading: Repeated that or repeated himself, saying that is required. OriginalPC8791 repeatedly said that and MG are grammatical.

units.text: Nanjo repeated himself that the time of death would be discovered during the autopsy, but Natsuhi said again that this wouldn't be a problem.
units.japanese: 南條は、遺体を解剖されれば死亡時期が特定されると繰り返すが、夏妃は問題ないと繰り返し言った。

description: MG assigns acting alive to dead Kinzo instead of the people acting as though he exists.
sourceReading: Acting as though Kinzo exists is attributed to Natsuhi false representation. OriginalPC9479–9480 does not assign active performance to dead Kinzo. UP everything behaving retains represented existence.

units.text: "The only reason he's able to act like he's alive like this... is because of Aunt Natsuhi's lie, her attempt to make it through the family conference while hiding Grandfather's death."
units.japanese: 「それを存在するかのように振舞っているのは、何とか祖父さまの死を隠して親族会議を誤魔化し切ろうとする夏妃伯母さんの嘘だからだ」

description: MG introduces malformed Consider this is a confidential benefit.
sourceReading: Consider this a benefit or consider that this is a benefit is required. OriginalPC10192 This is a secret benefit is grammatical; UP preserves it.

units.text: "You really did a good job. Both of you, as well as Genji and Shannon, will get your pay for a month's worth of past vacation time, as well as five extra days, just as promised. Consider this is a confidential benefit. Talk with Genji when you collect your pay so that the other servants don't find out."
units.japanese: 「本当にご苦労でした。お前たちと源次と紗音には、約束どおり、過去一ヶ月分の休暇の買い上げと、新たに５日の有給を与えます。秘密の手当てですよ。取得に際しては源次と相談し、他の使用人たちに気取られないように」
candidates: Consider this is a confidential benefit

description: MG introduces a duplicated auxiliary in The days they'd had been locked.
sourceReading: The contraction they'd already supplies had; the following had been duplicates the auxiliary. Original PC10679–10680 and UP have grammatical they had been.

units.text: The days they'd had been locked in a killing-fest with red swords and blue wedges... already seemed like the distant past. Now, not only was Beato unable to do that, ...it was even difficult for her to make her body do as she pleased. Even just drinking a mouthful of black tea like this was hard...
units.japanese: かつて、赤き宝刀と青き楔で殺し合いをした日々のことが、もはや遠い過去のよう。今のベアトとは、殺し合いどころか、……意思を通わせることさえ難しい。こうして、……紅茶を一口、飲ませることさえ……。

description: MG makes Battler the recipient of the method he has proclaimed since the start.
sourceReading: そして最初から、それを掲げている continues Battler as subject: he has upheld/proclaimed the method. MG adds to me to the passive, turning him into its recipient; PC12113–12114 has passive shown without that added recipient. UP restores active proclamation.

units.text: That's right. I already know how I can reach the end of that journey. It's been made clear to me since the very beginning.
units.japanese: そうさ。俺はその旅路を辿るための方法を、もう知っている。そして最初から、それを掲げている。

description: UP broadens Natsuhi's prohibition on suspicious contacts into a prohibition on connections with other men.
sourceReading: 疑われるような接点 restricts the forbidden contacts to ones inviting suspicion. UP prohibits connections with men other than her husband and then gives suspicion as a reason. PC12882–12884 and MG retain the restricted scope.

units.text: Natsuhi thought that as a wife, it wasn't right for her to have connections with men other than her husband, much less a young man; it might be considered suspicious. The phone call suddenly seemed like something dirty.
units.japanese: 妻たるもの、夫以外の、それも若い男性と、疑われるような接点があるべきではない。そう思うと、急に汚らわしい電話のように思えてきた。
candidates: connections with men other than her husband

description: UP adds very small size to the puddle instead of applying small solely to the splash sound.
sourceReading: 水溜りを踏み、小さく、ぱしゃりという音を立て describes stepping in a puddle and making a small splash sound. UP independently adds very small puddle; MG and originalPC14020–14021 qualify the sound alone.

units.text: As she did, .........from behind her back, ............came a patter‐patter. ...The sound of approaching footsteps. Then, whoever it was stepped in a very small puddle, making a light splashing sound, and Maria finally heard. However, even the slight distraction that sound caused made her feel irritated, and Maria ignored it despite having heard it.
units.japanese: そんな、………真里亞の背後から、……………ひたり、ひたり、と。…足音が近付いてくる。そして水溜りを踏み、小さく、ぱしゃりという音を立て、それはようやく真里亞の耳に届いた。しかし、その音に気を取られることさえ苛立たしくて、真里亞は聞こえていても無視する。

description: MG corrupts Erika's surname kanji from 古戸 to 坤戸 in her introduction.
sourceReading: JP and UP 古戸ヱリカ match original PC14534/14536. MG introduces 坤戸ヱリカ; 古 and 坤 are different kanji.

units.text: "......Thank you very much. ...Allow me to introduce myself. ...I am called Furudo Erika (坤戸ヱリカ).
units.japanese: 「…………ありがとうございます。…自己紹介申し上げます。……古戸ヱリカと申します」

description: MG changes inability to pretend to be anything beyond themselves into inability to continue pretending.
sourceReading: それ以上のフリ cannot pretend to be more than who they are. MG any longer substitutes duration; originalPC15465/66 and UP preserve anything else.

units.text: Well, no matter how much we try to smooth it over, we are who we are. We couldn't pretend any longer. Still, that laugh really did help us to relax. We were so concerned about the guest getting nervous, we'd gotten even more nervous ourselves.
units.japanese:
ま、俺たちがどう取り繕うと、俺たちは俺たち。
それ以上のフリは出来やしなかった。でも、その笑いのお陰で俺たちもリラックスできたのは確かだ。客人が緊張していないか気遣うあまり、一番緊張していたのは自分たちだったのだ。

description: MG assigns Ronove's proposal a female pronoun.
sourceReading: Ronove proposes the change22 and confirms26; Beatrice seconds it28. OriginalPC18137 explicitly identifies Ronove,18140/18144 has propose the same thing without gender misattribution. MG her incorrectly assigns the male proposer a female pronoun.

units.text: "In other words, we'll take Kinzo out of the study and have him tightrope walk from shadow to shadow where the toxin can't reach, just like last year. It may be dangerous, but I would like to second her proposal."
units.japanese: 「つまり、去年のように、金蔵を極力、書斎の外に出し、毒素の陰から陰へと綱渡りをさせるということだ。危険ではあるが、妾もそれを提案したい」

description: MG omits the preposition in time remaining us tonight.
sourceReading: MG remaining us requires remaining to us or left to us. PC18873/18875 and UP preserve The night is not short.

units.text: "Natsuhi-sama, we have quite some time remaining us tonight. ...Let's leave Gaap's strategy as a final trump card and iron out a plan of our own for now. Please give us permission. ...And...please give us the trust, magical power, and absolute conviction we'll need to succeed without fail."
units.japanese: 「夏妃さま。夜は短くありません。……ガァプの手は最後の切り札とし、今は策を練りましょう。そのご許可をどうか。……そして、必ず成し遂げられるという、信頼と魔力と絶対の信念を、我らにお与え下さい」

description: MG omits to in I would like give Battler full credit.
sourceReading: MG would like give needs infinitival to. OriginalPC20541/20542 and UP have want to give.

units.text: "...I abandon any rights to this discovery. I'm already satisfied to have my reasoning proven correct. So, I'd like give Battler-san full credit."
units.japanese: 「……私は、この発見を放棄します。推理が正しかったことが証明されただけで、もう満足していますので。黄金発見の功績の全てを、戦人さんに譲りたいと思います」

description: UP substitutes missing ventilation for missing climate control in the cold room.
sourceReading: 空調 climate control, in the cold room context heating. OriginalPC20868/20870 and MG no heating. UP no ventilation instead asserts lack of air circulation.

units.text: Perhaps because everyone was tired out from this seemingly endless argument, they took a short break. It was decided that this family conference inside the Golden Land should be moved over to the mansion... This place may have been gorgeous, like a VIP room, but there was no ventilation, and it was a little cold. It wasn't well suited for a long conversation.
units.japanese: いつ終わるとも知れぬ醜い罵り合いは、互いが疲れてきたのか、一度休止を迎える。黄金郷での親族会議は、場を屋敷に移すこととなった…。確かに貴賓室のように煌びやかではあるが、空調はなく、少し寒い。長話をするには向かなかったためだ。

description: UP replaces the portable-shrine figurehead metaphor with a donation box.
sourceReading: お神輿 portable shrine metaphor: supporters carry Battler as their nominal leader in the succession dispute. OriginalPC22289/22291 and MG preserve shrine. UP personal donation box substitutes a vessel for donations.

units.text: "......Who knows. After all, you're like our personal donation box. ......Sleepy?"
units.japanese: 「……さぁ。戦人くんは私たちのお神輿だからね。……眠い？」

description: MG inserts in into About as much as, making the comparison ungrammatical.
sourceReading: MG About as much in as your average school class has an extraneous in. OriginalPC22297 About as much as is grammatical; UP comparison grammatical.

units.text: "About as much in as your average school class."
units.japanese: 「古典の授業程度には」

description: MG replaces the caller refusing to answer with Genji saying he cannot give an answer.
sourceReading: お答えいただけません reports Genji cannot obtain the caller answer. OriginalPC22980/22982 and UP He would not answer identify caller refusal. MG I can give you no answer on that matter substitutes Genji inability/refusal to relay an answer.

units.text: "......I can give you no answer on that matter. He kept insisting that he wanted to speak to you directly."
units.japanese: 「………お答えいただけません。奥様と直接お話ししたいとの一点張りでございます」
candidates: give you no answer on that matter

description: UP drops the explicit single kanji character on the card, replacing it with one English word.
sourceReading: 漢字で一文字 秋 specifies exactly one written kanji character. MG preserves literal秋 and kanji; originalPC23605–23611 also does. UP one single word Autumn preserves meaning but removes writing-system and character-count information.

units.text: ......As she screamed, Natsuhi crushed the card she had found under the clock into a little ball. It had a pattern on it like a tarot card, along with one single word: "Autumn".........
units.japanese: ……夏妃は時計の下から見つけたカードを、絶叫とともに握り潰してしまう。それは、タロットカードのような絵柄が書かれていて、……漢字で一文字、“秋”と書かれていた………。

description: UP uses nominative I as part of the object of want.
sourceReading: You want my husband and I to raise this baby needs objective my husband and me. OriginalPC24883 uses want me to raise and does not have this introduced object-case error.

units.text: "......In other words, ......you want my husband and I to raise this baby...as our own child......?"
units.japanese: 「……それはつまり、……私と夫の子として…、育てよと仰るのですか……」
candidates: want my husband and I to raise this baby

description: MG changes potentially being considered alive into potentially discovering actual survival.
sourceReading: 生きていることになっている describes being represented or considered alive. OriginalPC JP25665 and WH25666 retain made out to be alive; UP retains considered alive. MG introduces you might find out that it is alive.

units.text: "......That's right. Beato definitely killed that baby. However, you might find out that it's alive in the world of Humans. ...Whether it's really alive or not, right?"
units.japanese: 「…………そうね。ベアトは確かに殺したわ。でも、ニンゲンの世界では生きていることになっているのかもしれない。……本当に生きているのかどうかは、ともかくね？」

description: MG omits the article before proactive and clear answer.
sourceReading: MG I gave her proactive and clear answer requires a singular-count article. OriginalPC26211–26212 and UP retain an active and clear answer.

units.text: Erika offered me her hand to shake. ...Instead of just passively ignoring this, I gave her proactive and clear answer by knocking her hand aside.
units.japanese: ヱリカは、握手を求めるような真似事をする。…俺は、無視などという消極的な真似でなく、その手を弾くという、より積極的な行為で明白な返事をしてやる。
candidates: gave her proactive and clear answer

description: MG adds singular there is before plural master keys.
sourceReading: MG there's the master keys adds singular agreement before plural keys. Original PC28968–28970 has grammatical noun-phrase ellipsis; UP there are preserves plural agreement.

units.text: "In addition to the one key Krauss-sama held, there's the master keys..."
units.japanese: 「旦那様がお持ちの１本の他に、マスターキーが…」

description: MG introduces Even through before a concessive clause.
sourceReading: MG Even through you have been shown cannot introduce this concessive clause. Original PC29358–29359 has Even if; UP also uses Even if.

units.text: "Ahhaha! Even through you've been shown their gaping wounds, you're still trying that one on principle, as long as there's no red, right?! But don't get your hopes up. I'm not giving you a freebie red truth! After all, I just have to deny it all at once at the end of the game, at 24:00 on October 5th!"
units.japanese: 「あっはは！　例え、傷口ばっくり見せられちゃっても、赤くなきゃそう来るわよねぇ基本よねぇ？！　でも駄目よ。赤き真実なんてサービスしないわよぅ！　何しろ、ゲームの最後、１０月５日２４時にちょいと一ヶ所、否定すればいいんだもんねぇ！」

description: UP duplicates is in the first-game question.
sourceReading: UP Is this is your first game here duplicates the finite verb. OriginalPC36182–36183 and MG have grammatical first-game questions.

units.text: "Hey, new girls. .........Is this is your first game here? Sorry, but calling checkmate after something like that is no good. Yeah, it's no goddamn good at all...!!"
units.japanese: 「新しく来たお嬢さん方。………ここのゲームは初めてか？　悪いが、その程度でチェックメイトって言っちまうようじゃ、全然駄目だぜ。あぁ、本当に駄目だな…ッ！！」

description: UP omits Cornelia being knocked away together with the blue barrier.
sourceReading: JP コーネリアを青き結界ごと打ち破り、弾き飛ばし and originalPC37513–37514 explicitly displace Cornelia and barrier. UP smashes away only the barrier; MG retains both.

units.text: Battler......flew. He burst through Cornelia's blue barrier, smashing it away, .....and his body flew out the window into the darkness of the rainy sky. The fragments of the blue barrier scattered, leaving blue dust in their wake, coloring the air beautifully. The locked room... ...had been smashed open......!!
units.japanese: 戦人が、……飛ぶ。コーネリアを青き結界ごと打ち破り、弾き飛ばし、……戦人の体が窓より、雨天の大空の闇に、飛ぶ。青き結界の破片が飛び散り、その飛沫を従え、空間を美しく彩った。密室は、……打ち破られた……ッ！！

description: MG changes inquisitor honor as reason for striking into a negative concession.
sourceReading: JP 異端審問官の名にかけて gives the honor-based reason she cannot permit an unchallenged escape. OriginalPC37829–37831 and UP retain that reason. MG Not even with her reputation on the line casts reputation risk as an unsuccessful countervailing consideration.

units.text: For the first time, an expression showed on Dlanor's face. ...It was a sudden smile. She had known about that long before. ...However, she still couldn't let him escape without attempting that single strike. Not even with her reputation as an Inquisitor of Heresy on the line. She still crossed swords with Battler, even though she knew it would fail.
units.japanese:
ドラノールは、初めて表情を見せる。
……それは、ふっと笑うものだった。彼女も、構造がすでに言及済みであることはとっくに知っていた。だが、一太刀も交えずに逃せない。
異端審問官の名にかけて。だから、及ばぬと知りつつでも、戦人と太刀を交えたのだ。

description: UP changes Natsuhi unwary emergence from hiding into shameless emergence.
sourceReading: のこのこと出てくる here describes walking unsuspectingly into the feared killer waiting outside her closet. PC44070–44071 and MG use stumble out; UP shamelessly supplies a lack-of-shame assessment.

units.text:
By this time, the room had settled back into silence, ......and that earlier feeling of Hideyoshi being in a noisy struggle had disappeared completely. What's.........going on here......?! So, right now, ......I'm in the same room as the murderer who killed Hideyoshi‐san......?! In that case, the culprit should try to escape from the room as soon as possible, ......so why are they staying so quiet in here...?! I haven't heard anything, ......nothing that might have been the culprit who attacked Hideyoshi‐san rushing away. ......No matter how much I strain my ears, I can't sense anyone in the room. In fact, ......it's so silent that it makes what happened just a second ago feel like an illusion. In other words, .........does this mean......that the culprit is holding his breath, standing right in front of this closet... waiting for me to shamelessly come out......? I don't even know what to be scared of anymore. If only I could just melt away into the darkness of this closet...! I mustn't remain in this room any longer.
I get the feeling I have more to worry about than just my personal safety... But what should I do?! I don't even know if it's a good idea to leave this closet...!!
units.japanese:
その時には、もう部屋は静まり返っていて、……さきほどまでの、取っ組み合うような秀吉の賑やかな気配は、一切消え去っていた。これは、………どういうこと……？！今、私は、……秀吉さんを殺した、殺人者と同じ部屋に一緒にいるということ……？！なら、犯人は早くこの部屋から逃げ出せばいいのに、……どうして息を殺しているの…？！秀吉さんを襲った犯人が、慌しく逃げ出していくらしい音は、……まるで何も聞こえない。……どんなに耳を凝らしても、室内に何かの気配はない。それどころか、今の出来事が全て、幻だったのではないかと思うほどに、……静寂。それはつまり、………まさか犯人が、……息を殺したまま、…このクローゼットの前に立ちはだかり、…私がのこのこと出てくるのを待ち受けているのでは……。もはや私は、何に怯えていいのかわからない。いっそこのクローゼットの暗闇に、溶け込むようにして消えてしまえればいいのに…！これ以上、この部屋に留まってはいけない。
身の危険だけでなく、色々とまずい気がする…。でも、どうすれば？！私には、このクローゼットを出てよいのかさえわからない…！！

description: MG switches the addressee to you but leaves her sad past.
sourceReading: MG you would laugh/confess continues story of her sad past, leaving inconsistent reference. OriginalPC52300–52301 consistently uses Natsuhi-san/her; UP uses you/your.

units.text: "If this was a third-rate mystery, ...you would let out a high-pitched laugh about now, confess to the crime, and start telling the story of her sad past. ...Don't tell me you intend to make me explain that part as well?"
units.japanese: 「これが三流ミステリーなら。……そろそろ夏妃さんが高笑いを始めて、罪を認め、悲しい過去話を始めるタイミングなのですが。……まさか、それまで私がしなくてはなりませんか？」

description: MG reverses the resolve to live as a good person forever into a negative prediction.
sourceReading: 未来永劫、良き人として生きないと is elliptical necessity, must live as a good person forever. OriginalPC56373–56374 and UP use must. MG says I will not live as a good person for all eternity.

units.text: In the future, if the accusations against her are proven false. This tale will probably be rewritten... However, that future will never come. ...I think... Truth is a fleeting thing. Even if I am a good person until my death... If some heartless person after my death overwrites the records and says I wasn't a good person, and if that is shared with everyone else... ...Then even all the goodness in which I lived my life could be overwritten easily. And so, I think... That I won't live as a good person for all eternity....
units.japanese:
未来に冤罪が証明された時。その時こそ、この物語は遡って書き換えられるだろう……。しかし、その未来は、訪れない。……私は、思う。真実など、儚い。死ぬまで良き人であったとしても。死後に心無い誰かが、私が良き人ではなかったと一言、記録書に書き記し、それを人々が共有すれば。……私が生涯、良心を貫いたことさえ、易々と塗り替えられてしまうのだから。だから、私は思う。
未来永劫、良き人として生きないと……。
candidates: live as a good person for all eternity

description: MG misorders just and a in for a just little bit.
sourceReading: MG joined them for a just little bit misplaces just. OriginalPC47849–47850 and UP retain grammatical for a little bit; Japanese ほんの少しだけ has no disfluency.

units.text: "It'll be a pain to have you try anything funny, so I'll make this clear now. In fact, I should've done this in the beginning. I apologize for being so roundabout. This is the situation around the guesthouse at 24:00." "......The gold was found, an emergency family meeting was called for, and Battler-san went to the mansion with the relatives. I, the three cousins, Doctor Nanjo, Gohda-san, and Kumasawa-san remained in the guesthouse." "I have already explained Gohda-san and Kumasawa-san's alibis. George-san, Jessica-san, and Maria-san were playing cards in the cousin room. I actually joined them for a just little bit, and I clearly witnessed that they were alive at that time." "My master, I ask that you repeat this!!"
units.japanese: 「おかしな追求があると面倒なので、先にはっきりさせます。というか、むしろこれは最初にするべきでした。前後したことをお詫びします。２４時の時点での、ゲストハウスの状況です」「………黄金が発見され、緊急の親族会議になり、戦人さんと親族たちは屋敷へ。ゲストハウスには、私と、いとこ３人、南條先生、郷田さん、熊沢さんが残りました」「郷田さん、熊沢さんのアリバイについてはすでにご説明の通り。譲治さん、朱志香さん、真里亞さんの３人は、いとこ部屋でトランプで遊んでいました。実は私、ほんの少しだけ、交ぜていただきましたので、この時刻に生存していたのをはっきり確認しています」「我が主ッ、以上の復唱を要求します！！」
candidates: joined them for a just little bit

description: MG adds that the archive is cramped.
sourceReading: JP says the archive holds enough books to be called a small library. PC48447–48448 and UP have no cramped-space condition. MG introduces Cramped though it was.

units.text: Cramped though it was, that book storage room in the guesthouse was stocked well enough that it was fair to call it a small library. In it were several famous foreign mystery novels that Kinzo had once taken a liking to. Of course, they were all originals and in English, but English was no problem for either Erika or Nanjo. For this occasion, they had borrowed the key to the library one more time from Gohda in the servant room. At that point, Erika checked the seal again, and, of course, reset it. Damn her. Even though she keeps it sealed for anyone else to enter or leave, she alone enters and leaves whenever she wants.
units.japanese: ゲストハウスの書庫には、小さな図書館と呼べるほどの本が納められている。その中には、かつて金蔵が興味を持っていたことのある、海外ミステリーの名作も多数、収められていた。無論、全て原書は英語だが、ヱリカも南條も英語はまったく問題なかった。その際に、もう一度、使用人室の郷田に、書庫の鍵を借りたのだという。ヱリカはそこで、その際に封印は確認し直し、もちろん仕掛け直したと付け加える。くそったれ。都合よく人の出入りは封印しやがるくせに、自分だけは好きに出入りしてやがる。

description: MG and UP change financial subjugation of the birth family into financial ruin.
sourceReading: 経済的に屈服させた denotes forced financial submission. PC57637–57638 correctly preserves submission; both re-edits use financially ruining.

units.text:
After being forced into an unwanted marriage, Natsuhi developed a grudge against the Ushiromiya family and was filled with a desire for revenge. 
(*Trial Summary, p.3) As revenge for financially ruining her birth family, Natsuhi also plotted to take over the Ushiromiya family's fortune. 
(*Trial Summary, p.4) When Natsuhi learned that the wealth of the Ushiromiya family was for all intents and purposes controlled by Kinzo himself, she initiated sexual relations to curry favor with him and managed to ensnare him. 
(*Trial Summary, p.7) 
(*Bernkastel Documents, p.682) To curry favor with Kinzo, Natsuhi repeatedly disguised herself as Beatrice, a witch and figment of Kinzo's imagination, and engaged in sexual acts. 
Kinzo saw Natsuhi dressed as the mistress from his past and was easily ensnared. 
Additionally, a servant happened to witness her in this outfit, forming part of the basis for the legend of the witch. 
(*Trial Summary, p.8) 
(*Submitted Evidence #17) 
(*Bernkastel Documents, p.802)
units.japanese:
望まぬ結婚を強いられた夏妃は、右代宮家に対し恨みを抱き、復讐心を膨らませていきました。
（※裁判概要書：３ページより）夏妃は、右代宮家がかつて、実家を経済的に屈服させたことへも復讐するため、右代宮家の財産の乗っ取りを画策しました。
（※裁判概要書：４ページより）右代宮家の財産が、金蔵個人によって事実上、掌握されていることを知った夏妃は、金蔵に取り入るため、情交によってこれを篭絡しました。
（※裁判概要書：７ページより）
（※ベルンカステル文書：６８２ページより）夏妃は金蔵に取り入るために、金蔵の妄想の魔女である、ベアトリーチェの姿に扮して情交を重ねていました。
金蔵は、その夏妃に、在りし日の愛人の姿を見て、容易に篭絡されたのでした。
また、この姿が偶然、使用人に目撃され、一部の魔女伝説の根拠となりました。
（※裁判概要書：８ページより）
（※提出証拠品：第１７号より）
（※ベルンカステル文書：８０２ページより）

sourceReading: 大法院長官職務代理者 denotes acting for the court chief. PC57967–57970 uses Deputy Chief; re-edits independently substitute Attorney General.

description: UP blends Come to think of it and Now that you mention it.
sourceReading: UP Come to mention it is a nonidiomatic blend; JPそれを言われると and PC237719–237720 use Now that I hear it. MG remains grammatical.

units.text: Come to mention it, ......maybe that really was the case. My fight against Beato began in earnest starting with the second game, I think. When Beato threw locked‐room mysteries at me, at first, I didn't seriously try to tackle them. After all, I knew nothing except that people had died in a locked room, and the windows and doors were all locked from the inside. ......I had basically no hints. So I refused to debate, on the grounds that I couldn't fight because the lack of clues made reasoning impossible. ......After that, Beato sneered at me, didn't she... asking whether I would repeat that over and over forever in an endless repetition of moves...... At that time, Beato said this:
units.japanese: それを言われると、………確かにそうだったかもしれない。ベアトと本格的に戦うようになったのは、第２のゲームからだったか。ベアトが挑んできた密室の謎に、俺は最初、真面目に挑まなかった。何しろ、密室で人が死んでる、窓も扉も内側から閉まってる、くらいしか情報がない。……ノーヒントにも程がある。だから、手掛かりが足りないから推理不能、戦いには応じないと言って論争を拒絶したんだ。……そうしたらベアトは、それを永遠にいつまでも繰り返し、千日手とする気なのかと嘲笑ったんじゃなかったっけ……。ベアトはあの時、こう言った。

description: MG inverts the subject and auxiliary inside a relative where clause.
sourceReading: MG reach the level where can it progress has direct-question order embedded in a relative clause. PC238353–238355 and UP use where it progresses.

units.text: "...Battler-kun, when does this "the chicken or the egg" type of shy love reach the level where can it progress into mutual love...?"
units.japanese: 「……戦人くん。その、卵が先か鶏が先か、という奥手な恋愛は、どの段階にまで進んだら、相思相愛の関係になるのですか……？」
candidates: reach the level where can it progress

description: UP makes reciprocal acknowledgment and shared progress into Battler unilateral admission.
sourceReading: 俺たちは認め合わなきゃ requires both acknowledging their love to each other before progressing. PC238970–238973 and MG preserve we acknowledge/we progress; UP I admit/I progress.

units.text: However, that raises the question: .........is it even possible to solve a story written by an observer who isn't impartial? .........All reasoning ends here if you get obsessed with this. That's why......it's so important for me to believe. That Beato... ......is trying to fight me through this tale. Because it's a fight, ......that means I've been given a chance of winning. And the fact that I've been given that... ......must mean... ......that reasoning is possible. ......This part......is the hardest. Unless I believe that the cruel witch took on the risk of losing to try and have a fair fight with me, ......I can't get past this part. ......Virgilia's right, ......it's just like love. If I can't believe that Beato is fighting me head‐on with everything she's got, ......I won't be able to reason any further than this. .........Alright, ...I'll admit it. Unless I admit that we're "in love", ......I won't be able to get any further.
units.japanese: しかし、ならば襲われる疑問は、………公正でない観測者が記した物語が、そもそも推理可能なのかということだ。………これに取り憑かれると、全ての推理はここまでで停滞して、終わる。だから、……俺は信じなければならなかった。ベアトが、………この物語によって、俺と戦おうとしていることを。戦うとは即ち、……俺にも勝つ余地が与えられているということ。それを与えているということは、………推理は可能という、……意味なのではないか。……ここは、……苦しかった。あの残酷な魔女が、自らの敗北を賭して、俺とフェアな勝負をしていると信じなければ、……乗り越えられない。……ワルギリアの言うとおりだぜ、……まるで恋愛だ。ベアトは、俺と全力で、真正面から戦っていると信じられなきゃ、……これ以上の推理には、至れない。………あぁ、…認めるぜ。俺たちは“愛し合ってる”と認め合わなきゃ、……これより先には進めないんだ。

description: UP weakens impossible to deny culprit identity to impossible to eliminate her as a suspect.
sourceReading: 夏妃が犯人であることは否定不能 asserts inability to deny the culprit proposition. PC240740–240742 and MG preserve it. UP cannot rule out Natsuhi only retains suspicion as possible.
