description: No flinch becomes barely flinching
sourceReading: Explicit zero movement changes to slight movement; MG preserves zero.

units.text:
Letting my voiceless emotions explode, ...I slammed the table hard. The two witches barely flinched. ......One grinned.
The other looked indifferent, as though nothing had happened. The two of them just stared at me silently.
...As though they were reproaching me.
units.japanese:
声なく感情を爆発させ、…俺はテーブルを激しく叩く。２人の魔女はまるで怯まない。……１人はにやにやと。
１人は何事もないかのように淡白に。ただ、２人そろって無言で俺を見ている。
…まるで詰るように。

description: MG uses a before incomprehensible.
sourceReading: MG has a incomprehensible geometric shape; UP and original WH use an. Japanese describes an incomprehensible geometric pattern.

units.text: Around Battler was a swirl of glowing Fragments, sparkling like the night sky, ...and on the floor was what appeared to be a red magic circle. To an outsider, it would seem to be nothing more than a incomprehensible geometric shape. But to Battler, who stood at its center, it was the outline for a new tale...
units.japanese: 戦人の周囲に、光のカケラが、まるで天体のように渦巻き、……床には赤い魔法陣のようなものが浮き上がっている。それは傍目には理解の出来ない幾何学模様に過ぎない。しかし、その中心に立つ戦人にとっては、新しき物語の筋書きそのものなのだ…。

description: MG uses each others’ instead of the reciprocal possessive each other’s.
sourceReading: MG repeats each others' efforts at rows733 and735; UP and original WH use congratulate each other, without the introduced erroneous possessive.

units.text: "'Creating a game is far from easy. I certainly never expected us to recognize each others' efforts like this.'"
units.japanese:
「“ゲームを作るのは楽なことではない。よもやそなたと、それを労い合う日が来ようとはな”」
「ゲームを作るのは楽なことではない。よもやそなたと、それを労い合う日が来ようとはな」

units.text: "Creating a game is far from easy. I certainly never expected us to recognize each others' efforts like this."
units.japanese:
「“ゲームを作るのは楽なことではない。よもやそなたと、それを労い合う日が来ようとはな”」
「ゲームを作るのは楽なことではない。よもやそなたと、それを労い合う日が来ようとはな」

description: MG changes the self-granted right to love into having what it takes to fall in love.
sourceReading: JP repeats 恋の資格 as a right one grants oneself. Original WH uses deserve and right; UP retains that entitlement. MG repeatedly uses what it takes and what is needed, shifting moral permission to personal capacity.

units.text: "I was!! I never realized that a lie you make to yourself could be so sad, so painful, so excruciating!! And I couldn't forgive myself for hurting Milady with that lie!! I believed that I didn't have what it takes to ever fall in love again!!"
units.japanese:
「悲しかったッ！！　自分につく嘘が、こんなにも辛くて悔しくて悲しいなんて知らなかった！！　そして僕のそんな嘘が、お嬢様を傷つけたのが、堪らなく許せなかった！！　そんな自分に、もう二度と恋をする資格なんてないと思ってたッ！！」
「あるよ。恋の資格はね？　自分だけが与えられるの。家具だから駄目とか、そんなの関係ない。駄目だって自分で決めたら、もう駄目なの。決め付けちゃ駄目。だから私は与えたよ、この身の程知らずな家具の身に、恋の資格を。だから嘉音くんにだってあるよ」
「恋をする資格が？」

units.text: "But that wasn't true. Do you know what's needed to fall in love? It's something you can't get from anyone but yourself. Being furniture or not has nothing to do with it. If you decide for yourself that it won't work out, then it won't. You mustn't leap to such rigid conclusions. That's why I, overambitious furniture that I am, gave myself what's needed to fall in love. So you have it too, Kanon-kun."
units.japanese:
「悲しかったッ！！　自分につく嘘が、こんなにも辛くて悔しくて悲しいなんて知らなかった！！　そして僕のそんな嘘が、お嬢様を傷つけたのが、堪らなく許せなかった！！　そんな自分に、もう二度と恋をする資格なんてないと思ってたッ！！」
「あるよ。恋の資格はね？　自分だけが与えられるの。家具だから駄目とか、そんなの関係ない。駄目だって自分で決めたら、もう駄目なの。決め付けちゃ駄目。だから私は与えたよ、この身の程知らずな家具の身に、恋の資格を。だから嘉音くんにだってあるよ」
「恋をする資格が？」

units.text: "You mean, I have what it takes to fall in love?"
units.japanese:
「悲しかったッ！！　自分につく嘘が、こんなにも辛くて悔しくて悲しいなんて知らなかった！！　そして僕のそんな嘘が、お嬢様を傷つけたのが、堪らなく許せなかった！！　そんな自分に、もう二度と恋をする資格なんてないと思ってたッ！！」
「あるよ。恋の資格はね？　自分だけが与えられるの。家具だから駄目とか、そんなの関係ない。駄目だって自分で決めたら、もう駄目なの。決め付けちゃ駄目。だから私は与えたよ、この身の程知らずな家具の身に、恋の資格を。だから嘉音くんにだってあるよ」
「恋をする資格が？」

description: MG substitutes 音 for 嘉 in Jessica’s guess about Kanon’s real name.
sourceReading: JP explicitly guesses 嘉 from 嘉音; original PC65637/65639 and UP retain 嘉. MG uses 音, changing the character she predicts.

units.text: "Good, that'll do for now. And I'd like to call you by your name, Kanon-kun. ...You have a real name...besides Kanon, don't you? I'll bet it has the character 音 in it, like Kanon does... Wh-What could it be, ...heheh..."
units.japanese: 「うん、今はそれでいい。だから私も、嘉音くんのこと、名前で呼びたい。……嘉音じゃなくて、……本当の名前があるんでしょ？　きっと、嘉音の嘉が含まれた名前だと思うな…。な、何だろ、……えへへ…」

description: MG inserts an extraneous to after will in Featherine’s command.
sourceReading: MG you will to see to her needs is ungrammatical. JP commands Ange to care for Beatrice; original PC66298/66300 and UP use a grammatical imperative.

units.text: "Raise your head, child of man. ...I shall give that child the privilege of using my library however she likes for a time. ...Ange, my miko, you will to see to her needs."
units.japanese: 「面を上げよ、人の子よ。……その娘に、しばしの間、我が書庫を自由に閲覧する資格を与えようぞ。……我が巫女、縁寿。その方に世話を命ず」

description: MG omits to in want them to be viewed.
sourceReading: MG want them be viewed omits the infinitive marker. JP describes creating an environment for the desired reception; originalPC70077/70079 and UP are grammatical.

units.text: "That's right. At a fundamental level, all phenomena are neutral, indifferent, and dull. ...If you want them be viewed in a certain way, you must first create a suitable environment..."
units.japanese: 「そうだ。全ての現象は本来、中立、中性、無味無色だ。……それを、望む受け取り方をさせるには、その環境作りが必要となる…」

description: UP removes the uncertainty from George’s recollection of when he noticed his problem.
sourceReading: JP 中学生くらいの頃だったろうか recalls approximate time tentatively; originalPC72562/72563 and MG retain Probably. UP It started when asserts an unqualified time.

units.text: How many years ago was it when I noticed? It started when I was in middle school. At the time, I assumed that I was obviously the most gentlemanly of the cousins, so I would obviously be popular with women. However, reality was completely different.
units.japanese: 僕がそれに気付いたのが、……何年前だったろう。中学生くらいの頃だったろうか。当時の僕は、いとこの中でもっとも紳士的で、女性にモテて当然だろうと思い込んでいた。しかし、現実はまるで違う。

description: MG changes Kanon’s responding to affection into merely receiving it.
sourceReading: JP distinguishes receiving affection from being able only to respond. OriginalPC75957/75958 and UP retain respond; MG repeats receive and eliminates his responsive action.

units.text: Kanon hung his head. ...Since he had never learned anything on his own, he had never been able to take the initiative with her in any way.. The fact that he was accepting her affection one-sidedly, unable to do anything but simply receive it, ...made him sad...and frustrated at himself.
units.japanese: 嘉音は俯く。……何も学んでこなかった自分に、彼女をリードできるようなことなんて、何一つない。なのに、一方的に好意を受け、……自分に出来ることが、それに応えるだけだなんて、……悲しくて、……そして自分が悔しかった。

description: UP states Shannon’s rejection of magic without the source’s inferential qualification.
sourceReading: JP 決別したはず gives Ange’s inference. OriginalPC76821/76823 and MG retain supposedly; UP states She put the miracle of magic behind her as an unqualified event.

units.text: "It's true that the brooch gave Shannon the chance she needed to get together with George onii‐chan, but after that, she said she wanted to deepen their relationship without borrowing the power of magic, and she even tried to give the brooch back to Beato. She put the miracle of magic behind her at that point. ......In that case, why is she once again in need of its power?"
units.japanese: 「現に紗音はかつて、譲治お兄ちゃんとの出会いのきっかけを作ったのはブローチのお陰だけど、それ以降は魔法の力を借りずに関係を深めたいと言って、ベアトにブローチを返そうとさえしたわ。彼女はその時点で、一度は魔法の奇跡と決別したはず。……なのになぜ再び、その力を必要としているの？」
candidates: put the miracle of magic behind

description: MG replaces Erika’s shrug with a grimace.
sourceReading: JP 肩を竦めて and originalPC80728/80729 specify shrugging; MG changes this to a facial expression. UP retains the shrug.

units.text: Erika grimaced and showed the piece of packing tape she had torn off to Dlanor. At a glance, Dlanor couldn't tell what had annoyed Erika. However, as soon as she held it, she realized the difference right away.
units.japanese:
ヱリカは肩を竦めて、切り取ったガムテープ片をドラノールに示す。一見しただけでは、ヱリカが何を不満なのかわからない。
しかしそれを受け取ってすぐに、違いに気が付いた。

description: MG changes unexpected part-time work into obtaining a new job.
sourceReading: JP 急にバイトが入っちゃって describes unexpected work arising; originalPC81079/81081 and UP preserve being called to work. MG suddenly got a new part-time job instead describes new employment.

units.text: ...His senior was asking so he had to go. He suddenly got a new part-time job. He said he was talking with a friend on the phone who just wouldn't hang up."
units.japanese: ………先輩の付き合いで断れなくて。急にバイトが入っちゃって。ダチの電話が長くてなかなか切れなくって」
candidates: suddenly got a new part-time job

description: MG changes Jessica’s odd pause into physical distance.
sourceReading: JP 妙な間 in the hesitant conversation identifies an odd pause; originalPC85692/85694 and UP retain silence. MG introduces the strange distance she was standing at.

units.text: Noticing the strange distance Jessica was standing at, Kyrie turned around. ...That unprotected back was already gone. Jessica realized that her hesitation had made her lose her own first chance...
units.japanese:
朱志香の妙な間に気付き、霧江が振り返る。
……無防備な背中はもうない。朱志香は自らの躊躇が、最初のチャンスを失わせてしまったことを知る…。

description: MG drops the excess condition from the warning about shyness.
sourceReading: JP 過ぎれば says when shyness goes too far; PC89285/89287 and UP retain excess. MG Even shyness can kill love omits the threshold.

units.text: "What witch would hesitate at committing murder on the game board? Even shyness can kill love."
units.japanese: 「魔女がゲーム盤の殺人に臆してどうするというのか。奥手も、過ぎれば恋を殺すぞ」

description: UP changes never fighting into being unable to win.
sourceReading: JP 戦いもせず explicitly concerns not fighting; originalPC89955/89957 and MG retain that condition. UP substitutes could neither win nor die.

units.text: "The battle of love is cruelest to those... who could neither win nor die."
units.japanese: 「恋の戦いは、戦いもせず、死ねもしなかった者に、もっとも残酷なんだ」

description: MG gives Kanon responsibility for causing the danger he intends to fend off.
sourceReading: JP 火の粉は払う means fend off the sparks or defend oneself. OriginalPC90574/90576 and UP retain self-defense; MG messes I have made introduces his causation.

units.text: "...I don't want to kill past my quota. ...But I'll clean up the messes I've made...!!"
units.japanese: 「……ノルマ以上の殺しは不本意だ。……でも、火の粉は払う…ッ！！」

description: MG changes the sword’s red trajectory into a curved blade.
sourceReading: JP 赤い軌跡 describes a red trail; originalPC90661/90662 describes red locus, and UP red-trailing. MG red curved blade describes intrinsic geometry.

units.text: The red curved blade extending from Kanon's hand vanished in an instant. He tried hard to make it reappear, but when he attempted to use it on Maria and Sakutarou again, it vanished once more. Because of Sakutarou's power, he was unable to make either of them the target of his attacks.
units.japanese: 嘉音の手より伸びる赤い軌跡の剣が、たちまち霧散する。消えたものを、再び顕現しようと努力するが、それをマリアたちに振るおうとすれば再び、霧散してしまう。さくたろうの力により、マリアたちを攻撃の対象とすることが出来ないのだ。

description: MG duplicates your in Mind your own your business.
sourceReading: MG has an extraneous possessive your; originalPC93247 and UP have no duplication.

units.text: "Huh? Wh-Where... ...M-Mind your own your business!"
units.japanese: 「え、ど、どこにッ…。……い、いい加減なことを言わないで下さいっ」

description: UP replaces recognition of the ordeal as a trial with inability to escape it.
sourceReading: JP acknowledges this is indeed a trial; originalPC96664/96666 and MG retain identification. UP says I cannot get away from this trial, adding an escape constraint.

units.text: ".........I...can't get away from this trial, can I..."
units.japanese: 「………やはり、これは、試練なのですね…」

description: UP misspells proceeded as proceeeded.
sourceReading: UP has three e letters in proceeeded; MG and original WH have no such typo.

units.text:
And no one had been inside the locked rooms except for the victims.
And Krauss's group, the ones who had broken the room open, were not the culprits...... ......Erika's battle had proceeeded in this way, with her detailed repetition requests winning her several other little red truths just like these.
units.japanese:
そして、密室には犠牲者以外は誰も存在しなかった。
そして、密室を破った蔵臼たちは犯人ではなく……、……そんな調子で、他にも細かくいくつもの復唱要求から赤き真実を勝ち取った。

description: MG omits the article in was most basic part.
sourceReading: MG was most basic part lacks the required determiner before the singular superlative noun phrase. OriginalPC100258/100259 and UP use grammatical role phrasing.

units.text: With that, the humans in the room Erika had just left had been specified. Carefully checking even obvious things like that was most basic part of playing on the Human side.
units.japanese: たった今、ヱリカが出てきた部屋の中の人物が特定される。こんな当たり前のことさえ、きっちりと確認すべきがニンゲン側の基本だ。

description: UP changes failure to solve by the game’s end into permanent inability to solve.
sourceReading: JP 最後まで bounds predicted failure to the end of this contest. PC104637/104639 and MG retain that bound; UP forever unable removes the endpoint. Probability remains qualified.

units.text: With a riddle this tough, Erika would probably be forever unable to solve the mystery of Battler's disappearance. And even a single unsolved riddle would mean victory for the witch side. Battler...... wanted to respond to this repetition request if at all possible.
units.japanese: これほどの謎なら、恐らくヱリカは、戦人消失の謎を最後まで解けないだろう。解けない謎が一つでもあれば、それは魔女側の勝利となる。戦人にとって、……この復唱要求は、………何としても答えたいものなのだ。

description: MG and UP mismatch the verb number with their differently constructed subjects.
sourceReading: MG singular The move, along with that final red truth takes are, where was/is is required for the head subject; UP changes the linkage to and but retains is, where are is required. Original WH105590 along with/is is grammatical. Both introduce distinct agreement slips.

units.text: "I judge it to be valid. ...He's presented logic that doesn't violate any of the red truths, and I've finished checking it. ...The move by the player on the witch side, along with that final red truth he repeated, are valid. ......Battler, for the first time, ...I've got to say I think you're incredible..."
units.japanese: 「判定は、有効よ。……赤き真実全てに抵触しないロジックの提出を受け、その検証を終えたわ。……魔女側プレイヤーの手、及び、最後の復唱要求に応じた赤き真実は有効。………戦人。あんたを初めて、……すごいと思ったわ…」
candidates: along with that final red truth

units.text: "I judge it to be valid. ......He's presented logic that doesn't violate any of the red truths, and I've finished checking it. ......The move by the player on the witch side, and the red truth given in response to the final repetition request, is valid. .........Battler. For the first time, ......I have to say I think you're incredible..."
units.japanese: 「判定は、有効よ。……赤き真実全てに抵触しないロジックの提出を受け、その検証を終えたわ。……魔女側プレイヤーの手、及び、最後の復唱要求に応じた赤き真実は有効。………戦人。あんたを初めて、……すごいと思ったわ…」

description: MG removes the plural head troops but retains plural agreement in Chiester Sister that weren’t.
sourceReading: Japanese シエスタ姉妹兵 denotes the guards; original PC113234–113235 has grammatical plural Siesta Sister troops. MG singular Sister with weren’t and were loses agreement; UP preserves troops.

units.text: The Chiester honor guards stood at attention along either side of that path, raised their adorned bayonets with mechanical precision, and made sure that no evil could block the path that the pair walked down. Chiester Sister that weren't part of the honor guard were stationed all over the cathedral, hiding behind pillars and the like, keeping an eye out for any intruders.
units.japanese: その道をシエスタ姉妹近衛隊の儀仗兵が挟んで並び、装飾された銃剣を、機械仕掛けのように規律正しく構え、二人のための道を邪魔する一切の邪悪が存在しないことを確認する。儀仗兵以外のシエスタ姉妹兵は、柱の影などで、聖堂全体を見渡しながら、不審者の妨害を警戒している。

description: UP omits far from go so far for Battler.
sourceReading: UP go so for Battler lacks far, retained by MG and originalPC108902. The incomplete English construction obscures the intended extent.

units.text: ".........I still cannot fathom why you are willing to go so for Battler, ......but I shall do as you ask. After all, it is a request made by myself. I will add my wisdom to yours......"
units.japanese: 「………どうして、あの戦人のためにそこまでせねばならぬのかは、相変わらずわからぬが、……いいとも。他ならぬ自分自身の頼みである。妾も知恵を絞ろうぞ……」

description: MG changes the ability to bite one’s tongue into having the courage to do so.
sourceReading: 舌が噛めるなら expresses ability.1363 expressly denies physical strength, while1364–1365 separately establish refusal to give up. Original PC114163/114165 if you think you can preserves ability. MG adds a courage taunt.

units.text: ...You'll be endlessly defiled and humiliated by me, ...and every time I forget the taste of victory, ...I'll use your body to remind me. ......Over...and over again... ...If you've got the guts to bite off your tongue, now's the time... ...Once this goes on your finger, ...you won't even be able to do that."
units.japanese: 「……私に永遠に、穢され、辱しめられ、……私が勝利の美酒の味を忘れる度に、……あなたはその身を以って、私にそれを思い出させるのです。………何度も、………何度もね……。……舌が噛めるなら、今の内にどうぞ…。……指輪が通れば、……それすらも出来なくなりますから」

description: MG inserts a before some sort of hint.
sourceReading: MG give us a some sort of hint combines incompatible determiners. OriginalPC110329/110331 and UP are grammatical.

units.text: "...Can't you at least give us a some sort of hint about that miracle?! We've known each other for quite some time. ...Can't you at least give my little sister a hint as a parting gift?"
units.japanese: 「……その奇跡のヒントくらい出せぬか！　そなたらと妾は短い付き合いではあるまいに。……別れの餞別に、我が妹にせめてヒントくらいは出してやれぬか」
candidates: give us a some sort of hint

description: MG omits to after telling you.
sourceReading: MG telling you show us omits the infinitive marker. OriginalPC110388/110390 has telling you to show us; UP paraphrases grammatically.

units.text: "...Yes, we can't "see", which is why I'm telling you show us. ...These two are always like this. You'll never get bored, but they can be very irritating at times like these."
units.japanese: 「……視えぬから見せろというのにっ。……こやつらは、いつもこういう調子でな。退屈はせぬが、こういう時には腹立たしいっ」

description: MG omits that from a power that can lead to miracles.
sourceReading: MG capable of granting a power can lead to miracles omits the relative marker before can. OriginalPC111741/111743 and UP use grammatical miraculous power.

units.text: "True. ...However, ...that is precisely why they are capable of granting a power can lead to miracles."
units.japanese: 「ですな。……しかしだからこそ、……奇跡にも通ずる力を与えられるのです」
candidates: capable of granting a power can lead to miracles

description: UP reverses being seen through love into being able to see.
sourceReading: 421–424 discuss others coming to see the loved person. 私たちは視える continues we become visible; UP We can all see makes them perceivers. MG and originalPC116771–116772 preserve others seeing us.

units.text: We can all ‘see’see...if we have love......
units.japanese: 愛があれば、私たちは視えるよ……。

description: UP uses ran after infinitive to in the time it took me to ran.
sourceReading: Japanese recalls the brief interval running past the dining hall. UP infinitive requires run. MG and original PC120783–120784 are grammatical.

units.text: I wonder why such strong memories popped up in the short time it took me to ran past the dining hall... And then, ......my memories of Jessica.
units.japanese: 食堂の前を駆け抜けるだけのわずかの時間に、どうしてこれほどに濃密な記憶が。そして、……朱志香の記憶。
candidates: time it took me to ran

description: Aquire spelling introduced
sourceReading: OriginalWH and UP received; MG introduces aquire instead of acquire.

units.text: "...It'll likely be just five or six people at most. And they'll probably be armed with nothing more than handguns. They're no match for you. Feel free to run wild. But make sure you kill them. ...Were you able to aquire one of your favorite toys?"
units.japanese: 「……………せいぜい５〜６人前後のグループだろう。武装も恐らく拳銃程度。お前の敵じゃない。好きに暴れろ。だが確実に殺せ。……お前好みの玩具は用意できたか？」

description: MG misspells occurrence as occurance.
sourceReading: MG introduces the spelling occurance in its rewritten sentence; originalPC128163/128165 and UP lack this spelling error.

units.text: Lion was the Successor and lived in the Head Household. That made conversations with Kinzo an everyday occurance. Because of this, Lion must have been used to chatting with people who were moody or hard to follow. With the understanding that getting stuck on the details would be nothing but a waste of time, the conversation naturally fell into a pattern as though Lion and this unknown man Will were long-time friends...
units.japanese:
理御は本家に住む、次期当主。
普段から、金蔵の相手をすることが多かった。なので、気難しい相手や、会話が噛み合わない相手とのやり取りには慣れがあったに違いない。瑣末なことは気にするだけ無駄だと割り切り、正体不明の男、ウィルと、まるでずっと前からの友人であるかのように、自然と振舞えてしまうのだった……。

description: MG truncates Eva’s qualifying dialogue and leaves an unmatched opening quote.
sourceReading: Eva qualifies the asserted family connection with って言ってもねぇ. MG ends at a new opening quote Well, before another speaker starts93. OriginalPC128586–128590 and UP retain a completed qualification.

units.text: "Her connection to the Ushiromiya family? "Well,
units.japanese: 「右代宮家とのかかわり、……って言ってもねぇ？」

description: MG combines incompatible determiners in to the some paradise.
sourceReading: 幸せの国へ refers to the land of happiness. MG the some is malformed; UP grammatical land of happiness preserves it.

units.text: "I even surprised myself... To think that I made it so far into such a dense forest. ...I was tormented by twigs and sharp leaves over and over again." "However, that wasn't enough to bother me on that day. ...After all, I wanted to disappear into the forest and vanish forever. ...If, by some chance, there really was a witch's mansion in the depths of the forest, ...I hoped that she might take me to the some paradise, or else turn me into a frog and make me a resident of the forest."
units.japanese: 「自分でも驚くわ……。あんな鬱蒼とした森を、よくもあんなに深くまで。……たくさんの梢や鋭い葉っぱで苛まれたわ」「でも、あの日の私は気にしなかった。……森の奥へ消えることで、永遠に消えてしまいたかったし。……もし、本当に森の奥に魔女の館があったなら、……自分を幸せの国へ連れて行ってくれるか、蛙にでも変えて、森の住人に変えてくれると思っていたから」

description: MG omits infinitive to in chose not call.
sourceReading: Chose not to call requires to. OriginalPC131038–131040 and UP use grammatical did not call.

units.text: "When Ushiromiya Rosa went to Kuwadorian, Beatrice told her a little about herself. ...In that conversation, she referred to you as Kinzo. It was the same when she spoke to you directly. Though she said that she thought of you as a father, she didn't call you Father. ...She either chose not call you that, or she wasn't allowed to call you that. That can only mean one thing."
units.japanese: 「右代宮楼座は九羽鳥庵にて、多少の身の上話を交わしている。……その中で、ベアトリーチェはお前のことを指して、金蔵と呼んでいる。これはお前を前にしても同じだ」「彼女はお前を父と思っていると言ったにもかかわらず、父とは呼んでいなかった。……呼ばなかったのか、呼ぶことは許されなかったのか。それが意味することは、一つしかない」

description: MG turns not merely a father-daughter relationship into denial of that relationship.
sourceReading: 親子としての関係だけでなく means not only the parent-child relationship. MG drops simply from originalPC131558–131560 and categorically negates it; UP preserves not simply.

units.text: "The Master stayed in Kuwadorian as much as time allowed. He would sometimes pretend to go on a business trip and stay there for several days, treasuring the time he spent with Beatrice-sama. ...It was not a father-daughter relationship. You could sometimes catch a glimpse of his great love for the dead Beatrice-sama, and it was a heart-warming thing."
units.japanese: 「お館様は、お時間の許す限り、九羽鳥庵へ通われました。時にはご出張と偽られ、何日も滞在され、ベアトリーチェさまとの生活を大切になさいました。……それは親子としての関係だけでなく。亡きベアトリーチェさまへの深い愛を垣間見れる、心温まるものでございましたとも」

description: UP calls the already installed puppet family head a puppet heir.
sourceReading: 当主 identifies the family head in Kinzo’s retrospective account. UP heir confuses that held role with the future succession explicitly distinguished371. OriginalPC132022–132024 and MG preserve head.

units.text: "A puppet heir, huh... ...I doubt that could've been easy."
units.japanese: 「操り人形の当主か。……気楽なものじゃねぇだろうな」

description: MG duplicates auxiliaries in imagine it being been kept safe.
sourceReading: MG being been is malformed. OriginalWH141579 and UP use grammatical passive constructions.

units.text: It really did look like an offering. A small French doll was sitting on the side table. The doll's hair...was gold. ...It was wearing a black dress. Just who managed to find this doll, and where? There's no doubt that someone placed the doll here to symbolize Beatrice. Does that mean...this doll is supposed to be the owner of this room, or something...? And, looking like an offering to that owner, ...there sat a small plate with several cookies and wrapped chocolates. It was all set out neatly, and there was no dust piled up on the doll. ...In other words, both the doll and the offering were taken care of on a regular basis by the servants, kept in good condition along with the rest of the room. Taken care of? ...No, it's more than that. It looked like an offering...no, like some sort of worship, a prayer saying "please don't curse us"... ...So, even though the doll was more than eerie enough by itself, ...viscerally, it was even more unnerving to imagine it being been kept safe and worshiped in a place like this.
units.japanese: それはまさに、お供えに見えた。サイドテーブルの上には、一体の小さめのフランス人形が座っている。その人形の髪は、黄金。……服は、黒いドレス。どこから誰がこんな人形を見つけてきたやら。ベアトリーチェを暗示して、誰かがここに置いたのは疑いようもなかった。ということは、この人形こそが、この部屋の主だとでも言うのか…。そして、その主にお供えするように、……小皿が置かれ、クッキーと包み紙で捻ったチョコがいくつか置かれていた。小綺麗に置かれ、人形には埃も積もっていない。……つまり、この人形もお供えも、日々、使用人たちによって手入れされ、部屋同様に維持されているということだ。手入れ？　……いや、これは手入れなんかじゃない。どうか、私たちを祟らないで下さいという、お供え、……いや、まるで崇拝にさえ見える。……だから、人形そのものも充分に不気味だったが、……こんなところに安置され、敬われているということそのものが、生理的に気持ち悪かった。
candidates: imagine it being been kept safe

sourceReading: Question399–402 opens quotation but MG402 does not close it; originalPC144192 and UP close it.

description: MG changes Kinzo accepting the child as his grandchild into accepting the child as her grandchild.
sourceReading: PS3 asks whether Kinzo can welcome Beatrice’s grandchild as family. OriginalPC146101–146102 says his grandchild. MG her substitutes Beatrice’s already stated relationship for Kinzo’s familial acceptance; UP family preserves source.

units.text: "There was one matter in which Genji did not trust the master he so respected. That matter was whether Kinzo would be capable of accepting Beatrice's grandchild as her grandchild." "Genji had served the Kuwadorian Beatrice for many years as well. He was very aware of what she had felt. He knew that she had accepted the favor Kinzo had bestowed on her and respected him as a father." "However, her love was not the same as Kinzo's love. Kinzo thought her to be Beatrice reborn... and tried to use her to satisfy the many feelings he had felt for the late Beatrice. Of course, the Kuwadorian Beatrice could not accept those feelings. In the end, she had her chastity stolen by the one she thought of as her only family and respected as a father..."
units.japanese: 「源次は尊敬する主人のことを、ただ一つだけ信じていないことがあった。それは、ベアトリーチェの孫を、果たして本当に家族として迎え入れられるのか、である」「源次は九羽鳥庵のベアトリーチェにもずっと仕えていた。その胸中についても詳しかった。彼女が金蔵の寵愛を一身に受け、父として敬愛していたことも」「しかしそれは金蔵のそれとは異なった。金蔵は彼女を、ベアトリーチェの生まれ変わりと思い、亡きベアトリーチェへの万感の思いの慰み者にしようとした。その思いを、九羽鳥庵のベアトリーチェが受け入れきれるわけもない。彼女は父と思い、尊敬してきた金蔵自らに、純潔を奪われることになるのである……」

description: UP includes an unresolved FIXME marker inside the story sentence.
sourceReading: Raw UP prose reads voiceless{FIXME?} laugh. Japanese, MG and originalPC147189–147190 contain no editorial query. This establishes textual contamination only; native rendering has not been verified.

units.text:
The shrill, voiceless{FIXME? laugh of the formless witch continues to mock my sobbing. The witch is right beside me, laughing at me. As I dash around the chapel, she's following along with me, taunting me. Then... she must be... there. She's right behind me, ......just over my shoulder, cackling away at this very moment. I know that turning around won't help, since she has no form.
I can try to look, but I mustn't look with my eyes. Once my eyes tell me there's nothing there, I won't be able to 1:‘see’"see" anymore. I learned that from the Director of the Gospel House. ......You mustn't try to seelook with your real eyes. ......You must ‘see’see with your mind's eye. The whole world is filled with God's love. In the many blessings of everyday life, one can find God, and angels, and the Holy Ghost. If you try to look at them with your eyes, you won't be able to see them or ‘see’ them.If you look with your eyes, you won't be able to see them. So you won't be able to feel them or understand them. Instead, you must quietly understand them with the eye of your heart. You don't look and have your eyes reflect their image.
You ‘see’"see"...{0and picture them in your mind. In this way, I learned how to recognize beings not of this world at the Gospel House. ......This power doesn't only allow you to ‘see’"see" God.
It allows you to ‘see’"see" all those not of this world.
units.japanese:
姿無き魔女の声無き高笑いが、私の嘆きを嘲笑う。魔女は、ずっと無様に探し回る私と一緒にいて笑ってる。私が礼拝堂をぐるぐる回るのを、一緒に付いて回って、嘲笑ってる。だから、いるのは、そこ。私のすぐ後、……肩越しの後にいて、今もくすくすケラケラと、笑っている。振り返ったって、姿がないのは知ってる。
見ようとして、目で見てはいけない。何もないことを目で知れば、視えなくなってしまう。園長先生に習った。……目で見ようとしてはいけない。……心の眼で、視なくちゃ。世界の全ては神様の愛で満たされてる。日々の恵みのそこかしこに、神様や天使、聖霊の姿があるのだ。その姿を、目で見て捉えようとするから、見えなくて、視えない。だから感じられず、理解できなくなる。心の眼で、静かに理解するのだ。見て映すんじゃない。視て、心に、描く。そうすることで、この世ならざる存在を知覚できることを、私は福音の家で覚えたのだ。……神様の姿を視えるようになるだけじゃない。
この力は、この世ならざる者全てを、視ることが出来る力なのだ。

description: UP uses an before mysterious.
sourceReading: Mysterious begins with a consonant sound and requires a. OriginalPC151225–151229 and MG are grammatical.

units.text:
That night. ......As I gazed at the ceiling from the bed in my dorm room, ......I looked at my hands. I couldn't sleep. The excitement from the time those keys danced was still there in my fingers... Is this... ...how Beatrice... ...how witches... ...always feel? ............I have a witch friend called Beatrice.
She always used to pull pranks on me with her strange magic. Because I saw this all the time, .........I thought I knew what magic was. But today... .....she had possessed my body......and used magic with it. The sensation of magic that I finally felt at that time......still held my heart entranced. It was a completely unknown pleasure. After all...... With a movement of my fingertips, .........the key had danced on command.
It was an mysterious, wondrous miracle of magic—something no Humanhuman could do. I still couldn't let go of that excitement... ........................
units.japanese:
夜。……寮の自室のベッドで天井を眺めながら、……自分の両手を見た。眠れない。まだ指先に、……あの、鍵束とダンスを踊った時のわくわくが、残っている…。あれは、……ベアトリーチェにとっては、……魔女にとっては、……当り前のことだったのだろうか。…………ベアトリーチェという、魔女の友人がいる。
彼女は不思議な魔法で、いつも私に悪戯をしていた。それをいつも見せられてきたから、………私は魔法を、知っているつもりだった。しかし今日。……彼女は私の体に憑依し、……私の体で魔法を使った。そこで初めて知った魔法の感触は、……未だに私の心を虜にしている。まったく未知の、初めて知る快楽だった。だって……。指先を動かすと自在に、………鍵が踊ったのだ。
ニンゲンには出来ない、不思議な不思議な、魔法の奇跡。まだ、……興奮が冷めない…。……………………。

description: MG changes the magic-versus-servant comparison by replacing than with when.
sourceReading: Source magic thrill exceeds being recommended as servant; originalPC151385–151386 and UP retain than. MG when makes the servant recommendation the more thrilling occasion.

units.text: "A witch. Beatrice. ...You see, today, Beatrice possessed me and used my body to do magic. That unknown world felt so...thrilling. It was much more thrilling when I learned that I'd been selected as an Ushiromiya family servant. It was like learning about a new world. ...As though I'd been living in a world of darkness all my life and thought I knew what the world was like, then finally learned what light was and saw the world for the first time. It was...joy. ...Excitement."
units.japanese: 「魔女。ベアトリーチェ。……今日ね、ベアトリーチェが私に乗り移って、私の体を使って、魔法を使ったの。その時、その未知の世界に、……こう、ぞくぞくっとしたものを感じたの。それは、右代宮家の使用人に推薦されたことを知らされた時よりも、ずっとずっと上」「知らなかった世界を初めて知ったような、……まるで、暗闇の世界だけに住んでて世界を全て知っているようなつもりになっていた私が、初めて光を知って、世界を目にするような。そんな、喜び。……興奮」

units.japanese: 「……いや、それで良いのだ。……誰にも解けぬ。だから、奇跡なのだ」

description: Being made to solve the epitaph becomes being allowed to solve it
sourceReading: The causative passive is arranged or induced solving, explained by the prepared Cinderella299 and staged farce301. Original PC161329/161331 retains made to solve.

units.japanese: 「碑文は、解かれたんじゃない。解かされたんだ」

description: MG rewrites the epitaph arrival clue and its solution as a treasure-power exponent puzzle.
sourceReading: The source concludes by reaching the Golden Land. CH16 explains 郷 read as kyou, then 京 interpreted as kei (10^16), one tenth giving quadrillion. MG adds treasure power and finality to the epitaph and replaces the Kyoto/kei reasoning with repeated exponentiation. Original PC163883/163977/164003 and164983/164985 preserve the Japanese chain and arrival; UP follows them.

One shall be all the gold from the Golden Land. ...Kinzo received a massive amount of gold from Beatrice, and rumor has it that it still lies hidden somewhere. Is this, as the family members and servants are all whispering, a code showing the location of Kinzo's hidden gold?

そして第十の晩に旅は終わり、黄金の郷に至る……。

一つは、黄金郷の全ての黄金。……金蔵は、ベアトリーチェより莫大な黄金を授けられ、今尚、それをどこかに隠していると噂される。これはやはり、家人や使用人たちが噂しているように、金蔵が隠した黄金の在り処を示す暗号なのだろうか。

units.text: "Right, that theory about a ten-day journey ending at the tenth twilight. "On the tenth twilight, at journey's end, you shall attain to the power of the Golden Land's treasures, once and for the last time." She took that section to be a literal trip that ends when you "attain to", or reach, the treasures of the Golden Land."

units.japanese:
「第十の晩の、黄金の“郷”に注目した推理だな。碑文の中には、他に四度も黄金郷という単語が登場するのに、なぜかこれ一つだけが、黄金の郷と記されている」
「なぜ、第十の晩だけ、黄金の郷なのか。これに気付くのにも、そしてどうしてなのかに気付くのにも、これまた長い時間を掛けました」
「楼座の推理はこうだった。黄金の“郷”をキョウと読み、京都の“京”と読み解いた。そして、懐かしき故郷から京都までの十日かかる旅路を十分の一した地点に、何か秘密があると疑った。………いい推理だったが惜しかった。“京”は京都以外にも読み解けたんだ」
「……“京”を、京都以外で読み解く……？　ん……」
「難しく考えるな。そのままだ」
「……京です。いえ、キョウでなく、ケイと読みましょうか。数字の単位です。一十百千万億兆、京」
「数字の、単位……！」
「ややこしいことを言うと理御が混乱する。話を戻そう。……第十の晩に１京に至るならば、第一の晩はいくつになる？」
「い、１京の十分の一ですから、……えっと、………千兆…？」
「正解だ。千兆から、鍵の選びし６文字を間引くんだ」
「Ｑｉｌｉａｎが英語である以上、千兆も英語であろうとはすぐに察しました」
「千兆は英語では、Ｑｕａｄｒｉｌｌｉｏｎ。……第５のゲームでの戦人の推理通り、１１文字だ。いや、これはあんたの推理だったか」

description: The hypothetical dead face becomes Clair’s face
sourceReading: Will asks what would have happened if the man had insisted on seeing the dead face and stepped inside. Japanese does not assign that face to the addressee.

units.text: "......That was a risky game from the very start. ......What would you have done if he'd insisted on seeing your face and just stepped inside?"
units.japanese: 「……始めから、危ういゲームだったな。………もしもあいつが、それでも死に顔を見たいと言って踏み入っていたなら、どうしていた」

description: Eva’s skeptical appraisal becomes astonishment
sourceReading: 眉唾だわ means doubtful or suspicious. PC250057/250059 and MG preserve skepticism; UP asks who would have thought it.

units.text: "One tenth of a "{ruby:kei:京"... Who'd have thought it?"
units.japanese: 「京の十分の一で千兆とはね…。眉唾だわ」

description: MG omits the article in this is source of
sourceReading: Source requires an article here; original PC251844 and UP are grammatical.

units.text: "I see. So this is source of the Golden Witch's magical energy."
units.japanese: 「なるほどな。黄金の魔女の、まさに魔法エネルギーっちゅうわけやな」

description: MG writes that’ll they need instead of that they need
sourceReading: Original PC252564 and UP are grammatical; the extra ll produces an invalid clause.

units.text: It was painful for Lion too. Lion would have tried to intervene and calm them, if that had been possible. The gold isn't going anywhere, right? If you just slow down and think, you'll be able to resolve this. Going by what Eva and the others said, it's clear that'll they need a lot of money before the end of the year. However, the billion yen cash card should be more than enough to pay for that. That would handle their emergency expenses, so they could then convert the gold to cash at their leisure...and just split it amongst themselves. Sure, maybe Krauss was the only one capable of converting the gold. That might give him an advantage over the other siblings. However, this gold couldn't be dealt with by open means. In addition to attracting public attention, it would also lead to various legal problems. It was better for this secret money to remain secret. If they wanted to get the largest portions possible, then they should all agree not to tell anyone about this gold. In other words, to maximize their profits, they would all need to make a gentleman's agreement...to keep this secret. Krauss did have a slight advantage. However, it was possible for the other relatives to refuse to cooperate and tell the world about the gold. And then, ...there was also the concealment of Kinzo's death to consider. Krauss was an investor. He needed not only financial clout, but also a certain degree of public confidence in him. His advantage isn't big enough for him to act so overbearing.
units.japanese:
理御もまた、辛かった。
自分がその場にいたなら、彼らを仲裁してなだめたかった。黄金は逃げない。冷静に時間をゆっくりと掛ければ、解決できる話なのだ。絵羽たちの言い分を聞く限り、年内に大きなお金を必要としていることはわかる。しかし、そのお金は１０億円のキャッシュカードで充分に支払える。火急な支出をそれで満たした上で、ゆっくりと黄金を現金に溶かし、分配すればいいではないか。確かに、換金は蔵臼にしか出来ないかもしれない。その分、兄弟での立場は有利かもしれない。しかし、この黄金は表沙汰に出来ないものだ。世間の好奇の目を引くだけでなく、いろいろ法律上の問題も出てくる。裏金は裏金のままにした方がいい。最も彼らが多くの取り分を得ようと思ったら、彼ら全員が、この黄金の存在を口外すべきではないのだ。即ち、彼らが最大利益を享受するためには、全員で秘密を守るという紳士協定が必要なのだ。確かに換金できる蔵臼の立場はやや有利だ。しかし、他の親族たちには、黄金の存在を公にするという非協力が可能なのだ。それに、……金蔵の死を隠しているという負い目もある。蔵臼は投資家。資金力だけでなく、ある程度の社会信用も重要な立場だ。彼が居丈高になれるほど、立場はそう有利ではないはずなのだ。

description: MG adds promiscuity to the PC reference to conceiving through sex
sourceReading: Original PC257366/257368 says sleeping with someone suffices to conceive; PS3 removes the explicit sex reference. MG sleep around implies promiscuity beyond either source.

units.text: "That's the thing about kids. If you just sleep around, they get made all by themselves."
units.japanese: 「子供なんて。勝手に出来るわ」

description: UP reduces kei from ten quadrillion to one quadrillion
sourceReading: 京 denotes10^16, ten quadrillion. PC260832/260833 and MG render this final unit correctly; UP uses quadrillion. The earlier 億 problem is tracked as modified canonical045 rather than counted twice.

units.text: A billion, a trillion, a quadrillion cats all bared their fangs. In the starry sky of cat eyes, countless flesh‐colored mouths opened, exposing countless teeth. ......The world was wrapped in flesh and blood and fangs.
units.japanese: 億、兆、京にも届く無数の猫たちが、一斉に牙を剥く。猫の目の星空が一斉に、肉色の口腔を開いて牙を並べる。……世界は、肉と血と牙で、包まれた。

description: MG writes a incredibly rather than an incredibly
sourceReading: The adjective begins with a vowel sound and requires an; original PC261126 has grammatical a truly, as does UP.

units.text: "Hey, pieces of Beato's game...? I'm gonna have you spin a incredibly brutal tale that I'll find incredibly entertaining. Tremble in fear of the certain fate you've been promised. ...By the name of Bernkastel, Witch of Miracles, ...and as the final Game Master of Beato's game, I proclaim it." "...Though just saying it would be boring. ...Maybe I should follow Beato's rules and say it in red."
units.japanese: 「さぁ、ベアトのゲーム盤の駒たち……？　私を最高に楽しませる、最高に残虐な物語を紡がせてあげるわ。慄きなさい、約束された絶対の運命を。……奇跡の魔女、ベルンカステルの名において。……そして、ベアトのゲームの、最後のゲームマスターとして宣言するわ」「……ただ宣言するだけじゃつまらないわね。……ベアトのゲームに則って、赤き真実で宣言してやった方がいいかしら？」

description: MG omits to before the recipient in the tale I have to offer up you.
sourceReading: The tale is the object offered and you the recipient, requiring offer up to you. Original PC125670–125674 and UP retain grammatical gift wording.

units.text: "...This is... the sole tale I have to offer up you."
units.japanese: 「……これは、俺からお前に捧げる、……唯一の物語だ」

description: MG adds a normality judgment and a Halloween rationale to Maria’s word preference
sourceReading: Japanese says Maria insists on a difference in nuance, while Ange treats the words as different things. Active original PC171218/171221 follows that distinction. MG imports obsolete commented English171219 and adds a Halloween rationale.

units.text: Maria was apparently speaking in English, but Ange, being normal, was not. Maria seemed to think the English word was more fitting for Halloween, but it looked like Ange thought kabocha and pumpkins were entirely different things. Everyone laughed, but Ange, not knowing why she was being laughed at, cocked her head to one side discontentedly.
units.japanese: 真里亞はニュアンスの違いにこだわって言ったようだが、縁寿の方は心の底から、パンプキンとカボチャは別の存在だと思っているようだ。一同は大笑いするが、縁寿にはなぜ笑われたのかわからず、納得いかない顔で小首を傾げている。

description: MG truncates the nose-blowing narration and leaves a lowercase sentence opening
sourceReading: Source explicitly describes blowing his nose with a handkerchief. Original PC171676/171677 and UP retain the introductory action; MG drops it and begins he in lowercase.

units.text: he didn't look like he could possibly be anyone other than a kindly grandpa overcome with tears at his grandchildren's gifts.
units.japanese: ハンカチで鼻をかむその姿は、孫たちからの贈り物に感涙を浮かべる、ただの好々爺にしか見えない。

description: MG reverses the floor-riddle hint without adjusting its range
sourceReading: MG claims only one ordinal from first through fourth does not end in th. First, second and third all do not. Original PC183249 says only one ends in th; the revised UP hint excludes first and second and is coherent with third.

units.text: "Precisely. From floor 1 to floor 4, there's only one floor that does not end in "th"."
units.japanese:
「そういうことだ。１階から１１階までの間で、ガイと読むのは１つしかない」
「お見事っ、正解よ…！　１階から１１階の間に、ガイと読めるフロアは３階（３ガイ）だけだわ」

units.text: "Well done, you got it...! Ignoring the first and the second, there's only one floor that does not end in "th", ...the 3rd floor."
units.japanese:
「そういうことだ。１階から１１階までの間で、ガイと読むのは１つしかない」
「お見事っ、正解よ…！　１階から１１階の間に、ガイと読めるフロアは３階（３ガイ）だけだわ」

description: Both releases add a signature to Kinzo’s photograph gift
sourceReading: ブロマイド写真 is a celebrity photograph; PC188436 specifies no signature, and originalWH188438 adds a poster medium but no signature. Both new witnesses call it signed.

units.text: And there, right by her pillow, was the gift from Kinzo, ......a signed celebrity photograph of Kinzo himself.
units.japanese: そして枕元に置かれたのは、金蔵からの贈り物の、金蔵のブロマイド写真。

units.text: And there, right by her pillow, was the gift from Kinzo, ......a signed celebrity photograph of Kinzo himself.
units.japanese: そして枕元に置かれたのは、金蔵からの贈り物の、金蔵のブロマイド写真。

description: MG specifies sparkling cider where the source says juice
sourceReading: Japanese ジュース and originalPC189583/189585 specify juice. MG replaces both occurrences with sparkling cider.

units.text: "Maria, you're a kid, so drink some sparkling cider instead!"
units.japanese:
「真里亞は子供なんだから、ジュースにしなさいっ」
「ほら、真里亞ちゃんも僕とお揃いのジュースにしよう」

units.text: "Hey, Maria-chan, why don't we drink some sparkling cider together."
units.japanese:
「真里亞は子供なんだから、ジュースにしなさいっ」
「ほら、真里亞ちゃんも僕とお揃いのジュースにしよう」

description: MG asserts sleeping where Battler describes a precaution in case of sleep
sourceReading: 寝ていたら悪いから gives a conditional reason for not knocking. OriginalPC190734/190736 preserves in-case sleeping. MG She was sleeping asserts the state.

units.text: "Hmmm... She was sleeping, so I didn't knock on the door, but if she locked it, that proves she woke up. ...Let's try knocking once."
units.japanese: 「んー……。寝ていたら悪いからとノックはしなかったんだが、鍵を掛けたってことは、起きたって証拠だしな。……一度、ノックするか」

description: UP duplicates the copula in that’s is hardly surprising
sourceReading: The clause requires either that is or that’s, not both. Original PC195557 and MG are grammatical.

units.text: "Well, that's is hardly surprising. After all, the culprit went on to kill Krauss and Natsuhi, so they've killed a total of not just six, but eight people."
units.japanese: 「まぁ、当然であろうな。蔵臼、夏妃まで殺しているのだから、６人どころか、８人は殺していることになるのだから」

description: UP uses the malformed complement trust the questioner that the problem can be solved.
sourceReading: MG and original WH coordinate trusting the questioner with believing the problem solvable; UP merges the constructions without the required complement relation.

units.text: "You can't get anywhere unless you start by believing it was made to be solvable. ......A battle of wits can't begin until you trust the questioner that the problem can be solved."
units.japanese: 「解けるように出来ていることを、まず信じろ。……問題は解けるように出されていると、出題者を信頼して初めて、思考の戦いは始まる」
candidates: trust the questioner that the problem can be solved

description: UP omits key selection from the goat’s epitaph quotation
sourceReading: The goat utters the six chosen by the key. PC203017/203019 and MG preserve selection; UP only says sacrifice the six.

units.text: ‘......On the first twilight......sacrifice the six...............’
units.japanese: 『……第一の晩に……、鍵が選びし……６人を……………』

description: UP uses the ungrammatical command Not hesitate
sourceReading: Battler announces immediate retreat. Not hesitate is neither an idiomatic negative imperative nor a nominal fragment; originalPC203989/203991 and MG are grammatical.

units.text: "Not hesitate. We're retreating. ......If we take too long to make a decision, even that road will be closed to us. Let's evacuate everyone. How can we open the door to the Golden Land?!"
units.japanese: 「即決する。撤退だ。……決断が遅れればそれさえ不可能になる。全員を黄金郷へ避難させよう。黄金郷の扉を開くにはどうすればいい？！」

description: UP replaces inability to unlearn with inability to know everything
sourceReading: Humans can learn but cannot unlearn657;658 refers back with cannot do this. OriginalPC210994/210996 leaves that anaphora intact; MG explicitly unlearn. UP instead says cannot know all.

units.text: "While people can learn, they cannot "unlearn"......"
units.japanese: 「人は、知ることは出来ても、“知らぬ”ことは出来ない生き物、也……」

description: MG misspells violence as violene
sourceReading: MG nominal rewrite produces violene. Active originalPC212586/212587 and UP use grammatical violently.

units.text: They were all so intent on tearing the guts out of Beatrice's cat box that they couldn't even hide the drool trickling from their mouths. Those gluttonous goat nobles, who derived pleasure from the violene of exposing the truth, were in a line of cars heading towards the meeting place.
units.japanese: 皆、ベアトリーチェの猫箱を、そのハラワタを引き摺り出して食い千切りたくて、滴る涎を隠すことも出来ないのだ。そんな、真実を暴く暴力性に快楽を覚える暴食の山羊の貴族たちが、黒山羊に引かせた車で、列を成して会場へ向かっているのだ。

description: MG turns Ikuko’s cheerful manner into an intention to cheer the narrator up
sourceReading: The narrator notices her cheerful manner toward him. OriginalPC215811/215812 and UP retain this; MG supplies a purpose of changing his mood.

units.text: With the haze my mind was in, it was extremely hard to make out what she was talking about. However, ...I was able to pick up on the fact...that she was trying to cheer me up.
units.japanese: 私のぼんやりとした頭では、彼女が何を言っているのか、あまり理解は出来なかった。でも、……彼女が私に対し、上機嫌に接していることだけは理解できた。

description: UP omits Erika’s formal thanks after praising the tea.
sourceReading: Firm independent UP omission: ご馳走様です omitted; MG retains thanks for meal. PC JP221030 / WH221032. Strongest alternative: tea praise implies appreciation, but distinct formal thanks terminates the mock-polite exchange. Minor omission/voice.

units.text: "That was one hell of a farce. But I will say that the tea was good. ......Well now, it seems that you've all been in agreement since the start. ......Allow me to ask for your answer once again."
units.japanese: 「とんだ茶番でした。でも紅茶は美味しかったですよ。ご馳走様です。……では、皆さんの意見は、最初から統一されているようですし。……改めまして、お返事をお伺いしましょう」

description: UP writes a embarrassed grin instead of an embarrassed grin.
sourceReading: Firm independent UP grammar: a embarrassed grin; original WH laughed embarrassedly. MG correct. Strongest alternative: no plausible grammatical reading for a before embarrassed.

units.text: Jessica gave a embarrassed grin. ......She looked even more relaxed than she had on the stage at the school festival.
units.japanese: 朱志香は照れ笑いを浮かべる。……その表情は、文化祭のステージ前よりリラックスしていた。

description: MG omits of in The sight this expression.
sourceReading: Firm independent MG grammar: The sight this expression missing of; PC Seeing this expression and UP correct. Strongest alternative: nominal sight construction still requires of.

units.text: Dlanor's hair bristled with rage. The sight this expression on one of her old friends...pinned Erika to the spot.
units.japanese: ドラノールの髪が、憤怒で吹き上がる。一度は友と呼んだ彼女のその形相に、……ヱリカは足が竦むのを覚えた。
